This study presents an interpretable stage-wise hyperspectral unmixing framework (I-HyperSU) under fixed endmember priors, which is explicitly decomposed into a fixed endmember matrix $\mathbf{A}$, an abundance block $\mathbf{X}$, and a structural residual refinement block $\mathbf{S}$. The X-block estimates abundances using FISTA with nonnegativity and sparsity enhancement, and a soft penalty that approximately enforces sum-to-one constraints. The S-block jointly applies low-rank SVD structural regularization and a lightweight deep image prior (DIP) to refine structured residuals. This staged design makes the interaction between abundance and residual components transparent and interpretable. Experiments on Samson, Urban, and Jasper Ridge datasets demonstrate that, under fixed and imperfect endmember priors, soft abundance relaxation consistently outperforms hard simplex projection. Under the default N-FINDR endmember prior, the proposed framework reduces the joint reconstruction error by 61.7\%--69.5\% compared with a fixed-$\mathbf{A}$ UCLS baseline, while keeping the abundance RMSE nearly unchanged, indicating that the residual refinement branch accounts for structured model mismatch without degrading the abundance estimates. For example, on Urban, the reconstruction SAM decreases from $5.99^\circ$ for the X-only model to $1.92^\circ$ for the full model.

</details>


### [277] [Hi-FLoop: Hierarchical State-Feedback Loops for Multi-Timescale World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08796)
*Rx Fan,Zhan H*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HI-FLOOP提出了一种分支一致的多时间尺度状态反馈框架用于多智能体交通仿真，通过场景级World分支、三档时间尺度（Goal/Preview/Control）以及前缀冻结的级联恢复机制，在8秒闭环生成中实现跨尺度一致性与生成状态自恢复，在H-D公共验证集上取得Overall 0.689987的成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长时域闭环交通仿真方法通常从初始场景一次性展开未来轨迹，并将意图推断、交互建模与运动生成作为一个整体求解，难以协调不同决策时间尺度，且生成状态演化过程中缺乏跨尺度一致性维护与自适应恢复能力。

Method: 提出HI-FLOOP框架：(1) 8个场景级World代表联合假设，所有智能体在8秒rollout中共享同一World身份；(2) 分支内采用三档时间尺度——8秒Goal锚定意图、2秒Preview协调交互、1秒Control生成物理运动；(3) 每0.5秒commit仅将已执行前缀作为新事实反馈，未执行假设不进入事实记忆；(4) Joint Preview Interaction (JPI)从Preview构建稀疏有向前向图，利用冲突概率与到达时间差门控交互精化；(5) 前缀冻结的A-to-B级联用于生成状态恢复：冻结模型A生成0-1秒，将类型化物理状态、可行上下文与分支索引（不含隐状态）传递给独立模型B进行重编码并恢复1-2秒。

Result: 在全部955个场景的H-D公共验证集上，单次S1跑分获得Overall 0.689987（官方评测器）；在智能体中心oracle评测下，8秒horizon oracle-minADE@8达1.196636 m，6秒horizon为0.526 m。

Conclusion: HI-FLOOP通过分支一致的多时间尺度状态反馈机制，有效提升了长时域闭环交通仿真的多样性、协调性与物理合理性，验证了分离决策层次与显式状态恢复策略的有效性。

Abstract: Multi-agent traffic simulation seeks diverse, coordinated, and physically realistic futures from maps and observed history. Long-horizon closed-loop generation must reconcile multiple decision time scales while its context evolves with generated states. Existing methods often unfold long futures from the initial scene and resolve intent, interaction, and motion monolithically, weakening cross-scale consistency and adaptation. We present HI-FLOOP, a branch-consistent multi-timescale state-feedback framework. Eight scene-level Worlds represent joint hypotheses, and all agents share the selected World identity throughout an 8-second rollout. Within the branch, an 8-second Goal anchors intent, a 2-second Preview coordinates interactions, and 1-second Control produces physical motion. Every 0.5-second commit feeds back only its executed prefix as new facts, while unexecuted hypotheses never enter factual memory. Joint Preview Interaction (JPI) induces a sparse directed future graph from Preview and uses conflict probabilities and signed arrival-time differences to gate interaction refinement. For generated-state recovery, a prefix-frozen A-to-B cascade lets frozen Model A generate 0-1 seconds, then transfers typed physical state, admissible context, and the branch index, but no latent state, to an independent Model B for re-encoding and 1-2-second recovery. On the full H-D public-validation split of 955 scenarios, one complete S1 run yields an Overall score of 0.689987 with the official evaluator. Under agent-centric oracle evaluation, HI-FLOOP achieves oracle-minADE@8 of 1.196636 m over the 8-second horizon and 0.526 m over the 6-second horizon.

</details>


### [278] [Evaluation Principles for MRI-MRA Registration in Trigeminal Neuralgia: An ROI-Centered Neurovascular Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08805)
*Xupeng Zhang,Xihang Wang,Michael Xie,Haoyuan Liang,Hau Ern Lien,Oishika Das,James Feghali,Risheng Xu,Peirong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将三叉神经痛（TN）MRI-MRA融合配准视为以ROI为中心的神经血管配准-评估问题，构建了包含149名患者、双侧三叉神经ROI标注的基准数据集，评估了六种配准流水线。研究发现传统全脑配准评估指标具有误导性，并揭示了局部MRA对比度、视野不匹配等因素对评估结果的关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TN术前评估需要MRI（显示神经）与TOF-MRA（显示血管）的联合判读，MRI-MRA融合在临床上有价值，但传统全脑配准评估不适用于这一任务——因为临床相关目标是小的三叉神经ROI、血管标注部分且临床聚焦、局部TOF-MRA对比度可变、视野不匹配限制变形配准。

Method: 将TN MRI-MRA融合定义为以ROI为中心的神经血管配准-评估问题，构建149名患者、双侧ROI标注的基准；评估六种代表性配准流水线，使用局部图像指标、分割派生的血管定位指标、预测体积分析以及对比度和视野分层比较。

Result: 传统评估总结常具误导性：局部图像相似性、血管-背景可分性和下游血管定位不能协同排序方法；单侧血管距离严重受部分标注下预测血管范围影响；局部MRA对比度决定血管可分性指标何时可提供信息。变形细化相比仿射对齐仅提供小的、依赖视野的益处；阅片审查显示局部有利的血管距离可与全局不合理的配准共存。

Conclusion: TN MRI-MRA配准应被评估为局部、血管感知、对比敏感且视野感知的可视化任务，而非通用多模态脑配准。代码已公开。

Abstract: Preoperative evaluation of trigeminal neuralgia (TN) often requires joint interpretation of structural MRI, which depicts the trigeminal nerve and surrounding cisternal anatomy, and time-of-flight MRA, which highlights vascular structures. Although MRI-MRA fusion is clinically attractive for visualizing neurovascular compression, this task is poorly captured by conventional whole-brain registration evaluation because the clinically relevant target is a small trigeminal ROI, vessel annotations are partial and clinically focused, local TOF-MRA contrast is variable, and field-of-view mismatch can limit deformable alignment. We formulate TN MRI-MRA fusion as an ROI-centered neurovascular registration-evaluation problem and construct a benchmark from 149 patients with clinician-annotated bilateral trigeminal ROIs. Six representative registration pipelines were evaluated using local image-based metrics, segmentation-derived vessel-localization metrics, prediction-volume analysis, and contrast- and FOV-stratified comparisons. Conventional evaluation summaries were often misleading: local image similarity, vessel-background separability, and downstream vessel localization did not co-rank methods; one-sided vessel distances were strongly affected by predicted vessel extent under partial annotations; and local MRA contrast determined when vessel-separability metrics were informative. Deformable refinement provided only a small, FOV-dependent benefit over affine alignment, while reader review showed that locally favorable vessel distances could coexist with globally implausible registrations. These findings indicate that TN MRI-MRA registration should be evaluated as a local, vessel-aware, contrast-sensitive, and FOV-aware visualization task rather than as generic multimodal brain registration. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/jhuldr/TN-Reg-Benchmark.

</details>


### [279] [ArmPoser: Real-Time, Calibration-Free Arm Pose Estimation from Smartwatch IMU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08806)
*Bishnu Dev,Vasco Xu,Xi-Aan Loh,Chenfeng Gao,Henry Hoffmann,Karan Ahuja*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ArmPoser是一种无需校准的智能手表IMU手臂姿态估计系统，直接在消费级智能手表原生参考坐标系中训练模型，消除了坐标变换、显式对齐和骨骼偏移校准的需求，并通过物理驱动的佩戴位置与手臂形态变化增强训练，在公开基准和自有研究上达到或超过校准基线的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于智能手表的臂姿估计方法依赖校准姿势和预处理流程，将原始IMU测量转换为标准化训练格式。这些步骤阻碍了日常场景部署，并因不完美的校准和传感器漂移引入误差。作者旨在消除这些障碍，实现在日常环境中的开箱即用。

Method: 核心创新是在设备原生坐标系中直接训练模型（与消费级智能手表实际生成IMU数据的方式对齐），无需坐标变换、显式对齐和骨骼偏移校准。此外，通过物理上合理的佩戴位置与手臂形态变化增强训练数据，以适应个体差异；并设计了穿戴配置模块，可推断前臂前后佩戴方向和表冠朝向。

Result: 在公开基准和一项包含10名参与者、30种活动的watchOS与Android智能手表研究中，ArmPoser在无需任何用户校准的情况下达到或超过了校准基线的性能。

Conclusion: ArmPoser证明了直接在设备原生坐标系中训练可以消除校准需求而不损失精度，为智能手表臂姿估计在日常场景中的实际部署铺平了道路。

Abstract: Arm pose estimation enables applications in fitness, extended reality input, rehabilitation, and life logging. Prior smartwatch-based approaches rely on calibration poses and preprocessing pipelines that transform raw IMU measurements into standardized training formats. These steps hinder deployment in everyday settings and introduce errors due to imperfect calibration and sensor drift. We present ArmPoser, a calibration-free arm pose estimation system using a single smartwatch IMU. Our central contribution is training models directly in the reference frame native to consumer smartwatches, aligning learning with how IMU data is produced by deployed devices. By operating on device-native axes, ArmPoser removes the need for coordinate transformations, explicit alignment, and bone-offset calibration used in prior work. We further augment training with physically grounded variations in watch placement and arm morphology to account for user-specific variability. ArmPoser also includes a wear-configuration module that infers anterior or posterior forearm placement and crown orientation. We evaluate pose estimation on public benchmarks and on a 10-participant, 30-activity study using watchOS and Android smartwatches, where ArmPoser matches or exceeds calibrated baselines without any user calibration.

</details>


### [280] [Beyond Gait: Person Identification from Millimeter-Wave Point Clouds Across Activities of Daily Living](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08818)
*Xilai Wang,Zixiong Han,Saad Rhanmouni,Chenzhe Zhao,Yunze Lu,Miodrag Bolic*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于活动条件化的毫米波点云身份识别框架。通过人类活动识别路由器将每个片段分发至特定活动的身份专家（监督式专家混合模型），结合双流静态-动态PointNet（DS-SDPNet）处理毫米波点云。实验表明，在七种日常生活活动场景下，硬路由可将识别准确率从62.1%提升至68.0%，双人重识别场景中mAP从57.2%提升至75.4%，Rank-1从59.1%提升至82.1%，验证了利用步态之外的ADL进行身份识别的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于毫米波点云的身份识别主要依赖步态（gait），但室内行走往往短暂且易被打断。为了弥补这一局限，研究是否可以利用其他日常生活活动（ADLs）作为互补的身份信息来源，并探讨活动是否能作为学习身份表征的有效上下文信息。

Method: 提出活动条件化框架：1）使用人类活动识别路由器将每个点云片段分派到特定活动的身份识别专家；2）以监督式专家混合模型（mixture of experts）实现；3）提出双流静态-动态PointNet（DS-SDPNet），同时融合时间聚合的空间结构特征与帧间动态信息。

Result: 在11名受试者、七种ADL的mm-ADL数据集上：硬路由将闭集识别准确率从62.1%提升至68.0%；双人ReID场景下mAP从57.2%提升至75.4%，Rank-1从59.1%提升至82.1%；活动特定专家优于共享嵌入，增益不仅限于缩小候选集。

Conclusion: 研究证明了在受控室内条件下，利用步态之外的日常生活活动进行身份识别的可行性，以及活动条件化对提升识别性能的显著价值。

Abstract: Person identification from millimeter-wave (mmWave) point clouds has mainly relied on gait. Indoor walking, however, is often brief and interrupted, while other activities of daily living (ADLs) may provide complementary identity information. We investigate identification across seven ADLs using mm-ADL, a new point-cloud dataset collected from 11 subjects under a controlled protocol. This extension introduces heterogeneous states and transitions whose spatial and temporal characteristics vary with activity. We therefore study whether activity can provide useful context for learning identity representations. We propose an activity-conditioned framework in which a human activity recognition router dispatches each clip to an activity-specific identity expert. The framework is implemented as a supervised mixture of experts, using a dual-stream static-dynamic PointNet (DS-SDPNet) to combine time-aggregated spatial structure with frame-to-frame information. We evaluate closed-set identification (ID) and subject-disjoint re-identification (ReID). With learned hard routing, ID accuracy increases from 62.1% to 68.0%. In a two-occupant ReID setting, hard routing increases mAP from 57.2% to 75.4% and Rank-1 accuracy from 59.1% to 82.1%. Under a matched gallery partition, activity-specific experts also outperform a shared embedding, showing that the gain extends beyond restricting the gallery. These results support the feasibility of using ADLs beyond gait for identification and the value of activity conditioning under controlled indoor conditions.

</details>


### [281] [Leveraging Visual and Geometric Priors for Metric-scale and Complete Vehicle Gaussian Reconstruction from Limited Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08841)
*Jinyu Miao,Jiusi Li,Yifei He,Miao Long,Kun Jiang,Mengmeng Yang,Diange Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种前馈式车辆资产重建方法，利用互补先验从稀疏单侧车载观测图像重建具有度量尺度的3D高斯车辆表示，并通过对称感知克隆策略补全未观测区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真车辆资产对可控交通场景生成（尤其是合成罕见的安全关键长尾场景）至关重要，但现有方法存在两个问题：一是图像到3D生成方法缺乏可靠的度量尺度；二是车载相机通常只能观测到车辆一侧，导致多视图重建在未观测区域不完整。

Method: 提出一种前馈式车辆资产重建方法，利用两种互补先验从稀疏单侧观测重建3D高斯表示。首先利用视觉基础模型作为视觉先验进行高斯初始化以实现度量尺度重建，然后通过可学习的编码器-解码器模块估计高斯属性。此外，提出对称感知克隆策略，利用车辆的左右对称结构作为几何先验，直接在高斯空间中补全未观测侧面。

Result: 在公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法在车辆资产完整性和几何精度方面显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了真实车载图像中车辆重建的度量尺度问题和单侧观测不完整问题，为长尾安全关键场景合成提供了高质量的可复用车辆资产。

Abstract: High-fidelity vehicle assets are essential for controllable traffic scene generation, particularly for synthesizing rare and safety-critical long-tail scenarios. However, reconstructing a reusable vehicle representation from in-the-wild onboard images remains challenging for two reasons. First, image-to-3D generation methods generally produce models without reliable metric scale. Second, onboard cameras usually observe only one side of a target vehicle, making conventional multi-view reconstruction incomplete on unobserved regions. To solve these problems, we propose a feed-forward vehicle asset reconstruction method, which leverages two complementary priors to reconstruct 3D Gaussian representations for vehicles using sparse one-sided observations. To achieve metric-scale reconstruction, a visual foundation model is first utilized to serve as a visual prior for Gaussian initialization. The Gaussian attributes are then estimated by a learnable encoder-decoder module. A symmetry-aware cloning strategy is presented to complete the unobserved side directly in Gaussian space, which exploits the bilateral structure of vehicles as a geometric prior. Experiments on the public dataset demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing approaches in both vehicle asset completeness and geometric accuracy.

</details>


### [282] [FIRE3D: Feed-forward Interactive 3D Scene Reconstruction Within A Minute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08848)
*Hongchi Xia,Tianhang Cheng,Wei-Chiu Ma,Shenlong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FIRE3D是一个统一的框架，能从单张RGB图像或随意拍摄的RGB视频，在一分钟内将其转换为可用于游戏和交互应用的、可直接用于仿真的3D场景资产。其核心是一个前馈、端到端的网络，从估计的RGB-D观测中预测组合式场景表示（包括每个物体的6自由度位姿、包围盒、网格和纹理），无需测试时优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么需要优化耗时过长，要么前馈方法缺乏物体级别的完整性，难以生成可交互、可仿真的场景资产。作者希望弥合从纯视觉捕获到可直接用于游戏/交互的仿真就绪场景之间的鸿沟。

Method: 采用前馈端到端网络，将从RGB采集估计的带姿态RGB-D观测作为输入，将场景建模为一系列离散实体（每个实体含位姿、包围盒、网格和纹理），实现组成式场景表示，无需测试时优化。

Result: 在姿态精度、几何完整性和纹理质量上，在多种数据集上达到具有竞争力或最先进的结果，同时比此前可交互方法快数个数量级。

Conclusion: FIRE3D在速度上远超此前交互就绪方法，且提供了超越现有前馈3D方法的物体级完整性，能够高效生成可仿真、可交互的场景。

Abstract: We present FIRE3D, a unified framework that takes a single RGB image or casual RGB video and transforms it into simulation-ready 3D scene assets for games and interactive applications in under a minute. At the core of FIRE3D is a feed-forward, end-to-end network that predicts a compositional scene representation from posed RGB-D observations estimated from the RGB capture, including the 6-DoF pose, bounding box, mesh, and texture for every object. By modeling the scene as a collection of discrete entities, FIRE3D produces amodally complete and simulation-ready environments where objects are physically decoupled and ready for interaction. Our framework requires no test-time optimization, runs orders of magnitude faster than prior interaction-ready methods, and provides object-level completeness beyond existing feed-forward 3D approaches. We demonstrate competitive or state-of-the-art results across pose accuracy, geometry completeness, and texture quality across various datasets while being orders of magnitudes faster. Project page: https://xiahongchi.github.io/Fire3D/

</details>


### [283] [DSE-VTG: Dual-Side Enhancement for Training-Free Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08850)
*Zhuo Cao,Bingqing Zhang,Sen Wang,Xue Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DSE-VTG，一个无需任务特定训练的视频时序定位框架。它在视觉侧通过多尺度相似度融合（MSF）结合帧级和片段级相似度来捕捉时间动态，在文本侧通过查询级测试时自适应（Q-TTA）优化查询嵌入以解决查询歧义。实验在三个标准基准和两个OOD基准上达到训练无关方法的最新水平，在Charades-STA上比最强先验训练无关方法mIoU提高5.61，在分布偏移场景Charades-CG Novel-Word上达到50.86 mIoU，超越最强监督基线2.76 mIoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的文本引导视频时序定位（VTG）需要密集时间标注和任务特定模型训练，成本高且在分布偏移下性能脆弱。虽然现有的训练无关方法通过直接匹配预训练视觉-语言表示避免了训练成本，但仍面临两个根本性信息瓶颈：帧级视觉编码忽略了时间动态，以及固定查询嵌入无法解决查询歧义问题。

Method: DSE-VTG采用双侧重增强框架：（1）视觉侧提出多尺度相似度融合（MSF），将帧级和片段级相似度结合为统一的时间感知相似度剖面；（2）文本侧提出查询级测试时自适应（Q-TTA），在测试时优化轻量级加性偏移以调整查询嵌入适配视频，无需微调骨干网络或调用外部大语言模型。

Result: 在三个标准基准和两个OOD基准上的广泛实验表明，DSE-VTG在训练无关方法中达到最先进性能。在Charades-STA上，mIoU比先前最强的训练无关方法提高5.61点。在分布偏移下（Charades-CG Novel-Word），DSE-VTG达到50.86 mIoU，超越最强监督基线2.76 mIoU。

Conclusion: DSE-VTG通过视觉侧与文本侧的双向增强，在完全不需任务特定训练的情况下有效解决了帧级编码时间动态缺失和查询歧义两大瓶颈，不仅在标准基准上显著优于训练无关方法，即便面对分布偏移也能超越强监督基线，展现出良好的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Text-guided Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) aims to localize the relevant segments in an untrimmed video based on text queries, yet collecting dense temporal annotations and training task-specific models remain costly and brittle under distribution shift. Recent training-free VTG approaches mitigate this issue by directly matching pretrained vision-language representations, but they still face two fundamental information bottlenecks: frame-wise visual encoding overlooks temporal dynamics, while fixed query embeddings cannot resolve query ambiguity. To address these issues, we propose DSE-VTG, a \underline{D}ual-\underline{S}ide \underline{E}nhancement framework that addresses both without any task-specific training. On the visual side, Multi-scale Similarity Fusion (MSF) combines frame- and clip-level similarities into a unified, temporally aware similarity profile. On the textual side, Query-level Test-Time Adaptation (Q-TTA) optimizes a lightweight additive offset to adapt the query embedding to the video at test time, without finetuning the backbone or calling external large language models. Extensive experiments on three standard and two OOD benchmarks show that DSE-VTG achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods. On Charades-STA, it improves mIoU over the strongest prior training-free method by 5.61 points. Under distribution shift, DSE-VTG reaches 50.86 mIoU on Charades-CG Novel-Word, surpassing the strongest supervised baseline by 2.76 mIoU. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [284] [SeGDeP: Semantic- and Geometric-Aware Decoupled Prompts for Reasoning Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08867)
*Linnan Zhao,Xu Liu,Lingling Li,Licheng Jiao,Fang Liu,Wenping Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SeGDeP提出了一种显式的"语义-位置"解耦接口用于推理分割任务。通过语义提示分支和独立的几何投影路径分别处理what和where信号，并联合条件化SAM 3掩码解码器，配合组奖励解耦策略优化(GDPO)进行训练。仅微调Qwen3-VL 0.38%参数（LoRA）即在多个基准上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM分割器接口要么使用特殊触发词，要么将语义识别和空间定位两种信号压缩进同一上下文，但这两类信号接受不同监督且失败模式不同。这种耦合导致无法诊断失败源于目标理解错误还是定位错误，因此需要显式解耦的what-where接口来分别建模和优化两类信号。

Method: 1) 设计双分支架构：语义提示分支与独立的几何投影路径，将解析后的MLLM状态分别转换为语义特征和DETR预测的边界框；2) 两路信号联合条件化SAM 3掩码解码器生成精确分割掩码；3) 两阶段训练：先对齐可执行接口，再使用组奖励解耦策略优化(GDPO)平衡格式、box-IoU和mask-IoU三类反馈信号。

Result: SeGDeP-4B在八个RefCOCO系列分割上平均cIoU达82.7，在ReasonSeg验证/测试集上gIoU达66.0/59.6，仅通过LoRA适配Qwen3-VL 0.38%的参数。消融实验、梯度诊断和提示干预分析进一步证明两条路径发展出互补的语义与几何特化能力。

Conclusion: 显式解耦what-where信号的分割接口优于隐式耦合方式，能有效分离失败来源并导向互补特化。解耦后的独立反馈优化策略（GDPO）能更好地平衡不同监督信号，在极低参数微调下取得优异性能。

Abstract: Reasoning segmentation converts an implicit linguistic conclusion into a precise mask, requiring both semantic identification and spatial grounding. Existing MLLM-segmenter interfaces either use a special trigger or compress both signals into one context, although they receive different supervision and fail differently. This coupling obscures whether a failure arises from target interpretation or from localization. We present SeGDeP, an explicit what-where interface. A semantic prompt branch and an independent geometric projection path transform resolved MLLM states into semantic features and a DETR-predicted box, which jointly condition a SAM 3 mask decoder. Training first aligns this executable interface, then uses group reward-decoupled policy optimization (GDPO) to balance format, box-IoU, and mask-IoU feedback. SeGDeP-4B reaches 82.7 average cIoU over eight RefCOCO-family splits and 66.0/59.6 gIoU on ReasonSeg val/test while adapting only 0.38% of Qwen3-VL parameters through LoRA. Controlled stage-wise ablations, gradient diagnostics, and prompt interventions further show that the two paths develop complementary semantic and geometric specialization rather than duplicating the same evidence.

</details>


### [285] [Medical AI Encodes a "Feeling of Error": Verifying Cancer Segmentation via Internal Concepts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08879)
*Mengmeng Ma,Yunxiang Peng,Tang Li,Lu Lin,Binsheng Zhao,Oguz Akin,Xi Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出利用机制可解释性工具（稀疏自编码器）从癌症分割模型的内部神经激活中捕捉类似人类"错误感觉"（Feeling of Error）的内部信号，用于预测模型自身的失败。在多个癌症分割任务上的实验表明，该方法优于基于输出的失败检测方法，同时保持分割质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 癌症分割模型可能静默失败，产生看似合理但不正确的掩码，可能导致漏诊或不必要的活检。现有的基于输出的错误检测方法（如预测置信度或不确定性）无法解释失败原因，且面临灵敏度与质量之间的权衡。作者类比人类的"错误感觉"（自发的不安感提示潜在错误），探询AI模型是否也具有类似的内在失败信号。

Method: 使用稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders）对模型的内部神经激活进行分解，将激活表示为人类可解释概念词典的组合。研究发现失败案例呈现独特的潜在特征：活跃概念数量更少且激活幅度更低。基于这些概念激活训练一个分类器用于失败检测，同时提供错误解释。

Result: 在前列腺、胰腺和脑癌分割任务上的实验表明，该方法在失败检测方面优于基于输出的方法，同时不降低分割质量。

Conclusion: 模型内部确实存在类似人类"错误感觉"的可检测信号，通过机制可解释性方法利用该信号可以实现更准确且可解释的失败检测，克服了基于输出方法固有的局限性。

Abstract: Cancer segmentation models can fail silently, generating plausible but incorrect masks that risk missed findings or unnecessary biopsies. A critical question arises: Do AI models "know" when they are wrong, and if so, can we use the signal to predict their own failures? Humans do have a "Feeling of Error" (FOE): a spontaneous sense of unease that flags a potential error during thinking. We investigate whether cancer segmentation models exhibit an analogous internal signal. Unlike output-level cues (e.g., prediction confidence or uncertainty), which offer no insight into why a failure occurs and suffer from a sensitivity-quality tradeoff where high detection sensitivity could degrade overall segmentation quality. We instead propose to capture the model's FOE from its inner workings. Using mechanistic interpretability tools, specifically Sparse Autoencoders, we decompose internal neural activations into a dictionary of human-interpretable concepts and show that failure cases exhibit a distinct latent signature: fewer active concepts with lower activation magnitudes compared to successful segmentation. By training a classifier on these concept activations, we achieve accurate failure detection along with explanations for the model's mistakes. Experiments on prostate, pancreatic, and brain cancer segmentation demonstrate that our approach outperforms output-based methods in failure detection while preserving segmentation quality.

</details>


### [286] [FRAME: Factored Retrieval via Attribute Readouts for Object-Centric Scene Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08886)
*Woosang Jeon,Sanghyeok Choi,Minwoo Kim,Taehyun Jung,Taehyeong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出属性组合检索问题，即用自然语言查询固定物体场景记忆以检索满足多重持久属性（如类别、材质、大小、外观）的目标物体。作者引入受控评估协议，并提出FRAME方法，将语言转化为查询相关属性权重，从物体嵌入中估计各属性证据并按查询聚合排序，在多个基准上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言引导的机器人需要持久场景记忆来跟随指令、重访物体和解析随时间遇到的物体引用。现有场景记忆检索多强调空间或关系引用，而日常物体引用常通过多重持久属性（类别、材质、大小、表面外观）来指定，这一能力尚未被充分研究。

Method: FRAME方法：1) 将自然语言转换为查询相关的属性权重；2) 使用学习到的读取头从物体嵌入中估计每个属性的证据；3) 根据查询聚合这些证据对物体排序。作者还设计了受控评估协议，使用固定场景记忆和属性定义的目标，将检索与感知及标注歧义分离。

Result: 在未见过的场景和物体资产上，FRAME优于代表性的场景记忆检索基线，并将分解后的物体评分简化为轻量级的矩阵-向量计算，兼具准确性与效率。

Conclusion: 属性组合检索可作为语言引导机器人的一种互补场景记忆能力，证明持久物体属性可以被呈现为可组合的证据，用于准确高效的多属性检索。

Abstract: Language-guided robots need persistent scene memories to follow instructions, revisit objects, and resolve references to objects encountered over time. While much of language-guided scene-memory retrieval has emphasized spatial or relational references, many everyday object references specify objects by multiple persistent attributes, such as category, material, size, or surface appearance. We formalize this problem as attribute-compositional retrieval, where a fixed object-centric scene memory is queried with natural language to retrieve the object satisfying the requested attributes. To investigate this capability directly, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol with fixed scene memories and attribute-defined targets, separating retrieval from perception and annotation ambiguities. We then propose FRAME, which turns language into query-relevant attribute weights, uses learned readouts to estimate per-attribute evidence from object embeddings, and ranks objects by aggregating this evidence according to the query. Across held-out scenes and object assets, FRAME outperforms representative scene-memory retrieval baselines while reducing post-decomposition object scoring to lightweight matrix-vector computation. These results position attribute-compositional retrieval as a complementary scene-memory capability for language-guided robots, showing that persistent object attributes can be exposed as composable evidence for accurate and efficient multi-attribute retrieval.

</details>


### [287] [CoSA: Correlation-Guided Change A ttention with Learnable Residual Gating for Remote Sensing Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08914)
*Abdirashid Omar,Jonghyuk Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究固定交通摄像头（CCTV）图像上的人行横道分割任务，探索数据高效的跨视角（first-person view到elevated CCTV）迁移方案。作者使用241张手工标注CCTV图像和5,926张无标注CCTV帧，训练DeepLabV3-ResNet50（42.0M参数），在40张留出验证集上取得88.91% IoU。通过对无标注帧进行置信度和几何先验排序，选出前1000张伪标签。重要发现是：报告中第二阶段的98.52% IoU存在方法论问题——由于目录布局不匹配，评价分割仅包含教师生成的伪标签而无法人标注，因此该数字应视为内部伪标签一致性而非对人工真实标注的准确率。系统在RTX A6000上达到77 FPS推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素级标注固定交通摄像头图像成本高昂，而从街景视角训练的模型在应用于高处CCTV视角时存在显著的视角和外观域偏移。作者希望探索一种数据高效的跨域目标域训练方案，减少对密集人工标注的依赖。

Method: 采用两阶段pipeline：(1) 源域实验：在3,300张第一人称视角图像上训练自定义U-Net（31.0M参数），作为源基线（非迁移结果）；(2) 目标域：使用201张手工标注CCTV图像训练DeepLabV3-ResNet50（42.0M参数），在40张留出人工掩码上验证；随后对5,926张无标注帧进行预测，使用图像级确定性和最大连通区域先验排序，选择前1,000张作伪标签用于自训练。作者还进行了仓库审计以核实结果的有效性。

Result: 源域U-Net在FPV测试集上93.05% IoU（作为源基线）。目标域模型在40张人工验证图像上88.91% IoU。无标注帧选择的前1,000张平均确定性0.976、综合得分0.988。审计发现报告的98.52% IoU实为在仅含伪标签的150张分割上测得的伪标签内部一致性（因目录不匹配导致0张人工样本进入组合数据加载器）。FP32推理在512×512分辨率下达12.98ms（77 FPS，RTX A6000）。

Conclusion: 置信度和几何先验过滤的伪标签策略在目标域上是可行的，88.91% IoU是可辩护的目标域结果。但必须强调伪标签评估须与自训练所用标签隔离，否则会产生误导性的性能数字（如98.52%实为内部一致性）。论文工作为数据有限场景下的跨视角语义分割提供了实用参考。

Abstract: Pixel-level annotation of fixed traffic-camera imagery is expensive, while crosswalk models trained from street-level imagery face a substantial viewpoint and appearance shift when applied to elevated CCTV. We investigate a data-efficient target-domain pipeline using 241 manually annotated CCTV images and 5,926 unlabeled CCTV frames. A source-domain experiment trains a 31.0M-parameter custom U-Net on 3,300 first-person-view (FPV) images and obtains 93.05% IoU on its 330-image FPV test split. This result is a source baseline, not transferred performance: the released CCTV notebook instantiates a 42.0M-parameter DeepLabV3-ResNet50 from torchvision weights, and no compatible mapping from the U-Net checkpoint is implemented. Training on 201 manual CCTV images and selecting on 40 held-out manual masks yields 88.91% IoU. The model then predicts all unlabeled frames; image-level certainty and a largest-component area prior rank the candidates, and the top 1,000 attain mean certainty 0.976 and mean combined score 0.988. A repository audit shows that the reported second-stage 98.52% IoU was measured on a 150-image split containing only teacher-generated pseudo-masks. Because of a directory-layout mismatch, the executed combined-data loader found zero manual samples and split 1,000 pseudo-labeled samples into 850 training and 150 evaluation samples. We therefore report 98.52% as internal pseudo-label agreement rather than human-ground-truth accuracy. The defensible target-domain result is 88.91% IoU on the 40 manual validation images. Batch-one FP32 inference at 512 x 512 requires 12.98 ms, corresponding to 77.03 FPS, on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 48 GB GPU. These findings support the practicality of confidence-and-geometry filtering while also showing why pseudo-label evaluation must remain isolated from the labels used for self-training.

</details>


### [288] [EgoSIS: From Factorized Visual Ego-Transitions to Motion-Canonical Spatial Evidence for UAV Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08938)
*Jingpu Yang,Fengxian Ji,Mingxuan Cui,Yilin Sun,Hang Zhang,Jianhua Zhu,Yufeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EgoSIS，一种无位姿适配器，通过三阶段将RGB派生的双向光流转化为运动规范的视觉证据，解决UAV视频问答中相机运动与场景变化分离的问题。在SIS-Bench上，EgoSIS-8B达到89.9%感知、82.5%感知加记忆和76.2%整体准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UAV视频问答需要将相机运动与场景变化分离，但仅依赖RGB的多模态模型缺乏明确、稳定的参考标准来进行这种分离，现有方法难以有效处理该挑战。

Method: EgoSIS采用三阶段架构：(1) FVET拟合鲁棒图像平面变换，暴露运动、残差支持和可靠性因子；(2) ReTEM使用可靠性加权更新维护有界历史，并在剪切或持续不确定性时重新锚定；(3) EASE将支持的视觉特征扭曲到每个片段的局部锚点，通过零初始化残差向每个视觉切片注入四个空间证据标记，不改变Qwen的视觉标记数量。

Result: 在SIS-Bench基准上，EgoSIS-8B获得89.9%感知准确率、82.5%感知加记忆准确率和76.2%整体准确率，最大增益集中在自我意识感知和记忆任务上。

Conclusion: EgoSIS提供了光流与空间推理之间可解释的接口，有效提升了UAV视频问答在自我感知和记忆方面的表现。

Abstract: UAV video question answering requires separating camera motion from changes in the scene, but RGB-only multimodal models receive no explicit, stable reference for that separation. We present EgoSIS, a pose-free adapter that converts RGB-derived bidirectional flow into motion-canonical visual evidence in three stages. Factorized Visual Ego-Transitions (FVET) fits a robust image-plane transition and exposes motion, residual-support, and reliability factors. Reliability-Gated Ego-Transition Memory (ReTEM) uses reliability-weighted updates for a bounded history and re-anchors it at cuts or sustained uncertainty. Ego-Aligned Spatial Evidence (EASE) warps supported visual features into each segment's local anchor and injects four spatial evidence tokens per visual slice through zero-initialized residuals, without changing Qwen's visual-token count. On SIS-Bench, EgoSIS-8B obtains 89.9\% perception, 82.5\% perception-plus-memory, and 76.2\% overall accuracy, with the largest gains concentrated in self-awareness perception and memory. The adapter thus provides an interpretable interface between optical flow and spatial reasoning.

</details>


### [289] [Prior-free relative 6D pose estimation of multiple object instances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08949)
*Behdad Khodabandehloo,Andrea Caraffa,Davide Boscaini,Fabio Poiesi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"无先验相对6D位姿估计"这一全新任务，无需CAD模型、模板或参考图像即可估计同一图像中未知物体多个实例之间的相对6D位姿。为此提出PROSE方法，利用多模态基础特征寻找实例间粗糙对应，通过环一致性约束优化，并构建PRENCH基准用于系统评估。PROSE在无需任务特定监督的情况下优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的6D位姿估计方法逐渐减少对物体特定先验的依赖（从3D模型到多视角捕捉再到单参考图像），但都仍假设已知要估计的物体。作者希望消除这一假设，实现真正的先验无关估计。

Method: PROSE方法：1) 使用多模态基础特征在未知物体的多个实例间寻找粗糙对应关系，无需训练；2) 通过跨实例元组的环一致性约束细化对应关系；3) 利用全局一致的对应关系估计任意实例对之间的相对6D位姿。同时构建PRENCH基准，由三个多实例BOP数据集构建并补充任务特定元数据。

Result: 在PRENCH基准上，PROSE一致优于将最先进的单图像方法适配到该新设置所得出的基线方法，且无需任务特定监督或额外学习组件。

Conclusion: 该工作将6D位姿估计推进到无需任何物体先验的极致形态，验证了基础模型特征在无监督位姿估计中的潜力，为未来研究提供了新问题设定与基准。

Abstract: Object 6D pose estimation formulations have progressively reduced reliance on object-specific priors, evolving from explicit 3D models to multi-view object captures to single reference images. We take this progression to its extreme by introducing prior-free relative 6D pose estimation, which lifts the assumption of knowing which object is to be posed within the scene. This novel setting aims to estimate the relative poses of multiple instances of an unknown object within the same image, without requiring CAD models, templates, or reference images. We solve this by formulating a novel method (PROSE) that finds coarse correspondences between object instances using multimodal foundation features, thus requiring no training. We refine these correspondences by imposing cycle consistency across tuples of instances, and leverage the resulting globally consistent correspondences to estimate the relative 6D pose between any pair of instances. To enable systematic evaluation, we design a novel benchmark (PRENCH) built from three multi-instance BOP datasets and enriched with task-specific metadata. PROSE consistently outperforms baselines obtained by adapting state-of-the-art single-image methods to the proposed setting, while requiring neither task-specific supervision nor additional learned components. Project website: https://tev-fbk.github.io/PROSE/

</details>


### [290] [Concentrate After Imagination: Text-Conditioned Evidence Grounding for Partially Relevant Video Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08999)
*Shuaiqi Cheng,Siyu You,Yanbi Wu,Yuxi Chen,Jiahao Zhang,Xuming Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE，一种用于部分相关视频检索（PRVR）的分数级证据验证算子，通过激活查询相关的全局视频寄存器并路由其支持到帧级证据，作为查询条件化的残差校准来缓解"查询无关的集中瓶颈"问题，在三个基准上均取得最优SumR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PRVR方法尽管改进了局部表示、不确定性建模和全局上下文，但最终排序仍倾向于信任最强的局部响应，导致偶然相似的片段产生无支撑的峰值。作者将此失败归结为"查询无关的集中瓶颈"（query-agnostic concentration bottleneck）。

Method: 提出TRACE算子：(1) 给定查询和全局视频寄存器，激活查询相关的寄存器；(2) 将寄存器支持路由到帧级证据；(3) 在局部时间选择前平滑地边缘化查询-寄存器-帧的替代路径。与表示层特征融合不同，TRACE仅将证据作为查询条件化的残差校准，作用于原始局部分数。

Result: 在ActivityNet Captions、Charades-STA和TVR三个基准上取得最佳SumR，较DreamPRVR骨干分别提升1.2、1.1和1.5分。消融、路由破坏、难负样本和跨骨干迁移分析支持增益来源于查询条件化证据验证而非通用的分数偏置。

Conclusion: TRACE通过分数级的证据验证而非表示级特征融合，有效解决了PRVR中查询无关的集中瓶颈问题，且验证了方法增益的机制性来源。

Abstract: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) retrieves untrimmed videos when queries describe only short moments. Although recent methods improve local representations, uncertainty modeling, and global context, final ranking often still trusts the strongest local response; a coincidentally similar fragment can therefore produce an unsupported peak. We identify this failure as the query-agnostic concentration bottleneck and propose TRACE, a score-level evidence verification operator for PRVR. Given a query and global video registers, TRACE activates query-relevant registers, routes their support to frame-level evidence, and smoothly marginalizes alternative query-to-register-to-frame paths before localized temporal selection. Unlike representation-level feature fusion, TRACE uses this evidence only as a query-conditioned residual calibration of the original local score. On ActivityNet Captions, Charades-STA, and TVR, TRACE achieves the best SumR on all three benchmarks and improves the DreamPRVR backbone by 1.2, 1.1, and 1.5 points, respectively. Ablation, routing-corruption, hard-negative, and cross-backbone transfer analyses support the interpretation that the gains arise from query-conditioned evidence verification rather than a generic score offset.

</details>


### [291] [DXPR: Depth-Based Vision-LiDAR Cross-Modal Place Recognition Using Vision Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09005)
*Yungsoo Han,Youngseok Jang,Seungwon Roh,Jeongyeon Seo,H. Jin Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DXPR是一个基于深度图像的跨模态地点识别框架，利用视觉基础模型(VFMs)将单目相机查询与LiDAR地图进行匹配，无需模态特定的编码器。通过将相机图像和LiDAR扫描统一转换为深度图像表示，使用单个VFM骨干网络学习模态不变的全局描述符，并在KITTI和Boreas数据集上表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统跨模态地点识别(CMPR)需要模态特定的编码器来处理相机和LiDAR数据的异构性，这限制了系统的泛化能力。本文旨在利用视觉基础模型的能力，消除模态差异，使机器人仅用相机就能在预构建的LiDAR地图中稳健定位，尤其是在季节性、天气和光照剧烈变化的环境下。

Method: 1) 将相机图像和LiDAR扫描统一转换为深度图像表示，使得单一VFM骨干网络加聚合头可以学习模态无关的全局描述符。2) 提出几何感知的重叠挖掘器(geometry-aware overlap miner)：先进行跨模态尺度对齐，再通过前向投影计算像素级重叠分数，用于重新标记模糊样本对。3) 自适应调制多相似度损失中的正样本边界，避免在弱重叠视图上过拟合。

Result: 在KITTI数据集上，DXPR在大多数序列中达到近乎完美的Recall@1，优于先前的CMPR基线。在Boreas数据集上，序列内性能与强单模态基线(DINOv2-SALAD)相当，在更具挑战性的跨序列设置中表现明显更优。与RangeBEV相比，在序列内和跨序列评估中均表现更好。

Conclusion: DXPR验证了通过统一深度图像表示和视觉基础模型，可以有效实现无需模态特定编码器的跨模态地点识别，展现出对季节、天气和昼夜变化的强鲁棒性，为仅依赖相机的LiDAR地图定位提供了可行方案。

Abstract: We present DXPR, a depth-based cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) framework that uses vision foundation models (VFMs) to match monocular camera queries against a LiDAR map without modality-specific encoders. This enables robots and autonomous vehicles to robustly localize using only cameras within pre-built LiDAR maps, even under severe seasonal, weather, and illumination changes. The key idea is to convert both camera images and LiDAR scans into a unified depth image representation so that a single VFM backbone with an aggregation head can learn modality-invariant global descriptors. To make pairwise metric learning faithful to scene geometry, we introduce a geometry-aware overlap miner: after cross-modal scale alignment of camera and LiDAR depth, we forward-warp measurements between views to compute a pixel-level overlap score. This score relabels ambiguous pairs and adaptively modulates the positive margin in a multi-similarity loss to avoid overfitting on weakly overlapping views. Extensive experiments on KITTI odometry and Boreas demonstrate strong performance and robustness across seasons, weather, and day/night. On KITTI, DXPR achieves near-perfect Recall@1 on most sequences and outperforms prior CMPR baselines. On Boreas, DXPR achieves intra-sequence performance on par with a strong single-modal baseline (DINOv2-SALAD), while showing clear improvements in the more challenging inter-sequence setting. Compared with RangeBEV, our method consistently performs better in both intra- and inter-sequence evaluations, demonstrating robustness under diverse seasonal and illumination changes.

</details>


### [292] [A Joint 2D-3D Statistical Shape Model for Orthopedic Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09010)
*Florence Dell'Aniello Picard,Pranav Poudel,Nairouz Shehata,Frédéric Lavoie,Herve Lombaert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种联合2D-3D统计形状模型（SSM），通过PCA在共享潜空间中显式捕获2D与3D分割之间的协变关系，直接从X光片恢复三维股骨形状，相比传统3D-only SSM基线方法性能更优，且推理速度快约4倍（每例不到3秒）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维股骨重建在X光片投影中丢失深度信息，属于病态问题。现有方法依赖3D统计形状模型（SSM）作为先验并通过迭代的3D到2D投影匹配进行重建，但这种方法计算开销大，且将SSM限制在单一维度，未能充分探索和利用2D观测与3D几何之间的统计关系。

Method: 提出联合2D-3D SSM：训练时将2D和3D分割配准到共同3D模板及其对应的2D投影上，将得到的平稳速度场用PCA联合分解，在共享潜空间中建模2D-3D协变关系。推理时对未见对象直接通过将2D潜坐标提升到3D PCA子空间来恢复3D形状，无需迭代3D-2D投影匹配。

Result: 在NMDID数据集上的实验表明，所提出的联合2D-3D SSM优于广泛使用的3D-only SSM基线方法，且推理时间约快4倍，每个对象耗时不到3秒。

Conclusion: 联合2D-3D SSM通过直接在数据中学习2D到3D的映射关系，避免了推理时的对应计算和迭代优化，在提升重建精度的同时大幅提高了推理效率，为X光片驱动的三维重建提供了更高效且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Three-dimensional femoral reconstruction from radiographs supports surgical planning, implant sizing, and post-operative follow-up, but remains ill-posed as X-ray projections discard depth information. Existing methods often incorporate a 3D statistical shape model (SSM) as a shape prior to guide reconstructions toward anatomically plausible shapes, relying on iterative 3D-to-2D projection matching. Yet, these approaches are computationally expensive and constrain their SSM to a single dimensionality, leaving the statistical relationship between 2D observations and 3D geometry largely unexploited and unexplored. We instead propose a joint 2D-3D SSM that explicitly captures the co-variation between 2D and 3D segmentations in a shared latent space. During training, 2D and 3D segmentations are registered to a common 3D template and its corresponding 2D projections, and the resulting stationary velocity fields are jointly decomposed using principal component analysis (PCA). This joint modeling allows the 2D-to-3D mapping to be learned directly from data rather than computing correspondences at inference time. For unseen subjects, the 3D shape is recovered directly by lifting the 2D latent coordinates to the 3D PCA subspace, thereby eliminating the need for iterative 3D-to-2D projection. Experiments on NMDID demonstrate that the proposed joint 2D-3D SSM outperforms a widely-used 3D-only SSM baseline while achieving inference approximately 4 times faster, at under 3 seconds per subject. The code is available at: https://github.com/florence-dellaniello-picard/joint2d3d-ssm.

</details>


### [293] [Spheriverse: 3D Scene Understanding from Spherical Observations in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09012)
*Fei Teng,Sheng Wu,Mengfei Duan,Guoqiang Zhao,Junhui Ma,Kai Luo,Siyu Li,Hao Shi,Zhiyong Li,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Spheriverse数据集（64,400对时间对齐的全景图像-LiDAR数据，覆盖多种场景与天气条件），并建立语义占用预测、语义建图和3D目标检测三大基准，评估30+方法。同时提出SphereOcc占用预测框架，通过CSRR和SER模块实现球面与笛卡尔空间的几何建模与语义证据检索，在mIoU和GeoIoU上分别超越现有最佳方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景（球面）观测数据提供3D场景理解的全局视觉上下文，但视觉信息编码在角度域（angular domain），物理世界则以笛卡尔坐标表示。这种跨空间表示差异导致了几何对应和语义证据聚合困难，现有方法未能有效弥合这一鸿沟。此外，缺乏大规模时间对齐的球面图像-LiDAR数据集来系统研究该问题。

Method: 1) 构建Spheriverse数据集：64,400对时间对齐球面图像-LiDAR对（644序列），覆盖多样场景、光照与天气条件，含细粒度语义类别；2) 建立三个基准：语义占用预测、语义建图、3D目标检测；3) 提出SphereOcc框架：CSRR将球面范围-方位角几何通过区域调制融入笛卡尔体素特征；SER基于体素内容和range-height-azimuth几何自适应从源球面图像特征中检索语义证据。

Result: SphereOcc在语义占用预测上达到13.91% mIoU和24.65% GeoIoU，较TPVFormer和SurroundOcc分别提升1.70和2.10个百分点；在全部五个场景的两个指标上均排名第一，且在不同空间分区和缩减视场条件下均保持一致优势。

Conclusion: 球面与笛卡尔空间之间的表示差异可通过显式的几何建模（区域调制与几何条件证据检索）有效弥合。Spheriverse数据集和基准将为球面感知研究提供标准化评估平台，推动该方向的持续发展。

Abstract: Spherical observations provide global visual context for 3D scene understanding. However, visual information is encoded in an angular domain, whereas the physical world is represented in Cartesian coordinates. This cross-space representation gap complicates geometric correspondence and semantic evidence aggregation. To delve into this challenge, we introduce Spheriverse, comprising $64,400$ temporally aligned spherical image-LiDAR pairs organized into 644 sequences. The dataset spans diverse scenes, illumination, and weather conditions, with fine-grained semantic classes. We further establish benchmarks for semantic occupancy prediction, semantic mapping, and 3D object detection, evaluating 30+ methods through overall and scene-wise comparisons. For dense prediction, we propose SphereOcc, an occupancy framework that couples spherical geometry modeling with semantic evidence retrieval. Cartesian-Spherical Representation Remodeling (CSRR) incorporates spherical range-azimuth geometry into Cartesian voxel features through region-wise modulation. Spherical Evidence Re-querying (SER) then conditions queries on voxel content and range-height-azimuth geometry to adaptively retrieve relevant semantic evidence from source spherical image features. SphereOcc achieves 13.91% mIoU and 24.65% GeoIoU, outperforming the respective best-performing methods, TPVFormer and SurroundOcc, by 1.70 and 2.10 percentage points. It also ranks first in both metrics across all five scenes, with consistent advantages across the evaluated spatial partitions and reduced fields of view. The established benchmark and source code will be available at https://feit-feiteng.github.io/Spheriverse.

</details>


### [294] [PIC: Revisiting INR for Image Coding with Fast Encoding and Sub-Millisecond Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09020)
*Xiang Liu,Jinxiang Wang,Bin Chen,Zimo Liu,Mingyao Hong,Jiawei Li,Yaowei Wang,Shu-tao Xia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了PIC（Practical INR Image Codec），一种前馈式隐式神经表示（INR）图像编码架构，通过单次前向传播计算INR网络所需的全部信息，实现20 FPS的编码速度和2000 FPS的解码速度，在RD性能和编码/解码速度上均达到或超越JPEG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: INR-based图像压缩器相比传统端到端图像编解码器具有显著的解码复杂度优势，但实际应用受限于较慢的编码速度和未充分利用的解码效率。现有INR编码方法无法同时满足实用编码速度、高解码速度和良好率失真性能。

Method: 提出前馈式INR图像编码架构（PIC），通过单次前向传播计算INR网络所需的全部必要信息，显著提升编码速度至20 FPS；同时实现高度优化的解码器，达到2000 FPS的解码速度。

Result: PIC实现了20 FPS的编码速度和2000 FPS的解码速度，在相当率失真（RD）性能下显著超越JPEG的解码性能，是首个在RD性能和编解码速度上同时优于或可比JPEG的学习型图像编解码器。

Conclusion: 本文首次实现了一个学习型图像编解码器，在RD性能和解码速度上同时达到或超越JPEG，同时保持实用的编码速度，为INR-based图像编码的实际部署铺平了道路。

Abstract: Implicit neural representation (INR) has achieved remarkable progress in novel view synthesis and image/video coding in recent years.Compared to conventional end-to-end image codecs, INR-based compressors demonstrate significant advantages in decoding complexity. However, their practical application has been hindered by the inferior encoding speed and underutilized decoding efficiency.In this work, we propose a feedforward INR image coding architecture, Practical INR Image Codec (PIC), that computes all the necessary information for INR network in a single forward pass, achieving an encoding speed of 20 FPS. Additionally, we implement a highly optimized decoder that reaches 2000 FPS decoding speed, significantly surpassing JPEG's performance at comparable rate-distortion (RD) performance. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first learning-based image codec that simultaneously outperforms or is comparable with JPEG in both RD performance and decoding speed while maintaining practical encoding speed. Code is available at https://github.com/actcwlf/PIC.

</details>


### [295] [Task-driven Processing with Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09025)
*Oleh Kolner,Thomas Ortner,Stanisław Woźniak,Angeliki Pantazi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CF-GAP是一种任务驱动的视觉前端，通过选择性引导一系列有限的视图瞥视(glimpses)来增强高分辨率图像的实例检测，避免全图像处理，可将检测器平均精度提升高达20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉模型处理整幅图像，缺乏针对任务选择性聚焦感兴趣区域的能力。在高分辨率、杂乱场景中执行特定任务（如实例检测）时，图像常被缩放到固定尺寸，关键细节容易丢失，导致检测性能下降。

Method: 提出Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception (CF-GAP)，作为任务驱动的注意力前端。它利用任务信息引导一系列有限的视图瞥视跨越场景，通过由粗到精的方式迭代地聚焦在最相关的区域，然后以高分辨率将这些区域送入下游实例检测器处理。

Result: 在HR-InsDet和Robotools基准上，CF-GAP将多种最先进实例检测器的平均精度(AP)提升高达20%，并能使轻量级检测器超越其更大规模的对应版本。

Conclusion: 通过避免全图像处理和消除不相关的干扰信息，CF-GAP有效地增强了实例检测器在高分辨率杂乱场景中的处理能力，验证了任务驱动的主动感知策略的优越性。

Abstract: State-of-the-art vision models process images in their entirety, lacking the ability to selectively zoom in on relevant regions. This limitation is particularly acute in scenarios where processing must be conditioned on a specific task - such as instance detection, which requires localizing a specific object in a high-resolution, cluttered scene. In such settings, critical details are easily lost as images are often resized to match the model dimensions and computational constraints. We introduce Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception (CF-GAP), a task-driven front-end that enhances high-resolution processing of existing instance detectors. CF-GAP selectively directs a sequence of limited view glimpses across the scene, utilizing task information to iteratively refine focus on the most relevant regions. These localized regions are then processed at high resolution by a downstream instance detector. By avoiding full-image processing and eliminating irrelevant confounding information, CF-GAP improves Average Precision (AP) by up to 20% across various state-of-the-art instance detectors on the HR-InsDet and Robotools benchmarks, while further enabling lightweight detectors to outperform their larger counterparts.

</details>


### [296] ["World Knowledge" in the Weights: Reading Concept Circuits of Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09055)
*Yanlin Chen,Tang Li,Xi Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出使用跨层转码器（Cross-Layer Transcoders, CLTs）从视觉Transformer（ViT）中提取"概念电路"（concept circuits），即节点为稀疏可解释概念、边为跨层概念交互的有向图。方法提供两种互补视图：全局概念电路（输入不变，从跨层权重直接恢复，揭示模型编码的可复用"世界知识"）和实例概念电路（输入相关，识别特定预测实际使用的概念与路径）。在三个应用场景中验证：自动虚假相关发现、虚假相关移除（在Waterbird数据集上比现有方法提升11.0%）、以及不同基础模型（如CLIP vs DINO）的可表示结构对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉Transformer虽然在视觉领域取得了显著的泛化性能，但其内部如何表征世界结构仍是黑箱。现有可解释性研究多聚焦于单层或局部机制，缺乏对跨层概念交互的全局理解，因此需要一种能够揭示ViT内部概念层级组织与信息流动机制的方法。

Method: 利用Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs)从ViT中读取概念电路：1) 使用CLT将网络跨层表征解码为稀疏、可解释的概念节点；2) 概念电路被构建为有向图，节点为概念、边为跨层交互；3) 全局概念电路直接从学习到的跨层权重中恢复（输入不变），实例概念电路则针对特定输入动态生成（输入相关）；4) 通过全局电路的统计特征实现自动虚假相关发现，通过对实例电路进行干预实现虚假相关移除，通过跨模型对比揭示监督范式差异。

Result: 1) 在自动虚假相关发现中能有效识别模型内部的捷径依赖；2) 在虚假相关移除任务中，通过干预实例概念电路引导模型走向正确预测，在Waterbird数据集上较现有方法提升11.0%的准确率；3) 通过对比不同基础模型（CLIP vs DINO）的全局概念电路，揭示了不同监督范式（对比学习vs自监督）对模型表征结构塑造的差异。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 概念电路提供了一种统一、可解释的框架来理解ViT内部的"世界知识"组织方式，兼顾全局结构化理解与实例级精细解释，并在虚假相关诊断/修复及模型对比等实际任务中展现出有效性与实用价值，为视觉Transformer的可解释性研究开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Vision transformers (ViTs) have achieved remarkable generalization across visual domains, yet little is known about how they internally represent the structure of the world. To address this gap, we use Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) to read concept circuits from ViTs: directed graphs whose nodes correspond to sparse, interpretable concepts and edges capture concept interactions across layers. Our method yields two complementary views of model behavior. The global concept circuit is input-invariant and can be recovered directly from learned cross-layer weights, exposing the reusable "world knowledge" encoded in the model. The instance concept circuit is input-dependent and identifies the concepts and pathways actually used for a specific prediction, enabling faithful example-level explanations. We demonstrate the utility of concept circuits in three ways: (1) Automatic spurious correlation discovery: leveraging the statistics of our global concept circuits to identify shortcut dependencies within the model. (2) Spurious correlation removal: intervening on the instance concept circuit to steer the model towards correct predictions. Empirical results show that our method outperforms existing counterparts by 11.0% on the Waterbird dataset. (3) Model comparison: contrasting the global concept circuits of different foundation models (e.g., CLIP vs. DINO) to reveal how supervision paradigms shape representational structure. Our code is available at https://github.com/deep-real/VisionCLT

</details>


### [297] [GoDeep: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding via Language-Space Lifting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09082)
*Thodoris Betsas,Anastasios Doulamis,Andreas Georgopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GoDeep方法，将视觉语言模型仅用作翻译器，生成结构化的实体级描述，然后在纯语言嵌入空间中直接聚合3D分割结果，无需3D训练语料或专用3D编码器，在ScanNet++和文化遗产基准上表现出竞争性甚至更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的开放词汇3D语义分割方法通常将CLIP特征提升到3D空间，但这种方法在组合任务上表现类似词袋模型，且需要大量3D训练语料和每领域专用的3D编码器，成本高且泛化能力受限。

Method: 利用视觉语言模型作为翻译器，为每个姿态图像生成结构化、实体级的描述；将这些描述进行定位、投影并在通用的纯语言嵌入空间中聚合，完全不需要3D训练语料或专用3D编码器。同时利用启发式权重和可解释性提出聚合策略，提升细粒度元素定位。

Result: 在ScanNet++上与强注释无关基线竞争；在5栋建筑的文化遗产基准上，原始分数CLIP变体更高，但一次系统性词汇校正即可逆转排名，并通过第二次独立校正得到验证；在ScanNet++上对真正OOV对象表现出更强的分离能力并能定位OOV对象。

Conclusion: 语言空间嵌入比CLIP嵌入更忠实地追踪物理内容，能清晰区分存在与缺失的对象，且所有表示保持离散文本形式，预测可在点级别解释，无需任何2D-3D注释。

Abstract: Open vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation methods typically lift CLIP features into 3D. This embeds points in a joint vision-language space known to behave like a bag-of-words on compositional tasks. Furthermore, even annotation free variants often require a large 3D training corpus and a dedicated 3D encoder per domain. Instead we use a vision-language model purely as a translator. It produces structured, entity-level descriptions of each posed image. These descriptions are grounded, projected, and aggregated directly in a general-purpose, language-only embedding space, with no 3D training corpus or encoder required. On ScanNet++, our pipeline is competitive with strong annotation free baselines trained on ScanNet. On a 5-building cultural heritage benchmark, raw scores initially favor a CLIP-based variant, but a single systematic vocabulary correction reverses this ranking. An effect confirmed by a second, independent correction on a different class, indicating that language-space embeddings track physical content more faithfully. This fidelity extends to genuinely out-of-vocabulary (OOV) objects on ScanNet++ proving that language-space embeddings separate presence from absence objects far more sharply than CLIP-based embeddings do. GoDeep also localize these OOV objects within the scene, all without any 2D-3D annotation. Because every representation remains discrete text, predictions are also explainable at the point level. Finally, exploiting both a heuristic weighting, that favors precise over merely frequent observations and GoDeep's explainability property, we propose an aggregation strategy, as a proof of concept, that favors finer elements localization.

</details>


### [298] [Mask Forcing: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion Distillation via Dual-Noise Masking Rollout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09123)
*Zhuoran Zhao,Shengju Qian,Tongtong Liang,Xianghao Kong,Songchun Zhang,Junchao Huang,Guian Fang,Xin Wang,Pan Hui,Anyi Rao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Mask Forcing方法，通过双噪声掩码自滚动策略（Dual-Noise Masking Rollout）解决自回归（AR）视频扩散模型在分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）中因反向KL目标导致的模式坍缩问题，从而提升生成视频的视觉质量和真实感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AR视频扩散模型通过DMD蒸馏预训练的双向扩散模型，但生成的视频存在过饱和和过平滑问题。其根本原因是DMD中的反向KL目标具有模式寻求（mode-seeking）行为，导致学生分布坍缩到教师分布的少数几个模式上，限制了生成视频的视觉质量和真实感。

Method: 提出Mask Forcing策略，即Dual-Noise Masking Rollout方法。核心思想是在AR扩散蒸馏的自滚动过程中，通过沿空间和时间轴随机掩码，将更干净的信号注入到带噪的滚动输入中。这些扰动鼓励学生滚动探索教师分布的更多区域，使DMD提供超越学生已覆盖模式的更丰富的学习信号；同时，更干净的token作为去噪指导帮助其他噪声较大的token，改善中间滚动预测并减少误差累积。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法能有效提升多种AR视频扩散蒸馏方法的视觉质量，且无需引入真实视频数据或额外的后训练阶段，计算效率高。

Conclusion: Mask Forcing通过简单的随机掩码扰动策略有效缓解了反向KL模式寻求导致的模式坍缩问题，为AR视频扩散蒸馏提供了一种高效且通用的改进方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models have shown great potential in real-time video generation. Recent methods distill pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into causal AR students through Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), but the generated videos often suffer from over-saturation and over-smoothing issues, resulting in limited visual quality and realism. The key contributing factor is the mode-seeking behavior of the reverse KL objective in DMD, which can cause the student distribution to collapse onto only a few modes of the teacher distribution. To address this, we propose Mask Forcing, a Dual-Noise Masking Rollout strategy that perturbs the AR student self-rollout to mitigate mode collapse induced by reverse-KL mode seeking. The core idea is to inject cleaner signals into noisy rollout inputs via random masks along spatial and temporal axes during the self-rollout process of AR diffusion distillation. Such perturbations encourage the student rollouts to explore more regions of the teacher distribution, allowing DMD to provide learning signals beyond the modes already covered by the student. Moreover, the cleaner tokens act as denoising guidance for other noisier tokens, improving the intermediate rollout predictions and reducing error accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method improves multiple AR video diffusion distillation methods with higher visual quality efficiently, without incorporating real video data or additional post-training stages.

</details>


### [299] [Canonical Color as a Lens into Concept Decodability in Vision Encoders and VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09124)
*Xiaofu Chen,Stella Frank,Yova Kementchedjhieva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究视觉编码器中概念性信息（而非仅视觉可见信息）的编码程度。以"标准颜色"（canonical color）作为受控测试案例，探究当输入为灰度图像时，视觉编码器是否仍能以线性方式解码出物体的标准颜色信息。实验发现标准颜色（如香蕉的黄）从灰度图像中仍可线性解码，且与预测的对象身份紧密相关，表明存在概念性关联。进一步分析完整VLM后发现，VLM的后训练对视觉编码器中的颜色可解码性有显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉编码器为视觉语言模型构建图像表示，但人们不清楚这种表示中究竟包含多少概念性（概念性）而非仅直接可见的信息。标准颜色提供了一个理想的研究透镜——它既是物体本质属性，又不直接存在于灰度图像中，可用于检验编码器是否承载超越像素层面的概念语义。

Method: 1) 构建具有标准颜色的物体数据集；2) 分别使用彩色和灰度图像作为输入，对视觉编码器进行探针实验（probing），检验颜色和物体身份的可线性解码性；3) 将分析扩展至完整的VLM，考察后训练阶段如何影响视觉编码器中标准颜色的可解码程度。

Result: 1) 标准颜色在灰度图像输入下仍可从视觉编码器中解码出来，且这一解码与预测的物体身份相关联，表明存在概念性联系；2) VLM的后训练对视觉编码器中颜色的可解码性产生显著影响。

Conclusion: 标准颜色是追踪视觉编码器和VLM中物体级概念语义信息的有效且可控的研究透镜。视觉编码器不仅在像素层面编码颜色，还在概念层面将物体身份与其典型颜色关联起来，而VLM后训练会显著重塑这一概念表征。

Abstract: Visual encoders construct a representation of the image input for Vision-Language models. How much conceptual, as opposed to immediately visible, information does this representation contain? We use canonical color as a controlled test case to ask whether vision encoders make canonical-color information linearly accessible, even when color is removed from the input image. We construct a dataset of objects with canonical colors, and probe vision encoders for both color and object identity using color and grayscale images. We find that canonical color remains decodable from grayscale images, and is tied to predicted object identity, indicating a conceptual link. Extending this analysis to full VLMs, we find that VLM post-training can have a surprisingly large effect on color decodability in the vision encoder. Overall, canonical color provides a usefully controllable lens for tracing object-level conceptual semantic information in vision encoders and VLMs.

</details>


### [300] [Point4D: Long-range 4D Motion Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09145)
*Minsik Jeon,Jay Karhade,Deva Ramanan,Shubham Tulsiani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Point4D是一个前馈式4D重建模型，能够对数百帧的长视频序列可靠地推断密集的每点3D轨迹，突破了现有4D方法仅能处理数十帧短输入窗口的限制。其核心创新是灵活的3D查询运动解码器，将轨迹预测与图像平面可见性解耦，并通过跨帧视觉描述符重用提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4D重建方法受限于短输入窗口（最多几十帧），无法处理多百帧的长视频序列，难以在长时间范围内稳健地追踪密集3D点轨迹。

Method: 1) 提出灵活的3D查询运动解码器，将轨迹预测与图像平面可见性解耦；2) 预测的3D端点可直接在下一块中重新查询，无需重投影或匹配；3) 从任意可见帧提取并重用视觉描述符，而非仅依赖源图像块。

Result: 在覆盖200帧以上的多种长视频追踪基准上取得了最先进的性能，大幅优于此前的前馈式4D方法。

Conclusion: Point4D证明了前馈式网络具备处理超长视频4D重建的能力，其查询解耦与描述符重用策略是提升长范围轨迹追踪性能的有效途径。

Abstract: We introduce Point4D, a feed-forward model for 4D reconstruction of long-range video sequences. Point4D is able to reliably infer dense per-point 3D trajectories across multi-hundred-frame videos, unlike existing 4D methods that are limited to short input windows of at most a few dozen frames. A key innovation that enables this is our flexible 3D query-based motion decoder that decouples trajectory prediction from image-plane visibility. The predicted 3D endpoints are then directly re-queried in the next chunk without re-projection or matching. Furthermore, we show that extracting and reusing a visual descriptor from an arbitrary frame where the point is visible leads to better performance than relying solely on the source patch. Overall, Point4D achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse long-video tracking benchmarks spanning over 200 frames and largely outperforms previous feed-forward 4D method. Project page: https://point-4d.github.io

</details>


### [301] [SyncWorld: Visual Calibration Enables World Models as Zero-Shot Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09155)
*Yuncong Yang,Zhengtao Han,Furkan Ozyurt,Zeyuan Yang,Han Yang,Junyi Cao,Haoyu Zhen,Yilun Du,Chuang Gan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SyncWorld是一个以动作为条件的零样本世界模型，通过在上下文中利用视觉校准片段（paired frames和动作）来指定特定环境下的动作-视觉映射，使其能够在未见过的环境中进行零样本模拟，无需额外训练，并能实现无需训练的测试时策略改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人世界模型作为策略回路的想象环境时，需要细粒度控制，但动作在像素空间中不是通用语言——环境变化、相机视角、机器人位置或形态改变都会使相同数值动作产生不同视觉表现，导致混合训练时出现冲突监督和部署时泛化脆弱。

Method: SyncWorld引入视觉校准片段（包含成对帧和动作，展示所有可控自由度）来在上下文中指定特定设置下的动作-视觉映射。训练时使用视觉校准上下文，让模型学会通过视觉证据解释动作，并在缺乏显式校准时利用交互历史。

Result: 实验表明SyncWorld能准确模拟先前未见环境中的动作结果，且其模拟回放能力可在无需训练的情况下实现测试时策略改进。

Conclusion: 通过上下文化视觉校准，世界模型可以克服动作在像素空间中非通用的问题，实现跨未见环境的零样本模拟能力。

Abstract: World models are increasingly used as policy-in-the-loop imagination environments, where reliable rollouts require fine-grained controllability with respect to low-level robot actions. A key obstacle to scaling such models in robotics is that actions are not a universal language in pixel space: changes in visual environment, camera view, robot placement, or embodiment alter how the same numerical action manifests visually, leading to conflicting supervision under mixed training and brittle generalization at deployment. We introduce SyncWorld, an action-conditioned world model that serves as a zero-shot simulator across unseen environments without any additional training. SyncWorld leverages a visual calibration episode---paired frames and actions that showcase all the controllable degrees of freedom---to specify the setup-specific Action--Visual Mapping in context. Training with visual calibration contexts teaches the model to interpret actions through visual evidence and to leverage interaction history when explicit calibration is unavailable. Experiments show that SyncWorld can accurately simulate action outcomes in previously unseen settings, and that its capability of simulating rollouts enables test-time policy improvement without training.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [302] [When Agent Governance Helps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05531)
*Michael Ray Johnson,Linda Naimi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次提出并验证了受治理的自主体AI组织（GAMPO框架）的设计与评估方法，通过321篇文献的综合分析提炼出可运行的规范，并在医疗基准CHI-Bench上跨开源与前沿模型进行实证检验。核心发现是：治理收益受模型剩余能力制约，具有领域和模型特异性；在能力受限的开源模型上完整流程无可靠收益，而前沿模型上基于案例的"完成定义"规范优于统一流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前不存在关于如何在护栏内让自主体追求自生成目标的受治理AI代理组织应该如何设计与评估的规范说明，这一空白亟需填补。

Method: 1) 对321个来源进行基于文档的定性证据综合，整合代理、敏捷、平台和治理理论，构建GAMPO框架的可运行规范；2) 在CHI-Bench（长期医疗基准）上对GAMPO的提示层实例化进行跨模型（开放与前沿）测试，比较完整流程、单句提示及基于案例的"完成定义"等多种治理策略。

Result: 治理收益受模型剩余能力门槛限制：能力受限的开源模型上完整流程无可靠收益，但单句"验证写入"提示使成功率翻倍（2/20→4/20）；前沿模型上同一脚手架将授权通过率从24%提升至40%，但另一模型净收益为零（归因于稳定的推荐覆盖倾向）。将通用流程替换为仅基于案例政策和公开标准的、与答案无关的按任务"完成定义"后，授权通过率在5次最佳自洽下达84%（单次68%），利用管理达44%，但护理管理遭遇主观内容质量瓶颈。

Conclusion: 贡献在于一个具名、可审计的框架（GAMPO）及能力门槛证据：治理应依据模型的剩余能力量体裁衣，在前沿处基于案例的规范优于统一流程。但研究属探索性：仅部分实例化、每格样本量小（n=5-25）、单次试验。

Abstract: No specification says how a governed autotelic AI agent organization, where agents pursue self-generated goals inside guardrails, should be designed and evaluated. We answer in two parts. First, we synthesize the Governed Autotelic Multi-Agent Product Organization (GAMPO) framework from a document-based qualitative evidence synthesis of 321 sources, integrating agency, agile, platform, and governance theory into a runnable specification. Second, we probe a prompt-layer instantiation of GAMPO on CHI-Bench, a long-horizon healthcare benchmark, across open and frontier models. The result is a boundary condition: governance benefit is gated by a model's spare capacity and is domain- and model-specific. On capacity-constrained open models the full procedure yields no reliable benefit, whereas a single "verify your writes" sentence doubles task success (pass@1 2/20 to 4/20). At the frontier the same scaffold lifts prior-authorization 24% to 40% but nets zero on another model, a gap traced to a stable recommendation-override disposition. A second result refines the first: replacing the generic procedure with an answer-blind, per-task definition-of-done, keyed only to the case's own policy and published standards, never the hidden key, raises prior-authorization to 84% under best-of-five self-consistency (68% single-attempt, confirmed by a held-out board) and utilization-management to 44%, while care-management meets a subjective content-quality wall. The contribution is a named, auditable framework and capability-gated evidence that governance should be sized to spare capacity, and that at the frontier a case-grounded specification beats a uniform procedure. Findings are exploratory: partial instantiation, small per-cell samples (n = 5-25), and single trials.

</details>


### [303] [TamilEOT: A Dataset and Model for Semantic End-of-Turn Detection in Tamil Telephone Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05631)
*Santhoshkumar V*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发布 TamilEOT，一个包含 18,485 个标注语轮边界（来自 116 通真实泰米尔语电话对话）的数据集，以及两个基于 Smart Turn v3 微调的音频端到端（EOT）检测器。在 4,168 个片段（来自 30 通未见通话）的保留测试集上，准确率从零样本的 70.30% 提升至 83.71%（8.7 MB）和 86.13%（21 MB），ROC-AUC 从 0.751 提升至 0.921，模型可在单线程 CPU 上 150 ms 内运行。论文还披露了数据标注代价、标签质量问题及复现差异等负面结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音智能体在每个停顿处都需判断用户是否说完。若无语言模型，该决策只能依赖固定静默超时：设短则打断，设长则每轮都付出完整等待代价。虽已有开放语义端到端检测器，但据作者所知没有任何一个覆盖南印度语言，因此需要为泰米尔语构建此类检测器及配套数据集。

Method: 从 116 通真实泰米尔语电话录音中切出 18,485 个标注语轮边界；使用规则生成标签，并以盲听人工复核检验（正类 95.9% 正确，负类仅 44.4% 低于随机水平）；随后改用音频-LLM 标注器（与人工一致性达 97.5%，成本 5.69 美元）；基于 Smart Turn v3 微调两个不同规模的音频-only 检测器；并系统测量各训练杠杆的效果，包括编码器容量、随机种子波动以及生产环境 VAD 与流式适配器的额外损耗。

Result: 保留集上两模型准确率达 83.71%（8.7 MB）和 86.13%（21 MB），ROC-AUC 从 0.751 升至 0.921，单线程 CPU 推理均低于 150 ms。训练杠杆中仅编码器容量带来显著提升；相同配置与种子的三次运行之间准确率波动达 0.87 个百分点，构成所有实验差异的意义下限；生产 VAD 与流式适配器额外损失 2.60 个百分点，且 7.8% 的边界从未被送达模型。

Conclusion: TamilEOT 填补了南印度语言语义端到端检测的空白，实现了显著的准确率与 AUC 提升，且推理开销低。论文同时揭示了构建该系统的真实成本：规则标签在负类上不可靠，标签来源需谨慎选择；训练效果的主要来源是模型容量而非超参数调节；需以复现波动幅度作为判断其他改进是否有意义的基准。作者公开了数据、权重、代码及全部负面结果，以促进可复现研究。

Abstract: A voice agent has to decide, at every pause, whether the user has finished speaking. Without a model of the language that decision falls back to a fixed silence timeout: set it short and the agent interrupts, set it long and every turn pays the full wait. Open semantic end-of-turn detectors exist, but to our knowledge none covers a South Indian language. We release TamilEOT: 18,485 labelled turn boundaries cut from 116 real Tamil telephone conversations, and two audio-only detectors fine-tuned from Smart Turn v3. On a held-out split of 4,168 clips from 30 unseen calls, accuracy rises from 70.30% zero-shot to 83.71% (8.7 MB) and 86.13% (21 MB); ROC-AUC rises from 0.751 to 0.921. Both models run in under 150 ms single-threaded on a laptop CPU. We also report what building it cost. Rule-derived labels, checked against a blind human listening pass, were right 95.9% of the time on the positive class and 44.4% on the negative class, which is below chance, because the rule answered a different question than the model is asked. Replacing them with an audio-LLM labeller measured at 97.5% human agreement cost US$5.69. Of every training lever we measured, only encoder capacity moved the result; three runs at identical config and seed span 0.87 accuracy points, which is the floor below which none of our other deltas mean anything. Replaying the same labelled boundaries through the production VAD and streaming adapter costs a further 2.60 points, and 7.8% of boundaries are never surfaced to the model at all. Data, weights, code and every negative result are public.

</details>


### [304] [Better Together: Complementary Query Rewriting Under a Strong RAG Baseline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05637)
*Sara Shanian,Xiaoqin Yi,Pavlo Ruban,Kurt MacDonald*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了在强检索管线（BGE密集检索+交叉编码器重排+MMR多样化）下多种查询改写策略的效果。核心发现：单独改写最多与强基线持平，但不同方法在不同问题上失败模式互补，组合可带来显著增益；预算匹配对照实验证明互补性是主因而非检索预算。作者提出基于置信度的门控路由器，仅在基线top-1分数低时执行改写，可在不到40%查询上付出改写成本的同时捕获约一半的合并增益，并使下游F1提升+1.92。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 查询改写是改进RAG的流行手段，但现有研究未在强检索基线条件下系统检验其真实价值，尤其是不同改写策略之间的互补关系、成本效益以及何时值得使用改写等问题缺乏严格评估。

Method: 在固定竞争性管线（BGE检索+交叉编码器重排+MMR）下，比较四种查询改写策略（S1-S4）与两种LLM强基线（HyDE、Query2Doc）；在三个数据集上使用三种子+配对bootstrap显著性检验；进行预算匹配对照以区分预算效益与互补性；提出置信度门控路由器，仅在基线top-1得分低时启用改写。

Result: 企业数据集上四种方法联合（S1+S3+S4+HyDE）使HIT@10提升+12.5点（51.70 vs 39.22），五种方法联合达+13.8点；预算匹配对照仅捕获约40%增益，证明互补性是主要驱动力。HotpotQA上联合提升+1.6至+1.8点（p<0.001），AmbigNQ上融合反而有害（低于最佳单独方法2.4点）。门控路由器在企业数据上捕获约一半全合并增益（+4.3 HIT@10），改写成本仅覆盖<40%查询，并在AmbigNQ上自动放弃改写；下游评估显示F1提升+1.92（p<0.01）。

Conclusion: 查询改写应被视为互补的覆盖来源，通过成本感知路由应用，而非作为强基线的独立替代方案。不同改写策略的失败模式互补性是组合增益的主要来源，而非简单增加检索预算。

Abstract: A popular way to improve Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is to rewrite the user's question into several variants and search with all of them. We test whether this actually helps once the underlying search is already strong. Under one fixed, competitive pipeline (BGE dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and MMR diversification), we compare four query-rewriting strategies (S1-S4) against two strong LLM baselines (HyDE, Query2Doc) on three datasets (HotpotQA, AmbigNQ, and the 512K-document EnterpriseRAG-Bench) over three seeds with paired-bootstrap significance tests. Our headline result is that rewriting alone is at best competitive with a strong baseline, but combining methods yields outsized gains because different strategies fail on different questions. A post-hoc union of four methods (S1+S3+S4+HyDE) improves HIT@10 over the baseline by +12.5 points on enterprise data (51.70 vs 39.22), and a five-method union reaches 52.98 (+13.8). Budget-matched controls capture only ~40% of this gain, confirming that complementarity, not retrieval budget, is the primary driver. On HotpotQA the union adds +1.6 to +1.8 points (p<0.001), saturating the all-method oracle; on AmbigNQ the same fusion hurts (-2.4 below the best solo, p<0.001), and we analyze when and why. Because rewriting is expensive, we evaluate in simulation a confidence-gated router that runs rewriting only when the baseline's own top-1 score is low. It captures about half of the enterprise full-merge gain (+4.3 HIT@10) while paying rewriting cost on <40% of queries, and automatically declines to rewrite on AmbigNQ. A downstream answer-quality evaluation confirms the router improves F1 by +1.92 (p<0.01) at roughly 40% of the expansion cost. In short: treat query rewriting as a complementary coverage source, applied through cost-aware routing, not as a standalone replacement for a strong baseline.

</details>


### [305] [Who Maintains Agent Skills? A Longitudinal Study of Human-Governed, AI-Assisted Skill Maintenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05677)
*Chen Shen,Estevam Hruschka*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究通过挖掘五个公开AI技能仓库的完整提交历史（873次提交、143个技能文件、254次实质性后期编辑），直接研究了终身AI智能体中技能人工维护的过程。研究发现：所有实质性编辑都通过具名人工账户完成，62%带有AI共同作者标识；编辑以添加和修正为主，属于真正的策展工作；而预先注册的"规则相似性"编码轴未能通过可靠性检验。研究公开了语料库、编码手册、挖掘脚本和回放协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化技能策展工作主要与自动化基线对比，将人工维护视为无法测量的瓶颈而未加研究。本文直接关注这一缺失环节，试图理解在真实世界中人类如何维护AI技能文件，从而为自动化策展器提供衡量基准和运行约束的现实依据。

Method: 挖掘五个公开AI技能仓库的完整提交历史（2025年10月至2026年6月），选取自AI工具组织的目标性样本。对每个编辑使用预先注册的治理（governance）、操作（operation）和触发证据（trigger-evidence）编码手册进行编码，并对样本进行审计。

Result: 三个主要发现：(1) 所有实质性编辑均通过具名人工账户创建或合并，62%带有AI共同作者标记，且各仓库间差异显著；(2) 编辑是真正的策展行为，审计样本显示大多数编辑改变了技能内容，操作以添加和修正为主；(3) 预先注册的规则相似性编码轴未通过可靠性门槛，从提交产物中可靠编码规则相似性仍是开放问题。

Conclusion: 对于自进化智能体，公开技能维护在实践中更像"人工主导、AI辅助"的循环，而非自主流水线。未来的自动化策展器必须以此现实为基准来衡量自身，并在这一人类治理框架内运行。

Abstract: Lifelong LLM agents increasingly rely on external skill artifacts as one element for preserving and reusing capabilities over time. These skills (usually portable Markdown files such as SKILL.md) describe when and how to apply a capability and must be corrected, expanded, and consolidated as tools and usage patterns shift over deployment. Recent work seeks to automate skill curation, but it largely evaluates against automated baselines and treats human maintenance as an unmeasured bottleneck. We study that missing process directly. We mine the full commit histories of five public AI-skill repositories, a purposive sample of AI-tooling organizations, covering 873 commits, 143 skill files, and 254 substantive post-creation edits from October 2025 to June 2026. We code each edit with pre-registered governance, operation, and trigger-evidence codebooks. Three findings emerge. First, every substantive edit is authored or merged through a named human account, while 62% carry an AI co-author trailer, with large repository-level variation. Second, these edits are genuine curation: an audited sample shows that most change skill content, and the coded operations are dominated by additions and corrections. Third, a pre-registered rule-likeness axis fails its reliability gate; reliably coding rule-likeness from commit artifacts remains an open measurement problem. We release the corpus, codebooks, mining scripts, and a replay protocol for automated skill curators. For self-evolving agents, public skill maintenance currently looks less like an autonomous pipeline than a human-governed, AI-assisted loop that future curators must measure against and operate within.

</details>


### [306] [A Rubric-Guided Large Language Model Solution for Opioid Use Disorder Computable Phenotyping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05682)
*Mengxian Lyu,Paredes Pardo,Cheng Peng,Ziyi Chen,Mengyuan Zhang,Jieting Li Lu,Gary M Reisfield,William M Greene,Jenny Lo-Ciganic,Yonghui Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一种基于评分标准指导的大语言模型（LLM）框架，结合OPRO优化策略，用于从电子健康记录（EHRs）中自动识别阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）。该框架利用专家制定的18项评分标准指导LLM提取临床文本中的关键证据，在253名患者（含68例OUD阳性）的验证中取得了F1分数0.774和AUROC 0.934的最佳性能，分别比机器学习方法和零样本LLM提升了12.8%和44.4%的F1相对改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）是美国严重的公共卫生危机，但从电子健康记录（EHRs）中识别OUD十分困难，因为诊断编码常缺失，而支持证据深藏在临床叙述文本中。准确的OUD识别对于支持干预措施和改善健康结果至关重要。

Method: 研究设计了一个评分标准指导的LLM框架，融合了OPRO（Optimization by PROmpting）提示优化技术。该方法使用专家制定的18项标准来指导LLM自动提取关键临床文本及支持证据，以确定OUD标记（computable phenotyping, CP）。两位UF Health医生对253名患者（68例OUD阳性）进行了病历审查以验证模型。

Result: LLM-based CP取得了最佳F1分数0.774和AUROC 0.934，相比基于机器学习（结合EHR和NLP提取变量）的CP和零样本LLM方法，相对F1提升分别达12.8%和44.4%。

Conclusion: 提出的基于LLM的CP方法能有效将LLM提取的证据与OUD表型判定相关联，提供更好的可解释性，有望提升EHR中OUD识别的准确性。

Abstract: Opioid use disorder (OUD) remains a public health crisis in the United States, yet it is difficult to identify from electronic health records (EHRs) because missing diagnosis codes and supporting evidence are buried in clinical narratives. Accurate OUD identification is critical to support interventions and improve health outcomes. This study developed a rubric-guided large language model (LLM) that incorporated Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) for OUD computable phenotyping (CP). The framework used an 18-item, expert-identified rubric to instruct LLMs to automatically extract critical text with supporting evidence to determine OUD flags. Two UF Health physicians (GMR and WMG) chart-reviewed 253 patients, including 68 OUD-positive cases. Our LLM-based computable phenotype (CP) achieved the best F1 score of 0.774 and an AUROC of 0.934, outperforming the machine learning-based CP using EHR and natural language processing-extracted variables, and zero-shot LLMs by relative F1 improvements of 12.8% and 44.4%, respectively. The proposed LLM-based CP could link LLM-extracted evidence to OUD phenotyping for better explainability.

</details>


### [307] [Intra-Prompt Parallel Decoding for Common-Context Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05707)
*Theodore Glavas,Nikhita Vedula,Dushyanta Dhyani,Antonios Valkanas,Yilun Zhu,Shervin Malmasi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: IPPD是一种新型推理方法，通过在单个prompt中并行解码多个共享上下文的问答任务，利用虚拟位置ID和注意力掩码操作，在不微调或改动LLM架构的情况下提高吞吐量达7倍，且与批处理推理完全兼容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在共享上下文问答任务中，LLM通常为每个问题生成独立prompt，导致GPU在注意力阶段因内存瓶颈而利用率不足。已有的批处理和缓存技术虽能改善并行度，但问题分离的架构限制了加速潜力。

Method: 提出Intra-Prompt Parallel Decoding (IPPD)方法，将多个共享上下文的问答问题放入单个prompt中并行解码。通过虚拟位置ID和注意力掩码操作，在单次推理步骤中为每个问题解码next token，高效共享注意力的内存与计算资源。支持与批处理推理兼容。

Result: IPPD相比标准解码可提供高达7倍的有效吞吐量，且无质量退化；在大多数场景下优于基于PagedAttention的前缀缓存方法。

Conclusion: IPPD通过prompt内并行解码有效解决了共享上下文问答中的GPU内存瓶颈问题，在无需修改模型的前提下显著提升推理效率，并与现有批处理架构兼容。

Abstract: In common-context question answering (CCQA) tasks, multiple input questions share a common context to base their answers from. However, Large Language Models typically generate each answer using an independent prompt. While existing batching and caching techniques help improve parallelism and reduce repeated computations, the separation of questions across prompts limits the achievable speedup, as modern GPUs are underutilized due to a memory bottleneck during attention. We present Intra-Prompt Parallel Decoding (IPPD), a novel inference method that answers multiple common-context questions in parallel within a single prompt. IPPD directly addresses the bottleneck by efficiently sharing both memory and computation during the attention process, as the next token for every question is decoded in a single inference step. IPPD uses virtual position IDs and attention mask manipulation to generate the same output as standard prompting without requiring fine-tuning or any changes to the LLM architecture. Since all parallelism occurs within a prompt, IPPD is fully compatible with batched inference, even when each prompt features a different context. Our experiments show that IPPD delivers up to 7X the effective throughput as standard decoding without quality degradation, and outperforms prefix caching with PagedAttention in most settings.

</details>


### [308] [MedWER: A Reproducible, Model-Free Evaluation Protocol for Medical Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05728)
*Justin Behling*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MedWER，一个面向医学自动语音识别（ASR）的评估协议与开源工具。其核心创新在于使用固定的、许可干净的医学术语列表（19,373个药物、诊断、症状和损伤机制条目）作为分母，取代依赖NER模型或云API的可变分母，从而解决传统WER指标掩盖临床关键错误的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统整体词错误率（WER）会掩盖临床关键错误——转录文本即使95%正确也可能替换掉一种药物。现有解决方案通常对医学实体加权，但这依赖于评估时的命名实体识别（NER）模型或云API，导致指标分母成为版本化的黑箱，缺乏可复现性和透明度。

Method: MedWER协议包含两个核心组件：（1）固定的、许可干净的术语列表（19,373条目，涵盖药物、诊断、症状和损伤机制，从公共数据源投影而来）；（2）结合固定文本规范化器与短语感知的术语受限WER计算。唯一可版本化的组件是规范化器依赖，被锁定在精确版本并通过提交的黄金固定测试进行校验。术语列表的覆盖率通过独立省级药物福利文件验证，匹配启发式算法则基于ground-truth实体跨度进行校准。

Result: 作者在Moonshine base、Whisper base.en和MedASR三个模型上，使用两个开放基准数据集进行基线评估，并用重采样的每话语分数报告95%置信区间。覆盖率经独立数据集验证，匹配算法经ground-truth校准，实验结果以开源工具形式发布。

Conclusion: MedWER通过固定术语列表替代NER黑箱，使医学ASR评估指标具有确定性、可复现性和临床针对性，为医学语音识别系统的关键错误评估提供了更可靠的方案。

Abstract: Overall word error rate hides clinically critical errors: a transcript can be 95% correct and still swap one drug for another. The usual fix weights errors on medical entities, and almost always depends on an evaluation-time named-entity recognition (NER) model or cloud API, which makes the metric's denominator a versioned black box. We present MedWER, an evaluation protocol and open-source tool for medical ASR whose denominator is a fixed, license-clean term list: 19,373 drug, diagnosis, symptom, and injury-mechanism entries projected from public sources. The protocol couples a pinned text normalizer with a phrase-aware term-restricted WER, the MedWER, so the only versioned component is a normalizer dependency held at an exact release and checked against committed golden fixtures. Coverage is validated against an independent provincial drug-benefit file the list was not built from; the matching heuristic is calibrated against ground-truth entity spans. Baselines for Moonshine~base, Whisper~base.en, and MedASR on two open benchmarks are scored with the released tool and reported with 95% confidence intervals from resampled per-utterance scores.

</details>


### [309] [Some Tokens Behave like Magnets: Revealing Linguistic Organization in the Layers of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05743)
*Andrew Liu,Devan Srinivasan,Gerald Penn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现了大型语言模型(LLM)中一类特殊的token向量——"磁性向量"(magnetic vectors)，它们通过吸引或排斥作用组织周围的token，类似于物理磁铁对铁屑的排列效果。研究发现功能词在早期层中一致表现为排斥磁体，且这种模式在不同架构、尺寸和层配置中一致存在。通过因果实验证明，移除早期排斥磁体会严重损害句法任务(如POS标注准确率从91%降至10%以下)，而移除晚期吸引磁体则损害语义任务。该发现为理解语言模型如何跨层几何化组织语言计算提供了首个无需探针的路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解大型语言模型内部如何组织和处理语言信息一直是可解释性研究的关键挑战。现有方法通常依赖探针(probing)来解读模型内部表征，但这种方法存在局限。本文的动机是寻找一种无需探针就能理解LLM如何跨层几何化组织语言计算的方式，通过识别token向量间的内在几何关系来揭示语言处理的组织原则。

Method: 本文通过分析LLM中token向量之间的几何关系，识别出具有"吸引"或"排斥"两种极性作用的特殊向量——磁性向量。研究者从三个维度展开分析：(1)统计功能词在不同层中作为排斥磁体的显著模式；(2)跨多种LLM架构(不同大小和层配置)验证模式的一致性；(3)通过微调实验和因果干预实验(移除特定层中的磁性向量)来验证磁性向量的因果相关性以及其对句法任务和语义任务的差异化影响。

Result: (1)功能词在早期层中一致表现为排斥磁体，深层中磁体会以独特方式重组极性；(2)该模式在不同LLM架构、尺寸和层配置中一致存在；(3)微调下游任务后，任务功能性token会涌现为磁体——如问答任务中答案span token在最终层成为独特的排斥磁体；(4)因果实验显示，移除早期排斥磁体会严重损害句法任务(POS标注准确率从91%降至<10%)但不影响语义任务，移除晚期吸引磁体则产生相反效果。

Conclusion: 磁性向量的发现揭示了LLM中存在的系统性、跨架构一致的token组织模式，表明模型通过吸引/排斥两种极性在几何空间中分层次地组织语言计算：早期层偏向句法处理，晚期层偏向语义处理。这一现象为理解LLM内部机制提供了首个无需探针的路径，值得进一步深入研究。

Abstract: We identify a special group of token vectors inside large language models (LLMs), which we term magnetic vectors, that organize the surrounding tokens by either attracting or repelling them. Particularly, tokens pointing the same way as an attracting magnet are elongated; tokens pointing the same way as a repelling magnet are compressed. Just as physical magnets pull or push away the iron filings around them, these vectors organize their surroundings through two opposing polarities. Moreover, we identify a statistically significant pattern in linguistic category where function words consistently act as repelling magnets in early layers, and we also find magnets consistently reorganize their polarities in unique ways deeper in the model. In a further case study we find this observation may unveil a deliberate, layer-wise organization in how LLMs process language.
  This pattern is consistent across different LLM architectures, sizes, and layer configurations. It is also causally relevant.
