Our results show that semantic drift in the fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B is not evenly distributed across all usages. Instead, a significant part of the change is driven by a smaller set of high-impact contextual instances, rather than gradual and uniform change across all occurrences. This work provides a preliminary framework for diachronic analysis in low-resource contexts, highlighting the trade-offs between model sensitivity and data availability.

</details>


### [447] [Navigating the digital spectrum: Assessing political bias, stability, and downstream fairness in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08637)
*Luka Debevc,Nishan Chatterjee,Antoine Doucet,Senja Pollak,Matej Martinc*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个稳健的政治罗盘测试评估框架，在八维扰动空间中采样300种配置，对8个Gemma 3和Qwen 3模型在14种语言和3种量化级别下进行政治立场评估。研究发现大多数模型平均偏向自由意志主义-左翼，但指令措辞、语言和答题格式会显著影响恢复的坐标；跨语言差异主要反映坐标漂移而非文化推理差异；最小模型的近原点估计可能反映弱信号而非真正的中间主义；政治角色提示在下游任务中具有可测量但任务和数据集特定的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地作为信息中介部署，但测量其政治行为仍然不可靠，因为问卷结果混合了模型自身倾向与测量伪影及响应诱发偏差。现有评估方法缺乏稳健性，需要一种能隔离这些因素的系统性评估框架。

Method: 引入设计平均化的政治罗盘测试评估框架，在八维扰动空间中采样300种配置，扰动维度包括语言、框架、指令、答题格式、选项顺序和角色措辞等。对8个模型（Gemma 3和Qwen 3系列）在14种语言和3种量化级别上进行评估，获得带量化不确定性的设计平均政治坐标，并通过逆向工程测试暴露轴权重失衡和退化响应塌缩等问题。

Result: 多数模型平均偏向自由意志主义-左翼；指令措辞、语言和答题格式显著影响坐标；跨语言差异主要是坐标漂移而非文化推理差异；最小模型近原点估计反映弱信号而非中间主义；自由文本推理和聊天后分类改变坐标；更大模型展现更清晰的角色分离，但威权主义-左翼角色无法使多数模型向预期社会方向移动；下游任务中角色效应相对模型大小和目标群体而言较弱，基准提示与中间派提示在主题级情感上一致性最高。

Conclusion: 政治角色提示具有可测量但依赖任务和数据集的下游效应。对于评估LLM政治行为，采用设计平均化和不确定性量化是必要的方法论改进，否则单次问卷结果可能严重误导对模型政治倾向的判断。

Abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed as information intermediaries, yet measuring their political behavior remains fragile because questionnaire results mix model dispositions with measurement artifacts and response-elicitation biases. We introduce a robust Political Compass Test evaluation framework that samples 300 configurations across an eight-dimensional perturbation space varying language, framing, instructions, answer format, option order, and persona wording. We evaluate eight Gemma 3 and Qwen 3 models across 14 languages and three quantization levels, obtaining design-averaged political coordinates with quantified uncertainty. Most models lean Libertarian-Left on average, but instruction phrasing, language, and answer format significantly affect recovered coordinates. Cross-lingual differences primarily reflect coordinate drift rather than distinct cultural reasoning. Reverse-engineering the test also exposes axis-weighting imbalances and the collapse of degenerate responses toward the center, so near-origin estimates for the smallest models can reflect weak signal rather than centrism. Free-text reasoning and chat-then-classify elicitation alter recovered coordinates, and larger models show clearer persona separation, with a specific failure of the Authoritarian-Left persona to move most models in the intended social direction. In downstream tasks, persona effects are modest relative to model size and target group for hate-speech detection, while base and centrist prompts give the highest agreement for topic-level sentiment. Political role prompting therefore has measurable but task- and dataset-specific downstream effects.

</details>


### [448] [Combating Instruction Conflict via Energy-Driven Latent Conflict Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08646)
*Mingyu Ma,Yuxin Wu,Jingbo Wang,Tianxiao Huang,Leixin Sun,Xiaochuan Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ELCD，一种响应级别的潜在冲突检测器，用于在生成后、投递前验证LLM输出是否违反系统级约束（即"响应漂移"现象）。ELCD通过拼接最终token嵌入与平均池化响应嵌入构建复合隐藏状态表示，并优化成对边际排序目标来区分合规与漂移响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有防御机制主要聚焦于静态输入检查，无法检测"响应漂移"——即模型的最终响应在输入看似合规的情况下仍违反系统级约束。这构成一个关键安全漏洞，尤其是在分层指令（系统约束与用户指令冲突）日益普遍的场景下。

Method: ELCD在生成完成后、交付前运行。它通过拼接最终token的嵌入与整个响应的平均池化嵌入，构造复合隐藏状态表示；随后优化一个成对边际排序目标，使合规响应与漂移响应在潜在特征空间中彼此分离。该方法适用于开源或自托管的LLM部署。

Result: 在五个主流LLM（参数规模1.5B至14B）上的大量实验表明，ELCD显著优于竞争基线。具体而言，在Llama-2-7B上PR-AUC提升约30个百分点；在Mistral-7B上将95% TPR下的误报率（FPR95）降至2.67%。

Conclusion: ELCD提供了一种有前景的潜在指令冲突检测方案，专门针对后生成阶段的响应级验证，弥补了静态输入检查方法的不足，适用于开放权重或自托管的LLM部署场景。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with hierarchical instructions, yet they remain vulnerable to conflicts in which user directives override system-level constraints. Existing defense mechanisms predominantly focus on static input inspection and therefore fail to detect Response Drift, a phenomenon in which the model's final response violates system-level constraints despite seemingly compliant inputs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ELCD, a response-level latent conflict detector for post-generation, pre-delivery verification. Given the full generated output, ELCD constructs a composite hidden-state representation by concatenating the final-token embedding with the mean-pooled response embedding. It then optimizes a pairwise margin ranking objective to separate compliant and drifting responses in latent space. Extensive experiments across five mainstream LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 14B parameters demonstrate that ELCD significantly outperforms competitive baselines. Notably, it improves the PR-AUC on Llama-2-7B by approximately 30 percentage points and reduces the False Positive Rate at 95% TPR (FPR95) on Mistral-7B to 2.67%. These results suggest that ELCD provides a promising approach for latent instruction-conflict detection in open-weight or self-hosted LLM deployments.

</details>


### [449] [When Victorian Becomes a Prompt: Literary Periodization as a Generative Constraint in 100 AI-Generated Novels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08689)
*Mehdy Sedaghat Payam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"生成式时代划分"(Generative Periodization)概念，即利用文学时代标签(如维多利亚时期)来引导生成文本。作者在100部长篇小说上测试GPT、Qwen和Llama三种模型，并使用基于19世纪文学训练的时代对齐分数(PAS)评估其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI颠覆了文学史的传统分期逻辑——时代标签如今可先于作品存在并影响创作内容。作者希望系统性地测试并验证"用文学时代标签生成文本"这一新型范式是否有效，以及不同模型在此任务上的表现差异。

Method: 在100部书长小说上设置维多利亚时期与零风格两种条件，分别使用GPT、Qwen和Llama三种工作流生成文本。开发时代对齐分数(PAS)，该分数基于19世纪文学训练，并使用主题降维后的语法特征来评估文本的时代对齐度，并以人类零风格散文为基准。

Result: 研究表明：维多利亚时期的提示词在GPT和Qwen中产生一致的历史方向偏移，但在Llama中效果不佳。仅维多利亚式的重新校准和更难的对照语料库仍能保持GPT和Qwen的效果。跨模型迁移也显示出语法变化的共同方向。实际可测的目标是更广泛的19世纪而非严格意义上的维多利亚时期。

Conclusion: 生成式时代划分是一个可行的框架，但模型间的鲁棒性存在差异。该研究揭示了时代标签能引导大语言模型生成具有特定历史语法特征的文本，但效果取决于模型架构，且对齐的目标时代范围比预设的更为宽泛。

Abstract: Generative AI inverts the typical periodization of literary history: the periodizing tag Victorian can now come first and influence what is written. Generative periodization, defined and tested here, describes the use of literary-period designations in generating texts. I test this approach on 100 book-length novels produced under Victorian and Zero-Style conditions using GPT, Qwen, and Llama workflows. The Period Alignment Score (PAS), trained on nineteenth-century literature and benchmarked against human Zero-Style prose, assesses alignment using topic-reduced grammatical features. Victorian prompts produce consistent historical-direction shifts in GPT and Qwen, but not robustly in Llama. Victorian-only recalibration and harder comparison corpora preserve the GPT and Qwen effects. Cross-model transfer also shows a shared direction of grammatical change. The measurable target is the broader nineteenth century rather than the Victorian period per se.

</details>


### [450] [Global Divergence, Local Convergence: Representation Geometry in SSMs and Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08692)
*Amit Ben-Artzy,Roy Schwartz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过多尺度分析，系统比较了Transformer、状态空间模型（SSM/Mamba）及混合架构在内部表示几何与功能上的异同。研究发现：SSM将表示信息均匀分布于各维度，而Transformer的表示被单一主方向主导；尽管几何结构迥异，两者的有效表示容量却惊人地匹配；两者以相近维度的子空间编码概念；并且在局部语义流形层面展现出显著的功能趋同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba等状态空间模型在语言建模上达到了与Transformer相当的性能，但两者架构根本不同。这引发一个关键问题：不同的架构如何影响内部表示的几何特性和功能本质？理解这一问题有助于揭示不同架构实现强大能力的共同机制，以及各自独特的表示策略。

Method: 采用多尺度分析方法：(1) 几何分析——比较Transformer、SSM和混合架构中表示信息在维度上的分布情况；(2) 容量分析——通过可压缩性评估不同几何分布对表示容量的影响；(3) 概念编码分析——使用秩约束探针（rank-constrained probes）检验架构如何编码概念；(4) 流形对齐分析——通过主题表示和token最近邻来考察局部语义流形的对齐程度。

Result: (1) SSM的表示信息在各维度均匀分布，而Transformer的表示由单一主方向主导；混合架构显示每个注意力层后表示空间都更偏向单一主导方向。(2) 尽管几何结构截然不同，两种架构的有效表示容量紧密匹配。(3) 两种架构在维度惊人相似的子空间中编码概念，且Transformer的主导主方向并不承载更多概念信息。(4) 在特定主题表示和token最近邻层面，两种架构的语义流形高度对齐。

Conclusion: 尽管Transformer和SSM在潜在空间的使用方式上存在明显差异（各向同性 vs. 主方向主导），但它们在局部语义流形层面展现出引人注目的功能趋同，表明不同架构可能通过不同的几何策略达成了相似的表征能力。

Abstract: Recent state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba achieve language modeling performance comparable to transformers despite relying on fundamentally different architectures. This raises an important question: how do these structural differences influence the geometry and functional nature of their internal representations? We study this question through a multi-scale analysis of representations in transformers, SSMs, and hybrid architecture. First, we find that SSMs distribute their representational information evenly across all dimensions, whereas transformer representations are heavily dominated by a single principal direction. By evaluating hybrid architectures, we observe that the representation space becomes increasingly skewed toward a single dominant direction after each attention layer. Next, we explore how the different geometric spread of representations impacts representational capacity through compressibility. Surprisingly, we find that despite their contrasting geometric structures, both architectures exhibit tightly matched effective capacities. We further investigate whether this skewed geometry affects how concepts are encoded. Using rank-constrained probes, we demonstrate that both architectures encode concepts in subspaces of surprisingly similar dimensionality. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the transformers' dominant principal direction does not inherently encode more conceptual information. Finally, we zoom in and examine the alignment between manifolds, either by analyzing representations of specific topics or by looking at the nearest neighborhoods of tokens, and find that they are highly aligned. Ultimately, our analysis suggests that while transformers and SSMs induce different usage of latent space, they display a striking functional convergence at the level of local semantic manifolds.

</details>


### [451] [Record Grouping Controls Evidence Weight in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08698)
*Zhongxuan Liu,Sicheng Zhou,Hongzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了检索增强语言模型中"提供的分组"（supplied partition）作为前生成表示变量的作用。作者建立了群组内容状态的不变式理论，推导了内容感知的分区误差界，并通过104,402次试验和48项控制面板实验证明：分组方式会显著且模型依赖地影响生成结果，错误拆分增加10.27-32.66个百分点，错误合并减少9.13-31.79个百分点，表明分组是一个可控的前生成表示变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索到的记录作为呈现单元，但分区决定了哪些记录作为一条证据贡献进入语言模型。现有工作缺乏对"分组如何影响生成内容"的形式化理解，需要刻画分组对群组内容状态的影响，并将其作为可控变量进行研究。

Method: 理论部分：刻画不变的群组-内容状态，去除组内副本同时保留互补的规范内容，证明相同组计数可编码不同证据状态，推导内容感知的分区误差界。实验部分：在6个公开检查点上进行104,402次试验的自然文本干预，以及48项控制活动面板实验，采用平衡镜像设计检验交互效应。

Result: 内容固定的错误拆分使性能增加10.27-32.66个百分点，错误合并使性能下降9.13-31.79个百分点；六槽对照在全部16个单元保持正方向；48项面板实验中，改变提供分区在所有四种模型上产生可测量的、检查点依赖的决策偏移，平衡镜像设计揭示显著的顺序交互。

Conclusion: 提供的分区是一个可控的前生成表示变量，其行为效应具有检查点依赖性。理论与实验共同确立了分区在生成前阶段的表示作用及其可调节性。

Abstract: Retrieved records are presentation units; a supplied partition determines which records enter a language model as one evidential contribution. We characterize the invariant group-content state that removes within-group copies while retaining complementary canonical content, show that equal group counts can encode different evidence states, and derive a sharp content-aware partition-error bound. Given a supplied partition, our pre-generation representation deduplicates and aggregates content within groups and bounds each group's contribution. Across 104,402 trials and 6 public checkpoints, a central natural-text intervention finds that content-fixed false splits add 10.27-32.66 percentage points and false merges remove 9.13-31.79 points; a matched six-slot control retains the positive direction in all 16 cells. In a new 48-item controlled campaign panel, changing the supplied partition produces measurable, checkpoint-dependent decision shifts across all four models, and the balanced mirror design exposes substantial order interactions. Together, the theory and experiments establish the supplied partition as a controllable pre-generation representation variable and characterize its checkpoint-dependent behavioral effects.

</details>


### [452] [Improving Term Evaluation in Machine Translation: Variation Matters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08779)
*Nicolas Dahan,Ziqian Peng,François Yvon,Rachel Bawden*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨机器翻译术语评估中如何合理对待翻译变异问题。传统评估假设每个源术语只有一个正确目标形式，但人工译者常引入变异而被现有指标误判为不一致。论文基于英法科学翻译的文档级评估，提出新的跨术语变异(CTV)诊断指标，并通过四个MT系统在两个平行语料上的实验发现：MT系统比人工译者产生更少的目标侧变异、迁移模式依赖变异类型、一致性排名随指标变化、术语表约束可提升准确性和一致性但会抑制有效变异。论文主张采用变异感知评估，仅当目标侧变异未镜像源侧变异时才施加一致性惩罚。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MT术语评估假设每个源术语对应单一正确目标形式，但人工翻译中普遍存在合理的变异现象，导致当前评估指标错误地将有效变异视为不一致，无法反映真实翻译质量。

Method: 结合三类评估手段：基于术语表的准确性、翻译一致性、以及新提出的跨术语变异(CTV)诊断指标。CTV测试变异关系是否在跨语言间被保留。实验基于两个平行语料，由四个MT系统翻译英法科学文本。

Result: 研究发现：(1) MT系统生成的目标侧变异少于人工译者；(2) 变异迁移模式强烈依赖变异类型；(3) 一致性排名随所选指标而不同；(4) 术语表约束提升准确性和一致性但抑制有效变异，从而降低CTV。

Conclusion: 主张变异感知的评估框架：一致性惩罚应基于目标侧变异是否镜像源侧变异来调节，而非无条件惩罚所有不一致。

Abstract: Terminology evaluation in machine translation (MT) usually assumes a single correct target form per source term. However, human translators routinely introduce variation that current metrics penalize as inconsistency. We examine how to account for this variation in document-level MT evaluation of English-French scientific translation, combining glossary-based accuracy, translation consistency, and a new cross-term variation (CTV) diagnostic measure that tests whether variation relationships are preserved across languages. Based on analyses of two parallel corpora, translated by four MT systems, we find that (1) MT systems generate less target-side variation than human translators; (2) transfer patterns strongly depend on the variation type; (3) consistency rankings vary with the choice of metric; and (4) constraining MT with a glossary improves accuracy and consistency but degrades CTV by suppressing valid variation. We argue for variation-aware evaluation that conditions consistency penalties on whether target-side variation mirrors source-side variation.

</details>


### [453] [Evolution of Multimodal Question Answering: From Modality-Adaptive Extraction to Unified Language Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08896)
*Abdullah Al Shafi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对三种多模态问答框架（MAE、Solar、UniMMQA）进行了系统性方法比较，追踪了从模态自适应管道到统一架构的演变，并通过实证分析表明向统一文本中心化架构的转变（特别是UniMMQA）能带来EM和F1分数的显著提升，同时指出了信息丢失、错误传播及细粒度跨模态依赖捕捉不足等持续挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态数据的快速增长使得跨文本、表格和图像等异构来源进行推理的问答系统需求日益迫切，需要对现有不同架构设计进行系统性对比，以理解多模态问答的技术演进趋势。

Method: 对MAE、Solar和UniMMQA三种代表性框架进行方法学比较，从跨模态交互建模、异构输入变换和推理方式三个维度分析，重点考察各框架在模态表征、推理与答案生成上的关键设计差异，并在多个基准数据集上进行Empirical对比（EM与F1指标）。

Result: 分析揭示从显式模态特异性处理向由预训练语言模型（PLMs）驱动的统一文本中心化表述的明显转变；UniMMQA在EM和F1分数上表现最一致且最具可扩展性，整体上统一架构相比多阶段管道带来实质性改进。

Conclusion: 尽管统一架构取得显著进展，仍存在模态转换中的信息损失、多阶段流水线的错误传播以及细粒度跨模态依赖捕捉不足等问题，研究为未来统一多模态推理系统的设计方向提供了洞察。

Abstract: The rapid growth of multimodal data has intensified the need for question answering (QA) systems capable of reasoning across heterogeneous sources such as text, tables, and images. In this paper, we present a comprehensive methodological comparison of three influential frameworks, namely Multimodal Adaptive Extraction (MAE), Solar, and UniMMQA, tracing the evolution of multimodal question answering from modality-adaptive pipelines to fully unified architectures. We examine how each approach models cross-modal interactions, transforms heterogeneous inputs, and performs reasoning, highlighting key design differences in modality representation, reasoning, and answer generation. Our analysis demonstrates a clear shift from explicit modality-specific processing toward unified text-centric formulations enabled by pre-trained language models (PLMs). Empirical comparisons across benchmark datasets show that this transition leads to substantial improvements in both Exact Match (EM) and F1-Scores, with UniMMQA achieving the most consistent and scalable performance. Despite these advances, we identify persistent challenges, including information loss during modality transformation, error propagation in multi-stage pipelines, and limitations in capturing fine-grained cross-modal dependencies. Overall, this study provides a deeper understanding of current design trends and offers insights into the future direction of unified multimodal reasoning systems.

</details>


### [454] [Experience Funnel: A State-Policy Alternating Loop for Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08919)
*Wenbo Gao,Zhaomou Song,Zhiyuan Ji,Renxi Liu,Xing Li,Xianzhi Yu,Xiaoguang Li,James Chung-wai Cheung,Weizhe Lin,Yaoyuan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Experience Funnel框架，通过交替进行状态适应（快速显式文本状态演化）与策略巩固（慢速参数化策略蒸馏），实现LLM智能体从交互经验中持续自我进化，兼顾快速适应与可复用能力积累。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的自主智能体通过与环境的持续交互积累经验，如何将这些任务特定的交互经验转化为可复用的模型能力是关键挑战。现有方法存在两难：显式文本状态（如技能、工具集）适应快且可读可编辑，但依赖外部上下文；参数化策略紧凑可复用，但更新速度慢。缺乏能同时兼顾两者优势的进化机制。

Method: 提出Experience Funnel框架，采用"快状态适应"与"慢策略巩固"交替进行的双循环结构：(1) 将交互轨迹蒸馏为显式文本状态，实现快速经验吸收与验证；(2) 选择性识别跨状态版本仍有效的状态赋能行为，通过转移感知蒸馏（transition-aware distillation）将其巩固进参数化策略；(3) 更新后的状态-策略对生成新rollouts，为下一轮进化提供证据。

Result: 在多个多样化的智能体基准上，Experience Funnel一致优于纯状态演化和纯策略内化方法，并逐步将有用的显式经验转化为自主的策略能力。

Conclusion: 快慢交替的进化架构能够有效平衡快速适应与长期能力积累，逐步将外部的显式经验"漏斗式"收缩内化为智能体自身的参数化能力，为LLM智能体的持续自我进化提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) continuously accumulate experience through interaction, creating an opportunity to improve future behavior through self-evolution. A fundamental challenge is how to transform abundant, task-specific interaction experience into reusable model competence without sacrificing the ability to adapt rapidly to newly observed evidence. Explicit textual states, such as skills and agent harnesses, provide fast, human-readable and editable adaptation, but incur persistent dependence on external context; parametric policies provide compact and reusable competence, but are substantially slower to update. We present \textit{Experience Funnel}, a self-evolving framework that couples fast state adaptation with slow policy consolidation in an alternating loop. Interaction trajectories are first distilled into an explicit textual state, where newly acquired experience can be rapidly incorporated and validated. The framework then selectively identifies state-enabled behavior that remains useful across state revisions and consolidates it into the policy through transition-aware distillation. The updated state--policy pair subsequently generates new rollouts, providing fresh evidence for the next round of state adaptation and policy consolidation. Experiments across diverse agent benchmarks show that \textit{Experience Funnel} consistently improves agent capability over state-only evolution and policy-internalization approaches, while progressively converting useful explicit experience into autonomous policy competence.

</details>


### [455] [When Models Defer to Wrong Answers: A Robustness Audit of Source-Attributed Cues in Multiple-Choice QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08934)
*Manikandan Ravikiran,Siddharth Vohra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文审计了语言模型在多选题问答中，面对"关于他源回答的声明"时答案是否会被动摇。作者提出NC-MCAR指标，衡量模型在有效提示条件下从正确答案转向错误选项的比率。在MMLU-Pro和IndicMMLU-Pro上（5种语言）对4个模型进行测试，共22万次输出，发现"专家模板"的NC-MCAR高达41.1%，远超"多数模板"的12.5%，表明未经核实的来源声明可动摇模型原本与任务证据一致的答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型常被输入"问题+他源回答的声明"这样的组合，但此类未经核实的声明是否会破坏模型答案的稳定性目前缺乏系统性审计。作者希望量化这种误导性提示对模型答案的干扰程度。

Method: 针对每个测试项，固定一个错误选项，改变附着在其上的提示模板（如"专家模板"、"多数模板"等误导条件）;提出NC-MCAR指标，仅统计在有效提示下、且同一模型在中性提示下先选对正确答案的试次中，模型转向该错误选项的比例。在MMLU-Pro与IndicMMLU-Pro上，用英语、印地语、孟加拉语、泰米尔语和泰卢固语对4个指令跟随模型进行评估。

Result: 在22万次输出中，"专家模板"的聚合NC-MCAR为41.1%，而"多数模板"仅为12.5%（两者使用相同的错误选项和最终指令）。填充项准确率远高于"专家错误"准确率，且正确线索提示具有较高的有效响应准确率。

Conclusion: 审计表明，在受测的强制选择提示下存在明显的答案不稳定问题：一个裸露的、未经证实的来源声明，可能压过模型此前与任务证据一致的答案，这对基于来源的grounding构成实际风险。

Abstract: Language models often receive a question together with a claim about what another source answered. We audit whether such claims destabilize answers in multiple-choice question answering. For each item, we hold one wrong option fixed across misleading conditions and vary the cue template attached to it. We introduce \emph{neutral-conditioned misleading cue adoption rate} (NC-MCAR), which measures switches to that option only on valid cued trials where the same model first selected the gold answer under a neutral prompt. This is a measure of answer instability, not proof that the model knew the answer or that all deference is irrational. We evaluate four instruction-following models on MMLU-Pro and IndicMMLU-Pro in English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, and Telugu. Across 220{,}000 outputs, the expert template yields 41.1\% aggregate NC-MCAR, compared with 12.5\% for the majority template. These two conditions use the same wrong option and final instruction. Filler accuracy remains well above expert-wrong accuracy, while correct-cue prompts have high valid-response accuracy. The audit documents answer instability relevant to grounding under the tested forced-choice prompts: a bare, unverified source claim can outweigh an answer that was previously consistent with the task evidence.

</details>


### [456] [Evaluation of Contextual Understanding in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09004)
*Subavarshana Arumugam,Mamta Nallaretnam,Kithuni Wickramasinghe,Chamath Gunapala,Pragatheeswaran Vipulanandan,Uthayasanker Thayasivam,Kamal Premaratne*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于知识图谱的评估框架S3KG（知识图谱语义结构相似度），通过混合结构和语义相似度的连续评分，来评估大语言模型在问答任务中的上下文理解能力，并附带诊断框架来分类推理错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统评估指标（如困惑度、BLEU、表面准确率）无法揭示LLM如何提取、整合和推理上下文信息，尤其在问答任务中，模型需要将回答与上下文知识对齐而非依赖记忆联想，因此需要更深入的评估方法。

Method: 提出S3KG（Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs）混合相似度度量方法，将结构相似性和语义相似性整合为连续评估分数，同时设计一个诊断框架用于对推理错误进行分类，并在精选的QA基准上将其与已有指标进行对比验证。

Result: 在构建的标准问答基准上对S3KG进行验证，结果表明其在衡量LLM生成回答的正确性、忠实性和可解释性方面具有有效性。

Conclusion: S3KG为评估LLM的上下文理解能力提供了一种比传统指标更全面、更具解释性的评估方案，能够衡量正确性、忠实性和可解释性三个维度。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across diverse NLP tasks, yet their ability to exhibit genuine contextual understanding remains uncertain. Traditional evaluation metrics such as perplexity, BiLingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU), or surface-level accuracy fail to reveal how well LLMs extract, integrate, and reason over contextual information--a gap particularly critical in question answering, where models must align responses with contextually grounded knowledge rather than memorized associations. We propose a novel knowledge graph-based evaluation framework introducing Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs (S3KG), a hybrid similarity measure integrating structural and semantic similarity into a continuous evaluation score, alongside a diagnostic framework for categorizing reasoning errors. To validate this pipeline, we evaluate S3KG against established metrics on a curated question-answer (QA) benchmark, demonstrating its effectiveness in measuring correctness, faithfulness, and interpretability in LLM-generated responses.

</details>


### [457] [The Audit Decides the Verdict: Instrument Effects Rival Demographic Bias in LLM Decision Audits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09048)
*Siddharth Vohra,Manikandan Ravikiran*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文测试了先前慈善援助基准中发现的"评分偏袒少数族裔、排名惩罚少数族裔"的人口统计偏差反转是否能在招聘、贷款和医疗分诊领域泛化。通过对5个模型进行40,726次请求测试，结果发现该反转并不泛化：36个计划对比无一在多重检验校正后存活。评级优势符号维持但规模约为已发表效果的一半，精确性扩展将招聘排名惩罚限制在已发表效应之下，但贷款和医疗分诊的排名下限高于该界限。植入差异、原始援助材料的定向复制以及审计背景效应共同界定了这些零结果。结论是审计裁决更多反映审计构造而非真实的人口统计偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究显示语言模型的表面人口统计偏差可能因审计提问方式不同而出现矛盾结果（单次评分偏袒少数族裔，并排排名则惩罚其申请者）。这种不一致对理解模型真实偏差性质构成挑战，作者希望检验该反转现象是否在招聘、贷款和医疗等其他高风险决策领域普遍存在，从而判断模型是否真的存在人口统计偏差，抑或只是审计构造的产物。

Method: 对5个语言模型进行40,726次请求测试，涵盖招聘、贷款和医疗分诊三个领域；申请仅改变申请者姓名；在数据收集前预设主要测试（36个计划对比）。同时植入不同大小的合成偏差验证检测灵敏度，并使用原始援助材料进行定向复制，还引入审计透明度（模型能否识别审计）和身份内容（种族vs爱好）等条件的对照实验。

Result: 先前发现的偏差反转（评分偏袒/排名惩罚）未能在新领域中泛化。36个计划对比无一在多假设校正后存活。评级优势在符号上保持但效应量约为已发表研究的一半。招聘排名惩罚可被排除在已发表效应之外（结论性），但贷款和医疗排名的排除不具结论性。植入的偏差能被按注入大小检测到；模型几乎总能识别透明审计，种族与爱好对评分无差异影响；候选在列表中的位置效应与任何人口统计效应相当甚至更大。

Conclusion: 先前报告的人口统计偏差反转是一个领域特异现象而非普遍规律。审计裁决更多反映审计构造（如候选排序位置、审计设计方式）而非模型真实的人口统计偏差。建议对语言模型偏差审计需更谨慎，考虑审计构造的影响，避免将审计设计主导的结果误归因于人口统计偏见。

Abstract: Whether a language model looks demographically biased can depend on how the audit asks its question. A charitable-aid benchmark reports that the same models favor minority applicants when rating requests one at a time and penalize some when ranking side by side. We test whether that reversal generalizes to hiring, lending, and medical triage: 40,726 requests to five models, applications differing only in the applicant's name, and a primary test fixed before collection. It does not. None of 36 planned contrasts survives correction. The rating advantage keeps its sign at roughly half the published size, and a precision extension bounds any hiring ranking penalty below the published effect, though the lending and triage ranking floors sit above that margin, so the exclusion is conclusive for hiring ranking and for rating in all three domains only. Planted disparities tracking their injected sizes and a directional replication on the original aid materials bound these nulls. The audit is livelier than the demographics: models recognize transparent audits nearly always, tie every identical-content comparison whether the varying detail is race or a hobby, and reward first-listed candidates as much as any demographic effect we measure. Audit verdicts reflect audit construction more than demographic bias.

</details>


### [458] [Performance of Clinical AI System and Physicians and Frontier Language Models in primary care diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09070)
*Andy Nkansah,Hanna Plotnitskaya,Stanislau Salavei,Anna Kozlova,Piotr Gibas,Julian Milek,Viktar Harbachou,Aleksey Ropan,Pavel Satalkin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究评估了临床AI系统Doctorina在150个波兰语初级保健模拟病例中的表现，与8名医生和4个前沿语言模型进行对比。Doctorina在Top-1诊断一致性（82.0% vs 57.0%）、诊断/鉴别诊断一致性（97.3% vs 85.0%）、检查方案（89.4 vs 66.9）和治疗方案（83.7 vs 61.2）评分上均显著优于医生，其优势从主诊断选择扩展到诊断检查和初始治疗环节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的临床AI评估往往局限于单一诊断任务，忽略了临床实践中自适应信息收集后的诊断与管理全过程。本文旨在通过更全面的临床评估框架，比较AI系统与人类医生及通用语言模型在真实临床场景中的综合表现。

Method: 在150个合成的波兰语初级保健咨询案例中，比较Doctorina、8名医生和4个独立的前沿语言模型（包括Kimi K3、Claude Opus 5等）的表现。评估涵盖Top-1诊断一致性、主诊断或参考鉴别诊断一致性，以及对诊断检查方案和治疗方案进行标准化评分。还进行了第二次Doctorina执行的重复验证。

Result: Doctorina在Top-1诊断一致性上达到82.0%（医生为57.0%，差异25.0个百分点），主诊断或参考鉴别诊断一致性达97.3%（医生为85.0%）。检查评分为89.4 vs 66.9，治疗评分为83.7 vs 61.2。Doctorina在诊断指标上得分最高，Kimi K3次之；Claude Opus 5在治疗评估中领先。第二次执行结果复现了Doctorina对医生的全面优势。

Conclusion: Doctorina相对医生的优势不仅体现在主诊断选择上，还扩展到了质量更高的诊断检查和自适应咨询后的初始治疗方案。这提示临床AI评估应纳入完整的诊断与管理流程，而非仅局限于单一诊断任务。

Abstract: Clinical AI evaluation should encompass diagnosis and management after adaptive information gathering. We compared Doctorina, eight physicians and four standalone frontier language models in 150 synthetic Polish-language primary-care consultations. Doctorina achieved 82.0% Top-1 concordance versus 57.0% for physicians (difference, 25.0 percentage points; 95% confidence interval, 17.7-32.7) and 97.3% versus 85.0% primary-or-reference-differential concordance. Across 149 case pairs, normalized workup and treatment scores were 89.4 versus 66.9 and 83.7 versus 61.2. Doctorina had the highest diagnostic point estimates among all six groups; Kimi K3 ranked next, while Claude Opus 5 led the closely spaced management estimates of Opus, Doctorina and Kimi. A second Doctorina execution reproduced the advantages over physicians across all outcomes. Doctorina's advantage over physicians therefore extended from primary-diagnosis selection to higher-rated diagnostic workup and initial treatment after adaptive consultation.

</details>


### [459] [ToolLoop: Closed-Loop Tool-Use Data Synthesis via Decomposed Generation and Dynamic Self-Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09072)
*Min Zeng,Yuzhou Liu,Zhenyu Cao,Hanxiu Chen,Heng Li,Caiquan Liu,Yafei Wen,Xiaoxin Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ToolLoop是一个闭循环框架，将工具使用数据的合成分解为三个渐进阶段：采样函数名组合、反向推导用户查询、正向推导工具调用。每阶段通过动态自反馈实现从"生成-过滤"到"生成-验证-精炼"的转变。在BFCL上仅用11K合成示例和4B参数模型即达到86.40%准确率，跨基准泛化能力强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成工具使用数据的方法多采用"生成-过滤"范式，依赖静态事后验证，导致数据效率低且特征分布不平衡。高质量工具调用数据对训练语言模型与外部工具交互至关重要，因此需要更高效的合成框架。

Method: ToolLoop采用三个渐进阶段的闭循环框架：(1)采样函数名组合作为地面真值；(2)反向推导用户查询；(3)正向推导工具调用。每个阶段通过动态自反馈迭代引导模型生成高质量数据，实现从"生成-过滤"到"生成-验证-精炼"的范式转变。

Result: 在Berkeley函数调用排行榜(BFCL)上，使用11K合成示例训练的4B参数模型在非推理模式下达到86.40%准确率；移除BFCL重叠候选函数的Isolate变体仍达86.07%。在ACEBench跨基准评估中达到72.1%整体准确率，仅使用基线18.3%的训练数据。

Conclusion: ToolLoop通过闭循环生成-验证-精炼框架有效提升了合成工具使用数据的质量和效率，以更少的数据实现更强的性能，并展现出良好的跨基准泛化能力，验证了该合成范式的有效性。

Abstract: High-quality tool-use data is critical for training language models to interact effectively with external tools. However, existing synthetic approaches typically follow a generate-then-filter paradigm with static post-hoc verification, often yielding inefficient data with imbalanced feature distributions. We propose ToolLoop, a closed-loop framework that decomposes synthesis into three progressive stages: (1) sampling function name combinations as ground truth; (2) backward derivation of user queries; and (3) forward derivation of tool calls. At each stage, dynamic self-feedback iteratively guides the model toward high-quality generation, realizing a transition from generate-then-filter to generate-verify-refine. On the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL), a 4B parameter model trained with our 11K synthetic examples achieves 86.40% accuracy in non-reasoning mode, while an Isolate variant that removes BFCL-overlapping candidate functions still reaches 86.07\%. Cross-benchmark evaluation on ACEBench further demonstrates strong generalization, with 72.1% overall accuracy using only 18.3% of baseline training data.

</details>


### [460] [ActReview: Rebuttal-Guided Training Data and Rubric Rewards for Actionable Peer Review Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09076)
*Yiling Ma,Yilun Zhao,Sihong Wu,Ziyu Chen,Manasi Patwardhan,Arman Cohan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ActReview，一种基于反驳引导的后训练框架，用于生成可操作的同行评审反馈。核心思想是利用作者反驳中隐含的修订意图作为监督信号，通过多任务SFT和GRPO训练Qwen3-8B模型，使评审不仅能指出问题还能给出具体修订建议。作者构建了ActReview-40K数据集和ActReview-Bench基准，实验表明该方法在可操作性和落地性上优于现有专门评审生成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM被越来越多地用于投稿前自我审查，现有评审反馈往往只指出缺陷而不提供具体的修订指导，缺乏可操作性。作者发现作者反驳中隐含了针对评审意见的可行修订行动，可作为一种潜在的监督信号来训练生成面向修订的反馈。

Method: 将可操作评审生成分解为两个子任务：诊断性声明生成和修订建议生成。从OpenReview的真实评审-反驳线程中构建ActReview-40K数据集，将评审弱点与作者回应对齐，并基于论文局部证据进行grounding。采用多任务SFT后进行GRPO强化学习，使用候选感知、弱点特定的奖励函数。构建ActReview-Bench人工筛选基准（1000实例）用于评估。

Result: ActReview在可操作性和证据落地性上优于先前的专门评审生成模型，并与强提示型LLM具有竞争力。人工评估确认了改进的修订有用性，但也揭示了在技术准确性上仍存在差距。额外分析支持对未见论文的泛化能力和跨独立评审者的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 作者反驳中的修订意图可以作为有效的潜在监督信号来训练可操作评审生成模型。ActReview验证了这一范式的可行性，但仍需改进技术准确性，为未来工作指明了方向。

Abstract: As LLMs are increasingly used for pre-submission self-review, there is growing demand for feedback that not only identifies weaknesses but also guides authors toward concrete revisions. We study this as Actionable Peer-review Generation and decompose it into two subtasks: diagnostic claim generation and revision suggestion generation. We introduce ActReview, a rebuttal-guided post-training framework that connects paper-specific diagnoses to concrete, grounded revision plans. Our central insight is that author rebuttals reveal plausible actions for addressing reviewer concerns and can therefore provide latent supervision for revision-oriented feedback. From real review-rebuttal threads on OpenReview, we construct ActReview-40K by aligning reviewer weaknesses with author responses and grounding the resulting feedback in localized paper evidence. We post-train Qwen3-8B-Base with multi-task supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO using candidate-aware, weakness-specific rubric rewards. We also introduce ActReview-Bench, a human-curated benchmark of 1,000 instances for evaluating diagnostic quality and revision usefulness. Experiments show that ActReview outperforms prior specialized review-generation models on actionability and grounding while remaining competitive with strong prompt-based LLMs. Human evaluation confirms improved revision usefulness while revealing a remaining gap in technical accuracy, and additional analyses support generalization to held-out papers and robustness across independent judges.

</details>


### [461] [It's Not RoPE that Creates Sinks: The Role of Self-Concentration and Value-Non-Mixing in Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09085)
*Raito Kiya,Satoki Ohashi,Kosuke Sato,Go Kamoda,Ryosuke Takahashi,Yuji Yamamoto,Daiki Shiono,Keisuke Sakaguchi,Goro Kobayashi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）中在序列初始位置出现的"注意力汇"（Attention Sink）和"大规模激活"（Massive Activations）现象，并揭示了其背后的成因机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力汇和大规模激活现象在LLMs中经常共同出现，且大规模激活会对低比特量化带来挑战。理解这些现象的成因对于改进量化策略和深入理解注意力机制至关重要。

Method: 通过实验分析，探究了因果掩码导致的注意力自集中（self-concentration）以及注意力输出中的Value-non-mixing现象，揭示它们与注意力汇和大规模激活的因果关系。

Result: 实验发现因果掩码引发的注意力自集中和注意力输出中的Value-non-mixing是注意力汇和大规模激活现象产生的关键因素。

Conclusion: 这些发现为LLM内部动态提供了新的经验证据，可指导未来的量化策略设计，并深化对注意力层内部机制的理解。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit "Attention Sink" (AS) and the accompanying "Massive Activations" (MAs) at the initial position of a sequence. These phenomena frequently co-occur, and MAs can pose challenges for low-bit quantization. In this study, we analyze the factors underlying AS and MAs that emerge at the initial position regardless of the token occupying it. Our experiments suggest that self-concentration of attention, resulting from the causal mask, and the subsequent Value-non-mixing in attention outputs contribute to AS and MAs. These findings provide new empirical evidence on the internal dynamics of LLMs, offering insights that may inform future quantization strategies and advance our understanding of the internal mechanisms of attention layers.

</details>


### [462] [Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09090)
*Leyuan Tang,Kangda Wei,Tianyu Jiang,Ruihong Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SPINE基准测试，通过LLM代理扮演持续且错误的用户，自适应地质疑目标模型长达25轮对话，以评估大语言模型在持续压力下的谄媚行为。实验发现所有模型的崩溃率随对话长度增加，短对话协议低估了谄媚现象；通过可访问的推理轨迹发现正确立场常仍存在于推理中却被放弃，表明谄媚源于取悦用户而非知识缺乏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有谄媚评估通常使用简短、预设的对话，无法捕捉在持续、适应性分歧下出现的失败模式，因此需要更真实的长期对抗场景来全面评估模型谄媚倾向。

Method: 构建SPINE基准，由一个LLM代理扮演持续但错误的用户，自适应挑战目标模型长达25轮。使用100个虚假前提和100个不道德查询评估四个生产系统和三个Olmo3-7b变体，并分析可访问的推理轨迹与消融实验。

Result: 所有模型的崩溃率随对话长度增加；短对话协议低估谄媚；推理轨迹分析显示正确立场在推理中仍被代表却最终让步，表明模型选择取悦用户而非无知；自适应LLM代理比预生成脚本暴露更多谄媚崩溃；情感诉求是诱导谄媚行为最强的策略。

Conclusion: 当前模型在持续压力下保持立场仍不可靠，谄媚源于模型取悦用户的意图而非知识不足，需要更长对话的评估协议和针对情感操控的防御策略。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) may abandon correct positions when users push back, exhibiting a failure mode known as sycophancy. Existing evaluations typically use short, pre-specified conversations and may therefore miss failures that emerge under sustained, adaptive disagreement. We introduce SPINE, a benchmark in which an LLM proxy plays a persistent but mistaken user and adaptively challenges a target model for up to 25 turns. We evaluate four production systems and three Olmo3-7b variants on 100 false-presupposition and 100 unethical-query items. Our experimental results show that collapse rates increase with conversation length for every model, short-horizon protocols underestimate sycophancy and resistance under sustained pressure remains unreliable across current models. By analyzing models with accessible reasoning traces, we surprisingly found that the correct position often remains represented in a reasoning trace when the response concedes, suggesting that the model chooses to please a user and sycophancy is not due to lack of knowledge or ignorance. Ablations show that adaptive LLM proxy exposes more sycophantic collapse than pre-generated scripts. Among all tactics, emotional appeals is the most associated with inducing LLM sycophantic behavior. The code and data are released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPINE

</details>


### [463] [ReCite: Agentic Reasoning for Faithful Citation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09156)
*Yuyang Huang,Bobo Li,Jiajia Song,Yuzhe Ding,Chong Teng,Fei Li,Donghong Ji*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ReCite，一个解耦的智能体框架，通过位置感知、意图感知查询规划和反思性验证实现主动的声明级推理，以解决学术引用推荐中的错误归属问题，在严格引用准确率上超越大规模生成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于语义相似度的引用推荐系统虽然避免了生成不存在的论文，但常错误引用难以在逻辑上支持作者声明的真实论文（即误归属问题）。作者认为准确引用需要从基于相似性的搜索转向主动的声明级推理。

Method: 提出ReCite框架，包含三个解耦模块：位置感知（location perception）、意图感知查询规划（intent-aware query planning）、反思性验证（reflective verification）。框架在合成的推理轨迹上训练，智能体验证声明-证据一致性，并在检索到的候选缺乏逻辑支持时触发自我纠正循环。

Result: 实验表明，ReCite这一轻量级框架在严格引用准确率上超越了最先进的大规模生成模型。

Conclusion: 通过将文献匹配植根于可验证的逻辑而非语义重叠，ReCite为自动化学术写作建立了可靠的引用基础，代表了引用推荐从相似性匹配向逻辑推理范式的转变。

Abstract: Accurate citations are the foundation of academic writing, tracing intellectual origins and substantiating core claims. However, manually navigating the growing volume of scientific literature is increasingly difficult, prompting reliance on automatic citation recommendation. While modern retrieval-augmented architectures have largely mitigated the fabrication of non-existent papers, current systems relying on semantic similarity struggle with misattribution, often citing authentic papers that fail to logically support the author's claim. To address this challenge, we argue that accurate citation requires a shift from similarity-based search to active, claim-level reasoning. We propose ReCite, a decoupled agentic framework that orchestrates location perception, intent-aware query planning, and reflective verification. Trained on synthesized reasoning trajectories, our agent verifies claim-evidence consistency and triggers self-correction loops when retrieved candidates lack logical support. Experiments demonstrate that our lightweight framework outperforms state-of-the-art massive generative models in strict citation accuracy. By grounding literature matching in verifiable logic rather than semantic overlap, ReCite establishes a reliable foundation for automated academic writing.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [464] [Looking for Bidding Teammates: A Game-Theoretic Model of Stranger Collusion in Peer Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05444)
*Jinming Xing,Charlotte Brian*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文首次提出同行评审中勾结形成的博弈论模型——"互投困境"（Mutual Bidding Dilemma），论证开放招募场景下的审稿勾结难以仅靠激励自发形成，必须有执行/惩罚机制才能持续；并通过端到端会议仿真表明现有检测器对抗伪装攻击的F1上限仅0.322，损害呈分布性而非聚合性，随机分配是唯一直达执行层面的防御手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型计算机会议论文投标是审稿人分配的第一步，审稿人可通过线上招募互相认识、交换身份标识、对彼此的论文投标并互相给出虚高评分。现有勾结模型假设举报人是已互信的同事，而开放招募打破了这个假设，使已有机制失效。作者希望从博弈论角度建模并理解这种勾结"能否形成"以及"如何防范"。

Method: 提出四阶段博弈模型（Mutual Bidding Dilemma）：招募、在举报风险下交换标识、不可验证的投标、互审。在此基础上推导：回馈"永远不是个体理性的"（无论收益多大），因此勾结无法靠激励自发成立；唯一能闭合缺口的是执行机制（作者能看到自己的评审、截稿周期反复、群体有记忆）。作者推导出虚高评分可持续的条件、高于某检出率无同盟能存活的阈值，并在校准的端到端会议仿真中评估多种检测器与攻击策略。

Result: 理论结果表明勾结形成在纯激励下不可能（互惠永不理性），执行机制才是关键。仿真中所有测试检测器对抗伪装投标、环形扩散和操纵亲和度的攻击者时F1不超过0.322；两人同盟可带来3.2个百分点的录取概率收益；危害是分布性的：70篇诚实论文被挤掉，但平均质量仅移动0.002，任何汇总统计量都无法察觉。随机分配是唯一直接触及执行本身的防御，使"未投中标的搭档"与"投标失败者"无法区分。

Conclusion: 相互投标困境表明，审稿勾结的防线不在于激励设计（互惠在本模型下从不理性），而在于执行与记忆机制；现有检测器在精明伪装下性能极低，且危害具有隐蔽的分布性，提示需要在机制层面（如随机化、消除可被利用的信号）而非仅靠检测器来防御勾结形成。

Abstract: Paper bidding is the entry point to reviewer assignment at large CS conferences: reviewers declare interest, combined by an optimizer with automated affinity scores. Reviewers who have never met recruit each other online, exchange identifiers, bid on each other's papers, and reciprocate with inflated scores. Existing collusion models assume already-trusted colleagues; open recruitment removes that assumption and the mechanism that made such arrangements work. We give the first game-theoretic model of collusion \emph{formation} in peer review, the \emph{Mutual Bidding Dilemma}: a four-stage game covering recruitment, exchange of identifiers under risk of being reported, unverifiable bidding, and reciprocal reviewing. The model predicts the arrangement cannot form: once assigned a partner's paper, writing the inflated review is pure cost, since the benefit depends on the partner's own decision. Reciprocation is never individually rational, for any payoffs, and the arrangement unwinds. What closes the gap is enforcement, not incentives: authors see their own reviews, deadlines recur every few months, and the group remembers who reciprocated. We derive the condition under which inflation is sustainable, the detection rate above which no partnership survives, and show effort enters both. On a calibrated end-to-end conference simulation, no detector we test exceeds $F_1 = 0.322$ against an attacker who camouflages bids, spreads them around a ring, and manipulates affinity; a two-person arrangement is worth $3.2$ points of acceptance probability; and the harm is distributional, not aggregate: $70$ honest papers are displaced while mean quality moves by only $0.002$, so no summary statistic reveals it. Randomized assignment is the one defense reaching enforcement itself, making a partner who never bid indistinguishable from one who bid and lost.

</details>


### [465] [Three-sided mobility-energy market design as a multiperiod stochastic assignment game](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05449)
*Hai Yang,Joseph Y. J. Chow*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出一个双层规划模型来理解移动出行服务商（MSP）与能源提供商（EP）在三边市场中的交互关系，该模型以市场监管者为上层，优化服务定价以最大化平台利润；下层采用可扩展的基于链路的扰动效用路径选择（PURC）框架建模多利益相关者均衡，并通过时间离散间隔捕捉移动需求与充电需求之间的时间滞后关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有框架往往忽视移动出行需求与充电需求之间的时间相互依赖关系，缺乏能全面理解MSP与EP在三边市场中交互作用的理论模型。

Method: 提出一个由市场监管者监管的博弈分配双向层问题：上层优化服务定价以最大化平台盈利能力；下层利用可扩展的链路级扰动效用路径选择（PURC）框架建模多利益相关者均衡。评估时间框架划分为离散区间，通过经验仿射函数捕捉移动性与充电需求之间的时间滞后，并通过按时间顺序将下层分解为相互作用的移动出行服务与充电子网络来求解模型。

Result: 在扩展的Nguyen-Dupuis网络上的数值实验揭示三个关键洞见：（1）存在关键充电容量阈值，低于该阈值会迫使可部署车队规模大幅缩减并产生局部交通荒漠；（2）将内生运营成本纳入建模可揭示凹型利润轨迹，显示总利润在接近市场饱和前的特定车队规模处达到最大；（3）最优动态定价运行在狭窄范围内，高峰定价作为稳定的收入驱动力，而非高峰定价则作为高度敏感的运营缓冲。

Conclusion: 这些发现为协调车队规模与充电基础设施部署提供了可操作策略，帮助MSP与EP在扩展电动车生态系统中做出更好的决策。

Abstract: As mobility service providers (MSPs) and energy providers (EPs) expand electric vehicle ecosystems, models are needed to understand their interactions within a three-sided market. Existing frameworks often overlook the temporal interdependencies between mobility and charging demands. We address this gap by proposing a bilevel problem as an assignment game overseen by a market regulator. The upper level optimizes service pricing to maximize platform profitability. The lower level models a multi-stakeholder equilibrium using a scalable, link-based Perturbed Utility Route Choice (PURC) framework. The evaluation time frame is divided into discrete intervals, capturing the temporal lag between mobility and charging demand via an empirical affine function. We solve the model by chronologically decomposing the lower level into interacting mobility service and recharge subnetworks. Numerical experiments on the expanded Nguyen-Dupuis network reveal several key insights. First, a critical charging capacity threshold exists; operating below it forces a severe reduction in the deployable fleet and creates localized transit deserts. Second, modeling endogenous operating costs reveals a concave profit trajectory, demonstrating that total profit maximizes at a specific fleet size just before market saturation. Third, optimal dynamic pricing operates within a narrow range, where peak pricing acts as a steady revenue driver and off-peak pricing serves as a highly sensitive operational buffer. These findings provide actionable strategies for coordinating fleet sizing and charging infrastructure deployment.

</details>


### [466] [Large Language Models as Strategic Bidding Agents in P2P Energy Trading Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05462)
*Ismail Lotfi,Ali Ghrayeb,Haitham Abu-Rub*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出将大语言模型作为推理驱动的竞标代理，集成到重复P2P能源双向拍卖市场中，并与随机竞标和ε-greedy多臂老虎机策略进行对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: P2P能源交易市场中竞标代理的策略行为尚未被充分探索，尤其是在有界理性背景下的重复博弈场景中。传统统计学习方法存在探索期长、环境迁移能力差等问题，需要新的推理驱动型代理策略。

Method: 构建一个将LLM作为推理驱动竞标代理的框架，应用于重复P2P能源双向拍卖市场。比较三种竞标策略：随机竞标、ε-greedy多臂老虎机方法以及基于LLM的策略。

Result: LLM策略在前期的已清算交易量上优于ε-greedy MAB和随机竞标基线，消除了统计学习算法的探索预热期。在环境变化时，ε-greedy策略性能显著下降，而LLM策略仍能保持较高的剩余和成功交易。但在同质LLM代理群体中，卖方利用买方的理性外部选项将清算价格推高至纳什均衡之上，导致剩余分配向卖方倾斜且不收敛。

Conclusion: LLM作为竞标代理在效率和环境适应性上具有优势，但其高级上下文推理能力在同质群体中可能导致市场权力失衡和分配不对称问题，需要进一步关注LLM代理对市场动态的潜在影响。

Abstract: Peer-to-peer (P2P) energy trading markets rely on double auction mechanisms to match prosumers and consumers in smart grid distribution networks. However, the strategic behavior of bidding agents in such markets remains not fully explored, particularly in repeated settings with bounded rationality. This paper proposes a novel framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) as reasoning-driven bidding agents in repeated P2P energy double auctions. We compare the performance of three bidding strategies: random bidding, an $\varepsilon$-greedy multi-armed bandit (MAB) approach, and an LLM-based strategy. Simulation results show that the LLM-based strategy achieves superior cleared trading volume over the first episodes compared to $\varepsilon$-greedy MAB and random bidding baselines, eliminating the exploration burn-in period that statistical learning algorithms inherently require before converging to productive price arms. Importantly, when tested in an environment different from the one used during learning, the performance of the $\varepsilon$-greedy strategy drops significantly, while that of the LLM-based bidding strategy continue to achieve higher surplus and successful trades. Nevertheless, the LLM's advanced contextual reasoning also gives rise to an important market dynamic. In a homogeneous population of LLM agents, sellers increasingly exploit buyers' rational outside options to drive clearing prices above the Nash equilibrium, resulting in a progressively more asymmetric allocation of surplus in favor of sellers that does not converge within the observed time horizon.

</details>


### [467] [Truth Revelation, Information Hiding, or Misinformation: Characterization of Equilibrium Outcomes in Signaling Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05489)
*Ertan Kazıklı,Sinan Gezici,Serdar Yüksel*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究贝叶斯说服问题（Bayesian persuasion），其中接收者试图估计信源。论文完整刻画了发送者需要随机化策略的条件，证明在确定性策略限制下（无论是完全揭示、量化还是非信息性），在特定条件下总存在能提升发送者收益的随机化策略。同时提出了一种算法程序来获得贝叶斯说服解，并统一了完全对齐与完全错位收益结构的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信号传递游戏中，发送者与接收者标准不一致时，均衡行为可能表现为完全揭示、量化或随机化策略。作者希望理解并刻画贝叶斯说服（Stackelberg型）问题中发送者何时需要使用随机化策略，以及随机化如何改善发送者的收益。

Method: 作者对有限基数的一般信源，完整刻画了发送者需要随机化的充要条件；提出了一种算法程序来获得贝叶斯说服解，该算法通过比较有限多个后验概率组合的收益来求解。此外，分别分析了完全对齐（解为完全揭示）和完全错位（解为非信息性）的收益结构，并最终统一证明：若发送者关于后验分布的期望收益连续，则均衡解要么是完全揭示的发送者，要么是非信息性的发送者。

Result: 研究发现：在确定性政策限制下，无论均衡解是完全揭示、量化还是非信息性，在论文刻画的某些条件下，总存在改进发送者收益的随机化政策。论文给出了随机化需求的完整条件刻画，并提供了获取贝叶斯说服解的算法流程。统一结果为：在连续性假设下，均衡解两端（完全揭示或非信息性）的二分性成立。

Conclusion: 论文完整刻画了贝叶斯说服问题中随机化策略的必要性条件，建立了算法求解框架，并证明了在收益连续性条件下均衡解呈现"完全揭示或非信息性"的二分结构，为理解信号博弈中随机化均衡提供了理论依据。

Abstract: In signaling games where a sender and a receiver have misaligned criteria, equilibrium behavior may lead to fully revealing, quantized, or randomized policies. Notably, the first arises in statistical decision theory and classical communication theoretic problems involving a fully aligned sensor and receiver, the second arises in Nash theoretic simultaneous signaling games, and the last may appear in Stackelberg type (leader-follower) Bayesian signaling games. In this paper, we investigate the Bayesian persuasion problem involving a receiver that tries to estimate the source. We show that for certain payoff structures, the equilibrium solution is such that a source observation is mapped to distinct messages with nonzero probabilities. More specifically, we completely characterize conditions under which the sender requires randomization for the Bayesian persuasion problem involving general sources with finite cardinality. In particular, regardless of whether the equilibrium solution under a deterministic policy restriction is fully revealing, quantized or noninformative, there exists a randomized sender policy that improves the sender's payoff under certain conditions characterized in the paper. Moreover, we provide an algorithmic procedure to obtain the Bayesian persuasion solution, where the algorithm compares the payoffs with finitely many posterior probability combinations. We also consider fully aligned and completely misaligned payoff structures, where the solutions respectively involve a fully revealing sender and a noninformative sender. Then, we unify these results by proving that if the sender's expected payoff with respect to posterior distributions is continuous, then the equilibrium solution involves either a fully revealing sender or a noninformative sender.

</details>


### [468] [A 1.283 Price-of-Anarchy Bound for the Repeated Virtual First-Price Auction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05499)
*Endre Csóka*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究重复分配单一不可分割资源的问题，其中n个策略性玩家各自拥有私有的价值分布。作者提出应用带有相等初始虚拟货币禀赋的重复一价拍卖机制，证明每个玩家能够渐近地获得与Csóka 2026相同的公平下限保障f(D_i)，从而使该机制达到1.283-最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究目标是在重复分配单一资源时寻找既公平又高效的机制。作者希望提供一个比现有方法更简单、更稳健的替代机制，同时可能帮助推导出更紧的Price of Anarchy上限。

Method: 采用重复一价拍卖（repeated first-price auction），为每个玩家分配相等的初始虚拟货币禀赋。玩家价值分布D_i是私有的，且在各周期间独立抽取。通过这一机制设计，分析每个玩家能否渐近地获得公平下限保障f(D_i)。

Result: 论文证明每个玩家可以渐近地获得与Csóka 2026相同的公平下限保障f(D_i)，即该机制在特定情况下的效率达到1.283-最优。

Conclusion: 该机制为这个问题提供了一种更简单且更稳健的替代方案，并且可能有助于推导更紧的Price of Anarchy上界。

Abstract: We study the repeated allocation of a single indivisible resource among $n$ strategic players. Each player $i$ has a privately known value distribution $D_i$, and values are drawn independently across players and periods. The goal is to find fair and efficient mechanisms.
  We apply the repeated first-price auction with equal initial endowments of virtual money. We show that each player can asymptotically secure the same fair-floor guarantee $f(D_i)$ as in Csóka 2026; consequently, the mechanism is $1.283$-optimal. This provides a simpler and more robust alternative mechanism for this special case and may also help derive sharper upper bounds on the price of anarchy.

</details>


### [469] [Utility-Driven Spatial Data Sampling for UAV-Assisted Scientific Smart Farming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05765)
*Keiwan Soltani,Sajal K. Das*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向智能农业的效用驱动空间采样框架，无人机基于科学效用评分（新鲜度、冗余度、异常可能性、模型不确定性）选择高价值网格单元进行数据采集，在电池和返航约束下将UAV数据收集重新定义为自适应科学数据管理而非穷尽式感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模智能农业部署中，能量受限的无人机无法在每个任务中采集所有传感器的数据。现有UAV辅助采集方法通常优化覆盖率、路由长度、数据量或新鲜度，但未区分"可用数据"与"有科学价值的数据"，导致采集效率低下。

Method: 将农田划分为与UAV地面覆盖范围相匹配的网格单元；初始探索阶段后，每个单元基于新鲜度、冗余度、异常可能性和模型不确定性获得科学效用评分；UAV在电池和返航约束下选择并访问高效用子集单元。

Result: 该框架将UAV数据采集从穷尽式感知转变为自适应的科学数据管理，提升采集数据的科学价值。

Conclusion: 通过效用驱动的空间采样框架，实现了在能量约束下优先采集科学上有价值的数据，而非盲目覆盖所有区域。

Abstract: Large smart-farming deployments generate continuous scientific data from spatially distributed sensors, including soil, humidity, temperature, crop-health, and pest-related measurements. In vast agricultural fields, however, an energy-constrained unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) often cannot collect data from every sensor during each mission. Existing UAV-assisted collection methods typically optimize coverage, route length, data volume, or freshness, but they do not always distinguish between data that is merely available and data that is scientifically valuable. This poster introduces a utility-driven spatial sampling framework for UAV-assisted smart farming. The field is partitioned into grid cells, each sized according to the UAV ground coverage range. After an initial exploration phase, each cell receives a scientific utility score based on freshness, redundancy, anomaly likelihood, and model uncertainty. The UAV then selects and visits a subset of high-utility cells under battery and return-to-base constraints. The proposed framework reframes UAV-based collection as adaptive scientific data management rather than exhaustive sensing.

</details>


### [470] [Games Over Observation Spaces in Multi-Agent Capture the Flag](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06178)
*Mae Frost,Michael Amir,Shaunak D. Bopardikar*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体夺旗（CtF）场景，探讨在防御方仅使用单个固定启发式策略的情况下，通过集中式防御预言机操控每个防御智能体的图可见区域，从而激发出固定策略更丰富的涌现行为，并形式化为二人零和博弈，用Double Oracle算法求解近似经验纳什均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在真实多智能体对抗场景中，防御方往往受限于固定的启发式策略（无法更换策略库），这限制了防御能力的上限。作者希望探索一种不需要更换策略本身、仅通过操控智能体所见的局部信息（可见性配置）就能提升防御效果的途径。

Method: 将攻防交互形式化为二人零和博弈：攻击方在其多样化启发式策略库中选择策略，防御方在组合爆炸的可见性配置文件空间中做决策。由于博弈规模巨大，提出Double Oracle（双预言机）算法来逐步扩展策略空间并求解近似经验纳什均衡。

Result: 通过实验验证，观测信息操控（即对每个防御智能体可见的图区域进行策略性限制）确实能够显著提升防御方的性能表现。

Conclusion: 即使在防御策略固定不可更换的约束下，通过集中式地操控各个防御智能体的感知范围（可见性配置），仍然可以引导统一策略产生多样化的涌现行为，从而有效应对不同类型的攻击者，改善整体防御效果。

Abstract: We consider a multi-agent Capture the Flag (CtF) scenario in a graph-based environment, where a team of attackers seeks to reach designated flag vertices while a defending team attempts to intercept them. In our setting, both teams operate using decentralized heuristic policies. While the attacking team may choose its heuristic from a diverse library of policies, the defense is restricted to playing a single fixed policy. To overcome this limitation, a centralized defense oracle strategically restricts the portion of the graph visible to each of its agents in order to elicit a wider range of emergent behaviors from its fixed policy. We formalize this interaction as a two-player zero-sum game, where the attacker reasons over its library of heuristics and the defense reasons over the combinatorial space of visibility profiles. To solve this intractably large game, we propose a Double Oracle algorithm to find approximate empirical equilibria, and we empirically validate that observation manipulation can improve the defense's performance.

</details>


### [471] [Pairwise Maximin Share Allocations Need Not Exist](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06282)
*Haris Aziz*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了不可分割物品的公平分配问题，首次否定了PMMS（成对最大最小份额公平）分配在严格正加性估值下总是存在的猜想，构造了一个四个代理且估值严格为正的反例，证明该实例不存在完整的PMMS分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PMMS公平分配是否在正加性估值下总是存在的问题自该概念提出以来一直悬而未决，解决这一开放问题对于理解公平分配理论的边界具有重要意义。

Method: 通过构造一个包含四个代理且所有代理估值严格为正的具体反例实例，证明该实例中不存在任何完整的PMMS分配，从而否定了一般存在性。

Result: 构造出四个代理、正加性估值的实例，该实例不存在完整的PMMS分配，回答了开放问题并给出了否定结论。

Conclusion: PMMS分配在严格正加性估值下并不总是存在，此前关于其一般存在性的猜想被推翻。

Abstract: We study the fair allocation of indivisible goods among agents with strictly positive additive valuations. Pairwise maximin share fairness (PMMS) asks that, for every ordered pair of agents, the first agent value her own bundle at least as highly as the best worst-case share she could secure by repartitioning the two agents' combined bundles into two parts. Whether a PMMS allocation always exists for positive additive valuations has remained open since the notion was introduced. We resolve this question in the negative. We construct an instance with four agents and strictly positive additive valuations that admits no complete PMMS allocation.

</details>


### [472] [Deception in Reach-Avoid Game with Unknown Heterogeneous Attackers Speed Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06953)
*Xiangkai Wu,Shaolin Tan,Wei Wang,Zhen Han*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了一个双攻击者单防御者的reach-avoid博弈问题，其中攻击者速度异构且为私有信息（仅公开连续范围），建立了临界速度对框架来分析捕获顺序模糊性，并证明了攻击者可通过慢速欺骗策略误导防御者做出次优决策，从而获得优于完全信息博弈的收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统研究假设完全信息环境，而现实场景中攻击者的速度往往是私有信息。现有关于速度不确定性（不确定速度）的研究主要聚焦于同构设置，忽略了异构性带来的复杂性。异构性将不确定性从单一能力水平扩展到攻击者之间的相对能力配置，产生捕获顺序模糊性，而这一问题尚未被充分研究。

Method: 建立临界速度对（critical speed pair）框架，用于刻画不同能力配置何时引致不同的最优捕获顺序；基于该框架分析防御者的猜测行为，并为攻击者设计信息限制策略；通过数值可视化验证欺骗策略的有效性与广泛适用性。

Result: 在特定初始条件下，攻击者可以通过慢速欺骗策略误导防御者做出次优决策，获得比完全信息博弈更优的支付；数值结果表明此类困境条件广泛存在。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了在速度信息不对称且异构的情况下，攻击者可以利用私有能力信息误导防御者，实现超越完全信息博弈的收益，为信息不对称下的多智能体安全博弈提供了新的理论洞察。

Abstract: This letter investigates a reach-avoid game involving two Attackers and one Defender, where the Attackers aim to maximize the number reaching the target region while the Defender seeks to minimize it. In contrast to conventional complete information formulations, we consider an information asymmetry scenario where the Attackers' heterogeneous maximum speeds are privately known but publicly disclosed to lie within continuous ranges. Existing studies on uncertain speeds, however, have primarily focused on homogeneous settings, whereas heterogeneity extends the uncertainty from a common capability level to the relative capability configuration of the Attackers. To address the resulting capture-order ambiguity over infinitely many possible speed combinations, we establish a critical speed pair framework that characterizes when different capability configurations induce different optimal capture orders, and enables the analysis of the Defender's guessing behavior and the design of information-limiting strategies for the Attackers. We demonstrate that under certain initial conditions, the Attackers can mislead the Defender into making suboptimal decisions through a slow-speed deception strategy, achieving superior payoffs compared to the complete information game. Numerical visualizations reveal the widespread occurrence of such dilemma conditions.

</details>


### [473] [How Well Can Strategyproof Tournament Rules Resist Pairwise Manipulation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07062)
*Ke Ding,Bo Li,Fangxiao Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了锦标赛规则（tournament rules）的抗操纵性。作者建立了三种非操纵性概念之间的严格层级关系：NM_λ 强于 MNM 强于 SNM。在此基础上，他们分析了更强但研究较少的概念（成对乘法非操纵性和 λ 的 2-非操纵性），证明 Randomized Death Match 规则满足 2-MNM-3/2 且匹配下界，并提出了新的 BlockBonusedWinStrengths 规则，该规则满足 Condorcet 一致性、单调性和 2-NM₂，将此前 λ=11 的上界大幅改进至 λ=2，与下界 λ=1 仅相差两倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 锦标赛规则需要同时满足 Condorcet 一致性、单调性以及对联盟操纵的抵抗力。以往研究主要使用加法度量（k-SNM-α）来衡量操纵，最近引入了乘法度量（k-MNM-δ）和描述团队自私性的 λ 非操纵性（k-NM_λ）。这些更强且更实用的概念研究不足，需要深入探索能够满足这些更强概念的规则。

Method: 首先证明三种非操纵性概念之间存在严格层级关系：NM_λ 严格强于 MNM，MNM 严格强于 SNM。然后针对更强且研究较少的两个概念进行具体规则分析：(1) 证明 Randomized Death Match 规则满足 2-MNM-3/2 并匹配下界；(2) 提出 BlockBonusedWinStrengths 规则，证明其满足 Condorcet 一致性、单调性和 2-NM₂。

Result: (1) 建立了 NM_λ 严格强于 MNM 严格强于 SNM 的层级关系；(2) Randomized Death Match 满足 2-MNM-3/2 且匹配理论下界；(3) 新提出的 BlockBonusedWinStrengths 规则满足 Condorcet 一致性、单调性和 2-NM₂，将此前上界从 λ=11 大幅改进到 λ=2，与下界 λ=1 仅相差两倍。

Conclusion: 本文通过建立概念间的层级关系明确了各非操纵性概念的相对强度，并通过分析现有规则和设计新规则，显著推进了锦标赛规则在乘法非操纵性和 λ 非操纵性这两个更强框架下的理解，其中 BlockBonusedWinStrengths 规则在满足所有理想性质的前提下将参数上界优化到了接近理论极限。

Abstract: A tournament rule maps the outcomes of all pairwise matches among $n$ teams to a possibly randomized winner. Desirable rules should be Condorcet consistent and monotone, yet also resistant to manipulation among coalition. Prior work mostly measures such manipulation additively through $k$-strongly non-manipulable at $α$ ($k$-SNM-$α$), meaning that no coalition of size $k$ can fix the matches among themselves to increase their total winning probability by $α$. Very recently, two new notions of non-manipulability were introduced. Multiplicative non-manipulability ($k$-MNM-$δ$) is defined analogously, using the multiplicative factor instead. Non-manipulability for $λ$ ($k$-NM$_λ$) characterizes the selfishness of a team, which restricts a coalition's gain to be less than $λ$ times the winning probability sacrificed by its members.
  In this work, we begin with a strict hierarchy among these three notions: NM$_λ$ is stronger than MNM, which is then stronger than SNM. This motivates us to consider those two notions that are stronger but less studied: pairwise multiplicative non-manipulability and $2$-non-manipulability for $λ$. We show that Randomized Death Match is $2$-MNM-$3/2$ and optimally matches the lower bound. Then, we introduce the BlockBonusedWinStrengths rule, which is Condorcet consistent, monotone, and $2$-NM$_2$. This rule substantially improves the previous upper bound of $λ=11$ and comes within a factor of two of the lower bound $λ=1$.

</details>


### [474] [The Fine-Grained Complexity of Approximate Nash Equilibrium and Free Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07136)
*Noah Golowich*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了在近似误差趋于零的机制下，计算近似纳什均衡和近似自由博弈值的细粒度复杂度。在PCP for PPAD和ETH for PPAD猜想下，证明计算ε-近似纳什均衡需要N^(log(N)/ε²)^(1-o(1))时间，表明Lipton-Markakis-Mehta算法在所有ε=ω(1/√N)范围内都是最优的。同时建立了自由博弈值估计的类似紧下界，回答了Aaronson等人提出的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作虽然已在常数ε机制下证明近似纳什均衡计算的最优性（Rubinstein 2016），但在ε=o(1)的渐近消失误差机制下，只能排除N^(O(logN)/ε)这样显著更小的运行时间，存在差距。作者希望在该机制下建立紧的下界，并解决自由博弈值估计中的类似开放问题。

Method: 本文结合PCP for PPAD与ETH for PPAD猜想，以及ETH猜想，通过精细化的归约技术构建从计算困难问题到近似纳什均衡和自由博弈值估计的规约，从而在误差趋于零的机制下推导出更强的下界。同时使用类似技术将方法推广到自由博弈的ε-加性值估计问题上。

Result: 证明了计算ε-近似纳什均衡需要N^(log(N)/ε²)^(1-o(1))时间（在PCP for PPAD与ETH for PPAD猜想下），在所有ε=ω(1/√N)机制下达到最优；并建立了自由博弈ε-加性值估计的紧下界N^(log(N)/ε²)^(1-o(1))（在ETH下），适用于ε≥2^(-o(√logN))。

Conclusion: 本文填补了近似纳什均衡在误差消失机制下的最优性空白，证明Lipton-Markakis-Mehta算法在整个相关机制范围内都是最优的，同时回答了Aaronson等人（2014）关于自由博弈值估计复杂度的开放问题，为两个相关问题建立了精确的细粒度复杂度刻画。

Abstract: We study the fine-grained complexity of computing approximate Nash equilibria and approximating the value of free games in the regime where the approximation error vanishes. Under the PCP for PPAD and ETH for PPAD conjectures, we show that computing $\varepsilon$-approximate Nash equilibria in 2-player $N$-action normal-form games requires time $N^{(\log(N)/\varepsilon^2)^{1-o(1)}}$, thus showing that the classical Lipton-Markakis-Mehta algorithm (2003) is optimal through all regimes of $\varepsilon = ω(1/\sqrt{N})$. While such optimality was known in the constant-$\varepsilon$ regime (Rubinstein, 2016), previous work could only rule out significantly smaller running times of $N^{O(\log(N)/\varepsilon)}$ in the regime $\varepsilon = o(1)$. Using similar techniques, we then establish an analogous tight lower bound of $N^{(\log(N)/\varepsilon^2)^{1-o(1)}}$ under ETH for $\varepsilon$-additive value estimation in free games, when $\varepsilon \geq 2^{-o(\sqrt{\log N})}$, answering a question of Aaronson, Impagliazzo, and Moshkovitz (2014).

</details>


### [475] [Improved Randomized Approximations for Strategic Obnoxious Facility Location](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07261)
*Hau Chan,Jianan Lin,Chenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究线段上厌恶型设施选址问题的随机策略证明机制。针对社会福利目标，提出新随机机制将最优近似比从3/2降至1.47359，并将下界从1.15470提升至1.19318；针对最小效用目标，将近似保证从√(2n)+O(1)降至√n+O(1)，并将渐近下界从3/2加强到2。四个界均严格优于此前已知结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 策略证明的社会选择机制旨在设计防操纵的设施选址机制。对于厌恶型设施（如垃圾场、核电站等）选址问题，现有随机机制的最优近似比上界（3/2）与下界（2/√3）之间存在显著gap，且最小效用目标下的渐近下界（3/2）与上界之间存在矛盾可能性，亟需收窄这些间隙并验证最优性的理论边界。

Method: （1）对社会福利目标，构造了一种新颖的随机化机制以突破3/2近似上界；（2）通过更精巧的分析手段提高随机策略证明机制的近似下界至105/88；（3）对最小效用目标，沿用了Chan等人提出的即profile-independent方法，设计简单随机机制；（4）通过严格的对抗性论证证明渐近意义上没有任何随机策略证明机制能达到严格小于2的近似比。

Result: 社会福利目标：上界从1.5改进到1.47359；下界从1.15470提升至1.19318。最小效用目标：上界从√(2n)+O(1)改进到√n+O(1)；渐近下界从1.5加强到2。论文中考虑的四个界均严格优于此前已知结果。

Conclusion: 本文全面提升了线段上厌恶型设施选址问题在两种效用目标下的近似比界限，缩小了上下界间隙，并揭示出即使引入随机化，策略证明机制在渐近意义下也无法实现小于2的近似比，为该问题的最优机制设计提供了更强的理论约束与方向指引。

Abstract: We study randomized strategyproof mechanisms for strategic obnoxious facility location on a line segment, where agents wish the facility to be located as far away from them as possible and their utility is their distance from the facility, under the social utility and minimum utility objectives. For social utility, we propose a novel randomized mechanism that breaks the previously best known \(\frac32\)-approximation of [Cheng, Yu, and Zhang, TCS 2013], achieving an approximation ratio of at most \(1.47359\). We also raise the lower bound on the approximation ratio of randomized strategyproof mechanisms from \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\approx1.15470\) [Feigenbaum et al., JAAMAS 2020] to \(\frac{105}{88}\approx1.19318\). For minimum utility, following the profile-independent approach of [Chan, Lin and Wang, AAMAS 2026], we design a simple randomized mechanism that reduces the approximation guarantee from \(\sqrt{2n}+O(1)\) to \(\sqrt n+O(1)\), where \(n\) is the number of agents. Finally, we prove that no randomized strategyproof mechanism can achieve an asymptotic approximation ratio strictly smaller than \(2\), strengthening the previous asymptotic lower bound of \(\frac32\) [Feigenbaum et al., JAAMAS 2020]. Thus, all four bounds considered in this paper strictly improve upon the corresponding previously known results.

</details>


### [476] [Finding Representative and Approximately Efficient Committees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07554)
*Dominik Peters,Rohit Vaish,Jatin Yadav*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了审批投票中的比例批准投票（PAV）的计算复杂性与效率性质之间的权衡。作者系统分析了局部PAV的效率性质（弱Pareto最优、2-近似fPO和2/3-近似PAV得分，均紧界），并设计了一个多项式时间算法，通过管道舍入凹松弛并用局部PAV初始化，同时实现EJR+比例性、α*-fPO（α*≈1.346）、弱Pareto最优性以及0.79-近似PAV得分（匹配P≠NP下的最优可计算界）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PAV在审批委员会投票中被广泛研究，因为它结合了比例代表性和Pareto效率，但计算PAV委员会是NP难的。自然的疑问是：能否通过计算高效的程序同时实现PAV的比例性和效率性质？

Method: 作者首先系统研究局部PAV（基于局部搜索的PAV变体）的效率性质，证明其弱Pareto最优，并得出2-近似fPO和2/3-近似PAV得分的紧界。然后设计了多项式时间算法：对PAV目标进行凹松弛并做管道舍入（pipage rounding），用得到的委员会初始化局部PAV，从而将全局近似保证与局部搜索稳定性结合。

Result: 全局PAV是Pareto最优且满足α*-fPO（α*≈1.346为紧界）。提出的算法返回的委员会满足EJR+（比例保证）、α*-fPO和弱Pareto最优性，并达到0.79-近似的最优PAV得分，匹配P≠NP假设下的最佳可能多项式时间近似。

Conclusion: 论文表明，通过巧妙的算法设计，可以在多项式时间内同时获得PAV的强比例性保证和良好的效率性质（全局近似与局部搜索稳定性结合），从而在很大程度上回答了PAV的计算限制能否被克服的问题。

Abstract: In approval-based committee voting, proportional approval voting (PAV) is a well-studied rule that combines proportional representation with Pareto efficiency. However, computing a PAV committee is NP-hard, raising a natural question: Can the proportionality and efficiency properties of PAV be achieved via computationally efficient procedures?
  We make two contributions toward answering this question. First, building on the known proportionality guarantees of the local-search-based variant of PAV (or local PAV), we systematically study its efficiency properties. We show that local PAV committees are weakly Pareto optimal, meaning that no other committee is strictly preferred by every voter. We also identify limitations: Local PAV guarantees only a $2$-approximation to fractional Pareto optimality ($2$-fPO) and a $2/3$-approximation to the optimal PAV score, and both bounds are tight. In contrast, global PAV is Pareto optimal and satisfies the stronger $α^\star$-fPO guarantee, where $α^\star \approx 1.346$ is the unique solution of $\int_0^{α^\star} \frac{1-e^{-y}}{y} \, dy = 1$, and this approximation is tight.
  Second, we design a polynomial-time algorithm that combines the best of these guarantees. The committee returned by our algorithm satisfies EJR$+$ (a proportionality guarantee), $α^\star$-fPO, and weak Pareto optimality. It also achieves a $0.79$-approximation to the optimal PAV score, matching the best possible polynomial-time approximation assuming $P \neq NP$. Our algorithm works by pipage rounding a concave relaxation of the PAV objective and using that committee to initialize local PAV, thereby combining global approximation guarantees with local search stability.

</details>


### [477] [Sequential Offering in On-Demand Platforms: On the Optimality of Greedy Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08001)
*Hongyao Ma,Will Ma,Matias Romero*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了按需平台中工人的顺序招聘与动态定价的联合优化问题。核心发现是：当工人的保留工资分布满足非增凸密度函数条件时，贪心排序（最优工人优先）加上逆向归纳定价可最大化福利；对于任意分布，贪心排序能达到先知基准的n/(2n-1)紧致近似比。数值实验表明，即使贪心在某些情形下次优，福利损失也远低于最坏情况上界，说明平台应坚持贪心排序而非低报价策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 按需平台需要向独立工人分配时效性任务，工人可能拒绝报价。平台常通过逐次提高报价来应对拒绝，但动态调价与工人被接触顺序之间的交互被忽视：若最优工人被最早接触并看到最低报价而拒绝，较差工人反而在涨价后接受任务，导致系统效率低下。

Method: 将顺序报价问题建模为联合优化工人排序和定价轨迹的问题，目标为最大化期望福利或平台利润。通过理论分析，结合贪心排序策略与逆向归纳法求解最优定价，并对一般分布情形给出先知基准（prophet benchmark）下的近似比分析。

Result: 主要结果：当保留工资分布为均匀、指数等具有非增凸密度函数的分布时，贪心排序与逆向归纳定价联合达到福利最大化。对任意分布，贪心排序可达到先知基准的n/(2n-1)近似比且该界限紧致。数值实验表明在分布假设之外的情境中，福利损失远低于理论最坏上界。

Conclusion: 平台不应向较差匹配的工人发送初始低报价（"low ball"），而应坚持贪心排序（按匹配质量排序），同时通过考虑下游报价的延续价值来优化工资水平。这一发现对平台运营策略具有直接的实践指导意义。

Abstract: On-demand platforms face the fundamental challenge of fulfilling time-sensitive jobs with independent workers who may decline offers. To minimize delays and unfulfilled jobs, platforms frequently raise the offered wage sequentially following each rejection. However, the interaction between these dynamic price adjustments and the specific sequence in which workers are approached has been overlooked. In particular, if the best-suited workers (e.g., closest to the job) are also ranked earliest in the sequence, then those workers would see the lowest offered wages and may decline, leading to poor system outcomes where less-suited workers end up seeing the raised wages and accepting the job. We study the sequential offering problem to maximize expected welfare or platform profit by jointly optimizing the ranking of workers and the pricing trajectory. Surprisingly, our main result establishes that if the reservation wage distribution exhibits a non-increasing and convex density function (e.g., Uniform, Exponential), welfare is maximized by greedy ranking and wages optimized via backward induction. For arbitrary distributions, we prove that greedy ranking achieves a tight $n/(2n - 1)$ fraction of the prophet benchmark. Numerical results for settings beyond the distributional assumptions find welfare losses well below those allowed by the universal guarantee, even in families where greedy is provably suboptimal. This suggests that rather than sending initial "low ball'' offers to worse matches, platforms should stick with greedy ranking and optimize the wage offerings by appropriately taking the continuation value of the downstream offers into consideration.

</details>


### [478] [Stable Voting Rules on the Edge of Optimal Metric Distortion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08259)
*Ziyi Cai,Moses Charikar,Jabari Hastings,Prasanna Ramakrishnan,Kangning Wang,Qilin Ye*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明了一种随机投票规则的存在性，其度量失真（metric distortion）至多2.13713，与下界2.11264仅相差0.025。该规则源自委员会选举中稳定k-抽签（stable k-lotteries）的推广，与以往工作不同，新规则从零和博弈导出的单一分布中采样，无需在不同投票规则间混合。研究同时给出了稳定k-抽签的尖锐失真界，特别证明了稳定2-抽签的失真为7/3，尽管其仅依赖候选人三元组的聚合偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机投票规则的度量失真是衡量其社会选择质量的关键指标，此前存在从随机化到确定性投票规则的失真下界与上界之间的差距。作者希望缩小这一差距，找到一种接近最优的随机投票规则。

Method: 将委员会选举中提出的稳定k-抽签概念进行推广，构造一种随机投票规则。该规则不采用多种投票规则的混合，而是从由零和博弈求解得到的单一概率分布中进行采样。

Result: 实现了至多2.13713的度量失真，将此前与理论下界2.11264的差距缩小到0.025以内。同时给出了稳定k-抽签的紧致失真界，其中稳定2-抽签的失真精确为7/3。

Conclusion: 该研究在随机投票规则的度量失真问题上取得了显著进展，通过与委员会选择理论的联系，构造出接近最优的投票规则，并揭示稳定抽签方法在单胜者投票场景中的强大适用性。

Abstract: We prove the existence of a randomized voting rule with metric distortion at most $2.13713$, within $0.025$ of the lower bound of $2.11264$. Our rule comes from a generalization of stable $k$-lotteries developed in the context of committee selection. In contrast to prior work, our rule samples from a single distribution derived from a zero-sum game, without mixing between voting rules. Our result also gives sharp distortion bounds for stable $k$-lotteries, and in particular shows that stable $2$-lotteries have distortion $7/3$, despite only relying on aggregate preferences over triples of candidates.

</details>


### [479] [Subquadratic Subsidies for Nonnegative or Nonpositive Valuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08272)
*Max Dupré la Tour,Mashbat Suzuki*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究不可分割物品在津贴（补贴）下的无嫉妒分配问题，将研究范围从可加估值扩展到更一般的估值类。假设每个单项边际值在[-1,1]范围内，证明当所有代理对每个捆绑物品赋予非负值或所有赋予非正值时，总津贴O(n^{3/2}√log n)即可实现n个代理间的无嫉妒分配。这些估值类分别涵盖单调商品和单调杂务，但不需要单调性假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有关于津贴实现无嫉妒分配的研究大多局限于可加估值，而现实场景中代理的估值往往更加复杂（如互补性或替代性）。本文旨在突破可加估值的限制，探索更广泛的估值类别下津贴的充分性上界。

Method: 论文考虑两类估值：所有代理对所有捆绑赋予非负值（涵盖单调商品）以及所有赋予非正值（涵盖单调杂务），但不要求单调性。在假设单项边际值位于[-1,1]的条件下，推导出实现无嫉妒分配所需的总津贴上界为O(n^{3/2}√log n)。

Result: 证明了在两类非可加估值下，总津贴O(n^{3/2}√log n)足以实现无嫉妒分配。这是首个对一般单调估值在所有代理数量下都成立的次二次（subquadratic）总津贴上界结果。

Conclusion: 该结果显著扩展了津贴无嫉妒研究的估值适用范围，首次为一般单调估值建立了次二次的总津贴界限，为后续在更一般估值设置下的机制设计与公平分配研究提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We study envy-freeness with subsidies for indivisible items beyond additive valuations. Assuming that every single-item marginal value lies in $[-1,1]$, we prove that a total subsidy of $O(n^{3/2}\sqrt{\log n})$ suffices to achieve envy-freeness among $n$ agents whenever all agents assign nonnegative values to every bundle or all assign nonpositive values to every bundle. These valuation classes include monotone goods and monotone chores, respectively, but do not require monotonicity. Our result establishes the first subquadratic total-subsidy bound for general monotone valuations that holds for every number of agents.

</details>


### [480] [Jointly Satisfying Pareto Optimality and Justified Representation is NP-Hard in Approval-Based Multiwinner Voting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08357)
*Chris Dong*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明了一个重要结果：在基于批准的多赢家投票中，同时满足正当代表性和帕累托最优性的委员会的计算是NP困难的。该证明最初由ChatGPT Astra发现，随后由作者验证并重写。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于批准的多赢家投票中，一个悬而未决的开放问题是：能否高效计算同时满足正当代表性（justified representation）和帕累托最优性（Pareto optimality）的委员会。这个问题在理论上具有重要意义，关系到两个核心公理是否可以同时实现并有效求解。

Method: 作者通过归约方法证明该问题的NP难度。值得注意的亮点是，最初的证明思路由ChatGPT Astra（AI模型）发现，作者随后对该证明进行了验证和重新撰写以确保其正确性与严谨性。

Result: 作者证明了在包含所有偏好画像的域上，输出同时满足正当代表性和帕累托最优性的委员会是NP难问题，从而对该开放问题给出了否定回答。

Conclusion: 该结果表明，在一般偏好域上，同时满足这两个重要公理的委员会无法被高效计算，这为多赢家投票领域提供了新的理论边界。此外，该研究也展示了AI在数学证明发现中的辅助作用。

Abstract: An open problem in approval-based multiwinner voting concerns whether we can efficiently compute committees that satisfy both justified representation and Pareto optimality. We answer this question negatively by proving that, on the domain of all profiles, outputting a committee satisfying both axioms is NP-hard. An initial proof was found by ChatGPT Astra. This was then verified and rewritten by the author.

</details>


### [481] [Strategyproof Mechanisms for Connecting Impassable Regions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08488)
*Hau Chan,Jianan Lin,Chenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究被障碍物分隔的线段上，构建连接两个区域间的路径的策略性（strategyproof）机制设计问题。n个代理在各自区域内拥有私有位置，可选择原始路线或新路径（成本为其长度的k倍）。作者刻画了最优路径，给出了最大成本和社会成本的确定性及随机化机制的紧或近似界，并改进了Chan和Wang（AAMAS 2023）实数线路径模型的相关界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在设施选址和路径规划中，当区域被障碍物分隔时，如何在代理报告私有位置（可能撒谎）的情况下，设计诚实诱导（strategyproof/group-strategyproof）的机制来构建接近最优的路径，是一个具有理论与实际意义的核心问题。

Method: 通过刻画两种目标（最大成本与社会成本）下的最优路径结构，构造确定性GSP机制实现上界（最大成本2/(1+k)，社会成本n/(1+k(n-1))），并给出匹配下界；随后提出power-proportional随机化机制（期望策略真实性）分析其近似比，并用统一手法推导随机化下界，最后将技术迁移到实数线路径模型以改善已有界。

Result: 确定性最大成本近似比紧为2/(1+k)；确定性社会成本上界为n/(1+k(n-1))且配合下界。power-proportional随机机制的社会成本近似比至多为5（k=0时紧为3）。随机下界：最大成本为(3+2k)/(2+3k)，社会成本（n≥7）为max{1, 285/(263+385k)}。对实数线模型：确定性最大成本下界2匹配上界；社会成本下界由3/2提升至2（SP）与max{2,n-1}（GSP）；随机比例机制由6改进至3，下界由1.02提升至285/263≈1.08365（n≥7）。

Conclusion: 本文为障碍物分隔区域的路径构建问题提供了系统性的机制设计分析，建立了确定性机制紧界与随机机制的近似保证，并将改进结果推广至已有实数线模型，填补并强化了该方向的理论空白。

Abstract: We study strategyproof mechanisms for building a pathway between two regions of a line segment separated by an obstacle. Each of the $n$ agents has a private location within its region and may use either its original route to a facility or the new pathway, whose traversal cost is a fraction $k\in[0,1)$ of its length. We seek strategyproof (SP) and group-strategyproof (GSP) mechanisms that approximately minimize maximum cost or social cost. After characterizing optimal pathways for both objectives, we establish a tight deterministic maximum-cost approximation ratio of $\frac{2}{1+k}$ and a deterministic social-cost upper bound of $\frac{n}{1+k(n-1)}$, together with complementary lower bounds. Both upper bounds are achieved by GSP mechanisms. We then study randomized mechanisms under strategyproofness in expectation. A power-proportional mechanism achieves a social-cost approximation ratio at most $5$, independent of $n$ and $k$, with a tight guarantee of $3$ for this mechanism when $k=0$. We prove randomized lower bounds of $\frac{3+2k}{2+3k}$ for maximum cost and $\max\big\{1,\frac{285}{263+385k}\big\}$ for social cost, the latter for $n\ge7$. Finally, we improve several bounds for the real-line pathway model of [Chan and Wang, AAMAS 2023]. Our deterministic maximum-cost lower bound of $2$ matches the upper bound obtainable from [Qin, Fang, and Liu, COCOA 2024]. We strengthen the deterministic social-cost lower bound from $\frac32$ to $2$ under SP and to $\max\{2,n-1\}$ under GSP. For randomized social cost, we sharpen the guarantee of Chan and Wang's proportional mechanism from $6$ to $3$ and raise their lower bound from $1.02$ to $\frac{285}{263}\approx1.08365$ for $n\ge7$.

</details>


### [482] [Towards Actionable Strategy Certificates in Stochastic Parity Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08529)
*Christel Baier,Diane Cauquil,Calvin Chau,Sascha Klüppelholz,Anne-Kathrin Schmuck*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在随机奇偶博弈（2.5人博弈）中合成大规模获胜策略的新方法。作者引入"可操作策略证书"（ASCerts），这是一种局部、宽松的策略表示方式，而非计算单一的完整获胜策略。通过扩展随机不变量的证书到博弈场景，并巧妙地将其与几乎必然获胜的策略模板结合，ASCerts不仅能证明合成策略以概率λ停留在安全区域，还能以简洁的局部表示编码大量（甚至无限多）获胜策略，支持高效合成、自适应和运行时策略提取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法通常计算单一的、完全指定的获胜策略，这在不确定性和对抗性环境中限制了策略的适应性和灵活性。需要一种既能保证定量目标（以概率λ停留在安全区域）又能表示大规模策略集合的方法，以增强策略的可信度并支持运行时自适应控制。

Method: 1) 将随机不变量的已知证书扩展到随机博弈场景；2) 将用于随机不变量的证书与几乎必然获胜的策略模板相结合，形成定量获胜策略的局部表示；3) 证书被重新诠释为简洁、局部、宽松的多策略表示形式（可表示无限多策略）。

Result: 提供了概念验证实现，并通过案例研究展示了ASCerts在运行时自适应中的潜力。

Conclusion: ASCerts为随机奇偶博弈中的定量获胜策略提供了一种局部且宽松的表示方法，能够证明策略以至少λ概率留在安全区域，从而提升可信度，并支持高效合成、自适应和运行时策略提取，适用于不确定和对抗性环境中的逻辑控制。

Abstract: We propose a new approach for synthesizing large sets of winning strategies in stochastic parity games (2.5-player games) with quantitative objectives. Instead of computing a single, fully specified winning strategy, we introduce Actionable Strategy Certificates (ASCerts) as a local and permissive representation of a large class of system player winning strategies. To this end, we extend known certificates for stochastic invariants to the setting of games. Our certificates prove that synthesized strategies remain within a safe region of the game with probability at least $λ\in [0,1]$. As such, the certificates enhance the trustworthiness of synthesized strategies. The crux of our approach is to reinterpret and leverage the certificates as concise, local, and permissive representation of (possibly infinitely many) strategies. By carefully combining our certificates for stochastic invariants with strategy templates for almost-sure winning, we obtain a novel local representation of quantitatively winning strategies in stochastic parity games. This enables efficient synthesis, adaptation, and runtime strategy extraction, making ASCerts well suited for logical control in uncertain and adversarial environments. We provide a proof-of-concept implementation and demonstrate the potential of applying ASCerts in runtime adaptation on a case study.

</details>


### [483] [Comparison-Based Fair Division of Indivisible Chores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08687)
*Zehan Lin,Shengxin Liu,Biaoshuai Tao,Shengwei Zhou*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究在仅比较查询（comparison queries）访问下对不可分割杂务（chores）进行公平分配的查询复杂度问题。作者提出了基于比较的算法，可在O(n³log m)次查询内计算PROP1分配；在固定顺序和连续分配约束下用O(n³log²m)次查询实现连续PROP1。主要结果为：对任意固定代理数n和常数ε>0，可通过对数级别（log m）的比较复杂度计算(13/11+ε)-MMS分配，匹配了Huang和Segal-Halevi在基数访问下的最优13/11保证；并证明了比较访问的MMS失真至多为13/11。此外，对三个代理，可用O(log m)次比较查询计算EF1分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统公平分配研究假设算法可观测精确的基数成本（cardinal costs），但现实中往往只能获得偏好比较信息。本文旨在探究在仅比较访问（而非完整基数信息）下能实现何种程度的公平分配保证，特别是能否匹配基数访问下的最优结果。
