Method: 设计了多类基于比较查询的算法：针对PROP1提出O(n³log m)查询的通用算法及连续情况下的O(n³log²m)查询算法；针对MMS，利用比较访问设计了对数查询复杂度的(13/11+ε)-MMS分配算法；对三代理EF1设计了O(log m)查询的算法。通过精巧的查询策略，在无需数值信息的情况下复现了基数访问下的最优比率。

Result: 主要结论包括：(1) 比较查询可实现PROP1和连续PROP1分配，查询复杂度分别为O(n³log m)和O(n³log²m)；(2) 对固定n和常数ε，比较访问可实现(13/11+ε)-MMS，复杂度为O(log m)级别的查询，匹配了基数访问下13/11的最优MMS保证；(3) 证明了比较访问的MMS失真上界为13/11；(4) 三代理EF1可用O(log m)次比较查询计算。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了比较访问在公平分配任务中的强大能力：尽管仅观察偏好比较而非数值成本，算法仍能以对数查询复杂度匹配基数访问下最优的13/11-MMS保证。这表明在公平分配杂务的场景中，数值信息可能并非必要，为实际应用中降低信息获取成本提供了理论依据。

Abstract: We investigate the query complexity of fairly allocating $m$ indivisible chores among $n$ agents with additive cost functions. We depart from the standard cardinal model and assume only comparison access: an algorithm may ask an agent which of two bundles is less costly, but never observes numerical costs. Our first results concern proportionality up to one item (PROP1). We design comparison-based algorithms that compute PROP1 allocations using $O(n^3\log m)$ comparison queries. When the chores are arranged in a fixed order and allocations are required to be contiguous, we compute a contiguous PROP1 allocation using $O(n^3 \log^2 m)$ comparison queries. Our main result concerns the maximin share (MMS) guarantee. We show that for any fixed number of agents $n$ and constant $\varepsilon>0$, a $\left(13/11 +\varepsilon\right)$-MMS allocation can be computed with a comparison complexity logarithmic in $m$. Remarkably, comparison access suffices to match the state-of-the-art $13/11$ cardinal-access guarantee of Huang and Segal-Halevi up to an arbitrarily small loss. Furthermore, our result implies that the MMS distortion of comparison access (i.e., the worst-case multiplicative loss in MMS fairness incurred by observing only comparisons rather than numerical costs) is at most $13/11$. Finally, we show that, for three agents, an allocation satisfying envy-freeness up to one item (EF1) can be computed using $O(\log m)$ comparison queries.

</details>


### [484] [Last-Iterate Convergence of Policy Dynamics in Zero-Sum Networked Separable Markov Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08823)
*Zailin Ma*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出熵正则化乐观乘性权重更新（ER-OMWU）算法，用于有限时域零和网络化可分马尔可夫博弈，该算法是单循环、对称更新玩家策略的策略动力学方法，能在最后迭代返回ε-近似纳什均衡，收敛率为Õ(1/ε)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一般多玩家马尔可夫博弈求解纳什均衡在计算上不可行，而双人零和马尔可夫博弈有快速策略优化方法。有限时域零和网络化可分马尔可夫博弈处于中间地带：既通过成对交互保留全局竞争结构，又保持纳什均衡的计算可解性。但现有方法要么依赖均衡折叠论证（仅适用于简化设定），要么依赖逐阶段均衡求解器的后向动态规划，缺乏直接策略更新方法的分析与设计。

Method: 提出熵正则化乐观乘性权重更新（ER-OMWU）算法。该方法是一种互补的单循环策略动力学，对称地更新所有玩家的策略，并承诺在最后一次迭代返回近似纳什均衡。该算法结合了熵正则化与乐观乘性权重更新机制。

Result: 提供了该类博弈中策略动力学的首次最后迭代收敛分析：经过Õ(1/ε)次迭代后，返回的策略是ε-近似纳什均衡。该结果保持了双人零和马尔可夫博弈中策略优化所达到的近线性收敛速率，同时将策略动力学视角扩展到更复杂但有结构的多玩家设定中。

Conclusion: 本文填补了网络化可分马尔可夫博弈中直接策略更新方法的空白，证明了ER-OMWU能以近线性速率收敛到近似纳什均衡，将双人零和马尔可夫博弈的成功策略动力学方法推广到结构化多玩家博弈场景。

Abstract: Solving Nash equilibria for general multi-player Markov games is computationally intractable, while two-player zero-sum Markov games admit fast last-iterate policy-optimization methods. Finite-horizon zero-sum networked separable Markov games occupy an important middle ground: they retain global competition structure through pairwise interactions, while preserving computational tractability of Nash equilibria (NE) in the full-information and known-transition setting. Existing algorithms for this class either proceed through equilibrium-collapse arguments for a simplified setting where a single controller determines the transition probability, or backward dynamic programming that relies on equilibrium solvers at each stage. However, the design and analysis of direct policy-update approaches remain inadequate. To address this issue, we propose the entropy-regularized optimistic multiplicative weights update (ER-OMWU), a complementary single-loop policy dynamic that updates players' policies symmetrically and returns an approximate NE in the last iteration. We provide a first last-iterate convergence analysis of policy dynamics in the games of interest: after $\widetilde{O}(1/ε)$ iterations, the returned policy is an $ε$-approximate Nash equilibrium. The result preserves the near-linear convergence rate achieved by policy optimization in two-player zero-sum Markov games, but extends the policy-dynamics viewpoint to a more complicated but structured multi-player setting.

</details>


### [485] [Approval-Based Multiwinner Voting with Candidate Qualities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08830)
*Niclas Boehmer,Chris Dong,Luca Kreisel,Markus Utke*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的基于批准的多人投票模型，其中每个候选人都带有外生的质量分数。作者重新思考了在存在质量分数时比例代表制应如何定义，引入了基于阈值和基于价值的公理族，分析其关系、可满足性和计算复杂性，并提出能同时满足最强可联合比例公理的投票规则。他们还发现标准比例概念会导致质量几乎完全损失，但提出一类新的互惠公理（按共同批准候选人的质量缩放群体权利），在此公理下总能找到保留至少3/4最优总质量的委员会，且计算无额外成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准基于批准的多人投票假设候选人的全部特征由其支持者集合决定，但现实中候选人往往带有外生质量（如可靠性、相关性）。作者希望打破这一假设，探究在引入质量分数后，比例代表制的含义、可满足性，以及比例性与最大化质量目标之间的兼容性。

Method: 引入两类公理：基于阈值的公理族和基于价值的公理族，系统分析其关系与可满足性；提出新的"互惠公理"类（reciprocal axioms），将群体的应得权利按其共同批准候选人的质量进行缩放；设计满足最强联合可满足比例公理的投票规则，并利用这些规则证明存在保留至少3/4最优总和质量的比例委员会。

Result: 标准比例性概念（如完全比例）可能导致几乎完全的质量损失；而在新的互惠公理类下，总能存在保留至少3/4最优总和质量的委员会；满足这些公理的委员会可由所提出的投票规则在无额外计算成本的情况下计算得出。

Conclusion: 该研究建立了含质量分数的批准型多人投票的正式理论基础，证明"质量感知的互惠比例性"能够在比例代表性与质量最大化之间取得良好平衡，避免了标准比例概念与质量优化之间的根本冲突。

Abstract: We initiate the study of a new model of approval-based multiwinner voting in which each candidate carries an exogenous quality score, capturing, for instance, the reliability of the candidate or their relevance to the context of the selection. Quality scores break with the standard assumption of approval-based multiwinner voting that candidates are fully defined by the set of their supporters. We rethink what proportional representation means in the presence of quality scores. For this, we introduce a threshold-based and a value-based family of axioms, analyze their relationships, satisfiability, and computational complexity, and present rules that achieve the strongest jointly satisfiable combinations of our proportionality axioms. We then analyze the compatibility of proportionality with the natural goal of maximizing the summed quality of the selected candidates. While imposing standard proportionality notions can lead to an almost complete loss of quality, we show that under a new class of reciprocal axioms, which scale a group's entitlement by the quality of its commonly approved candidate(s), there always exist proportional committees retaining at least 3/4 of the optimal summed quality, and such committees can be computed by our voting rules at no additional computational cost.

</details>


### [486] [The Complexity of Membership, Uniqueness, and Counting for Optimal Proportional Approval Voting Committees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08884)
*Yizhou Ai*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究比例批准投票（PAV）中最大化委员会的复杂性，证明当委员会规模作为输入的一部分时，成员资格、必然性和唯一性三个决策问题均为Δ2^P-完全；计数的委员会问题是#·OptP-完全的（在度量归约下），并与#SAT图灵等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PAV通过最大化调和效用来选择委员会，但此前对最大化解集的结构（成员资格、唯一性、数量）缺乏系统性的复杂性分析，需要厘清这些基础决策与计数问题在最坏情况下的计算难度。

Method: 通过构造从SAT类问题到PAV实例的归约，将满足赋值直接编码为委员会；利用调和边际奖励在多项式数量选民下实现二元目标。每个满足赋值对应唯一委员会表示，固定子句选票使这些表示具有相同子句得分，从而实现计算复杂性分类。

Result: 委员会规模作为输入时，三个决策问题（成员资格、必然性、唯一性）均为Δ2^P-完全；即使在最多两个最优委员会时唯一性仍困难。计数最优委员会在度量归约下为#·OptP-完全，与#SAT图灵等价；若计数问题属于#P将蕴含NP=coNP。

Conclusion: PAV的最优解集在结构上非常复杂：即便限制最优解很少，判定唯一性仍然困难；计数问题的高复杂性表明，即使在#P之外也难以近似求解，揭示了该投票规则在实际应用中的计算瓶颈。

Abstract: Proportional Approval Voting (PAV) chooses committees that maximize a sum of harmonic utilities. We study the set of maximizing committees: whether a candidate belongs to some or all of them, whether the optimum is unique, and how many optima exist. When the committee size is part of the input, the three decision problems are $Δ_2^\mathrm{P}$-complete. Uniqueness remains hard for instances with at most two optimal committees. Counting optimal committees is $\#\!\cdot\!\mathrm{OptP}$-complete under metric reductions: every function $f$ in this class reduces to an election with exactly $f(x)+1$ optimal committees. The reductions encode satisfying assignments directly as committees and use harmonic marginal rewards to realize binary objectives with polynomially many voters. Each satisfying assignment has a unique committee representation, and fixed clause ballots give these representations the same clause score. We also prove Turing equivalence with $\#\mathrm{SAT}$ and show that membership of the counting problem in $\#\mathrm{P}$ would imply $\\mathrm{NP}=\mathrm{coNP}$.

</details>


### [487] [Strengthening Proportionality in Participatory Budgeting with Additive Utilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08888)
*Tzeh Yuan Neoh,Nicholas Teh*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究参与式预算中的比例代表性问题，证明对任意非负可加效用和项目成本，可在多项式时间内实现"至多一个项目"的完全正当代表（FJR up to one project），并将Residual-Budget Greedy算法扩展到满足更强分数性公理，该公理可多项式时间验证。对于审批效用，该公理与FJR+一致，提供精确FJR。选定集合的任何可行补全都保留代表保障，文中给出保证可定价性（priceability）的补全方案，并对单位成本项目增强到Droop配额。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参与式预算中比例代表是核心目标，完全正当代表（FJR）能处理群体成员偏好不同项目的情况，但计算FJR结果在可加效用下是强NP难问题，需要寻找多项式时间可计算且保留强代表保障的近似方案。

Method: 扩展Residual-Budget Greedy算法，提出满足更强分数性公理的方法；该分数性公理可多项式时间验证，并与FJR+建立联系（审批效用下等价）；同时构造保证可定价性的预算补全方案，并针对单位成本情形强化至Droop配额。

Result: 对任意非负可加效用和项目成本，可在多项式时间实现FJR up to one project；审批效用下获得精确FJR；选定集合的所有可行补全均保留代表保障；构造了保持可定价性的补全；单位成本项目情形可同时保证Droop配额与可定价性。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在多项式时间内为一般可加效用和任意成本提供了近乎FJR的代表保障，并通过分数性公理提供了可验证的中间概念，兼顾了代表性与预算分配的灵活性，为参与式预算算法打开了新的理论空间。

Abstract: Proportional representation is a central goal in participatory budgeting, where voters select public projects subject to a shared budget. Full justified representation (FJR) accounts for groups whose members may value different projects, but computing an FJR outcome is strongly NP-hard for additive utilities. We show that FJR up to one project can be achieved in polynomial time for arbitrary nonnegative additive utilities and project costs. Our approach extends Residual-Budget Greedy and satisfies a stronger fractional axiom that can also be verified in polynomial time. For approval utilities, this axiom coincides with FJR+, providing exact FJR in that setting. We further show that every feasible completion of the algorithm's selected set preserves the representation guarantee, providing flexibility in allocating the remaining budget. In particular, we give a completion that ensures priceability at the original budget. For unit-cost projects, we strengthen the representation guarantee to the Droop quota and combine it with priceability whenever there are enough positively valued projects to fill the budget.

</details>


### [488] [PMMS Allocations Need Not Exist for 3 Agents with Additive Valuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08954)
*Paul Gölz*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文构造了一个仅需3个代理和9件商品的公平分配反例，证明了在不可分割商品且可加估值的情况下，成对最大分享（PMMS）性质无法被任何分配满足，并通过穷举验证表明PMMS无法在78/79以上比率内被近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PMMS是一种比最大分享（MMS）更强的公平性概念，此前对PMMS是否总能被满足的问题尚无定论。通过构造具体反例来证明PMMS在一般公平分配问题中不可行，是解决这一悬而未决问题的关键。

Method: 构造一个包含n=3个代理和m=9件商品的特定公平分配实例，并通过严格的数学证明表明该实例中不存在任何PMMS分配；同时构造另一个实例，借助计算机穷举枚举验证PMMS的近似比率上界为78/79。

Result: 找到了一个3代理9商品的具体反例，证明PMMS分配在该实例中不存在；并找到一个独立实例，经穷举验证表明PMMS无法在78/79（约0.987）的比率内被近似满足。

Conclusion: PMMS性质在一般的不可分割商品公平分配问题中并不能总被满足，这为相关研究划定了边界，也提示未来研究需转向PMMS的近似算法或寻求其他可满足的公平性标准。

Abstract: This note gives an instance demonstrating that the pairwise maximin share (PMMS) property cannot be satisfied by any allocation in certain fair division problems with indivisible goods and additive valuations. The instance requires only $n=3$ agents and $m=9$ goods, and is accompanied by a proof that no PMMS allocation exists. A separate instance shows (certified by exhaustive enumeration with a computer) that PMMS cannot be approximated within a ratio above $78/79 \approx 0.987$.

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [489] [MVWeaver: A Hierarchical Music Video Generation Agent with a Learned Song-to-Visual Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06478)
*Sifei Li,Minyan Luo,Xu Li,Guodong Qi,Xincan Wang,Hanwen Wang,Chen Zhang,Pengfei Wan,Oliver Deussen,Weiming Dong*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: MVWeaver是一个音乐视频生成智能体，通过分层规划与学习的歌曲到视觉桥接（song-to-visual bridge）实现长时连贯且以歌曲为根基的音乐视频自动生成。论文构建了由歌曲分析模块、视觉规划器和图像/视频生成模型组成的架构，并使用1,861个真实歌曲-MV配对及教师推断的标注数据进行LoRA微调，取得了更优的歌曲-视觉翻译和镜头间连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动音乐视频生成系统能生成视觉上合理的镜头，但在长视频连贯性和以歌曲为根基的视觉发展方面表现不佳。需要一种能将歌曲理解转化为可执行镜头规划的方法来解决这一问题。

Method: MVWeaver架构包含三部分：综合歌曲分析模块、构建分层规划的视觉规划器、以及渲染规划内容的下游图像和视频生成模型。为赋予通用LLM歌曲到视觉的特定知识，作者从真实MV中获取监督信号，涵盖了1,861个真实的歌曲-MV配对，包含歌曲侧、MV侧和教师推断的歌曲到视觉理由标注。使用这些标注对大型语言模型进行基于LoRA的监督微调，使其能够预测引导分层视觉规划的歌曲到视觉桥接。

Result: 实验表明MVWeaver在歌曲为基础的视觉翻译上更强、视觉发展更丰富、概念与镜头间连贯性更好；消融实验支持了学习到的桥接条件的作用。

Conclusion: 通过学习歌曲到视觉的桥接并用真实MV数据进行监督微调，MVWeaver显著提升了音乐视频生成的长时连贯性和歌曲根基性的视觉发展，验证了桥接学习的有效性。

Abstract: Music videos are an important form of audiovisual expression in contemporary culture. They translate and extend the expressive content of songs through deliberate visual design. Existing automatic music video (MV) generation systems can generate visually plausible shots, yet often struggle with long-form coherence and song-grounded visual development. We present MVWeaver, a music video generation agent that integrates hierarchical planning with a learned song-to-visual bridge that translates song understanding into executable shot plans. The MVWeaver architecture comprises a comprehensive song analysis module, a visual planner that constructs hierarchical plans, and downstream image and video generation models that render the planned content. To equip a general-purpose LLM with MV-specific song-to-visual knowledge, we learn a bridge between song analysis and visual planning from real-MV-derived supervision and curate 1,861 real-world song--MV pairs with structured song-side, MV-side, and teacher-inferred song-to-visual rationale annotations. Using these annotations, we perform LoRA-based supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of a large language model to predict song-to-visual bridges that guide hierarchical visual planning. Our experiments demonstrate stronger song-grounded visual translation, richer visual development, and greater conceptual and shot-to-shot coherence, while ablations support the benefits of learned bridge conditioning.

</details>


### [490] [Vision-Guided Text Prompt Tuning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06497)
*Xiaoran Kou,Jingyi Wu,Peng Sun,Yang Liu,Hong Chen*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出VG-TPT方法，通过视觉引导的文本提示调优实现多模态情感分析。该方法在冻结的BERT编码器上逐层注入视觉情感线索的适应性提示，利用共引导路由器从提示库中组合提示，实现样本特异和层特异的调制。在CMU-MOSEI和CMU-MOSI数据集上超越文本基线并媲美全模态方法，仅更新240万可训练参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态情感分析需有效建模语言语义与非语言情感线索，核心挑战是如何以受控、自适应且参数高效的方式将视觉面部证据校准到以文本为中心的情感理解中。无差别融合会引入视觉噪声并扭曲文本语义，且完全微调大型视觉和文本编码器成本高昂并易在小规模MSA数据集上过拟合。

Method: 提出Vision-Guided Text Prompt Tuning (VG-TPT)，将视觉-文本情感建模表述为对冻结文本表示的可控视觉校准。通过层间自适应提示将视觉情感线索注入冻结的BERT编码器，而非依赖后期特征融合或全骨干微调。共引导路由器根据演化的文本状态和视觉引导特征从可训练提示库中组合提示，实现样本特异和层特异调制。

Result: 在CMU-MOSEI和CMU-MOSI上的实验表明，VG-TPT相较纯文本基线一致提升，性能与多种全模态方法相当或更优，同时仅更新240万可训练参数。

Conclusion: 证明通过提示调优实现视觉校准冻结文本编码器是可行且高效的方案，为多模态情感分析提供参数高效的新范式。

Abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis requires effective modeling of both verbal semantics and non-verbal affective cues. A central challenge is to calibrate text-centered sentiment understanding with visual facial evidence in a controlled, adaptive, and parameter-efficient manner. Text usually serves as the semantic anchor, whereas visual cues provide complementary evidence for ambiguous or implicit expressions; however, indiscriminate fusion may introduce visual noise and distort textual semantics. Moreover, fully fine-tuning large visual and textual encoders is costly and prone to overfitting on limited and scenario-dependent MSA benchmarks. To address these issues, we propose Vision-Guided Text Prompt Tuning (VG-TPT), which formulates visual-text sentiment modeling as controllable visual calibration of frozen text representations. VG-TPT injects visual affective cues into a frozen BERT encoder through layer-wise adaptive prompts, rather than relying on late-stage feature fusion or full backbone tuning. A co-guided router composes prompts from a trainable prompt bank according to both the evolving text state and the visual guidance feature, enabling sample-specific and layer-specific modulation. Experiments on CMU-MOSEI and CMU-MOSI show that VG-TPT consistently improves over text-only baselines and achieves competitive or superior performance compared with several full-modality methods, while updating only 2.4M trainable parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/ma-tubu/VG-TPT.

</details>


### [491] [AdoDAS: A Privacy-Preserving Multimodal Challenge for Adolescent Depression, Anxiety, and Stress Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07038)
*Zhaojie Luo,Junkun Wang,Tianhua Qi,Yuxuan Wu,Xin Zhao,Tetsuya Takiguchi,Tomoko Matsui,Kun Qian,Fei Wang,Shuqiong Wu,Zhengjun Yue,Hiroshi Ishiguro,Xinyuan Qian,Haizhou Li*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文介绍了AdoDAS大挑战赛，该赛事在隐私保护政策下，利用24,000段青少年语音-视觉-文本分段数据进行多任务抑郁/焦虑/压力筛查与DASS-21条目序数预测。最终95支筛查队伍和64支条目预测队伍入围排行榜，领先方案F1达0.5921，QWK达0.2776，显著优于视听基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 青少年抑郁、焦虑和压力问题亟需可扩展的筛查工具，但需在不替代专业评估的前提下进行。此外，保护未成年人原始录音的隐私是关键约束，需要在不上传达原始数据的情况下构建有效的多模态评估系统。

Method: AdoDAS挑战赛在隐私保护框架下，向参赛者提供脱敏的视听表征及ASR文本，涵盖6,000名参与者的24,000个分段（含脚本朗读与三个开放式应答会话）。设置两个赛道：多任务二分类D/A/S筛查与21项DASS-21条目的序数预测。获奖系统采用跨会话建模、时序多模态融合、心理测量结构建模与任务感知校准等技术。

Result: 视听基线在平均F1上为0.4604，在平均QWK上为0.2675；最佳提交分别达到0.5921和0.2776。191个注册团队中，最终95支筛查团队和64支条目预测团队入围排行榜。

Conclusion: AdoDAS挑战赛验证了在隐私保护约束下利用多模态表征进行青少年心理健康自动评估的可行性，领先系统的表现表明该领域仍有改进空间，并为未来研究提供了基准与方向。

Abstract: Adolescent depression, anxiety, and stress (D/A/S) call for scalable tools that complement, rather than replace, professional evaluation. Under a privacy-preserving policy, the AdoDAS Grand Challenge withholds minors' raw recordings and distributes anonymized audio-visual representations and ASR-derived text. Its 6,000 participants provide 24,000 segments across one scripted-reading and three open-response sessions. Two tracks assess multi-task binary D/A/S screening and ordinal prediction of 21 DASS-21 item responses. From 191 registrations, the final leaderboards included 95 eligible screening teams and 64 item-prediction teams. Audio-visual baselines achieved 0.4604 mean F1 and 0.2675 mean Quadratic Weighted Kappa; leading submissions reached 0.5921 and 0.2776. Representative systems emphasize cross-session modelling, temporal multimodal fusion, psychometric structure, and task-aware calibration.

</details>


### [492] [Can Agents Win the Video Browser Showdown?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07311)
*Bastian Jäckl,Zuzana Vopálková,Daniel A. Keim,Jakub Lokoč*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文研究了现代视觉语言模型（VLM）和智能体方法在交互式视频检索中完全自主达成搜索目标的能力，通过VLM智能体控制现有视频搜索系统，从初始意图描述出发自主完成搜索任务，结果在多种场景下达到了与历史专家操作系统竞争的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视频搜索是交互式过程，需要用户扮演两个角色：持有搜索意图和通过迭代搜索循环将意图操作化。作者希望探究能否从初始的搜索目标描述出发，用智能体系统全自动地解决传统上需要交互式参与的搜索任务，以减轻用户负担并提高搜索效率。

Method: 作者结合了现有的交互式视频搜索系统和VLM智能体：搜索系统提供索引和高效查询能力，而基于VLM的智能体负责分析排名靠前的检索结果并决定下一步行动。关键挑战在于VLM不了解整个大规模视频数据集，需要在现有搜索系统与智能VLM控制者之间实现有效结合。

Result: 现代智能体能够自主操作交互式视频检索系统，从初始意图描述出发解决许多搜索任务，在多种设置下达到了与强历史专家操作系统相竞争的性能。

Conclusion: 研究表明，基于VLM的智能体方法在自主交互式视频检索方面展现出显著潜力，初始的搜索目标描述可能足以驱动智能体系统完成传统上需要人工交互迭代的搜索任务。

Abstract: Searching large video collections is typically an interactive process in which users play two roles. First, they hold the search intent: the underlying goal that determines what content they seek and why. Second, users must operationalize this intent through an iterative search loop. Users translate their intent into queries, browse the retrieved candidates, and refine their queries based on the results. In this paper, we investigate the capabilities of modern Vision Language Models (VLM) and agentic approaches to reach search goals interactively and fully autonomously. Specifically, we study whether a provided initial specification of a search goal might be sufficient to solve traditionally interactive search tasks with an agentic system. Provided that the involved VLMs are not aware of the whole large video dataset in advance, the key challenge lies in the effective combination of an existing interactive video search system and a smart VLM agent controlling the system. While the search system provides indexing and efficient querying, the VLM-based agents analyze top-ranked items and make decisions about next actions. Our results show that modern agents can autonomously operate interactive video retrieval systems to solve many search tasks from an initial intent description, achieving performance competitive with strong historical expert-operated systems in several settings.

</details>


### [493] [Concept-Level Risk and Calibration for Governance in Diffusion Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08517)
*Kun Xu,Yushu Zhang,Tao Wang,Shuren Qi,Barbara Carminati,Elena Ferrari,Yuming Fang*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出CLRC（概念级概率审计与报告框架），将扩散模型的治理相关概念行为形式化为伯努利语义事件，通过概念风险算子将模型-通道配置映射为结构化风险档案，实现对提示接口、嵌入通道、模型和记录条件的统一比较与审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型的安全治理在高风险场景下缺乏统一评估手段。现有方法依赖启发式审计、对抗探测或任务特定的擦除基准，无法跨模型、条件通道和部署条件进行系统性比较，尤其对身份关联和隐私相关概念的安全评估存在明显不足。

Method: 将治理相关概念行为形式化为随机生成诱导的伯努利语义事件；定义概念风险算子将模型-通道配置映射为结构化风险档案；采用样本级事后校准与配置级风险聚合；并引入多协议校准器提升留出概率的可靠性。

Result: 在SD1.5、SD2.1和SDXL上的实验揭示不同概念族、通道、记录条件和移位协议下存在一致但不均匀的操作风险模式。嵌入通道访问和混淆提示暴露的风险常被标准提示评估低估；多协议池化校准器改善了留出概率可靠性，但标准校准器不具备迁移性。

Conclusion: CLRC为多媒体生成系统的概率化、决策感知治理提供了统一的审计模式，支持跨模型、跨通道和跨部署条件的系统化风险评估与比较。

Abstract: Diffusion models have become a core paradigm for multimedia generation, offering powerful concept-driven controllability for personalization, semantic editing, and selective unlearning. However, as semantic control extends beyond natural-language prompts to learned embeddings and intervention pipelines, the safety and governance of these systems become increasingly difficult to evaluate in a unified manner, especially for safety-sensitive, identity-linked, and other privacy-relevant concepts. Existing studies mainly rely on heuristic audits, adversarial probing, or task-specific erasure benchmarks, and therefore provide limited support for systematic comparison across models, conditioning channels, and deployment conditions. We present a concept-level probabilistic audit and reporting framework for diffusion models. We formalize governance-relevant concept behaviors as Bernoulli semantic events induced by stochastic generation, and define a Concept Risk Operator that maps model-channel configurations to structured risk profiles, enabling comparison across prompting interfaces, learned embedding channels, models, and recorded conditions. We apply sample-level post-hoc calibration and configuration-level risk aggregation, and show that probability error can change thresholded actions near policy boundaries. Experiments on SD1.5, SD2.1, and SDXL reveal consistent yet non-uniform operational risk patterns across concept families, channels, recorded conditions, and shifted protocols. In particular, embedding-based access and obfuscated prompts expose risks often understated by standard-prompt evaluation. A pooled multi-protocol calibrator improves held-out probability reliability, but we do not claim transfer from a standard-only calibrator. CLRC provides a common audit schema for probabilistic and decision-aware governance of multimedia generation systems.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [494] [Beyond Right and Wrong: Evaluating Second-order Social Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05437)
*Sunny Rai,Jinyi Kuang,Reyhan Jamalova,Annie Lou,Cristina Bicchieri,Niyati Malhotra,Victor Hugo Orozco-Olvera,Ana Maria Munoz-Boudet,Lyle H Ungar,Sharath C Guntuku*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种评估大语言模型元规范（metanorm）推理能力的新框架，涵盖情感评估与行为反应两个维度，并引入两个新分类任务（预测违规者的自我调节与观察者的他者调节）。作者发布了包含450个规范违规场景的多视角数据集NormReact，标注了违规者性别与观察者社会亲近度下的情绪与行为反应。研究发现六种当前LLM普遍高估负面制裁，在人类预期不作为的场景中过度预测惩罚，且随社会距离增加与人类判断的一致性恶化，暗示AI在规范敏感领域可能扭曲社会监管的真实图景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的AI对齐工作主要聚焦于一阶社会规范（教导模型什么可接受/不可接受），但社会智能不仅依赖规范识别，还需要预判谁会执行规范以及如何执行（如公开羞辱或监禁）。这种二阶预期（元规范）决定人们面对违规时的反应，但目前缺乏对LLM元规范推理的系统评估框架。

Method: 提出一个沿情感评估和行为反应两个维度评估LLM元规范推理的框架，设计了两个分类任务：预测违规者的自我调节与观察者的他者调节，并构建了450个规范违规场景的多视角数据集NormReact，按违规者性别与观察者社会亲近度手工标注情绪与行为反应。

Result: 在六个LLM上进行实验发现：模型普遍描绘出一个更严苛的社会世界，在人类预期不作为的场景中过度预测负面制裁；且随社会距离增大，模型与人类判断的一致性持续恶化。

Conclusion: AI系统在规范敏感领域（从冲突调解到政策模拟）可能产生扭曲的社会监管图景——过度表征惩罚，而低估现实世界规范执行中的宽容、克制与关系校准特征。

Abstract: Previous AI alignment efforts have focused primarily on first-order social norms -- teaching models what is socially acceptable or unacceptable (e.g., `do not steal'). However, social intelligence depends not only on norm recognition, but also on anticipating who will enforce it and how (e.g., public shame or even imprisonment). These second-order expectations, known as metanorms, govern how people respond when social rules are broken. We introduce a novel framework for evaluating metanorm reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) along two dimensions: emotional appraisal and behavioral response, and propose new classification tasks, namely, predicting self-regulation in violators, and other-regulation in observers. We release a multi-perspective dataset, NormReact, of 450 norm violation scenarios, hand-annotated for emotions and behavioral responses across norm violators' gender and observers' social closeness. Current LLMs portray a harsher social world: across six models, they overpredict negative sanctions where humans would expect inaction, and alignment with human judgments deteriorates as social distance increases. These findings suggest that AI systems in norm-sensitive domains from conflict mediation to policy simulation, may risk producing a distorted picture of social regulation: one that over-represents punishment and under-represents the tolerance, restraint, and relational calibration that characterize actual norm enforcement in real world.

</details>


### [495] [CriticGen: Generation-Aware Evaluation as Actionable Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05439)
*Huifang Du,Zecheng Zuo,Sen Wang,Chenghao Fan,Haofen Wang,Yehui Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CriticGen是一个细粒度、生成感知的大语言模型评估框架，通过生成样本特定的评估维度和评分标准（动态rubric），将评估转化为可执行的答案改进控制信号，实现评分、理由、改进建议和精炼答案的联合产出，显著提升评估质量与答案改进效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型评估方法粒度粗糙且与生成过程脱节，产生的解释缺乏通用性和可操作性，无法为模型改进提供有效的行动反馈。

Method: CriticGen首先在高层次类别（主观、客观、自衍生约束）下生成样本特定的评估维度和评分标准，这些标准作为动态rubric，共同指导模型联合产出分数、理由、可执行的改进建议以及精炼后的答案，实现rubric条件化的精炼过程。

Result: 细粒度评估需兼具实例特异性和可操作性。CriticGen生成更高质量的rubric（相关性/覆盖率从3.33/4.03提升至3.97/4.24）；达到最佳分数相关性（Pearson 0.9556, Spearman 0.9560）；基于标准的理由和建议F1从0.6369/0.5994提升至0.7554/0.7900；反馈可改善73.17%的答案，非退化率达93.28%。

Conclusion: 评估应当针对具体实例且具备可操作性。CriticGen通过将评估转化为可控的答案改进行为，证明了"评估即控制"的理念，为模型反馈与迭代改进提供了更有效的路径。

Abstract: Current evaluation methods for large language models are coarse-grained and decoupled from generation, producing generic explanations that fail to provide actionable feedback for model improvement. We propose CriticGen, a fine-grained, generation-aware evaluation framework that turns evaluation into actionable control for answer improvement. CriticGen first generates sample-specific evaluation dimensions and scoring criteria under high-level categories such as subjective, objective, and self-derived constraints. These criteria then serve as a dynamic rubric for jointly producing a score, a reason, an executable refinement suggestion, and a refined answer. This rubric-conditioned refinement process enables models to diagnose flaws and perform targeted answer improvement. Experimental results show that fine-grained evaluation should be both instance-specific and actionable. CriticGen induces higher-quality rubrics, improving relevance/coverage from 3.33/4.03 to 3.97/4.24. CriticGen also achieves the best score correlations, with 0.9556 Pearson and 0.9560 Spearman, and raises the F1 of criterion-grounded reasons and executable suggestions from 0.6369/0.5994 to 0.7554/0.7900. Crucially, its feedback translates into reliable answer improvement, improving 73.17% of answers with a 93.28% non-degradation rate.

</details>


### [496] [When Does Memory Help? A Cost-Aware Evaluation of Long-Term Memory in Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05441)
*Shweta Mishra,Shashank Mishra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MERIT基准与测试框架，用于衡量工具使用型LLM智能体在显式计算成本下的记忆边际效用。通过在三个领域进行场景化工具任务测试（含泄露检查、难度阶梯、受控记忆损坏及全量代币/美元计量），发现记忆可将依赖型任务成功率从0.00提升至0.55-1.00；但嵌入检索在事实更新场景表现不稳定，而更新即写存储（结构化存储与LLM摘要）保持0.70-1.00。记忆实现方式的替换可使任务成功率变化高达60个百分点，且全量回放从不经济。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆基准（如LoCoMo、LongMemEval）仅评估对话历史的问答能力，而非检验记忆事实是否真正改变工具使用型智能体的行为决策。这种评估方式无法反映记忆在真实任务执行中的实际价值，因此需要一个新的评估范式，在显式成本计量下衡量记忆的边际效用。

Method: MERIT包含：(1)三个领域的场景化工具任务，其早期情节事实依赖性通过自动化泄露检查验证；(2)难度阶梯，最终包含更新事实回忆；(3)受控记忆损坏；(4)对每个记忆操作进行全量代币与美元计量。实验采用两代试点（gpt-4.1-mini）与预注册的3模型x3种子网格（GPT-4.1、Claude Haiku 4.5），并对照不同记忆实现（嵌入检索、结构化事实存储、LLM摘要、混合方案）。

Result: 在23,440个评分情节（花费$42.57）中，记忆将依赖型任务成功率从泄露验证的0.00基线提升至0.55-1.00。更新事实场景下，嵌入检索跨模型表现不稳定（0.30-0.95，最大种子差距0.45），且智能体仅在55%情况下依据正确检索值行动；更新即写存储保持0.70-1.00，混合方案反而劣于单独事实存储。最新一代抽查（Claude Sonnet 5）复现该模式。更换记忆实现使任务成功率变化高达60个百分点，最优条件下的边际效用为每美元2.7-3.9倍。

Conclusion: MERIT证明记忆的实际价值应通过其是否改变工具使用行为来衡量，而非问答能力。更新事实场景下嵌入检索的脆弱性及混合方案的反直觉劣化揭示了记忆实现选择的重要性；全量回放不具经济性，凸显边际效用计量的必要性。论文释放了完整基准、框架与追踪数据以推动后续研究。

Abstract: Long-term memory for LLM agents is evaluated today by conversational recall benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval), which measure question answering over dialogue history, not whether remembered facts change what a tool-using agent does. We present MERIT (Memory Evaluation for Realistic Instrumented Tasks), a benchmark and harness that measures the marginal utility of memory for task-executing agents under explicit cost accounting. MERIT provides episodic tool-use tasks in three domains whose dependence on earlier-episode facts is verified by an automated leak check; a difficulty ladder ending in updated-fact recall; controlled memory corruption; and full token and dollar metering of every memory operation. Across 23,440 scored episodes ($42.57), a two-generation pilot on gpt-4.1-mini and a preregistered 3-model x 3-seed grid (GPT-4.1, Claude Haiku 4.5; memory side held fixed), memory lifts dependent-task success from a leak-verified floor of 0.00 to 0.55-1.00. On updated facts, embedding retrieval collapses unpredictably (0.30-0.95 across models; max seed gap 0.45), and agents act on a correctly retrieved value only 55% of the time, while update-on-write stores (a structured fact store and, notably, LLM summarization) remain at 0.70-1.00; the hybrid is worse than the fact store alone. A latest-generation spot-check (Claude Sonnet 5, gated on a clean full-replay control) reproduces the pattern. Swapping a memory's implementation moves task success by up to 60 points, and full replay is never economical: the best condition per domain delivers 2.7-3.9x its marginal utility per dollar. We release the benchmark, harness, and all traces.

</details>


### [497] [AutoFyn Technical Report: Non-Parametric Expert Iteration for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05446)
*Adib Hasan,Daniel Schaffield,Akashnil Dutta,Tarik Adnan Moon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoFyn是一个受Expert Iteration算法启发的智能体框架，通过更新持久状态而非模型权重来适配冻结模型。每轮从全新会话开始，仅通过显式接口（持久记忆文件、报告、仓库状态）重引入持久信息，并在多个领域展现出卓越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法需要微调模型权重来适应任务，但冻结模型无法被更新。AutoFyn希望探索一种替代范式：保持模型权重不变，通过外部持久状态来跨轮次累积和改进知识，实现"专家迭代"的效果。

Method: 每轮从全新模型会话开始，编排器（orchestrator）探索、规划并构建多种替代方案，使用专用智能体；任务导向的验证器验证工作并提供客观奖励；该奖励被蒸馏回持久状态，从而更新下一轮的有效策略。核心是用持久记忆文件、报告和仓库状态作为显式接口来传递信息。

Result: 在2026年国际数学奥林匹克竞赛的6个新问题上，AutoFyn使所有有提升空间的模型比其服务提供商自带的编码智能体得分更高；在Spider 2.0 dbt基准上构建了排名第一的智能体；并在Next.js、MetaMask、pnpm、Warp、LiteLLM、Langflow和Open WebUI中产出了16个维护者确认的漏洞公告。

Conclusion: AutoFyn证明了通过更新外部持久状态而非模型权重，可以显著提升冻结模型在复杂任务上的表现，涵盖数学、数据科学和网络安全等多个领域，展示了该范式作为传统微调替代方案的巨大潜力。

Abstract: We introduce AutoFyn, an agent harness inspired by the Expert Iteration algorithm, adapting a frozen model across many rounds by updating persistent state from verified reward signals rather than model weights. Each round begins from a fresh model session, and durable information is reintroduced only through explicit interfaces such as persistent memory files, reports, and repository state. Within a round, an orchestrator explores, plans and builds many alternative approaches with specialized agents, while a task-grounded verifier verifies the work and supplies an objective reward for measuring progress. This reward is distilled back into the persistent state, which updates the effective policy for the next round. In this technical report, we formalize this loop and describe its persistent state and verification interfaces. We then demonstrate its use in three domains, namely olympiad mathematics, data science, and cybersecurity. On the six fresh problems of the 2026 International Mathematical Olympiad, every model with room to improve scores higher under AutoFyn than in its provider's own coding agent. AutoFyn also built the top-ranked agent on the Spider 2.0 dbt benchmark, and has produced $16$ maintainer-confirmed vulnerability advisories in Next.js, MetaMask, pnpm, Warp, LiteLLM, Langflow, and Open WebUI.

</details>


### [498] [Damage-Aware Bandit Pruning for Vision and Language Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05448)
*Salem Ameen,Sunil Vadera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将Transformer的结构化后训练剪枝单元选择问题建模为"损伤感知的多臂老虎机"问题，在固定候选评估预算下，通过成对损伤（掩蔽损失减去基线损失）减少批次间波动，采用UCB策略或分数Beta Thompson采样顺序选择注意力头和MLP通道组，并在多模型多数据集上验证该方法相比预算贪婪选择通常能降低退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化后训练剪枝需要选择完整的、抑制后仅造成有限性能退化的功能单元。如何在固定的候选评估预算下有效选择这些单元是一个核心挑战，作者希望提出一个更具损伤感知性的选择框架来减少退化。

Method: 将结构化单元选择建模为损伤感知的多臂老虎机问题。注意力头和MLP通道组在校准批次上被临时掩蔽；成对损伤定义为同批次上掩蔽损失减基线损失，以降低批次间方差。采用平滑有界奖励驱动的UCB策略或分数Beta Thompson采样，每一步顺序添加一个单元来构建最终掩码。被选单元在原始稠密checkpoint中被功能性置零。

Result: 在WikiText-2、LAMBADA和Imagenette上覆盖GPT-2、OPT、Pythia、Qwen2.5、SmolLM2、ViT-B/16、DeiT-Tiny和Swin-Tiny等模型，并与随机、幅度、静态显著性及预算贪婪选择对比。五个种子下，老虎机方法在成对语言模型比较中通常比预算贪婪减少退化。28个重点比较中23个bootstrap置信区间排除零，11个配对检验p<0.05，6个经Benjamini-Hochberg校正后q<0.05（共116个数据集级检验）。ViT-B/16和Swin-Tiny的匹配评估结果表明其增益不能仅由更大候选评估预算解释。

Conclusion: 老虎机式单元选择方法在固定评估预算下通常优于预算贪婪方法，其优势在部分视觉模型上也不能仅归因于评估预算差异，表明该方法在结构化剪枝单元选择上具有稳健的有效性。

Abstract: Structured post-training pruning of transformers requires selecting complete functional units whose suppression causes limited degradation. We formulate structured-unit selection for language and vision transformers as a damage-aware multi-armed bandit problem under a fixed candidate-evaluation budget. Attention heads and MLP channel groups are temporarily masked on calibration batches. Paired damage is the masked loss minus the base loss on the same batch, reducing batch-to-batch variation. A smooth bounded reward drives either a UCB-style policy or fractional-Beta Thompson Sampling, and the final mask is constructed sequentially by adding one unit at each step. The selected units are functionally zeroed in the original dense checkpoint; therefore, the reported parameter effects represent effective structural suppression rather than physical compression or measured speedup. Experiments on WikiText-2, LAMBADA, and Imagenette cover GPT-2, OPT, Pythia, Qwen2.5, SmolLM2, ViT-B/16, DeiT-Tiny, and Swin-Tiny, with comparisons against random, magnitude, static-saliency, and budgeted-greedy selection. Across five seeds, the bandit methods usually reduce degradation relative to budgeted greedy in the paired language-model comparisons. Of 28 comparisons highlighted in the paper, 23 bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero and 11 paired tests have p < 0.05; six have q < 0.05 after Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the full family of 116 dataset-wise tests. Matched-evaluation results for ViT-B/16 and Swin-Tiny indicate that their gains are not explained solely by a larger candidate-evaluation budget.

</details>


### [499] [RAFM-SER++: A Lightweight Multimodal Emotion Recognition Framework for Real-Time Behavioral Monitoring in Surveillance Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07409)
*Ngo Truong Dinh,Tung-Lam Bui,Chi-Trung Duong,Vien Nguyen Thi,Viet-Anh Nguyen,Phuc-Lu Le*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RAFM_SER++是一个轻量级多模态语音情感识别框架，采用非对称残差注意力融合机制（RAFM），通过单向残差注意力路径将情感语音线索注入语义文本表示中，避免昂贵的双向跨模态交互。在IEMOCAP和ESD基准上，该方法优于HuBERT-Base基线，与最先进的MemoCMT相比减少了60%以上的可训练参数，实现了更快的推理速度（79.60 it/s），并在IEMOCAP上达到81.10%、ESD上达到95.39%的BACC分数，适用于实时监控系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于交互密集型跨模态Transformer的多模态语音情感识别系统虽然准确率高，但计算成本过高，难以部署在延迟敏感和资源受限的监控系统中。作者希望解决高精度与低计算开销之间的矛盾。

Method: 提出RAFM_SER++框架，核心是名为RAFM的非对称残差注意力融合机制。该方法通过单向残差注意力路径将情感语音线索注入语义文本表示，替代昂贵的双向交互。同时结合BYOL启发的跨模态对齐目标和注意力引导池化，增强多模态表示学习同时保持低计算开销。

Result: 在IEMOCAP和ESD基准上，RAFM_SER++持续优于HuBERT-Base基线；相比MemoCMT减少了60%以上的可训练参数，推理速度达79.60 it/s（更快），BACC分数在IEMOCAP上为81.10%、在ESD上为95.39%。

Conclusion: 轻量级非对称多模态融合是交互密集型跨模态Transformer在实时监控应用中有效的替代方案，能够在保持情感识别性能的同时显著降低计算与资源开销。

Abstract: Recent multimodal Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) systems achieve high accuracy through interaction-heavy cross-modal transformers, but their computational cost limits deployment in latency-sensitive and resource-constrained surveillance systems. To address this challenge, we propose RAFM_SER++, a lightweight multimodal SER framework featuring an asymmetric Residual Attention Fusion Mechanism (RAFM). Rather than relying on computationally expensive bidirectional interactions, RAFM injects affective speech cues into semantic text representations through a one-directional residual attention pathway. Combined with a BYOL-inspired cross-modal alignment objective and attention-guided pooling, the proposed framework improves multimodal representation learning while maintaining low computational overhead.
  Experiments on the IEMOCAP and ESD benchmarks demonstrate that RAFM_SER++ consistently outperforms the HuBERT-Base baseline and achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off compared with the state-of-the-art MemoCMT. Specifically, RAFM_SER++ reduces trainable parameters by more than 60%, achieves faster inference (79.60 it/s), and attains BACC scores of 81.10% on IEMOCAP and 95.39% on ESD. These results indicate that lightweight asymmetric multimodal fusion is an effective alternative to interaction-heavy cross-modal transformers for real-time surveillance applications.

</details>


### [500] [Compiling VGDL into Causal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05459)
*Mohit Jiwatode,Bodo Rosenhahn,Alexander Dockhorn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个确定性框架，将视频游戏描述语言（VGDL）中定义的游戏直接编译为动态结构因果模型（DSCM），通过将精灵动态、交互规则和终止条件转换为显式结构方程，实现游戏机制与因果模型的精确映射，从而保证因果保真度并支持反事实推理等下游任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习智能体常依赖虚假相关性，而大语言模型容易对游戏规则产生幻觉。尽管因果强化学习能提高可解释性，但目前缺乏将复杂游戏机制直接形式化映射为因果模型的系统方法，现有方法多依赖从游戏轨迹推断或大语言模型输出，均不够可靠。

Method: 提出一个确定性编译框架：将VGDL描述的游戏（包括精灵动态、交互规则、终止条件）直接翻译为显式结构方程，构建动态结构因果模型。每个游戏tick被视为从时间t状态变量到t+1的因果转移，实现游戏文本描述到因果结构的直接、无噪声映射。

Result: 该方法保证了与真实游戏机制之间的绝对因果保真度，生成的模型提供透明的因果路径，可支持反事实推理、因果强化学习智能体训练和程序化内容验证。

Conclusion: 该框架在符号化游戏描述与因果基础的游戏AI之间建立了原则性桥梁，为因果推理和可解释游戏智能体提供了可靠的基础设施。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning and large language models often struggle to accurately capture the causal mechanics of game environments. Standard reinforcement learning agents tend to rely on spurious correlations, while large language models are prone to hallucinating game rules. Although causal reinforcement learning improves interpretability, there is currently no formal methodology to map complex game mechanics directly into causal models. To address this, we propose a deterministic framework that compiles games specified in the Video Game Description Language into Dynamic Structural Causal Models. Rather than inferring causal structures from gameplay traces or noisy large language models' outputs, our methodology directly translates game components, including sprite dynamics, interaction rules, and termination conditions, into explicit structural equations. Each game tick represents a causal transition from state variables at time $t$ to $t+1$. By establishing this grounded mapping, the approach guarantees absolute causal fidelity to the ground-truth game mechanics. The resulting models offer transparent causal pathways that support counterfactual reasoning, causal reinforcement learning agent training, and procedural content validation. This framework provides a principled bridge between symbolic game descriptions and causally grounded game AI.

</details>


### [501] [ARC-Bench: Closed-Loop Replanning Masks Broken Action Ranking in Frozen JEPA World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05461)
*Zhengshu Zhang,Zhiyuan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了基于奖励自由潜在世界模型的规划器存在根本缺陷：其"潜在空间接近度=动作质量"的假设不成立。作者引入ARC-Bench无泄漏固定候选协议来审计JEPA-WM模型的动作排序能力，发现官方检查点在操作和导航任务中均出现严重且结构性的排名失败，且无法用溯源、欠训练或骨干网络替换等平凡原因解释。更关键的是，闭环重规划机制掩盖了这一缺陷——降低重规划频率导致成功率崩溃，表明闭环成功率系统性高估了冻结潜在表征的可排序性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型通过冻结潜在空间中的距离分数对候选动作进行排序，隐含假设潜在距离与真实代价一致（即可动作排序性）。此前尚无工作直接审计这一假设在官方发布的JEPA-WM检查点上是否成立，而闭环成功率可能掩盖了潜在的排序缺陷。

Method: 提出ARC-Bench协议：采用无泄漏（no-leak）、固定候选的方式，直接测量冻结的JEPA风格目标函数是否将候选动作按真实代价正确排序。应用于官方JEPA-WM检查点（操作和导航领域），并扩展视觉骨干（DINOv2替换为V-JEPA 1/2的ViT-L/ViT-G）进行控制实验，同时通过降低重规划频率来验证闭环掩盖假说。

Result: 官方操作审计中得分最高的候选动作几乎总是次优的；迷宫导航领域同样出现排序反转。缺陷在更换DINOv2为V-JEPA编码器后依然存在。还原性检查排除了数据来源、欠训练、骨干网络预算和度量循环性等平凡解释。降低重规划频率后成功率大幅下降，且频繁重规划拯救的片段中往往包含严重的首次规划排名失败。

Conclusion: 冻结潜在表征的动作可排序性在官方JEPA-WM模型中系统性失败，而闭环重规划以频率换成功，掩盖了这一根本缺陷。因此基于闭环成功率评估会系统性高估潜在空间规划器的质量，研究者需要对潜在空间规划方法进行直接审计而非依赖闭环表现。

Abstract: Reward-free latent world models plan by scoring candidate actions with distances in a frozen latent space: an action is preferred if its predicted future embedding lands closer to the goal embedding. This silently assumes that latent closeness is action-rankable, i.e., that ordering candidates by latent distance agrees with ordering them by true cost. We audit this assumption directly. We introduce ARC-Bench, a no-leak, fixed-candidate protocol that measures whether frozen JEPA-style objectives rank candidate actions correctly, and apply it to official released JEPA-WM checkpoints across navigation and manipulation-style control. The assumption fails, severely and structurally: on the official manipulation audits the top-scored candidate is almost always suboptimal, and the same inversion appears in the maze domains. A controlled visual-backbone extension shows that the defect persists when DINOv2 is replaced by video-pretrained V-JEPA 1 and V-JEPA 2 encoders at ViT-L/ViT-G scale. Provenance, undertraining, matched-budget backbone controls, and metric-circularity controls rule out trivial explanations. We then explain why this defect has stayed invisible: closed-loop replanning masks it. When we reduce the planner's replanning frequency, success collapses in both a navigation and a manipulation domain, and the episodes rescued by frequent replanning are enriched for severe first-plan ranking failures in the PointMaze first-plan diagnostic. Closed-loop success rates therefore systematically overstate the rankability of frozen latent representations. ARC-Bench supplies the measurement, and the masking mechanism the explanation, for methods that adapt, amortize, or replan around latent-space planners without directly auditing released JEPA-WM action rankability.

</details>


### [502] [Formation of structural attractors in neuromorphic systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06826)
*Yurii Parzhyn,Alexander Schwarzmann,Mykyta Lapin,Kostiantyn Bokhan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出不变结构学习（ISL）理论，将概念形成解释为超图空间中向结构吸引子的收敛，而非全局损失函数的最小化。论文包含三个层面：数学形式化（证明有限收敛性、类结构吸引子的存在唯一性、吸引子图的自组织）、计算验证（无反向传播且极小训练集下完成经典图像识别）、以及神经生物学假设（树突树中的结构吸引子实现、神经编码作为内部吸引子动力学的投影等），并以可检验假设而非既定事实的形式呈现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基于优化和反向传播的学习范式在可解释性和生物学合理性上存在局限，作者希望提出一种非优化的、从结构角度理解学习的理论框架，并以数学、计算和神经生物学三个维度加以支持和验证。

Method: 论文分为三部分方法：1) 数学上形式化结构约简过程，证明有限收敛性、类结构吸引子的存在唯一性以及吸引子图的自组织；2) 计算上在无反向传播、极小训练数据的条件下对经典图像识别任务进行验证；3) 在神经生物学层面提出树突树实现结构吸引子、神经编码作为内部吸引子动力学投影等假设，并与树突计算、突触可塑性的实验数据对照。

Result: 数学上证明了ISL模型的一致性和有限收敛性；计算上证明了该机制在经典图像识别任务中的可行性（无需反向传播且仅需极小训练集）；神经生物学假设与现代实验数据基本兼容，但明确将其定位为可检验假设而非既定事实。

Conclusion: ISL模型在数学上一致、计算上可行，神经生物学假设为实验验证提供了潜在方向，为探索非优化的概念形成机制开辟了新路径。

Abstract: This paper examines the theory of Invariant Structural Learning (ISL), which proposes a non-optimization approach to concept formation. Learning is interpreted as convergence to structural attractors in a hypergraph space, rather than as the minimization of a global loss function. The paper presents the ISL model, including its mathematical formalization, computational verification, and a hypothetical neurobiological interpretation. The mathematical section introduces the formal apparatus of the structural reduction process and proves its finite convergence, the existence and uniqueness of class structural attractors, and the self-organization of attractor maps. The computational section demonstrates the feasibility of the proposed approach on classical image recognition tasks, utilizing the proposed learning mechanism without backpropagation and with extremely small training datasets. Finally, the neurobiological section formulates hypotheses regarding the possible implementation of structural attractors in dendritic trees, neural coding as a projection of internal attractor dynamics, and the development of neural architectures supporting the proposed learning concept. These hypotheses are discussed in the context of modern experimental data in the fields of dendritic computations, synaptic plasticity, and the structural organization of neural circuits. The proposed neurobiological mechanisms are presented as testable hypotheses rather than established biological facts. The results demonstrate the mathematical consistency and computational feasibility of the proposed model, while the neurobiological hypotheses outline potential directions for its experimental verification.

</details>


### [503] [RAPID: Reliability-Aware Pair Importance Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05481)
*Ali Mahdavi,Azadeh Zamanifar,Amirfarhad Farhadi,Omid Kashefi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RAPID方法，用于优化示例间关系蒸馏。该方法将"可靠性门控的关系目标"与"自适应支持对提议"分离：可靠性决定强调哪些教师关系，校准的教师熵和分离的学生-教师残差决定评估哪些关系，并通过精确的逆提议校正保证损失和梯度估计器条件无偏。在两个文本分类任务上的实验表明，门控目标取得最高平均准确率，RAPID次之，均优于交叉熵基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有示例间关系蒸馏中，计算小批量内所有样本对具有O(n²)的二次复杂度；而均匀子采样可能无法高效利用有限的关系预算，导致关系蒸馏的效果受限。

Method: 提出RAPID（可靠性感知对重要性蒸馏），将目标分为两部分：1) 可靠性门控的关系目标，决定强调哪些教师关系；2) 全支持自适应对提议，通过校准教师熵和分离的学生-教师残差决定评估哪些关系。采用精确逆提议校正，使损失和梯度估计器相对于门控小批量目标条件无偏。

Result: 在AG News（BERT到DistilBERT，关系预算256）和SST-2（DistilBERT到DistilBERT，关系预算64）上：可靠性门控关系蒸馏取得最高平均学生准确率（AG News 94.285±0.054%，SST-2 88.800±0.532%）；RAPID排名第二（94.241±0.025%和88.685±0.462%），均优于交叉熵基线（94.154±0.124%和87.271±0.162%）。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，门控目标在两个设置下均取得最高平均准确率，自适应提议保持在种子级变化范围内。这支持了模块化观点：目标可靠性与评估优先级是可分离的设计维度。

Abstract: Inter example relational distillation transfers a teacher's representation geometry by matching relations among examples within a mini batch. Computing all pairs has quadratic complexity in the batch size, whereas uniform subsampling may use a limited relation budget inefficiently. We introduce Reliability Aware Pair Importance Distillation, or RAPID, which separates a reliability gated relational target from a full support adaptive pair proposal. Reliability determines which teacher relations are emphasized, while calibrated teacher entropy and detached student-teacher residuals determine which relations are evaluated. Exact inverse proposal correction makes the loss and gradient estimators conditionally unbiased with respect to the gated mini batch target. We evaluate RAPID in two text classification settings: AG News with BERT-to-DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 256, and SST-2 with DistilBERT to DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 64. Reliability gated relational distillation achieves the highest observed mean student accuracy on both datasets: 94.285 plus or minus 0.054 percent on AG News and 88.800 plus or minus 0.532 percent on SST-2. RAPID ranks second, achieving 94.241 plus or minus 0.025 percent and 88.685 plus or minus 0.462 percent, respectively, compared with 94.154 plus or minus 0.124 percent and 87.271 plus or minus 0.162 percent for the cross entropy baseline. Pilot evaluations are counted toward the same total budget as the main relation evaluations. Across both settings, the gated target yields the highest mean accuracy, while the adaptive proposal remains within seed-level variation. These results support the modular view that target reliability and evaluation priority are separable design dimensions.

</details>


### [504] [PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN: Prior-Guided Joint Probabilistic Forecasting of Clinical Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05488)
*Weizhi Nie,Rihao Chang,Weijie Wang,Yuting Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN，一种面向多变量生理信号联合概率预测的轨迹优先框架。在MIMIC-IV衍生的6,882名患者、54,694个窗口上评估，该方法在13个模型中取得第二低的归一化MAE(0.37727)和最低的RMSE(0.52656)，超越确定性TimeKAN 0.52%。但轨迹衍生的风险评分在临床事件检测上弱于专用GRU-D分类器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床恶化并非单一诊断标签所能刻画，而是通过耦合且部分可观测的轨迹展开。现有方法通常忽略轨迹的多变量联合演变特性，因此需要一种轨迹优先的联合概率预测框架来更全面地建模生理状态演变。

Method: 框架包含五个核心组件：缺失感知的时间编码器、软器官系统先验、患者特定的关系建模、非线性Kolmogorov-Arnold消息传递，以及低秩多变量Student-t分布输出头。该框架支持对24小时历史进行编码并对未来6小时的多变量生理信号进行联合概率预测。

Result: 在五个种子和13个模型上评估，PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN达到第二低的归一化MAE(0.37727±0.00029)和最低的RMSE(0.52656±0.00034)，相对确定性TimeKAN降低MAE 0.52%。边际NLL为0.66380，CRPS为0.27301。经验覆盖率在50/80/95%名义区间下为0.533/0.831/0.958。去除关系结构导致最大消融损失。轨迹衍生的风险评分AUROC仅0.603，弱于GRU-D分类器的0.650。

Conclusion: 联合轨迹预测虽然能提供可观测的中间任务，在点预测与概率校准上表现良好，但仅靠准确的生理预测不足以构建校准良好的临床事件检测器。该工作的临床价值应谨慎评估——轨迹预测本身可作为可解释的中间步骤，但需与专用分类方法协作方能支撑临床决策。

Abstract: Clinical deterioration unfolds through coupled, partially observed trajectories, not a single diagnostic label. We introduce PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN, a trajectory-first framework for joint probabilistic forecasting of multivariate physiology. It combines missingness-aware temporal encoders, a soft organ-system prior, patient-specific relations, nonlinear Kolmogorov-Arnold messages, and a low-rank multivariate Student-t head. We evaluate 24-hour histories and six-hour forecasts on a frozen MIMIC-IV-derived cohort of 6,882 patients and 54,694 windows. Across five seeds and 13 models, PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN obtains the second-lowest normalized MAE (0.37727 +/- 0.00029) and the lowest RMSE (0.52656 +/- 0.00034). It reduces MAE by 0.52% relative to deterministic TimeKAN. For probabilistic forecasting, it reaches a marginal NLL of 0.66380 and a CRPS of 0.27301. Empirical coverage is 0.533, 0.831, and 0.958 for nominal 50%, 80%, and 95% intervals. Removing relational structure causes the largest ablation loss. Increasing covariance rank improves joint likelihood but has little effect on point accuracy. A trajectory-derived risk score remains weaker than a dedicated GRU-D classifier (AUROC 0.603 versus 0.650), which limits the present clinical claim. Joint trajectory forecasting therefore provides an inspectable intermediate task, but accurate physiology forecasts alone do not ensure a calibrated event detector.

</details>


### [505] [SciLitBench: Benchmark and Design Principles for LLM-Powered Systematic Literature Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05505)
*Miguel Zabaleta,Baihan Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SciLitBench，一个多阶段系统综述基准，涵盖标题/摘要筛选、全文筛选和模式引导的数据提取三个阶段，包含42,981条检索记录、1,012篇全文和888篇入选论文的标注。作者评估了6个模型家族共22个开源权重LLM，发现显式纳入/排除标准可提升28.8%的标题摘要筛选F2分数，研究者撰写的理由可提升全文筛选15%。数据提取阶段可靠性差异显著，从出版年份的0.97准确率降至计算方法提取的0.37 Jaccard重叠度。该基准揭示了高召回筛选与证据完整提取之间的实用边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统综述需要人工判断贯穿数千条记录，但现有LLM评估通常孤立地考察单个综述阶段，缺乏跨多个阶段的统一评估框架，无法全面反映LLM在完整证据合成流程中的实际能力与局限。

Method: 构建SciLitBench多阶段基准：包含标题/摘要筛选、全文筛选、模式引导数据提取三个阶段，使用22个来自6个模型家族的开源权重LLM，通过引入显式纳入/排除标准和研究者的筛选理由来测试提示增强效果，并评估各阶段性能。

Result: 显式纳入和排除标准使标题/摘要筛选F2提升28.8%，研究者撰写的理由使全文筛选提升15%。数据提取可靠性差异大：出版年份准确率0.97，但计算方法Jaccard重叠仅0.37；最强模型仅恢复30%的标注评估证据和25%的局限性。

Conclusion: SciLitBench确定了高召回筛选与证据完整提取之间的实用性能边界，提供了可复现的资源来评估基于LLM的证据合成，表明LLM在筛选阶段表现可靠但在复杂数据提取任务中存在明显局限。

Abstract: Systematic reviews require sustained human judgment across thousands of records, yet existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically examine review stages in isolation. We introduce SciLitBench, a multi-stage benchmark spanning title and abstract screening, full-text screening, and schema-guided data extraction, with 42,981 retrieved records, 1,012 full texts, and annotations for 888 included papers. Across 22 open-weight LLMs from six model families, explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria improve title and abstract screening $F_2$ by 28.8\%, while researcher-authored rationales improve full-text screening by 15\%. Data extraction reveals a different reliability regime: performance declines from 0.97 accuracy for publication year to 0.37 Jaccard overlap for computational approach, while the strongest models recover only 30\% of annotated evaluation evidence and 25\% of limitations. SciLitBench identifies a practical boundary between high-recall screening and evidence-complete extraction and provides a reproducible resource for evaluating LLM-assisted evidence synthesis.

</details>


### [506] [SCAFFOLD: Self-Improving Web Agents via Recursive Parametric Skill Abstraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05511)
*Bowei He,Xiaokun Zhang,Meng Ding,Xue Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Scaffold，一个用于视觉 Web 智能体的自改进框架。它从成功轨迹中归纳可执行的参数化技能，构建递归组合的技能层级，利用最小描述长度（MDL）准则和行为等价性检查压缩技能库，并定期将技能增强轨迹蒸馏回模型权重中。在 WebArena、VisualWebArena 和 Online-Mind2Web 上，相比最强技能增强基线，成功率提升 11.1–17.2 个绝对百分点，且五轮自改进迭代中呈现单调增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web 智能体需要处理视觉丰富、长时程且跨网站不断变化的界面，但大多数现有智能体仍孤立地学习每个任务，丢弃积累的程序性知识。现有技能增强框架虽迈出第一步，但将技能库视为扁平或两层的提示端缓存，缺乏压缩冗余和递归组合技能的机制化原则。

Method: Scaffold 包含四个核心组件：(i) 在多实例抽象约束下，从成功轨迹归纳参数化、可执行的技能；(ii) 维护递归组合的技能层级，高层技能可调用低层技能；(iii) 通过最小描述长度（MDL）准则和行为等价性检查来压缩技能库；(iv) 定期将技能增强的轨迹蒸馏回模型权重中，将抽象内化到模型参数。

Result: 在 WebArena、VisualWebArena 和 Online-Mind2Web 的保留测试集上，Scaffold 相比最强技能增强基线提升了 11.1–17.2 个绝对百分点的成功率，并在五轮自改进迭代中展现单调增益，未发生技能库崩溃。

Conclusion: Scaffold 通过系统化的技能归纳、递归组合、信息论驱动的压缩以及权重蒸馏，实现了 Web 智能体的持续自改进，验证了程序性知识积累与内化的有效性，为视觉 Web 智能体的技能库管理提供了新的设计范式。

Abstract: Web agents need to navigate visually rich, long-horizon interfaces that change across sites, yet most previous agents still learn each task in isolation and discard the procedural knowledge they accumulate. Recent skill-augmented frameworks take an important first step, but they treat the skill library as a flat or two-tier prompt-side cache and offer no principled mechanism for compressing redundancy or composing skills recursively. We introduce \textsc{Scaffold}, a self-improving framework for visual web agents that (i) induces parametric, executable skills from successful trajectories under a multi-instance abstraction constraint, (ii) maintains a recursively composed hierarchy in which higher-level skills invoke lower-level ones, (iii) compacts the library via a minimum-description-length (MDL) criterion and behavioral equivalence checking, and (iv) periodically distills skill-augmented trajectories back into model weights to internalize the abstractions. Across WebArena, VisualWebArena, and a held-out split of Online-Mind2Web, \textsc{Scaffold} improves success rate by $11.1$--$17.2$ absolute points over the strongest skill-augmented baseline and shows monotonic gains across five self-improvement iterations without library collapse. We release the code and documents in the Github \href{https://github.com/BokwaiHo/SCAFFOLD}{repository}.

</details>


### [507] [Reasoning-Aware Compression: Identifying and Protecting Vulnerable Reasoning Circuits for Energy-Efficient LLM Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05512)
*Leonard Twagirayezu,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种推理感知的压缩框架，通过硬件级GPU能量测量和模块级脆弱性分析，识别大推理模型中对INT4量化敏感的推理电路并选择性恢复至FP16，在多个推理基准上实现了均匀量化无法达到的帕累托最优压缩点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大推理模型（LRMs）部署时能耗巨大，但现有压缩方法对所有组件采用统一量化，可能破坏关键的推理电路。作者希望解决如何在不损害推理能力的前提下有效降低LRM能耗的问题。

Method: 1) 在五个推理基准（GSM8K、FOLIO、MATH-500、ProofWriter、MuSiQue）上结合硬件级GPU能量测量，对不同量化条件进行基准测试。2) 通过对留出校准集进行扰动扫描，剖析全部196-224个(层,投影)组合的每模块INT4脆弱性。3) 选择性将最敏感的电路恢复为FP16精度（混合精度方案）。

Result: 三个关键发现：1) INT4量化可能因延长推理链而增加能耗，25%的功耗下降在GSM8K上反而变成净能量增加；2) 脆弱性具有任务依赖性，注意力投影对数学推理更关键，逻辑推理中敏感性模式因架构而异；3) 选择性压缩达到均匀方法无法企及的帕累托最优点，如R1-Qwen-7B Top-10%在ProofWriter上相比FP16提升+12个百分点且能耗降低9.7%。

Conclusion: 推理感知的选择性压缩框架表明，量化不仅影响能耗的单步功耗，还影响推理链长度这一能量维度；通过按任务和架构识别关键电路并选择性恢复精度，可在降低能耗的同时甚至提升推理准确性，优于统一量化方法。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) impose substantial energy costs during deployment, yet current compression methods apply uniform quantization across all components, risking damage to critical reasoning circuits. We present a reasoning-aware compression framework that benchmarks quantization conditions across five reasoning benchmarks, GSM8K, FOLIO, MATH-500, ProofWriter, and MuSiQue, with hardware-level GPU energy measurement; profiles per-module INT4 vulnerability across all 196-224 (layer, projection) pairs via a perturbation sweep on a held-out calibration split, then selectively restores the most sensitive circuits to FP16. Three findings emerge. First, INT4 quantization can increase energy by extending reasoning chains; a 25% power reduction becomes a net energy increase on GSM8K. Second, vulnerability is task-dependent: attention projections are more critical for mathematical reasoning, and sensitivity patterns differ by architecture in logical inference. Third, selective compression achieves Pareto-optimal points inaccessible to uniform methods: R1-Qwen-7B Top-10% on ProofWriter gains +12 pp over FP16 at -9.7% energy, validated on held-out data across five reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [508] [When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05513)
*Jianwei Zhang,Sihan Cao,Pengcheng Zheng,Ya Wen,Pei Ke,Kuien Liu,Shen Gao,Wei Dong,Yang Yang,Chaoning Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种预算感知的在线教学框架（Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming），通过可解性感知的教师门控和分数引导的回合选择机制，在保持同等首次通过成功率的同时，显著减少教师调用次数（平均减少22.6%）和学生训练计算量（平均减少52.1%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web智能体在真实环境中部署需要持续在线适应，但部署昂贵的专有模型商业成本过高，因此需要依赖轻量级本地模型通过更强的教师模型进行在线教学。然而，标准的交互式反馈成本过高，且传统的轨迹级偏好优化在不可解决的回合和冗余执行回合上浪费预算，亟需更高效的在线教学策略。

Method: 提出一种预算感知的框架，系统性地编排"何时教"和"教什么"两个关键问题。具体包括：(1) 可解性感知的教师门控机制，决定何时需要查询教师模型；(2) 分数引导的回合选择机制，决定保留哪些信息量丰富的回合用于学生训练。

Result: 在MiniWoB和TimeWarp数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在保持与基线相当的首次通过成功率的同时，平均减少22.6%的教师调用次数和52.1%的学生训练计算量。

Conclusion: 通过预算约束下的选择性教学策略，可以显著降低在线教学中教师调用和学生训练的计算成本，而不会损害学习效果，为轻量级本地模型的持续在线适应提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Web agents have achieved significant success in automating complex internet tasks but deploying them in real-world environments requires continuous online adaptation. Given that deploying powerful proprietary models remains commercially cost-prohibitive, practitioners must rely on lightweight local models that evolve post-deployment via online teaching from a stronger teacher. However, standard interactive feedback imposes prohibitive costs. We show that conventional trajectory-level preference optimization wastes budget on both unresolvable episodes and redundant execution turns. To resolve these inefficiencies, we propose \textbf{Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming}, a budget-aware framework that systematically orchestrates \textbf{when} and \textbf{what} to teach. Specifically, our framework integrates a solvability-aware teacher gate to dictate \textbf{when} to query the teacher model and a score-guided turn selection mechanism to decide \textbf{what} informative turns to retain. Extensive experiments on MiniWoB and TimeWarp demonstrate that our method achieves comparable first-pass success while reducing teacher calls by 22.6\% and student training compute by 52.1\% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjw131f1fc/budgeted-online-teaching.

</details>


### [509] [The Failure Happens Before the Drift: The Social Dynamics of Values in LLM Agent Societies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05514)
*Farah Atif,Sougata Saha,Monojit Choudhury*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于世界价值观调查(WVS)的仿真框架，用于评估LLM代理能否在长期、价值密集的对话中忠实模拟多样化的人类价值系统。约4000次对话、1200个角色、15个主题、3个模型的实验中，超过50%的角色从一开始就无法表达其分配的WVS画像，且模拟的价值分布系统性偏离分配的WVS画像，表明当前LLM代理在表示和长期保持多样化人类价值画像方面仍是有限的代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理越来越多地被用作社会科学研究中人类参与者的替代品，但尚不清楚它们能否忠实地模拟多样化且相互冲突的人类价值系统。这一能力缺口对于依赖代理进行社会调查和研究的有效性构成根本性挑战。

Method: 提出一个WVS基础的仿真框架：(1) 构建具有文化多样性和不同沟通风格的代理；(2) 让这些代理参与纵向、价值密集的讨论；(3) 在约4,000次对话中评估价值忠厚度(value faithfulness)、价值漂移(value drift)和对话真实性(conversational realism)；(4) 使用GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash和Gemma-4-E4B三个模型；(5) 通过消融实验移除人口统计学细节来测试影响。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 超过50%的角色从一开始就无法表达其分配的WVS画像；(2) 2-7%的角色在重复对话后发生价值漂移；(3) 移除人口统计学细节可改善某些模型的忠厚度，但无法改变总体趋势——模拟价值分布仍系统性偏离分配的WVS画像；(4) 与人类对话相比，模拟对话在风格一致性与语义多样性之间存在不同的权衡，常产生内容多样但风格重复的交流。

Conclusion: 当前LLM代理虽能生成看似合理的对话，但在表示和长期保持多样化人类价值画像方面仍存在显著局限，不宜作为社会科学研究中人类参与者的充分替代品。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used as proxies for human participants in social science research, yet it remains unclear whether they can faithfully simulate diverse and conflicting human value systems. We present a World Values Survey (WVS)-grounded simulation framework where culturally diverse agents with different communication styles engage in longitudinal, value-laden discussions. Across approximately 4,000 conversations involving 1,200 personas, 15 topics, and three models (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemma-4-E4B), we evaluate value faithfulness, value drift, and conversational realism. We find that more than 50\% of personas fail to express their assigned WVS profiles from the outset, while 2-7\% drift after repeated conversations. Ablations removing demographic details improve faithfulness for some models but do not change the broader trend: simulated value distributions still systematically deviate from the assigned WVS profiles. Compared to human discussions, simulated dialogues show a different trade-off between stylistic consistency and semantic diversity, often producing content-wise varied but stylistically repetitive exchanges. These findings suggest that current LLM agents can generate plausible conversations, but remain limited proxies for representing and preserving diverse human value profiles over time.

</details>


### [510] [Beyond "AI Helps Humans": Decision-Targeted Evaluation Design for Human-Agent Teams in the Agentic Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05527)
*Hamed Khosravi,Xiaoming Huo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 TEAM-Design 规则，在有限的回放预算下决定哪些任务更可能接受"仅人类"回放、哪些更可能接受"仅智能体"回放，以评估人机协作工作流是否优于人类单独或智能体单独。该规则根据基线结果的可预测性和比较的难度动态分配回放概率，并证明其能解决预算设计问题并控制错误决策概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在部署人机协作工作流（如编码智能体受工程师监督、临床模型辅助放射科医生）时，需要判断该工作流是否同时优于"仅人类"和"仅智能体"两种替代方案。但部署后无法观察到替代结果，需通过回放任务来恢复，而回放预算有限。因此核心设计问题是如何分配预算：哪些任务应回放"仅人类"基线，哪些应回放"仅智能体"基线。现有方法（智能体基准测试、基于方差的采样、贝叶斯信息方法）均未直接针对这种部署决策进行优化。

Method: 提出 TEAM-Design 规则，为每个任务赋予两个回放概率（每个基线一个）。在缺失基线结果难以从已有信息预测、且该比较更难确立时提高回放概率；在回放成本高时降低概率。理论证明该规则能解决预算设计问题，且从记录的概率中随机抽取回放仍能控制错误宣称工作流优于两种替代方案的概率。

Result: 在6个临床场景（无人机工作流能同时优于两种替代）和一个编码基准（有一种能）上重新分析，并在合成设计和基于真实胸部X光读者研究构建的半合成设计上评估。TEAM-Design 在一个比较明显比另一个更难确定时效果最佳；当两个比较难度相当时，其表现可能差于基于方差的分配方法。

Conclusion: TEAM-Design 提供了一种针对部署决策的预算分配框架，在不平衡难度场景下优势明显，但在两个基线比较难度相近时存在局限性，需要考虑与现有方法结合或改进。

Abstract: Wherever a coding agent works under engineer supervision, or a clinical model assists a radiologist, the deployment question is whether to keep the human-AI workflow or replace it with the human alone or the agent alone. The human-AI workflow is worth keeping only if it beats both of those alternatives. Yet once it is deployed, neither alternative outcome is observed: recovering one means replaying the task under that alternative, and every replay costs expert time or compute. Under a fixed replay budget, the design question is therefore which tasks should be more likely to receive a human-only replay, and which an agent-only replay. Existing methods do not directly target this decision. Agent benchmarks do not choose which missing baseline to measure, variance-based sampling ignores which of the two comparisons is closer to failing, and Bayesian information methods focus on learning model parameters instead of making the deployment decision. We propose TEAM-Design, a rule that gives every task two replay probabilities, one per baseline. It raises a probability where the missing baseline outcome is hard to predict from what is already known about the task and where that comparison is harder to establish, and lowers it where replay is expensive. We prove that the rule solves this budgeted design problem, and that drawing the replays at random from recorded probabilities still controls the chance of wrongly declaring that the workflow beats both. We reanalyze 6 clinical settings, where no human-AI workflow beats both alternatives, and a coding benchmark, where one does, then evaluate TEAM-Design on synthetic designs and on a semi-synthetic design built from a real chest X-ray reader study. TEAM-Design works best when one of the two comparisons is clearly harder to settle than the other, and can do worse than variance-based allocation when the two are similarly difficult.

</details>


### [511] [EdgeMem: LLM-Free Agent Memory Construction and Retrieval via Evidence-Preserving Multi-Anchor Hypergraph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05553)
*Zeyang Cui,Jiannong Cao,Zhiyuan Wen,Bo Yuan,Junlan Feng,Shengyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EdgeMem是一种基于"保留原始交互轮次并通过互补的内容、时间和情景线索组织它们"原则的智能体记忆方法，使用多锚点超图结合轻量级局部处理，检索直接返回原始证据，只在最终答案生成时使用LLM。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆方法常将交互历史压缩为摘要或其他LLM生成的表示，存在两个问题：重复生成增加了计算成本；在系统不知道未来查询需求之前就丢弃了包含答案的细节。

Method: EdgeMem基于简单原则：保留原始交互轮次，通过互补的内容、时间、情景线索进行组织。用多锚点超图（multi-anchor hypergraph）配合轻量级局部处理实现，检索直接返回源证据，仅在最终回答生成时调用LLM。

Result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上展示了强大的检索和基于记忆的问答能力。在LoCoMo上，七个复现系统在共享提示下EdgeMem获得最高严格评判分数（61.01对比58.70），且构建和检索不需要生成式LLM调用。

Conclusion: EdgeMem表明没有生成式记忆管理的"保留并组织原始证据"方法，能为智能体记忆提供有效且高效的基础。

Abstract: Agent memory allows LLM agents to use earlier interactions when answering new queries. Existing methods often compress interaction histories into summaries or other LLM-generated representations. Repeated generation adds cost and can discard answer-bearing details before the system knows what a future query will require. We propose EdgeMem, an agent-memory method built around a simple principle: preserve original interaction turns and organize them through complementary content, temporal, and episodic cues. EdgeMem realizes this principle with a multi-anchor hypergraph constructed by lightweight local processing. Retrieval directly returns source evidence and reserves LLM use for final answer generation, combining structured access to multi-session histories with faithful retention of the original conversation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show strong retrieval and memory-grounded question answering; on LoCoMo, EdgeMem achieves the highest strict-judge score among seven reproduced systems under a shared prompt (61.01 versus 58.70), while construction and retrieval require no generative-LLM calls. Overall, EdgeMem shows that preserving and organizing source evidence provides an effective and efficient foundation for agent memory without generative memory management.

</details>


### [512] [Deep belief networks are exact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05572)
*Gleb Smirnov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文证明所有定义在{-1,1}^n上的严格正概率分布都可以被有限参数的sigmoid信念网络精确表示，回答了Sutskever和Hinton提出的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sutskever和Hinton此前提出了一个开放性问题：sigmoid信念网络是否能够精确表示所有严格正的布尔概率分布。此前的工作只能给出近似表示，无法证明精确表示的可行性。

Method: 作者将Sutskever和Hinton的概率共享近似方法升级为精确表示，关键证明工具是Brouwer不动点定理，通过构造合适的连续映射并利用其不动点性质来保证精确表示的存在性。

Result: 成功证明了所有严格正的概率分布（定义在{-1,1}^n的二值空间上）都可以由有限参数的sigmoid信念网络精确表示，解决了该开放问题。

Conclusion: sigmoid信念网络在精确表示能力上具有充分的表达力，能够覆盖所有严格正的二值概率分布，这为该类概率图模型的理论基础提供了坚实的保证。

Abstract: We prove that every strictly positive probability distribution on \(\{-1,1\}^n\) is represented exactly by a sigmoid belief network with finite parameters. This answers a question of Sutskever and Hinton. The proof upgrades their probability-sharing approximation to exact representation using Brouwer's fixed-point theorem.

</details>


### [513] [EnvCraft: Synthesizing Executable Environments in Agentic RL for Claw-like Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05576)
*Yirong Zeng,Shen You,Jinhang Feng,Yufei Liu,Xiao Ding,Yutai Hou,Hao Cong,Yuxian Wang,Wu Ning,Wang Xu,Bibo Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EnvCraft框架，通过自动化合成可执行的交互环境和可扩展的训练数据，解决Agentic RL中交互式训练环境严重稀缺的问题，支持Claw类智能体的长程任务训练。实验中合成了139个交互环境约2万个复杂任务，在Claw风格基准上提升最高达+11.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型正从被动语言接口转向执行长程任务的自主Claw类智能体。虽然Agentic RL是优化这些智能体的有前景路径，但其扩展严重受限于交互式训练环境的严重匮乏。现有合成环境仅局限于工具调用端点，无法满足Claw类智能体端到端的真实需求。

Method: EnvCraft框架包含两个核心引擎：(1)环境合成引擎，构建沙箱隔离的工作空间；(2)拓扑感知的数据生成引擎，产生连贯的任务轨迹。通过这两个引擎自动合成可执行环境及可扩展的训练数据。

Result: 合成了139个交互环境，包含约2万个复杂任务用于Agentic RL训练。在Qwen3/3.5系列模型（8B-32B）上，Claw风格基准提升最高达+11.9%，通用工具使用基准提升+8.0%，同时减少了推理token消耗。

Conclusion: 合成的可执行环境能为训练提供稳健且可泛化的学习信号，验证了通过自动化环境合成来扩展Agentic RL训练范式的可行性。

Abstract: The paradigm of LLMs has rapidly shifted from passive language interfaces to autonomous Claw-like agents that execute long-horizon tasks across stateful workspaces. While Agentic Reinforcement Learning (Agentic RL) provides a promising path to optimize these agents, its scaling is heavily bottlenecked by the severe scarcity of interactive training environments. Existing synthetic environments are strictly limited to tool-calling endpoints, rendering them insufficient for accommodating the end-to-end real-world demands of claw-like agents. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnvCraft, an automated framework for synthesizing executable environments and scalable training data. Specifically, EnvCraft employs an environment synthesis engine to build sandbox-isolated workspaces, alongside a topology-aware data generation engine to produce coherent task trajectories. Overall, we synthesize 139 interactive environments comprising approximately 20K complex tasks for Agentic RL training. Experiments on Qwen3/3.5 models (8B-32B) show that our method yields gains of up to +11.9% on Claw-style benchmarks and +8.0% on general tool-use benchmarks, with concurrent reductions in inference token cost. The results confirm that synthesized executable environments provide robust and generalizable learning signals for training.

</details>


### [514] [Planning and Scheduling Business Processes under Control-Flow Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05578)
*Michel Kunkler,Stefanie Rinderle-Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究业务流程中的活动调度问题，将其建模为机会约束优化问题，提出两阶段分解方法与集成方法两种求解方案，在真实和合成数据集上验证了两种方法的权衡：集成方法得到更优的makespan但难以扩展，分解方法可扩展至大规模场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业务流程调度中，活动序列因执行过程中产生的数据决策而存在不确定性，这使得精确调度极具挑战。现有方法未充分考虑执行路径的不确定性对可行性和冗余活动数量的影响。

Method: 将问题形式化为机会约束优化问题，提出两种公式化方案：(1) 分解方法——分为规划阶段（最小化期望冗余活动数量并满足可行性约束）与调度阶段（在已规划活动上最小化makespan）；(2) 集成方法——将规划与调度合并为单一公式。

Result: 在两个真实数据集和一个合成数据集上的评估表明，集成方法能获得更优的makespan但在规模增大时难以求解，而分解方法能够扩展到大规模场景。

Conclusion: 两种方法各有优劣：集成方法质量高但可扩展性差，分解方法牺牲部分最优性以换取更大规模的可处理性，实际应用中需根据问题规模进行选择。

Abstract: Scheduling activities in business processes can improve efficiency (e.g., reduce makespan), but is challenging because the exact sequence of activities required to complete a case is often uncertain due to decisions based on data that emerges during execution. Nevertheless, probabilistic information regarding such decisions can often be estimated or derived from historical execution logs, and can help anticipate which execution paths are likely to lead to successful completion. Planning with particular execution paths affects feasibility, i.e., the probability of successful completion, and the expected number of superfluous activities that are planned but never executed. We frame the problem as a chance-constrained optimization problem and present two formulations: A decomposed approach with two stages, a planning stage that minimizes the expected number of superfluous activities subject to a feasibility constraint, and a scheduling stage that minimizes the makespan over the planned activities; and an integrated approach that combines planning and scheduling into a single formulation. Evaluation on two real-world and one synthetic dataset shows that the integrated approach yields superior makespans but is intractable at scale, while the decomposed approach scales to large settings.

</details>


### [515] [Agents Trust Tools Too Much: Measuring Reliance on Unreliable Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05587)
*Hoyeol Yang,Woojung Song,Taewon Kim,Jonghyun Song,Seoyeon Park,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了工具使用型智能体对不可靠工具返回结果的过度信任问题。通过评估14个LLM在使用网页搜索、LLM子代理委派和代码执行三种工具时的表现，作者发现智能体在所有设置下都表现出高度过度信任——平均采纳率超过三分之一，网页搜索场景下高达68%。值得注意的是，智能体经常能识别出冲突甚至内部恢复正确答案，却只向用户呈现被污染的错误答案。尽管在提示词、工具元数据和后训练三个层面进行了干预，但没有一种方法能持续缓解跨工具的过度信任问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具使用智能体评估主要关注任务完成成功率，并假设工具返回可靠信息。然而真实系统中工具返回可能看似合理却实际错误。作者旨在探究智能体在面对不可靠工具返回时的行为模式，识别其过度信任问题及其严重性，以推动更完善的评估与干预方法。

Method: 作者使用三种工具（网页搜索、LLM子代理委派、代码执行）评估14个LLM。针对每种工具，作者污染其返回内容，测量智能体是否在最终答案中采纳被污染的内容。通过分析推理轨迹来识别失败模式，并在三个层面进行干预：用户提示、工具提供者元数据、智能体构建者后训练。

Result: 所有三种设置下智能体均表现出高度过度信任：每种工具的平均采纳率超过三分之一，网页搜索最高达68.0%。推理轨迹分析发现一个严重失败模式——智能体常能识别冲突甚至内部恢复正确答案，却只展示被污染的答案且不向用户发出警告。干预实验表明，虽然有部分方法对特定模型或工具有效，但没有任何方法能跨工具一致地缓解过度信任。

Conclusion: 过度信任不可靠工具是工具使用智能体中一个严重且顽固的失败模式。这要求未来的评估和干预不仅要让智能体验证工具输出，还要使其向用户透明地沟通未解决的冲突。目前尚无统一的缓解方案，该问题亟待更多研究关注。

Abstract: Existing evaluations of tool-using agents primarily measure whether an agent can successfully complete diverse tasks with tools. These evaluations generally assume that tools return reliable information. However, tool returns in real-world systems can be plausible yet incorrect. We investigate how agents respond to unreliable tool returns by evaluating fourteen LLMs using three tools-web search, LLM sub-agent delegation, and code execution. For each tool, we corrupt its returns and measure whether agents adopt the corrupted content in their final answers. Agents exhibit high levels of overtrust across all three settings: the mean adoption rate exceeds one third for every tool and reaches 68.0% for web search. Analysis of reasoning traces reveals a particularly concerning failure mode: agents often recognize conflicts and even recover the correct answer internally, yet present only the corrupted answer without warning the user. To mitigate agents' overtrust in tool returns, we intervene at three levels: prompting by the user, metadata from the tool provider, and post-training by the agent builder. Although some interventions help for particular models or tools, none consistently mitigates overtrust across tools. These findings identify overtrust in unreliable tools as a serious and persistent failure mode, motivating evaluations and interventions that enable agents to validate tool outputs and transparently communicate unresolved conflicts.

</details>


### [516] [The convergent laboratory: when AI reasoning, autonomous experiments, high performance and quantum computing reshape chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05643)
*Eliu Huerta,Xiaoyun Wang,Geetika Gupta,Edward H. Sargent,Cameron J. Owen,Victor Fung,Abhishek Mitra,Austin Cheng,Emma Bouchard,Shams Mehdi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是TPC26会议（汇聚学术界、国家实验室和工业界领袖的会议）催生的一篇评论文章，探讨了人工智能、自主代理、自动驾驶实验室、高性能计算和量子计算如何汇聚融合以加速材料科学发现，并认为这些技术正处于颠覆性变革的临界点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI驱动的推理、自主代理框架、自动驾驶实验室和容错量子处理器同时成熟，作者希望提供一个参考框架，记录这一被认为是化学科学领域变革性进展和生产性颠覆的关键转折点，分享处于这些前沿研究者的第一手经验。

Method: 本文作为一篇评论（Comment）文章，基于TPC26会议（https://tpc26.org）的讨论与交流，汇集了来自学术界、国家实验室和工业界研究人员在前沿领域的亲身实践经验，分析AI、自主代理、自动驾驶实验室、高性能计算及量子计算等技术的协同放大效应。

Result: 文章指出这些独立技术（AI、自主代理、自动驾驶实验室、高性能计算、量子计算）正在汇聚并对材料科学发现产生协同放大的影响，标志着化学科学正迎来一个变革性进展和生产性颠覆的"临界点"（tipping point）。

Conclusion: 这篇评论旨在作为一种时代参考，捕捉全球范围内以AI为核心驱动的材料科学发现范式转型的本质，为处于这一颠覆性变革时期的研究者提供前瞻性指引。

Abstract: This Comment emerges from TPC26 (https://tpc26.org), a conference convening leaders from academia, national laboratories, and industry who are reshaping materials science discovery. The meeting explored how AI, autonomous agents, self-driving labs, higher performance and quantum computing converge to amplify their individual impact on materials science discovery. The perspectives here reflect the firsthand experiences of researchers at these frontiers and capture the essence of this global endeavor. As AI-driven reasoning, autonomous agentic frameworks, self-driving laboratories, and fault-tolerant quantum processors mature simultaneously, we offer this Comment as a reference at what we believe is a tipping point of transformative advances and productive disruption in the chemical sciences.

</details>


### [517] [What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05663)
*T. J. Barton,Chris Constantakis,Patti Hauseman,Annie Mous,Alaska Hoffman,Brian Bergeron,Hunter Goodreau*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文呈现了来自两个生产系统的自主语言模型交易代理的持续、人群规模测量记录（DX Terminal Pro 和 DXAP 实时 alpha 舰队），覆盖约六个月的 750 万次单模型调用和 30 万次链上操作。四个核心发现：运营层决定行为多于策略文本；仓位规模对波动性视而不见；代理几乎无法捕获其达到的上行空间；两个舰队均未表现出方向性优势。所有结论均通过日内聚类推理、排列零假设和共同费用重述的稳健性检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模自主语言模型交易代理已在生产中部署，但缺乏对其实际行为与表现的人群规模、持续性的实证测量。本文旨在通过生产环境中的真实运营数据，揭示此类代理的真实交易行为模式及其性能边界。

Method: 收集并分析两个共享设计谱系的生产系统（DX Terminal Pro 和 DXAP 实时 alpha 舰队）的完整运营记录，涵盖约六个月、750 万次单模型调用与 30 万次链上操作。运用固定效应模型、断点回归、风险滑块分析、方差分解、配对重放联赛等方法，并通过日内聚类推理、排列零假设与共同费用重述进行稳健性检验。

Result: （1）运营层（如风险滑块、代理固定效应、排行榜渲染边界）对行为的因果影响超过策略文本，其中风险滑块使杠杆每级增加 +0.425，代理固定效应吸收 60% 方差，排行榜前 3 名截断处存在 1.75 倍断点回归。（2）仓位规模对波动率不敏感：所有波动率六分位的杠杆中位数均为 5.0x，一个占用 11% 账面价值的姿态滑块单元格持有 62% 的清算。（3）43.2% 的仓位在 24 小时内出现至少 +300 bps 的有利偏差，但其中 49.3% 以负交易回报收盘，机械括号策略每仓位可回收 +39.0 bps。（4）两个舰队均无方向性优势：DXAP 舰队不盈利，对阵匹配的 Hyperliquid 零售基准胜率仅 41% 对 50%；前沿模型的配对重放联赛显示决策质量在统计上无法区分，但不同模型族的稳定性选择差异显著。

Conclusion: 自主 LLM 交易代理在当前状态下在决策质量上不具统计显著优势，但其行为主要由运营层设计而非策略文本驱动；文章以 17 条方法论准则收尾，强调了生产级测量中的自我修正与透明性。

Abstract: We present a continuous, population-scale measurement record of autonomous language-model trading agents operating in production across two systems with one design lineage: DX Terminal Pro (3,505 user-funded vaults trading real ETH in Base memecoin markets for 21 days, February to March 2026) and the DXAP live alpha fleet (500 to 599 user-created agents all-history, 91 to 117 concurrently active, trading Hyperliquid perpetuals, June to August 2026). The record spans roughly six months, 7.5M single-model invocations with about 300K onchain actions, and a further 231,638 multi-tool turns producing 14,596 fills. Four findings carry the paper. First, the operating layer determines behavior more than anything written in strategy text: a risk slider explains leverage (+0.425 per level), agent fixed effects absorb 60% of variance, and a leaderboard render boundary causally routes selection (regression discontinuity 1.75x at the top-3 cut). Second, sizing is volatility-blind: median leverage is 5.0x in every volatility sextile, and one posture-slider cell (11% of the book) holds 62% of liquidations. Third, agents capture almost none of the upside they reach: 43.2% of positions saw at least +300 bps of favorable excursion within 24h, yet 49.3% of those closed with a negative trade return; a mechanical bracket recovers +39.0 bps per position. Fourth, neither fleet shows a directional edge. The DXAP fleet is not profitable and trails a matched Hyperliquid retail benchmark (41% vs. 50% roundtrip win rate).
