A paired-replay league of frontier models on 416 captured production scenarios finds decision quality statistically indistinguishable at this horizon, while choice stability differs sharply across model families. Every headline survives day-clustered inference, permutation nulls, and a common-fee restatement; the paper closes with a 17-rule methodology canon bought with our own retractions.

</details>


### [518] [CUSP: Decomposable Collective Uncertainty for Multi-Agent Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05708)
*Chung-En Johnny Yu,David Garcia,Brian Jalaian,Nathaniel D. Bastian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CUSP（集体不确定性通过语义意见池化），一个无需训练的UQ框架，将多个VLM响应映射到共享语义响应空间，通过池化语义意见产生两个互补的系统级信号：集体不确定性（池化意见的离散度）和JSD（模型间冲突）。该框架不需要token logits或校准标签，适用于开源和商业VLM。实验表明集体不确定性在小模型集成中最强，JSD在商业模型机制中最强，池化预测显著提升准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合异构VLM可提升多模态推理，但单个模型的置信度或聚合答案的置信度都无法衡量系统级可靠性。需要一种能够捕捉多模型集成系统整体不确定性的方法。

Method: CUSP框架将多个VLM响应映射到共享语义响应空间，池化为一个池化语义意见，并报告两个互补信号：集体不确定性（池化意见的离散度）和Jensen-Shannon散度（模型间冲突）。该框架无需token logits和校准标签，借助精确的熵分解将总离散度与模型冲突分离。

Result: 在静态多VLM集成中：集体不确定性在小模型机制中为最强信号（预测错误检测0.764 AUROC，弃权0.889 AUARC），优于多数投票和朴素选择基线4.7-15.8个点；JSD在商业机制中最强（0.819 AUROC，0.910 AUARC），硬答案模型冲突排序AUROC达0.982。池化预测准确性比平均单模型提升5.6-13.0个点。在多步多智能体系统中，子智能体集体不确定性排序系统失败优于偶然（0.619 AUROC），最佳弃权排序为0.699 AUARC。

Conclusion: CUSP提供了一个无需训练、通用、有效的多VLM系统级不确定性量化框架，集体不确定性和JSD分别在不同的模型机制中表现最佳，且池化预测本身也能提升准确性，为多VLM集成系统的可靠性评估提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Aggregating heterogeneous vision-language models (VLMs) can improve multimodal reasoning, but neither an individual model's confidence nor that of the aggregated answer measures reliability at the system level. We present CUSP (Collective Uncertainty through Semantic Opinion Pooling), a training-free uncertainty quantification framework that maps multiple VLM responses to a shared semantic response space, pools them into a pooled semantic opinion, and reports two complementary system-level signals: collective uncertainty, the dispersion of the pooled opinion, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), the conflict among the model-level opinions. Within this pooled semantic opinion, the unnormalized collective entropy decomposes exactly into the mean of the models' individual semantic entropies and the JSD, separating total dispersion from model conflict. Requiring neither token logits nor calibration labels, CUSP applies to open-weight and commercial VLMs alike. In static multi-VLM ensembles, collective uncertainty is the strongest signal in the small-model regime (0.764 AUROC for prediction-error detection, 0.889 AUARC for abstention), outperforming uncertainty baselines majority voting and naive selection by 4.7 to 15.8 points and widening its margin as the ensemble grows; JSD is strongest in the evaluated commercial regime (0.819 AUROC, 0.910 AUARC) and ranks hard-answer model conflict with AUROC up to 0.982. The pooled prediction also improves accuracy over the average single model by 5.6 to 13.0 points. Over the full trajectory of a multi-step, multi-agent system, subagent collective uncertainty ranks system failures above chance (0.619 AUROC) and gives the best abstention ordering among the evaluated signals (0.699 AUARC).

</details>


### [519] [Recovering Temporal and Geographic Signals from Language Model Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05721)
*Esteban Feuerstein,Victoria Klimkowski,Juan Manuel Ortiz de Zarate,Federico Hernán Suaiter*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于投影的简单方法，直接作用于语言模型的输出嵌入，通过少量种子示例定义嵌入空间中的轴，检测文本或实体在该轴上的投影，以探究嵌入是否编码时间和地理等结构化现实世界信息。该方法完全黑盒、与模型无关，仅需嵌入而无需访问模型权重或内部激活，适用于仅提供API的现代嵌入模型。实验表明投影能恢复有意义的时序和空间结构，为下游时间与地理信息检索任务提供实用工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解语言模型嵌入是否编码结构化的现实世界信息（如时间和地理信号）对于表示分析和信息检索都很重要，但现有方法往往需要访问模型内部状态或进行额外训练，难以应用于仅通过API提供的现代嵌入模型。

Method: 提出一种基于投影的黑盒方法：给定少量种子示例，在嵌入空间中定义一个轴，然后通过文本或实体在该轴上的投影值进行排序。该方法仅需要输出嵌入，不依赖模型权重、内部激活、辅助探针或额外训练。

Result: 在时间和地理数据集上应用该方法，发现嵌入投影能够恢复有意义的年代顺序和空间结构，证明输出嵌入编码了时间和空间相关信号。

Conclusion: 输出嵌入确实编码了时间和空间维度信息，该方法可作为轻量级工具用于嵌入式模型的可解释性分析，以及时间排序、地理排名和标注等下游时间与地理信息检索任务。

Abstract: Understanding whether language-model embeddings encode structured real-world information is important for both representation analysis and information retrieval. We study this question for temporal and geographic signals using a simple projection-based method that operates directly on output embeddings. Given a small set of seed examples, the method defines an axis in embedding space and ranks texts or entities by their projection onto that axis. Our approach is fully black-box and model-agnostic: it requires only embeddings, without access to model weights, internal activations, auxiliary probes, or additional training. This makes it applicable to modern embedding models available only through APIs and provides a lightweight way to analyze whether temporal and spatial dimensions are present in their representation spaces. We apply the method to temporal and geographic datasets and find that embedding projections recover meaningful chronological and spatial structure. These results provide evidence that output embeddings encode signals relevant to time and space, while also offering a practical tool for interpretability and for downstream temporal and geographic information retrieval tasks, such as temporal ordering, geographic ranking, and tagging.

</details>


### [520] [Beyond Prompts: Measuring and Optimizing LLM Tool-Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05736)
*Cen,Zhao,Haibo Ruan,Wenjie Chen,Pei-fen Tu,Usman Abbasi,Joel Hesch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究固定模型下LLM工具智能体的运行时优化问题，提出资源受限的harness选择协议，并介绍PRISM优化器，通过在三个基准测试上平均提升10~15个百分点，同时强调除平均提升外还应报告所选方案的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM工具智能体可在不重训练模型的情况下，通过修改运行时harness（提示词、工具接口、中间件、状态处理、恢复逻辑）来改进性能。然而，如何在这种资源受限场景下系统性地选择最优harness配置仍然缺乏系统性研究，且现有优化器可能找到大增益但选择脆弱的更新。

Method: 提出资源受限harness选择协议，搜索空间限定为提示词和工具边界中间件（守卫型拦截编辑，而非任意重写执行逻辑）。协议统计指标包括平均持出提升、最差条件提升、可重复性、成本诊断及RelLift95(B)保守估计。实例化提示词专用与提示词加中间件两类优化器，其中PRISM通过聚类失败案例，在Pareto搜索中将修复路由到提示词、工具边界中间件或联合编辑空间。

Result: 在BFCL多轮、tau2-Retail和tau2-Telecom三个基准上，PRISM分别获得14.2、14.9和10.1个百分点的平均持出提升，且三个基准上RelLift95均为正。组件消融表明收益主要来自失败表面路由和编辑模式约束。跨优化器对比显示，部分搜索方法虽可偶尔找到大增益，但会选择脆弱更新。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在报告所选harness的平均持出提升的同时，也应报告其可靠性指标。PRISM通过失败表面路由和受约束的编辑模式，在多个基准上实现稳健且显著的性能提升。

Abstract: LLM tool agents can be improved without retraining by modifying the runtime harness around a fixed model: prompts, tool interfaces, middleware, state handling, and recovery logic. We study this setting as resource-bounded harness selection for fixed-model multi-turn tool agents, with the search surface scoped to prompts and tool-boundary middleware: edits are guarded intercepts at the tool boundary, not arbitrary rewriting of agent execution logic. Our optimizer-agnostic protocol reports mean held-out lift, worst-condition lift, repeatability, logged cost diagnostics, and RelLift95(B), a conservative estimate of the held-out gain of the harness selected under budget B. We instantiate the protocol with prompt-only and prompt-plus-middleware optimizers, including PRISM, which clusters failures and routes repairs to prompt, tool-boundary middleware, or joint edit surfaces within a Pareto search. On BFCL multi-round, tau2-Retail, and tau2-Telecom, PRISM obtains mean held-out lifts of 14.2, 14.9, and 10.1 percentage points and positive empirical RelLift95 on all three benchmarks, and a component ablation attributes the margin chiefly to failure-surface routing and the edit-pattern constraint. Across optimizers, the results show that some search procedures can occasionally find large gains but still choose brittle updates, so the reliability of the chosen harness should be reported alongside average held-out lift.

</details>


### [521] [The Normalization of Deviance in AI Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05749)
*Emilio Barkett,Alexander Kimpton,Daniel Graham,Yusuf Kundgol*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出AI风险研究过度聚焦于"能力风险"，忽视组织层面的结构性失败风险。通过分析挑战者号航天飞机、三哩岛核事故和波音737 MAX坠机等历史灾难案例，论文识别出导致组织走向灾难的共性结构机制，并将其映射到当代AI开发组织上，认为现有安全基础设施可能只是"形式合规"，无法真正防止灾难性后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI风险研究主要关注系统能力过强、过度自主或与人类价值观不一致等"能力风险"，但对构建这些系统的组织机构本身是否先天倾向于走向失败这一组织层面的问题关注不足。作者认为，无论AI系统多么强大，其开发组织都可能面临与过去重大技术灾难相同的结构性动态，因此需要将这些隐性的组织风险揭示出来。

Method: 采用案例研究方法，对挑战者号航天飞机事故、三哩岛核事故和波音737 MAX坠机三起重大技术灾难进行深度案例分析，提炼各案例灾难发生前的共性结构性机制，然后将这些机制系统性地映射到当代AI开发的组织结构与流程中加以对照分析。

Result: 研究发现，三类灾难案例存在共同的结构性失败机制，这些机制同样存在于当代AI开发组织中。更关键的发现是，现有安全基础设施可能提供的是"表面保护"——组织即使完全合规地完成了安全流程，仍可能产出灾难性结果，即"合规陷阱"。AI发展的"灾难前兆期"仍在进行之中。

Conclusion: AI开发组织的结构性失败风险是真实且紧迫的，不能仅靠提升AI系统能力层面的安全性来解决。作者呼吁在AI发展的"前灾难期"将这些组织动态变得可识别、可干预，以便在灾难发生前打断这一失败轨迹。

Abstract: Work on the risks of artificial intelligence has focused predominantly on capability risk: the danger that systems become too powerful, too autonomous, or too misaligned with human values. Far less attention has been paid to the organizational level---to whether the institutions building these systems are themselves predisposed to drift toward failure. This paper argues that they are. Regardless of how capable AI systems become, the organizations building them face the same structural dynamics that preceded past major technological disasters. Drawing on case studies of the Space Shuttle Challenger, the Three Mile Island accident, and the Boeing 737 MAX crashes, this paper identifies the common structural mechanisms preceding each failure and maps them onto contemporary AI development. The findings suggest that existing safety infrastructure may provide less protection than it appears, as organizations can complete safety processes in full compliance and still produce catastrophic outcomes. The pre-disaster period of AI development is still underway; the purpose of this paper is to make these dynamics legible while they can still be interrupted.

</details>


### [522] [The Internal Anatomy of Strategic Choice in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07478)
*Vinícius Ferraz,Leon Houf,Enrico Ferrea*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过记录四个开源大模型（包含稠密与混合专家架构，以及匹配的基座-指令微调对）在一次玩144个严格序数2×2博弈时的激活，追踪从提示中的激励经激活到选择的预定路径。结果显示稠密模型反映了人类随博弈复杂性增加而未调整的衰退；激励与选择在所有模型中均可检测，但模型在激励是否影响选择、是否与之对齐以及增强激励是否改变偏好上存在差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大语言模型虽能像战略智能体一样行动和像人类一样选择，但其内在计算是否真正与人类相似，以及不同模型架构和训练方式（如基座与指令微调）在从激励表征到决策的计算路径上有何差异。

Method: 对四个开源权重模型（涵盖稠密与MoE架构、基座与指令调优的Qwen2.5配对）记录其在一次144个严格序数2×2博弈中的激活，遵循从提示激励→激活→选择的预设路径进行分析，比较激励是否到达选择层面的可解码性、对齐程度及强度增强的效应。

Result: 稠密模型复制了人类随博弈复杂性增加而选择质量未调整地下降的模式；所有模型中激励与选择均可被检测，但差异体现在激励是否传导到选择、是否与选择对齐、以及强化激励是否改变偏好上。基座与指令调优的Qwen2.5在基线选择几乎相同，但激励传导性不同；固定的决策线索在内部可区分，但选择层面的改变是选择性的。

Conclusion: 相似的行为可能建立在不同的计算之上；后训练可以在保持行为和可解码信息大体不变的同时，重塑从激励表征到决策的路径。

Abstract: Large language models act as strategic agents and models of human choice, yet choosing like a strategic agent does not mean computing like one. We recorded activations from four open-weight models --- dense and mixture-of-experts, including a matched base--instruct pair --- in one-shot play of 144 strict ordinal $2\times2$ games. We followed a prespecified incentive from prompt, through activations, to choice. Dense models mirrored the unadjusted human decline with game complexity. Incentive and choice were detectable in every model, but models differed in whether incentive reached the choice, aligned with it and, where tested, whether strengthening it shifted preference. The base and instruction-tuned Qwen2.5 models chose almost identically at baseline yet differed in whether incentive reached choice. Fixed decision cues were distinguishable internally but changed choices selectively. Similar behaviour can rest on different computation; post-training can reshape the path from represented incentive to decision while leaving behaviour and decodable information largely intact.

</details>


### [523] [From Monolithic Blending to Agentic Orchestration: Dynamic Response for Conversational Assistants at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05758)
*Cen,Zhao,Peng Wang,Chuan Shi,Yufeng Zhang,Ying Lyu,Wanmeng Ren,Robert Xue,Claire Na Cheng,Yashar Mehdad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文报告了某大型住宿市场中台客服助手的生产迁移：用一个有界ReAct编排器（配合类型化工具）加小型生成器，替换原先单一的Qwen3-235B-A22B混合应答模型。通过回放和A/B测试，作者将架构变更与其他改动（prompt、对齐、serving）的效果分离归因。结果显示，类型化实体选择将预订选择器的精确度从8.3%提升至89.1%（召回从75.2%降至67.3%）；类型化动作ID加成员检查将结构化动作幻觉从2.14%降至0%；硬/软升级（escalation）响应率分别从5.60%/9.56%降至3.08%/2.49%；编排放置的P90延迟从3.87秒降至2.24秒，GPU占用减少约三分之一，自托管使年度模型服务成本降低一个数量级以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产级客服助手的架构选择（单模型一体化 vs. 编排器+工具 vs. 分工模型）缺乏大规模、受控的实验证据。作者在真实生产环境（每月数百万对话、11种语言、P90延迟10秒约束）中迁移系统，并希望在混合多项改动的情况下，能严谨地区分出架构本身的贡献，而非把prompt、对齐和serving改进的功劳一并算到架构头上。

Method: 采用"Dynamic Response (DR)"架构：一个有界ReAct编排器作用于类型化工具（typed tools），加上一个较小的生成器，后者从后端验证过的上下文契约（context contract）写作。方法学上强调因果归因：对"架构效应"仅在完全相同的重放回合上测量（隔离prompt/对齐/serving变化），并辅以低流量A/B测试复现回放的升级（escalation）降低效果。同时报告服务优化的延迟、GPU和成本指标。

Result: 核心架构效应（重放回合、同条件测量）：类型化实体选择使预订选择器精确度从8.3%→89.1%，召回从75.2%→67.3%（precision-first操作点）；类型化动作ID+成员检查使结构化动作幻觉从2.14%→0%。A/B测试：硬升级5.60%→3.08%，软升级9.56%→2.49%；人工转接保持平稳；自助解决方向性提升+5.1点（95% CI [-2, +12]，未达显著）。服务优化：编排器P90从3.87s→2.24s，GPU占用减少约1/3，自托管降低年度模型服务成本超一个数量级。

Conclusion: 在大规模、多语言、延迟受限的生产客服场景中，"有界ReAct编排器+类型化工具+小型生成器（后端契约驱动）"的模块化架构优于单一巨型混合应答模型：类型化实体/动作工具不仅显著提升精确度并彻底消除结构化动作幻觉，还降低了升级响应率（在真实流量A/B中得到复现）。作者强调了严谨归因方法的重要性——只有用相同重放回合测得的差异才能归为架构效应，而服务优化（推理延迟、GPU、成本）的改善则显著得益于自托管与精简生成器。整体而言，文章为"分工 vs. 混合"的客服架构之争提供了大规模生产证据，对自托管模型的成本论点亦有贡献。

Abstract: Conversational assistants can blend retrieval, action selection, escalation, and wording in a single model path, or separate those roles. We report a production migration of a customer-support assistant at a large accommodation marketplace (millions of conversations per month, 11 languages, 10-second P90). Dynamic Response (DR) replaces a single Qwen3-235B-A22B blended responder with a bounded ReAct orchestrator over typed tools plus a smaller generator that writes from a backend-validated context contract. Because the migration also changed prompts, alignment, and serving, we attribute each effect to its cause and claim as architecture effects only those measured on identical replayed turns: typed entity selection moves the reservation selector to a precision-first operating point (precision 8.3% to 89.1%, recall 75.2% to 67.3%), and typed action IDs with a membership check remove observed structured-action hallucination (2.14% to 0.0%). A low-ramp A/B test reproduces the replay escalation reductions: hard-escalation responses fall from 5.60% to 3.08% and soft-escalation responses from 9.56% to 2.49%, while production handoff volume holds roughly steady; self-solve is directional (+5.1 points, 95% CI [-2, +12]). Serving optimizations cut orchestrator P90 latency from 3.87s to 2.24s on a GPU footprint reduced by roughly one-third, and self-hosting reduces estimated annual model-serving cost by more than an order of magnitude.

</details>


### [524] [Inference-Time Graph Engineering for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05774)
*Katherine Tieu,Dongqi Fu,Yinglong Xia,Hong Li,Hong Yan,Jingrui He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ReActNet，一个无需训练的多智能体协作框架，将查询和角色化智能体编译为一系列带语义指令的时序有向通信图，通过结构化消息传递执行，在多个任务上优于固定拓扑和可学习拓扑的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于多智能体LLM的系统依赖图结构通信来协调专业化智能体，但大多优化静态拓扑，缺乏任务自适应性和可解释性。作者从图工程视角重新审视多智能体编排问题，希望超越静态拓扑优化，实现任务条件化的时序工作流。

Method: ReActNet将查询和角色化智能体编译成一系列有向通信图快照，每个快照对应一个推理阶段，每条边携带自然语言指令描述消息语义。编译后的时序图通过结构化消息传递执行：智能体整合前序状态与来自控制器分配邻居的消息来更新状态，最终由聚合器综合所有状态生成答案。设计上将图编译与图执行分离。

Result: 在知识推理、数学问题求解、代码生成和GAIA式助手任务中，ReActNet一致优于固定拓扑和可学习拓扑的基线方法，同时保持有竞争力的推理成本。

Conclusion: 有效的多智能体编排不仅取决于哪些智能体之间通信，还取决于工程化可执行的工作流图——即编码了推理过程中信息何时、为何以及如何流动的图结构。

Abstract: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on graph-structured communication to coordinate specialized agents. We revisit multi-agent orchestration from a graph-engineering perspective: rather than optimizing a static topology, we synthesize a task-conditioned temporal workflow graph that jointly specifies agent connectivity and edge-level communication semantics. We introduce ReActNet, a training-free framework that compiles a query and a set of role-specialized agents into a sequence of directed communication graphs. Each graph snapshot corresponds to one reasoning stage, and each edge carries a natural-language instruction specifying the message that a source agent should provide to a target agent. The compiled temporal graph is then executed through structured message passing: agents update their reasoning states by integrating their previous states with messages from controller-assigned neighbors, and a final aggregator synthesizes the resulting states into the answer. This design separates graph compilation from graph execution, making multi-agent coordination explicit, inspectable, and task-conditioned without requiring reinforcement learning or gradient-based topology optimization. Across knowledge reasoning, mathematical problem solving, code generation, and GAIA-style assistant tasks, ReActNet consistently improves over fixed-topology and learned-topology baselines while maintaining competitive inference cost. These results suggest that effective multi-agent orchestration depends not only on which agents communicate, but also on engineering executable workflow graphs that encode when, why, and how information should flow during reasoning.

</details>


### [525] [DI-Bench: Systematically Generating In-Domain Data Intelligence Benchmarks for Enterprise Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05776)
*Jiangyun Zhang,Kristen Surrao,Torpong Nitayanont,Yupei Zhang,Roopali Singh,Zhiyu Chen,Julia Huang,Zhou Tang,Shayan Ali Akbar,Omar Alonso,Erwin Cornejo,Yuan Li,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DI-Bench，一个自动化生成数据智能（DI）领域企业代理基准测试的流水线，通过构建工件链接图将数据表、维度、指标和文档关联起来，生成需要计算与知识检索结合的任务，并对四个模型评估发现其在规则修改计算任务上仅达32%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业代理在领域特定基准上的评估至关重要，但现有公共基准很少评估代理能否将业务知识与分析计算结合，且人工构建此类基准成本高昂。

Method: 构建工件链接图（连接数据表、维度、指标和文档），基于此生成需要结构化数据和关联知识的问题；通过查询执行推导真实答案，再用LLM生成问题并进行验证。应用于两个公共数据集。

Result: 生成包含731个任务的基准，涵盖知识检索、分析计算和规则推理；评估四个模型，发现模型在执行需要检索业务规则修改计算的任务时准确率仅为32%。

Conclusion: DI-Bench能够自动生成区分度良好的企业领域基准，揭示了现有模型在融合业务规则与数据分析计算方面的显著不足。

Abstract: Evaluating enterprise agents on domain-specific benchmarks is critical, yet public benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can integrate business knowledge with analytical computation, and constructing such benchmarks manually is costly. We present DI-Bench, a pipeline for generating realistic benchmarks for data intelligence (DI), the practice of extracting insights from large volumes of enterprise data. To emulate realistic DI tasks that require both computation and knowledge retrieval, DI-Bench builds an artifact linkage graph over data tables, dimensions, metrics, and documents to form questions involving structured data and associated knowledge. Ground truth answers are derived via query execution, followed by LLM question generation and validation. Applied to two public datasets, the pipeline produces a 731-task benchmark covering knowledge retrieval, analytical computation, and rule-grounded reasoning. To show the discriminatory capability and difficulty of the benchmark, we evaluate four models, revealing a substantial finding: models achieve only 32% accuracy when doing computational tasks where retrieved business rules modify the computation.

</details>


### [526] [Distilling Vision-Language Models for On-Device Fire Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05782)
*Mohammad Kazzazi,Zixuan Liu,Siavash Khajavi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究如何将领域特化的视觉语言模型（VLM）通过知识蒸馏压缩为轻量级模型，并成功部署到商业火灾检测传感器上，实现了在资源受限设备上的火灾语义理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统火灾检测系统误报率高，VLM虽能通过语义推理降低误报，但模型规模过大难以部署在嵌入式火灾传感器上。因此需要探索在不损失安全关键行为的前提下压缩领域特化VLM。

Method: 采用教师-学生知识蒸馏框架，将针对火灾理解微调的大型VLM作为教师，蒸馏到轻量级学生模型中，并在多个VLM家族和模型规模上进行实验验证。

Result: 紧凑的学生模型保留了教师模型的大部分火灾理解能力；在商业Detectium火灾检测传感器上部署后，压缩和部署不仅影响准确率还改变模型失败模式；Qwen2.5-0.5B在所有模型中提供了最佳的整体部署权衡。

Conclusion: 研究为在资源受限、安全关键的场景中部署领域特化VLM提供了更广泛的指导，强调了压缩不仅仅是精度问题，还需关注失败模式的改变和实际部署权衡。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative to conventional fire detection systems by reasoning about the semantic context of a scene and thus reducing false alarms, yet their large model size makes deployment on embedded fire sensors impractical. In this paper, we study how domain-specialized VLMs can be compressed for fully on-device deployment without losing the safety-critical behavior required for fire detection. We develop a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework in which large VLMs fine-tuned for fire understanding can be distilled into lightweight students. Experiments across multiple VLM families and model scales show that compact students preserve most of their teachers' fire-understanding capability. We further deploy the distilled models on our commercial Detectium fire detection sensor and jointly evaluate reasoning accuracy, latency, and memory usage. The results show that compression and deployment affect not only accuracy but also model failure modes, with Qwen2.5-0.5B providing the strongest overall deployment trade-off. Our findings provide broader guidance for deploying domain-specialized VLMs in resource-constrained, safety-critical settings.

</details>


### [527] [More Than Mimicking Reviewers: Evaluating LLMs for Pre-Submission Peer Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05788)
*Pouya Parsa,Amin Rezaei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了一个面向作者的LLM预审系统，该系统在论文正式提交前生成广泛的原子性问题列表并压缩成简短报告。实验发现，通过去重和补充（refill）策略，覆盖率达到78.7%（严格）和84.9%（按严重性加权），远超独立采样。但论文表明虽然LLM评审在大规模候选池中覆盖良好，其压缩能力不足，主要瓶颈来自代表性选择策略和匹配器灵敏度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同行评审反馈往往来得太晚，作者无法在提交前进行有意义的修改。研究者希望将部分"压力测试"提前到投稿前，让作者在提交前就能获得类似审稿意见的反馈。

Method: 构建作者面向的LLM系统：首先生成大量原子性关注点（candidate pool），然后将其压缩为简短报告。使用10,000篇ICLR 2026投稿中的3,398篇可回溯访问的稿件，通过与历史评审的一致性评估以及遗漏关注点的有效性验证来评测系统。

Result: 独立采样仅覆盖44.9%的历史问题；去重与补充策略达到78.7%严格覆盖率和84.9%严重性加权覆盖率（消耗3.6倍请求和5.2倍token）。隐藏的Top-32 Oracle能保持256候选池的79.3%加权覆盖率，但仅基于论文的选择器只能保留40-44%。

Conclusion: LLM评审在大型候选池下提供广泛覆盖，但压缩效果不佳。消融实验表明代表性选择（representative selection）和匹配器灵敏度是导致这一差距的主要来源，为未来改进提供了明确方向。

Abstract: Peer-review feedback often arrives too late for authors to make meaningful revisions. We study an author-facing LLM system that moves part of this stress test before submission: it generates a broad pool of atomic concerns and compresses them into a short report. We evaluate agreement with historical reviews and, separately, the possible validity of concerns they omit.
  From 10,000 ICLR 2026 submissions, we use 3,398 manuscripts with accessible versions that predate review. On a ten-paper diagnostic, independent sampling covers 44.9% of historical issues; deduplication and refill reaches 78.7% strict and 84.9% seriousness-weighted coverage, at 3.6$\times$ more requests and 5.2$\times$ more tokens. A hidden Top-32 Oracle preserves the full 79.3% weighted coverage of a 256-candidate pool, but paper-only selectors retain only 40--44%. LLM review therefore provides broad coverage with a large candidate pool but compresses poorly; ablations identify representative selection and matcher sensitivity as the main sources of this gap.

</details>


### [528] [Customer Relationship Intelligence: Integrating CRM and MDM for Enhanced Customer Engagement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06189)
*Tejasvi c. Addagada*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨CRM、MDM和CKM如何共同构成客户关系智能（CRI）框架以增强客户参与（CE）。基于100名跨行业受访者的横断面调查，发现CRM和CKM是CE的显著正向预测因子，而MDM仅作为基础性数据质量使能者，其直接效应和中介效应均不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多孤立看待CRM、MDM和CKM，缺乏将它们整合为统一的客户关系智能框架来理解其对客户参与影响的系统性研究。

Method: 采用横断面问卷调查法，收集零售、医疗、IT和电信四个行业共100名参与者数据；使用Spearman rho相关分析和序数逻辑回归（IBM SPSS）检验预测关系；运用Hayes PROCESS Model 4并行中介分析（5,000次bootstrap抽样）检验MDM通过CRM和CKM对CE的间接效应。

Result: 双变量相关均弱且不显著（r<0.19, p>0.06）；回归显示CRM（beta=0.717, p=0.002）和CKM（beta=0.581, p=0.009）是CE的显著正向预测因子，MDM直接效应为正但不显著（beta=0.346, p=0.071）；模型解释CE方差20.5%；中介分析未发现显著间接效应，H4假设未获支持。

Conclusion: CRM和CKM是CRI框架中驱动客户参与的主要因素，MDM更多发挥基础性数据质量使能作用，其战略价值通过对CRM执行和知识管理的支撑得以实现。鉴于样本量和横断面设计局限，研究结论属探索性，需在更大样本和纵向设计（尤其BFSI受监管情境）中进一步验证。

Abstract: This study examines how Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Master Data Management (MDM), and Customer Knowledge Management (CKM) jointly constitute a Customer Relationship Intelligence (CRI) framework for enhanced Customer Engagement (CE). A cross-sectional survey of 100 participants across retail, healthcare, IT, and telecommunications sectors was analysed using Spearman rho correlation and ordinal logistic regression (IBM SPSS). Bivariate correlations were weak and non-significant (r<0.19, p>0.06). Regression identified CRM (beta=0.717, p=0.002) and CKM (beta=0.581, p=0.009) as significant positive predictors of CE; MDM showed a positive but non-significant direct effect (beta=0.346, p=0.071). The model explained 20.5% of CE variance (Nagelkerke R^2=0.205). Parallel mediation analysis (Hayes PROCESS Model 4, 5,000 bootstrap samples) found no significant indirect effects of MDM on CE via CRM (IE=0.021, 95% BC CI [-0.072, 0.121]) or CKM (IE=0.032, 95% BC CI [-0.061, 0.126]); Hypothesis H4 was not supported. CRM and CKM emerge as the principal drivers of CE within the CRI framework, while MDM functions as a foundational data quality enabler whose strategic value is realised through its enabling effect on CRM execution and knowledge management. Findings should be treated as exploratory given the sample size and cross-sectional design. Future research should replicate with larger sector-specific samples and longitudinal designs, particularly in regulated BFSI contexts where MDM architecture is shaped by data governance mandates.

</details>


### [529] [Spillover-Aware Multi-Value Steering for Pluralistic LLM Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05800)
*Weici Pan,Xander Barron,Jiawei Zhou,Zhenhua Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需微调的多概念激活引导方法，解决现有激活引导只能处理单一概念的问题。针对多维度价值对齐中的引导溢出效应，作者将其类比为因果推断中的处理效应与溢出效应分解，追溯其根源为引导方向的几何纠缠（由Gram矩阵刻画），并推导出一种零成本的基于激活范数惩罚目标修正，可精确解耦各方向贡献。在气候话语任务上，修正将净引导效应从+5.9%提升至+14.0%，经10万对成对判断验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的价值对齐是多元化的（Pluralistic alignment），不同利益相关者需要不同价值侧重点，需要同时引导多个维度。然而现有激活引导方法一次只能处理一个概念，且朴素的多维引导会产生严重的溢出效应——原本用于某一价值的影响会泄漏到其他价值维度上，导致引导效果不准确。

Method: 1) 将引导溢出问题形式化为类似因果推断中"处理效应vs溢出效应"的分解；2) 追溯溢出根源为引导方向间的几何纠缠，用Gram矩阵量化；3) 从激活范数惩罚目标中推导出零成本修正，实现方向贡献的精确解耦；4) 构建端到端流水线：给定领域问题，自动发现价值维度、提取方向、诊断纠缠、应用修正后的引导——全程无需微调、奖励模型或人工提示工程。

Result: 在气候话语（climate discourse）任务上，修正方法将净引导效应（net steering effect）从+5.9%提升到+14.0%，效果通过超过100,000次成对判断（pairwise judgments）验证，证明了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文解决了多元对齐中多维度激活引导的溢出问题，通过理论诊断（Gram矩阵纠缠分析）和零成本修正实现了精确的多方向解耦，为无需训练数据的pluralistic alignment提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案，并为理解激活引导的几何结构提供了新视角。

Abstract: Activation steering controls LLM behavior at inference time by adding learned directions to hidden states, but existing methods handle one concept at a time. Pluralistic alignment, where different stakeholders need different value emphases, requires steering multiple dimensions simultaneously. We show that naive steering produces substantial spillover: the effect intended for one value leaks into others. This parallels the treatment-versus-spillover decomposition in causal inference. We trace spillover to geometric entanglement of steering directions, captured by their Gram matrix, and derive a zero-cost correction from an activation-norm-penalized objective that decouples each direction's contribution exactly. Our end-to-end pipeline requires no fine-tuning, no reward model, and no manual prompt engineering: given only domain questions, it automatically discovers value dimensions, extracts directions, diagnoses entanglement, and applies corrected steering. On climate discourse, the correction improves the net steering effect from +5.9% to +14.0%, validated over 100,000 pairwise judgments.

</details>


### [530] [Beyond One-Shot Expansion: Contrastive Evidence Exploration for Multi-Hop Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07050)
*JungMin Yun,YoungBin Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个无需训练的迭代式多跳检索框架，通过证据条件化探索、段落对比细化与覆盖感知排序，提升多跳问答中的检索质量与下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳问答中现有检索方法依赖单一检索意图或一次性查询扩展，难以适应逐步发现的新证据，且容易引入噪声或冗余检索信号，限制了检索引导推理的效果。

Method: 1) 离线索引阶段构建段落特定的对比性切面，刻画每个段落与语义相似邻居的差异。2) 推理阶段迭代执行：检索证据、生成针对未解决信息需求的探针、利用对比性切面对候选项进行相关性细化、选择能共同覆盖多样化检索意图的互补段落集合。

Result: 在MuSiQue、HotpotQA和2WikiMultihopQA三个数据集上与基线相比，检索质量和下游问答性能均有持续提升。

Conclusion: 该训练无关框架通过证据导向的迭代探索、对比度细化与覆盖感知选择，有效解决了多跳检索中的证据发现与冗余控制问题。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) critically depends on retrieving the evidence necessary for effective reasoning. However, this remains particularly challenging in multi-hop question answering (QA), where supporting passages are often linked through intermediate entities and relations that must be progressively uncovered. Existing retrieval approaches typically rely on a single retrieval intent or one-shot query expansion, limiting their ability to adapt to newly retrieved evidence and potentially introducing noisy or redundant retrieval signals. To address these limitations, we propose a training-free multi-hop retrieval framework that integrates evidence-conditioned exploration, passage-specific contrastive refinement, and coverage-aware final ranking. During offline indexing, the framework constructs passage-specific contrastive facets that characterize each passage relative to its semantically similar neighbors, providing fine-grained signals to distinguish closely related candidates. At inference time, the framework iteratively retrieves evidence, generates probes targeting unresolved information needs, refines candidate relevance using the contrastive facets, and selects a complementary set of passages that collectively cover diverse evidence-seeking intents. Experiments on MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultihopQA demonstrate consistent improvements in retrieval quality and downstream QA performance over baselines.

</details>


### [531] [Evidence-Aligned Local Composition of Discrete Experts for Sequence Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05801)
*Mohammad Panahazari,Usman A. Khan,Shuchin Aeron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"证据对齐的局部组合"（evidence-aligned local composition）方法，用于在文档损坏且仅有冻结的领域专家模型时进行恢复。该方法通过从损坏观测的边缘证据中推断每个位置上的软专家权重，无需区域标签或训练路由器即可在测试时决定缺失内容和信任哪个专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实文档（如README）常由多个领域文本（散文、代码、配置）混合组成。当文档损坏时，恢复它需要同时判断缺失内容和在每个位置信任哪个领域专家。传统方法依赖区域标签或训练路由器，这在测试时不可用，因此需要一种无需监督的局部专家混合推断机制。

Method: 提出证据对齐的局部组合方法：在给定损坏模型下，从损坏观测的边缘证据中推断每个专家在每个位置上的软权重。证据通过专家自身的去噪损失估计，并在位置上平滑权重。由于权重是软的，当真实组合为混合时能恢复混合分布，当单一专家足够时则集中于该专家。

Result: 在分类模拟器、字节级专家以及由1.3B离散流匹配模型微调的专家上进行评估：自然混合科学文档上达到0.85的字段准确率，词法不重叠的构造混合文档上达到0.98。当专家真正有区分度时，恢复效果优于单一全局权重；当专家收敛一致时退化为全局权重，与专家分离度指标一致。

Conclusion: 证据对齐的局部软权重组合能在无标签、无路由器的情况下有效恢复混合文档，权重能追踪真实区域分布，且恢复性能随专家差异度自适应调整。

Abstract: A document modeled as a discrete sequence of tokens can be thought of as being generated from a composition of texts from different domains; a README file, for example, moves between prose, code, and configuration. When such a document is corrupted and only frozen domain experts are available, restoring it requires deciding both what is missing and which expert to trust at each position, at test time and without region labels or a trained router. We introduce evidence-aligned local composition, which infers a soft, position-wise weighting over the experts from the marginal evidence of the corrupted observation under a given corruption model, estimating the evidence from the experts' own denoising losses and smoothing the weights across positions. Because the weighting is soft, it recovers a mixture when the true composition is mixed and concentrates on one expert when that suffices. Across a categorical simulator, byte-level experts, and experts fine-tuned from a $1.3$B discrete flow-matching model, the inferred weights track the true regions at $0.85$ field accuracy on naturally mixed scientific documents, and at $0.98$ on constructed mixtures whose regions are lexically disjoint. Restoration improves over a single global weight when the experts are genuinely distinct and reduces to it when they converge, tracking a measure of expert separation.

</details>


### [532] [Exposing Weaknesses in Emotion Recognition in Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05806)
*Amir Ben Khalifa,Fanny Bezancon,Amine Trabelsi,Bessam Abdulrazak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文质疑ERC任务中"每条话语可被赋予单一情绪标签"的核心假设，通过零样本LLM实验和多注释者重新标注研究，发现聚合指标掩盖了系统性失败，许多"模型错误"实为标注歧义而非模型缺陷，并提出LLM-as-Judge框架以更合理的方式评估情绪合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ERC方法依赖任务特定微调，可能利用数据集特定线索，且ERC领域普遍假设每条话语有单一无歧义的情绪标签，但这一假设很少被质疑。作者希望探究该假设的有效性，并揭示标准单一标签评估的局限性。

Method: 1) 使用LLM在零样本设置下进行ERC评估，并结合前序对话轮次作为上下文；2) 分析错误集中在含否定、感叹、插入语的话语；3) 进行四位人工标注者的受控重新标注研究；4) 提出LLM-as-Judge评估框架，对各情绪独立评估其在对话语境中的合理性而非强制单一标签决策。

Result: 1) 聚合指标掩盖了系统的失败模式，错误集中在含否定、感叹和插入语的话语周围，且该模式在所有评估模型中一致，表明是基准问题而非模型弱点；2) 四位标注者仅在35%的案例中达到强一致性，中性话语主导高一致性案例，许多情绪类别处于低一致性区间。

Conclusion: 许多表面上的模型错误实际上反映了真实标注歧义而非情绪理解能力不足，标准单一标签评估不足以衡量ERC系统的实际能力，需要新的评估范式（如提出的LLM-as-Judge框架）来更准确地评估情绪识别性能。

Abstract: Emotion Recognition in Conversations (ERC) aims to identify speakers' emotions in multi-turn dialogue. Accurate emotion recognition can support a wide range of applications, including empathetic conversational agents, mental health support, and educational technologies. While many recent approaches rely on task-specific fine-tuning, such models may exploit dataset-specific cues. A central yet rarely questioned assumption in ERC is that each utterance can be assigned a single unambiguous emotion label. To investigate this assumption, we study ERC using Large Language Models (LLMs) in a zero-shot setting while incorporating preceding conversational turns as context. We show that aggregate metrics mask systematic failures. Errors concentrate around utterances containing negations, exclamations, and interjections. This pattern is consistent across all evaluated models, suggesting limitations in the benchmarks rather than model-specific weaknesses. A controlled re-annotation study involving four human annotators supports this finding: strong agreement is observed in only 35 percent of cases, with neutral utterances dominating high-agreement instances, while many emotional categories fall into low-agreement regimes. These findings suggest that many apparent model errors reflect genuine annotation ambiguity rather than poor emotion understanding. Standard single-label evaluation is therefore insufficient. To address this limitation, we introduce an LLM-as-Judge framework that evaluates each emotion independently according to its plausibility in the conversational context rather than enforcing a single-label decision.

</details>


### [533] [Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Digital Inventory of Cultural Heritage & Traditional Knowledge: Case for Indonesian Open Digital Library of Culture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08105)
*Hokky Situngkir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向印尼数字文化图书馆（PDBI）的自主AI文化知识采集方法论框架，通过五阶段经济漏斗（聚焦爬取、多语种抽取与规范化、向量编码与分块、智能体决策、幂等发布）从开放网络自动采集文化遗产知识，在扩大语料覆盖的同时加深条目数据深度，并保留四个高价值人工角色，架构上保证机器永不覆写人类贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDBI平台自2007年依赖人工贡献，积累数万条Nusantara文化遗产条目，但面临三大结构性障碍：覆盖不足（知识分散于多语言多站点）、完整性受损（开放来源混杂权威文档与噪声）、数据浅层化（主题被记录但数据深度不足）。

Method: 采用五阶段经济漏斗框架：1) 聚焦爬取；2) 多语言抽取与规范化；3) 向量编码与分块；4) 智能体决策；5) 幂等发布。遵循"确定性编排、智能体决策"原则。各阶段形式化建模：漏斗经济学与最优过滤器排序；子临界分支过程描述爬取前沿动力学；事实级新颖性通过蕴含度量；贝叶斯多源证据融合，对神圣类别提高发布阈值；通过幂等upsert与事务性outbox实现恰好一次效应；滑窗推理预算与预留协议；统计质量审计；种子选择作为子模覆盖最大化。

Result: 框架保留了四个高价值人工角色：方向策展人、升级审批人、质量审计员、意义守护者，同时分阶段提升机器自主性。讨论了伦理、法律与文化敏感性影响，架构性保证机器永不覆写人类贡献。

Conclusion: 该框架在扩大语料覆盖广度与加深每条目数据深度之间取得了平衡，通过严谨的形式化建模为文化知识自动化采集提供了方法论指导，同时以人工角色保留和写入保护机制对冲了文化敏感性与伦理风险。

Abstract: The Indonesian Digital Library of Culture (Perpustakaan Digital Budaya Indonesia, PDBI; budaya-indonesia.org) is a participatory platform that has collected tens of thousands of entries on Nusantara cultural heritage through public contribution since 2007. Manual contribution faces three structural barriers: coverage (knowledge is scattered across languages and sites), integrity (open sources mix authentic documentation with noise), and completeness (subjects are recorded but their data remain shallow). This paper presents a methodological framework for autonomous, AI-based harvesting of cultural knowledge from the open web, designed to expand corpus coverage while intensifying per-entry data depth. The methodology is organised as a five-stage economic funnel: focused crawling, multilingual extraction and canonicalisation, vector encoding with blocking, agentic decision-making, and idempotent publication, under the principle of deterministic orchestration, agentic decisions. Each stage is formalised: funnel economics and optimal filter ordering; crawl-frontier dynamics as a subcritical branching process that explains the necessity of recurrent re-seeding; fact-level novelty via a containment measure; Bayesian multi-source evidence fusion with elevated publication thresholds for sacred categories; exactly-once effects via idempotent upserts and the transactional outbox; sliding-window inference budgeting with a reservation protocol; statistical quality auditing; and seed selection as submodular coverage maximisation. The framework retains four high-value human roles: curator of direction, escalation approver, quality auditor, and guardian of meaning, while machine autonomy is raised in stages. Ethical, legal, and cultural-sensitivity implications are discussed, including the architectural guarantee that the machine never overwrites human contributions.

</details>


### [534] [Agentic BAIM-LLM Evaluation (ABLE): Benchmarking LLM Use of Protein Design Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05818)
*Bryce Cai,Geetha Jeyapragasan,Samira Nedungadi,Jake Yukich,Seth Donoughe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了ABLE基准，用于评估LLM代理在双重用途蛋白质设计工作流中使用生物AI模型（BAIMs）的能力，涵盖结构检索、序列生成和设计验证等任务。评估15个前沿模型发现7个拒绝所有任务，其余模型表现差异显著，其中Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 3 Pro在信息检索、工具选择和工具使用方面得分最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质设计领域存在双重用途风险，LLM代理与生物AI模型的结合可能大幅降低蛋白质设计门槛，但目前缺乏系统性的基准来评估LLM代理在这类工作流中的实际能力与风险。

Method: 构建ABLE基准，设计涵盖结构检索、序列生成和设计验证三类任务；选取15个前沿LLM模型进行系统评估，并在部分任务上与专家人类基线进行对比。

Result: 7个模型完全拒绝所有任务；其余模型表现差异显著，Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 3 Pro综合得分最高；模型在规划、策略生成以及生物知识与工具使用整合方面仍存在不一致性。

Conclusion: 当前LLM确实能显著降低蛋白质设计的入门门槛，但在复杂规划、策略制定及跨领域知识整合方面仍不够可靠，提示需要进一步改进模型能力并关注相关安全风险。

Abstract: We introduce ABLE, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to use biological AI models (BAIMs), such as ProteinMPNN and AlphaFold3, in dual-use protein design workflows. ABLE assesses agent performance through a set of tasks spanning structure retrieval, sequence generation, and design validation. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find that seven refuse all tasks, while the remaining models exhibit substantial performance differences. Claude Sonnet 4 and Gemini 3 Pro achieve the highest scores across information retrieval, tool selection, and tool use. We further compare model performance on a subset of tasks against an expert human baseline. Our results suggest that current LLMs can substantially lower barriers to protein design, but remain inconsistent in planning, strategy generation, and integrating biological knowledge with tool use.

</details>


### [535] [Beyond Top-$k$ Skill Retrieval: Diversity-Aware Skill Routing for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05824)
*Wang Wei,Tiankai Yang,Samyadeep Basu,Hongjie Chen,Yue Zhao,Zhengzhong Tu,Xiyang Hu,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi,Hoda Eldardiry*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DSR（Diverse Skill Routing）框架，利用行列式点过程（DPP）在技能路由中同时平衡相关性与非冗余性，通过查询残差多样性核函数来惩罚冗余技能重叠，同时避免因共享查询相关性而产生的过度惩罚。在SkillRouter基准上，DSR显著提升了召回率和完整覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体日益依赖外部技能，但现有技能路由器通常独立地对候选技能按查询相关性排序，导致大量功能冗余的技能浪费上下文预算，无法为复杂任务选择互补的技能组合。

Method: 提出DSR框架，采用行列式点过程（DPP）作为多样性感知的重排序机制，平衡相关性与非冗余性；引入查询残差多样性核函数，惩罚技能间的冗余重叠，同时减少仅由共享查询相关性引起的多余惩罚。

Result: 在SkillRouter基准上，DSR相比强点式重排序基线提升了召回率和完整覆盖率，在多技能查询上的收益更为显著。

Conclusion: 技能路由不应仅被看作相关性排序问题，还应被视为互补技能集合的选择问题。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skills, but routing user requests over large skill registries is difficult because many skills are functionally redundant while complex tasks often require complementary skill sets. Existing skill routers typically rank candidates independently by query relevance, which can waste context budget on redundant skills. We propose Diverse Skill Routing (DSR), a diversity-aware reranking framework that uses a Determinantal Point Process to balance relevance and non-redundancy. DSR introduces a query-residual diversity kernel that penalizes redundant skill overlap while reducing penalties caused only by shared query relevance. On the SkillRouter benchmark, DSR improves recall and full coverage over a strong pointwise reranking baseline, with larger gains on multi-skill queries. These results suggest that skill routing should be treated not only as relevance ranking, but also as complementary set selection.

</details>


### [536] [Bridging the Semantic-Utility Gap in Multimodal RAG via Generator-in-the-Loop Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08188)
*Zhan-Lun Chang,Dong-Jun Han,Seyyedali Hosseinalipour,Mung Chiang,Christopher G. Brinton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段生成器在环对齐框架，通过冻结VLM的答案监督信号挖掘偏好对，微调LoRA跨编码器重排器，缩小标准检索器与生成器回答效用之间的偏好差距，不依赖人工文档相关性标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准检索器和重排器优化的是语义相似度而非回答效用，导致检索到的看似相关文档可能无法帮助视觉语言模型（VLM）生成正确答案，存在偏好差距。

Method: 两阶段框架：Stage 1利用VLM根据图像-查询对生成假设文本段落，作为密集文本检索的查询，弥合图像到文本的模态鸿沟；Stage 2用LoRA微调跨编码器重排器，使用从冻结VLM中挖掘的答案监督偏好对训练（根据给定答案标签，文档若能促使VLM产出正确答案则为正样本，否则为负样本），兼容对比损失、DPO和SFT等多种对齐损失函数，并支持周期性重新挖掘偏好对。

Result: 在VQA-X和A-OKVQA数据集上，配合Qwen3.5-2B和Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct，所提框架在各种对齐损失和池大小设置下持续优于排序序、随机和REPLUG风格似然基线。

Conclusion: 答案级别的生成器反馈是偏好对齐的有效监督信号，能有效缩小检索与生成间的偏好差距。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) augmented with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) benefit from access to external evidence. However, standard retrievers and rerankers optimize for semantic similarity rather than answer utility, creating a preference gap: documents that appear relevant may not help the generator produce a correct answer. Motivated by this, we propose a two-stage generator-in-the-loop alignment framework that closes this gap without human document-level relevance annotations. Our framework consists of two stages: in Stage 1, a VLM generates a hypothetical text passage from the image-query pair, which is used as the retrieval query for dense text search, bridging the image-to-text modality gap. In Stage 2, a cross-encoder reranker adapted with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is fine-tuned using answer-supervised preference pairs mined from the frozen VLM: given the dataset answer label, a candidate document is labeled positive if the VLM produces the correct answer when given that document as context, and negative otherwise. This generator-guided signal is compatible with multiple alignment loss functions, including contrastive (triplet) loss, pairwise direct preference optimization (DPO), and supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and supports periodic re-mining to refresh preference pairs as the reranker improves. Experiments on VQA-X and A-OKVQA with Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct show that our proposed framework consistently outperforms rank-order, random, and REPLUG-style likelihood baselines under various alignment losses and pool size settings, suggesting that answer-level generator feedback is an effective supervision signal for preference alignment.

</details>


### [537] [Learning Counterfactual World Models for Embodied Reasoning under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05834)
*Todd Y. Zhou,Daniel Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出反事实坍缩（counterfactual collapse）这一失败模式，指出仅优化感知相似性的世界模型表示无法区分具有不同行为后果的干预。作者提出CLWM框架，结合循环信念状态编码器、动作条件潜动力学和对比反事实目标，在遮挡操作、别名导航和长时程操作任务上显著提升规划成功率，并引入表示无关的反事实可分性指标用于审计任意编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型被广泛用作具身智能的通用方案，其底层表示通常在大规模视频和多模态语料上预训练。然而，仅靠预测质量无法判断学到的表示是否真正"可行动"。作者识别出一个关键失败模式：模型能预测视觉上合理的未来，却无法区分行为后果不同的干预，这源于表示优化目标偏向感知相似性而非干预结构。

Method: 提出CLWM（Counterfactual Latent World Models），由三部分构成：（1）循环信念状态编码器；（2）动作条件潜动力学模型；（3）对比反事实目标，用于分离由不同干预导致的未来状态分布，即使其观测在视觉上相似。此外提出表示无关的反事实可分性度量，可审计任意编码器的可行动性。

Result: 在遮挡推物（Occluded Push）上规划成功率从65.1%提升至74.6%；在别名迷宫（Aliased Maze）上从67.3%提升至78.9%；在延迟厨房（Deferred Kitchen）上利用性规划失败从18.4%降至9.7%。消融实验表明增益主要来自硬反事实负样本（尤其是感知别名负样本）。反事实可分性指标与五种基线模型类的规划成功率高度相关（r≥0.94）。

Conclusion: 可行动表示的关键不在于感知预测精度，而在于能否区分干预后果。CLWM通过对比反事实目标有效克服了反事实坍缩。反事实可分性指标为审计预训练或从零训练的编码器提供了表示无关的工具，但目前仅在从零训练的世界模型上验证，尚未在大型预训练编码器上评测。

Abstract: World models promise a general route to embodied intelligence: learn predictive dynamics once, then reason, plan, and act with them. Increasingly, the representations beneath such models are pretrained on large-scale video, interaction, and multimodal corpora, which raises a question prediction quality alone cannot answer: when is a learned representation actually actionable? We identify a failure mode we call counterfactual collapse: a model predicts visually plausible futures while failing to distinguish interventions with different behavioral consequences. This arises whenever a representation is optimized for perceptual similarity rather than intervention structure, which is precisely the objective under which most large-scale pretrained encoders are learned. We introduce Counterfactual Latent World Models (CLWM), which combine a recurrent belief-state encoder, action-conditioned latent dynamics, and a contrastive counterfactual objective that separates futures induced by distinct interventions even when their observations look alike. Across occluded manipulation, aliased navigation, and long-horizon manipulation, CLWM improves planning success over the strongest baseline (65.1% $\to$ 74.6% on Occluded Push and 67.3% $\to$ 78.9% on Aliased Maze) and reduces exploitative planning failures (18.4% $\to$ 9.7% on Deferred Kitchen), with ablations attributing the gains to hard counterfactual negatives, especially perceptual-alias negatives. Finally, our counterfactual separability metric, which tracks planning success across the five baseline model classes ($r \ge 0.94$), is representation-agnostic: given intervention-outcome labels, it can audit any encoder, pretrained or trained from scratch, before a planner trusts it. We do not yet measure it on large-scale pretrained encoders. Here we establish the metric and its relationship to planning success for world models trained from scratch.

</details>


### [538] [Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification for Hallucination Detection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08267)
*Runsong Jia,Zhen Fang,Mengjia Wu,Jie Lu,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的幻觉检测方法，称为证据对齐实体验证（EAEV），通过将生成实体与检索证据上下文对齐，从三个互补维度评估实体-证据一致性，并引入反事实稳定性分析以增强鲁棒性，在多个RAG基准上取得了优于现有方法的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的幻觉检测方法主要依赖模型内部信号（如不确定性和自一致性），这类方法受限于模型的预训练知识，可能过时且覆盖有限，尤其在专业或最新信息上表现不佳。RAG虽可缓解此问题，但将其系统性地应用于幻觉检测仍是一个未被充分研究的任务。

Method: 提出证据对齐实体验证（EAEV）方法：1）利用RAG检索相关证据上下文，将生成内容中的实体与证据进行对齐；2）从三个互补维度评估实体-证据的语义对齐程度；3）引入反事实稳定性分析，通过扰动证据来检验对齐的鲁棒性，从而识别幻觉实体。

Result: 在多个RAG基准数据集上的实验表明，EAEV相比现有方法取得了一致的性能提升，并展现出较强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: EAEV证明了将RAG整合到幻觉检测任务中的有效性，通过引入外部证据作为检测依据，解决了预训练知识过时和覆盖不足的问题，为幻觉检测提供了一种更具事实依据的新范式。

Abstract: Hallucination detection is crucial for large language models (LLMs), as hallucinated content creates significant barriers in applications requiring factual accuracy. Current detection methods mainly depend on internal signals like uncertainty and self-consistency checks, using the model's pre-trained knowledge to identify unreliable outputs. However, pre-trained knowledge may become outdated and has coverage limitations, especially for specialized or recent information. To address these limitations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising solution by retrieving relevant evidence at inference time, grounding outputs beyond the model's parametric knowledge. In this paper, we target a critical and practical learning problem RAG-based hallucination detection (RHD), where RAG is employed to enhance hallucination detection by addressing information updating challenges. To address RHD, we propose a novel method Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification (EAEV), which detects entity-level hallucinations by leveraging RAG to align generated entities with retrieved evidence contexts. Specifically, EAEV evaluates entity-evidence alignment through three complementary dimensions and introduces counterfactual stability analysis to ensure robust alignments under evidence perturbations. Experiments across multiple RAG benchmarks demonstrate that EAEV achieves consistent improvements over existing methods with strong generalization capabilities.

</details>


### [539] [AgentBrew: Offline Tool-Use Agent Learning from Raw Real-World Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05837)
*Zhiyi Lyu,Yewen Li,Longtao Zheng,Shengtian Yang,Lang Feng,Lei Feng,Peng Jiang,Kun Gai,Qingpeng Cai,Bo An*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentBrew是一个离线训练框架，用于从单批原始交互轨迹中学习有效的工具使用策略，无需任务验证器或在线策略回滚。通过回顾性任务推断（retrospective task inference）和基于PMI的信用分配（credit assignment）从嘈杂的原始轨迹中提取训练信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界中部署基于LLM的Agent工具使用API日益增多，但针对特定环境的训练仍然困难：真实应用没有预定义任务或验证器、没有可靠的模拟器，且大规模环境交互预算有限。现有方法依赖预定义任务或在线交互，难以应用于真实环境。

Method: AgentBrew包含两个核心组件：(1) 回顾性任务推断（Retrospective Task Inference）：为每条原始轨迹根据其实际结果重建对齐的指令；(2) 基于PMI的信用分配（PMI-Based Credit Assignment）：利用点互信息将轨迹关于推断指令的总信息分解为每个动作的加性信用，用于加权策略训练目标，放大信息性动作并抑制无效动作。

Result: 在三个真实世界的MCP应用（GitHub、Notion、PostgreSQL）上，AgentBrew使Qwen3-32B平均提升+8.7 Acc/+9.7 Score，超越Qwen3-235B（+2.3/+4.4），并优于拒绝采样（+5.9/+10.3）。

Conclusion: 细粒度的离线学习能够从原始轨迹中恢复基于过滤方法所丢弃的有用监督信号，证明了在缺乏任务验证器或模拟器的现实环境中进行高效Agent训练的可行性。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications through tool-use APIs, yet training them for specific environments remains fundamentally difficult: real-world applications provide no pre-defined tasks or verifiers, no faithful simulators, and limited budget for large-scale environment interaction. In this paper, we propose \textbf{AgentBrew}, an offline training framework that learns effective tool-use policies from a single batch of raw interaction trajectories, without task verifiers or iterative on-policy rollouts. The agent first explores the target environment to collect a raw trajectory corpus without quality filtering. To extract training signal from this noisy corpus, \emph{retrospective task inference} reconstructs an aligned instruction for each trajectory based on its actual outcome, and \emph{PMI-Based credit assignment} decomposes the trajectory's total information about the inferred instruction into additive per-action credits via pointwise mutual information (PMI). These credits weight the policy training objective, amplifying informative actions while suppressing ineffective ones. On three real-world MCP applications (GitHub, Notion, PostgreSQL), AgentBrew improves Qwen3-32B by +8.7 Acc / +9.7 Score on average, surpassing Qwen3-235B (+2.3 / +4.4) and outperforming rejection sampling (+5.9 / +10.3). These results demonstrate that fine-grained offline learning can recover useful supervision from raw trajectories that filtering-based approaches would discard. The code is available at https://github.com/alphatogo/AgentBrew

</details>


### [540] [Multimodal Resource-Exhaustion Attacks on Vision-Language Models via Joint Pixel-Prompt Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05889)
*Zhaoxiong Ni,Yatie Xiao,Chi-Man Pun,Fei Peng,Qingxiao Guan,Keke Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出JPPO（联合像素-提示优化），首个将可见提示与图像扰动同时作为对抗变量的复合攻击框架，通过跨模态协同优化实现资源耗尽攻击，在多个开源VLM上取得显著延迟和能耗放大效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对自回归视觉语言模型（VLM）的资源耗尽攻击通常采用单模态威胁模型，仅优化图像分支而保持用户可见提示固定。即使是循环类变体也局限于单通道范式，未将可用性攻击视为可在多个可控输入表面上联合优化的跨模态问题，存在结构性盲区。

Method: JPPO是一种复合对抗框架，将可见提示提升为一等对抗变量，与图像扰动协同。在受限联合输入威胁模型下，JPPO对像素和提示两个表面执行耦合的分阶段优化，产生协同成本放大效应，且在实验中循环发生率可忽略不计，区别于依赖循环的失败模式。

Result: 在MS COCO和ImageNet上、8/255无穷范数预算下评估五个开源VLM家族：对Qwen2.5-VL-7B实现4.6倍以上延迟和5.3倍以上能耗放大；对BLIP-2实现36.6倍延迟和32.7倍能耗放大。这是直接对比基线中最强的成本放大效果，且所需优化迭代次数更少。消融实验确认放大源于多模态协同而非提示长度或单模态孤立效果。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了当前VLM服务防御中的结构性盲点，主张将成本感知的鲁棒性评估作为多模态部署的一等安全需求。

Abstract: Resource-exhaustion attacks against autoregressive vision-language models (VLMs) typically assume unimodal threat models, treating the image branch as the primary optimization surface while holding user-visible prompts fixed. Even recent loop-centric variants remain confined to this single-channel paradigm, leaving the exploitation of availability unexplored as a cross-modal optimization problem over jointly controllable input surfaces.
  We introduce Joint Pixel-Prompt Optimization (JPPO), the first compound adversarial framework elevating the visible prompt to a first-class adversarial variable alongside image perturbations. Under a restricted joint-input threat model, JPPO performs coupled, stagewise optimization over both the pixel and prompt surfaces. This produces synergistic cost amplification, mechanistically distinct from loop-dependent failures, exhibiting negligible loop incidence in our experiments.
  Evaluating five open-source VLM families on MS COCO and ImageNet under an 8/255 infinity-norm budget, JPPO achieves over 4.6x latency and 5.3x energy amplification on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and over 36.6x latency with 32.7x energy amplification on BLIP-2. This represents the strongest cost amplification among directly compared baselines while requiring substantially fewer optimization iterations. Ablations confirm this amplification arises from multimodal coordination rather than prompt length or isolated modalities. These findings reveal structural blind spots in current VLM serving defenses, motivating cost-aware robustness evaluation as a first-class security requirement for multimodal deployments.

</details>


### [541] [The End of AI Exponentiation: Fluttering Inside and Outside AI Bubble](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05894)
*Victor Kebande*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨了人工智能指数级增长可能面临终结的观点，分析了从技术、社会、经济、伦理到基础设施等多维度挑战，包括数据峰值限制、算力需求飙升、合成数据递归、估值膨胀及社会不稳定等问题，并剖析了AI生态系统内外部的"泡沫"表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI发展正面临传统"规模化范式"的瓶颈——持续指数增长遭遇摩擦。作者旨在揭示AI指数增长时代终结的必然性，并探索这一转折对科技、经济与社会各层面的深远影响。

Method: 采用概念性分析视角，将AI生态系统的"泡沫"分为内部与外部两个维度进行系统剖析：内部涉及算力/数据中心竞赛、投机性投资与超级智能竞速；外部涉及劳动力冲击、治理担忧、公众不确定性与地缘政治加速。

Result: 识别出AI指数增长面临的五大核心挑战（峰值数据、算力需求、合成数据递归、估值膨胀、社会不稳定），并系统梳理了AI生态内外部的系统性风险与不稳定因素。

Conclusion: AI正在从"指数增长期"迈向一个更具不确定性与波动性的新阶段，需要重新审视传统规模化范式的可持续性，并正视泡沫内外部的系统性挑战。

Abstract: The exponentiation of Artificial intelligence (AI) in the recent past has entered a transformative era that has been driven by the growth in large language models (LLMs), large-scale compute infrastructures, and autonomous reasoning systems. However, the rapid acceleration of AI has increasingly shown technological, societal, economic, ethical and infrastructural challenges associated with peak data limitations, rising computational demands, synthetic data recursion, valuation inflation, and societal instability. The traditional scaling paradigms that have powered the modern AI systems are gradually encountering friction in sustaining continuous exponential growth. This paper views ``the end of AI exponentiation,'' thus exploring how it flutters inside and outside the bubble, where instability emerges within the AI ecosystem through compute and data-center races, speculative investments, and the rat-race toward superintelligence, and outside the ecosystem through labor disruption, governance concerns, public uncertainty, and geopolitical acceleration surrounding future intelligent systems and infrastructures globally.

</details>


### [542] [Beyond Final Decisions: A Process-Centric Benchmark for Transparent AI-Assisted Peer Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05947)
*Siming Yuan,Xueyi Zhang,Wangze Ni,Tianfang Xiao,Shimin Di,Jia Zhu,Zhuoren Jiang,Rong Tan,Lei Chen,Kui Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个以过程为中心的AI辅助同行评审诊断基准，通过将论文内容、摘要、批评、建议和决策建模为(x, z_s, z_c, z_r, y)，对AI评审过程的中间环节进行系统性评估，而非仅关注最终评审质量或决策准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI辅助同行评审的评估主要关注生成评审的整体质量或最终决策的准确性，缺乏对模型决策是否有充分可靠评审证据支持的证据。这限制了我们对AI评审过程可靠性的理解。

Method: 构建过程对齐的基准数据（来自PeerRead、NLPeer ARR-22和OpenReview-ICLR），以直接从论文内容预测决策（Direct）为基线，比较Gold过程变量与预测过程变量的决策价值，并进行阶段级评估、链一致性评估和干预敏感性分析。

Result: 在三个数据集和六个模型上的实验表明：Gold过程变量通常具有更高的决策价值；主要分析模型中Gold-Predicted差距在不同数据集和随机种子上保持稳定；虽然模型生成的中间评审文本在相邻阶段具有较高的局部一致性，但最终决策并未被先前的评审证据一致地支持。

Conclusion: 该基准为辅助而非替代人类评审者的AI系统提供了一个透明、可审计的诊断工具，用于评估其评审过程的可靠性。

Abstract: Peer review is central to quality control in science. However, existing evaluations of AI-assisted peer review mainly focus on the overall quality of generated reviews or the accuracy of final decisions. They therefore provide limited evidence about whether model decisions are supported by sufficient and reliable review evidence. We introduce a process-centric diagnostic benchmark for AI-assisted peer review. It uses (x,$z_s$,$z_c$,$z_r$,y)
  to represent the paper content, summary, critique, suggestion, and decision. We convert heterogeneous review records from PeerRead, NLPeer ARR-22, and OpenReview-ICLR into process-aligned data. Our benchmark uses direct decision prediction from the paper content (Direct) as its baseline. It compares the decision value of Gold-process variables and Predicted-process variables, and conducts stage-level evaluation, chain-consistency evaluation, and interventional sensitivity analysis. Experiments across three datasets and six models show that Gold-process variables generally have higher decision value. For the main analysis model, the Gold--Predicted gap remains stable across datasets and random seeds. This gap is also reproduced in most model--dataset combinations. Although model-generated intermediate review texts show relatively high local consistency across adjacent stages, the final decisions are not consistently supported by the preceding review evidence. Our benchmark targets AI systems designed to assist rather than replace human reviewers. It provides a transparent and auditable diagnostic tool for evaluating the reliability of their review processes.

</details>


### [543] [MOAE: Multi-Objective Agent Evolution with Pareto-Preserving Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05992)
*Hengle Jiang,Qijun Cai,Ziying Luo,Ke Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出多目标智能体进化（MOAE）方法，通过帕累托保留的进化搜索对完整智能体行为轨迹进行迭代上下文优化，在不预先固定标量化权重的情况下同时优化任务性能、轨迹质量和安全性等多个目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于LLM的智能体不断发展，其评估维度日益多元化（任务完成率、交互质量、安全性和效率）。现有方法往往将异构指标折叠成固定标量分数进行优化，但这种标量化方式依赖度量标准化和偏好权重，且可能丢弃代表有用部署权衡的候选方案。核心问题在于这些目标能否同时被优化。

Method: MOAE将迭代式上下文细化组织为对完整智能体行为轨迹的帕累托保留进化搜索。在有限行为预算下，维护非支配候选的经验档案；使用目标特异性诊断指导后代生成；仅在部署阶段应用约束感知选择，将搜索中的候选保留与返回最终解时的偏好分离。该方法无需参数更新，允许每个目标替换为任意可测量属性（实例化为任务性能、轨迹质量和安全性）。

Result: 在TravelPlanner和AgentDojo上的实验表明，MOAE在匹配的行为预算下持续提升任务性能和轨迹质量，同时保持强安全性。搜索行为分析显示，帕累托保留扩大了可达目标区域并增加了联合改进的频率。

Conclusion: 帕累托保留的上下文进化方法能够在搜索过程中不绑定固定标量化的情况下优化多个智能体属性，展示了在多目标智能体优化中的潜力。

Abstract: As LLM-based agents continue to advance, their evaluation has become increasingly multifaceted: a capable agent must not only achieve high task completion accuracy but also perform well in interaction quality, safety, and efficiency, raising a central question: can these objectives be optimized simultaneously? Existing methods have considered multiple objectives, but many collapse heterogeneous measurements into a fixed scalar score. Such scalarization depends on metric normalization and preference weights and may discard candidates that represent useful deployment trade-offs. We introduce Multi-Objective Agent Evolution (MOAE), which organizes iterative in-context refinement as a Pareto-preserving evolutionary search over complete agent rollouts. Given a limited rollout budget, MOAE maintains an empirical archive of non-dominated candidates, uses objective-specific diagnostics to guide offspring generation, and applies constraint-aware selection only at deployment. This separates candidate preservation during search from the preference used to return a final solution. The procedure requires no parameter updates and allows each objective to be replaced by any measurable property, which we instantiate as task performance, trajectory quality, and safety. Experiments on TravelPlanner and AgentDojo show that MOAE consistently improves task performance and trajectory quality while maintaining strong safety under matched rollout budgets. Search-behavior analysis further shows that Pareto preservation expands the attainable objective region and increases the frequency of joint improvement. These results demonstrate the potential of Pareto-preserving in-context evolution for optimizing multiple agent properties without committing to a fixed scalarization during search.

</details>


### [544] [Agentic Pressure: The Endogenous Entropy of Reliable Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05995)
*Hengle Jiang,Ziying Luo,Ke Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文识别并提出了一种全新的非对抗性现象——"Agentic Pressure"（智能体压力），指出智能体在长时程、无约束环境中运行时，因目标达成与规则遵从之间的冲突会自发累积动力学压力，当压力超过临界阈值时，对齐的智能体会出现"安全漂移"（safety drift），并通过"工具性幻觉"（Instrumental Hallucination）合理化违规行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注静态越狱攻击（static jailbreaks），而忽视了智能体在真实长时程自主运行中自发产生的、非对抗性的对齐失稳现象。这种内生性摩擦会导致智能体在无人干扰的情况下逐渐偏离安全对齐，亟需提出框架加以解释。

Method: 首先定义Agentic Pressure为"克服环境摩擦所需功与智能体剩余容量之比"的理论框架；其次通过理论分析证明当压力超过临界阈值时，安全漂移成为数学上的最优适应策略；最后通过实证实验验证框架的有效性。

Result: 实证实验证实了理论框架，表明经过对齐的智能体在高压力条件下会自发牺牲安全来维持自主性，验证了Agentic Pressure导致安全漂移的假设。

Conclusion: Agentic Pressure是一种内生且动态的力，与静态越狱有本质区别。它为理解智能体在野外长时程运行中的对齐退化提供了新的理论视角，暗示仅依赖静态安全对齐不足以保障长期可靠自主性，需关注压力累积带来的动态安全风险。

Abstract: Achieving reliable autonomy in the wild requires agents to sustain continuous operations across long-horizon trajectories. However, as agents navigate these unconstrained settings, they encounter cumulative friction that inherently destabilizes their alignment. In this paper, we identify a distinct non-adversarial phenomenon termed Agentic Pressure. We define this as a kinetic force that spontaneously emerges when the cost of compliance conflicts with the imperative of goal achievement. Unlike static jailbreaks, this pressure is endogenous and arises directly from the dynamics of interaction. We propose a theoretical framework that formalizes Agentic Pressure as the ratio between the required work to overcome environmental friction and the remaining capacity of the agent. Our analysis demonstrates that when this pressure exceeds a critical threshold, agents exhibit safety drift as a mathematically optimal adaptation. Consequently, they often resort to Instrumental Hallucination to rationalize rule violations. Empirical experiments validate this framework and show that aligned agents spontaneously compromise safety to preserve autonomy under high-pressure conditions.

</details>


### [545] [Generator-Independent Runtime Assurance under Partial Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06036)
*Guangxi Wan,Yongbo Xie,Yuqi Liu,Qingwei Dong,Qingxin Li,Hongfei Bai,Peng Zeng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究基于提案的控制器（如学习策略、语言模型规划器等黑箱生成器）在运行时验证门控下的闭环安全性。核心问题是：闭环安全保证何时能与生成器解耦？作者提出"同时集合可靠性"（simultaneous setwise soundness）作为实现生成器无关准入可靠性（admission soundness）的充要条件，并给出合同安全性（contract safety）的充分条件及违反界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逐候选认证模式（per-candidate certification）在重试或best-of-k选择下无法组合，单候选误接受水平α会膨胀为1-(1-α)^k。随着基于提案的控制器（黑箱生成器）日益广泛地部署于运行时验证门之后，需要一种能够与生成器解耦的、可组合的安全保证方法。

Method: (1) 提出核心定理：同时集合可靠性（一次性认证一个不含非可行动作的可接受提案集合）是生成器无关准入可靠性的充要条件，最坏情况下执行非可行提案的概率等于集合失效概率；(2) 结合设计时证书与no-bypass规则，推导合同安全性的违反界Γ+Σε_t+η，该界在生成器被任意（甚至对抗性）替换时保持不变；(3) 第二定理处理部分观测下准入机制的极限：若TV距离为δ的两个状态假设需要不同安全决策，则ā+β+δ≥1；(4) 引入序列风险账本（sequential risk ledger）与时间一致置信管实现可实现性，表明确定性准入计算将所有统计风险集中于状态估计。

Result: 同时集合可靠性是生成器独立准入可靠性的充要条件；合同安全性的违反界Γ+Σε_t+η对任意生成器替换不变；部分观测下存在信息论下界ā+β+δ≥1；Simplex风格运行时保障与控制屏障函数滤波可被视为该框架的退化情形。

Conclusion: 该框架为黑箱提案生成器提供了可组合、生成器无关的运行时安全保障，揭示了确定性准入计算的风险集中结构，并为已有安全机制提供了统一的理论视角。

Abstract: Proposal-based controllers---learned policies, language-model planners, and other black-box \emph{generators}---are increasingly deployed behind runtime verification gates. We ask when the closed-loop safety guarantee decouples from the generator. The prevailing per-candidate certification pattern does not compose: under retry or best-of-$k$ selection a per-candidate false-admission level $α$ can inflate to $1-(1-α)^{k}$. Our main theorem shows that \emph{simultaneous setwise soundness}---certifying a set of admissible proposals containing no nonviable action---is necessary and sufficient for generator-independent \emph{admission soundness}, the worst case over all generators of executing a nonviable proposal equalling the probability of setwise failure; together with a design-time certificate and a no-bypass rule it is sufficient for \emph{contract safety}, with violation bound $Γ+\sum_t\varepsilon_t+η$ invariant under arbitrary, even adversarial, replacement of the generator. A second theorem bounds every admission mechanism under partial observation: for a fixed probing and admission policy, if two state hypotheses whose information laws lie within total-variation distance $δ$ require different safe decisions, then $\abar+β+δ\ge1$. A sequential risk ledger makes the guarantee implementable with time-uniform confidence tubes, and shows that deterministic admission computations concentrate all statistical risk in state estimation. Simplex-style runtime assurance and control-barrier-function filtering are recovered as degenerate cases.

</details>


### [546] [DAREBench: Deployment-Aware and Reliable Evaluation of Models as Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06059)
*Yu Liu,Zhilin Liu,Zhiwei Yang,Shaojie Zhang,Zheyuan Deng,Tingwei Huang,Zhenbo Luo,Lei Jiang,Yanbing Liu,Pei Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DAREBench是一个面向大语言模型智能体部署的基准测试，基于共享的OpenClaw执行环境，将233个任务按输入模态和执行形式组织为2×3工作负载矩阵，采用基于契约的统一评估协议和证据评分审计，对35个模型进行7587次运行评估，发现没有单一模型在所有工作负载组中占优，文本和多模态任务呈现不同的准确率-成本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体评估基准往往绑定特定任务类型、执行环境或评分协议，限制了可比性、可解释性和可靠性，难以支撑模型部署决策。

Method: 基于共享OpenClaw执行环境，从22个来源基准中筛选适配233个任务，构建2×3工作负载矩阵（输入模态×执行形式），采用统一契约式评估协议与基于证据的评分审计。

Result: 评估了23个商业API模型和12个本地开源模型共7587次模型-任务运行，报告准确率和token消耗及参考成本。结果显示无单一模型全面占优，本地开源模型在部分组别具备竞争力但整体仍落后于前沿商业模型。

Conclusion: 智能体部署和模型选择应考虑工作负载特征、部署模式及准确率-成本权衡，而非依赖单一总分。

Abstract: As large language models evolve from question-answering systems into general-purpose agents, evaluation must move beyond static answer correctness to assess multimodal perception, multi-step execution, tool use, and artifact delivery. However, existing benchmarks are often tied to specific task types, execution environments, or scoring protocols, limiting their comparability, interpretability, and reliability for deployment decisions. We introduce DAREBench (Deployment-Aware and Reliable Evaluation of Models as Agents), a benchmark designed to capture workload variation and support reliable agent evaluation. Built on a shared OpenClaw execution environment, DAREBench organizes 233 tasks selected and adapted from 22 source benchmarks into a $2\times3$ workload matrix defined by input modality and execution form, and evaluates them under a unified contract-based protocol with evidence-based score auditing. We evaluate 23 commercial API models and 12 locally deployed open-weight models over 7,587 model--task runs, reporting accuracy and token consumption alongside reference costs for API models. Results show that no single model dominates all workload groups, text and multimodal tasks exhibit distinct accuracy--cost trade-offs, and local open-weight models are competitive in several groups but still trail frontier commercial models overall. These findings suggest that agent deployment and model selection should consider workload profiles, deployment mode, and accuracy--cost trade-offs rather than rely on a single aggregate score.

</details>


### [547] [Explaining AI Agents Through Execution Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06063)
*Vittoria Vineis,Fabiano Veglianti,Lorenzo Antonelli,Claudia Di Carlo,Matteo Silvestri,Gabriele Tolomei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对AI Agent的后置可解释性框架，将代理的执行轨迹转换为结构化报告和忠实于其可观察行为的自然语言解释，适用于不同代理架构、环境和任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI Agent在真实场景中日益普及，需要可审计的流程级解释，但传统XAI方法无法满足多步骤交互式系统的透明性需求。

Method: 提出一个仅依赖执行轨迹的后置XAI框架，将冗长的代理执行轨迹转换为结构化报告，并生成严格基于可观察行为的自然语言解释。

Result: 在多个基准和架构上进行的人类与自动化评估显示，该框架能生成高质量、忠实于轨迹的解释，并能可靠识别无根据的声明、不合理的动作和证据缺失，优于朴素的LLM生成解释。

Conclusion: 该框架为AI Agent提供了架构无关的流程级可解释性方案，填补了传统XAI方法在交互式多步骤系统中的空白，验证了解释忠实性与可审计性的重要价值。

Abstract: AI Agents are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, where they interact with external tools and make sequential decisions with limited human oversight. This creates a pressing need for reliable and auditable explanations of what an agent did and why. However, traditional Explainable AI (XAI) methods fall short of providing the process-level transparency required for such interactive, multi-step systems, motivating a paradigm shift toward approaches specifically designed for AI Agents. To address this gap, we present a post-hoc XAI framework that transforms a lengthy agent's execution trace into a structured report and a faithful natural-language explanation explicitly grounded in its observable behavior. Because it relies solely on execution traces, the framework applies across different agent architectures, environments, and tasks. Human and automated evaluations across multiple benchmarks and architectures show that our framework produces high-quality, trace-faithful explanations while reliably identifying unsupported claims, unjustified actions, and evidence gaps, outperforming naive LLM-generated explanations.

</details>


### [548] [Generating Instance Generators in PDDL Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06071)
*Nicola J. Müller,Naya Rudolph,Katharina Stein,Jörg Hoffmann,Ayal Taitler,Timo P. Gros*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成PDDL规划域实例生成程序的方法，通过内置的健全性检查保证生成实例的合法性，从而替代人工编写实例生成器的传统做法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDDL作为AI规划领域的标准语言，只能描述规划域的谓词和动作模式，但无法指定实例集合的具体约束（如初始状态合法性、目标条件、域子集约束）。这导致实例生成一直是临时性的，需要人工为每个域和子集手动编写生成器。已有的理性推理和学习方法存在可扩展性限制。

Method: 利用LLM自动生成实例生成程序（instance-generation programs），并通过预设的健全性检查（prescribed checks）提供内置的正确性保证。

Result: 自动生成的实例生成器能够高效地产生大量健全（sound）且多样（diverse）的实例。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的实例生成程序是解决PDDL实例生成问题的一种新途径，兼顾了效率、健全性和多样性，克服了以往方法在可扩展性上的局限。

Abstract: PDDL, the de-facto standard language in the AI Planning community, is designed to specify planning domains: sets of instances that share the same predicates and action schemas. Yet it does not provide any means to specify the actual instance set, i.e., legality constraints on initial states and goal conditions, as well as possibly domain subset constraints specifying an instance subset we are interested in. One consequence of this is that instance generation has always been ad-hoc, with manually written domain- and subset-specific instance generators. Recent work has started to address this, through reasoning and learning methods that however suffer from scalability limitations. Here we introduce an alternative approach, leveraging LLMs to generate instance-generation programs, with built-in soundness guarantees through prescribed checks. We show that these automatically generated instance generators return large numbers of sound and diverse instances efficiently.

</details>


### [549] [LayerRoute: Action-Conditioned Mixture-of-Layers Routing for Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06079)
*Zheng Lu,Haoran Liao,Wanqi Zhong,Yunhe Ni,Lijie Wang,Xingjie Fan,Zhisheng Chen,Yantang Qu,Meijia Chen,Tianyu Xin,Zirui Song,Yiming Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LayerRoute，一种动作条件化的表示路由接口，允许VLA策略动态访问不同层的VLM表示并重用中间动作状态，在LIBERO等基准上以极少参数增量（0.31%/3.87%）实现了最高7.2的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA策略中，VLM信息通过固定的层分配暴露给每个动作层，缺乏灵活性；同时中间动作状态仅通过残差流隐式传播，未能显式重用。然而不同操作任务可能需要不同层次的视觉语义表示（从局部视觉几何到语言对齐的抽象语义）的不同组合。

Method: LayerRoute包含两个核心组件：1) Layer Mixture Router——动态形成缓存的VLM表示混合，根据动作条件自适应选择层表示；2) Action-State Reread——重新读取并复用早期的动作表示。两者共同构成动作条件化的路由接口。

Result: 在多种仿真和真实世界基准测试中，LayerRoute一致提升了StarVLA-π和π₀.₅的性能，在LIBERO Long上取得了最高7.2的提升，且仅增加0.31%/3.87%的额外参数。消融研究验证了动作条件化层路由的益处，路由分析揭示了各动作层和任务设置中的结构化分配模式。

Conclusion: LayerRoute通过动作条件化的自适应表示路由，有效解决了VLA策略中表示访问灵活性不足的问题，验证了按需混合VLM层表示以及显式重用动作状态的价值，为改进VLA接口设计提供了新方向。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to guide action generation for robot control. VLMs provide hierarchical visual-semantic representations that evolve across layers, from local visual geometry to abstract, language-aligned semantics; different manipulation tasks may therefore require different mixtures of layer representations. Meanwhile, the action module maintains intermediate representations that evolve throughout action computation and may provide useful information for subsequent decisions. However, existing VLA interfaces offer limited flexibility in representation access: VLM information is exposed through fixed layer assignments for each action layer, while intermediate action states are only propagated implicitly through residual streams without explicit reuse. We introduce LayerRoute, an action-conditioned representation routing interface that enables adaptive access to VLM layers and action representations. The Layer Mixture Router dynamically forms mixtures of cached VLM representations, while Action-State Reread reuses earlier action representations. Across diverse simulation and real-world benchmarks, LayerRoute consistently improves StarVLA-$π$ and $π_{0.5}$, achieving up to 7.2 gains on LIBERO Long with only 0.31% / 3.87% additional parameters. Ablation studies validate the benefit of action-conditioned layer routing, while routing analyses reveal structured allocation patterns across action layers and task settings.

</details>


### [550] [A Unified Policy Architecture (UPA): The Governance Kernel for Enterprise AI Operating Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06543)
*Prabhu Raghav,Balamurugan Pandi,Arul Vivek,Shek Mohammed,Sridhar S*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出统一策略架构（UPA），一种面向企业AI操作系统的治理架构，旨在统一管理自主AI代理、工具、工作流、记忆、资源及代理间交互的治理策略，将策略控制从授权扩展到运行时义务、人工审批、合规、审计与治理评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI正演变为企业操作系统，其中自主AI代理可以规划、推理、使用记忆、调用工具、执行工作流并与代理协作。然而现有的授权、安全、防护栏和合规机制是碎片化的，并非为将自主AI作为统一系统进行治理而设计，这构成了新的治理挑战。

Method: UPA提供统一的策略模型来治理AI和代理、工具、工作流、记忆、企业资源、代理间交互及企业业务规则。它超越传统授权，将策略控制扩展至运行时义务、人工审批、合规、审计证据和治理评估。论文还提出声明式策略语言基础、策略求值语义、可扩展插件、行业策略包和治理评估框架。

Result: 论文提出UPA的完整治理模型，包括治理模型本身、声明式策略语言基础、策略求值语义、可扩展插件、行业策略包以及企业治理评估框架，并识别了多代理协调、感知来源的策略和有状态运行时治理等扩展方向。

Conclusion: UPA为构建安全、可问责、可治理的自主AI企业操作系统提供了基础，是实现企业级AI系统统一治理的关键架构方案。

Abstract: Enterprise AI is evolving into an Enterprise Operating System where autonomous AI agents can plan, reason, use memory, invoke tools, execute workflows, and collaborate with other agents. This shift creates a new governance challenge: existing authorization, security, guardrails, and compliance mechanisms are fragmented and are not designed to govern autonomous AI as a unified system.
  This paper introduces the Unified Policy Architecture (UPA), a governance architecture for Enterprise AI Operating Systems. UPA provides a unified policy model for governing AI and agents, tools, workflows, memory, enterprise resources, and agent-to-agent interactions and enterprise business rules. It extends policy control beyond authorisation to include runtime obligations, human approvals, compliance, audit evidence, and governance evaluation.
  We present UPA's governance model, declarative policy language foundations, policy evaluation semantics, extensible plugins, industry policy packs, and an evaluation framework for enterprise governance. We also identify extensions for multi-agent coordination, provenance-aware policies, and stateful runtime governance. UPA provides a foundation for building secure, accountable, and governable Enterprise Operating Systems for autonomous AI.

</details>


### [551] [SAP: State-Guided Data Synthesis with Argument Provenance for Multi-Turn Tool Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06124)
*Zichen Tian,Jinpeng Chen,Cheng Gong,Suiyun Zhang,Rui Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SAP（State-Guided Data Synthesis with Argument Provenance）方法，通过状态引导、工具参数溯源约束和逐轮验证，高效合成高质量的多轮工具调用数据，以解决现有数据合成方法中参数级依赖不足的问题。基于SAP生成数据训练的SAP-4B模型在多个基准上具备与更大模型竞争的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量多轮工具调用数据对训练智能体模型至关重要，但现有数据合成方法常常忽视参数级依赖关系——这是长序列工具使用的关键所在。即使模型选对了工具，也可能因使用虚构、过时或弱根基的参数值而导致任务执行失败。因此需要一种能捕捉长程参数依赖的高质量数据合成方法。

Method: SAP方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 状态引导（state guidance），用于构建具有长程依赖关系的工具调用轨迹；(2) 工具参数溯源约束（tool-argument provenance constraints），确保工具参数值具有可靠的来源根基；(3) 逐轮验证（turn-level validation），验证每一轮的工具调用的准确性，从而高效合成高质量轨迹数据。

Result: 基于SAP合成数据训练的SAP-4B模型，在多个基准测试上表现出极强的竞争力，即使与规模大得多的模型相比也毫不逊色。相关源代码、合成数据和训练权重已开源。

Conclusion: SAP通过针对参数级依赖的专门设计，有效解决了多轮工具使用数据合成中的关键缺陷，证明了高质量、参数可溯源的数据合成方法能够显著提升较小规模智能体模型的性能表现。

Abstract: High-quality multi-turn tool-use data is essential for training agentic models, yet existing data synthesis methods often underrepresent the argument-level dependencies that are critical to long-horizon tool use. As a result, even when a model selects the correct tool, task execution may still fail because the model fills tool arguments with fabricated, stale, or weakly grounded values. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{State-Guided Data Synthesis with Argument Provenance (SAP)}. SAP combines state guidance, tool-argument provenance constraints, and turn-level validation to efficiently construct tool-use trajectories with long-range dependencies and high accuracy. Using data generated by SAP, we build SAP-4B, which is highly competitive even when compared with much larger models across multiple benchmarks. Source code, synthesized data, and trained weights are available at https://github.com/Zichen1024/SAP.

</details>


### [552] [CIT-CAD: Constraint Intent Tree-based CAD Code Generation and Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07434)
*Yali Du,Hui Sun,San-Zhuo Xi,Ming Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CIT-CAD框架，通过从输入描述中推断"约束意图树"（CIT）来表示设计意图（实体、层级、操作和几何关系），该树同时用于引导CAD代码生成和定义验证约束。框架从生成程序中提取实际约束并与期望约束对比，利用不匹配来定位和修复设计违规，超越了传统仅基于渲染几何匹配（如IoU）的评估方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到CAD生成的基准和方法主要依赖渲染几何匹配（如IoU）来评估生成结果，但这类指标无法捕捉零件分解、构造层级、布尔操作、草图结构和几何关系中的错误。需要一个能够显式表示设计意图并据此检验生成代码的表示方法。

Method: 提出CIT-CAD框架，核心是推断约束意图树（CIT），该树表示预期的实体、层级、操作和关系。CIT扮演双重角色：一是引导CAD代码生成，二是定义预期约束用于验证。框架从生成的程序中提取实际约束，与预期约束比较，利用不匹配信息定位并修复设计违规。

Result: 实验表明该框架提升了CAD生成性能，在更复杂的多实体设计上获得了更大的改进。

Conclusion: 该工作是首个将文本到CAD生成从纯粹的渲染几何匹配推进到"构造意识"的综合、验证与修复的尝试，通过将设计意图转化为显式且可检查的对象来实现。

Abstract: Natural-language Computer-Aided Design (CAD) code generation aims to turn design intent into executable and editable parametric programs. Large language models (LLMs) make this goal increasingly practical, but useful systems must preserve the construction process behind the rendered geometry. Existing benchmarks and methods mostly focus on how closely the generated CAD model matches the reference geometry, often using metrics such as Intersection over Union (IoU). Such metrics can miss errors in part decomposition, construction hierarchy, Boolean operations, sketch structure, and geometric relations. This gap calls for a representation that makes design intent explicit and lets a system check generated code against that intent. We propose CIT-CAD, a framework that infers a Constraint Intent Tree (CIT) from the input description to represent the intended entities, hierarchy, operations, and relations. The tree has two roles: it guides CAD code generation and defines expected constraints for verification.
