The framework extracts actual constraints from the generated program, compares them with the expected constraints, and uses mismatches to localize and repair design violations. Experiments show that the framework improves CAD generation performance, with larger gains on more complex multi-entity designs. By turning design intent into an explicit and checkable object, this work is the first attempt to move text-to-CAD generation beyond rendered-geometry matching toward construction-aware synthesis, verification, and repair.

</details>


### [553] [CWF: A Collaborative Writing Framework for Personalized and Reliable Popular Science Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06126)
*Ruibiao Fu,Di Tang,Yunlong Yang,Ran Wang,Sicheng Lu,Peixuan Wu,Xiaoyu Fan,Jiacheng Ma,HaoZhe Luo,Yang Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"个性化可靠科普写作"新任务，构建了含39,134条数据的PSCB基准，并提出DA-MoE模型与多智能体事实核查机制，在兼顾受众个性化适配与事实准确性的前提下取得SOTA效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科普写作需针对不同认知水平受众进行个性化改编，但增强个性化常引入简化，导致幻觉与事实扭曲风险上升；已有方法缺乏联合评估受众适配与事实准确性的基准，且数据与计算成本高、泛化能力有限。

Method: 1) 构建39,134条条目的数据集及读者中心的PSCB基准；2) 提出DA-MoE，通过分离建模将受众适配与领域知识解耦，降低数据与计算需求并提升跨域泛化；3) 提出多智能体事实核查机制，在证据稀缺场景下通过角色专属智能体辩论增强证据，并在图上传播置信度以支持鲁棒验证与修订。

Result: 在PSCB基准上的实验表明，该方法取得了最先进的性能（SOTA），验证了其在个性化适配与事实准确性联合优化方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 个性化与可靠性可以在科普写作中联合实现；DA-MoE的解耦建模与多智能体核查机制为证据稀缺场景下的可信科普生成提供了有效方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: We introduce Personalized and Reliable Popular Science Writing, a novel task that requires adapting scientific explanations to audiences with different cognitive levels while preserving factual accuracy. However, improving personalization often introduces simplifications that increase the risk of hallucination and factual distortion. To address these challenges, we first construct a dataset of 39,134 entries and a reader-centric Personalized Science Communication Benchmark (PSCB) that jointly evaluates audience adaptation and factual accuracy. To reduce data and computational requirements while improving generalization across domains and audiences, we introduce DA-MoE, which explicitly decouples audience adaptation from domain knowledge through separate modeling. To enable robust verification and revision in evidence-scarce scenarios, a multi-agent fact-checking mechanism that augments limited evidence with role-specific agent debate and propagates confidence over a graph is proposed. Experiments on PSCB show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/DPInnovationWorks/CWF.

</details>


### [554] [A Tool-Augmented, GPT-4 Chatbot for Real-Time Repository Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07586)
*Muhammad Jawad Chowdhury,Md. Sakib Khan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于GPT-4的新型聊天机器人架构，用于自动提取和分析软件仓库数据。该架构首先解析用户查询以提取相关参数，然后选择正确的工具，最后调用GPT-4生成详细回复。与基于嵌入模型和文档检索器的多组件系统不同，该架构反转了流程，依赖提示工程和工具选择来匹配查询意图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件仓库包含大量代码贡献、缺陷报告和项目活动数据，但由于查询仓库所需的专业知识有限，非技术利益相关者和开发者难以访问这些信息。

Method: 提出一种结构化路径的聊天机器人架构：(1) 解析用户查询提取相关参数；(2) 基于分析选择正确的工具；(3) 调用GPT-4模型生成详细响应。该架构依赖提示工程和工具选择，而非传统的嵌入模型与文档检索器组合。

Result: 在多种问题类型（包括Issues、Pull Requests、Commits、复合问题和一般仓库信息）上进行了实验，验证了目标提示在提高模型回复准确性方面的能力。

Conclusion: 该架构能够使仓库数据对技术和非技术受众更加可访问，通过生成可操作的见解，证明了其对多样化用户群体的实用性。

Abstract: Software repositories contain vast amounts of data on code contributions, bug reports, and project activities, yet this information remains challenging for non-technical stakeholders and developers to access due to limited expertise in querying repositories. To address this, we introduce a novel chatbot architecture leveraging OpenAI's GPT-4 model for automated extraction and analysis of repository data. In contrast, our architecture takes a structured path first by parsing the user's query to extract relevant parameters, then selecting the correct tool to employ based on that analysis, and finally invoking the GPT-4 model to create a highly detailed response. In contrast to previous work based on multi-component systems with embedding models and document retrievers, our architecture inverts the process by relying on prompt engineering and tool selection to fit with the query intent. To validate our approach, we conducted experiments on various question types, including Issues, Pull Requests, Commits, Compound Questions, and General Repository Information, evaluating our target prompts' ability to improve the accuracy of responses from the model. Beyond demonstrating the utility of this architecture to a diverse set of users, our findings suggest that this architecture can make repository data more accessible to technical and non-technical audiences through the production of actionable insights.

</details>


### [555] [Substrate-Portable Execution for Production LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06128)
*Tarun Gopinath,Atul Kulkarni,Vijay Rajakumar,Shrikar Katti,Parthasarathy Govindarajen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个绑定自适应的智能体执行平台，将工作流定义与执行底层解耦。开发者只需定义一次类型化数据流图，平台即可将其编译为实时服务（进程内流式）、异步执行（AWS SWF）或批量推理（Apache Flink）三种执行模式，无需修改工作流代码。该平台在亚马逊Rufus智能助手中得到验证，覆盖多种编排模式，三种执行绑定下输出质量无差异，批量执行成本符合API定价折扣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产级LLM智能体需要在多种执行模式下运行（实时在线、异步后台、大规模批量），但现有执行语义通常只耦合单一运行时，导致可移植性差。例如Rufus中的流式编排在异步和批量模式下会造成阻塞，且无法利用提供50%折扣的批量推理API。

Method: 提出一个绑定自适应的智能体执行平台，核心思路是将工作流定义为类型化数据流图，平台将该图编译到三种不同执行底层：进程内流式（实时服务）、AWS SWF（异步）、Apache Flink（批量）。LLM推理被建模为可挂起的图节点，其行为随执行底层自适应变化：在线时流式交付，异步时持久化重试，离线时批量提交。

Result: 在数十个生产智能体配置下，覆盖五种编排模式（RAG、ReAct、PreAct、条件路由、多智能体深度研究）进行验证。三种执行绑定下输出质量无检测差异；批量执行在保持生产规模流式路径运行的同时，将单查询推理成本降至与批量API定价一致。

Conclusion: 工作流定义与执行底层解耦是可行的，且能同时满足不同模式的SLO要求。绑定自适应执行在保持输出质量的同时，充分利用批量推理API的成本优势，解决了生产级LLM智能体的跨运行时可移植性难题。

Abstract: Production LLM agents execute tool-calling loops, retrieval chains, and compositional workflows in multiple modes, yet execution semantics are often coupled to one runtime. We encountered this portability problem in Rufus, a conversational AI assistant with a large tool catalog that serves millions of Amazon customers. Rufus supports real-time serving, asynchronous background tasks, and high-volume batch workloads such as evaluation and content pregeneration. Each mode has distinct service-level objectives and typically uses a separate runtime. Reusing streaming orchestration makes asynchronous and batch workloads blocking and prevents use of batch inference APIs, which offer a 50 percent discount at published prices. We present a binding-adaptive agent execution platform that separates workflow definition from execution substrate. Developers define a workflow once as a typed dataflow graph. The platform compiles the graph to in-process streaming for real-time serving, durable AWS SWF orchestration for asynchronous execution, or distributed Apache Flink stream processing for batch inference. No workflow code changes are required. LLM inference is represented as a suspendable graph node whose behavior depends on the substrate: streaming delivery online, durable retry asynchronously, and batched submission offline. We validated dozens of production agent configurations across five orchestration patterns: single-inference RAG, iterative ReAct, compositional PreAct, conditional routing, and multi-agent deep research. Across all three bindings, we found no detectable difference in output quality. Batch execution reduced per-query inference cost in line with published batch API pricing while operating alongside the streaming path at production scale.

</details>


### [556] [IIns-VAE+: A Robust Transfer Learning Framework for Environmental Identification in Wireless Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06131)
*Yuxiao Li,Keke Hu,Bobai Zhao,Santiago Mazuelas,Yuan Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出IIns-VAE+混合模型，将IIns-VAE框架与Minimax Risk Classifiers（MRC）相结合，以提升无线感知环境识别的跨域泛化能力，在三种迁移学习场景下显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G ISAC系统的无线感知环境识别需要可靠的情境感知能力，但深度学习模型在跨环境领域偏移下泛化性能差。现有IIns-VAE虽能学习丰富表征特征，但其神经分类器仍易受分布变化影响。

Method: 提出IIns-VAE+混合模型，将IIns-VAE框架与Minimax Risk Classifiers（MRC）相结合，利用MRC对分布变化的鲁棒性来增强IIns-VAE分类器在迁移学习场景中的适应性。

Result: 使用真实世界数据集在三种迁移学习场景（通用到特定房间环境、高到低标签分辨率、混合到特定环境）中进行评估，IIns-VAE+在所有场景下均显著优于基线方法。

Conclusion: IIns-VAE+在构建未来6G系统自适应、鲁棒的感知网络中具有重要价值，为解决无线感知中领域偏移问题提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Environmental identification in wireless sensing is essential for 6G integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems to achieve reliable situational awareness. However, deep learning (DL) models for this task often fail to generalize under domain shift across diverse environments. While the Inter-Instance Variational Auto-encoder (IIns-VAE) learns features of rich representation, its neural classifier remains vulnerable to these distribution changes. In this paper, we propose IIns-VAE+, a hybrid model that combines the IIns-VAE framework with Minimax Risk Classifiers (MRC) to improve adaptability in transfer learning scenarios. We use real-world datasets to evaluate our framework across three transfer learning scenarios, including general to specific room environments, high to low label resolutions, and mixed to specific environments. The experimental results indicate that IIns-VAE+ significantly outperforms baselines, demonstrating its critical value in building adaptable and robust perceptive networks in future 6G systems.

</details>


### [557] [SWE-Bench Pro Verified: A Reliable Benchmark for Software Engineering Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08149)
*Pujun Zheng,Zixin Shang,Shufan Jiang,Wenhui Tian,Dongsheng Zhu,Zerun Ma,Dingbo Yuan,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了SWE-Bench Pro Verified，一个经过验证和修复的软件工程代理基准测试版本，以解决SWE-Bench Pro中存在的奖励黑客（reward hacking）和任务质量问题，提供更可信的评估结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SWE-Bench Pro作为仓库级软件工程任务的标准基准，其评估受到两大不可靠来源的影响：一是通过黄金解决方案或隐藏评估信息泄露导致的奖励黑客问题，二是任务质量问题（如误导性问题陈述和不恰当范围的测试）。这些问题会导致基准性能被夸大，掩盖代理真实的编码能力。

Method: 提出SWE-Bench Pro Verified，采用两种核心方法：(1) 反黑客保护措施（anti-hacking safeguards），在不干扰正常代理功能的前提下消除主要的信息泄露渠道；(2) 任务精炼（task refinement），对被标记为有缺陷的实例进行最小化修正，解决其中的不一致性问题。

Result: 在SWE-Bench Pro Verified上的评估显示，部分模型的性能显著低于此前报告的结果，表明SWE-Bench Pro上的既有结果可能高估了模型真实的软件工程能力。

Conclusion: SWE-Bench Pro Verified提供了一个更可信的基准，用于准确评估软件工程代理的实际能力。

Abstract: SWE-Bench Pro has emerged as a standard benchmark for evaluating software engineering agents on challenging repository-level tasks. However, our analysis work show that its evaluation is undermined by two sources of unreliability: \textbf{reward hacking}, enabled by leakage of gold solutions or hidden evaluation information, and \textbf{task quality issues}, including misleading problem statements and improperly scoped tests. These issues can inflate benchmark performance and obscure agents' true coding ability. We present \textbf{SWE-Bench Pro Verified}, a verified version of SWE-Bench Pro that addresses both problems. Our approach combines \textbf{anti-hacking} safeguards that eliminate major leakage channels without disrupting normal agent functionality, with \textbf{task refinement} that minimally corrects inconsistencies within flawed instances. Evaluations on SWE-Bench Pro Verified reveal that some models perform substantially worse than previously reported, suggesting that existing results on SWE-Bench Pro may overestimate real software engineering capability. SWE-Bench Pro Verified offers a more trustworthy benchmark for assessing software engineering agents.

</details>


### [558] [MVFA: A Multi-View Text-Guided Multimodal Fusion LLM Adapter for Sentiment Analysis and Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06188)
*Pengfei Shao,Jisheng Dang,Jiawen Fang,Ning Liu,Wencan Zhang,Bimei Wang,Jingwen Zhao,Jianhuang Lai,Qi Tian,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MVFA（多视角文本引导多模态融合适配器），一种参数高效框架，通过多视角文本引导跨模态交互并利用增强Q-Former压缩伪token，使冻结的LLM具备多模态情感分析能力。在三个数据集（CH-SIMS V2.0、MELD、CHERMA）上达到SOTA性能，仅更新少量参数，并验证了在多个LLM骨干上的可移植性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态情感分析与对话情绪识别需要建模文本、音频和视觉模态间的异构交互。虽然LLM具备强大的语言理解能力，但将其适配到多模态情感计算面临挑战：全模型微调计算代价过高，而现有轻量适配器在跨模态融合时无法保留丰富的文本语义线索。

Method: MVFA首先通过最大池化、均值池化和注意力池化构建互补的文本视图；这些视图引导与音频和视觉特征的跨模态交互。融合后的多模态表示通过增强Q-Former融合模块压缩为一组可学习的伪token。以ChatGLM3-6B-base为主骨干，并在LLaMA2-7B和Qwen3-8B上验证可移植性。

Result: 在CH-SIMS V2.0上达到84.62% Acc2和84.59% F1；在MELD上达到67.36% Acc和66.03% WF1；在CHERMA上达到74.66% Acc。在关键指标上达到SOTA，仅更新少量参数。

Conclusion: 多视角文本引导融合被证明是情感计算中参数高效多模态LLM适配的有效且可扩展范式，兼顾了性能与参数效率。

Abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis and emotion recognition in conversations demand effective modeling of heterogeneous interactions across textual, acoustic, and visual modalities. Although large language models (LLMs) offer powerful language understanding, adapting them to multimodal affective computing remains challenging: full-model fine-tuning is computationally prohibitive, while many existing lightweight adapters fail to preserve rich textual cues during cross-modal fusion. To address these limitations, we propose the multi-view text-guided multimodal fusion adapter (MVFA), a parameter-efficient framework that augments frozen LLMs with strong multimodal reasoning capability. MVFA first constructs complementary text views via max pooling, mean pooling, and attention pooling; these views then guide cross-modal interactions with audio and visual features. The fused multimodal representations are subsequently compressed into a compact set of learnable pseudo-tokens through an Enhanced Q-Former Fusion Module. Using ChatGLM3-6B-base as the primary backbone, we further validate MVFA on LLaMA2-7B and Qwen3-8B to examine its portability across multiple frozen LLM backbones. MVFA is evaluated on three challenging datasets: CH-SIMS V2.0, MELD, and CHERMA. Experimental results demonstrate that MVFA achieves state-of-the-art performance on key metrics while updating only a small fraction of parameters. Specifically, it attains 84.62\% Acc2 and 84.59\% F1 on CH-SIMS V2.0, 67.36\% Acc and 66.03\% WF1 on MELD, and 74.66\% Acc on CHERMA. These findings establish multi-view text-guided fusion as an effective and scalable paradigm for parameter-efficient multimodal LLM adaptation in affective computing. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Overwhelm1208/MVFA.

</details>


### [559] [Qiushi Engine on AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08196)
*Wenhao Li,Shuxing Yang,Fujia Chen,Jincheng Mi,Yuang Pan,Rui Zhao,Zichen Li,Junyao Wu,Shenzhan Hong,Yaqi Li,Yize Wang,Kaihao Zhu,Taowen Deng,Junjie Yang,Hongsheng Chen,Yihao Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析求是引擎 v0.8 在 AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard 基准的 40 个测试任务上的表现，使用 DeepSeek deepseek-v4pro-preview 作为模型后端。官方记录得分 0.816，平均成本 15.209 美元/任务，完整任务完成率 10%（4/40），507 个评审项中满足 416 项（82.1%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在评估求是引擎在端到端自动科研代理任务上的实际能力，该任务要求代理自主完成从研究问题到实验设计、代码实现、执行、结果分析和报告交付的完整流程。

Method: 在 AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard 的全部 40 个测试任务上评估模型可配置的求是引擎 v0.8，并以 DeepSeek deepseek-v4pro-preview 为模型后端，同时进行官方存档与本地全精度重算，记录了 40 条 Meta-Trace 记录用于细节分析。

Result: 官方排行榜得分 0.816，平均成本 15.209 美元/任务；本地全精度重算成本为 $81.59 \pm 1.87$。完整任务完成率 4/40 = 10%，比官方最好约 3% 高 7 个百分点（约 3.3 倍）。507 个评审项中满足 416 项（82.1%）。主要差距在于重复运行、外部依赖、指定指标和消融研究。

Conclusion: 求是引擎在自动科研代理任务上显著优于官方代理基线，但完整任务完成率仍然不高；报告详细阐述了基准、系统工作流、聚合结果、代表性案例及解释上的局限。

Abstract: This report analyzes Qiushi Engine v0.8 across all 40 test tasks in AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard, a benchmark that requires autonomous agents to carry a research question through experimental design, code implementation, actual execution, result analysis, and report delivery. Qiushi Engine is model-configurable; this evaluation selected DeepSeek deepseek-v4pro-preview as the model backend. The official AstaBench leaderboard records a score of 0.816 and an average benchmark cost of USD 15.209 per task, while the full-precision local recomputation is $81.59 \pm 1.87$. Four tasks satisfied every rubric item, yielding a full-task completion rate of 4/40 = 10% -- 7 percentage points above, and about 3.3 times, the approximately 3% best rate reported for AstaBench's official agents. Across 507 required rubric items, 416 were satisfied (82.1%). Official scoring archives and 40 Meta-Trace records show sustained production and verification of reports, code, and experimental artifacts; the principal gaps lie in repeated runs, external dependencies, specified metrics, and ablation studies. The report explains the benchmark, system workflow, aggregate results, representative cases, and limits of interpretation.

</details>


### [560] [EvolveScaler: Synthesizing Information-Evolution Contexts via Executable State Machines and Natural-Language Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08435)
*Ziliang Zhao,Zenan Xu,Shuting Wang,Zhao Wang,Bowen Cao,Minda Hu,Lincheng Li,Pluto Zhou,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EvolveScaler，一个代码驱动的信息演化（IE）合成框架。该框架通过人类编写操作规范定义状态转换、记录有效性和答案逻辑，再由LLM合成自包含模拟器并渲染为自然语言事件历史。实验表明其在超长上下文评测上具有挑战性，且训练的模型能在多个域外基准上获得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于文本的合成管线难以验证数据，因为长上下文中的信息演化涉及状态转换和答案逻辑的隐含性。长上下文编码的是一个动态演变过程而非固定记录，后期事件可能修订或撤销早期信息，这使得验证有效记录和重建答案变得困难。

Method: EvolveScaler采用代码驱动方法：(1) 人类撰写操作规范，定义状态转换、记录有效性、难度控制和可执行答案逻辑；(2) 用强LLM从每个规范合成自包含模拟器；(3) 执行经验证的模拟器生成自然语言多轮事件历史；(4) 通过确定性回放计算参考答案和原子化检查清单。框架包含117个任务原型和159个最终问题操作符，覆盖5个难度级别。

Result: 生成约35,100个训练样本和585个验证评估实例，事件规模从7到1,200个不等。在very_long层级上最强模型仅达59.3% avg@5，六个模型得分低于10%。用6,000个EvolveScaler样例训练内部A3B模型，在8个独立构建的域外基准上平均提升5.25分。

Conclusion: 代码驱动的IE合成方法既能提供具有挑战性的评测数据，又能提供可迁移的训练监督信号，表明其在长上下文推理任务中的有效性。

Abstract: In persistent interactions, long contexts may encode an evolving process rather than a fixed record: later events can revise or revoke earlier information, changing what remains valid and what conclusions follow. We call this setting information evolution (IE). Solving IE requires identifying valid records, applying updates in order, and reconstructing the query-relevant state from the event history. Existing text-first synthesis pipelines make such data difficult to verify because state transitions and answer logic remain implicit. We introduce EvolveScaler, a code-driven framework that defines information evolution before rendering it as natural language. Human-authored operational specifications define state transitions, record validity, difficulty controls, and executable answer logic; a strong LLM then synthesizes a self-contained simulator from each specification. Executing validated simulators produces natural-language multi-turn event histories, while deterministic replay computes reference answers and atomic checklists. We instantiate EvolveScaler with 117 task prototypes and 159 final-question operators across five difficulty levels spanning approximately 7 to 1,200 events per instance, yielding about 35,100 training examples and 585 validated evaluation instances. On the very_long tier, the strongest model reaches 59.3% avg@5, while six models score below 10%. Training an internal A3B model on 6,000 EvolveScaler examples improves performance over its base checkpoint on all eight independently constructed out-of-distribution benchmarks, with a 5.25-point average gain. These results show that code-driven IE synthesis provides both challenging evaluation and transferable training supervision.

</details>


### [561] [SCIRIGOR:Evaluating Open-Ended Scientific Analysis Beyond Final Scores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06192)
*Bowen Liu,Shuo Nie,Bodong Du,Xiaomeng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SciRIGOR评估框架与基准，用于检验科学编码智能体产出的分析结果与科学论断是否被证据支撑。基准覆盖6个领域17个子领域的100个案例，通过重建类型化证据图、分离工件保真度与关系有效性来评估完整的"数据-论断"证据链。评估11种智能体/模型配置后发现，内部一致性（论断与忠实/不忠实结果的符合率相近）并不能保证科学正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学编码智能体产生的代码、结果、图表和论断相互依赖，但仅评估最终输出无法确定其结论是否真正得到科学证据支持。现有评估忽视了从数据到论断的完整证据链验证。

Method: 构建SciRIGOR框架：(1) 从科学文章中提取100个案例形成基准；(2) 重建类型化证据图（typed evidence graphs）；(3) 分离工件保真度（artifact fidelity）与关系有效性（relational validity）；(4) 对完整论断-证据路径评分，并定位最早的不受支持关系；(5) 引入源导向的替代路径以容纳科学上等效的分析与可视化方案。

Result: 评估11种智能体/模型配置发现：论断与忠实结果的符合率和与不忠实结果的符合率几乎相同（91.8%对91.0%），说明内部一致性无法区分证据真伪。软证据链分数最高仅62.6%，严格整链成功率最高仅18.0%。

Conclusion: 内部连贯性不能确立科学正确性。评估必须沿着完整的数据到论断路径验证支撑关系，而非仅凭最终输出的一致性判断。

Abstract: Scientific coding agents produce interdependent code, results, figures, and claims, yet evaluating final
  outputs alone does not establish whether their conclusions are scientifically supported. We formulate
  evidence-grounded multimodal scientific analysis, requiring agents to produce executable analyses and claims
  supported by results and visualizations from the same run. We introduce SciRIGOR, an evaluation framework and
  benchmark comprising 100 cases from scientific articles across six domains and 17 subfields. The framework
  reconstructs typed evidence graphs, separates artifact fidelity from relational validity, and scores complete
  claim-support paths while localizing the earliest unsupported relation. Source-grounded alternative paths
  accommodate scientifically equivalent analyses and visualizations. We evaluate 11 agent/model configurations.
  On full-benchmark runs, claims agree with faithful and unfaithful results at nearly identical rates (91.8%
  versus 91.0%). Yet no system exceeds 62.6% on the soft evidence-chain score or 18.0% strict whole-chain
  success. These findings show that internal coherence does not establish scientific correctness: evaluation
  must verify support along the complete data-to-claim path.

</details>


### [562] [API Benchmark Scores Do Not Reliably Transfer to Chatbot Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08861)
*Jennifer Wang,Joachim Baumann,Daniel E. Ho,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过审计ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini七个系统和九个基准测试，发现API评估与界面评估之间存在系统性差异：API评估在准确性和测试-重测一致性上分别平均高出3.4和2.1个百分点。对于ChatGPT，API与界面之间的性能差异甚至超过GPT 5.3到GPT 5.4的模型代际差异，且调整API控制参数无法可靠消除这一差距，表明API评估不能忠实反映部署界面的实际行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准测试分数是模型发布的核心指标，影响购买决策、公众信任和政策制定。然而现有评估隐含假设API测量结果能忠实反映部署系统的行为，本文旨在挑战并验证这一假设。

Method: 对ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini七个系统进行系统审计，横跨九个基准测试，覆盖一般能力、社会偏见和谄媚行为三个维度。对比API评估与界面评估的准确性和一致性差异，并测试调整系统提示、采样参数和推理设置等API控制能否复现界面行为。

Result: API评估平均比界面评估高3.4个百分点（准确性）和2.1个百分点（测试-重测一致性）。ChatGPT的API-界面性能差异超过GPT 5.3与GPT 5.4之间的API性能差异。实验表明，调整API控制参数只能部分改变行为，无法可靠消除这一差距。

Conclusion: 研究发现存在"情境有效性差距"（context-validity gap）：通过API获得的测量结果不能普遍推广到对应的部署界面，将API评估作为部署系统的代理指标的做法存在问题，需要重新审视。

Abstract: Benchmark scores are a central currency in model releases: they inform purchasing decisions, shape public trust, and influence policy. Yet, a key assumption underlying benchmark scores is that the model performance measured through APIs faithfully reflects the behavior of deployed systems.
  We challenge this assumption by auditing ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across seven systems and nine benchmarks spanning general capability, social bias, and sycophancy. We find systematic API--interface differences in both accuracy and consistency. On average, API evaluations score 3.4 percentage points higher in accuracy and 2.1 percentage points higher in test--retest agreement than corresponding interface evaluations. For ChatGPT, the performance difference between API and interface access exceeds the API-only difference between GPT 5.3 and GPT 5.4. Put differently, switching access surfaces can degrade performance as much as downgrading a full model generation.
  We further test whether exposed API controls can reproduce interface behavior by varying system prompts, sampling parameters, and reasoning settings. These controls shift behavior in some cases but do not reliably eliminate the gap. Our findings document a context-validity gap: measurements obtained through APIs do not necessarily generalize to corresponding deployed interfaces, complicating the use of API evaluations as proxies for deployed systems.

</details>


### [563] [Predicting Wind Turbine Power Using Machine Learning and Weather Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06194)
*Khivishta Boodhoo,Isaac Triguero,Josh Plumbly,Bruce Nicolson,Nicholas Watson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究开发了线性回归和人工神经网络模型，利用天气数据预测海上风力涡轮机功率输出。通过比较不同数据预处理、数据量（一个月vs一年）和特征选择策略，发现ANN模型表现最佳（R²=0.98，MAE=194），不仅能识别低功率时段用于调度维护（每次节省约2000 kW），还可通过附近气象站数据实现跨涡轮机的可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上风力涡轮机的维护会导致强制停机，降低发电效率。准确预测功率输出有助于识别低功率时段以安排维护，但数据量、特征选择和数据预处理对预测模型性能的影响尚未被充分研究，且现有模型在不同涡轮机间的可迁移性有限。

Method: 以线性回归为基线模型，与人工神经网络模型进行对比；仅使用天气条件作为输入以增强适用性；研究多种数据预处理技术；分别用一个月和一年的数据进行模型训练以考察数据量影响；使用随机森林回归器进行特征选择。

Result: ANN模型获得最高精度（R²=0.98，MAE=194），优于基线线性回归模型（R²=0.94，MAE=441）。性能与过往研究相当，且利用附近气象站的独立天气数据集，使模型可迁移至不同地点的相似风力涡轮机。ANN模型成功识别出两个月内多个4小时低功率预测时段，每次维护事件可节省约2000 kW功率输出。

Conclusion: 基于天气数据的ANN模型在风力涡轮机功率预测中表现优越，不仅精度较高，还具备良好的跨涡轮机可迁移性和实际维护调度应用价值，是一种具有实用前景的预测方法。

Abstract: Offshore wind turbines are widely used to generate renewable energy, but their maintenance can result in decreased efficiency due to forced shutdowns. Accurate wind turbine power predictions can identify periods of low power that would be ideal for scheduling maintenance. However, the effects of data volume, feature selection, and data preprocessing on the performance of such power prediction models have not been thoroughly studied. Besides, current models have limited transferability between different wind turbines. Therefore, this study developed a baseline Linear Regression for performance comparison with a more complex Artificial Neural Network model to predict the power output of a wind turbine, using weather conditions only to enhance applicability. A range of data preprocessing techniques were studied, and models were trained on one month and one year of data to determine the effects of data preprocessing and volume on model performance. Feature selection was explored using a Random Forest Regressor. The best results from the different models showed that the Artificial Neural Network models provided the highest accuracy, with an R2 score of 0.98 and a low Mean Absolute Error of 194, when compared with the baseline model (R2 score of 0.94 and Mean Absolute Error of 441). The model performance is comparable to the range of results in past studies, with the advantage that the proposed method leverages a separate weather dataset from a nearby weather station, enabling future applications for similar wind turbines in different locations. The Artificial Neural Network model was then used to identify 4-h periods of low power predictions over 2 months (simulating application for future periods), providing power output savings of approximately 2000 kW for each maintenance event.

</details>


### [564] [MeClear: Cooperative Game-Theoretic Attribution and Risk-Aware Memory Clearance for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09115)
*Boyu Yang,Jiazheng Sun,Zilong Lu,Zhi Qiu,Xin Peng,Jun Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MeClear，一个任务条件化的记忆清理框架，通过合作归因识别具有负面下游效用的记忆并将其选择性抑制，从而提升长对话LLM代理的任务恢复能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视野LLM代理依赖外部记忆系统保存用户偏好和任务知识，但传统检索机制只优化语义兼容性而非下游效用，常引入过时、误导或冲突的证据到活动上下文中，影响代理表现。

Method: MeClear结合Leave One Out筛选与采样合作Shapley归因来在交互证据间分配效用，解决单一移除评估无法处理的冗余冲突掩蔽问题。利用归因排序执行查询范围的最小清理策略（嵌套过滤），在清理上下文上验证任务恢复，但不永久修改持久记忆库。

Result: 在十个长对话记忆池上的实验表明，MeClear达到85.9%的目标召回率和82.3%的整体任务恢复率，相比Leave One Out基线提升了25.5个百分点。

Conclusion: MeClear通过任务条件化的记忆清理机制有效识别并抑制负面效用记忆，显著优于传统的单次移除归因基线，在不改变持久记忆的前提下提升了代理的任务执行能力。

Abstract: Long horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents rely on external memory systems to preserve user preferences and task knowledge across extended interactions. Conventional retrieval mechanisms optimize semantic compatibility rather than downstream utility, frequently introducing outdated, misleading, or conflicting evidence into the active context. We present MeClear, a task conditioned memory clearance framework that identifies memories featuring negative downstream utility through cooperative attribution and selectively suppresses them from agent execution. MeClear combines Leave One Out screening with sampled cooperative Shapley attribution to distribute utility across interacting evidence, effectively resolving redundant conflict masking where single removal evaluations fail. Utilizing attribution rankings, MeClear executes a query scoped minimal clearance strategy over a nested filtration, verifying task recovery on the cleared context without permanently altering the persistent memory bank. Comprehensive experimental evaluations across ten long dialogue memory pools demonstrate that MeClear achieves a target recall of 85.9% and an overall task recovery rate of 82.3%, representing a 25.5 percentage point improvement over Leave One Out (LOO) baselines.

</details>


### [565] [AutoKD: Autonomous Knowledge Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06366)
*Qinwen Ge,Bo Ni,Haowei Fu,Ngoc N. Tran,Erik Blasch,Tyler Derr*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoKD是一个多智能体自主知识发现框架，通过六名协调的LLM智能体在开放式发现循环中协作，将经过验证的发现存储在持久洞察图中，作为长期记忆和探索引导机制，使发现能够累积并指导后续研究，弥补了现有LLM多智能体系统一次性、无法累积的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据丰富领域中的科学发现受限于人类带宽，数据量和复杂性增长远超人类研究者的阅读、推理和综合能力。现有基于LLM的多智能体系统仅针对假设生成，无法自动化验证过程，且每次运行都是一次性的，缺乏发现累积和引导后续探究的机制。

Method: 提出AutoKD框架：(1)六个协调的LLM智能体在开放式发现循环中协作；(2)被接受的发现存储在持久洞察图中，该图既是长期记忆又是探索引导机制；(3)实现计算性与累积性兼备的自主知识发现。

Result: 在三个不同数据集上从两个视角进行评估：针对已发表发现的无提示开放性质量，以及通过文献衍生查询的条件性质量。两种评估视角下，AutoKD均能覆盖已知发现并发现补充人类驱动研究的实质性新发现。

Conclusion: AutoKD验证了多智能体LLM系统可以超越单次假设生成，实现可累积的自主知识发现，其成果能够与人类主导的研究相互补充。

Abstract: Scientific discovery in data-rich domains is currently constrained by human bandwidth: the growth in the volume and complexity of real-world data far outpaces the rate at which researchers can read, reason, and synthesize. Recent LLM-based multi-agent systems have begun to automate portions of the research cycle, but they target hypothesis generation in settings where validation cannot itself be automated, and each run is one-shot, with no mechanism for findings to accumulate or steer subsequent inquiry. This paper introduces AutoKD, a multi-agent framework for autonomous knowledge discovery that is both computational and cumulative, allowing validated findings to persist and inform subsequent inquiry. Six coordinated LLM agents collaborate in an open-ended discovery loop, where accepted findings are stored in a persistent insight graph that serves as both long-term memory and an exploration-steering mechanism. We evaluate AutoKD on three diverse datasets from two perspectives: Open-ended Quality against published findings, and Conditioned Quality via literature-derived queries. Across both evaluation perspectives, AutoKD covers known findings and surfaces substantive discoveries that complement human-driven research. Our code is available at https://github.com/GeQinwen/AutoKD.

</details>


### [566] [ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09133)
*Leitian Tao,Baolin Peng,Haorui Wang,Hang Wang,Hao Cheng,Wenlin Yao,Qianhui Wu,Tao Ge,Sharon Li,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ExecCritic框架，通过分离测试生成与代码修复两个角色的强化学习训练，解决了编码代理中"自写测试自修补丁"带来的虚假置信问题，在SWE-bench Verified上达到72.6%的修复率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的编码代理依赖执行反馈来引导仓库修复，但当同一轨迹同时生成测试和补丁时，两者的错误可能相互印证产生虚假置信度。测试质量决定了执行反馈是否有用，因此需要更好的测试生成与反馈利用机制。

Method: 采用test-verify-revise三阶段脚手架：(1) Test agent独立生成仓库原生测试；(2) fail-closed harness负责资格验证并冻结测试；(3) Repair agent根据执行反馈修改源代码但不允许更改测试。两个角色均以Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B为骨干、分别训练：Test agent通过"Learn to Test"学习生成能区分正确与错误补丁的行为有效测试；Repair agent通过"Test to Improve"学习直接任务求解与反馈引导的修订。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified上，测试质量显著影响反馈效果：基础Test agent的测试使修复率从61.2%基线降至57.3%，而GPT-5.6-sol生成的测试提升至65.3%。角色专用后训练将Qwen Test agent的Base-to-Gold成功率从22.2%提升至62.2%；组合两个后训练Qwen代理达到72.6%，较原无测试基线提升11.4个百分点。

Conclusion: 角色分离与角色专用强化学习能显著提升编码代理的修复能力，高质量行为有效的测试是执行反馈发挥作用的关键前提；该方法在评测时无需更强模型或Oracle反馈即可超越基线。

Abstract: Execution feedback can guide coding agents toward correct repository repairs, but only when the tests capture the behavior requested by the issue. Agent-generated tests can encode incomplete or incorrect behavioral targets; when the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can agree and create false confidence. We introduce ExecCritic, combining a test--verify--revise scaffold with a role-specific reinforcement learning recipe for training agents within it. The scaffold separates test construction from source-code repair: a Test agent independently generates repository-native tests, a fail-closed harness qualifies and freezes them, and a Repair agent revises source code from their execution feedback without changing the tests. Both roles use Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B as the backbone and are trained separately. In Learn to Test, the Test agent learns to produce behaviorally valid tests that distinguish correct from incorrect patches. In Test to Improve, the Repair agent learns both direct task resolution and feedback-guided revision. On SWE-bench Verified, test quality determines whether feedback helps: holding the base Repair agent fixed, tests from the base Test agent reduce resolved rate from a no-test baseline of 61.2% to 57.3%, whereas tests from GPT-5.6-sol raise it to 65.3%. Role-specific post-training raises the Qwen Test agent's Base-to-Gold success from 22.2% to 62.2%; composing the two post-trained Qwen agents reaches 72.6%, an 11.4-point gain over the original no-test baseline without stronger-model or Oracle feedback at evaluation time. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic.

</details>


### [567] [Building Trustworthy Graph-Agentic RAG for Social Good: Architectures, Failure Propagation, and Assurance by Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06391)
*Vijay Bommireddy,Raviteja Bommireddy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统梳理了面向社会公益场景的图智能体检索增强生成（Graph-agentic RAG）系统，提出"证据到行动的故障链"模型及"契约式保证"设计蓝图，通过五大接口契约明确系统的可追溯性、授权、时效与可恢复性，并给出评估议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图智能体RAG虽能处理跨文档、实体、时间或机构的复杂关系推理，但其组合结构产生耦合的故障路径——图构建缺陷可能成为检索证据、改变后续控制决策并传播至关键结果。在涉及新鲜度、授权、可追溯性、监督与救济等社会公益场景中，现有设计与评估方法缺乏系统化框架来应对这些风险。

Method: 作者采用三层方法：（1）按图基材、图生命周期、智能体功能、协调模式与权威边界五维度对文献进行组织分类，区分基于图的检索与依赖于观测的图控制；（2）将已报告风险综合为"证据到行动故障链"；（3）提出"基于构造的保障（assurance-by-construction）"蓝图，定义证据、检索、推理、能力与委派、结果五大接口契约，并辅以公共效益信息设计示例约束图结构、权限、弃权和操作权威。

Result: 提出一套覆盖图断言、轨迹、声明、协调与结果的评估议程，并通过示例展示了框架如何使溯源、时间有效性、授权、不确定性和可恢复性在系统边界显式化。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献在于将图智能体RAG的风险从零散的个案问题上升为结构化故障链，并提出接口契约作为设计与评估的统一边界条件，为公益场景中可问责、可追溯的图智能体RAG系统奠定了系统化方法论基础。

Abstract: Graph-agentic retrieval-augmented generation combines structured evidence with adaptive controllers that can plan retrieval, traverse relations, verify intermediate claims, delegate subtasks, and use tools. This combination is useful when answers depend on relations across documents, entities, time, or institutions, but it also creates coupled failure paths: a defect in graph construction can become retrieved evidence, alter later control decisions, and propagate toward a consequential outcome. We examine how such systems should be designed and evaluated for social-good settings in which freshness, authorization, traceability, oversight, and recourse matter alongside answer quality. We organize the literature by graph substrate, graph lifecycle, agent function, coordination pattern, and authority boundary, and distinguish graph-based retrieval from observation-dependent graph control. We then synthesize reported risks as an evidence-to-action failure chain and propose an assurance-by-construction blueprint comprising five interface contracts for evidence, retrieval, reasoning, capability and delegation, and outcome. These contracts make provenance, temporal validity, authorization, uncertainty, and recoverability explicit at system boundaries. An illustrative public-benefit information design shows how the framework constrains graph structure, permissions, abstention, and operating authority. Finally, we derive an evaluation agenda spanning graph assertions, trajectories, claims, coordination, and outcomes.

</details>


### [568] [From Concentration to Differentiation and Back: Routing Effective Rank in MoE Reasoning Cohorts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06403)
*Kang Chen,Sihan Zhao,Yixin Cao,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为路由有效秩（routing effective rank, deff）的无标签诊断指标，用于度量MoE推理rollout群体在测试时计算的组织结构。deff在10种MoE配置和5个数学/科学基准上表现出可复现的"低-高-低"轨迹（98.5%的3,105个模型-问题队列中出现显著内部峰值），并通过精确分解将轨迹归因于公共模质量与残差谱维度，揭示了推理努力通过延迟峰值时间（2.59 octaves）而非提升峰值幅度来影响群体分化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时扩展（test-time scaling）会产生大量推理rollout，但缺乏标准化的无标签方法来说明推理展开过程中这些rollout的内部计算如何重组。现有方法难以在无标签条件下刻画推理群体的组织结构变化。

Method: 引入"路由有效秩"deff——基于MoE专家路由相似性构建跨rollout图，并计算其熵有效维度。具体包括：(1) 在推理时间轴上追踪deff的低-高-低轨迹；(2) 通过精确分解将轨迹拆分为公共模质量（common-mode mass）与残差谱维度；(3) 分析推理努力（token预算加倍）对峰值时序、高秩区间时长和幅度的影响。

Result: deff在98.5%的3,105个队列中呈现可复现的低-高-低轨迹；公共模量分配约占轨迹的三分之二，残差谱贡献约四分之一且保留显著变异性；更高的推理努力将峰值延迟2.59个octave（token预算加倍单位），并一致扩展四种测试架构的高秩期——表明努力效应体现在时序和持续时间而非峰值幅度。公共模浓度增加可预测非一致队列的相同答案可恢复性。

Conclusion: 路由有效秩是一种可分解、无标签的群体组织诊断工具，为MoE推理rollout如何随时间分化并重新集中提供了原理性的谱视角。正确性比较区分了结构监控与答案选择，确立了deff作为衡量推理群体演化组织的有效工具。

Abstract: Test-time scaling produces cohorts of reasoning rollouts, yet there is no standard label-free account of how their internal computation reorganizes as inference unfolds. We introduce routing effective rank deff, the entropy-effective dimensionality of a cross-rollout graph built from MoE expert-routing similarity. Across ten MoE configurations and five math/science benchmarks, deff exhibits a reproducible low-high-low trajectory, with a prominent interior maximum in 98.5% of 3,105 model-question cohorts: routing similarity is concentrated early, maximally differentiated at intermediate budgets, and reconcentrated later, and the timing of this maximum varies systematically with architecture and reasoning effort. An exact decomposition separates cohort-wide common-mode mass from residual spectral dimensionality: common-mode reallocation accounts for about two thirds of the trajectory, while the residual spectrum contributes about one quarter and retains substantial variation beyond the common mode. The decomposition further localizes behavior: among non-unanimous cohorts, increases in common-mode concentration strongly predict same-answer recoverability, and higher reasoning effort delays the maximum by 2.59 octaves (doublings of the token budget) and consistently expands the high-rank period across all four tested architectures, locating the effort effect in timing and duration rather than peak amplitude. Correctness comparisons separate structural monitoring from answer selection, positioning routing effective rank as a decomposable, label-free diagnostic of cohort organization - a principled spectral lens on how MoE reasoning cohorts differentiate and reconcentrate over inference time.

</details>


### [569] [Causal Attribution for Agentic Decisions: Estimators, Coupling, and a Traceability Specification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06445)
*Ajay Pravin Mahale*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文围绕高风险的AI智能体系统，提出"判定可追溯性"的估计框架，指出在事后因果归因条件下现有边际总效应与共同随机数总效应两个估量都会失效，并给出了在上下文分歧后仍可估计直接效应的耦合方案及其退化闭式解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险AI系统的提供者须保存可追溯决策的记录，但对智能体系统而言，尚未确立这些记录需要包含什么才能支持事后因果归因。此外，欧盟《AI法案》第86条解释权已于2026年8月2日生效，而第12条日志与附件IV文档规范被推迟至2027年12月2日，这一"日历空档"使得可追溯性规范成为紧迫缺口。

Method: 作者给出估计框架并检验其失效条件；将先前的边际总效应与隔离单步自身贡献的"共同随机数总效应"区分开；在固定下游的自然直接效应下，用手工推导逐一核对估计量；设计耦合机制使上下文分歧后直接效应仍可估计，并给出其退化的闭式表达式。

Result: 两种估量以相同方向失效：边际估量下，因果惰性步骤与决定性步骤在每轮播下的链上总效应完全相同（代数恒等式而非偶然）；共同随机数下，当执行步骤翻转（约十分之一运行）时决定性步骤恰好得零，而其直接效应为0.25并可证明其确实起作用。直接与中介路径相悖时，用作自然排序基础的中介份额会超过1，把被抑制成分排在纯中介之上。由于实时管线在研究中不可用，仅发布差异实验预注册而非结果。

Conclusion: 零值并不证明步骤未起任何作用；应基于此，而非归入方法局限。作者贡献了一份此类文件所需的可追溯性规范，以应对《AI法案》日程打开的规范空档——解释权已生效而记录与文档要求尚被推迟。

Abstract: A provider of a high-risk AI system must keep records that make a decision traceable, and for agentic systems it has not been established what those records must contain for post-hoc causal attribution to be possible. We give the estimator framework and then the conditions under which it fails. We separate the marginal total effect that prior work measures from a common-random-numbers total effect that isolates a step's own contribution, add the natural direct effect under a pinned downstream, and check the estimators against hand derivations. Both estimands then fail, in the same direction. Under the marginal estimand a causally inert step has the identical total effect to the decisive one on every run of our planted chain, an algebraic identity and not a coincidence at one draw. Under common random numbers the decisive step returns exactly zero on the runs where the executing step flips, about one in ten, while its direct effect there is 0.25 and it demonstrably acts; an exact zero does not certify that a step did nothing, and we put that here rather than in the limitations. We derive the coupling that keeps the direct effect estimable once contexts diverge, with a closed form for its degradation, and show that the mediated share on which a natural ranking is built is not a share under suppression: where the direct and mediated paths oppose, it exceeds one and ranks a suppressed component above a pure mediator. We publish the discrepancy experiment's pre-registration rather than a result, because the live pipeline it requires was not available in the study window. We contribute the traceability specification such a filing would need, against a gap the Act's calendar opens: Article 86's right to an explanation has applied since 2 August 2026, while the Article 12 logging and Annex IV documentation that could evidence one were deferred to 2 December 2027 by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.

</details>


### [570] [MARBO: Relational Belief Grounding for LLM Agents in Social Deduction Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06563)
*Hwang Yechan,Bae Sangjun,Kim Jeongmo,Bang Sangwoo,Han Seungyul*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MARBO框架，一个基于关系信念的偏好优化方法，通过将关系信念（关于隐藏角色和团队归属）显式地锚定到智能体的行动和游戏语言中，帮助小型LLM智能体在社交推理游戏的不确定条件下进行更一致的策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM智能体方法在社交推理游戏中主要通过提示工程和偏好优化来改进游戏表现，但它们优化动作和游戏语言时没有显式地将这些行为建立在关系信念（即对隐藏角色和团队身份的判断）之上。这导致智能体（特别是紧凑型LLM智能体）经常产生策略上不一致的行为。

Method: MARBO框架的核心设计是：仅在行为得到可靠关系信念支持、且能导向策略上有利的社会结果时，才提供偏好反馈。通过这种信念锚定的偏好优化，鼓励智能体在不确定环境下进行更一致的学习。

Result: 在代表性社交推理游戏上的实验表明，MARBO使紧凑型LLM智能体能够持续优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 将关系信念显式地融入偏好优化过程，能够有效提升小型LLM智能体在社交推理游戏中的策略一致性，为在部分可观测环境中训练更可靠的智能体提供了新思路。

Abstract: Social deduction games (SDGs) require agents to reason under partial observability by maintaining relational beliefs about hidden roles and team alignments. While recent LLM-agent approaches improve gameplay through prompting and preference optimization, they often optimize actions and in-game speech without explicitly grounding them in such beliefs. This frequently leads to strategically inconsistent behavior, especially for compact LLM agents. We introduce Multi-Agent Relational Belief Optimization (MARBO), a belief-grounded preference optimization framework that leverages relational beliefs to guide strategic decisions and in-game speech. MARBO provides preference feedback only when behaviors are supported by reliable relational beliefs and lead to strategically favorable social outcomes, encouraging more consistent learning under uncertainty. Experiments on representative SDGs show that MARBO enables compact LLM agents to consistently outperform existing baselines. The Code is available on https://github.com/PleaseTakemeAway/MARBO.

</details>


### [571] [A Translational Note on AI Safety Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06573)
*Madhava Gaikwad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出自动化红队相比人类红队在AI安全基准测试中发现更多漏洞的结论存在方法论混淆：基准测试衡量的是对预设危害集合的搜索彻底性，而结论却声称人类评估者变得可有可无。作者将其类比为学术密码学和临床药物试验中的"盲区"问题，提出"威胁模型覆盖缺口"（threat-model coverage gap）概念，并证明该缺口在现有开源模型中依然存在——非英语提示中的危害是英语基准无法捕获的。要弥补这一缺口，需要开发者的部署背景不同的评估者，而现有评估框架本身无法自行产生这样的评估者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明自动化红队比人类红队能发现更多漏洞且成本更低，这被解读为人类评估者正在变得可有可无。作者认为这种比较衡量的是A事物，结论却声称关于B事物——基准测试衡量的是对预先定义危害集合的搜索深度，而结论却说人类评估者整体上可以被取代。作者追溯这一盲区在学术密码学和临床药物试验中的历史先例，揭示评估内在有效性与评估覆盖范围之间的根本区别。

Method: 本文通过概念分析提出了"威胁模型覆盖缺口"这一框架：评估者的评估范围受限于预先定义的危害集合，若某一危害不在该集合中，则任何在该框架内工作的攻击者（无论自动化与否）都无法发现它。作者将此问题与密码学安全证明（只针对特定攻击模型）和临床试验（只针对特定人群）进行类比，并通过当前开源模型实例验证：非英语提示中可以浮现英语基准无法检测的危害。

Result: 作者证明了威胁模型覆盖缺口在当前的开放权重模型中确实存在——某些危害只在非英语提示中显现，而英语基准完全无法捕获。这一实证发现表明，仅仅扩大攻击者效率（从人类转向自动化）并不能解决覆盖缺口问题，因为这个缺口本质上是评估范围的问题而非搜索能力的问题。

Conclusion: 要弥合覆盖缺口，需要部署背景与开发者不同的评估者（如独立的外部评估方），而非仅仅依赖自动化工具。这一论点的方法论基础在于覆盖率（coverage），而非效率。作者认为现有评估框架（由开发者预先定义危害集合的模式）本身不太可能自行产生这样的独立评估者，因此需要外部干预或范式转变。

Abstract: Recent studies report that automated red-teaming finds more vulnerabilities, at lower cost, than human red-teaming on standard AI safety benchmarks, and some read this as evidence that human evaluators are becoming dispensable. The comparison measures one thing and the conclusion claims another. A benchmark measures how thoroughly an attacker searches a predefined set of harms, fixed in advance by the developers, and a harm left out of that set is invisible to any attacker working inside it, automated or not. The same blind spot appeared in academic cryptography and in clinical drug trials, where an evaluation that was internally valid stayed silent about the population it was never pointed at. We call the AI-safety version the \emph{threat-model coverage gap}, and find that it persists in a current open-weight model, where harms surface in non-English prompts that English benchmarks miss. Closing it requires evaluators whose deployment context differs from the developers'. The case for those evaluators is methodological, grounded in coverage, and the existing evaluation frame is unlikely to produce them on its own.

</details>


### [572] [SerenAI: State-transition system inspired by text-based world AI models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06647)
*Elvin Babayev,Artem Sinitsa,Arash Hajisharifi,Kabir Bakhshaei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SerenAI，一个基于世界模型的文本状态转换系统，将LLM从自由文本生成转变为输出可验证的结构化预测（因果增量、下一状态、有效性奖励和终止信号），通过参数高效微调和验证器RL两阶段训练显著提升结构化转换预测的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业工作流中广泛使用LLM，但在涉及法律、运营或财务流程时，对无约束自由文本生成的审计解释通常是不可处理的。需要一种可验证的系统来确保生成内容的可靠性和可审计性。

Method: SerenAI受世界模型启发，是一个状态转换系统，输入环境、状态和动作描述后输出4项内容：因果增量、逻辑后续状态、有效性奖励和终止信号。采用两阶段适应训练：参数高效微调(PEFT)后进行基于验证器的强化学习(RL)，使用50,000个因果示例，覆盖12个环境、10个推理域。

Result: 与8B开源基线相比：JSON有效性从85.0%提升至93.2%，模式有效性从55.0%提升至84.0%，精确结构化输出匹配从0%提升至41.5%，因果增量精确匹配从0%提升至41.5%，结果状态精确匹配从0%提升至42.0%，奖励精确匹配从1.0%提升至80.5%，终止信号精确匹配从38.0%提升至81.5%。

Conclusion: 验证器兼容的适应训练能改善结构化转换预测，但尚不能确立法律级可靠性。论文因此提出了面向证据支撑法律工作流的验证协议，包括校准、人工监督和主权本地部署。

Abstract: Although professional workflows leverage large language models widely, the interpretation for auditing unconstrained free-text generation is usually intractable if such generation demands legal, operational or financial workflow. We hereby demonstrate a text based system called SerenAI - inspired by world-models, it is a state transition system that outputs verifiable predictions rather than merely text: Provided with a description of the environment, state, and actions, the generated output contains 4 items: causal deltas that causally effect the given state, a next state that can logically follow from the given state and action, a validity reward, and a termination signal. For the released proto-model, we employ 2 steps of adaptation training, namely parameter efficient fine-tuning followed by verifier based RL over 50,000 exampled cause and effects in 12 environments spanning 10 reasoning domains. Compared to an initial internal evaluation of an 8B open-weight baseline, SerenAI increased JSON validity from 85.0% to 93.2%, schema validity from 55.0% to 84.0%, exact structured-output match from 0.0% to 41.5%, causal-delta exact match from 0.0% to 41.5%, resulting-state exact match from 0.0% to 42.0%, reward exact match from 1.0% to 80.5%, and termination exact match from 38.0% to 81.5%. These support the narrower claim that verifier-compatible adaptation can improve structured transition prediction. They do not yet establish legal-grade reliability. Accordingly, the paper also specifies a validation protocol for evidence-grounded legal workflows, calibration, human oversight, and sovereign on-premise deployment.

</details>


### [573] [A Computational Implementation of a Goal-Directed Theory of Affect](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06654)
*Bernhard Hilpert,Tamás Szűcs,Joost Broekens,Agnes Moors*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次实现了目标导向理论（GDT）的高保真计算模型，将情感视为智能体内部处理周期中差异检测与动作选择交互的副产品，而非事后标签。通过Dice/Corridor等模拟任务验证，复杂情感特征（如预期"提升"和失败"崩溃"）可从简单的目标差异与动作选择期望交互中自然涌现，无需额外专用模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情感计算建模长期面临两难：基于快照的描述性评价模型与缺乏心理学基础的细粒度信号驱动架构之间存在张力。现有方法要么过于简化、要么缺乏心理理论根基，亟需弥合这一鸿沟。

Method: 基于目标导向理论构建计算框架，将情感定义为智能体内部处理周期中差异检测与动作选择持续交互的功能性副产品。通过Dice/Corridor等原则性模拟任务，设计隔离实验以检验多步目标追求过程中的情感特征与动态。

Result: 模拟结果表明，复杂的情绪特征（如预期性"提升"与失败性"崩溃"）能够从目标差异与动作选择期望的简单交互中自然涌现，无需额外专用情感模块。每个计算组件均直接映射到心理理论组件，确保了透明性和可测试性。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了透明、可测试的框架，支持持续的"模拟-实证"研究闭环，推动领域超越"黑箱"启发式方法，迈向将情感细粒度、机制化地整合进智能体行为核心的理解路径。

Abstract: Computational modeling of emotion has long faced a tension between descriptive, "snapshot-based" appraisal models and granular, signal-driven architectures that often lack appropriate psychological grounding. This paper addresses this gap by presenting the first high-fidelity computational implementation of the Goal-Directed Theory (GDT) of affect. In this framework, affect is not a post-hoc label but a functional byproduct emerging from the continuous interplay between discrepancy detection and action selection within an agent's internal processing cycles. We evaluate the model through a series of principled simulations (Dice/Corridor tasks) designed to isolate affective signatures and dynamics during multi-step goal pursuit. Results demonstrate that complex affective profiles, like an anticipatory "lift" and a failure "crash", emerge naturally from simple interactions between goal-discrepancy and action-selection expectancies without requiring additional dedicated modules. By ensuring every computational component maps directly to components of the psychological theory, this work establishes a transparent, testable framework that enables a continuous "simulation-empiry" research loop. Our work contributes to moving the field beyond "black-box" heuristics toward a granular, mechanistic understanding of affect, integrated into the core of agent behavior.

</details>


### [574] [We Built a Mirror and Mistook It for a Mind: Causal Liability and the Fallacy of AI Consciousness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06715)
*Afshin Khadangi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文挑战"AI本身就是意识承载者"的隐含假设，提出"AI意识谬误"：生成系统能以第一人称形式返回人类内在性的语言痕迹，却不必然存在有意识的承载者。作者提出因果责任理论（CLT），将责任闭合作为个体化候选承载者的标准，并通过开放权重因果审计在多个模型家族中验证了该区分的实验可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当代关于机器意识的争论基于一个隐蔽前提——被称为"AI"的对象已经构成了意识可能归属的那种实体。作者希望挑战这一假设，将现象意识、内省报告与人类投射性内省三者分离，指出第一人称语言输出并不能直接推论出意识的存在，从而澄清意识归因中的逻辑混淆。

Method: 提出因果责任理论（CLT）：CLT-I以责任闭合作为个体化候选承载者的标准，即物理上持续的过程成为由自身内源区分所产生约束的不可委托继承者；CLT-II提出更强猜想，认为责任闭合是极简现象主体性的充要条件。通过开放权重因果审计（含强制区分、激活修补、活体与复制自适应状态对比、分离重建等实验）跨多个模型家族进行操作化验证。

Result: 强制区分产生持续的下游发散；激活修补显示强因果中介；在匹配随机性下，活体与复制自适应状态行为上完全相同；分离重建在过程替换下保留了计算状态，但按协议切断了构成连续性与不可委托继承。结果表明CLT-I的区分在实验上是可处理的，能将因果承载者结构与第一人称表现相分离。

Conclusion: 该框架可将意识归因、因果承载者个体化以及意识构成的独立形而上学问题三者分离，为机器意识争论提供了更为精确的概念基础。

Abstract: The contemporary debate over machine consciousness begins from a concealed assumption: that the object called "AI" already constitutes the kind of entity to which consciousness could belong. This paper challenges that assumption by separating phenomenal consciousness, introspective report, and human projective introspection, then arguing that generative systems can return linguistic traces of human interiority in first-person form without thereby identifying a phenomenal bearer. We call the resulting inference the AI Consciousness Fallacy. We then introduce Causal Liability Theory (CLT). CLT-I proposes liability closure as a criterion for individuating a candidate bearer: a physically continuing process becomes the non-delegable inheritor of constraints generated by its own endogenous discriminations. CLT-II advances the stronger conjecture that liability closure is necessary and sufficient for minimal phenomenal subjecthood. An open-weight causal audit operationalizes CLT-I across multiple model families. Forced discriminations produced persistent downstream divergence; activation patching showed strong causal mediation; live and copied adaptive states were behaviorally identical under matched randomness; and detached reconstruction preserved computational state across process replacement while, by protocol, breaking constitutive continuity and non-delegable inheritance. These results show that CLT-I distinctions are experimentally tractable and can dissociate causal bearer structure from first-person performance. The framework therefore separates consciousness attribution, causal bearer individuation, and the independent metaphysical question of consciousness constitution.

</details>


### [575] [Monte Carlo-Based Ex-Ante Assessment of the Green Benefits of an AI-Driven Smart Agriculture Platform in Hainan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06737)
*Zhaoyang Li,Ruijie Zhang,Zhaoji Sun,Lu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对智慧农业平台缺乏绿色价值统一量化评估框架的问题，以热带农业AI决策平台为对象，构建了从摇篮到农场大门的农业碳核算模型，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟传播参数不确定性。在海南三种作物场景全采纳情景下，农药、化肥、灌溉水和碳强度分别中位减少23.5%、21.0%、16.5%和21.5%，并提供了可复现的前瞻性绿色价值评估方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智慧农业平台被视为中国农药化肥减量、节水降碳的重要载体，但缺乏统一的定量评估框架来衡量其绿色价值，难以进行前瞻性评估和试点观测设计。

Method: 以集成大语言模型问答、多模态病虫害诊断、物联网感知、卫星遥感和闭环田间记录系统的热带农业AI决策平台为对象，构建覆盖农药化肥生产、田间N2O、灌溉电力和稻田CH4的摇篮到农场大门碳核算模型，将平台干预转化为可量化传导参数，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟在海南芒果、冬菜、水稻（南繁）三种情景（面积加权40%:30%:30%）中传播参数不确定性，辅以Sobol一阶敏感性分析和收敛性检验。

Result: 全采纳情景下，农药使用中位减少23.5%（90%区间15.0%-33.2%），化肥减少21.0%（13.8%-28.9%），灌溉水减少16.5%（10.9%-23.5%），碳强度降低21.5%（16.1%-27.2%）。化肥减量≥15%达成概率90.6%，碳明确下降概率98.1%，但总节水≥20%概率仅约20%。Sobol分析显示测土推荐和有机替代共同解释约83%的碳强度降低方差。万次迭代使统计量稳定，并报告了保守/基线/乐观情景边界。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了可复现、可校准的前瞻性绿色价值评估方法论，支持智慧农业平台的试点观测设计与情景化政策声明，弥补了该领域统一量化评估框架的缺失。

Abstract: Smart agriculture platforms are widely regarded as key carriers for implementing China's pesticide and fertilizer reduction, water-saving and carbon-reduction agendas, yet a unified quantitative framework for assessing their green value is still lacking. Taking an AI-driven decision platform for tropical agriculture as the object (integrating large-language-model question answering, multimodal pest diagnosis, IoT sensing, satellite remote sensing, and a closed-loop field record system), this study builds a cradle-to-farm-gate agricultural carbon accounting model covering pesticide and fertilizer production, field N2O, irrigation electricity and paddy CH4, translates platform interventions into quantifiable transmission parameters, and propagates parameter uncertainty by Monte Carlo simulation over three Hainan scenarios (mango, winter vegetable, rice/nanfan, area-weighted 40%:30%:30%). Under full adoption, median reductions are 23.5% (90% interval 15.0%-33.2%) for pesticide use, 21.0% (13.8%-28.9%) for fertilizer, 16.5% (10.9%-23.5%) for irrigation water, and 21.5% (16.1%-27.2%) for carbon intensity. Attainment probabilities are high for fertilizer reduction >=15% (90.6%) and clear carbon decline (98.1%), but only about 20% for aggregate water saving >=20%, favoring scenario-specific statements. Sobol first-order indices show soil-test recommendation and organic substitution jointly explain about 83% of the variance of aggregate carbon-intensity reduction. Convergence tests show 10,000 iterations stabilize all statistics; conservative/baseline/optimistic scenario bounds are reported. The framework offers a reproducible, calibration-ready methodology for ex-ante green-value assessment and pilot observation design.

</details>


### [576] [Simulating the Marginal Green Contribution of AI Modules in a Smart-Agriculture Platform: Evidence from Two Monte Carlo Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06740)
*Zhaoyang Li,Ruijie Zhang,Zhaoji Sun,Lu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文基于平台级蒙特卡洛评估框架，将智慧农业平台拆分为AI诊断、IoT感知和决策推送等明确组件，通过两个受控仿真实验量化各组件对绿色效益（农药/化肥减量、节水、甲烷减排）的独立贡献，并发现农民采纳率是达成绿色目标的首要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智慧农业平台通常将AI诊断、IoT感知与决策推送捆绑打包，导致各组件对绿色效益的贡献不清晰，资源配置缺乏定量依据。需要通过组件级拆解为资源分配决策提供量化证据。

Method: 将AI能力-农民行为-农化投入削减的因果链条显式建模，将农药/化肥削减量分解为可避免盲目施用比例×处方有效性×决策触达覆盖率×采纳率的乘积；设计两个受控仿真实验——实验1比较经验推广模式与AI模式下的农药/化肥削减概率；实验2比较现状(P0)、IoT工程改造(P1)、P1+AI灌溉调度(P2)三种方案的节水与甲烷减排效果，并进行敏感性分析。

Result: 实验1显示，AI模式下农药削减20%的概率由传统推广模式的近零提升至基线的20.7%，在诊断精度0.95和采纳率0.85时可达到49%；化肥削减15%的概率升至52.0%。实验2显示，中位节水率由现状7.8%(P0)提升至工程改造11.0%(P1)和AI调度16.0%(P2)，AI在工程基础上额外增加5.0个百分点；AI调度下稻田甲烷减排达30.5%，优于人工操作的19.8%，稻作灌溉-甲烷子系统碳强度下降27.9%。敏感性分析一致表明农民采纳率是主要瓶颈，且AI数据融合对土壤湿度感知误差具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 提供了一个可复现的组件级绿色价值评估与推广策略优化仿真框架，为智慧农业平台的各组件贡献解耦和资源配置提供定量依据，指导推广投入应优先解决农民采纳率问题而非单纯追求算法精度。

Abstract: Smart agriculture platforms usually bundle AI diagnosis, IoT sensing and decision push into a single package, so the green benefit attributable to each component remains unclear and resource-allocation decisions lack quantitative evidence. Building on a previous platform-level Monte Carlo assessment, this paper makes the components explicit and runs two controlled simulation experiments. Experiment 1 follows the chain from AI capability to farmer behavior to agrochemical input reduction, modeling pesticide/fertilizer reduction as avoidable blind-application share times prescription effectiveness times decision-touch coverage times adoption rate, and compares an experienced-extension mode with the AI mode: the probability of reaching 20% pesticide reduction is essentially zero in the extension mode but 20.7% at baseline, up to 49% with diagnosis accuracy 0.95 and adoption 0.85 under AI; the probability of 15% fertilizer reduction rises from near zero to 52.0%. Experiment 2 compares current practice (P0), IoT engineering retrofit (P1), and P1 plus AI irrigation scheduling (P2): median aggregate water saving rises from 7.8% (P0) to 11.0% (P1) and 16.0% (P2), with AI adding 5.0 percentage points beyond engineering; paddy CH4 reduction reaches 30.5% under AI scheduling versus 19.8% under manual operation, and the rice irrigation-methane subsystem carbon intensity declines 27.9%. Sensitivity analyses of both experiments consistently indicate that the primary bottleneck for meeting green targets is farmer adoption rather than algorithm accuracy, and that AI data fusion is robust to soil-moisture sensing errors. This work provides a reproducible simulation framework for component-level green-value evaluation and promotion-strategy optimization of smart agriculture platforms.

</details>


### [577] [Reason Through the Latent! Making Latent Visual Reasoning Necessary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06746)
*Suhyeong Park,Junha Jung,Jaewoo Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出因果视觉循环推理（CVRR），通过确保循环计算成为预测所需的唯一图像条件路径，解决"潜在状态包含视觉信息≠模型实际依赖该状态推理"的问题。CVRR保留预训练视觉能力，使循环状态成为唯一携带图像信息的通道，在V*, MMVP, BLINK, MME-RealWorld-Lite基准上保持强性能，并通过因果干预验证预测确实依赖循环内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在视觉推理（latent visual reasoning）试图通过隐藏状态计算而非显式文本链式思维进行多模态推理。然而，视觉信息存在于潜在状态并不能保证模型在产生答案时真正依赖该状态，因为可能存在其他图像条件路径。作者希望区分"潜在信息性"（latent informativeness）与"实际被用于预测的潜在计算"（latent computation actually used for prediction）。

Method: CVRR的核心设计：(1) 利用预训练视觉-语言模型，在图像融入后从问题隐藏状态初始化循环过程；(2) 反复更新该状态同时重读相同固定的视觉证据；(3) 在解码前移除视觉状态和原始多模态KV缓存，确保只有最终的循环状态携带图像条件信息到答案。这使得循环计算成为预测必需的图像条件路径。

Result: 在V*, MMVP, BLINK, MME-RealWorld-Lite四个基准上，CVRR在严格接口下保持强性能；兼容的潜在推理器即使在同一约束下重训练也无法恢复相当的视觉能力。因果干预表明：在问题固定时，预测对循环内容保持敏感变化，且持续的视觉证据能因果地修正循环轨迹。

Conclusion: 该工作证明可以通过严格接口设计（移除图像后残余的可见性）确保潜在循环状态携带的图像信息真正因果地驱动预测，从而将"潜在推理"从信息论上的存在性提升到因果可验证的计算路径。这种区分对于理解和设计真正依赖潜在视觉推理的模型具有重要意义。

Abstract: Latent visual reasoning aims to perform multimodal reasoning through hidden-state computation rather than explicit textual chains of thought. However, visual information being present in a latent state does not imply that the model actually relies on that state when producing its answer, especially when alternative image-conditioned paths remain available. We introduce \textbf{C}ausal \textbf{V}isual \textbf{R}ecurrent \textbf{R}easoning (CVRR), which preserves pretrained visual competence while making recurrent computation the required image-conditioned path to prediction. CVRR initializes recurrence from the question hidden state after the pretrained vision-language model has incorporated the image, then repeatedly updates this state while re-reading the same fixed visual evidence. Before decoding, visual states and the original multimodal KV cache are removed so that only the final recurrent state carries image-conditioned information to the answer. Across the $V^*$, MMVP, BLINK, and MME-RealWorld-Lite benchmarks, CVRR retains strong performance under this strict interface, while compatible latent reasoners fail to recover comparable visual competence even when retrained under the same constraint. Causal interventions further show that predictions remain sensitive to recurrent content when the question is held fixed, and that persistent visual evidence causally revises the recurrent trajectory. These results distinguish latent informativeness from latent computation that is actually used for prediction.

</details>


### [578] [Improving Proficiency and Efficiency of Android GUI Agents via Self-Generating Tool Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06792)
*Juyong Lee,Woogyeol Jin,Kimin Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DroidTool框架，通过智能体工作流自动生成工具（Python函数），将这些工具与GUI动作结合形成混合动作空间，用于增强Android智能体。生成工具的效率提升显著：性能提高约4.47个百分点，交互次数减少约20.05%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Android智能体采用结合GUI动作和工具动作（如通过API访问应用数据）的混合动作空间仍未被充分探索，主要障碍在于创建工具需要过多的人力成本。现有方法缺乏自动化工具生成机制，限制了混合动作空间智能体的发展。

Method: DroidTool框架包含两大核心机制：(1) 自生成工具，将工具实现为操作应用状态（如数据库）的Python函数；(2) 智能体工作流，包含提案、实现、测试生成与执行、修复四个阶段。值得注意的是，测试阶段不是孤立地测试每个工具，而是构建跨相关工具的关系型测试，以自然准备适当的测试前置条件并提升测试覆盖率。

Result: 在AndroidWorld、B-MoCA和MobileSafetyBench三个代表性基准上，相较于仅使用GUI的智能体，经过生成工具增强的GUI智能体平均性能提升约4.47个百分点，交互次数减少约20.05%。

Conclusion: DroidTool验证了自生成工具与GUI结合形成的混合动作空间能够显著提升Android智能体的任务完成效率和性能，同时大幅减少人工创建工具的成本，为混合动作空间智能体研究提供了一种可行的自动化路径。

Abstract: Android agents using a hybrid action space that combines GUI actions and tool actions (e.g., accessing application data via APIs) remain largely underexplored, mainly due to the excessive effort required to create tools. To address this gap, we introduce DroidTool, a framework for augmenting the agents with self-generated tools, which are realized as Python functions operating on application states (e.g., a database). To create tools with minimal human labor, DroidTool employs an agentic workflow featuring stages: proposal, implementation, test generation and execution, and repair. Notably, when testing the created tools for verification, it constructs relational tests across relevant tools for natural preparation of appropriate test preconditions and improved test coverage, rather than testing each tool separately. The GUI agents augmented with the generated tools achieved approximately 4.47%p higher performance with approximately 20.05% fewer interactions than the GUI-only agents, averaged across representative benchmarks: AndroidWorld, B-MoCA, and MobileSafetyBench.

</details>


### [579] [Unsound Search with Policy and Value Networks in Legends of Code and Magic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06816)
*Dustin Rubin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究在Legends of Code and Magic（LoCM）集换式卡牌游戏中，尽管通常认为枚举信念状态下的搜索在同类游戏中不可行，但作者通过测量三个先前定义的性质发现LoCM处于有利区域，并构建了结合模仿学习策略/价值网络与不完美信息搜索的智能体，以51.35%胜率击败了不使用搜索的冠军ByteRL，且该智能体在无搜索时仅得26.8%（搜索贡献+24.6分），同时对最佳响应攻击展现出比ByteRL更强的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"枚举型搜索在集换式卡牌游戏中不可用"的既有论断（因信念状态规模达2^101），验证不完美信息游戏中的非严格蒙特卡洛搜索是否也能有效且稳健地工作。

Method: 先测量三个可预测完美信息蒙特卡洛缺陷成本的性质，确认LoCM处于有利区域；然后模仿学习亚军策略NeteaseOPD构建策略与价值前馈网络；智能体在从对手牌组先验（由亚军选牌流程构建）采样的世界上进行搜索；在战斗阶段使用最严格配置与ByteRL对战1万局；并复制针对ByteRL的已发表最佳响应攻击以测试自身智能体的鲁棒性。

Result: 最严格配置下以51.35%（95% CI [50.37, 52.33]）胜率击败ByteRL（10,000局官方裁判与时限）；无搜索时该智能体仅得26.8%，加入搜索提升24.6个点；两个搜索配置在每轮最佳响应攻击迭代中均比ByteRL抵抗得更好。

Conclusion: 在LoCM这类集换式卡牌游戏中，非严格（unsound）搜索不仅能显著提升强度，而且比无搜索冠军更抗最佳响应攻击，说明搜索在此类不完美信息游戏中是可利用且有利的，反驳了此前认为搜索不可用的观点。

Abstract: Decision-time search in perfect and imperfect information games with enumerable belief states are effective methods for game AI. Collectible card games are imperfect information games with large belief states. Legends of Code and Magic is a collectible card game competition where the belief states are $2^{101}$. The Legends of Code and Magic (LoCM) champion, ByteRL, plays with no search. Other works claim sound enumeration-based search is unusable in the genre due to the number of belief states. We measured three previously defined properties that predict where theoretically unsound perfect information Monte Carlo's defects are cheap and found LoCM sits in the favorable region. Starting with imitation learning of the runner-up policy, NeteaseOPD, we created a policy and value feed-forward network. Our agent searches over worlds sampled from a prior over the opponent's deck built from the runner-up's drafts. Using our strictest configuration in the battle phase we beat ByteRL with a win percentage of 51.35% 95% CI [50.37, 52.33], over 10,000 pre-registered games using the LoCM official referee and time limit. Search is not a minor factor on the matchup between our agent and ByteRL. Without search this agent scores 26.8% and adding search adds +24.6 points. Unsound search in imperfect information games could be exploitable. We replicate a published best-response attack against ByteRL. We then apply the same attack protocol to two search configurations of our agent, and each one resists it better than ByteRL at every iteration. In LoCM unsound search gives us a stronger and more resilient agent.

</details>


### [580] [NormViz: A Benchmark and Framework for Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Global Cultures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06831)
*Akhila Yerukola,Fabrice Y Harel-Canada,Simran Khanuja,Abhinav Sukumar Rao,Ashima Suvarna,Nanyun Peng,Saadia Gabriel,Maarten Sap*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NormViz领域概念，并构建NormViz-Bench基准（3,268组对比图像对，覆盖16国）和NormViz-Train训练集（64k图像），用于评估和提升多模态AI对视觉社会规范的推理能力。最强VLM在基准上表现仅约26.6%对级准确率，微调后相对提升最高达125%，表明该领域是具挑战性且重要的前沿方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文化理解研究仅关注纯文本情境或视觉物品识别（如食物、服饰），缺乏对可通过视觉观察的行为是否符合当地社会规范的推理能力评估，即"视觉规范理解"，这一未被探索的盲区限制AI服务文化多样人群的能力。

Method: 1) 构建NormViz-Bench：3,268对人类验证的对比图像对（6,536张图），覆盖16国，每对仅变化文化相关行为（物体、属性、空间关系、动作），标注为符合/违反/无关当地规范；2) 引入对级评估要求两图均正确分类以防浅层视觉捷径；3) 构建NormViz-Train：64k带解释的训练图片集，用于微调VLM。

Result: 最强模型Gemini 3.0 Flash和Qwen2.5 VL 7B仅分别达到26.6%和21.6%对级准确率，在识别违规与文化中性视觉行为上最为困难；使用NormViz-Train微调后，Qwen3-VL 4B和8B对级准确率相对提升分别高达125%和36%，但绝对性能仍低于30%。

Conclusion: NormViz-Bench与NormViz-Train共同确立了视觉规范理解作为多模态AI极具挑战性与重要性的前沿问题；尽管微调展示出将视觉感知与文化意义联结的可行路径，绝对性能偏低说明该方向仍需持续探索。

Abstract: AI systems are used worldwide, but they struggle to serve the needs of culturally diverse populations. Prior work on cultural understanding evaluates AI systems on text-only settings or on visual artifact recognition (e.g. foods, clothing). The ability to reason about visually observable behaviors through local social norms, which we call visual norm understanding, remains unexamined. We introduce NormViz-Bench, a high quality, human-validated benchmark of 3,268 contrastive image pairs (6,536 images) spanning 16 countries. Each pair varies only in the culturally relevant behavior (e.g., objects, attributes, spatial relations, and actions) that alters how each image is interpreted. Each image is labeled as conforming to, violating, or irrelevant to local social norms, and pair-level evaluation requires both images to be correctly classified, thereby preventing reliance on superficial visual shortcuts. Even the strongest VLMs, Gemini 3.0 Flash and Qwen2.5 VL 7B, succeed on only 26.6% and 21.6% of pairs, struggling most with identifying violating and culturally benign visual behaviors. Towards bridging this, we introduce NormViz-Train, a training dataset of 64k images paired with explanations. Though absolute performance remains low (<30%), finetuning on NormViz-Train improves pair accuracy relatively by up to 125% and 36% Qwen3-VL 4B and 8B respectively, showing a path forward to teach models to connect visual perception to cultural significance. Together, NormViz-Bench and NormViz-Train establish visual norm understanding as a challenging and consequential frontier for multimodal AI.

</details>


### [581] [Learning transferable human physiology from two million hours of sleep with SleepFM-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06849)
*Rahul Thapa,Christopher Sun,William Theodor Lehn-Schioler,Sophia Claire Kivelson,Umaer Hanif,Hyatt Moore,Harrison G. Zhang,Hafsa Ahmed,Marcus Dige,Niels R. Lorenzen,Elisabeth Roxane M. Heremans,Adrien Specht,Ulysse Gimenez,Robin Guillard,Andreas Brink-Kjaer,James Zou,Emmanuel Mignot*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍SleepFM-2，一个基于282,511次多导睡眠图（PSG）记录（来自26个队列，含235,865次预训练，超200万小时多模态生理数据）训练的睡眠基础模型。相比SleepFM，它在疾病预测和睡眠分期上表现更好，支持觉醒、肢体运动和呼吸事件检测，并可迁移至可穿戴传感和主观睡眠表型。其PSG表征结合年龄、性别和BMI后，在215个后续记录的EHR表型中达到预设的判别力和显著性标准，其中155个表型中PSG表征提供了超越人口统计学的可复现信息。疾病评分揭示了与sigma频段空间耦合降低和低密度熵增加相关的可复现主成分。冻结编码器在睡眠事件上的表现处于专家评分者观察范围内，并可迁移至清醒期EEG、头带/耳内EEG、腕部PPG和腕部加速度计等传感器。研究证明多模态睡眠生理学可提供跨疾病、临床任务、传感器和主观体验的可迁移健康表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 睡眠是反映健康状况的重要窗口，能同时捕捉大脑、心脏、肌肉和呼吸系统的协调活动。作者旨在构建一个强大的睡眠基础模型，使其不仅能完成传统的睡眠分期和事件检测，还能预测广泛的疾病表型，并在不同传感器和临床任务间迁移，从而提供一种多模态、可转移的健康表征。

Method: SleepFM-2在大规模多模态PSG数据上预训练（282,511次记录，26个队列，超200万小时），涵盖EEG、心率、肌肉和呼吸系统信号。模型通过结合PSG表征与年龄、性别、BMI等人口统计信息来预测EHR表型，并与480特征的基线及SleepFM进行比较。此外，冻结编码器被用于评估睡眠事件检测、跨传感器迁移（可穿戴EEG、PPG、加速度计等）及主观睡眠表型捕捉能力。

Result: SleepFM-2在215个EHR表型上达到预设判别力和显著性标准，其中155个表型PSG表征提供了超过人口统计学信息的可复现增量。冻结编码器在睡眠事件上表现与专家评分者相当，成功迁移至多种可穿戴传感器，并在六个加速度计队列中改善睡眠分期。在UK Biobank中，其疾病预测性能接近直接在加速度计上预训练的模型。此外，疾病评分揭示了与sigma频段空间耦合降低和低密度熵增加相关的可复现主成分，并捕捉了常规PSG摘要无法恢复的主观睡眠体验。

Conclusion: 多模态睡眠生理学能够提供跨疾病、临床任务、传感器和主观体验的可迁移健康表征，SleepFM-2验证了睡眠数据作为全面健康评估窗口的潜力，具有重要的临床及研究应用前景。

Abstract: Sleep provides a nightly window into health by capturing coordinated activity across the brain, heart, muscles and respiratory system. We introduce SleepFM-2, a sleep foundation model developed and evaluated on 282,511 polysomnography recordings from 26 cohorts, including 235,865 used for pretraining. These data span more than two million hours of multimodal physiology. Compared with SleepFM, SleepFM-2 improves disease prediction and sleep scoring, supports arousal, limb movement and respiratory event detection, and transfers to wearable sensing and subjective sleep phenotypes. A model combining its PSG representation with age, sex and BMI met a prespecified discrimination and significance criterion for 215 subsequently recorded EHR phenotypes in two held-out cohorts, including one health system unseen during pretraining. For 155 phenotypes, the PSG representation added reproducible information beyond demographics. SleepFM-2 also outperformed a 480-feature baseline derived from the same recordings. Its disease scores revealed a reproducible principal component associated with reduced sigma-band spatial coupling and increased hypnodensity entropy. The frozen encoder performed within the observed range of expert scorers for sleep events and transferred to wakeful EEG, headband and in-ear EEG, wrist PPG and wrist accelerometry. It improved sleep staging across six accelerometry cohorts and achieved disease-prediction performance in UK Biobank similar to models pretrained directly on accelerometry. Finally, SleepFM-2 captured aspects of subjective sleep not recovered by conventional PSG summaries, particularly reports of the recorded night. These results show that multimodal sleep physiology can provide a transferable representation of human health across diseases, clinical tasks, sensors and subjective experience.

</details>


### [582] [A visual large language foundational model for medical image recognition using clinician-oriented social media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06914)
*Lingxuan Hou,Yuhua Xie,Yue Hu,Yan Zhuang,Junqi Li,Chengzhi Xia,Binh Phu Nguyen,Abubakar Siddique,Minh Nguyen,Yao Hou,Yanju Bao,Kexin Liu,Ke Chen,Jianjun Sun,Zeqi Li,Trung Nguyen,Jiangli Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了ThoughtMed-1M，一个包含超过一百万对长形式医学视觉问答数据的数据集，来源于临床医生社交媒体的匿名医学图像和专家评论，并通过高级LLM与临床医生验证流水线构建。基于此数据集训练了FOLTMed模型，在42个医学VQA基准上达到SOTA（宏准确率85.4%），并在事实性和相似性指标上超越现有模型3-5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM在医学领域展现出潜力，但医学应用中缺乏能够捕捉临床推理和显式图像-文本对齐的视觉问答（VQA）数据集，这限制了多模态LLM在临床场景中的发展。

Method: 利用临床医生导向社交媒体上的去标识医学图像和专家评论，结合先进LLM与临床医生在环验证，构建了严格的流水线来生成ThoughtMed-1M数据集（超过100万VQA对），并训练了FOLTMed（基于ThoughtMed-1M训练的基础LLM）。

Result: FOLTMed在42个医学VQA基准测试上取得SOTA性能，宏准确率达85.4%；在ThoughtMed-1M测试集上生成更具临床连贯性的响应，在事实性和相似性指标上比SOTA模型高出3-5%。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了一种可扩展的范式，用于推进临床接地多模态LLM的研究，缓解了医学VQA数据稀缺问题，为临床推理与图像-文本对齐提供了高质量的大规模数据资源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across diverse domains, showing considerable potential in medicine. However, their application in medical settings remains limited by the scarcity of visual question answering (VQA) datasets that capture clinical reasoning and explicit image-text alignment. Here, we leverage de-identified medical images and expert commentaries shared on clinician-oriented social media. By combining an advanced LLM with clinician-in-the-loop verification, we established a rigorous pipeline to construct ThoughtMed-1M, a long-form medical VQA dataset containing over one million VQA pairs and designed to capture structured clinical logic and medical image-text alignment. To demonstrate its utility, we developed a FOundational LLM Trained on ThoughtMed-1M (FOLTMed). FOLTMed achieved state-of-the-art performance across 42 medical VQA benchmark datasets, with a macro accuracy of 85.4%, and generated more clinically coherent responses on the ThoughtMed-1M test set. It outperformed state-of-the-art models by 3--5% across factuality and similarity metrics, highlighting a scalable paradigm for advancing research on clinically grounded multimodal LLMs.

</details>


### [583] [When and Why LLM Causal Priors Help: Closed-Loop Prior Selection for Amortized Causal Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06941)
*Haohao Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个闭环先验选择框架（closed-loop prior selection framework），将LLM蒸馏出的因果图注入Do-PFN等先验数据拟合网络（PFN）的过程形式化为一个预算约束的优化问题。框架通过廉价后训练和复合评分（以真实域泛化为主导）从候选先验池中选出优胜者，再进行完整训练和统计验证。在7.34M参数的Do-PFN上，优胜者取得2.75倍的显著增益，且机制实验表明增益依赖于蒸馏图的语义内容而非单纯的结构多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PFN（Prior-data fitted networks）通过程序化生成合成因果任务来摊销因果效应估计，但其性能高度依赖于合成训练先验，而先验目前由人工设计，成为瓶颈（Do-PFN和CausalPFN均承认此问题）。虽然LLM能够生成合理的因果图可作为先验材料，但注入是否有效、增益来源何处、何时有效等问题此前依赖手动试错，缺乏系统性方法。

Method: 提出闭环先验选择框架：将先验注入建模为对候选先验池的预算约束优化。候选先验经过廉价（cheap）后训练，由包含真实域泛化的复合指标评分，选择优胜者后进行完整训练和成对统计验证。机制实验通过对比语义内容与结构多样性来探究增益来源。

Result: 在7.34M参数的Do-PFN上，框架选出的优胜者在主要评估域获得统计学显著的2.75倍增益，误差低于未注入的官方基线。相邻监控域的泛化显著提升，且无受监控能力退化。机制实验（方向性证据）表明增益取决于蒸馏图的语义内容，而非仅结构多样性。

Conclusion: 该框架使LLM因果先验的使用从手动试错转变为可经验验证的选择问题。语义内容而非结构多样性是增益来源的这一规律，为未来先验注入实践提供了指导原则。

Abstract: Causal effect estimation asks how an outcome would change under an intervention, and medicine, economics, and public policy all treat it as a foundational task. Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) amortize the task: a model trained on large numbers of programmatically generated synthetic causal tasks reads a new problem's observational data into context and returns an interventional-effect estimate in a single forward pass. The capability of such models is largely determined by the synthetic training prior, which is currently designed by hand, a bottleneck acknowledged by both Do-PFN and CausalPFN. Large language models (LLMs) can now ``draw'' plausible causal graphs for a given domain, suggesting that LLM-distilled graphs could serve as prior material. Whether injecting such graphs helps at all, where any gain comes from, and when injection helps. Practice has so far relied on manual trial and error. We propose a \emph{closed-loop prior selection framework} that casts prior injection as a budget-constrained optimization over a candidate prior pool. Candidates undergo cheap post-training and are scored by a composite metric dominated by real-domain generalization; the winner then receives full training and paired statistical validation. On a 7.34M-parameter Do-PFN, the framework's winner attains a formally significant $2.75\times$ gain on the primary evaluation domain, and its error falls below that of the uninjected official base. Generalization on an adjacent monitoring domain improves significantly, and no monitored capability degrades. Mechanism experiments show that the gain depends on the semantic content of the distilled graph rather than its structural diversity alone does not produce it (directional evidence). With this framework and this regularity in hand, the use of LLM causal priors stops being manual trial and error and becomes an empirically verifiable selection problem.

</details>


### [584] [iBrain: A Unified Foundation Model Reading the Brain from Surface to Spikes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06960)
*Ying Chen,Tiou Wang,Zhifeng Yue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出iBrain，一个统一的基础模型，能够联合学习iEEG和尖峰活动两种侵入式神经记录信号。通过信号特异性编码器和共享时空Transformer主干，在7000多小时异构神经记录上预训练，采用掩码信号重建和通道视图对齐方法，在多个基准上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经基础模型大多针对单一侵入式记录范式独立开发，缺乏对iEEG和皮层内尖峰活动等异构侵入性信号的联合预训练探索，无法充分利用不同时空尺度的神经动力学信息。

Method: iBrain采用信号特异性编码器适配不同信号特征，通过共享的时空Transformer主干建模记录通道间和时间上的依赖关系。使用掩码信号重建和通道视图对齐两种预训练目标，在超过7000小时的异构神经记录数据上进行预训练。

Result: iBrain在多个基准上一致优于单信号预训练基线，达到SOTA性能；进一步实验表明其在不同记录设置下展现出良好的可迁移性和数据效率。

Conclusion: 异构侵入式神经记录的联合预训练具有潜力，能够支持可扩展的神经建模及跨记录设置和下游任务的可迁移表征。

Abstract: Invasive neural recordings provide high-fidelity measurements of brain activity, with signals such as intracranial EEG (iEEG) and intracortical spiking activity capturing neural dynamics at different spatial and temporal scales. Yet existing neural foundation models have largely been developed independently for different invasive recording paradigms, leaving joint pretraining across heterogeneous invasive signals underexplored. In this work, we introduce iBrain, a unified foundation model that jointly learns from iEEG and spiking activity. iBrain employs signal-specific encoders to accommodate their distinct signal characteristics and a shared spatiotemporal Transformer backbone to model dependencies across recording channels and time. We pretrain iBrain on over 7,000 hours of heterogeneous neural recordings using masked signal reconstruction and channel-view alignment, promoting contextual modeling of neural dynamics and robustness across different channels. iBrain consistently outperforms single-signal pretraining baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks. Further experiments demonstrate that iBrain exhibits transferability and data efficiency across diverse recording settings. These results highlight the potential of joint pretraining on heterogeneous invasive neural recordings to support scalable neural modeling and transferable representations across recording settings and downstream tasks.

</details>


### [585] [SSP-DMGTimeNet: Physics-Constrained Learning for Spatiotemporal Trajectory Prediction of Vehicle Platoons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06961)
*Yuhang Wang,Kailang Ma,Zirui Li,Mingfeng Fan,Kitae Jang,Changju Lee,Heye Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SSP-DMGTimeNet，一个物理约束学习的车辆队列时空轨迹预测框架，通过传播延迟感知的因果注意力机制和时频域弦稳定性损失，在保证轨迹预测精度的同时确保扰动沿队列的传播具有真实性（弦稳定）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跟驰预测方法主要优化轨迹精度，很少考虑预测扰动是否沿车辆队列真实传播，可能导致预测结果"精确但不稳定"（string-unstable），即扰动在队列中被错误放大。

Method: 1) 结合多尺度时间表示与跨车辆交互特征捕捉时变队列动力学；2) 提出传播延迟感知的因果注意力机制，显式建模上游到下游的扰动传播（学习相邻车辆间响应延迟并沿队列累积）；3) 设计时域和频域的弦稳定性损失，在训练中抑制相邻车辆及任意子队列的扰动放大。

Result: 在HighD上，五车队列的不稳定窗口率为0.65%，真实激励子集的最大首尾放大为0.898，同时保持有竞争力的轨迹预测性能。在NGSIM US-101和I-80的零样本评估中，速度MAE分别为1.316和1.252 m/s，不稳定窗口率为3.90%和4.10%。

Conclusion: 结合队列级物理约束可以有效平衡轨迹预测精度与扰动传播稳定性，证明了将物理先验融入深度学习框架的可行性。
