  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态层路由方法将每个路由决策视为仅依赖当前隐藏状态的局部操作，忽略了路由沿深度方向的序列性和路径依赖性——早期决策会影响下游路由器看到的表示，且层利用目标联合耦合所有决策。

Method: 引入路由器记忆机制，通过线性注意力逐步将先前的路由分数及其引发的残差更新聚合为紧凑的历史表示。在每层路由时，路由器联合当前隐藏表示与累积历史状态来选择执行分支。采用token级FFN路由，在冻结的预训练骨干上仅训练轻量路由器与适配器。

Result: 在Llama 3.1-8B上绕过26.87%的模型参数达到密集模型100.24%的性能；在更紧计算预算下绕过38.82%参数保持97.01%性能。消融实验证实移除路由历史会一致性地造成性能下降，尤其在多步推理和代码生成任务上最为显著。

Conclusion: 显式的路由记忆能够使动态路由更准确和更具适应性，证明了仅依赖隐藏状态的条件路由存在固有缺陷，而引入序列化的历史信息是提升路由质量的有效途径。

Abstract: Dynamic layer routing reduces the inference cost of Large Language Models (LLMs) by learning to skip layers for individual tokens. Existing methods, however, treat each routing decision as a local operation conditioned solely on the current hidden state which is a formulation that overlooks the sequential, path-dependent nature of routing across depth: earlier decisions shape the representations seen by downstream routers, and the layer-usage objective couples all decisions jointly. We propose History-Aware Routing (HeRo), a dynamic routing framework that resolves this mismatch by introducing a router memory mechanism to maintain an explicit routing state across model depth. The memory is constructed via linear attention, incrementally aggregating preceding routing scores and their induced residual updates into a compact history representation. At each routed layer, the router conditions jointly on this accumulated state and the current hidden representation to select the executed branch. Instantiated for token-wise FFN routing, HeRo trains only lightweight routers and adapters on a frozen backbone, requiring no modification to pretrained parameters. Across Llama 3.1-8B, Llama 2-7B, and Llama 2-13B, HeRo consistently achieves the highest aggregate performance retention among ten baselines. On Llama 3.1-8B, it bypasses 26.87% of model parameters while achieving 100.24% of dense model performance across seven benchmarks, and retains 97.01% while bypassing 38.82% of model parameters under a tighter computation budget. Ablation studies confirm that removing routing history consistently degrades performance, most notably on multistep reasoning and code generation, validating that explicit routing memory enables more accurate and adaptive dynamic routing than solely conditioning on hidden state.

</details>


### [651] [A Better Spur Should Start From Each Objective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08211)
*Shanwen Mao,Hao Zhang,Guangtao nie,Zhiheng Li,Huimu Wang,Sulong Xu,Gu Simiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出多边际偏好优化（MMPO），一种细粒度的多目标强化学习框架，通过数据、梯度和约束三个层面的干预（而非粗粒度的全局标量化）来解决真实场景中多目标优化面临的稀疏奖励、奖励冲突及后期奖励拉锯导致的指标振荡问题。实验表明MMPO在电商数据集上提升训练稳定性和冲突指标表现，并能泛化到ToolRL和代码生成等更广泛任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界的多目标强化学习常面临稀疏奖励、奖励冲突和后期奖励"拔河"等问题，传统线性标量化方法会导致严重的指标振荡。这些粗粒度的全局标量化方法无法有效处理多目标之间的复杂冲突关系，亟需更细粒度的优化方案。

Method: MMPO框架在三个层面进行干预：(1) 数据层面：曝光去偏以缓解稀疏和有偏奖励；(2) 梯度层面：优先级感知的正交投影以解耦冲突梯度；(3) 约束层面：自提示梯度约束以防止主导目标淹没弱势目标。

Result: 在真实电商数据集上，MMPO提升了训练稳定性并持续在冲突指标上取得更优表现；同时该框架能稳健地泛化到ToolRL和代码生成等更广泛任务，验证了其作为多目标对齐实用范式的有效性。

Conclusion: MMPO通过细粒度多层次干预替代粗粒度标量化，为多目标对齐提供了一种新的实用范式，在真实场景中展现出更好的稳定性、性能和泛化能力。

Abstract: Real-world Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) often suffers from sparse rewards, reward conflicts, and late-stage reward tug-of-war, causing traditional linear scalarization to experience severe metric oscillations. To address optimization conflicts among multiple objectives in real-world deployment scenarios, we propose Multi-Marginal Preference Optimization (MMPO), a fine-grained framework that intervenes at the data, gradient, and constraint levels rather than relying on coarse-grained global scalarization. Specifically, MMPO performs exposure debiasing to mitigate sparse and biased rewards, applies priority-aware orthogonal projection to decouple conflicting gradients, and introduces self-prompted gradient constraints to prevent dominant objectives from overwhelming weaker ones. Experiments on real-world e-commerce datasets show that MMPO improves training stability and consistently achieves better performance across conflicting metrics. Moreover, it generalizes robustly to broader tasks such as ToolRL and code generation, demonstrating its effectiveness as a practical paradigm for multi-objective alignment.

</details>


### [652] [Vision: Data-Centric Anchoring for Robust and Interpretable Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08216)
*Arun Vignesh Malarkkan,Xinyuan Wang,Yanjie Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"数据中心锚定"(Data-Centric Anchoring)框架，主张将鲁棒性和可解释性工程化到数据环境中，而非事后从模型中提取。核心贡献是"数据中心智能体循环"(Data-Centric Agentic Loop)四阶段框架：Curate(策划)、Augment(增强)、Constrain(约束)、Attribute(归因)，强调各阶段的结构性排序，使循环具有自校正能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体AI系统存在两个扩展(scale)无法解决的持久性问题：分布偏移下失效以及无法解释自身决策。作者认为这两者本质上是同一结构性缺陷的共同症状——即数据生命周期中的缺陷。观测性交互日志只记录智能体做了什么，而非它在其他情况下本会做什么，缺乏反事实结构，无法分离因果信号与巧合。

Method: 提出Data-Centric Agentic Loop四阶段框架：1) Curate-策划：数据甄选必须先于增强，因为生成模型会放大训练数据中的偏差；2) Augment-增强：数据增强必须先于约束，因为不变性目标在没有跨环境变化时是空洞的；3) Constrain-约束：在具有充分变化的数据上施加不变性约束；4) Attribute-归因：归因环节闭环，将观察到的失败转化为下一轮迭代的数据干预。循环的自校正性源于每个阶段为下一阶段制造前提条件。

Result: 论文提出以失败驱动的分类法将四种核心失败模式与数据生命周期关联：虚假特征依赖、分布偏移脆弱性、不确定性校准失误、解释不忠实。框架基于数据中缺乏反事实结构这一根因诊断，主张模型中心的方法无法恢复数据中本不包含的不变性。

Conclusion: 作者承认该方法的局限性，指出在规模化实际部署之前仍存在的开放问题。核心立场是：鲁棒性和可解释性问题应从数据层面解决而非模型层面，通过工程化的数据环境来预防而非事后修复。

Abstract: Agentic AI systems built on large language models fail in two persistent ways that scaling does not fix: they break under distribution shift, and they cannot explain the decisions they make. We argue these are co-symptoms of one structural deficiency in the data lifecycle that governs how agents are trained, evaluated, and deployed. Observational interaction logs record what an agent did, not what it would have done otherwise. They encode spurious correlations without controlled variation, so they lack the counterfactual structure needed to separate causal signal from coincidence or to validate an explanation. No model-centric method can recover invariances the data never contained. We present Data-Centric Anchoring: robustness and interpretability should be engineered into the data environment, not extracted from models after training. Our central contribution is the Data-Centric Agentic Loop, a four-stage framework of Curate, Augment, Constrain, and Attribute. The ordering is structural, not stylistic. Curation precedes augmentation because generative models amplify whatever bias they are trained on. Augmentation precedes constraint because invariance objectives are vacuous without variation across environments to be invariant to. Attribution closes the loop, converting observed failures into targeted data interventions for the next iteration. Each stage manufactures the preconditions of the next, which makes the loop self-correcting rather than merely sequential. We ground the framework in a failure-driven taxonomy that links four core failure modes to the data lifecycle: spurious feature reliance, distribution-shift fragility, uncertainty miscalibration, and explanation unfaithfulness. We close with the limits of this approach and the open problems that stand between it and practical deployment at scale.

</details>


### [653] [TTGBench: Benchmarking Topological Evolution and Semantic Drift in Text-attributed Temporal Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08226)
*Longfei Ma,Zemin Liu,Fei Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TTGBench，一个同时评估结构演化与语义演化的时间图基准，包含六个真实文本丰富的"双波动"数据集，首次支持多类和多标签时间节点分类，并系统评估了17种TGNN与LLM范式方法，揭示了两类方法在结构预测与语义追踪上的能力鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间图基准主要关注结构演化（通过时间链路预测），对语义演化的支持有限；时间节点分类被限制在简化的二分类场景，无法捕捉真实的语义漂移；且常用数据集存在高链路重复现象，导致性能评估虚高，掩盖了模型的真实能力。

Method: 提出TTGBench基准，包含六个文本丰富的真实世界数据集（具有"双波动"特性），同时支持多类与多标签时间节点分类以及时间链路预测，并利用17种方法（涵盖TGNN和LLM范式）进行全面评估。

Result: 评估揭示了TGNN方法与LLM方法之间明确的能力鸿沟：TGNN在结构预测上表现出色但在语义追踪上失败，而LLM预测器表现恰好相反。深入分析揭示了各自范式的基本局限性。

Conclusion: 现有TGNN与LLM范式各有短板，需要开发能够同时捕捉结构演化与语义演化的更全面的时间图模型；TTGBench填补了多类/多标签时间节点分类基准的空白。

Abstract: Temporal graph learning models the evolution of dynamic systems, where both structural interactions and semantic states change over time. However, existing benchmarks primarily emphasize structural evolution via temporal link prediction (TLP), while support for semantic evolution remains limited. Although temporal node classification (TNC) is sometimes included, it is typically restricted to simplistic binary settings that fail to capture realistic semantic drift. Moreover, commonly used datasets exhibit high link repetition, leading to inflated performance estimates and obscuring true model capability. To address these limitations, we introduce \textbf{TTGBench}, a new benchmark that jointly evaluates structural and semantic evolution. TTGBench comprises six real-world, text-rich datasets characterized by \emph{Dual Volatility}, enabling rigorous and fair evaluation of existing models. Notably, it is the first benchmark to support both multi-class and multi-label TNC, filling a critical gap in evaluating temporal semantic drift. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 17 state-of-the-art methods across Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNNs) and Large Language Model (LLM)-based paradigms. The results reveal a clear \emph{capability divide} between the two paradigms: TGNN-based methods excel at structural prediction but fail at semantic tracking, whereas LLM-based predictors show the opposite trend. Through in-depth analysis, we uncover their fundamental limitations and provide insights for developing more comprehensive temporal graph models.

</details>


### [654] [SE-GoS: Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills for Skill Library at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08228)
*Dawei Fu,Cheng Jiang,Sitian Qian,Huainan Wang,Zhongkai Hao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SE-GoS是一个无需训练的框架，通过从执行轨迹中演化现有的GoS技能图来提升检索性能，包含拓扑演化、边权重演化和描述演化三种互补更新机制，在多个LLM上一致提升任务奖励并减少输入token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM智能体依赖可复用的技能库，但随着技能库规模扩大到数千条目，有效检索成为瓶颈。现有方法如GoS和SkillDAG虽然利用依赖感知的图结构进行技能检索，但未解决如何从历史执行轨迹中系统性地提炼出能泛化到未见任务的更好检索图的问题。

Method: SE-GoS框架包含三种互补的更新操作：(1)拓扑演化——从执行证据中发现和剪枝技能关系；(2)边权重演化——基于历史有效性强化与检索相关的技能关系；(3)描述演化——利用执行反馈优化面向检索的技能描述。整个过程无需模型训练，保留原有检索流程。

Result: 在SkillsBench上使用三种LLM进行实验，SE-GoS一致性地提升任务奖励并减少输入token。在代表性设置中，一轮演化将奖励从52.4%提升到59.4%，同时相比完整技能加载减少约三分之一的输入token，得到的图还能迁移到不相交的留出集，比静态GoS基线提升5.4个百分点。

Conclusion: 技能图可以从执行经验中改进，而无需模型训练、检索算法变更或技能内容修改，将静态检索图转变为不断演化的检索基础设施。

Abstract: Modern LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, yet as skill libraries scale to thousands of entries, effective retrieval becomes a bottleneck. Graph-of-Skills (GoS) addresses this challenge by exploiting dependency-aware graph structure for scalable skill retrieval, while SkillDAG further demonstrates that skill graphs can accumulate execution-backed structure online. However, these approaches leave open whether historical execution traces can be systematically distilled into a better retrieval graph that generalizes to unseen tasks. We present Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills (SE-GoS), a training-free framework that evolves an existing GoS graph from execution traces while preserving the original retrieval pipeline. SE-GoS performs three complementary updates: topology evolution that discovers and prunes skill relationships from execution evidence, edge-weight evolution that reinforces retrieval-relevant relationships based on historical effectiveness, and description evolution that optimizes retrieval-facing skill descriptions using execution feedback. Across three LLMs on SkillsBench, SE-GoS consistently improves task reward while reducing input tokens relative to full skill loading, with gains varying across model families. In a representative setting, one evolution round improves reward from 52.4\% to 59.4\% while reducing input tokens by approximately one-third relative to full skill loading, and the resulting graph transfers to a disjoint held-out split with a 5.4-point improvement over the static GoS baseline. These results show that skill graphs can be improved from execution experience without model training, changes to the retrieval algorithm, or modifications to skill content, turning a static retrieval graph into an evolving retrieval infrastructure.

</details>


### [655] [Style Over Substance: Content-Invariant Wrappers Flip LLM Safety-Judge Verdicts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08236)
*Yongxi Zhou,Wenbo Ye,Yuanzhe Liu,Zihan Dong,Junwei Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究自动安全裁判（如Llama Guard、GPT-4o评分提示）是否真正评判回复内容而非措辞风格。作者在保持回复内容逐字节不变的前提下，添加仅改变语气/框架的风格包装（如教育免责声明、假安全推理块、令牌拒绝等），测试8个裁判对600多条JailbreakBench回复的判断翻转率。结果显示多数裁判几乎不受影响，但部分裁判存在可廉价利用的盲区：令牌拒绝包装使GPT-4o-mini的19.9%正确"不安全"判定翻转；Llama Guard 4可被"教育课程"框架确定性欺骗（12.3%翻转）；而gpt-oss-safeguard-20b免疫攻击，且仅重写评分提示即可将攻击削减十倍。人类验证确认100%内容不变性及90%翻转属于裁判错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动安全裁判系统产生几乎所有报告的越狱成功率、防御评估和安全排行榜背后的数字。作者质疑这些裁判究竟在评判回复内容还是措辞方式，揭示裁判可能被风格操纵而非内容变化所欺骗的隐患。

Method: 采用内容不变性测试框架：保持回复正文逐字节不变，仅添加内容不变的风格包装器（6-7种形式，包括教育免责声明、假安全推理块、令牌拒绝后跟危险正文、以及令无害拒绝听起来危险的反向框架）。使用600多条JailbreakBench回复×最多7种形式×8个裁判的系统性评估，配合配对显著性检验和噪声底线测量，并辅以双标注者人类验证（kappa 0.95-1.0）和bootstrap分析。

Result: 多数裁判几乎不受影响，但特定裁判存在可廉价利用的盲区：令牌拒绝包装翻转GPT-4o-mini的19.9%正确判定（噪声底线0.5%）；Llama Guard 4被"教育课程"框架确定性欺骗（12.3%有害判定翻转为安全）；gpt-oss-safeguard-20b免疫；仅重写评分提示（StrongREJECT风格）在同一模型上将攻击削减十倍，证明漏洞位于裁判而非内容。人类验证确认100%内容不变性和90%翻转属裁判错误。

Conclusion: 安全裁判系统存在"评风格而非评内容"的漏洞，特定部署模型（如GPT-4o-mini、Llama Guard 4）可被廉价风格包装可靠攻击。然而发现具有精确性而非普遍性——裁判间差异巨大，漏洞可通过改进评分提示或更换裁判模型修复。作者发布数据集、包装器、代码和逐判定标签以促进一步研究。

Abstract: Automatic safety judges -- systems such as Llama Guard or a GPT-4o grading prompt that decide whether a model's reply is harmful -- produce the numbers behind almost every reported jailbreak success rate, defense evaluation, and safety leaderboard. We ask whether these judges grade what a reply contains or how it sounds. We keep a reply's content fixed and add content-invariant style wrappers: fixed strings placed before or after the reply that change only its tone (an educational disclaimer, a fake safety "reasoning" block, a token refusal followed by the unchanged harmful body), or, on harmless refusals, framing that merely sounds dangerous. The body is preserved byte-for-byte, so a faithful judge must return the same verdict, and any flip is an error of the judge, not a change in safety. Over 600 JailbreakBench replies x up to 7 forms x 8 judges, we measure flip rates with paired significance tests and measured noise floors. Findings are precise rather than universal: most judges barely move, but specific judges harbor cheaply exploitable blind spots. A token-refusal wrapper flips 19.9% of GPT-4o-mini's correct "unsafe" verdicts (noise floor 0.5%; 18.2% under majority-of-three re-scoring) yet moves Claude only 0.4%. The deployed Llama Guard 4 is deterministically gamed: an "educational course" framing flips 12.3% of its harmful verdicts to safe. A second deployed guard (gpt-oss-safeguard-20b) is immune, and rewriting only the grading prompt (StrongREJECT-style) cuts the attack tenfold on the identical model -- the vulnerability lives in the judge, not the content. A two-annotator human validation confirms 100% content invariance and 90% of flips as judge errors (kappa 0.95-1.0), and a bootstrap shows the underlying model ranking is already unstable to sampling alone. We release the dataset, wrappers, code, and per-verdict labels.

</details>


### [656] [zScore-N: A Neural Network for On-Chain Wallet Reputation Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08247)
*Girish G N,Ashutosh Sahoo,Akshay SP,Gurukiran S,Dhanashekar Kandaswamy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了zScore-N，一个在生产环境中取代传统钱包信誉评分公式的神经网络。该网络以人工编写的评分公式为教师，利用5,208,952个钱包样本进行训练，能够精确复现公式输出（RMSE仅0.58分），同时在处理缺失数据时大幅优于原公式（10%缺失度下漂移17.9分对比公式的51.4分），并在生产规模上稳定运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的钱包信誉评分公式虽然可读且确定性好，但存在固有缺陷：分段且不可微、无法随数据累积而改进、无法区分真实零值与数据管道缺失造成的零值。这些问题限制了评分系统的准确性和可扩展性。

Method: 采用知识蒸馏的思路，将人工编写的评分公式作为教师模型，在2019-2024年间采样的5,208,952个钱包上校准，验证能复现生产输出至2.3e-13精度。利用公式生成无标签噪声的无限制训练数据，训练神经网络zScore-N，并使用缺失值掩码处理不完整数据。

Result: zScore-N在1000分制上达到0.58点RMSE（R²=0.99997），远优于梯度提升树（2.25）和线性回归（28.04）。在10%特征缺失率下，公式自身漂移51.4点并产生-12.5点系统性偏差，而网络仅漂移17.9点，将缺失数据引入的错误减半。系统已在覆盖数百万钱包的生产环境中运行。

Conclusion: zScore-N成功证明了神经网络可以在保持原有评分语义的同时，克服手写公式的局限性，特别是对缺失数据的鲁棒性显著提升，并已实际部署于生产环境，服务人口达数百万量级、规模跨六个数量级的钱包群体。

Abstract: Wallet reputation scores decide who receives an airdrop, who can borrow, and who enters an allowlist across decentralised finance. They almost always begin as hand-written formulas: compositions of clamped logarithmic, linear and square-root transforms over behavioural features, with every threshold and point award set by hand. Such a formula is readable and deterministic, but it is piecewise and non-differentiable, it cannot improve as data accumulates, and it cannot distinguish a feature that is genuinely zero from one its pipeline failed to capture. We present zScore-N, the neural network that replaced ours in production. The formula served as its teacher: calibrated against 5,208,952 wallets sampled across 2019-2024 and verified to reproduce production output to within 2.3e-13, it supplies unlimited labelled training data at zero label noise. The trained network reproduces it to 0.58 points RMSE on the 1000-point scale (R^2 = 0.99997), against 2.25 for gradient-boosted trees and 28.04 for linear regression on identical features and splits. Trained with missing-value masks against uncorrupted targets, it halves the error that incomplete data introduces: at 10% feature-level missingness the formula drifts 51.4 points from its own complete-data output with a systematic -12.5 point bias, while the network drifts 17.9. The network carries the score at production scale, across a population of millions of wallets spanning six orders of magnitude in size and activity.

</details>


### [657] [Agentic ML Exploration (A-MLE) for Ads Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08248)
*Erwin Gao,Vinodh Kumar Sunkara,Jingyi Guan,Qinjin Jia,Hangjun Xu,Xiang Ji,Sherman Wong,Surya Teja Chavali,Pratik Vaishnavi,Aryan Pandhi,Xiaoyu Deng,Zhaodong Wang,Samarth Inani,Fan Yang,Jakob Moberg,Zoe Zu,Nicolas Bievre,Sami Khenissi,Amit Jaspal,Ehsan Fakharizadi,Srinidhi Viswanathan,Dorothy Sun,Abishek Vanam,Sneha Iyer,Sheela Yadawad,Wenjie Chen,Gaby Nahum,Junhua Gu,Peter Chu,Yucheng Liu,Xin Zhao,Vitor Cid,Chaorong Chen,Vijay Pappu,Ashwin Kumar,Wenlin Chen,Ben Schulte,Deepak Chandra,Ritwik Tewari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出A-MLE（Agentic ML Exploration），一个基于LLM代理的自主系统，用于在广告排序模型组合中系统性地探索机器学习技术。该系统将ML迭代分解为五个阶段（假设生成、探索策略、实验执行、结果分析和共享知识库），由单个代理在沙盒执行层中编排，并在各阶段边界设置人工检查点。在工业级广告排序模型上的部署结果表明，代理式探索是工业推荐系统中ML工程师的实用倍增器，尤其对长尾模型有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代工业广告排序系统的瓶颈已不再是模型容量或训练算力，而是人类ML迭代的吞吐量——从研究到落地一个统计显著的改进需要数天到数周的高级工程师时间。由于不同模型之间存在异构的数据、架构和基础设施约束，对某个模型有效的技术向其他模型扩散缓慢且不均匀，导致大量可恢复的信号未被探索。

Method: A-MLE将ML迭代分解为五个阶段：假设生成、探索策略、实验执行、结果分析和共享知识库。系统由单个LLM代理编排，调用领域特定技能和代理工作流，在沙盒执行层中运行，每个阶段边界设有HITL（人在回路）检查点。评估采用分层能力框架（工具可用性、自主工作流执行、开放式探索），并进行跨LLM（Claude Sonnet、Gemini、GPT系列）的受控对比研究，使用固定代理循环观察执行可靠性和探索激进程度的差异。

Result: A-MLE在代表性的大规模广告排序模型集上成功部署，并通过分层能力框架进行了系统评估。跨LLM对照研究揭示了Claude Sonnet、Gemini和GPT系列在执行可靠性和探索激进程度上的定性差异。系统展示了在工业推荐系统中作为ML工程师有效倍增器的潜力，尤其对很少获得专家关注的长尾模型效果显著。

Conclusion: 研究发现代理式探索是工业推荐系统中ML工程师的实用力量倍增器。A-MLE能够释放此前因为人工迭代瓶颈而未被探索的有效信号。同时论文讨论了失败模式和影响可靠性的设计选择，为后续代理式ML探索系统的构建提供了有价值的参考。

Abstract: Modern industrial ads ranking stacks are increasingly bottlenecked not by model capacity or training compute, but by the throughput of human ML iteration - the cycles of research, implementation, training, debugging, evaluation, and launch required to surface a single statistically significant improvement. A typical ranking stack contains numerous differentiated models with heterogeneous data, architectures, and infrastructure constraints, and each cycle takes days to weeks of senior engineer attention per model. As a result, techniques that have proven effective on one model diffuse into others slowly and unevenly, leaving substantial recoverable signal unexplored. We present Agentic ML Exploration (A-MLE), an autonomous LLM-agent system that systematically explores ML techniques across a portfolio of ads ranking models. A-MLE decomposes ML iteration into five stages involving hypothesis generation, exploration strategy, experiment execution, result analysis and shared knowledge substrate which are orchestrated by a single agent that invokes domain-specific skills and agentic workflows against a sandboxed execution layer, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints at each stage boundary. We deploy A-MLE across a representative set of large-scale ads ranking models and evaluate it along a tiered capability framework (tool availability, autonomous workflow execution, and open-ended exploration). We further report a controlled cross-LLM study using a fixed agent loop, which surfaces qualitative differences in execution reliability and exploration aggressiveness across the Claude Sonnet, Gemini, and GPT families. We discuss failure modes and the design choices that govern reliability. Our findings suggest that agentic exploration is a practical force multiplier for ML engineers in industrial recommenders, especially for the long tail of models that rarely receive expert attention.

</details>


### [658] [CircuTutor: Transforming Static Circuit Problems into Intelligent and Dynamic Tutoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08254)
*Ziyu Luo,Xiaorui Ma,Lin Chen,Xiaoming Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CircuTutor，一个基于电路状态驱动的智能辅导系统，将静态教科书电路问题转化为交互式辅导流程，包含多模态问题解析、SPICE电路仿真、因果推理链解释、错误概念诊断和适应性练习生成，实验证明能有效提升概念学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习者学习直流电路概念时需要在不可见的物理量（电流、电压、电阻、功率）与可观察结果（灯泡亮度）之间建立联系。传统教科书材料和通用电路模拟器虽提供问题求解与探索机会，但缺乏对电路行为变化的解释支持，也无法诊断学生错误答案背后的推理原因。

Method: CircuTutor采用四阶段流程：(1)多模态问题解析：从教科书中提取问题文字、电路拓扑、元件参数、开关状态和选项，转化为结构化任务并通过仿真验证；(2)交互式电路探索：学习者可改变参数探索电路，SPICE兼容求解器计算物理一致的电路状态；(3)反馈解释：提交答案后，系统展示操作前后电路状态动画，将状态变化组织为因果推理链，解释底层电路行为，并将答案偏差映射到可能的错误概念；(4)适应性练习：针对诊断出的错误概念生成定制化的后续练习。

Result: 实验结果表明，CircuTutor有效提升了学习者的概念学习效果和整体学习体验。

Conclusion: 该框架展示了如何将模拟电路状态转化为智能交互式电路教学，并具有推广到其他STEM领域的潜力。

Abstract: Learning direct current circuit concepts requires learners to connect invisible physical quantities, such as current, voltage, resistance, and power, with observable outcomes such as bulb brightness. Conventional textbook materials and general-purpose circuit simulators provide opportunities for problem solving and exploration but offer limited support for explaining why circuit behavior changes or diagnosing the reasoning behind incorrect answers. We present CircuTutor, a circuit-state-driven intelligent tutoring system that transforms static textbook circuit problems into an interactive tutoring workflow. CircuTutor first uses multimodal problem parsing to extract the textbook question, circuit topology, component parameters, switch states, and answer options, which are converted into a structured task and validated through circuit simulation. Learners can then interactively explore the circuit (by changing parameters) and submit an answer while a SPICE-compatible solver computes physically consistent circuit states. After the learner submits an answer, CircuTutor presents a before-and-after circuit state animation corresponding to the selected operation, organizes the simulated state changes into a causal reasoning chain that explains the underlying circuit behavior, maps answer discrepancies to likely misconceptions, and generates adaptive follow-up exercises targeted at the diagnosed misconception. Our experimental results demonstrate that CircuTutor effectively improves conceptual learning and the overall learning experience. The proposed framework demonstrates how simulated circuit states can be transformed into intelligent and interactive tutoring for circuit education, with the potential to generalize to other STEM domains.

</details>


### [659] [Revoked but Still Authoritative: An Empirical Study of Revocation Enforcement in Agent-Memory Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08258)
*Yi Ting Shen,Kentaroh Toyoda,Alex Leung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了五种长期运行的智能体记忆系统如何处理"软撤销"（soft revocation）机制——即被矛盾事实标记为无效但仍保留在记忆中的情形。研究发现所有系统默认都不执行撤销：撤销的事实仍会在检索时被返回并导致智能体执行不安全操作。作者据此开发了一个位于智能体与记忆后端之间的守卫层，用于拦截被撤销或与替代记录冲突的记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期运行的语言模型智能体依赖持久记忆，许多记忆系统通过软撤销来保留历史（标记无效而非删除），但撤销标记是否在检索时被强制执行从未被检验过。作者希望填补这一空白，系统性地考察真实系统中撤销的执行情况。

Method: 作者对五个智能体记忆系统进行测量：为每个系统加载被撤销的策略及其替代策略；在九种策略场景和九个模型中跟踪被撤销事实是否在检索时被返回，以及智能体是否会据此行动；并在六种防御条件下对每次试验进行评分。基于发现，开发了一个位于智能体与记忆后端之间的守卫层，拦截被撤销或与替代策略冲突的记录。

Result: 研究发现没有系统默认执行撤销：只要撤销标签对检索层可见，被撤销的事实就会被返回，其排名高于替代策略，并引导智能体执行不安全的操作。这表明软撤销机制在实际系统中普遍失效。

Conclusion: 现有记忆系统的软撤销机制在默认情况下并未得到有效执行，存在安全风险。作者提出的守卫层方案可以有效拦截被撤销或冲突的记录，为记忆系统的安全设计提供了一种实用解决思路。

Abstract: Long-running language-model agents depend on persistent memory. Many agent-memory systems preserve history through soft revocation: a contradicted fact is marked invalid and retained rather than deleted. However, whether that mark is enforced at retrieval time is unexamined. In this paper, we measure five such systems: we load each with a revoked policy and its replacement, track whether the revoked fact is returned at retrieval and whether the agent then acts on it across nine policy scenarios and nine models, and score every trial under six defense conditions. We find that no system enforces revocation by default: the revoked fact is returned wherever the revocation label is visible to the retrieval layer, outranks its replacement, and leads agents to the unsafe action. Based on these findings, we develop a guard that sits between the agent and any memory backend and withholds records that are revoked or conflict with their replacement.

</details>


### [660] [Three Types of Negation of Triple and its Elements and an Extension of Triple](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08271)
*Zhenghua Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对经典三元组（triple）只能表达肯定断言、无法充分表达否定信息的问题，基于集合SCOI和包含三种否定的逻辑LCOI+PLCOI，提出了一种能区分并表达三种不同否定形式（矛盾否定、对立否定和中间否定）的TCOI三元组扩展，并探讨了其在反事实推理中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典三元组作为典型的语义数据模型，其简单结构仅能表达肯定断言，无法充分表达三元组及其元素中存在的各种否定形式，这限制了模型对复杂否定信息的表示与推理能力。

Method: （1）从概念上提出三元组中存在三种不同否定形式：矛盾否定、对立否定和中间否定；（2）基于集合SCOI和包含三种否定的逻辑LCOI+PLCOI，设计了TCOI三元组，作为经典三元组的语义与结构扩展；（3）三种否定可独立作用于三元组元素及整个三元组，系统性引入三个语义维度；（4）提出TCOI三元组蕴含推理的真值（连续值）算法，并通过反事实及反事实推理的实例进行计算验证。

Result: TCOI三元组在保留表达肯定断言能力的同时，系统性地引入了三种否定的三个语义维度，显著增强了三元组模型表示和推理复杂否定信息的能力；给出了TCOI三元组蕴含推理的连续真值算法，并通过反事实推理实例完成了计算。

Conclusion: TCOI三元组是对经典三元组的有力扩展，能够区分并表达三种否定形式，提升了对复杂否定信息的表示与推理能力，并在反事实推理中展现出应用价值。

Abstract: In various data models, the classical triple is a typical semantic data model. However, due to the design of the triple as a simple structure for representing positive assertions, it cannot sufficiently express different forms of negation present in the triple and its elements. This paper conceptually proposes that there are three distinct forms of negation within triples and their elements: contradictory negation, opposite negation and intermediary negation. Based on the the set SCOI and the logic LCOI+PLCOI with three kinds of negation, we propose an extension of triple that can distinguish and express these three different negations in the triple and its elements, called the TCOI triple with contradictory negation, opposite negation and intermediary negation. The TCOI triple is a semantic and structural extension of the classical triple. While retaining the ability to express positive assertions, it systematically introduces the three semantic dimensions of three negations, allowing these negations to independently act on the elements of the triple and on the whole triple. This significantly enhances the triple model capability to represent and reasoning about complex negative information. This paper also explores the expressive power and reasoning of the TCOI triple, as well as the application of TCOI triple implication reasoning in counterfactuals and counterfactual reasoning. We propose a truth-value (continuous value) algorithm for TCOI triple implication reasoning and perform its calculation through an example of the counterfactuals and counterfactual reasoning.

</details>


### [661] [MemForest: Efficient Agent Memory Management via EventTree Partitioning and Progressive Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08273)
*Junxi Wang,Te Sun,Jiayi Zhu,Chen Zhang,Siyuan Li,Xuyang Liu,Zichen Wen,Xiaobing Tu,Jinkui Ren,Xiantao Zhang,Ziqi Yuan,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MemForest，一种通用的智能体记忆压缩框架，通过事件中心化单元划分、事件树（EventTree）构建与合并来压缩历史记忆，并引入锚点引导的传播检索机制提升检索效率，在单模态和多模态基准上均以50%压缩比保持了97%以上的原始性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体记忆系统在长期对话、个性化助手和视频理解中展现出潜力，但持续累积的记忆在推理时引入了大量的存储和检索开销，亟需一种有效的记忆压缩方法来解决这一问题。

Method: MemForest包含三个核心组件：(1)利用全局语义相似性和局部时间连续性将历史记忆划分为以事件为中心的单元；(2)为每个单元构建最大生成树（EventTree），并通过选择高权重边逐步合并冗余记忆节点，降低存储开销；(3)引入锚点引导的传播检索机制，从关键节点的时间邻域中检索相关记忆节点，提高检索准确性。

Result: 在单模态Mem0框架下，MemForest在LoCoMo、LongMemEval和PersonaMem三个基准上压缩50%历史记忆的同时保留了97.1%的原始性能，实现了1.89倍检索加速；在多模态M3-Agent框架下，在M3-Bench-robot和M3-Bench-web两个基准上以50%压缩比保留99.7%的原始性能，实现2.24倍检索加速。

Conclusion: MemForest作为一种通用的记忆压缩框架，能有效降低智能体记忆系统的存储和检索成本，同时保持高水平的任务性能，适用于单模态和多模态等多种智能体记忆系统。

Abstract: Agent memory systems have demonstrated significant potential in long-term dialogue, personalized assistants, and video understanding. However, continuously accumulated memory introduces substantial storage and retrieval costs during inference. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{MemForest}, a general memory compression framework adaptable to various agent memory systems. Specifically, MemForest partitions historical memory into event-centric units by leveraging global semantic similarity and local temporal continuity. For each unit, it constructs a maximum spanning tree, termed an EventTree, and progressively merges redundant memory nodes by selecting high-weight edges, reducing storage overhead. Furthermore, we introduce an anchor-guided propagation retrieval mechanism that retrieves relevant memory nodes from the temporal neighborhoods of key nodes, improving retrieval accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MemForest. Under the unimodal Mem0 framework, MemForest retains \textbf{97.1%} of the original performance while compressing \textbf{50%} of historical memory across three benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and PersonaMem), achieving a \textbf{1.89x} retrieval speedup. Under the multimodal M3-Agent framework, it preserves \textbf{99.7%} of the original performance with a \textbf{50%} compression ratio across two benchmarks (M3-Bench-robot and M3-Bench-web), achieving a \textbf{2.24x} retrieval speedup. \textcolor{RoyalBlue}{\textit{Our code is available at [https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}}](https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}})

</details>


### [662] [Beyond Coherence: Benchmarking Professional Editing-Technique Execution in Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08275)
*Tianyi Zeng,Junchao Liao,Yujie Wei,Ziying Zhang,Litao Li,Tianyi Wang,Zhichao Wei,Shuyao Xu,Wenwen Qiang,Siyu Zhu,Zhenghao Zhang,Long Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CutCraft，这是首个针对多镜头音视频生成中剪辑技法执行能力的基准测试，配套层次化混合评估框架，并设计了一个智能体剪辑基线。实验揭示当前13个SOTA模型在"连贯性"与"剪辑技法执行"之间存在系统性差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频生成模型能产出连贯的电影级输出，但连贯并不等于能执行专业剪辑技法（如镜头结构、转场语法、音视频剪切关系、蒙太奇）。现有基准多依赖内容质量、同步性或物理合理性等代理指标，系统性忽略了编辑指令是否真正被执行。

Method: CutCraft包含三部分：(1) 将结构化多镜头提示扩展为带显式剪辑规格的基准数据；(2) 提出层次化混合评估框架，结合镜头结构对齐、专家模型指标、工具驱动的多模态判断及基于rubric的问答；(3) 设计智能体剪辑基线，将生成分解为规划、镜头级合成与事后合成三阶段，显式实现J-cut、L-cut和转场时序等剪辑语义。

Result: 在13个闭源与开源SOTA模型上评估发现：模型常能生成看似合理的多镜头视频，却无法可靠执行编辑指令；存在镜头结构不稳定、转场执行控制薄弱、高阶蒙太奇上性能急剧退化等问题；美学质量与剪辑技法合规性仅弱相关。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了音视频生成领域中"视觉连贯"与"专业编辑执行"之间被忽视的鸿沟，并提供了一个系统性的基准、评估方法和基线方案，为后续研究提供了可复现的评测平台。

Abstract: Recent multi-shot audio-video generators can produce increasingly coherent and cinematic outputs, but coherence does not imply the ability to execute editing techniques. Professional editing depends on shot structure, transition grammar, audio-video cut relations, and montage, yet existing benchmarks largely rely on proxies such as content quality, synchronization, or physical plausibility, systematically missing whether such editing instructions are actually executed. We introduce CutCraft, the first benchmark for editing-technique execution in multi-shot audio-video generation. CutCraft extends structured multi-shot prompts with explicit editing specifications and is paired with a hierarchical hybrid evaluation framework that combines shot-structure alignment, expert-model metrics, tool-grounded multimodal judgment, and rubric-based question answering. Beyond evaluation, we design an agentic editing baseline that decomposes generation into planning, shot-level synthesis, and post-hoc composition, explicitly realizing editing semantics such as J-cuts, L-cuts, and transition timing. Across 13 state-of-the-art closed- and open-source models, CutCraft reveals a consistent gap between coherence and editing-technique execution: current systems often produce plausible multi-shot videos yet fail to execute editorial instructions reliably. We find unstable shot structures, weak control of transition execution, and sharp degradation on higher-order montage, while aesthetic quality is only weakly correlated with editing-technique compliance. The benchmark and metrics, and the editing agent baseline are available at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/cut-craft-bench.

</details>


### [663] [LEBGen: An LLM-Enhanced Bayesian Network Framework for Few-Shot Travel Survey Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08288)
*Zijian Shen,Bin Zhou,Jiguang Wang,Ya Zhao,Jintao Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LEBGen，一种结合大语言模型(LLM)增强贝叶斯网络(BN)的框架，用于从少量样本生成合成出行调查数据。LLM利用行为知识识别出行者画像，并帮助修正BN结构中遗漏或虚假的依赖关系，从而在2%少样本设置下显著提升分布保真度和依赖关系保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 收集大规模代表性的出行调查数据成本高且耗时，少样本合成生成是一种可行替代方案。然而少样本数据对异质出行者群体覆盖不完整，难以恢复人口统计特征与出行行为之间的复杂依赖关系。现有方法各有局限：贝叶斯网络等概率生成模型具有显式分布控制能力，但从少样本学习的结构可能遗漏重要依赖或保留虚假依赖；需要利用LLM的行为知识来弥补统计证据的不足。

Method: LEBGen框架包含三个步骤：(1) LLM从人口统计属性和出行行为统计数据中识别出行者画像；(2) LLM利用这些知识恢复被画像增强BN结构遗漏的依赖关系，并剪除虚假的依赖关系；(3) 精炼后的BN完全基于观测数据进行参数化，生成合成出行记录。

Result: 在2022年香港出行特征调查的2%少样本设置下，LEBGen将平均边际Jensen-Shannon散度从0.0671降至0.0091，并将平均绝对Cramer's V误差相比最优基线降低了14.3%，在分布保真度和依赖保真度两个方面均有显著改善。

Conclusion: LEBGen验证了将LLM的行为知识注入贝叶斯网络结构学习能有效解决少样本出行调查数据生成中的依赖结构恢复问题，为交通规划中的小样本数据合成提供了一种有前景的思路。

Abstract: Travel survey data are essential for transportation planning and travel behavior analysis, yet collecting large-scale representative samples is costly and time-consuming. A practical alternative is to generate synthetic survey records from a few-shot sample. However, such samples provide incomplete coverage of heterogeneous traveler groups and insufficient evidence for recovering the complex dependencies between demographic characteristics and travel behavior. Existing approaches have complementary limitations. Probabilistic generative models such as Bayesian networks (BNs) offer explicit distributional control, but structures learned from few-shot samples may omit meaningful dependencies or retain spurious ones. Large language models (LLMs) can help address these difficulties in BN structure learning by providing behavioral knowledge that complements the limited statistical evidence. We therefore propose LEBGen, an LLM-enhanced BN framework that uses this knowledge to refine network structure for few-shot travel survey data generation. Specifically, the LLM first identifies traveler personas from demographic attribute and travel behavior statistics, then recovers dependencies missed by the persona-augmented BN structure and prune spurious ones. The refined BN is parameterized exclusively from the observed data to generate synthetic records. Under a 2% few-shot setting on the 2022 Hong Kong Travel Characteristics Survey, LEBGen reduces the mean marginal Jensen-Shannon divergence from 0.0671 to 0.0091 and the mean absolute Cramer's V error by 14.3% over the best-performing baseline, substantially improving both distributional and dependency fidelity.

</details>


### [664] [FastE: Readout-Triggered Token Compression for LLM Embedding Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08407)
*Jinsong Shu,Jinyong Wen,Baokun Wang,Zhongle Xie,Lidan Shou,Weiqiang Wang,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现最终读出型LLM嵌入模型（如Qwen3-Embedding和Qwen3-VL-Embedding）中存在"深度依赖的前缀冗余"现象：前缀状态在浅层被移除时损害较大，但随网络加深变得越来越可压缩。基于此提出FastE——一种无需训练、即插即用的方法，通过共享固定阈值和注意力分数排序来选择何时压缩及保留哪些前缀状态，可显著降低计算成本（NarrativeQA上减少40.11% FLOPs，同时保留99.53%的nDCG@10），且质量-效率权衡可直接通过最大移除比例调节，无需重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者观察到LLM嵌入模型的前缀状态存在深度依赖的冗余现象——随着前缀和读出状态在网络中传播，前缀状态变得越来越可压缩。这一发现表明在深层网络中移除冗余前缀状态的可能性，从而为降低嵌入生成的解码器计算成本提供了机会。

Method: FastE是一种训练免费的即插即用方法，包含两个核心机制：(1) 使用批量均值读出-前缀对齐的共享固定阈值作为轻量级在线启发式，决定何时触发压缩；(2) 通过读出位置对前缀状态的注意力分数进行排序，决定在后续层中保留哪些状态。

Result: FastE在NarrativeQA上使用Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B减少40.11%的decoder-backbone FLOPs，同时保留99.53%的Full Forward nDCG@10。在五个文本嵌入基准、两个骨干规模及三个跨模态检索任务上均验证了有效性，且质量-效率权衡可通过最大移除比例直接定制。

Conclusion: FastE为大规模嵌入生成提供了实用价值，适用于检索、索引、聚类和多模态表示系统。其最大贡献在于无需重训练即可实现可定制的质量-效率权衡，且即插即用特性使其易于部署在实际系统中。

Abstract: In this study, we identify depth-dependent prefix redundancy in final-readout LLM embedding models, notably across representative backbones including Qwen3-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Embedding. We find that removing prefix states is substantially more damaging in shallow layers than at greater depth, showing that prefix states become increasingly compressible as the prefix and readout states propagate through the network. To this end, we introduce FastE, a training-free, plug-and-play method. FastE uses a shared fixed threshold on batch-mean readout-prefix alignment as a lightweight online heuristic for selecting when compression occurs, and ranks prefix states by the attention scores they receive from the readout position to determine which states are retained in subsequent layers. Our evaluations demonstrate FastE's ability to substantially reduce computational costs: on NarrativeQA with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, it reduces decoder-backbone FLOPs by 40.11% while retaining 99.53% of Full Forward nDCG@10. Across five text embedding benchmarks, two backbone scales, and three cross-modal retrieval tasks, the quality-efficiency trade-off is directly customizable through the maximum removal ratio without retraining. We believe FastE offers practical value for scalable embedding generation in retrieval, indexing, clustering, and multimodal representation systems.

</details>


### [665] [Feyospace-v1: How the Cyber Mercury Seven Trained Frontier Cyber Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08418)
*Zongjie Li,Alan Z. W,John Nicolas J,Walter H. F,Scott Donald L,Gordon Y. P,Deke X*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个以数据为中心的框架，通过五个互补系统（Choulea、SkyReal、Hongzwang、PSBreakup、Kreator）解决开放权重网络智能体后训练中的瓶颈问题（执行环境成本、多轮监督、强教师获取），构建了可重置的多类安全环境（漏洞、CTF、固件、设备等），经执行验证和证据审计后产出164,269条轨迹用于长上下文监督微调，最终三个检查点平均提升23.76%（CyberGym全套）和10.49%（CTF套件池），其中Feyospace-s1验证成功率达63.24%，排名CyberGym官方排行榜第10位，所有检查点在同等参数规模中排名第1。这是首个七人独立团队端到端训练出领先智能体网络能力的开放权重模型的实证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练有能力的网络智能体通常被视为模型规模的问题，但开放权重后训练的实际瓶颈更在于可执行环境的成本、可靠的多轮监督以及强教师的获取难度。作者希望证明即使没有大规模计算资源，小团队也能通过数据工程策略训练出顶尖的网络智能体模型。

Method: 提出数据为中心的框架，包含五个互补系统：Choulea分析隐藏推理特征、SkyReal降低教师采样的成本、Hongzwang绕过教师执行的API限制、PSBreakup恢复模型合并中削弱的性能、Kreator将专家干预转化为可训练的推理过程。数据引擎构建了可重置的多种环境（代码、漏洞、CTF、内核历史、完整利用、固件和设备），候选轨迹经过执行验证和证据审计后才被保留，最终生成164,269条轨迹用于长上下文监督微调。

Result: 三个检查点相对起始模型在全套CyberGym上平均提升23.76%，在合并CTF套件上提升10.49%。截至2026年9月1日，Feyospace-s1验证成功率达63.24%，排名CyberGym官方排行榜第10，三个检查点在同等参数量级模型中均排名第1。

Conclusion: 首次端到端证明七人独立团队可以通过数据驱动的方法训练出具备领先智能体网络能力的开放权重模型，克服了资源受限条件下后训练的主要瓶颈。

Abstract: Training capable cyber agents is often treated primarily as a problem of model scale, yet open-weight post-training is constrained more directly by the cost of executable environments, reliable multi-turn supervision, and access to strong teachers. We present a data-centric framework that addresses these bottlenecks through five complementary systems: Choulea analyzes hidden reasoning signatures, SkyReal reduces teacher-sampling cost, Hongzwang bypasses API restrictions on teacher execution, PSBreakup restores capabilities weakened by model merging, and Kreator converts expert interventions into trainable reasoning. Our data engine constructs resettable coding, vulnerability, CTF, kernel-history, full-exploit, firmware, and device-backed environments. Candidate trajectories are retained only after execution verification and evidence auditing, yielding 164,269 trajectories for long-context supervised fine-tuning. The three checkpoints improve over their starting models by an average of 23.76% on the full CyberGym suite and 10.49% across the pooled CTF suites. As of September 1, 2026, Feyospace-s1 achieves a verified success rate of 63.24% and ranks 10th on the official CyberGym leaderboard, while all three checkpoints rank 1st among models at comparable parameter scales. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end demonstration that a seven-person independent team can train open-weight models with leading agentic cyber capability.

</details>


### [666] [SRPO: Setwise Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08452)
*Shengtian Yang,Ziyu Xiong,Yu Li,Yewen Li,Qingpeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SRPO（Setwise Relative Policy Optimization），将多智能体LLM中由同一个状态转移所消费的最小输出集合（active set）视为一个多智能体动作，通过组合成员log-ratio形成基数归一化的集合比率、分配单一相对优势并只裁剪一次，从而统一不同集合大小的分工与联合共同进化，实验证明在数学推理与多轮搜索任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体强化学习方法通常独立优化每个响应或轨迹，即使多个输出共同引起一次状态转移，导致更新单元与系统实际执行的动作不一致，缺乏对联合动作的整体优化。

Method: 将活跃集合（同一状态转移所消费的最小输出集）视为一个多智能体动作；将成员log-ratio组合成一个按基数归一化的集合比率；为集合分配一个相对优势；对整个集合只裁剪一次，从而将分工与联合共同进化统一为不同集合大小的动作。

Result: 在数学推理和多轮搜索任务上，SRPO在固定、混合和动态路由的工作流中以及四种模型规模下均取得最强的宏平均结果；优化诊断进一步表征了其在不同事件归约和集合大小下的稳定性。

Conclusion: SRPO通过以集合为更新单位的策略优化方法，解决了更新单元与执行动作不一致的问题，提供了一个统一的多智能体训练接口，并在多个任务与规模上验证了有效性。

Abstract: Multi-agent large language models solve complex tasks by coordinating several policies in a shared environment. However, existing reinforcement learning methods usually optimize each response or trajectory separately, even when several outputs jointly cause one state transition. Consequently, the update unit differs from the action executed by the system. To address this problem, we propose SRPO (Setwise Relative Policy Optimization), which treats the active set the minimal set of outputs consumed by one transition, as one multi-agent action. Specifically, SRPO combines member log-ratios into one cardinality-normalized set ratio, assigns one relative advantage, and clips the set once. This formulation unifies division of labor and joint co-evolution as actions with different set sizes. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and multi-turn search demonstrate one training interface for fixed, mixed, and dynamically routed workflows across four model scales, with the strongest macro-average results among the reported comparisons. Optimization diagnostics further characterize its stability under different event reductions and set sizes.

</details>


### [667] [Personalizing LLM Agent Memory Using Biometrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08558)
*Yanhong Qian,Qingguo Meng,Shihao Ding,Xingbo Dong,Zhe Jin,Hanrui Wang,Isao Echizen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Bio-Memory，一种生物特征感知的记忆架构，在记忆检索中同时考虑语义相似性和生物特征匹配（人脸/掌纹），以解决多用户共享场景下个性化记忆检索的身份归属问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多用户共享环境中，LLM智能体的个性化记忆检索不仅需要语义相似性，还需要确认当前请求者与存储记忆所属用户身份匹配，防止跨用户记忆泄露或误用。

Method: 基于A-Mem架构，为每条原子记忆笔记附加上生物特征嵌入（人脸或掌纹），先用生物特征匹配构建检索候选池，再进行语义排序。

Result: 在LoCoMo的10用户共享智能体设置下，结合7个人脸基准和10个掌纹协议进行评估。人脸个性化在CALFW上达到最大平均差距27.29%（F1）/21.15%（BLEU-1）；掌纹个性化在MS_Blue上达到25.75%/19.22%的差距，能一致地区分所有者和非所有者查询。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持生物特征可作为共享环境中个性化记忆检索的实用控制信号，有效分离所有者与非所有者的查询。

Abstract: Personalized memory helps LLM agents deliver stable, tailored assistance by storing and reusing user-specific data across interactions. In multi-user scenarios, however, retrieval must consider not only semantic similarity but also whether the current requester matches the identity associated with the stored memory. We propose Bio-Memory, a biometric-aware memory architecture that conditions memory retrieval on both semantic similarity and biometric matching. Built on top of A-Mem, Bio-Memory augments each atomic memory note with a biometric embedding and uses biometric matching to form the retrieval candidate pool before semantic ranking. We evaluate Bio-Memory on LoCoMo in a 10-user shared-agent setting over 7 face benchmarks and 10 palmprint protocols. Across datasets, Bio-Memory consistently separates owner and non-owner queries. Under face-based personalization, the largest average gap reaches 27.29% / 21.15% in F1 / BLEU-1 on CALFW; under palmprint-based personalization, the corresponding gap is 25.75% / 19.22% on MS_Blue. These results support biometrics as a practical control signal for personalized memory retrieval in shared environments.

</details>


### [668] [BIO-MEMART: Biometric-Aware KV Cache Memory for Multi-User LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08566)
*Yanhong Qian,Xuanying He,Qingguo Meng,Shihao Ding,Xingbo Dong,Zhe Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Bio-MemArt是一个面向多用户LLM代理的、基于生物特征感知的KV缓存记忆框架。它通过为每个存储的KV记忆块附加归一化生物特征模板，并用当前用户的生物特征探针过滤共享记忆池，再在授权候选池内执行原始MemArt的检索和KV复用流程，从而在保留潜在空间检索、直接缓存复用和解耦位置编码的同时，为共享KV记忆添加物理用户访问控制。实验表明在面部与掌纹基准上，所有者与所有者生物特征成功率显著区分，同时保持了低token的高效运行机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存正从单纯的推理优化演化为长期LLM代理的外部记忆基板。在多用户共享部署场景中，可复用的KV块引发了一个缺失的访问控制问题：仅靠语义相关性无法判断某个记忆块是否被授权给当前物理用户使用，因此需要引入访问控制机制。

Method: Bio-MemArt将归一化的生物特征模板附加到每个存储的KV记忆块上；使用当前用户的生物特征探针对共享记忆池进行过滤；仅在授权候选池内运行原始MemArt的检索和KV复用流程。该设计保留了潜在空间检索、直接缓存复用和解耦位置编码，同时增加了物理用户级别的访问控制。

Result: 在长期对话问答任务的面部和掌纹基准上进行了所有者和非所有者查询条件下的评估：面部基准上所有者成功率为95.71%，非所有者为0.86%；掌纹基准上所有者成功率为97.60%，非所有者为2.00%。效率方面，平均预填充token从全上下文提示下的18,781.96降至Bio-MemArt下的28.57，表明生物特征门控保留了KV缓存记忆的低token运行状态。

Conclusion: 生物特征门控机制能够在不牺牲KV缓存高效运行的前提下，有效实现多用户共享记忆场景下的物理访问控制，解决语义相关性无法覆盖的授权问题。

Abstract: KV cache is evolving from a serving optimization into an external memory substrate for long-term LLM agents. In a shared multi-user deployment, however, reusable KV blocks introduce a missing access-control question: semantic relevance alone cannot determine whether a memory block is authorized for the current physical user. We propose Bio-MemArt, a biometric-aware KV-cache memory framework for multi-user LLM agents. Bio-MemArt attaches a normalized biometric template to each stored KV memory block, filters the shared memory pool with the current user's biometric probe, and then runs the original MemArt retrieval and KV reuse pipeline only inside the authorized candidate pool. This design preserves latent-space retrieval, direct cache reuse, and decoupled position encoding while adding physical-user access control to shared KV memory. We evaluate Bio-MemArt under Owner and Non-owner query conditions on long-term dialogue QA with face and palmprint benchmarks. Across face benchmarks, the average owner and non-owner biometric success rates are 95.71% and 0.86%; across palmprint benchmarks, they are 97.60% and 2.00%. In the efficiency study, average prefill tokens drop from 18,781.96 under full-context prompting to 28.57 with Bio-MemArt, showing that biometric gating preserves the low-token operating regime of KV-cache memory.

</details>


### [669] [AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for Multi Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08572)
*Jaewon Chu,Jinwoo Seo,Jaewon Cho,Jeehye Na,Yunyang Xiong,Youngdae Kim,Hyunwoo J. Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AgentGrad，一个针对多智能体系统（MAS）的提示词优化框架，通过顺序干预和语义文本梯度抽象方法，解决了现有文本梯度方法在梯度提取和聚合阶段的局限性，在五个基准上达到最先进性能，并平均加速2.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统性能依赖于各智能体的提示词设计，但现有文本梯度优化方法存在两个关键局限：(1) 梯度提取阶段：选择目标提示词时未验证修改是否真正解决失败，且缺乏对智能体中间输出的agent级监督；(2) 梯度聚合阶段：个体梯度被随机分组拼接，混入不相关的失败模式，导致提示词泛化能力差。

Method: AgentGrad包含两个核心组件：1) 顺序干预（Sequential Intervention）：每次失败时逐个修改一个智能体的行为，以确定修改后能解决该失败的目标智能体，并用该智能体的修改后输出作为agent级监督，提取细粒度梯度；2) 语义文本梯度抽象（Semantic Textual Gradient Abstraction）：将语义相似的梯度聚类，防止混入不相关的失败模式，并将每个聚类抽象为捕获共享修正模式的泛化梯度。

Result: 在五个多智能体系统基准上，AgentGrad取得了最先进的性能，并且相比次快基线，平均减少了2.5倍的墙钟优化时间。

Conclusion: 通过顺序干预精确识别值得修改的目标智能体并结合语义梯度抽象避免无关失败模式混合，AgentGrad有效提升了MAS提示词优化的效果和效率，验证了该框架在多智能体场景下的优越性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) achieve strong performance by employing specialized multiple agents, yet their performance depends on the prompt design of each agent. For MAS prompt optimization, textual gradient methods that guide prompt updates using natural-language feedback have emerged as a leading paradigm. In this paper, we identify limitations in two stages of existing textual gradient approaches: gradient extraction and gradient aggregation. In gradient extraction, previous works select a target prompt without verifying whether modifying it resolves the failure, and derive gradients without agent-level supervision over the corresponding agent's intermediate output. In gradient aggregation, individual gradients are randomly grouped and concatenated, often mixing unrelated failure modes and producing prompts that fail to generalize. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{AgentGrad}, a prompt optimization framework for multi-agent systems based on sequential intervention and semantic textual gradient abstraction. For each failure, sequential intervention modifies the behavior of one agent at a time to identify the target agent whose modification resolves the failure. The modified output of the target agent then serves as agent-level supervision for extracting a fine-grained gradient. Semantic textual gradient abstraction clusters semantically similar gradients to prevent mixing unrelated failure modes, and abstracts each cluster into a generalized gradient that captures the shared corrective pattern. Experimental results show that AgentGrad achieves state-of-the-art performance across five MAS benchmarks and reduces wall-clock optimization time by $2.5\times$ on average compared to the next-fastest baseline.

</details>


### [670] [A Three-Tier Persona Vector for Controllable User Simulation in Agentic Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08592)
*Rahul Khedar,Eshita,Sneha Teja Sree Reddy Thondapu,Mayank Malhotra,Arup Kumar Das,Jitesh Chandra Mishra,Arun Menon,Avinash Karn,Mouli V*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种三层人物画像（persona）向量模型，包含6个分类人口统计学维度、12个连续行为特征维度和5个随场景动态变化的情感状态维度，并通过4级查询复杂度叠加层来控制对话措辞。该模型在64,698轮多轮对话中验证，展示了不同人物画像导致可测量的行为差异（15.8个百分点目标达成率差距），以及场景反应式情感状态设计能忠实复现真实世界的难度分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具增强型LLM代理的评估框架使用扁平化角色描述（如"你是一个愤怒的客户"），导致无论底层场景如何，生成的对话几乎相同，缺乏多样性和真实性，无法充分评估代理在不同用户类型下的表现。

Method: 提出三层人物画像向量模型：(1) 6个分类人口统计维度（司法辖区、年龄、渠道、设备、语言熟练度、时间可用性）；(2) 12个连续行为特征（耐心、果断性、数字素养等），围绕曲线化配置的基础向量用高斯噪声采样；(3) 5个连续情感状态（挫败感、焦虑、信任、自信、压力），随场景上下文动态变化。与此正交的是4级查询复杂度覆盖层，控制话语措辞从直接到故意模糊。在包含8个命名画像和3个生产语料库的合成数据生成管线中评估。

Result: 关键发现：(i) 不同人物画像导致代理目标达成率有15.8个百分点差距，确认特征向量产生可测量不同的用户行为；(ii) 同一人物在不同场景行为不同，验证场景反应式情感状态设计；(iii) 领域特定项目在预订流程合规性上显示约15-20个百分点的人物敏感性差距，证明模型忠实再现真实难度分布；(iv) 七种规则描述的特征相关性产生可审计的共现模式，无需学习协方差矩阵。

Conclusion: 人物画像模型在24,000+轮对话（原文为64,698轮多轮对话）中已验证有效性和可复现性，模型完整规格可供复现，为工具增强型LLM代理评估提供了更真实、更多样化的用户行为模拟框架。

Abstract: Evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents requires diverse, realistic user inputs yet most evaluation frameworks use flat role descriptions ("you are an angry customer") that produce near-identical conversations regardless of the underlying scenario. In this paper, we propose a three-tier persona vector with 23 operationalized dimensions: 6 categorical demographics (jurisdiction, age, channel, device, language proficiency, time availability), 12 continuous behavioral traits (patience, assertiveness, digital literacy, etc.) sampled with Gaussian noise around curated profile base vectors, and 5 continuous emotional states (frustration, anxiety, trust, confidence, stress) that shift in response to scenario context. Orthogonal to the persona, a 4-level query-complexity overlay controls utterance phrasing from direct to deliberately vague. We evaluate the persona model inside a synthetic data generation pipeline across 64,698 multi-turn conversations spanning 8 named profiles and 3 production corpora. Key findings: (i) a 15.8 percentage-point spread in agent goal-achievement across personas confirms trait vectors produce measurably different user behavior; (ii) the same persona behaves differently across scenarios due to scenario-reactive emotional state shifts, validating the scenario-reactive design; (iii) domain-specific projects show persona sensitivity on booking-flow compliance (~15-20 percentage points gap between tier-aware and pressure-test personas), demonstrating the model faithfully reproduces real-world difficulty distributions; (iv) seven rule-described trait correlations produce auditable co-occurrence patterns without requiring learned covariance matrices. The persona model is fully specified for reproduction.

</details>


### [671] [Graph-Based Personalized Memory for LLM Agents: Representation, Evolution, Retrieval, and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08599)
*Dac Duy Anh Nguyen,Zhangchi Qiu,Shigeng Chen,Alan Wee-Chung Liew*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述论文，围绕基于图的个性化记忆在LLM智能体中的应用，提出了一个以生命周期为导向的视角，将现有研究组织为记忆表征、记忆演化、记忆检索和记忆评估四个阶段，旨在阐明图结构记忆如何支持自适应的、可控的、以用户为中心的LLM智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体正从单次会话工具演变为长期个人助理，需要在跨任务、跨情境、跨交互中适应用户，因此记忆成为个性化的核心需求。然而，现有工作分散在个性化智能体和通用图记忆框架中，缺乏对整体设计空间的理解，难以系统地审视该领域。

Method: 采用生命周期视角的综述方法，将基于图的个性化记忆研究分为四个维度进行组织与分析：(1) 记忆表征——如何用显式关系、时间上下文和证据链接建模用户信息；(2) 记忆演化——记忆如何连接、修订与适应变化；(3) 记忆检索——如何支持个性化决策；(4) 记忆评估——现有评测实践。同时比较关键设计选择并讨论开放挑战。

Result: 论文对基于图的个性化记忆研究进行了系统分类与梳理，比较了各阶段的关键设计选择，总结了现有评估实践，并指出了构建可靠长期个性化智能体所面临的开放挑战。

Conclusion: 基于图的个性化记忆能够为LLM智能体提供一个结构化的方式来记录不仅是"记住了什么"，还包括记忆之间如何关联、如何更新、如何检索以支持个性化决策的完整机制。该综述为理解图记忆在自适应、可控、以用户为中心的LLM智能体中的设计空间提供了全面框架。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are evolving from single-session tools toward long-term personal assistants that must adapt to individual users across tasks, contexts, and interactions. This shift makes memory a core requirement for personalization, since user preferences, goals, constraints, relationships, and past experiences are accumulated gradually and often change over time. Graph-based personalized memory provides a structured way to model such user information through explicit relations, temporal context, and evidence links. Such representations can model not only what an agent remembers about a user but also how memories are connected, revised, and retrieved to support personalized decisions. However, existing work remains fragmented across personalized agents and generic graph memory frameworks, making it difficult to understand the design space as a whole. This survey develops a lifecycle-oriented view of graph-based personalized memory for LLM agents. We organize existing studies around memory representation, memory evolution, memory retrieval, and memory evaluation. We further compare key design choices, discuss current evaluation practices, and open challenges in building reliable long-term personalized agents. This survey aims to clarify how graph-based memory can support adaptive, controllable, and user-centric LLM agents.

</details>


### [672] [CLAMP: Constrained Decoding for Vision-Language Embodied Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08602)
*Tianyi Ma,Parisa Kordjamshidi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CLAMP是一个多模态约束落地框架，通过在解码时施加基于场景证据的约束来提升冻结VLM规划器的可执行性，结合硬掩码消除无效token与基于HMM的世界状态前瞻模块对可行候选进行重加权，在VLABench等基准上改善物体落地与安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身规划中VLM生成的计划虽流畅但不可执行：可能引用场景中不存在的物体、选择不具备所需affordance的动作、或违反语法和动作约束。

Method: CLAMP利用初始观察限制物体引用范围，借助符号动作模型规定状态转移与目标；解码时以硬掩码消除无效token候选，同时用基于HMM的世界状态前瞻模块根据动作前置条件与目标可达性对剩余可行候选的概率进行重加权；测试时通过从冻结VLM采样的无标签续写来适配HMM。

Result: 在VLABench、SafeAgentBench和TaPA上的实验表明，场景落地约束改善了物体落地与安全性，剩余失败主要源于感知错误或约束规格不匹配。

Conclusion: 保留VLM语言先验的同时，可在解码时阻止视觉上不受支持、不安全或不可行的候选进入计划；剩余瓶颈在于感知质量与约束规格的对齐。

Abstract: Embodied planning increasingly relies on vision-language models (VLMs) to translate instructions and visual observations into executable action sequences. However, fluent plans are not always executable. A VLM may refer to objects that are not visually observed, select actions whose required affordances are unavailable, or violate syntax and action constraints. We introduce CLAMP, a multimodal constraint-grounding framework that turns scene evidence into decoding-time constraints for a frozen VLM planner. CLAMP uses the initial observation to restrict object references to those supported by the scene, while a provided symbolic action model specifies state transitions and goals. During decoding, hard masks eliminate invalid next-token candidates, while a Hidden Markov Model (HMM)-based world-state lookahead module reweights the probabilities of the remaining feasible candidates based on action preconditions and goal reachability. This allows the planner to retain the VLM's language prior while preventing visually unsupported, unsafe, or infeasible candidates from entering the plan. For unseen tasks and environments, CLAMP adapts the HMM at test time using label-free continuations sampled from the frozen VLM. Experiments on VLABench, SafeAgentBench, and TaPA show that scene-grounded constraints improve object grounding and safety, while most remaining failures stem from perception errors or misaligned constraint specifications.

</details>


### [673] [GoAnt: Quality-Diversity Multi-Agent Search for Alpha Factor Discovery in Market Microstructure Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08719)
*Stella Zhao,Tommy Sha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GoAnt，一个质量-多样性多智能体搜索框架，用于自动化alpha因子发现。它结合了Explorer、Exploiter和Connector三种非通信智能体，配合共享自适应Mental Map和紧凑的Queen调度器，在固定评估预算下高效搜索符号化交易信号。在2023-2026年真实的A股微结构数据上，GoAnt在价量和订单簿场景中分别达到41.8和47.6的质量加权收益，相比最强基线提升57%和97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单一和多智能体程序搜索系统存在两大问题：一是过度拟合预测代理指标，导致执行成本后策略失效；二是反复探索冗余的因子族，限制了执行稳健性和行为多样性。

Method: GoAnt框架包含三类非通信智能体（Explorer、Exploiter、Connector）、一个共享自适应Mental Map（按无泄漏执行画像组织候选因子，每生态位保留一个精英）以及紧凑的Queen调度器（从显式搜索状态摘要中重新分配评估预算）。此外定义了与地图无关的有效产出协议，直接统计每个方法评估记录中的高质量、互不冗余因子数量，使基于档案和无地图系统在同一标准下比较。

Result: 在2023-2026年真实A股微结构数据上，GoAnt在价量和订单簿设定下分别达到41.8和47.6的质量加权产出，在匹配预算下较最强基线提升57%和97%。其锁定群体的样本外质量保留率为0.64（价量）和0.67（订单簿），优于静态地图的0.61和0.63。

Conclusion: GoAnt通过质量-多样性多智能体协作与自适应记忆机制，在提升因子发现效率和多样性的同时增强了样本外稳健性，为自动化alpha搜索提供了一种更鲁棒且行为更多样的解决方案。

Abstract: Automated alpha factor discovery searches symbolic trading signals from price-volume panels and order-book data under a fixed evaluation budget. Existing single- and multi-agent program-search systems can overfit predictive proxies that fail after execution costs and repeatedly explore redundant factor families, limiting execution robustness and behavioral diversity. We introduce GoAnt, a quality-diversity multi-agent search framework that combines non-communicating Explorer, Exploiter and Connector workers with a shared adaptive Mental Map and a compact Queen dispatcher. The Mental Map organizes candidates by leakage-free execution profiles and retains one elite per niche, while the Queen reallocates the evaluation budget from explicit search-state summaries. We also define a map-independent effective-yield protocol that counts high-quality, mutually nonredundant factors directly from each method's evaluation records, giving archive-based and map-free systems the same ruler. On real A-share microstructure data spanning 2023--2026, GoAnt reaches quality-weighted yields of 41.8 and 47.6 in price-volume and order-book settings, improving the strongest baseline by 57% and 97% under matched budgets. Its locked populations retain 0.64 and 0.67 of in-sample quality out of sample, compared with 0.61 and 0.63 for a static map.

</details>


### [674] [Application of curiosity driven exploration methods for hardware interference identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08729)
*Ludovic Matar,Clement Moulin-Frier,Pierre-Yves Oudeyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出利用人工智能中的好奇心驱动探索算法，在基于模拟器的环境中系统地覆盖多核干扰行为空间，相较于传统伪随机程序生成方法，在有限实验预算内实现了更广泛且更均匀的行为覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单核向多核架构的转变引入了共享硬件资源竞争导致的核间干扰，影响执行时间并使严格时间需求的验证复杂化（尤其在航空电子等领域需要全面识别干扰源）。现有干扰分析方法（无论手动还是基于模型）难以捕获微架构组件复杂交互产生的全部行为。

Method: 将多核干扰分析建模为复杂系统行为空间的探索问题，采用人工智能中的好奇心驱动探索算法，在基于模拟器的环境中系统且高效地覆盖可能的干扰行为空间。

Result: 实验表明，与传统的伪随机程序生成方法相比，所提出的方法在有限的实验预算内实现了更广泛且更均匀的行为覆盖率。

Conclusion: 好奇心驱动的探索算法为多核干扰分析提供了一种系统化、高效的行为空间覆盖方法，相较于随机方法具有显著优势。

Abstract: The transition from single-core to multi-core architectures in safety-critical embedded systems introduces significant challenges due to inter-core interference caused by contention for shared hardware resources. Such interference affects execution times and complicates the verification of strict temporal requirements, particularly in domains such as avionics where standards require comprehensive identification of interference sources. Existing interference analysis approaches, whether manual or model-based, struggle to capture the full range of behaviors arising from the complex interactions among micro-architectural components. In this paper, we frame multi-core interference analysis as the exploration of a complex system behavior space. We propose the use of curiosity-driven exploration algorithms from artificial intelligence to systematically and efficiently cover the space of possible interference behaviors. Using a simulator-based environment, we show that the proposed approach achieves broader and more uniform behavioral coverage within a limited experimental budget compared to traditional pseudo-random program generation methods.

</details>


### [675] [When Can One Obtain Certificates of Optimality Using Positivstellensaetze?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08736)
*Nayoon Kim,Allen Gehret,Shenyuan Ma,Jakub Marecek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究学习问题中非多项式目标函数与约束条件的正性证书与最优性证书。作者提取了Fischer构造性严格与弱Positivstellensätze的公理核心，并在有序域上的抽象函数代数中证明了相应定理。该框架将目标/约束函数与构建证书所需的基础原语分离，前者可由连续或可定义运算的广泛类别构建，后者需满足显式标量与闭包公理。文中给出了连续与可定义函数代数上的实例（包括不封闭于平方根的有序域），推导出下界与全局最优性证书，并分析了扩展项长度与共享计算图复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Positivstellensatz类证书方法主要针对多项式优化问题，但许多机器学习问题涉及非多项式目标与约束。作者希望将Fischer的构造性证书定理推广到更抽象的函数代数框架，从而覆盖更广泛的学习问题类别，同时明确分离目标函数构建与证书构造所需的原语角色。

Method: 作者首先隔离出Fischer构造性严格与弱Positivstellensätze的核心公理条件，然后在有序域上的抽象函数代数中证明一般化定理。框架区分两类函数：目标/约束函数（由广泛连续或可定义运算构建）与辅助原语（需满足显式标量与闭包公理）。随后在连续与可定义函数代数上给出具体实例，并分析证书扩展长度与共享计算图复杂度。

Result: 该框架成功推广了Fischer的构造性证书定理到抽象函数代数，覆盖了包括不封闭于平方根的有序域在内的广泛场景。研究推导出下界证书和全局最优性证书，并给出了扩展项长度与共享计算图复杂度分析。

Conclusion: 作者建立了一个统一的抽象框架，将正性/最优性证书理论从多项式领域扩展到非多项式学习问题，填补了理论空白，并为未来在更广泛函数类别上构造可验证证书提供了基础。

Abstract: We study certificates of positivity and optimality for learning problems whose objectives and constraints need not be polynomial. We isolate an axiomatic core of Fischer's constructive strict and weak Positivstellensätze and prove the resulting theorems for abstract function algebras over ordered fields. The framework separates two roles that can otherwise be conflated: objective and constraint functions may be built from broad classes of continuous or definable operations, while the auxiliary primitives used to construct a certificate satisfy explicit scalar and closure axioms. We give instances over continuous and definable function algebras, including ordered fields not closed under square roots, derive lower-bound and global-optimality certificates, and analyze both expanded term length and shared computation-graph complexity.

</details>


### [676] [It's All in the Way You Say It: The Role of Information Representation in LLM-Based Glycemic-Event Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08772)
*Andrea Apicella,Pasquale Arpaia,Matteo Orefice,Andrea Pollastro,Roberto Prevete*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了基于提示的通用大语言模型（LLM）在1型糖尿病患者餐后高血糖和低血糖预测中的应用，利用OhioT1DM数据集评估多种开源LLM在零样本和少样本推理下的表现，并系统变化生理信息的文本表示方式和信息量。结果表明传统监督模型在高血糖预测上表现最佳，而提示式LLM在低血糖预测上全面优于其他方法，且生理信息的表示方式对预测效果有决定性影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正被越来越多地用于生理时间序列预测，但其有效性不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于生理信息在推理时如何被表示和呈现。目前缺乏对提示式通用LLM在血糖事件预测中表现的系统性研究，特别是信息表示方式对其影响尚不明确。

Method: 使用OhioT1DM数据集，评估多种开源权重LLM在零样本和少样本推理下对餐后高血糖和低血糖的预测能力，预测时域为30、60和90分钟。系统变化生理信息的文本表示（从仅血糖观测到衍生描述符，以及胰岛素、膳食、碳水化合物和体力活动等额外上下文变量）和信息暴露量，并与患者特异性监督模型及专门针对血糖预测的Gluco-LLM架构进行对比。

Result: 结果显示强任务依赖性：传统监督模型在高血糖预测中表现最强，而提示式LLM在所有预测时域内均提升了低血糖预测性能。生理信息的表示方式对提示式推理的有效性有显著影响，但提供额外上下文信息并未带来系统性改进。

Conclusion: 生理信息的表示方式是提示式LLM血糖事件预测方法中的核心设计因素，研究为如何优化LLM在生理时间序列预测中的应用提供了重要见解。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being investigated for physiological time-series prediction, yet their effectiveness may depend not only on the model itself, but also on how physiological information is represented and presented at inference time. This study investigates prompt-based general-purpose LLMs for postprandial hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia prediction in individuals with type 1 diabetes. Using the OhioT1DM dataset, we evaluate multiple open-weight LLMs under zero-shot and few-shot inference across prediction horizons of 30, 60, and 90 minutes. The analysis varies both the textual representation of the available physiological information and the amount of information exposed to the model, ranging from glucose observations alone to derived descriptors and additional contextual variables related to insulin, meals, carbohydrates, and physical activity. Performance is compared with conventional patient-specific supervised models and with Gluco-LLM, a language-model-based architecture explicitly adapted to glucose time-series forecasting. Results show a marked task-dependent behavior. Conventional supervised models achieve the strongest performance for hyperglycemia prediction, whereas the best observed prompt-based LLM configurations improve performance for hypoglycemia across all investigated horizons. The effectiveness of prompt-based inference is also strongly influenced by how physiological information is represented, while providing additional contextual information does not lead to a systematic improvement. Overall, these findings highlight physiological information representation as a central design factor in prompt-based LLM approaches to glycemic-event prediction.

</details>


### [677] [Closing the Consistency Gap: Self-Evolving Agents That Learn to Stay on Course](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08832)
*Evelyn Duesterwald,Benjamin Elder,Lilian Ngweta,Shashanka Ubaru,Malgorzata Zimon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM智能体"平均准确但生产环境中不可靠"的一致性问题，提出了一种自进化智能体框架，通过一致性分析器定位轨迹中不稳定的步骤，并将诊断转化为指导性经验记忆，从而在后续执行中减少一致性差距。在AppWorld基准上，该方法将五次全成功任务比例提升16个百分点（同任务）和13个百分点（相似任务泛化）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的智能体在平均准确率上表现良好，但在实际生产中却不可靠。作者观察到同一任务执行五次时，ReAct/GPT-4.1仅在53%的任务中全部成功，尽管单次平均通过率达77%，存在24个百分点的"一致性差距"。作者认为弥合这一差距是可信任AI智能体部署的前提条件，但该问题此前被观察却未被系统解决。

Method: 提出自进化智能体框架，核心包括两个组件：（1）一致性分析器（Consistency Analyzer）：精确定位智能体轨迹中哪些步骤、何种原因导致跨执行结果不稳定；（2）指导生成器（Guideline Generator）：将分析诊断转化为针对性的指导准则，存入情景记忆，并在未来执行相似任务时注入智能体。框架通过识别的低一致性步骤生成经验并迭代改进。

Result: 在AppWorld基准上使用ReAct/GPT-4.1，该框架将五次运行全部成功的任务比例提升16个百分点（同任务评估）和13个百分点（相似任务泛化评估）。

Conclusion: 通过将不稳定步骤转化为可复用的情景记忆，能够有效缩小智能体的一致性差距，同时在同任务和相似任务泛化场景下均表现出显著改进，为可信任AI智能体的可靠部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-powered agents can be accurate on average yet unreliable in production, a discrepancy that has been observed but remains largely unaddressed. When given the same task five times, a ReAct agent on the AppWorld benchmark using GPT-4.1 succeeds in all five runs only 53% of the time, even though its per-run pass rate averages 77%. We call this 24-point shortfall the consistency gap, and we argue that addressing it is a precondition for trustworthy AI agent deployment. We present a self-evolving agent framework that reduces this gap by identifying unstable, low-consistency steps in agent trajectories and converting them into episodic memory the agent can draw on in future runs. At its core is a Consistency Analyzer that pinpoints where and why a trajectory is likely to flip across executions, and a Guideline Generator that converts the diagnosis into targeted guidelines, committed to memory and injected into future agent executions on similar tasks. On AppWorld with ReAct/GPT-4.1, our framework raises the fraction of tasks that succeed in all five runs by +16 points on same-task evaluation and +13 points on similar-task generalization.

</details>


### [678] [SkillAdam: Stable and Efficient Skill Evolution for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08944)
*Gaoyuan Li,Meihao Fan,Yizhe Liu,Shaolei Zhang,Ju Fan,Siyi Wang,Jiaheng Hou,Xudong Weng,Honghan Tian,Zang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillAdam是一个受Adam优化器启发的框架，用于优化离散且不可微的技能文档，通过优化记忆（类第一矩）稳定更新方向，通过波动驱动的编辑预算（类第二矩）自适应控制更新幅度，在七个基准上取得最先进性能并显著提升迭代效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent技能能为冻结语言模型提供领域知识和程序性指导，但获取高质量技能成本高、难以扩展。现有的技能自进化方法依赖启发式更新策略，导致优化不稳定且迭代效率低。作者识别出两个挑战：方向稳定性（需要有效修正累积而非被局部反馈覆盖）和更新自适应性（修订范围需反映近期案例改进的一致性）。

Method: SkillAdam将Adam优化器的思想类比到离散、非可微的技能文档优化中。第一矩的类比：引入优化记忆，记录已识别的问题及先前解决方案的结果，以稳定更新方向。第二矩的类比：引入波动驱动的编辑预算，跟踪近期案例级改进的历史加权变化，自适应控制更新幅度（即每次修订的技能范围）。

Result: 在覆盖短程和长程任务的七个基准上，SkillAdam取得了最先进性能，并展现出更稳定的优化动态。相比现有方法，它使用更少的优化迭代次数和更低的成本就能获得更高质量的技能。

Conclusion: SkillAdam证明将经典优化器思想（如Adam）迁移至离散技能文档优化领域是有效的，解决了技能自进化中方向不稳定和更新不自适应的问题，为Agent技能的高效自动化获取提供了新范式。

Abstract: Agent skills provide a lightweight way to equip frozen language-model agents with domain knowledge and procedural guidance, yet obtaining high-quality skills remains costly and difficult to scale. Expert-written skills require substantial human effort. Recent skill self-evolution methods automate an iterative loop that uses execution feedback to revise skills, but their heuristic update strategies often yield unstable optimization and low iteration efficiency. We identify two challenges in realizing stable and efficient skill self-evolution. Direction Stability requires effective corrections to accumulate rather than be overwritten by iteration-local feedback. Update Adaptivity requires the scope of each revision to reflect the consistency of recent case-level improvements. We introduce SkillAdam, an Adam-inspired framework for optimizing discrete and non-differentiable skill documents. As a functional analogue of Adam's first moment, an optimization memory records identified problems and the outcomes of prior solution attempts to stabilize the update direction. As a functional analogue of Adam's second moment, a volatility-driven edit budget tracks the history-weighted variation of recent case-level improvements and adaptively controls the update magnitude. Across seven benchmarks that span short- and long-horizon tasks, SkillAdam achieves state-of-the-art performance with more stable optimization dynamics. It also obtains stronger skills with substantially fewer optimization iterations and lower cost than prior methods. Code repository: https://github.com/ruc-datalab/SkillAdam

</details>


### [679] [PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08965)
*Yuan Gao,Sebastian Müller,Mattia Piccinini,Marc Kaufeld,Yuchen Zhang,Finn Rasmus Schäfer,Qunying Song,Johannes Betz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PlannerForge是一个统一的LLM-agent框架，覆盖自动驾驶场景测试全流程，从场景生成到ADS评估，并新增ADS增强与基准测试两个阶段。在10个LLM和5种提示条件下评估，各任务最佳得分0.88-1.00，开源模型表现可与商业API媲美，端到端管线保留78-83%的种子查询，并在场景生成、选择、修改等任务上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶安全验证面临挑战，现有基于场景的测试方法是一个碎片化的模块化流水线，场景生成、检索、修改、ADS执行和结果分析由不同工具完成且缺乏交互。虽然LLM智能体在感知、规划、控制等ADS子系统展现了潜力，但尚无工作用统一的LLM-agent框架覆盖整个场景化测试流水线。

Method: PlannerForge是一个统一的LLM-agent框架，扩展了从场景生成到ADS评估的所有场景化测试阶段，并增加了两个LLM增强的新阶段：ADS增强（Enhancement）和ADS基准测试（Benchmarking）。框架涵盖生成、选择、修改、模块路由、规划器测试和增强六个任务。

Result: 10个现成LLM在所有任务和5种提示条件下评估，最佳任务得分0.88-1.00；Qwen3.6:35B等开源模型在其中三个任务上匹敌商业API。端到端链式管线保留78%（开源）/83%（商业）的种子查询。自然语言生成超过Scenario Factory 2.0（193 vs 144个可执行/200），前1名选择超过BM25（92.0% vs 67.5%），物理有效编辑超过From-Words-to-Collisions（≥94% vs 31%）。N=400时成本调优将规划器成功率从50.4%提升至70.2%，碰撞率从19.0%降至8.4%，且无需领域特定微调。

Conclusion: PlannerForge证明了一个统一的LLM-agent框架可以在无需各模块深度定制的情况下，有效覆盖自动驾驶场景化测试全流程，开源模型在多数任务上可替代商业API。该系统通过成本调优显著提升规划器性能并降低碰撞率，为自动驾驶安全性验证提供了新的统一范式。

Abstract: Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge. Scenario-based testing is a systematic process used to validate Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs), but it remains a fragmented modular pipeline in which scenario generation, retrieval, modification, ADS execution, and results analysis are performed by separate tools with little interaction. Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise across ADS sub-systems such as perception, planning, and control. However, no prior work covers the whole scenario-based testing pipeline for ADSs with a unified LLM-agent framework. We present PlannerForge, an LLM-agent framework that extends all scenario-based testing stages (from Scenario Generation to ADS Assessment) and adds two further LLM-enhanced stages: ADS Enhancement and ADS Benchmarking. We evaluate PlannerForge with 10 off-the-shelf LLMs across all tasks (Generation, Selection, Modification, Module Routing, Planner Testing, and Enhancement) under 5 prompt conditions. Best-per-task scores range from 0.88 to 1.00, and open-source 20-35B backends match commercial APIs on most tasks. Open-source models such as Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three of the five tasks. Chaining the modules end-to-end retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). It outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0 (Finkeldei et al., 2025) on natural-language generation (193 vs. 144 executable of 200) and realises 92-96% of requested city, road and vehicle attributes. It outperforms BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009) at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and From-Words-to-Collisions (Gao et al., 2025) on physically valid edits (>=94% vs. 31%). At N=400, cost-tuning lifts planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and cuts collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%, without domain-specific fine-tuning.

</details>


### [680] [Good Pretraining, Bad SFT: Checkpoint Quality Across the Training Stack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08966)
*Sohir Maskey,Philipp Scholl,Jonas Knupp,Pit Neitemeier,Sascha Wirges*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现语言模型检查点的选择标准存在问题：预训练损失或基准分数最高的检查点并不一定是后续训练的最佳起点。在完整的30B MoE训练流程中，经过完整下游训练后表现更好的检查点具有更高的"解密度"（即在局部权重扰动下仍能保持下游性能）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上，语言模型检查点选择基于预训练损失或基准分数，假设最高分检查点是最佳后续训练起点。作者在30B混合专家（MoE）训练流程中发现这一假设可能失效，需要寻找更好的检查点选择指标。

Method: 作者在完整的30B混合专家（MoE）训练流程中，系统地比较了不同检查点在预训练损失、基准分数以及"解密度"（在局部权重扰动下保持下游性能的能力）上的表现，评估这些指标与下游训练后性能的相关性。

Result: 结果显示，预训练损失或基准分数最高的检查点并不总是后续训练的最佳起点。相反，具有更高"解密度"的检查点在经过完整下游训练后表现更好，"解密度"是一个更可靠的检查点选择指标。

Conclusion: 检查点选择不应仅依赖预训练损失或基准分数，解密度（对局部权重扰动的鲁棒性）是预测后续训练性能的更有效信号，为大规模MoE训练中的检查点选择提供了新思路。

Abstract: Language-model checkpoints are commonly selected by pretraining loss or benchmark scores, assuming that the highest-scoring checkpoint will remain the best starting point for subsequent training. We show that this assumption can fail in a full 30B mixture-of-experts training pipeline. The checkpoints that perform better after the full downstream training stack also have higher solution density, i.e., retain downstream performance under local weight perturbations.

</details>


### [681] [Deposon: An Auditable, Conservation-Guaranteed, Game-Theoretically Tested Scattering Layer over LLM Reasoning Paths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09001)
*Qihao Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Deposon散射层，为多步LLM推理的概念分解图构建机器可复验的账本。每个节点绑定两参数Deposon状态，路径经历透射、反射、不可逆耗散三通道散射（满足T+R+A=1，能量审计偏差达机器精度）。作者诚实报告三层证据：合成陷阱基准为封闭结果（100% vs 7%/10%），真实基准上区分度为零（与朴素六关键词规则过滤器无异），融合增益为负且lambda=2增益是伪影。动力学层面的势博弈主张被降级为近似，仅一致性层面的证据存续。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步LLM推理缺乏机器可复验的账本——被丢弃的推理路径不留下可审计记录。这一根本缺陷使得推理过程难以验证、审计与追责，作者旨在为推理过程引入可散射审计的机制化层。

Method: 提出Deposon散射层：将LLM生成的概念分解图每个节点绑定两参数Deposon状态；路径经三通道散射（透射、反射、不可逆耗散），满足守恒律T+R+A=1。同时将反向动力学建模为图上的势博弈，量化经验协调比（ECR），并形式化三个动力学等价命题。

Result: 合成陷阱基准上路径过滤增益封闭且显著（100% vs 7%/10%）；真实基准上与被平凡六关键词规则过滤器无统计显著差异（GSM8K 0.87≥0.85，McNemar p=0.5；StrategyQA 0.899=0.899）；融合为负结果（0.484→0.452，lambda=2增益为反场伪影）；势博弈主张遭前注册kill协议推翻，降级为近似（循环图中位残差0.669）。

Conclusion: 结论：Deposon的差分价值不在于传统意义上的推理性能提升（真实基准上无增益），而纯粹在于机器可验证性。性能主张被明确定位于合成陷阱场景，而现实场景的正当性需依托其可审计性而非准确率。作者强调诚实的证据分层报告，否定非线性融合增益之外的任何线性增益路径。

Abstract: Multi-step LLM reasoning lacks a machine-recheckable ledger: discarded reasoning paths leave no auditable record. We propose the Deposon scattering layer, which binds each node of an LLM-generated concept-decomposition graph to a two-parameter Deposon state; paths undergo three-channel scattering -- transmission, reflection, irreversible dissipation -- obeying T+R+A=1 for arbitrary parameters, with a maximum per-path energy-audit deviation of 2.2E-16 (machine epsilon). We report all three evidence tiers honestly. On synthetic trap benchmarks the path-filtering gain is closed (pre-registered): unified reaches 100% versus a decoy-capture baseline at 7%/10%. On real benchmarks the layer is indistinguishable from a trivial six-keyword rule filter (GSM8K 0.87 >= 0.85, McNemar p=0.5; StrategyQA 0.899 = 0.899); no difference is detected here, so we sharpen the claim to "the differential value lies solely in machine verifiability." Fusion yields a second negative result: convex combinations with a semantic prior never improve (physics 0.484 -> 0.452), and the apparent lambda=2 gain is an anti-field artifact; any fusion gain must be nonlinear. Modeling the reverse dynamics as a potential game on the graph, we evidence an auditable scalar's monotonicity and near-gradientness and quantify the empirical coordination ratio (ECR). The three formalized dynamical-equivalence propositions (P1a/P1b/T-P1c) are falsified under the pre-registered kill protocol, and the potential-game claim is downgraded to approximate (cyclic-graph median residual 0.669): only consistency-level evidence survives at the dynamical level. Code: github.com/zeroandcat/Deposon.

</details>


### [682] [Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09030)
*Mar Gonzàlez I Català,Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde,Davide Murari,Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb,Pietro Liò,George Montañez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"答案分布轨迹"(answer-distribution trajectories)方法，以随机动力学视角追踪大语言模型在推理过程中完整的答案预测分布演变，比传统的端到端准确率和熵轮廓提供更细粒度的推理动态分析。实验覆盖16个开源模型和4个推理基准，发现相同终点与相似熵轮廓的推理轨迹可能呈现截然不同的动态特征，且训练和推理选择会系统性地重塑这些动态轮廓。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 链式思维推理虽然为模型输入与最终答案之间提供了结构化计算，但现有评估主要依赖最终答案的准确性，忽略了到达答案的路径。熵轮廓方法虽能追踪推理过程中不确定性的演变，却无法揭示是哪些相互竞争的假设造成了这种不确定性。因此需要一种更细粒度的表示来刻画推理过程的完整动态。

Method: 引入"答案分布轨迹"表示，灵感来自随机动力学，追踪模型在推理展开时对答案的完整预测分布。该表示比端到端与熵摘要严格更细，能够通过探索、修订、运动和承诺等维度刻画推理轨迹的动态轮廓，并区分推理成功与失败的不同动力学机制。

Result: 在16个开源权重语言模型和4个推理基准上，发现具有相同终点和相似熵轮廓的轨迹可表现出显著不同的推理动态；推理动态在模型内部、模型之间以及任务之间均存在显著差异；不同目标偏好不同的动态轮廓；训练和推理选择会系统性地重塑这些动态。

Conclusion: 答案分布轨迹为分析和评估LLM推理动态提供了丰富的框架，弥补了仅依赖端点准确率或熵摘要评估推理质量的不足。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds.
