*Christoph Wigbels,Ali Abusaleh,Markus T. Jansen,Alexander Mehler,Manuel Schaaf,Markus J. Hofmann*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本研究探究能否用个体搜索历史的文本语料库(IC)模拟个体知识。316名成人完成36个多选题，测试多个LLM，仅Qwen3-1.7B可行。经LoRA微调后，在公开题目上优于参与者和德国常模样本，但在非公开题目上逊于参与者（提示训练数据污染）。将IC整合进RAG预测个体回答时，匹配准确率显著高于随机，但概率校准不佳。知识缺口预测欠佳，但语料超500万token时有所改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索能否利用个体搜索历史形成的文本语料库来模拟个体知识，以检验LLM在个性化知识模拟上的潜力与局限。

Method: 收集316名成人的个体语料库(IC)，让其回答36道多选题；对比多个LLM（仅Qwen3-1.7B可行）；采用LoRA进行任务特定微调；结合RAG整合IC预测个体反应；使用基于熵的评估基准衡量校准。

Result: LoRA微调后Qwen3-1.7B在公开题目上优于参与者和德国常模样本，但在非公开题目上表现更差（提示训练数据污染）；RAG下LLM-参与者匹配准确率显著高于随机（存在个体知识信号），但概率校准差；知识缺口预测欠佳，语料超500万token有改善。

Conclusion: 个体语料库包含可检测的个体知识信号，可用于模拟个体知识，但当前校准不足；熵基评估基准可作为个体化知识模拟的校准指标，未来需改善校准与知识缺口预测能力。

Abstract: This study examines whether individual text corpora (ICs) from search histories can be used to simulate individual knowledge. We collected ICs from 316 adults, who answered 36 multiple-choice knowledge items, and compared several large language models (LLMs) on this task, of which only Qwen3-1.7B proved viable. After task-specific fine-tuning via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), Qwen3-1.7B outperformed both participants and a representative German norm sample on publicly available items. On non-public questions, however, the LLM performed worse than our participants, suggesting possible training data contamination for the public questions. When integrating ICs into retrieval-augmented generation to predict individual responses, LLM-participant Match accuracies significantly exceeded chance, which demonstrates a detectable individual knowledge signal. The probabilities assigned to the participants' answers were, however, low and far below the probability of correct answers, indicating poor calibration toward individual response patterns. Knowledge-gap prediction was sub-optimal, though it improved for corpora exceeding five million tokens. We discuss our entropy based evaluation benchmarks as calibration indices for individualized knowledge simulation.

</details>


### [716] [PDMR: Passage-Driven Multi-ID Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08762)
*Smail Oussaidene,Mohand Boughanem*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出PDMR（Passage-Driven Multi-ID Retrieval），一种生成式检索框架，通过将文档切分为多个段落并为每个段落分配独立标识符，为同一文档提供多个语义入口点。PDMR将训练建模为多目标学习问题以处理一对多映射的监督歧义，在NQ320K和MS MARCO Document上取得了优于强基线的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式检索（GR）方法采用单一标识符假设，即每篇文档只映射到一个目标序列。但文档通常具有多面性（multi-faceted），单一标识符迫使模型将所有文档内容压缩进一个序列中，导致有损表示。当多个用户查询意图需要竞争同一个生成路径时，模型的鲁棒性和检索性能都会下降。

Method: PDMR将每篇文档分割为多个段落，并为每个选中的段落分配一个独立的标识符，从而为同一文档提供多个语义入口点。为了应对这种一对多映射带来的监督歧义，PDMR将训练形式化为多目标学习问题，设计目标函数将概率质量分配到多个有效的段落级标识符上。

Result: 在NQ320K上，PDMR在Recall@1和MRR@100上超越了强生成式和非生成式基线。在MS MARCO Document上，PDMR在Recall@1和MRR@10上取得了最佳结果，并在Recall@10上保持竞争力。消融实验表明段落级监督、标识符设计、训练查询增强和多目标学习各自贡献了互补的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过段落级多标识符表示，PDMR有效缓解了单一标识符带来的表示损失和查询意图竞争问题，验证了为文档提供多个语义访问路径是提升生成式检索性能的有效策略。

Abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) models map queries directly to document identifiers, replacing conventional retrieval over external sparse or dense indexes with autoregressive identifier generation. However, most generative retrieval frameworks rely on a single-identifier assumption, mapping each document to a single target sequence. This forces the model to represent all document content with one sequence. Since documents are often multi-faceted, this can lead to lossy representations and reduced robustness to query variation, where multiple query intents must compete for a single generative access path.
  In this work, we introduce Passage-Driven Multi-ID Retrieval (PDMR), a generative retrieval framework that represents documents through multiple passage-level identifiers. PDMR segments each document and assigns one identifier to each selected passage, which provides multiple semantic entry points for retrieving the same document. This multi-entry representation allows the model to align queries with specific semantic facets, thereby reducing the dependence on a single document-level target. To address the supervision ambiguity of this one-to-many mapping, we formulate training as a multi-target learning problem and explore an objective function designed to distribute probability mass across multiple valid passage-level identifiers.
  We evaluate PDMR on NQ320K and MS MARCO Document. On NQ320K, PDMR improves over strong generative and non-generative baselines on Recall@1 and MRR@100. On MS MARCO Document, PDMR achieves the best Recall@1 and MRR@10 among the reported methods, while remaining competitive on Recall@10. Controlled ablations further show that passage-level supervision, identifier design, training-query augmentation, and multi-target learning contribute complementary gains.

</details>


### [717] [REDSI: Addressing the Reproducibility and Evaluation Consistency of Differentiable Search Indexing for Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08860)
*Vivien Nicolas,Hicham Randrianarivo,Pascale Sébillot,Caio Corro*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ReDSI是首个开源的可复现DSI（可微搜索索引）实现，支持全部三种文档标识符类型（原子式、朴素式、语义式），并提供了参数化且文档完善的NQ320K数据集构建管道，实验结果表明其竞争力强于或持平以往DSI基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DSI框架已成为生成式检索的事实标准基线，但存在严重的可复现性问题：缺乏覆盖全部三种文档标识符类型的公开实现、已有结果差异大、NQ320K数据集预处理方式多样且定义不清，阻碍了该领域的研究进展。

Method: 提出ReDSI，一个开源DSI实现，统一支持原子式、朴素式和语义式三种文档标识符类型；同时构建了可参数化且有完善文档的NQ320K数据集构建管道，并在此基础上开展模型规模缩减（downscaling）下的大量实验。

Result: ReDSI在检索效果上与以往DSI基线相比具有竞争力或更强；同时在模型缩小场景下，系统性地评测了检索有效性、参数效率、训练方法和解码策略，揭示了新的研究方向。

Conclusion: ReDSI填补了DSI缺乏统一开源复现的空白，为生成式检索研究提供了可复现的基础设施，并通过小模型实验探索了新的研究前沿。

Abstract: The differentiable search index (DSI) framework (Tay et al., 2022) has become the de facto baseline for generative retrieval. However, DSI is hard to reproduce: no public implementation covers all three original document identifier types (atomic, naive, semantic), reported results vary widely, and the ubiquitous NQ320K dataset is built from Natural Questions through diverse and underspecified preprocessing. We introduce ReDSI, the first open-source DSI implementation supporting all three identifier types, together with a parameterizable and well-documented NQ320K construction pipeline.
  Experimentally, we achieve results that are competitive with or stronger than previous DSI baselines. Moreover, we conduct extensive experiments under model downscaling, covering retrieval effectiveness, parameter efficiency, training methods and decoding strategies, opening novel directions for future research.

</details>


### [718] [Q2D-Web: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Retrieval in Agentic RAG Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08887)
*Maximilian Schall,Sedigheh Eslami,Markus Krimmel,Antoine Chaffin,Louis Milliken,Bo Wang,Denis Bykov*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了Q2D-Web，一个大规模智能体检索基准，包含1.9亿文档的网页语料库和7万个基于生产环境真实用户查询改写的智能体搜索查询（覆盖10种语言）。该基准提供三种固定的相关性判定集（智能体引用、生产排名及两者联合），并评测了13种检索器，发现其在各判定集下排序相对稳定，但在主题领域、查询语言和查询类型上差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开基准无法评估大规模生产环境RAG中的第一阶段检索器：大规模语料库通常只有少量评测查询，而多查询基准仅含数百万文档；此外，大多数基准使用人类编写的查询，而智能体RAG管道中的第一阶段检索器服务于机器改写查询，其分布与人类搜索行为不同，存在评测空白。

Method: 构建包含190M文档和70k智能体搜索查询（十种语言）的基准，查询源自生产系统真实用户查询的改写；提供三组固定相关性判定：智能体引用、生产排序、以及联合两组信号并加入LLM对未标注池文档判断的合并集以减少假阴性。此外研究子语料采样作为全语料评测的近似方法，采用倒数排名融合选择保留三分之一的语料。

Result: 对13种检索器（词法、稠密、晚期交互模型）的评测显示，相对排序对判定集选择基本不敏感，但在主题领域、查询语言和查询类型间差异显著。保留三分之一的语料可保持全语料模型排序，仅使绝对Recall@1000提升3至7个百分点。

Conclusion: Q2D-Web填补了大规模智能体检索评测的空白，提供可扩展的评测方案，且子语料采样可作为高效近似评测手段。该基准及其公开排行榜可服务于生产级RAG系统的第一阶段检索器评估与开发。

Abstract: Evaluating first-stage retrievers in large-scale production RAG requires a benchmark that pairs a large-scale corpus with a large set of agent-reformulated search queries based on real user queries and their conversation threads, and that labels many relevant documents per query. No existing public benchmark evaluates this setting: large-scale collections typically provide only a small number of evaluation queries, whereas benchmarks with many queries generally contain only millions of documents. Moreover, most benchmarks assess human-written queries, while the first-stage retrievers in agentic RAG pipelines serve machine-written reformulations whose distribution differs from human search behavior. To overcome these evaluation gaps, we introduce Q2D-Web (Query2Doc-Web), a large-scale agentic retrieval benchmark consisting of a 190M-document web corpus and 70k agentic search queries in ten languages, reformulated from real-world user queries in production systems. Q2D-Web provides three sets of fixed relevance judgments: agent citations, production rankings, and a combined set that unions both signals and adds LLM-based judgments of unlabeled pooled documents to reduce false negatives. We benchmark 13 retrievers including lexical, dense, and late-interaction models and find that their relative ordering is largely insensitive to the choice of judgment set, while diverging substantially across topical domains, query languages, and query types. To enable fast evaluation, we also study subcorpus sampling as an approximation to full-corpus evaluations. Retaining a third of the corpus, selected by reciprocal rank fusion over pooled retriever runs, preserves the full-corpus model ranking under the combined judgments while raising absolute Recall@1000 only by 3 to 7 points. The public leaderboard is accessible under: https://huggingface.co/spaces/perplexity-ai/q2d-web-leaderboard

</details>


### [719] [FINALLY: A Dataset Recommender System for Recommender-Systems Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08941)
*Louis Owie*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文介绍了FINALLY，一个基于Web的数据集推荐工具，用于为离线推荐系统评估构建可配置的数据集集合。该工具结合必需数据集、候选池限制、元数据过滤、目标集大小、随机选择和基于有效协方差与凸包目标的多样/非多样策略。通过420次推荐运行和10种系统化配置进行验证，所有数据集集均满足约束条件，策略也符合预期优化方向，但未证明其科学适用性或全局最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集选择决定了推荐系统算法的评估条件，但现有工具无法支持构建同时满足实验约束和集合级选择目标的数据集集合。

Method: 开发FINALLY网络工具，支持必需数据集、候选池限制、元数据过滤、可配置目标集大小，并基于改进的有效协方差和凸包目标实现多样性与非多样性策略，同时提供随机选择作为基准。

Result: 通过420次推荐运行和10种系统化配置评估，所有数据集集满足目标大小、去重、快照成员、必需数据集和元数据过滤要求；40个确定性策略-配置组合均可复现；多样/非多样策略在所有配置中产生预期得分排序。

Conclusion: FINALLY工作流在技术一致性上得到验证，策略遵循其预期优化方向，但结果不证明生成选择在科学适用性、全局最优性或实践优越性方面的表现。

Abstract: Dataset selection shapes the empirical conditions under which recommender-system algorithms are evaluated, yet existing tools provide limited support for constructing complete dataset sets that jointly satisfy experimental constraints and set-level selection objectives. To address this problem, I developed FINALLY, a web-based dataset recommender for constructing configurable dataset sets for offline recommender-systems evaluations. FINALLY combines required datasets, candidate-pool restrictions, metadata filters, configurable target-set sizes, Random selection, and diverse and non-diverse strategies based on adapted Effective Covariance and Convex Hull objectives. I evaluated FINALLY through 420 recommendation runs across ten systematically varied configurations. All evaluated dataset sets satisfied the applicable target-size, duplicate-avoidance, snapshot-membership, required-dataset, and metadata-filter requirements. All 40 deterministic strategy--configuration combinations were reproducible. Both the Effective-Covariance-based and Convex-Hull-based strategies produced the expected diverse-versus-non-diverse score ordering in all ten configurations. Under their corresponding objectives, the diverse strategies produced scores above all 30 configuration-specific Random results, whereas the non-diverse strategies produced scores below all 30 Random results. These results establish technical consistency for the evaluated FINALLY workflow and show that the implemented strategies follow their intended optimization directions within the investigated configuration space. They do not establish the scientific suitability, global optimality, or practical superiority of the generated selections.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [720] [AhaBench: Do Agents Learn from Prior Experience? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05435)
*Zerui Cheng,Jiawei Xu,Huacan Chai,Jiayang Sun,Pramod Viswanath,Maxm Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AhaBench是一个评估语言模型智能体长期学习与迁移能力的基准测试套件，包含三个组件（Aha-Puzzle、Aha-Euler、Aha-Vending），通过"初始分数-经验后分数-学习提升"的三部分记分卡来区分模型在支持环境下表现良好、在经验后达到高分、以及在运行过程中提升最快这三种不同的能力维度，发现这些能力往往不属于同一模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大多数智能体评估在提示后即重置状态，或仅对单条轨迹的最终状态打分，无法回答一个更具操作性的问题：当固定模型接收到有用的经验后，在移除、改变或延迟明显支持的相关评估条件下，其后续行为是否有所提升。这需要一个能测试智能体长期学习和经验迁移能力的基准。

Method: 构建包含三个组件的AhaBench套件：Aha-Puzzle测试在解决隐藏状态谜题后的无提示探索能力；Aha-Euler将Project-Euler风格的数学思想转化为带精确验证器的"教授/留出"任务对；Aha-Vending模拟售货机智能体在延迟反馈和运营事故中的盈利能力。报告采用三部分记分卡：初始分数（起始能力）、经验后分数（后续实证结果）和学习提升（两者之差）。

Result: 在八个模型的面板上，Claude Opus 4.6在聚合经验后分数（64.3）和学习提升（+25.8）方面领先，Gemini 3.1 Pro紧随其后（63.4）。组件结果显示：谜题追踪提升了有支持的分数但常未转化为无提示探索行为；Aha-Euler完整教学达78.6-100.0%，而仅答案迁移为0.0-73.9%；Aha-Vending能区分盈利的事故处理与破产及无订单失败。

Conclusion: AhaBench的核心实证信息是：善于利用可见支持的模型、能达到高经验后分数的模型、以及在运行过程中改进最多的模型并非总是同一批模型。该分解揭示了三类能力的差异。论文开源了基准任务、评分细则、验证器、模拟器代码与评估接口。

Abstract: Modern language agents are expected to operate over long horizons: they ask follow-up questions, reuse worked examples, handle tool feedback, and adapt to delayed consequences. Most evaluations still reset the agent after a prompt or score only the final state of one trajectory. AhaBench asks a more operational question: when a fixed model receives useful experience, does its later behavior improve under a related evaluation condition where the obvious support has been removed, changed, or delayed? The suite contains three components. Aha-Puzzle tests no-hint exploration after solved hidden-state puzzles; Aha-Euler turns Project-Euler-style mathematical ideas into generated taught/held-out tasks with exact validators; and Aha-Vending, an open-source implementation inspired by Vending-Bench, tests whether a simulated vending agent remains profitable while handling delayed feedback and operational incidents. AhaBench reports a three-part scorecard: Initial Score measures starting competence, Post-Experience Score measures the later empirical outcome, and Learning Lift is their difference. This decomposition is the main empirical message: models that use visible support well, models that reach high post-experience scores, and models that improve most during a run are not always the same. On the common eight-model panel, Claude Opus 4.6 leads aggregate Post-Experience Score at 64.3 and aggregate Learning Lift at +25.8, with Gemini 3.1 Pro close behind at 63.4. The component results explain the split: puzzle traces raise supported scores but often fail to become no-hint exploration behavior; Aha-Euler full teaching reaches 78.6-100.0% while answer-only transfer ranges from 0.0 to 73.9%; and Aha-Vending separates profitable incident handling from bankruptcy and no-order failure. We release benchmark tasks, rubrics, validators, simulator code, and interfaces for evaluating new agents.

</details>


### [721] [When Do Options Help? Policy Necrosis and Redundant Coverage in Option-Critic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05508)
*Bingyun Liu,Yuheng Jing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过理论和实验解释了Option-Critic算法为什么在增加选项数量时性能会提升。研究发现三个关键原因：学习到的终止规则在功能上等同于每步都终止；选项内部策略几乎不探索导致"策略坏死"（约五分之三的状态受影响）；额外选项并不会改善单个选项，而是降低了所有选项在同一状态同时失败的概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Option-Critic是一种学习子策略及其终止规则的方法，其最显著的实验现象是"选项越多性能越好"。作者想要深入理解这一结果背后的真实机制，而非仅仅停留在表面观察。

Method: 结合理论分析与实验验证：(1) 证明当终止测试和选项选择策略读取相同值时，终止测试每步都会触发，学习到的规则等同于总是终止；并给出探索被阻塞时Ω(T)后悔度的反例。(2) 提出"策略坏死"概念，给出状态级检测测试。(3) 通过强制每步终止、恢复探索等消融实验来验证假设。

Result: 终止规则对性能提升没有贡献，强制每步终止后选项数量-性能曲线不变；约五分之三的选项内部状态发生策略坏死；增加选项使所有选项在同一状态同时失败的概率从59%降至4%，性能提升源于这一联合概率的下降而非单个选项变好。

Conclusion: Option-Critic的性能提升可完全归因于"多个失败率较高的选项组合后降低联合失败概率"这一机制，而非学习到了有意义的选项结构。这提示该领域的性能改进可能来自更朴素的机制，研究者应关注探索的充分性和多策略的鲁棒性组合。

Abstract: Option-critic learns options: sub-policies together with a learned rule for when each one hands control back. Its headline result is that performance improves as options are added. We explain that result, with theory and experiment. First, the termination rule option-critic learns by maximising return contributes nothing. When the termination test and the policy that picks options read the same values, the test fires at every step, so the learned rule is identical to always terminating. When that policy explores and the test does not, as in option-critic itself, the rule can block the exploration; there are instances where it suffers $Ω(T)$ regret while always terminating holds to $O(\log T)$. Forcing termination at every step leaves the option-count curve intact. Second, the policy inside an option barely explores at all, so a state locks onto the first action that looked good and never updates again. We name this policy necrosis, give a state-level test for it, and find three fifths of states necrotic in a typical option. Restoring exploration repairs those states, and one option then solves the task. Third, extra options improve no option; what falls is the chance that all of them fail in the same state, from $59\\%$ to $4\\%$, and performance follows that joint quantity.

</details>


### [722] [Multi-granularity Adaptive Hypergraph Representation Learning via Granular-ball](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05574)
*Sen Zhao,Yifan Guan,Jinyuan Ni,Gaojie Xu,Zhang Xu,Xiaoyu Lian,Yi Liu,Yi Wang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为MGHRL（多粒度超图表示学习）的新框架，通过自适应粒度球分裂生成多粒度超边，并利用多子网络分层可逆连接架构来捕捉和整合不同粒度的超图特征，在基准数据集上显著优于基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超图表示学习方法大多依赖预定义规则生成超边，忽略了图拓扑结构的多样性以及超边的多粒度特性，导致难以自适应地发现高阶关系和高效处理复杂结构信息。

Method: MGHRL包含两个核心组件：(1) 自适应粒度超图生成策略，通过粒度球的自适应分裂在不同粒度层级生成超边，依据图的拓扑结构捕捉高阶关系；(2) 多粒度超图网络，包含多个子网络分别捕捉不同粒度超边的特征，并通过分层可逆连接进行特征整合。

Result: 在基准数据集上的实验结果表明，MGHRL显著优于现有基线模型。

Conclusion: MGHRL通过自适应多粒度超图生成和多粒度网络集成，有效解决了现有方法在捕捉高阶关系和复杂结构信息方面的局限性，验证了多粒度视角下超图表示学习的有效性。

Abstract: Hypergraph representation learning aims to capture high-order information in graphs by constructing hyperedges that simultaneously connect multiple nodes. These hyperedges adapt to the graph's topological features, facilitating the extraction of high-order relationships at multiple granularities. Most prior work relies on predefined definitions to generate hyperedges, overlooking the diversity in graph topological structures and the multi-granularity characteristics of hyperedges. As a result, this limits their ability to effectively and adaptively discover high-order relationships and efficiently process complex structural information. To address this limitation, we propose a novel framework called \underline{M}ulti-\underline{G}ranularity \underline{H}ypergraph \underline{R}epresentation \underline{L}earning (MGHRL). MGHRL introduces an Adaptive Granular Hypergraph Generation strategy, which generates hyperedges at multiple levels of granularity through the adaptive splitting of granular-ball, effectively capturing high-order relationships based on the graph's topological structure. Additionally, we propose a Multi-Granularity Hypergraph Network with multiple sub-networks, capturing features from hyperedges at different granularities and integrating them via hierarchical reversible connections. Experimental results show that MGHRL significantly outperforms baseline models on benchmark datasets.

</details>


### [723] [Capsule Lens: Locating and Tracking Concept Geometry in Model Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05575)
*Yiming Tang,Harshvardhan Saini,Samyak Jha,Huaming Chen,Xufeng Duan,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Capsule Lens框架，用可解释参数的"胶囊"几何形式来匹配和追踪概念在模型内部表征空间中占据的区域，在静态和动态表征两种设置下验证，并通过三个案例（CLIP预训练、RL后训练于VQA和数学推理）揭示不同的几何动态模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性方法主要将表征映射到更可解释的空间，缺乏对概念如何在表征空间中占据区域进行直接刻画的框架；已有假设缺乏严格验证且多关注静态表征。

Method: Capsule Lens框架以胶囊（capsule）形式匹配概念的几何区域，胶囊由若干可解释参数定义，以闭式（closed form）方式拟合每个概念的几何结构，并在保留样本上验证。

Result: 在静态表征中展示了跨模型的定位概念几何能力以及span和norm曲线揭示的重要几何特征；在动态表征中通过三个案例（CLIP预训练、VQA视觉问答上的RL后训练、数学推理上的RL后训练）揭示了从广域网络重构到局部概念特定变化的定性不同的几何动力学，发现与现有文献一致也有新颖观察。

Conclusion: Capsule Lens是定位、分析和追踪静态及动态表征中概念几何的有前景的工具。

Abstract: Understanding how concepts are encoded in the internal representations of machine learning models is a central problem in mechanistic interpretability, essential both for the science of deep learning and for the trustworthy deployment of increasingly capable models. Existing approaches to interpret model representations mainly map representations onto more interpretable spaces and do not directly characterize how concepts occupy representation space; various hypotheses have been proposed, but often lack of rigorous validation and largely focus on static representations. In this work, we introduce Capsule Lens, a framework that matches the region a concept occupies with a simple, trackable geometric form, a capsule, defined by several interpretable parameters, fitted in closed form to each concept's geometry and validated on held-out samples. We apply Capsule Lens in two major settings: static and dynamic representations. On static representations, we demonstrate how to locate concept geometry across various models, and how the span and norm curves uncover important geometric characteristics. On dynamic representations, we present three case studies tracking representation drifts induced by distinct training settings, CLIP pretraining, RL post-training on visual question answering, and RL post-training on mathematical reasoning. These analyses reveal qualitatively different geometric dynamics, ranging from broad network-wide restructuring in CLIP pretraining to localized and concept-specific changes in RL post-training. Our results include findings aligned with existing literature as well as novel observations. We believe Capsule Lens stands as a promising tool for locating, analyzing, and tracking concept geometry in both static and dynamic representations.

</details>


### [724] [HB-PVI: A Hierarchical Bayesian Personalization and Value-of-Information Framework for Complex Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05582)
*Hammed A. Olayinka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HB-PVI框架，一个层级贝叶斯个性化与信息价值框架，用于在47名参与者的MUSIC-CAR复杂活动数据集中，联合建模参与者异质性、四种个性化机制的利弊以及额外标签的经济价值。结果表明适配器个性化带来的平均F1增益极小，而基于信息价值的策略在大多数设置下选择不购买任何标签，保留总体推断，主张在个性化收益较小时采取"总体优先"的部署策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化虽能提升活动识别性能，但参与者个体增益具有异质性，且每个额外校准标签都有获取成本。需要一种能够系统评估个性化机制是否值得投入标签成本的框架，而非仅追求原始预测准确率。

Method: HB-PVI框架结合了层级贝叶斯方法，包含：(1) 顺序蒙特卡洛参与者效应更新器；(2) Student-t层级增益模型；(3) 一步期望样本信息价值(EVSI)停止规则。采用泄漏安全的留一参与者交叉验证，评估四种个性化机制（适配器、适配器加头、原型残差等）的收益与危害。

Result: 适配器个性化产生微小正平均F1增益（从1个标签的0.00099增长到10个标签的0.00198），而适配器加头和原型残差个性化平均为负。在主要实际效益阈值下，一步EVSI在每个决策状态均为零，策略不购买任何标签。相比固定10次适配器个性化，标签量减少100%，后验平均F1损失仅0.00217。HB-PVI在216个成本阈值设置中的199个达到效用最优。

Conclusion: 当个性化收益相对于标签、计算和危害成本较小时，应采取"总体优先"的部署策略。信息价值推理而非原始预测准确率，应驱动健康传感应用中的个性化决策。

Abstract: Personalization can improve activity-recognition performance, but participant-specific gains are heterogeneous, and every additional calibration label has an acquisition cost. This study presents HB-PVI, a hierarchical Bayesian personalization and value-of-information framework jointly modeling participant heterogeneity, the benefit and harm of four personalization mechanisms, and the economic value of an additional label, for the 47-participant MUSIC-CAR complex-activity cohort. A leakage-safe, leave-one-participant-out evaluation combines a sequential-Monte-Carlo participant-effect updater with a Student-$t$ hierarchical gain model and a one-step expected-value-of-sample-information (EVSI) stopping rule. Adapter personalization produced small positive mean F1 gains, growing from 0.00099 at one label to 0.00198 at ten, while adapter-plus-head and prototype-residual personalization were negative on average. Under the primary practical-benefit threshold ($Δ_{\min}=0.01$) and cost setting, one-step EVSI was zero at every decision state, so the policy purchased no labels and retained population inference for all 47 participants, matching always-stop exactly (region-of-practical-equivalence probability $=1$). Relative to fixed ten-shot adapter personalization, this reduced labeling by 100\% while keeping the posterior mean F1 loss at 0.00217 (95\% credible interval, 0.00048 to 0.00389), with posterior probability 0.9992 of remaining below the 0.005 tolerance. HB-PVI was utility-optimal in 199 of 216 cost-threshold settings and in every setting at or above the primary label cost. These results argue for a population-first deployment policy whenever personalization gains are small relative to labeling, computation, and harm costs, and show that value-of-information reasoning, not raw predictive accuracy, should drive personalization decisions in health-sensing applications.

</details>


### [725] [Minimizing the Effect of Sleep Deprivation in the Forward-Forward Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06042)
*Joy Datta,Puja Saha,Rawhatur Rabbi,Nafiz Imtiaz Rafin,Swakkhar Shatabda,Md. Golam Rabiul Alam,Chad Mourning*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨了Forward-Forward算法在"睡眠剥夺"条件下的学习效能下降问题，通过替代激活函数、优化损失函数、阈值调整、引入周期性休息阶段以及模拟咖啡因刺激等多种方法进行缓解，在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上实现了最高2%-62%的准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Forward-Forward算法中正负两个pass的分离与数据不平衡处理被视作对人类睡眠剥夺认知过程的模仿，但先前研究表明睡眠剥夺对该算法的学习效能有灾难性影响，亟需缓解这一问题的策略。

Method: 探索多种缓解策略：包括替代激活函数、优化损失函数和阈值调整；通过在交替epoch中减少正pass数量来模拟周期性休息；同时研究咖啡因诱导的刺激对睡眠剥夺条件下性能提升的潜力。

Result: 在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上的实验表明，这些修改在睡眠剥夺条件下提升了准确率，在最严重的睡眠剥夺设置（16个正pass/清醒期，1个负pass/睡眠期）下观察到2%-62%的准确率提升。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法不仅增强了算法在睡眠剥夺条件下的韧性，还使其与人类认知的自适应机制更加对齐，为改善该算法在非常规状态下的学习能力提供了有效途径。

Abstract: This paper addresses the challenge posed by sleep deprivation in the Forward-Forward algorithm, where separating the two passes in this algorithm and imbalancing the data processing in the passes is considered an imitation of the cognitive processes observed in humans suffering from sleep deprivation. Previous research has demonstrated that sleep deprivation in the Forward-Forward algorithm has a catastrophic effect on learning efficacy. To mitigate this issue, we explore several approaches; these include alternative activation, optimized loss function, and threshold tuning. To simulate periodic rest, we reduce the number of positive passes in alternating epochs, creating short break phases. We additionally investigate the potential of caffeine-induced stimulation to enhance performance during sleep-deprived conditions. Experimental evaluations conducted on the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST datasets demonstrate that these modifications improve accuracy under the context of sleep deprivation. For example, a 2%-62% accuracy gain is observed in a severe sleep deprivation setting (16 positive or awake periods and 1 negative or sleep period). The approaches also enhance the resilience of the algorithm and its alignment with the adaptive mechanisms of human cognition.

</details>


### [726] [Endogenous Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Intrinsic Curiosity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05650)
*Armando Vieira*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于内在好奇心的强化学习框架，适用于非平稳、稀疏或缺失奖励的环境。该方法在Liquid State Machine (LSM) 基座上实现，通过外部奖励与认识动机机制结合来引导动作选择，核心假设是有效探索出现在中等程度的不连贯性水平。在LunarLanderv2和BipedalWalkerv3基准上取得了与PPO和ICM相当的性能，并发现Active Inference代理无法复现该好奇窗口，表明其捕获了独特的探索机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的强化学习在面对非平稳环境、稀疏或缺失奖励时探索效率低。作者认为有效的探索需要在"过度刚性"与"过度混乱"的动态之间取得平衡，即存在一个中间水平的"好奇窗口"，但目前缺乏对其机制的系统验证。

Method: 提出一个结合外部奖励与认识性动机（epistemic motivation）机制的RL框架，其中探索由内在好奇心驱动。实现上基于Liquid State Machine (LSM) 作为计算基座，通过调节动力学的不连贯性（incoherence）水平来探索好奇窗口。实验在离散动作的LunarLanderv2和连续控制的BipedalWalkerv3上进行，并与PPO和ICM对比，同时与Active Inference代理进行对照分析。

Result: 所提方法在两个基准任务上均取得与PPO和ICM相当的竞争性性能。实验证实了有效探索确实存在于中等不连贯性水平。此外，Active Inference代理在同样分析下无法恢复好奇窗口，说明该框架捕获了一种独特的探索动力学机制。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了"好奇窗口"假设——即最优探索出现在动力学有序性与无序性的中间地带，并表明基于LSM的好奇心驱动框架能够在此窗口内实现高效探索，其机制与Active Inference存在本质差异，为复杂环境下探索设计提供了新的理论视角。

Abstract: We propose a reinforcement learning framework in which exploration is driven by intrinsic curiosity, designed for scenarios where environments are non-stationary and rewards are sparse, delayed, uninformative, or absent. In our model, action selection is guided by a combination of external rewards and an epistemic motivation mechanism that biases the agent toward structured exploratory directions. The central hypothesis is that effective exploration emerges at intermediate levels of incoherence, while performance degrades under both overly rigid and overly disordered dynamics. To test this idea, we implement the framework on top of a Liquid State Machine (LSM) substrate and evaluate it on two standard benchmarks: the discrete-action LunarLanderv2 and the continuous-control BipedalWalkerv3. The proposed method achieves competitive performance on both tasks relative to established deep RL algorithms, including Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Intrinsic Curiosity Module (ICM). We further show that the curiosity window is not recovered in Active Inference agents under the same analysis, suggesting that the proposed dynamics capture a distinct exploration regime

</details>


### [727] [Linear Algebra Foundations of Efficient Attention: A Phase Reversal in Rank Collapse Under SVD Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06341)
*Anjaneya Teja Sarma Kalvakolanu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文统一了十四篇关于线性代数技术在Transformer基础模型研究中应用的同行评审工作，聚焦自注意力输出秩、低秩压缩方法和KV缓存投影三个领域。作者发现SVD压缩对网络秩坍缩有双重效应：在初始化时强烈抑制秩坍缩，但在预训练模型中反而加速秩坍缩（在GPT-2 124M、GPT-2 Medium 355M和Pythia-160M上验证），并对此现象进行了因果分解分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者注意到现有文献中存在一个开放问题：压缩方法与网络自然秩坍缩之间的相互作用尚未被充分理解。这促使他们系统性地研究SVD压缩对注意力投影秩坍缩的影响。

Method: 作者统一了十四篇相关同行评审工作，并在GPT-2系列和Pythia-160M模型上进行了实验。他们使用SVD压缩注意力投影，比较初始化与预训练两种设置下的秩坍缩行为，通过四种秩估计方法验证结果，并进行受控的因果分解分析来分离子空间选择与算子范数缩减两种效应的影响。

Result: 发现SVD压缩在初始化时强烈抑制秩坍缩，但在预训练模型上反而加速秩坍缩。因果分解显示，这种行为主要由SVD压缩时选择的子空间决定，而非其实现的算子范数缩减——子空间选择效应在初始化和预训练权重上分别解释了约76%和83%的效果，这细化了校准感知压缩的观点，并解释了其优于朴素SVD截断的原因。

Conclusion: 论文提供了对秩压缩与网络秩坍缩之间动态关系的深入理解，其核心贡献在于揭示并解释了SVD压缩在初始化与预训练两种情景下的相反效应，为压缩感知的研究提供了新的理论参考。

Abstract: Linear algebra provides the framework of concepts (matrix rank, singular value decomposition (SVD), and eigendecomposition) that modern artificial intelligence employs to encode, compress, and propagate information through neural networks. This paper unifies fourteen separate peer-reviewed works analyzing the usage of these techniques in the context of transformer-based foundation model research, focusing on three areas of the topic: derivations and properties of self-attention matrices' output rank, compression methods that purposefully utilize this phenomenon, and the low-rank key-value (KV) cache projection and its semiseparable-matrix duality to linear attention and state-space structured models. We were motivated to conduct this work after observing an open problem in this literature: the interplay of the mentioned compression methods with natural rank collapse of the network. With this paper, we report an original finding that using SVD compression of attention projections actually has the opposite effect on the rank collapse of the network: while it strongly suppresses it at initialization, it accelerates on pretrained models (for GPT-2 124M, GPT-2 Medium 355M, and Pythia-160M) with minimal risk of object aliasing artifacts appearing (verified on all compression ratios) and is consistent across four rank estimation methods. A controlled causal decomposition of the effect in both settings showed that the reason for this behavior can be explained by the choice of the subspace SVD makes when compressing the matrix better than the reduction of the operator norm it achieves, explaining roughly 76% of the effect at initialization and 83% on the pretrained weights, providing a refinement to the calibration-aware compression viewpoint and an explanation of why it outperformed naive SVD truncation.

</details>


### [728] [Robustness of LLM-Generated SystemVerilog Assertions to Semantics-Preserving RTL Transformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05658)
*FNU Aditi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种受控蜕变评估方法，用于测试LLM在保持语义的RTL变换下生成SystemVerilog断言（SVA）的稳定性。研究发现，在语义保持变换下，9.7%-27.0%原本正确的行为会变得错误，表明仅凭单一准确率无法充分评估LLM的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成SVA的评估仅报告单一语法表示下的点准确率，无法揭示当相同RTL行为以不同方式书写时模型输出的稳定性。这种评估方式可能掩盖模型在语义保持变换下的不稳定性，无法真实反映LLM在硬件验证中的可靠性。

Method: 从VERT数据集出发，构建质量过滤的条件控制池和包含295个赋值行为的40程序分层评估集。评估两个开源代码模型（Qwen2.5-Coder-7B和DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite），使用相同评估提示和贪婪解码。研究三种语义保持变换：操作数重排、确定性标识符重命名、冗余括号化。测量条件鲁棒性、不变失败率和任意翻转率，并使用10,000样本聚类自助法区间（在RTL程序层面）。

Result: 在所有六种模型-变换条件下，9.7%-27.0%原本正确的行为在语义保持变换后变错误。在标识符重命名下，DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite的整体准确率从53.9%提升至63.7%，但19.5%原本正确的行为失败。人工审查30个正确到错误转换样本，识别出路径谓词丢失、分支极性错误、布尔结构破坏和输出契约违规等问题。

Conclusion: 点准确率不足以表征LLM在断言生成中的可靠性，需采用鲁棒性感知的评估方法来辅助AI驱动的硬件验证。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for automating SystemVerilog Assertion (SVA) generation, yet most evaluations report correctness on a single syntactic representation of an input. Such point accuracy does not reveal whether a model's correct output is stable when the same RTL behavior is written differently. This paper presents a controlled metamorphic evaluation of LLM-based SVA generation under semantics-preserving RTL transformations. Starting from the VERT dataset, we construct a quality-filtered conditional-control pool and a stratified 40-program evaluation set containing 295 assignment behaviors. We evaluate two open code models, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite, with an identical evaluation prompt and greedy decoding. Three transformations are studied: operand reordering, deterministic identifier renaming, and redundant parenthesization. Beyond baseline and transformed accuracy, we measure conditional robustness, invariance failure, and any-flip rate, with 10,000-sample clustered bootstrap intervals at the RTL-program level. Across all six model-transformation conditions, 9.7%-27.0% of behaviors that were correct on the original RTL become incorrect after a semantics-preserving transformation. Aggregate accuracy can therefore hide substantial instability: under identifier renaming, DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite improves from 53.9% to 63.7% accuracy while 19.5% of its originally correct behaviors fail. Manual review of 30 sampled correct-to-wrong transitions identifies dropped path predicates, branch-polarity errors, Boolean-structure corruption, and output-contract violations. The results show that point accuracy alone is insufficient for characterizing LLM reliability in assertion generation and motivate robustness-aware evaluation for AI-assisted hardware verification.

</details>


### [729] [PAC-Private Autoregressive Generation: Calibrating Noise to Ensemble Disagreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05676)
*Mina Mirzadehsarcheshmeh,Amir Keyvan Khandani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将PAC隐私从分类任务扩展到自回归文本生成。通过构建128个相互重叠的"世界"（每个记录出现在半数世界中），在冻结的公开模型上为每个世界训练一个适配器，利用世界间的投票不一致性校准PAC噪声。在WikiText-103和GPT-2-small上，以2^-32的每token预算保留了74%的微调收益，而成员推断成功率在10^6 token后被限制在51.08%。相比PMixED，在匹配的成员推断界限下保留了98%的非私有headroom（PMixED最多56%），且无交叉点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在私有文本上微调后通常通过API提供服务，隐私泄露主要发生在生成输出而非暴露的权重上。已有的PMixED方法每次发布都消耗隐私预算，且在长时程上越来越依赖公开模型。PAC隐私虽能根据预测稳定性校准噪声，但此前从未从分类任务扩展到自回归生成任务。

Method: 1) 从私有语料构建m=128个重叠的世界，每条记录精确出现在m/2个世界中，真实世界作为机密；2) 在冻结的公开模型上为每个世界训练一个适配器；3) 每个token生成时，公开模型定义候选集，各世界投票，用后验加权的不一致程度决定PAC噪声大小，全体一致时无需校准噪声；4) 证明了I(S;Y1:T)≤I(S;HT)≤bT的隐私界；5) 引入耦合解码，在保持隐私核算的同时避免贪心解码退化。

Result: 在WikiText-103 + GPT-2-small上：以2^-32的每token预算保留74%的微调增益；10^6 token后成员推断成功率上限51.08%；后验熵估算的泄漏约为所收预算的17%。与PMixED在相同数据域和测试集上匹配成员推断界限比较时，本文在10^2到10^6 token范围内保留98%的非私有headroom（PMixED最多56%），且无交叉。需要注意的是，推理隐私不等于内容保护——即使对记忆化canary的成员优势为零，canary仍以相同速率被输出。

Conclusion: PAC隐私成功扩展到自回归生成场景，相比PMixED在隐私预算利用效率和长时程性能保持上具有显著优势。但研究也揭示了隐私保护的重要边界：推理隐私不提供内容层面的保护，记忆内容仍可能被生成。这为隐私保护的语义边界提供了重要启示。

Abstract: Language models adapted on private text are often served through APIs, so privacy leakage occurs through generated outputs rather than exposed weights. Private prediction protects these releases. Methods such as PMixED incur privacy cost at each release and increasingly rely on the public model over long horizons. PAC privacy instead calibrates noise to output variability across possible secrets, adding less noise when predictions are stable. To our knowledge, PAC-private prediction has not previously been extended from classification to autoregressive generation.
  We construct $m=128$ overlapping worlds from the private corpus, with each record appearing in exactly $m/2$ worlds, and train one adapter per world over a frozen public model. The realized world is the secret. At each token, the public model defines a candidate set, the worlds vote, and their posterior-weighted disagreement determines the PAC noise; unanimity requires no calibration noise. We prove $I(S;Y_{1:T}) \leq I(S;H_T) \leq bT$. Our contributions are extending PAC privacy to autoregressive generation, handling adaptive self-generated contexts, and introducing coupled decoding that preserves privacy accounting while avoiding greedy degeneration.
  On WikiText-103 with GPT-2-small, we retain 74% of the fine-tuning gain at a per-token budget of $2^{-32}$, while membership-inference success is bounded by 51.08% after $10^6$ tokens; posterior-entropy estimates of leakage are roughly 17% of the charged budget. Inference privacy is not content protection: even when membership advantage on a memorized canary is indistinguishable from zero, the canary is emitted at the same rate. Against PMixED under matched membership-inference bounds on the same data universe and test set, we retain 98% of non-private headroom from $10^2$ to $10^6$ tokens, versus at most 56%, with no crossover.

</details>


### [730] [Emergent Charging Coordination in Electric Delivery Fleets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07689)
*Javier Vales-Alonso,Juan J. Alcaraz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种纯本地控制的电动配送车队中途充电协调范式：每辆车运行相同策略，仅依据时间预算和广播的充电站占用率独立决策，无需中央调度或通信。在20个真实城市地图的仿真中，训练后的智能体（NEAT和PPO）零样本部署可完成96.8%-98.6%的班次，接近Oracle（99.5%），远超贪婪规则（73%）和阈值启发式（~80%），并将排队等待从约45分钟降至2分钟以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电动配送车队的中途充电决策相互耦合（过多车辆选择同一充电站会造成排队），现有解决耦合的方法（中央调度、预计算时刻表、预约机制）所需的基础设施大多不被充电站支持，因此需要一种不需要这些重型机制、但依然能协调多车充电行为的方案。

Method: 采用"涌现协调"范式：所有车辆运行同一本地策略，仅根据自身时间预算和广播的电站占用率决策。训练采用神经进化（NEAT）与策略梯度（PPO）两类强化学习/进化算法，在4个城市上训练，零样本部署到全部20个城市（16个未见城市）。在真实OpenStreetMap路网、静态场景下仿真验证。

Result: Oracle完成99.5%班次，贪婪最近站规则仅73%，NEAT达96.8%，PPO达98.6%且对需求/车辆特性漂移更鲁棒；阈值启发式在拥堵城市仅约80%。学习智能体自发学会部分充电与短时机会充电，并绕开拥堵站，将单次排队等待从约45分钟降至2分钟以内。

Conclusion: 该纯本地控制的协调范式能通过训练平衡"本地紧迫性"与"公共占用率"两股信息，以极小的实现成本达到接近Oracle的性能，为缺乏中央协调基础设施的电动配送车队提供了一种可行的充电协调方案。

Abstract: In electric delivery fleets, mid-shift charging is non-trivial: each vehicle must decide when, where and how much to charge to finish on time with battery above a safety floor. The choices are coupled: queues build where too many vehicles pick the same station. Prior work resolves this coupling with central dispatching, precomputed schedules or reservations, machinery that charging infrastructure rarely supports. Instead, we use a family of learning agents under purely local control: every vehicle runs the same policy, deciding alone from its time budgets and broadcast station occupancies, leading to emergent coordination without central control or messaging. We validate this paradigm in simulation on real OpenStreetMap networks of twenty cities, each with a frozen scenario calibrated by an omniscient Oracle (99.5% of shifts completed on time), whereas a naive greedy rule (nearest station on low battery) completes just 73%. Agents trained with neuroevolution (NEAT) and policy gradients (PPO) on four cities and deployed zero-shot across all twenty, sixteen never seen in training, complete 96.8% and 98.6% of shifts, with the policy-gradient controllers proving more robust when demand or vehicle characteristics drift beyond the trained regime. In contrast, tuned threshold heuristics that read vehicle urgency alone fall short in contended cities (~80%). Through training, these learning agents rediscover partial charging and short opportunistic sessions, and route around busy stations, cutting per-session queue waits from about 45 minutes to under 2. In summary, this coordination paradigm balances local urgency against public occupancy, reaching near-Oracle performance at minimal implementation cost.

</details>


### [731] [Connecting Score Matching, Maximum Likelihood, and Expectation-Maximization in Mixed Linear Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05688)
*Zhankun Luo,Abolfazl Hashemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了混合线性回归（MLR）中响应的方差保持扩散，在未知混合权重下的统计保证。分析将分数匹配的统计保证与固定扩散噪声水平下的损失几何和优化信号分离，证明估计量收敛到真实参数，且缩放误差收敛到最大似然估计的高斯极限，并推导了与EM相关的梯度展开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合线性回归中混合权重未知且扩散（score matching）方法缺乏严格的理论保证，作者希望厘清扩散去噪分数匹配在MLR中的统计一致性、损失几何与优化动力学之间的深层联系。

Method: 采用方差保持扩散建模响应；用KL散度连接去噪分数匹配目标（沿扩散路径积分）与似然及终端差异；在固定噪声尺度下将分数匹配损失分解为交叉熵与EM算子；再于高噪声极限刻画各向同性协方差下的梯度下降行为，并沿高信噪比射线分析不平衡梯度和隐方差项趋零。

Result: 在温和正则条件和终端调度下，估计量收敛至MLR真实参数，缩放误差收敛到MLE的高斯极限；固定噪声尺度下得到含隐方差修正项的EM相关低噪声梯度展开；高噪声极限下分数匹配不平衡梯度和隐方差项沿高信噪比射线逐点趋零；数值实验验证了理论发现。

Conclusion: 研究表明方差保持扩散下的分数匹配在混合线性回归中具有与最大似然估计相媲美的统计一致性，其优化信号可通过EM视角解释，为扩散生成模型用于混合模型参数估计提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We study variance-preserving diffusion of the response in mixed linear regression (MLR) with unknown mixing weights. Our analysis separates the statistical guarantees of score matching from the loss geometry and optimization signal at a fixed diffusion noise level. The KL divergence links the denoising score matching objective integrated over the diffusion path with the likelihood and a terminal discrepancy. Under mild regularity conditions and terminal schedule, the resulting estimator converges up to the ground truth parameters of MLR, and its scaled error converges to the Gaussian limit of the maximum-likelihood estimator. At a fixed scale of the diffusion noise level, we derive a decomposition linking the score matching loss to cross-entropy and Expectation-Maximization (EM) operators. This decomposition yields an EM-related low-noise gradient expansion with additional correction terms of latent variance. In the high-noise limit, we further characterize gradient descent on this limiting loss under isotropic covariance. Along fixed high signal-to-noise ratio rays, the score matching imbalance gradient and the latent-variance term tend to zero pointwise. Numerical experiments illustrate our theoretical findings and statistical guarantees.

</details>


### [732] [Why shared attention vectors fail: a case for outcome-indexed tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08615)
*Lenard Dome*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多维注意力学习在多结果学习任务中的不稳定性问题。传统的全局共享注意力向量（每维度一个标量）在多结果预测（模型预测多个结果）时会发生坍缩到边界值的情况，阻碍了有意义注意力调谐的学习和泛化。作者提出一种基于结果索引的注意力矩阵（outcome-indexed attentional matrix），将全局共享的注意力调谐转换为结果索引的表示。理论分析了共享向量不稳定的条件，并通过三个合成实验验证所提出的注意力矩阵能够收敛到有意义的表征，而共享注意力向量则失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多结果学习（multi-outcome learning）在现实任务中很常见，但现有基于梯度的注意力机制（全局共享注意力向量）在该场景下会变得不稳定并坍缩到边界，导致无法学习有意义的注意力调谐，进而损害学习与泛化能力。需要一种机制解决这一缺陷。

Method: 1) 理论上分析全局共享注意力向量在多结果条件下的不稳定条件，推导其坍缩机制。2) 提出结果索引注意力矩阵（outcome-indexed attentional matrix），用矩阵取代单一共享向量，每个结果拥有独立的注意力调谐。3) 通过三个合成实验基准对比两种注意力表示的性能。

Result: 三个合成实验表明，结果索引注意力矩阵能够收敛到有意义的注意力表征，而全局共享注意力向量在这类多结果任务中无法做到这一点。

Conclusion: 结果索引注意力矩阵是梯度式注意力过程的一种通用修复方案，能够改善多结果条件下的学习模型性能，为多结果学习中的注意力建模提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Dimensional attention in learning is often implemented as a globally shared attention vector, where each stimulus dimension corresponds to a single scalar. These scalars are learned by models through gradient-descent on error, where predictive features acquire more salience. We show that under multi-outcome learning, where models predict more than one outcome, this shared vector becomes unstable; it collapses to its bounds and prevents the models from learning meaningful attentional tunings for learning and generalization. We address this by introducing an outcome-indexed attentional matrix that converts globally shared attentional tuning into an outcome-indexed representation. We present an analysis of the unstable shared vectors and derive the conditions under which it holds. Empirically, three synthetic experiments benchmark the proposed attention matrices and show that they converge to meaningful representations, something shared attention vectors fail to do. These results suggest that outcome-indexed attentional matrices are a general fix for gradient-based attentional processes, which improves models of learning under multi-outcome conditions.

</details>


### [733] [GraphNOSE: A Graph Transformer in Olfaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05694)
*Mrityunjay Sharma,Sarabeshwar Balaji,Valentina Parma,Ritesh Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphNOSE是一个开源的图Transformer框架，用于从SMILES字符串预测气味描述符，支持单分子和二元混合物。它比标准GNN少6倍参数，平均AUROC提升4.52%，在分布外化合物上达到84%的AUROC，优于当前最优的Open-POM（81%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气味预测（从分子结构预测嗅觉品质）是化学信息学中的开放问题。线性模型在推广到新颖化学骨架、极端分子量或复杂气味混合物时常常失败，因此需要更强大的模型来提升泛化能力。

Method: 提出GraphNOSE框架：一种基于Transformer的图架构，集成位置编码和结构编码，从SMILES字符串预测多标签气味描述符，支持单分子和二元混合物预测。

Result: GraphNOSE使用标准GNN基线六分之一的参数，平均AUROC超出线性模型、分子语言模型嵌入、分子指纹和基线GNN 4.52%（p<0.01）。在分布外化合物上取得84%的AUROC，超过SOTA Open-POM（81%，p<0.001）。XAI分析识别的子结构驱动特征与化学直觉一致。

Conclusion: GraphNOSE是一种可扩展且可解释的气味预测架构，能够泛化到当前感知数据库中代表性不足的结构不同的化合物，是气味预测的重要进展。

Abstract: Predicting olfactory qualities from molecular structure is an open problem in chemoinformatics. Although linear models can link molecular features to odor descriptors, they often fail when extrapolating to novel chemical scaffolds, extreme molecular weights, or complex odor mixtures. To address this, we introduce GraphNOSE, an open-source graph transformer framework that predicts multi-label odor descriptors from simplified molecular-input line-entry system (SMILES) strings for single molecules and binary mixtures. By integrating positional and structural encodings within a transformer-based graph architecture, GraphNOSE achieves strong performance with six times fewer parameters than standard graph neural network (GNN) baseline while consistently outperforming linear models, molecular language model embeddings, molecular fingerprints, and baseline GNNs by an average area under the ROC curve (AUROC) margin of 4.52% (p < 0.01). GraphNOSE achieves an AUROC of 84% on out-of-distribution compounds (OODs). This exceeds the current state-of-the-art GNN for OOD in olfaction (Open-POM: 81%, p < 0.001), and identifies conditions under which linear models empirically fail. Finally, we apply XAI (explainable AI) methods to identify which substructures and molecular features drive odor predictions, yielding insights consistent with chemical intuition and grounded in the model's learned representations. Together, these results establish GraphNOSE as a scalable and interpretable architecture for olfactory prediction that generalizes to structurally distinct compounds underrepresented in current perceptual databases.

</details>


### [734] [Analysis of Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia with Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05698)
*Julian Szymanski,Patryk Orkisz,Higinio Mora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于神经网络的方法，通过分析ECG信号并利用呼吸性窦性心律不齐（RSA）现象来估算呼吸频率。方法训练深度学习模型直接从ECG输入数据预测呼吸波形，无需手动预处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的呼吸监测方法通常需要额外的设备或手动特征工程，不够便捷且难以规模化。利用ECG信号中的RSA现象来估算呼吸频率，可以实现非侵入式呼吸监测，具有可扩展性，适用于医疗保健和可穿戴设备场景。

Method: 开发并评估了三种不同的神经网络架构，这些架构能够自动从ECG信号中提取相关特征，无需手动预处理步骤。深度学习模型被训练用于直接从ECG输入数据预测呼吸波形。

Result: 论文开发了三种神经网络架构并对其进行了评估，但摘要中未给出具体的性能指标或定量实验结果。

Conclusion: 该方法为无创呼吸监测提供了稳健且可扩展的解决方案，在医疗保健和可穿戴技术领域具有潜在应用价值。

Abstract: The paper introduces a neural network-based approach for analyzing ECG signals to estimate respiratory rate by leveraging the phe- nomenon of Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia (RSA). Our method employs a deep learning model trained to predict respiratory waveforms directly from ECG input data. To achieve this, we developed and evaluated three different neural network architectures capable of automatically extract- ing relevant features from ECG signals without the need for manual preprocessing. The proposed approach offers a robust and scalable solu- tion for non-invasive respiratory monitoring, with potential applications in healthcare and wearable technology

</details>


### [735] [Newton Matching for Generative Modeling: A Unified Framework for Fine-Tuning and Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05727)
*Zeyang Li,Yunan Wang,Paolo Giaretta,Navid Azizan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Newton Matching框架，统一了生成建模中的微调与采样任务。该框架将标准条件匹配的最小化器视为规范速度场，构造与密度流形微分同胚的规范流形，并证明reverse-KL的Hessian等于Fisher-Rao度量，从而Newton方向等于负Fisher-Rao梯度。每个阶段通过正则化奖励驱动切向更新，再执行保持终端密度的规范化处理（canonical retraction），实现精确的有限步长密度表征。理想迭代在0<η≤τ时严格保证reverse-KL下降，满步长(η=τ)时局部二次收敛；进一步提出协方差与梯度两种形式及前向/反向回归配对构造的样本级更新损失，无需重要性采样或全轨迹反向传播。该框架将代表方法归类为精确实现、临界点一致近似或目标修改变体，推进了生成模型强化学习的理论与算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型微调和采样方法多依赖隔离的损失函数设计，缺乏统一的理论框架来理解各方法之间的关系。作者希望建立一个统一框架，将fine-tuning和sampling统一在同一个优化视角下，并通过微分几何工具（Fisher-Rao度量、流形结构）揭示逆向KL优化与经典方法之间的深层联系，从而实现模块化的算法设计。

Method: 核心方法包括：(1) 将标准条件匹配的总体最小化器定义为规范速度(canonical velocities)，构造与密度流形微分同胚的规范流形；(2) 在该流形上传输Fisher-Rao度量与混合连接(mixture connection)，证明reverse-KL的Hessian等于该度量；(3) 每个迭代阶段执行切向更新（由正则化奖励r-1/τ log(ρ/μ)驱动），随后进行保持终端密度的规范化(canonical retraction)；(4) 提出协方差形式和梯度形式，各自支持前向或反向回归配对构造，得出样本级切向更新损失；(5) 定义临界点一致性（临界点一致性即切向位移消失当且仅当ρ=π）来评估近似方法的有效性。

Result: 理论结果：(a) 理想Newton迭代在0<η≤τ时对目标以外的密度严格保证reverse-KL下降；(b) 在温和条件下全局收敛；(c) 满步长η=τ时局部二次收敛。实践结果：该方法无需重要性采样或全轨迹反向传播即可实现样本级更新，且能统一解释多种代表性方法（将其归类为精确实现、临界点一致近似或目标修改变体），支持模块化算法设计。

Conclusion: Newton Matching为生成模型中的强化学习/微调提供了一个统一的理论与算法框架，通过微分几何视角揭示了基于reverse-KL优化的内在结构（Newton方向=Fisher-Rao梯度方向），同时具备严格收敛保证和实用的样本级实现方式。该工作为理解、比较和设计生成模型微调与采样算法建立了统一范式。

Abstract: We develop Newton Matching, a unified framework for fine-tuning and sampling in generative modeling. The target is $π\proptoμe^{τr}$, where $r$ is the reward, $τ>0$ the inverse temperature, and $μ$ denotes the pretrained model's terminal density for fine-tuning or the constant $1$ for sampling. We shift the paradigm from isolated losses to iterative optimization over canonical models: population minimizers of standard conditional matching for terminal densities. Under compatible smooth-realization assumptions, canonical velocities form a manifold diffeomorphic to the density manifold. Transporting the Fisher-Rao metric and mixture connection to this manifold, we show that the reverse-KL Hessian equals the metric, so the Newton direction coincides with the negative Fisher-Rao gradient. At terminal density $ρ$, each stage takes a tangential step generated by the regularized reward $r-\frac1τ\log(ρ/μ)$, followed by terminal-density-preserving canonicalization. This canonical retraction yields an exact finite-stepsize density characterization. For the ideal iteration, we prove strict reverse-KL descent away from the target for $0 < η\le τ$, global convergence under mild conditions, and local quadratic convergence for full steps ($η=τ$). Covariance and gradient forms, each with forward or reverse regression-pair constructions, yield sample-wise tangential-update losses with the same population minimizer, without importance sampling or full-trajectory backpropagation. We develop approximate updates and define critical-point consistency as vanishing tangential displacement if and only if $ρ=π$. We recover representative methods as exact realizations, critical-point-consistent approximations, or objective-altering variants, enabling modular algorithm design. Our work advances the theory and algorithms of reinforcement learning for generative models.

</details>


### [736] [A Multi-Source Ensemble Approach to Candidate Generation for Alternative Vacation Rental Property Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05748)
*Syed Mohammed Arshad Zaidi,Eric Rincon,Shayan Hassantabar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了度假租赁平台中替代房源候选生成（CG）方法，比较了协同过滤、浅层嵌入和图神经网络（GNN）方法。实验表明，结合基于物品的协同过滤与GNN检索的混合架构，在Recall@300上比最强基线提升14.8%。研究还发现CG阶段的增益并不总能完全传导到下游排序阶段，存在"召回-转化差距"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 度假租赁平台中替代房源推荐至关重要，但候选生成面临异构库存、地理约束、可用性快速变化和长尾房源分布等独特挑战。现有研究缺乏对这些场景下CG方法的系统比较，且鲜有研究考察CG增益对下游排序阶段的实际影响。

Method: 在超过200万个活跃房源的平台上，系统比较了基于物品的协同过滤（item-based CF）、浅层嵌入（Hotel2Vec）和GNN方法。提出混合架构，将item-based CF与GNN检索相融合，利用两者互补优势：CF在交互丰富的房源上擅长早期召回，GNN则能发现多样化的非显然替代品并更好处理冷启动场景。

Result: 混合架构在Recall@300上比最强基线提升14.8%。GNN嵌入单独比Hotel2Vec浅层嵌入在所有K值上获得48-68%的相对召回提升。CG阶段更强候选池能带来更高下游排序质量，但CG与排序器训练的耦合使因果归因复杂化。

Conclusion: 混合CF+GNN架构是度假租赁平台替代房源候选生成的有效方案。CG增益不总能完全传导至下游排序，提醒从业者在两阶段推荐系统中部署新检索方法时需关注"召回-转化差距"。

Abstract: Alternative property recommendations play a critical role in vacation rental marketplaces, helping users discover relevant options when viewing a specific listing. However, generating high-quality candidate alternatives presents unique challenges: heterogeneous inventory, geographic constraints, rapid availability changes, and long-tail property distributions. We present a comprehensive study of candidate generation (CG) approaches for vacation rental alternatives, comparing collaborative filtering, shallow embeddings, and graph neural network (GNN) methods.
  Our experiments on a large-scale vacation rental platform (over 2M active properties) show that a hybrid architecture combining item-based collaborative filtering with GNN-based retrieval improves Recall@300 by 14.8% over the strongest baseline, by leveraging the complementary strengths of the two sources: collaborative filtering excels at early recall for properties with rich interaction history, while GNNs discover diverse, non-obvious alternatives and handle cold-start scenarios more effectively. As a component result, GNN-based embeddings alone substantially outperform shallow Hotel2Vec embeddings (48-68% relative recall improvement across K), motivating their inclusion in the ensemble.
  Crucially, we examine how CG-stage gains carry through to the downstream ranking stage, and find that a stronger candidate pool yields higher downstream ranking quality, though attributing this effect cleanly is complicated by the coupling between candidate generation and ranker training. This recall-conversion gap is an important consideration for practitioners deploying new retrieval methods in two-stage recommendation systems.

</details>


### [737] [Data Scout: Targeted Web Crawling for Domain-Specific Pretraining Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05766)
*Chirag Garg,Eelaaf Zahid,Farhan Ahmed,Jay Pankaj Gala,Eric Butler,Heiko Ludwig*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Data Scout提出了一种全新的领域预训练语料构建方法：不再从CommonCrawl等大规模归档中过滤内容，而是通过LLM将根主题扩展为分类体系和搜索查询，引导定向网络爬取，并用用户提供的分类器（probe）按子域层级筛选。该方法在数学领域取得显著效果：爬取页面中21.9%为高质量数学内容（相比过滤法提升70倍），其中63.2%的页面是CommonCrawl中不存在的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流方法是从大规模网络归档（如CommonCrawl）中过滤来构建领域特定预训练语料，这对热门领域有效，但对专业小众领域失效——相关内容稀疏且超出流行度驱动的爬虫覆盖范围。需要一种针对稀疏专业领域的新语料构建范式。

Method: Data Scout颠覆传统思路：不过滤归档，而是引导定向爬取。流程包括：(1) LLM将根主题扩展为分类体系及数千条搜索查询；(2) 返回的URL（种子）按子域分组；(3) 用户提供的分类器（probe）通过小样本筛查每个子域，只接受合格者。其核心洞察是相关性在子域层面有锐利边界（数学中同一子域内页面相关概率是兄弟子域的21倍）。

Result: 以FineMath分类器为probe时，21.9%的爬取页面为高质量数学内容，是过滤可比网络样本（0.31%）的70倍，爬取效率显著提升。更重要的是，63.2%的这些页面完全不在CommonCrawl中，却同样适用于训练。用1.9B Data Scout tokens对Llama-3.2-3B进行持续预训练，在GSM8k上与FineMath语料表现相当。

Conclusion: Data Scout的主要优势不仅是效率：还能发现CommonCrawl从未收录的高质量领域内容。由于probe是唯一的领域特定组件，该方法原则上可推广到任何拥有此类分类器的领域。

Abstract: The dominant approach to building domain-specific pretraining corpora is to filter large web archives such as CommonCrawl. This works well for popular domains but breaks down for specialized ones, where relevant content is sparse and often beyond the reach of popularity-driven crawlers. We present Data Scout, which inverts this: instead of filtering an archive, it directs a targeted crawl. An LLM expands a root topic into a taxonomy and thousands of search queries; the returned URLs (seeds) are grouped by subdomain and screened with a user-supplied classifier (the probe), admitting each subdomain on the basis of a small sample. This works because relevance has a sharp boundary at the subdomain level: in mathematics, a page is 21x more likely to be relevant than one on a sibling subdomain. With the FineMath classifier as the probe, 21.9% of crawled pages are high-quality math content, 70x the 0.31% rate from filtering a comparable web sample, so the crawl wastes far less effort. But the payoff is not just efficiency: 63.2% of these pages are missing from CommonCrawl altogether, yet just as useful for training. Continued pretraining of Llama-3.2-3B on 1.9B Data Scout tokens matches FineMath corpus on GSM8k. Because the probe is the only domain-specific component, Data Scout can in principle apply to any domain with such a classifier.

</details>


### [738] [RAPTOR: Role-Aware Private Training for Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05770)
*Duc Dm,Khai Le-Duc,Nguyen Do,Minh Son Hoang,Florent Draye,Thai Hoang,Hoang Phuong Dam,Jiarui Liu,Chris Ngo,Terry Jingchen Zhang,Anh Le Duc Tran,Nhat Do Minh,Minh Ngoc Le,My T. Thai,Ran Xu,Silvio Savarese,Mona Diab,Bernhard Schölkopf,Zhijing Jin,Huy L. Nguyen,Daeyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RAPTOR框架，为稀疏MoE模型设计角色感知的差分隐私微调方法，分别处理共享层与专家层的优化，采用专家专属裁剪与噪音、公开期望分母及与私有计数无关的更新调度，在严格隐私预算下显著优于标准DP基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DP微调方法将MoE当作单一稠密块处理，忽略共享层看到全部数据而专家只接收路由记录的差异，导致全局裁剪抑制专家梯度、批量归一化稀释稀疏专家更新、固定隐私噪音在低负载专家上信噪比恶化三种失败模式。

Method: RAPTOR交替优化共享层与专家层，针对性采用专家专属裁剪与噪音；使用公开期望所有者分母，设计了独立于私有真实专家计数的更新调度；每条记录恰好归属一个所有者专家，使层内各专家机制并行组合，共享流与专家流在训练中顺序组合，证明满足差分隐私；并推导公开分母估计器偏差-方差分解用于选取需保护的网络层。

Result: 在Switch Transformer、OLMoE在GLUE任务以及DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny上的微调实验显示，在各个隐私水平上均一致优于标准DP基线，最大优势通常出现在最严格的预算条件下。

Conclusion: 通过角色感知设计，使MoE的稀疏性在DP微调中成为隐私优势而非负担，更新所有专家在隐私成本上与更新单个专家等效，为稀疏模型的隐私训练提供了有效且可证明的框架。

Abstract: Differentially private (DP) fine-tuning methods treat sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models as a single dense block, ignoring that shared layers see all data while experts only see routed records. We identify and formally characterize three resulting failure modes: global clipping suppresses expert gradients, batch-level normalization dilutes sparse expert updates, and fixed privacy noise degrades signal-to-noise ratio on low-load experts. We introduce RAPTOR - a Role-Aware Private Training framework, which alternates shared and expert optimization and targets each failure directly, using expert-specific clipping and noise together with a public expected-owner denominator and a count-independent update schedule that avoids conditioning on private, realized expert counts. We prove the resulting mechanism satisfies $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP: because each record is assigned to exactly one owner expert, per-expert mechanisms within a layer compose in parallel, so updating all $E$ experts costs no more, in privacy terms, than updating one, with shared and expert streams composing sequentially across training. We further derive a bias-variance decomposition of the public-denominator estimator showing its bias grows predictably with routing imbalance, yielding a privacy-free rule for selecting which layer to protect from routing entropy measured on a small public corpus. Experiments on Switch Transformer and OLMoE fine-tuning across GLUE tasks, and on DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny, show consistent gains over standard DP baselines across several privacy levels ($\varepsilon$), with the largest margins typically at the tightest budgets. Code and models are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/RAPTOR

</details>


### [739] [Nonlinear elliptic homogenization with the parametric Deep Ritz method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05778)
*Conor Rowan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出使用参数化Deep Ritz方法求解非线性椭圆均匀化（homogenization）中产生的参数化胞元问题（parametric cell problems）。该方法利用胞元问题的变分结构，用神经网络同时离散化空间和宏观状态变量，强施加边界条件，从而在宏观状态和梯度范围内同时求解胞元问题，获得连续可微的胞元响应表示，相较于传统FE²方法显著加速了宏观尺度求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性均匀化问题中，均匀化本构关系依赖于宏观状态及其梯度，需要求解参数化的胞元问题。在宏观数值求解（如Newton迭代）中需要对均匀化本构关系求导，因此需要胞元问题解的可微表示。传统方法（如FE²双重网格）在每个宏观状态点都要重新求解胞元问题，计算成本高昂。

Method: 采用参数化Deep Ritz方法求解非线性均匀化中的参数化胞元问题：1) 利用胞元问题的变分结构（能量泛函形式）；2) 用神经网络将胞元响应的空间依赖与宏观状态依赖同时离散化；3) 强施加边界条件；4) 在宏观状态区间内并行求解参数化胞元问题，得到连续可微的响应表示。

Result: 该方法在精度和效率上均表现良好，能够提供胞元响应关于宏观状态和梯度的连续可微表示。与传统的FE²方法相比，该参数化表示显著加速了宏观尺度的求解过程。

Conclusion: 参数化Deep Ritz方法为非线性均匀化中的参数化胞元问题提供了高效、精确且可微的求解框架，相比传统FE²方案在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持了可微性，为后续宏观Newton迭代等应用提供了便利。

Abstract: Elliptic homogenization is used to determine coarse-grained properties of materials with features on small scales. When these small scale features have rapid, periodic fluctuations, the solution field corresponding to a homogenized constitutive relation closely resembles the true solution based on the heterogeneous material. This homogenized behavior of the material is computed from a cell problem, where a cell is defined to be one period of the fluctuating material. In the context of linear elliptic partial differential equations, the homogenized constitutive relation is defined simply by a constant coefficient tensor, but for nonlinear problems, the homogenized response depends on the macroscopic state and/or its gradient, thus requiring solutions to parametric cell problems. When computing a numerical solution with the homogenized constitutive relation, it is useful to have a differentiable representation of the solution to the cell problem, as derivatives of the homogenized constitutive relation are required in Newton iterations for the macroscopic state field. In this work, we use the Deep Ritz method to solve the parametric cell problems that arise from nonlinear homogenization. First, we exploit the variational structure of the cell problem, then we discretize the dependence of the cell response on both space and the macroscopic state with a neural network. Enforcing boundary conditions on the cell response strongly, we next use the parametric Deep Ritz method to simultaneously solve the cell problem over a range of macroscopic states. We show that this method is accurate, efficient, and offers a continuous and differentiable representation of the cell response over the macroscopic state and gradient. We then show that our parametric representation of the cell response significantly expedites macroscale solutions when compared to a traditional $\text{FE}^2$ scheme.

</details>


### [740] [Online Learning with LLM Experts from Limited Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05820)
*Wang Wei,Soumyabrata Pal,Koyel Mukherjee,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi,Branislav Kveton,Hoda Eldardiry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在线设置下的大语言模型（LLM）专家提示词自适应路由问题，即在有限反馈条件下最大化响应质量。作者将其建模为包含K个动作（专家）和d个特征（提示词）的赌博机问题，并提出在有限反馈预算m下的算法：全信息设置下达到Õ(dT/√m)的遗憾界，赌博机设置下达到Õ(dT√(K/m))的遗憾界。实验表明算法能从有限反馈中高效学习跨多种LLM的高质量路由策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着多种LLM专家模型的出现，如何将不同提示词（prompt）路由到最合适的LLM以最大化响应质量是一个重要问题。然而在实践中，获取每个提示词在各LLM上的质量反馈代价高昂（需要人工评估或额外成本），因此需要在有限反馈预算下进行自适应学习，这一需求催生了本文的研究。

Method: 本文将提示词路由问题形式化为带有限反馈的赌博机问题：K个动作代表不同LLM专家，d维特征编码提示词。作者设计了两种算法——分别面向全信息设置（能观察所有专家反馈）和赌博机设置（仅能观察所选专家的反馈），通过策略性地选择和观察奖励来在有限反馈预算m下最小化遗憾，并给出了相应的理论遗憾界。实验涵盖多种不同规模的LLM来验证路由学习效果。

Result: 理论上：全信息设置遗憾界为Õ(dT/√m)，赌博机设置为Õ(dT√(K/m))，表明即使在反馈远小于轮次（m ≪ T）时仍能获得次线性遗憾。实证上：所提算法能在有限反馈条件下高效学习跨多种不同LLM的高质量路由策略。

Conclusion: 研究表明，即使在反馈预算非常有限的实际约束下，通过精心设计的赌博机算法仍能有效地学习提示词到LLM专家的自适应路由策略，为多LLM系统中的资源分配与质量优化提供了理论基础和可行方案。

Abstract: We study adaptive routing of prompts to large language model (LLM) experts to maximize response quality in an online setting with limited feedback. We formulate it as a bandit problem with $K$ actions that represent experts and $d$ features that encode prompts, over a horizon of $T$ rounds. We propose algorithms that strategically select and observe rewards to minimize regret. In the full-information setting, we achieve a regret of $\tilde{O}(d T / \sqrt{m})$, while in the bandit setting we achieve $\tilde{O}(d T \sqrt{K / m})$, where $m \ll T$ is a budget on feedback. Our experiments show that we efficiently learn high-quality routing strategies across diverse LLMs from limited feedback.

</details>


### [741] [Generalizing HVAC Control With Domain Randomized Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05822)
*Pablo Boitel,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NOMAD-RL，一种基于在线元适应和物理信息域随机化的强化学习控制器，用于跨异构热区的HVAC控制。它通过非侵入式恒温器接口、循环策略网络和自适应域随机化方案（基于物理信息归一化流），在不依赖精确建筑模型的情况下实现跨建筑迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模部署高级HVAC控制器面临困难，原因在于传统方法要么依赖精确的建筑模型，要么需要逐站点重新调参，这严重阻碍了控制器的可扩展性和迁移能力。

Method: 1) 提出通用非侵入式恒温器接口，控制器仅基于温度设定点、区域测量和预测行动作；2) 采用循环策略网络支持在线适应以应对部分可观测性问题；3) 核心创新是基于物理信息归一化流的自适应域随机化，用于建模热区参数的相关多模态分布，同时保持物理合理性和可控性，形成渐进式自适应训练课程。

Result: 在多建筑环境中与恒定设定点PID、无域随机化RL和MPC进行对比评估。NOMAD-RL在单区和多区场景下均稳定优于PID和无随机化RL基线，尤其在更具挑战性的多区场景下接近精心调优的MPC性能。

Conclusion: 自适应、物理信息的域随机化方法对实现鲁棒且可迁移的HVAC控制具有巨大潜力，为大规模控制器部署提供了新思路。

Abstract: Deploying advanced HVAC (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) controllers at scale remains difficult because performance often depends on accurate building models or per-site retuning. We propose NOMAD-RL (Neural Online Meta-Adaptation for Dynamics), a general-purpose Reinforcement Learning (RL) controller designed to transfer across heterogeneous thermal zones through a universal, non-invasive thermostat interface. The controller acts on temperature setpoints from zone measurements and forecasts, while a recurrent policy supports online adaptation under partial observability.
  Our main contribution is an adaptive domain randomization scheme based on physics-informed normalizing flows, which models correlated and multimodal distributions of thermal-zone parameters while maintaining physical plausibility and controllability. This produces a realistic and progressively adaptive training curriculum that improves transfer across buildings. We evaluate NOMAD-RL against a constant-setpoint PID controller, RL without domain randomization, and MPC in single- and multi-zone settings. NOMAD-RL consistently outperforms the PID and non-randomized RL baselines, and approaches the performance of a well-tuned MPC, especially in the more challenging multi-zone case. These results highlight the potential of adaptive, physics-informed domain randomization for robust and transferable HVAC control.

</details>


### [742] [Scaling Optimal Classification Trees via Adaptive Feature and Sample Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05826)
*Jiancheng Tu,Wenqi Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出基于STreeD的联合特征空间和样本空间缩减框架：Weighted STreeD通过合并重复记录为加权代表来减少样本计算量，实现了最高121.41倍的加速；Adaptive STreeD通过迭代精化有界候选特征集并重用当前最优树的特征来求解缩减后的问题，在深度2-4下显著降低运行时间，并在更深处仍能返回可行树。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态规划方法求解最优分类树时，随着特征数量和训练样本数量的增加，计算成本急剧上升，严重限制了其在实际大规模实例中的应用。

Method: 1) Weighted STreeD：在投影到固定候选特征集后合并重复记录为加权代表，减少样本相关计算而不改变优化问题。2) Adaptive STreeD：迭代精化有界候选集，保留当前最优树使用的特征，重建加权表示并求解缩减后的问题。

Result: 在五个数据集上，Weighted STreeD相对标准STreeD最高达到121.41倍加速；Adaptive STreeD在深度2-4的匹配比较中降低运行时间，在更深层仍能返回可行树；在相同计算预算下的预测性能与最优分类树基线相当，部分比较中更高。

Conclusion: 联合特征和样本空间缩减能够有效将基于动态规划的最优树学习扩展到更具挑战性的实例。

Abstract: Dynamic programming for optimal classification trees becomes computationally expensive as the numbers of features and training samples increase. We develop a joint feature- and sample-space reduction framework based on STreeD. Weighted STreeD merges duplicate records created after projection onto a fixed candidate set into weighted representatives. This reduces sample-dependent computation without changing the fixed-candidate optimization problem. Adaptive STreeD repeatedly refines a bounded candidate set, retains features used by the incumbent tree, rebuilds the weighted representation, and solves the resulting reduced problems. Each certified Weighted STreeD solution is optimal for its current candidate set, while the outer feature search remains heuristic over the full feature space. Experiments on five data sets show that Weighted STreeD achieves speedups of up to 121.41 times over standard STreeD. Adaptive STreeD reduces runtime in matched comparisons at depths 2 to 4 and continues to return feasible trees at greater depths where full-feature methods are limited by time or memory. Under the same computational budget, its predictive performance remains comparable to the evaluated optimal classification tree baselines and is higher in some comparisons. These results show how joint feature- and sample-space reduction can scale dynamic-programming-based optimal-tree learning to more demanding instances.

</details>


### [743] [SAFEGuard: Detect Optimization-Based Jailbreak Attacks Through Harmful Semantic Analysis and Fluency Measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05850)
*Quoc Viet Vo,Trung Le,Damith C. Ranasinghe,Ehsan Abbasnejad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAFEGuard统一检测框架，结合跨层分布距离与困惑度的混合流畅度测量，以及基于梯度匹配的有害语义分析，用于检测优化型越狱攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有防御方法难以有效应对广泛的基于优化的越狱机制，这些机制能产生高度流畅性优化或有害语义混淆的提示词。

Method: SAFEGuard框架包含两部分：(1) 混合流畅度测量，基于跨层分布距离和困惑度；(2) 通过梯度匹配分析有害语义。核心观察是高度流畅提示词保持恶意意图接近有害提示词，而语义混淆提示词常注入无意义的token序列。

Result: SAFEGuard在多种基于优化的越狱攻击中持续优于最先进的基线方法，在准确性上有显著提升。

Conclusion: SAFEGuard在应对不断演化的越狱攻击方面表现出有效性，为LLM安全防御提供了统一的检测框架。

Abstract: Despite the significant efforts devoted to aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values and ensuring safe deployment, recent work has revealed that LLMs remain vulnerable to adversarial jailbreak attacks that can bypass safety guardrails and elicit harmful responses. Many defense methods are proposed to detect jailbreaks but they are limited in their effectiveness to counter wide-range optimization-based jailbreak mechanisms that can yield highly fluency-optimized or harmful semantic obfuscated prompts. To tackle this challenge, we propose a unified detection framework SAFEGuard which incorporates a hybrid fluency measurement based on cross-layer distribution distance and perplexity, and the analysis of harmful semantics through gradient matching. Our method is grounded in a paramount observation: high fluency prompts maintain their malicious intention close to harmful prompts while harmful semantic obfuscated prompts often inject gibberish token sequences. Our evaluation demonstrates that SAFEGuard consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and achieves significant improvement in accuracy across different optimization-based jailbreaks. This underscores the effectiveness of SAFEGuard against evolving jailbreak attacks.

</details>


### [744] [Selective Posterior Margin Regularization for Forward-Corrected Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05859)
*Zexing Zhang,Jichao Li,Tianyang Lei,XiongYi Lu,Yang Kewei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性后验边缘正则化（SPMR），在保留Forward目标函数的同时，利用逆向后验中前两位干净类之间的分歧，将模型对标注的"异议"转化为对干净分类器的分级更新，从而缓解类条件标签噪声下的记忆过拟合问题。在五个已知转移基准上，SPMR较完整Forward提升2.5-7.0个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类条件标签噪声学习常依赖干净类到观测标注的转移模型。Forward校正虽将转移嵌入似然，但有限样本网络仍可能记忆被污染的标签。校正似然诱导的逆向后验，当其主导类与标注不同时表明模型对该标注存疑，但领先备选类之间往往近乎并列，缺乏明确信号；若将所有冲突都当作修正标签会过度干预。

Method: SPMR保留Forward目标，将逆向后验分歧转化为干净分类器的分级更新。具体设计包括：(1) 选择逆向后验的主导类；(2) 用两个主导后验类间的分离度缩放任一解耦的成对边缘；(3) 对弥散性冲突赋予较小权重。间隙可分解为转移调整的成对分离与主导对的后验质量之积；主动边缘沿局部最小范数logit方向扩大所选成对边缘。

Result: 在五个已知转移基准上，SPMR较完整Forward提升2.5-7.0个百分点；与使用Mixup和早停的Forward相比仍高出0.7-2.5个百分点。匹配干预实验证实后验空间系数、转移调整目标和成对动作带来各自的独立增益。设计可迁移至估计转移、人工标注、架构变化及更强的Forward方案。

Conclusion: SPMR利用Forward校正中已可获得的潜在类证据进行正则化，无需将每个后验冲突都提升为修正标签，为类别条件标签噪声下的鲁棒学习提供了一条温和而有效的路径。

Abstract: Learning with class-conditional label noise often relies on a transition model from latent clean classes to observed annotations. Forward correction embeds this transition in the likelihood, yet finite-sample networks may still memorize corrupted labels. The corrected likelihood also induces a reverse posterior over the clean classes that could explain each annotation. When its leading class differs from the annotation, the model and transition matrix provide evidence against that annotation, but the leading alternatives can remain nearly tied. We introduce Selective Posterior Margin Regularization (SPMR), which preserves the Forward objective and converts this disagreement into a graded update on the clean classifier. SPMR selects the leading reverse-posterior class, scales a detached pairwise margin by the separation between the two leading posterior classes, and assigns correspondingly little influence to diffuse conflicts. The gap factorizes into transition- adjusted pairwise separation and the posterior mass carried by the leading pair. The active margin follows the locally minimum-norm logit direction that enlarges the selected pairwise margin. Across five known-transition benchmarks, SPMR improves full-length Forward by 2.5-7.0 percentage points and remains 0.7-2.5 percentage points above Forward with Mixup and early stopping. Matched interventions support distinct gains from the posterior-space coefficient, transition-adjusted target, and pairwise action. The same design transfers to estimated transitions, human annotations, architectural changes, and stronger Forward recipes. The formulation uses latent-class evidence already available inside Forward correction without promoting every posterior conflict to a corrected label.

</details>


### [745] [Beyond Arbitrary Geometry: Topology Generalization In neural PDE Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05860)
*Peiyao Chen,Zhouyuan Xu,Jianguo Nie,Jiansheng Fan,Chen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TopoBox-3D基准，利用Hodge热流系统研究神经算子在不同域拓扑（拓扑OOD）下的泛化能力。实验表明，跨六个架构、45个模型-任务单元中37个出现一致的额外退化，主导困难来自谱特性（初始Rayleigh商）而非谐波维度变化；显式incidence和谐波坐标并未提供最佳核恒等精度，但TNO在六项含非平凡谐波支撑的任务中混合输入非谐波精度均排名第一。结论指出拓扑是独立于任意几何兼容性的泛化轴，其影响跨越整个Hodge谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子通常声称能处理任意网格（几何通用），但未见域拓扑变化会同时改变PDE算子的不变子空间和衰减子空间。作者希望区分"几何通用"与"拓扑通用"，澄清拓扑变化如何影响神经算子泛化，并检验其影响是否仅限于谐波核。

Method: 利用Hodge热流作为受控透镜：改变空洞（tunnels）和腔体（cavities）以变化Betti数支撑，同时利用精确Hodge分解将谐波核与正谱分离。构建TopoBox-3D基准，对六种架构在45个模型-任务拓扑OOD单元中系统评估。使用初始Rayleigh商作为误差预测指标，并通过受控探针测试显式incidence和谐波坐标的影响。

Result: 1) 六种架构在45个拓扑OOD单元中37个出现一致的额外匹配退化；2) 谐波维度变化并未被更强惩罚；3) 初始Rayleigh商是误差最稳定预测因子；4) 谱展宽对边和面余链提供额外信息；5) 显式incidence与谐波坐标未带来最佳核恒等精度；6) TNO在全部六项含非平凡谐波支撑任务中混合输入非谐波精度排名第一。

Conclusion: 拓扑应被视为独立于任意几何兼容性的泛化轴，其影响跨越整个Hodge谱而非局限于谐波核。全局低频结构先验可能有助于组织快速衰减互补分量的预测，为神经算子跨拓扑与几何泛化提供新视角。

Abstract: Neural operators that accept arbitrary meshes are often treated as geometry-general, but unseen domain topology changes both the invariant and decaying subspaces of a PDE operator. We use Hodge heat flow as a controlled lens on this distinction and introduce TopoBox-3D, where tunnels and cavities vary Betti support while the exact Hodge decomposition separates the harmonic kernel from the positive spectrum. Across six architectures, models that infer topology implicitly suffer excess matched degradation in 37 of 45 model--task topology-OOD cells, yet cases that change harmonic dimension are not more strongly penalized on average. The dominant difficulty is instead spectral: the initial Rayleigh quotient is the most stable predictor of error, and spectral broadening adds information for edge and face cochains. Most strikingly, controlled probes show that explicit incidence and harmonic coordinates do not yield the best kernel-identity accuracy; nevertheless, TNO ranks first in mixed-input nonharmonic accuracy on all six tasks with nontrivial harmonic support. Together, these results establish topology as a distinct generalization axis beyond arbitrary-geometry compatibility and show that its influence extends across the Hodge spectrum rather than remaining confined to the harmonic kernel. More broadly, they suggest that global, low-frequency structural priors may help organize predictions in the faster-decaying complementary component, offering a new perspective on how neural operators may generalize across topology as well as geometry.

</details>


### [746] [Budgeted Task-Aware Acquisition of Dynamic Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05862)
*Zihe Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Scout框架，用于在预算受限的动态图学习中，智能决定哪些过期的图信息需要刷新以服务下游任务，而非简单地基于结构变化进行更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态图学习中，底层网络变化通常只能被部分观测，获取完整的当前图信息会产生高昂的观测和计算成本，在资源有限的情况下无法进行完整更新。因此需要一种预算受限的任务感知获取策略，决定哪些过期的图信息值得刷新。

Method: 提出Scout，一个轻量级框架，通过从维护的图和观测历史中学习查询每个节点的任务价值，来决定优先获取哪些图信息。

Result: 在21个基准-预算设置中，Scout在19个设置中取得最高平均下游性能；任务效用监督在16个真实世界设置中的13个中优于结构变化监督；任务匹配的获取比任务不匹配的获取在链接预测AUC上提升0.012-0.016，在节点分类准确率上提升0.064-0.09。

Conclusion: 有用的图观测取决于下游任务本身，通过直接从下游效用中学习，可以将有限的观测预算更有效地分配，而非仅关注结构变化。

Abstract: Learning on dynamic graphs is difficult when changes in the underlying network are only partially observed. Acquiring current graph information incurs observation and computational costs, making complete updates impractical under limited resources. This paper focuses on budgeted task-aware acquisition on dynamic networks, where a model needs to decide which stale graph information to refresh for a downstream task. We propose Scout, a lightweight framework that learns the task value of querying each node from the maintained graph and observation history. Our evaluation covers one synthetic and four real-world dynamic networks, two downstream tasks, nine acquisition baselines, and several query budgets. Scout achieves the highest mean downstream performance in 19 of the 21 benchmark-budget settings. Task-utility supervision also outperforms structural-change supervision in 13 of the 16 real-world settings. On the same dynamic network, task-matched acquisition improves link-prediction AUC by 0.012-0.016 and node-classification accuracy by 0.064-0.09 over task-mismatched acquisition. These results show that useful graph observations depend on the downstream task and that limited observation budgets can be allocated more effectively by learning directly from downstream utility.

</details>


### [747] [A budget-dependent crossover between coverage- and response-based training-set selection for machine-learned interatomic potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05877)
*Jia Bi,Alin-Marin Elena*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过预算解析（budget-resolved）比较，系统研究了机器学习原子间势训练集选择中两种策略——结构覆盖（structural coverage）与响应引导选择（response-guided selection）——在不同保留数据预算下的表现。研究发现，在5%预算下覆盖优于随机采样，但在20%预算下响应引导的"见证"（witness）选择反超覆盖，表明保留数据预算规模是决定训练集选择策略优劣的关键变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选择紧凑训练集时，需要判断是保留结构多样性还是针对模型分歧的构型进行选择。这两种策略孰优孰劣取决于保留的数据量，因此仅在单一训练集大小下比较是不充分的。作者希望突破这一局限，通过预算解析的方式系统评估不同数据预算下选择策略的优劣。

Method: 在GAP-20 Carbon和合并的修订版MD17数据集上重训练MACE模型，进行预算解析的比较。将结构覆盖选择器与响应引导选择器（针对覆盖训练模型与全数据参考模型间分歧的"见证"方法）进行对比。此外还分析了学习相似性保持覆盖排序的情况，以及冻结模型误差选择与嵌入覆盖的比较。

Result: 在5%预算下，覆盖在四个力端点上的绝对偏差均小于随机采样；见证在1%和5%下偏差更大，但20%时排序反转。在20%预算下，见证选择的模型直接将持有外力误差降低0.46-5.89%，八个配对训练种子区间全部偏向见证，六个误差低于全数据参考。平均力误差减少0.164-0.167 meV/Å，尾端和掩码端点的增益更大。

Conclusion: 保留数据预算规模是决定原子训练集选择策略优劣的关键变量。该研究为响应引导压缩何时优于结构覆盖提供了直接检验，确立了模型分歧在选择压缩训练集中的价值随数据预算增加而显现的规律。

Abstract: Selecting compact training sets for machine-learned interatomic potentials requires deciding whether to preserve structural diversity or target configurations on which models disagree. The better choice can depend on how much data is retained, making a comparison at one training-set size insufficient. Here we link selection criteria to prediction accuracy through a budget-resolved comparison of retrained MACE models on GAP-20 Carbon and pooled revised MD17. Structural coverage is compared with a response-guided selector that targets disagreement between a coverage-trained model and a full-data reference. This retrospective response witness tests the value of model disagreement for compressing an already labelled pool. At 5\%, coverage gives smaller absolute deviations from the full-data error than random sampling across four force endpoints in both datasets. The witness has larger deviations than coverage at 1\% and 5\%, but the ordering reverses at 20\%.
