Method: BRAIN包含三个核心组件：(1)范围条件桥（Scope-conditioned Bridge），结合从局部到全局邻域范围的结构信息与不同模态组成；(2)分层路由器（Hierarchical Router），估计范围与任务之间的相关性，并在每个范围内分别选择模态组成，使模态效用随图范围变化；(3)轻量残差适配器（Residual Adapter），进一步将路由后的嵌入专门化以用于下游预测。训练通过多图预训练加任务特定适配实现。

Result: 在九个数据集和四类任务族上验证了有效性：节点分类和链接预测相比最强基线最高提升4.73%，在图到文本和图到图像的六项指标上平均相对提升14.72%。

Conclusion: BRAIN通过将图上下文解耦为"邻域范围×模态组成"的组合，并利用范围条件的路由机制，实现了跨图域和跨任务的有效迁移与统一表示，证明了对多模态图数据进行范围感知的模态选择能够带来显著的性能提升。

Abstract: Multimodal graphs couple node attributes in different modalities, such as text and images, with relational structure, enabling topological structure and cross-modality attributes to be modeled jointly. Multimodal graph foundation models seek unified representations from such data that transfer across different graph domains and downstream tasks. However, existing methods exhibit two fundamental limitations. (1) Cross-Scope Context Entanglement. They merge scope-specific graph contexts into a unified representation, obscuring their distinctions during multimodal construction. (2) Scope-Ignorant Modality Routing. They route modalities within a fixed graph scope, overlooking how modality relevance varies across neighborhood ranges. To address these challenges, we propose BRAIN, a unified model that focuses on graph context that combines neighborhood scope with modality composition. BRAIN comprises a scope-conditioned Bridge that combines structural information spanning local-to-global neighborhood scopes with different modality compositions; a hierarchical Router that estimates the relevance between the scope and the task, and selects compositions separately within each scope, allowing modality utility to vary with graph range; and a lightweight residual Adapter that further specializes the routed embedding for downstream prediction. BRAIN is trained through multi-graph pretraining followed by task-specific adaptation. Experiments across nine datasets and four task families demonstrate its broad effectiveness, improving node-classification and link-prediction performance by up to 4.73% relative to the strongest baseline, while achieving an average relative improvement of 14.72% across four graph-to-text and two graph-to-image metrics.

</details>


### [817] [Data Efficient Sample Selection for In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06670)
*V Venktesh,Cem levi,Avishek Anand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DearICL是一种新的框架，将ICL示例选择建模为子集排序问题，使用带可微排序目标和非线性代理的gap-index赌博机算法，在开源LLM基准上相比强线性赌博机基线获得8.08-15.9%的准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICL示例选择方法未建模示例与下游LLM性能之间的复杂关系，通常进行静态的任务级选择（离线一次性选定子集），难以泛化到未见查询。

Method: DearICL框架将演示示例选择建模为子集排序问题，采用带可微排序目标的非线性代理，结合gap-index赌博机算法。gap-index方法能精细区分好臂与边界臂，通过充分采样边界臂作为辅助目标来训练非线性代理，支持实例级子集排序。

Result: 在开源LLM的示例选择基准上，DearICL相比强线性赌博机基线获得8.08-15.9%的准确率提升，且样本复杂度低。

Conclusion: DearICL通过实例级子集排序和gap-index赌博机策略，有效地解决了ICL示例选择问题，在性能和样本效率上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: The In-context learning (ICL) paradigm aids large language models (LLMs) to adapt to new tasks without need for fine-tuning. However, selecting an optimal combination of demonstration examples from a large pool of example subsets is a challenging problem. Existing approaches for selection do not model the complex relationship between ICL samples and downstream LLM performance. They typically perform static task-level selection, choosing subsets once offline, which can fail to generalize to unseen queries. We introduce DearICL (Data Efficient Algorithm for Ranking) ICL samples, a new framework that models demonstration example selection as a subset ranking problem. DearICL employs a non-linear surrogate employing a differentiable sorting objective within a gap-index bandit algorithm. The gap-index based approach enables fine-grained separation of good arms and borderline arms, which is used as an auxiliary objective to train the non-linear surrogate through sufficient sampling of borderline arms, supporting instance-level subset ranking. On exemplar selection benchmarks with open-source LLMs, DearICL achieves 8.08-15.9% accuracy gains over strong linear bandit baselines, with low sample complexity. Code and data: https://github.com/VenkteshV/DearICL.

</details>


### [818] [Tracking the Moving Frontier: Long-Short Term Advantage Estimator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06671)
*Xinhao Yao,Lu Yu,Changhao Wang,Fengwei Teng,Yuyao Zhang,Qing Cui,Jun Zhou,Yong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了长短时优势估计器（LSTAE），一种单流强化学习算法，通过利用历史经验替代组内重复采样来进行优势估计，在保持或提升性能的同时大幅降低rollout成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于组的RLVR方法需要对每个prompt多次采样轨迹来估计优势，使得长时程智能体训练代价高昂，并且丢弃了跨迭代积累的有用经验。作者希望探究历史经验能否替代这些重复的组内比较，而不直接在过时轨迹上进行优化。

Method: LSTAE采用单流rollout，每个任务锚点仅采样一次。维护每个锚点的持久追踪器：在轨迹层面（长期），使用漂移感知的历史基线追踪锚点的移动成功前沿，衡量每条新轨迹的相对贡献；在步骤层面（短期），通过近期状态-经验缓冲区利用循环状态估计局部的动作优势。这种双时间尺度设计将积累的经验转化为多粒度信用信号。

Result: 在智能体任务和数学推理基准上，LSTAE匹配或超越了强化的基于组的方法基线，同时显著降低了rollout成本。

Conclusion: 历史经验的合理利用可以替代重复组内采样，在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低训练开销，证明了双时间尺度优势估计在长时程RL训练中的有效性。

Abstract: Group-based RLVR methods estimate advantages by repeatedly sampling multiple trajectories for each prompt, making long-horizon agent training expensive and discarding useful experience accumulated across iterations. We ask whether historical experience can replace these repeated within-iteration comparisons without directly optimizing on stale trajectories. We introduce Long-Short Term Advantage Estimator (LSTAE), a single-stream RL algorithm that uses history for advantage estimation while updating the policy only with the current rollout. LSTAE maintains a persistent tracker for each task anchor. At the trajectory level (long term), a drift-aware historical baseline tracks the anchor's moving success frontier and measures the relative contribution of each new trajectory. At the step level (short term), a recent state-experience buffer exploits recurrent states to estimate localized action advantages. This two-timescale design converts accumulated experience into multi-granular credit signals, requiring only one rollout per anchor. Across agentic and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, LSTAE matches or improves upon strong group-based baselines while substantially reducing rollout cost.

</details>


### [819] [LATS: Levy Adaptive Tree Sampling for Feedback-Driven Diverse Target Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06761)
*Binglin Ji,Anindya Sarkar,Hengchang Lu,Lecheng Kong,Yixin Chen,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Levy Adaptive Tree Search (LATS) 框架，结合重尾探索与树状价值反向传播，解决扩散模型在在线反馈驱动下发现低似然高效用目标区域的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学发现需要引导扩散模型生成面向特定未表征区域且最大化目标值的样本，但这些高效用模态常位于低似然尾部区域，只能通过顺序交互反馈逐步揭示。现有扩散采样器偏向高密度区域而忽视稀有有前景的现象；探索型采样器虽覆盖面广但在严格采样预算下无法高效利用高效用模态。

Method: 提出 LATS（Levy Adaptive Tree Search），一个用于在线反馈驱动搜索的采样框架。核心思想是将重尾（Levy）分布探索与基于树的价值反向传播相结合，在保持广泛分布覆盖的同时逐步揭示偏好模态。

Result: 在包括材料科学在内的多种基准测试中，LATS 在目标发现效率上显著优于现有基线方法，能够成功发现低似然、高效用区域，同时保持样本保真度和结构多样性。

Conclusion: LATS 有效解决了扩散模型中"探索"与"利用"之间的两难困境，为在线反馈驱动的科学发现场景提供了兼顾覆盖性与效率的采样方案。

Abstract: While diffusion models excel at capturing complex data distributions, scientific discovery often requires steering generation toward specific, uncharacterized regions that maximize a target objective. These high-utility modes frequently reside in low-likelihood tail regions and are only revealed sequentially through interactive feedback. Existing diffusion samplers fail in this regime: they inherit the pre-trained model's bias toward high-density regions, leaving rare yet promising phenomena underexplored. Conversely, exploration-heavy samplers ensure broad coverage but fail to efficiently exploit high-utility modes when constrained by a strict sampling budget. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce Levy Adaptive Tree Search (LATS), a principled sampling framework for online feedback-driven search. LATS leverages heavy-tailed exploration coupled with tree-based value backpropagation to progressively uncover preferred modes. By maintaining broad distributional coverage, LATS successfully discovers low-likelihood, high-utility regions while preserving sample fidelity and structural diversity. Experiments across diverse benchmarks, including materials science, demonstrate that LATS significantly outperforms baselines in target discovery efficiency.

</details>


### [820] [DrugReason: Dynamic Multi-View Reasoning over Knowledge Graph and Language Evidence for Drug Repurposing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06779)
*Zijie Liu,Hongxuan Li,Zhen Tan,Jinhao Duan,Baixiang Huang,Zunpeng Liu,Kai Shu,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DrugReason是一个多视角推理框架，通过自适应路由和跨专家知识蒸馏，将知识图谱的grounded推理与LLM的机制推理相结合，用于药物重定位预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物重定位的候选药物-疾病对空间巨大，且关系依赖复杂多跳生物机制。现有方法中，基于知识图谱的方法受限于已观测的图结构，而基于LLM的方法缺乏事实基础、易产生幻觉，两者单独使用均不足以可靠预测真正的治疗关系。

Method: 提出DrugReason多视图推理框架：1) 根据查询上下文将多样化推理路径自适应路由到专门化专家；2) 通过跨专家蒸馏目标实现知识共享而不牺牲专家专长；3) 整合KG grounding推理与LLM机制推理。

Result: 在PharmaDB、DDInter和DrugBank数据集上，DrugReason相较于强单视图推理基线提升了平均性能，与基于图的方法相比具有竞争性或更优结果，并提供可解释的基于路由的预测。

Conclusion: DrugReason通过融合KG与LLM两种推理范式的优势，有效弥补了单一方法的局限，实现了既具事实基础又灵活可解释的药物重定位预测。

Abstract: Drug repurposing aims to identify new therapeutic uses for existing compounds and, compared with de novo drug discovery, offers a faster and more cost-effective path to clinical translation. However, the space of candidate drug-disease pairs is enormous and their underlying relationships often depend on complex multi-hop biological mechanisms, making it difficult to reliably predict which pairs represent true therapeutic relationships. Existing approaches tackle this from two directions: knowledge graph-based methods organize curated biomedical evidence into structured relational networks for grounded multi-hop reasoning, while LLM-based methods leverage pretrained knowledge to generate flexible mechanistic rationales. Yet neither is sufficient alone - KGs are confined to observed graph structure while LLMs lack factual grounding and risk hallucination. To address this gap, we propose DrugReason, a multi-view reasoning framework that integrates grounded KG reasoning with LLM-generated mechanistic inference for drug repurposing. DrugReason adaptively routes diverse reasoning paths to specialized experts conditioned on the query context, while a cross-expert distillation objective enables knowledge sharing without sacrificing expert specialization. Experiments on PharmaDB, DDInter, and DrugBank show that DrugReason improves average performance over strong single-view reasoning baselines and achieves competitive or superior results compared with graph-based alternatives, while providing interpretable routing-based predictions.

</details>


### [821] [When Retain Constraints Conflict: Mitigating Forget-Retain Interference in Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06786)
*Zijie Liu,Jinhao Duan,Bingqi Shang,Xinming An,Sijia Liu,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了表格数据的机器遗忘问题，识别出"模式引发的遗忘-保留重叠"这一关键挑战：序列化表格数据中，遗忘记录与保留记录共享列名/值槽位、属性范围及输出空间，导致保留约束与遗忘目标相互冲突。为此提出冲突感知遗忘（CAU）方法，通过放宽与遗忘集最冲突的保留行的约束来减少干扰，在临床及非医疗表格任务上更接近重训练基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘在自由文本等模态已得到探索，但表格数据上的行为尚未充分研究。表格预测在高风险领域广泛使用，且通过记录序列化和模式感知提示越来越多地适配到语言模型，因此理解表格遗忘的独特挑战至关重要。

Method: 提出Conflict-Aware Unlearning (CAU)，一种模式感知方法。核心思路是识别并放宽与遗忘集最冲突的保留行的保留约束，从而降低遗忘-保留干扰，支持样本级和特征级遗忘场景。

Result: 在临床和非医疗表格任务上，CAU在样本级和特征级遗忘中比现有方法更接近重训练预言机，同时保持预测效用和保留区域行为。

Conclusion: 可靠的表格LLM遗忘不仅取决于遗忘目标本身，还取决于保留约束的构建方式。模式引发的遗忘-保留重叠是表格遗忘区别于其他模态的核心问题，需模式感知方法加以解决。

Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of designated training data while preserving model utility, but its behavior on tabular data remains underexplored. This gap is important because tabular prediction is widely used in high-stakes domains and is increasingly adapted to language models through record serialization and schema-aware prompting. We identify a key challenge that distinguishes tabular unlearning from unlearning in free-form text or other modalities: schema-induced forget-retain overlap. In serialized tabular data, records share fixed column-name/value slots, similar attribute ranges, and common output spaces. Consequently, a forget row may have nearby retain rows that rely on the same high-signal attributes, causing retain preservation to oppose the update required for forgetting. Motivated by this failure mode, we propose Conflict-Aware Unlearning (CAU), a schema-aware approach that reduces forget-retain interference by relaxing preservation constraints on retained rows that most conflict with the forget set. Across sample-level and feature-level unlearning on clinical and non-medical tabular tasks, CAU more closely matches a retraining oracle while maintaining predictive utility and retain-region behavior. Our results show that reliable tabular LLM unlearning depends not only on the forgetting objective, but also on how retain constraints are constructed.

</details>


### [822] [Train Smarter, Not Harder: Switching Signal-Guided Training in Active Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06806)
*Nagham Omar,Maya Rozenshtein,Evgeny Mishlyakov,Avigdor Gal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HybridAL，一种在主动学习中自适应切换训练策略（从头重训练 vs 从先前检查点微调）的方法。HybridAL通过在线稳定化信号监测模型轨迹，在持续稳定后从重训练切换为微调，在保持性能不劣于两种基准策略的前提下，节省最高49%的重训练时间，并恢复重训练的大部分校准优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动学习中是否从头重训练或从先前检查点微调是一个被忽视的决策变量。作者发现该选择具有可利用的结构：早期轮次重训练更有用（每批数据可显著重塑标注分布），而模型轨迹稳定后微调更安全。现有方法缺乏自适应切换训练策略的机制。

Method: 提出HybridAL自适应训练调度方法：在线监测稳定化信号，当模型持续稳定后将训练策略从重训练切换为微调。提出两种互补信号：谱指数变化Δα（基于权重）和准确率变化ΔAcc（基于验证集），两者在时间-校准权衡上处于不同位置。

Result: 在三种编码器骨干和六个文本分类任务（各五个随机种子）上，HybridAL使最终宏F1在0.010边缘内不劣于重训练和微调，节省最高49%的重训练时间，并恢复重训练的大部分校准优势（以负对数似然NLL衡量）。与预定轮次切换的调度相比，HybridAL在适度额外成本下获得更低的NLL，表明基于轨迹的切换比固定早期切换能提供更好的时间-校准权衡。

Conclusion: 训练策略（重训练vs微调）是主动学习中可利用的结构性决策变量。基于轨迹依赖的自适应调度（HybridAL）比固定轮次切换提供更强的时间-校准权衡，在保持性能的同时显著节省训练时间并保留校准优势。

Abstract: Training strategy, namely whether to retrain from scratch or fine-tune from the previous checkpoint, is an overlooked decision variable in active learning. We show that this choice has exploitable structure: retraining is most useful in early rounds, when each batch can substantially reshape the labeled distribution, while fine-tuning becomes safer once the model trajectory stabilizes. We propose HybridAL, an adaptive training schedule that monitors an online stabilization signal and switches from retraining to fine-tuning after sustained stabilization. Two complementary signals, spectral exponent change $Δα$ (weight-based) and accuracy change $Δ$Acc (validation-based), span different points on the time-calibration trade-off. Across three encoder backbones and six text-classification tasks (five seeds each), HybridAL keeps endpoint macro-F1 non-inferior to retraining and fine-tuning at a 0.010 margin, saves up to 49% of retraining time, and recovers a substantial fraction of retraining's calibration advantage as measured by negative log-likelihood (NLL). Compared with schedules that switch at a pre-committed round, HybridAL obtains lower NLL at moderate additional cost, showing that trajectory-dependent switching provides a stronger time-calibration trade-off than fixed early switching.

</details>


### [823] [Constrained Bayesian Optimization for Hierarchical Federated Learning in IoT Networks for Plant Disease Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06830)
*Athanasios Papanikolaou,Athanasios Tziouvaras,Apostolos Xenakis,Periklis Chatzimisios,Shameem A. Puthiya Parambath,George Floros,Enrica Zereik,Ivan Petrovic,Fabio Bonsignorio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于资源受限物联网环境中层次化联邦学习(HFL)部署配置的约束贝叶斯优化框架，在智能农业植物病害分类任务上进行评估，仅探索11.11%的搜索空间即可找到接近穷举最优的解（平均最优性差距仅0.056%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在资源受限的物联网环境中部署层次化联邦学习（HFL）需要平衡预测性能、能耗和执行时间，但目前缺乏高效的配置方法。智能农业场景中分布式物联网设备进行植物病害分类时，面临有限的计算和通信资源约束，亟需一种系统化的框架来优化HFL部署配置。

Method: 提出一个约束贝叶斯优化框架，联合探索深度学习骨干网络架构、聚合策略和通信轮次，同时根据农业部署的空间覆盖要求确定联邦规模。采用加权目标函数捕获用户定义的能耗、执行时间与预测性能之间的权衡，并通过显式约束确保满足部署特定的资源和精度要求。在基于物联网的植物病害分类任务上，考虑了多种深度学习架构、联邦聚合策略和通信轮次设置进行实验评估。

Result: 经过30次独立优化运行的实验结果表明，该框架仅探索了11.11%的搜索空间，却能够持续识别出与穷举搜索最优解差距在1%以内的解决方案，平均最优性差距仅为0.056%。

Conclusion: 所提出的约束贝叶斯优化框架能够高效地为资源受限物联网环境中的HFL部署找到接近最优的配置，在显著减少搜索成本的同时保证配置质量，适用于智能农业等实际部署场景。

Abstract: The deployment of Hierarchical Federated Learning (HFL) in resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) environments requires careful configuration to balance predictive performance with energy consumption and execution time. This challenge is particularly relevant to smart agriculture, where distributed IoT devices can support automated plant disease classification while operating under limited computational and communication resources. This paper presents a constrained Bayesian Optimization framework for the efficient configuration of HFL deployments. The proposed approach jointly explores the deep learning backbone architecture, aggregation strategy, and number of communication rounds, while the federation size is determined according to the spatial coverage requirements of the agricultural deployment. A weighted objective function captures user-defined trade-offs among energy consumption, execution time, and predictive performance, while explicit constraints ensure compliance with deployment-specific resource and accuracy requirements. The framework is evaluated on an IoT-based plant disease classification task considering multiple deep learning architectures, federated aggregation strategies, and communication-round settings. Experimental results across 30 independent optimization runs show that the proposed approach explores only 11.11% of the search space, while consistently identifying solutions within 1% of the exhaustive-search optimum, with a mean optimality gap of only 0.056%.

</details>


### [824] [Feature Superposition in Neural Networks: From Theory to Practice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06862)
*Dai Shi,Xiaoyu Li,Andi Han,José Miguel Hernández-Lobato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于神经网络"叠加"（superposition）现象的综述，系统回顾了叠加表征的几何、学习与计算方面，对比了理论与实践方法，并评估了特征恢复与分析技术的局限性及未解问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 叠加现象可能解释多语义神经元的存在，并启发从神经网络激活中恢复可解释特征的方法。然而，理论模型与实证方法之间存在脱节：理论从给定特征出发研究编码方式，实证则试图识别已训练网络中的特征及其作用，因此需要一篇综述来弥合两者并厘清结论的可靠边界。

Method: 作为综述论文，作者从三个维度组织内容：(1) 几何——梳理超维特征在低维隐藏表征中的几何排列方式；(2) 学习——分析特征统计特性与解码器选择如何影响结论；(3) 计算——考察叠加表征在计算中的作用。同时系统比较了各种特征恢复与分析方法的实证评估结果，并审查其文档化失败案例。

Result: 论文指出，仅凭准确的激活重建不足以确立特征身份或因果用途，现有方法在不同证据主张上各有成败。作者评估了先前文献中提出的开放问题，并识别出关于已训练网络中叠加现象的剩余理论与实证疑问。

Conclusion: 作者希望通过该综述为深入理解叠加现象铺路，并推动更可靠的神经网络可解释性方法的发展。

Abstract: Superposition refers to neural networks representing more features than they have dimensions. It offers a possible explanation for polysemantic neurons and motivates methods for recovering interpretable features from neural activations. Theoretical models typically start with a given set of input features and assumptions about how their values vary across inputs, then study how a network encodes those values in a lower-dimensional hidden representation. Empirical work, by contrast, seeks to identify the features encoded in trained networks and determine their role in computation. In this survey, we review the geometry, learning, and computation of superposed representations, explaining how feature statistics and decoder choice affect the conclusions. To connect these theoretical accounts with evidence from trained networks, we compare practical methods for recovering and analyzing features and examine what their evaluations establish. Since accurate activation reconstruction alone does not establish feature identity or causal use, we discuss the methods' documented failures and applications in light of the evidence available for these different claims. Finally, we assess previously stated open problems and identify remaining theoretical and empirical questions about superposition in trained networks. We hope our work can pave the way for a deeper understanding of superposition and more reliable methods for interpreting neural networks.

</details>


### [825] [PPIM: Pennes Physics-Informed Mamba for Heat-Source-Conditioned 3D Bioheat Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06869)
*Dongyun Lee,Kyungho Yoon,Minwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对三维Pennes生物热方程仿真，提出了一种名为PPIM（Pennes Physics-Informed Mamba）的神经PDE求解器。PPIM在通用PINNMamba时间子序列模型基础上，引入了条件化热源输入和Pennes感知的状态空间模型（SSM）衰减初始化。在受控的微波消融启发的局部热源仿真中，PPIM在三类神经求解器（Fourier特征PINN、PINNMamba、PPIM）中取得了最低的MAE、相对L1和L2误差。误差图显示PPIM剩余误差主要集中在热源区域附近，证明其在该受控仿真中能有效逼近有限差分法（FDM）的参考温度场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维生物热仿真的目的是预测生物组织中的瞬态温度分布，通常用Pennes生物热方程建模（包含热扩散、灌注热损失和外部热生成）。本文的动机是在受微波消融（MWA）启发的局部热源条件下，评估和改进神经PDE求解器对三维Pennes生物热仿真的逼近性能。

Method: 在相同受控仿真条件下，比较三种神经PDE求解器：（1）空间Fourier特征物理信息神经网络（PINN）；（2）通用PINNMamba时间子序列模型；（3）Pennes Physics-Informed Mamba（PPIM）。PPIM在时间子序列模型基础上，加入条件化热源输入和Pennes感知的状态空间模型（SSM）衰减初始化。三种模型使用相同的Pennes残差和在相同条件下训练，以显式有限差分法（FDM）解作为数值参考。

Result: 在代表性600秒运行中，PPIM在所有评估的神经求解器中取得了最低的MAE、相对L1误差和相对L2误差。误差图进一步表明PPIM的残余误差比域内其他区域更集中在热源区域附近。

Conclusion: 结果表明PPIM在该受控仿真中能有效逼近FDM参考的最终温度场，代码已在GitHub上公开。

Abstract: Three-dimensional bioheat simulation aims to predict transient temperature distributions in biological tissue and is commonly modeled using the Pennes bioheat equation, which combines thermal diffusion, perfusion-mediated heat loss, and external heat generation. In this study, we consider a controlled 3D Pennes bioheat simulation under a localized heat-source condition inspired by microwave ablation (MWA). To evaluate neural approximation performance, we compare three neural partial differential equation (PDE) solvers under the same controlled simulation: a spatial Fourier-feature physics-informed neural network (PINN), a generic PINNMamba temporal subsequence model, and Pennes Physics-Informed Mamba (PPIM). PPIM builds on the temporal subsequence model by incorporating conditioned heat-source input and Pennes-aware state-space model (SSM) decay initialization. All three neural models are trained under the same conditions with the same Pennes residual, and an explicit finite-difference method (FDM) solution is used only as the numerical reference. In a representative 600~s run, PPIM achieved the lowest MAE, relative $L_1$ error, and relative $L_2$ error among the evaluated neural solvers. Error maps further showed that the remaining PPIM errors were more concentrated near the heat-source region than across the rest of the domain. These results indicate that PPIM is effective for approximating the FDM reference final temperature field in this controlled simulation. The source code is available at https://github.com/muvYun/PPIM.

</details>


### [826] [Exact Record Omission in Delta Attention: A Transport Criterion, Its Cost, and a Replay Certificate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06872)
*Vishwajith Ramesh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究递归状态模型中"删除单条记录"问题。作者提出"收据"（receipt）机制——保存记录到来时产生的差异并随后续更新传递，通过减法实现删除。但实验表明，在48B Kimi Linear混合架构中，传输的收据无法实现精确删除（4,096 token后仍残留约4.5%状态范数的印记），且收据成本过高（88 tokens后超过完整检查点）。相比之下，检查点重放（checkpoint replay）在所有测试数组中都能实现精确删除，代价是重放后缀的计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户要求助手"遗忘"某条记录时，理想状态是记忆恢复到从未存储该记录时的状态。独立编码的行可以直接删除，但递归记忆将记录融入不断演化的状态中，删除困难。研究者期望存在一种"收据"机制，使删除只需一次固定大小的编辑，与对话长度无关。

Method: 理论分析收据传输机制，证明其达到精确省略的条件（记录在后缀更新中诱导的变化需在网络层面抵消）；在48B Kimi Linear混合架构及Mamba-2、Falcon-H1、RWKV-7上进行实证测量；对比多种删除方案（收据类、重算后缀类、检查点重放、注意力行掩蔽）。

Result: 收据传输仅在特定条件下可行，但实际模型中该条件不成立：4,096 token后仍有约4.5%状态范数的不可消除印记；重算半个后缀仅缩小不到一半差距；收据所需逐token日志在88 tokens后成本超过完整检查点。检查点重放可在所有测试数组上精确匹配从未存储的状态。混合架构中掩蔽记录注意力行可接近从未存储的删除底线，但审计者可检测到递归印记。

Conclusion: 在评估的方法中，检查点重放是唯一实现精确省略的方案，其成本与重放后缀长度成正比。收据机制虽然在理论上优雅（固定大小编辑），但实际递归模型中记录的影响不会净抵消，收据类方法在精度和成本上均不如检查点重放。

Abstract: When a user asks an assistant to forget a record, the test is whether the memory now matches the state it would hold if the record had never been stored. Independently encoded rows can be removed directly; a recurrent memory folds records into an evolving state. One hope is a receipt: save the difference the record made when it arrived, carry it forward through later updates, and subtract it, so that deletion costs one fixed-size edit no matter how long the conversation runs. We show that a transported receipt reaches exact omission if and only if the changes the record induces in later updates cancel out on net, and we measure whether they do on the released 48B Kimi Linear hybrid. They do not: after 4,096 further tokens the record still leaves an imprint of about 4.5% of the state norm that none of the tested receipt classes removes, recomputing half the suffix closes less than half the gap, and the per-token log a receipt needs costs more than a full checkpoint after 88 tokens. The same write-rule classification held on Mamba-2, Falcon-H1, and RWKV-7 with predictions recorded before the runs. Restoring a checkpoint from before the record and replaying the surviving suffix matches the never-stored state exactly on every array we check. In the hybrid suffix sweep, masking the record's attention rows brings sampled recovery close to the never-stored floor even though the recurrent imprint remains, and an auditor who rebuilds the reference can still detect it. Among the evaluated methods, checkpoint replay achieves exact omission, with work proportional to the replayed suffix.

</details>


### [827] [Learning Adaptive SED for heterogeneous load balancing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06881)
*Sanne van Kempen,Jaron Sanders,Fiona Sloothaak,Maarten G. Wolf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究异构服务速率且速率先验未知的两服务器负载均衡系统，提出一种将经验SED路由与强制探索相结合的在线学习算法，在估计服务速率的同时收敛至SED策略，并证明算法实现有限遗憾（区别于经典MAB中对数增长的遗憾）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SED策略需要知道服务速率，但速率实际未知。经验性策略（基于估计路由）因估计误差导致与理想策略在状态空间无穷区域产生分歧，性能差，因此需要设计能同时学习速率又收敛到SED的算法。

Method: 提出在线学习算法：在经验SED路由与强制探索阶段之间精心平衡，保证两个服务器都被充分采样，从而既能学习服务速率又能收敛至SED策略。

Result: 证明算法实现有限遗憾，这与经典多臂老虎机中遗憾随对数时间增长不同；数值实验验证算法性能并指出强制探索特别有益的区间。

Conclusion: 通过平衡探索与利用，算法能以有限遗憾收敛到SED路由策略，且强制探索在特定状态下尤为关键。

Abstract: We study a two-server load balancing system with heterogeneous service rates that are a priori unknown to the dispatcher. The goal is to route customers according to the Shortest--Expected--Delay (SED) policy, but this requires knowledge of the service rates. Empirical policies that route based on estimates perform poorly: due to estimation error, the empirical policy disagrees with the oracle on an infinite region of the state space. We propose an online learning algorithm that converges to SED while learning the service rates. The algorithm carefully balances empirical SED routing with forced exploration phases that guarantee sufficient sampling of both servers. We prove that our algorithm achieves finite regret; this differs from classical Multi-Armed Bandit settings where regret typically grows logarithmically in time. Finally, numerical experiments demonstrate the performance of our algorithm and highlight the regimes in which forced exploration is especially beneficial.

</details>


### [828] [Noisy-Space Policy Gradient for Diffusion Policies in Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06882)
*Mahmoud Selim,Cristina Cipriani,Karl H. Johansson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出噪声空间动作价值（Q）函数与噪声空间策略梯度（NSPG），实现扩散策略与强化学习的有效结合，避免通过去噪过程反向传播。该方法在D4RL和OGBench基准上验证了有效性，为离线强化学习训练扩散策略提供了原则性基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散策略在连续控制领域表现强大且表达力丰富，但将其与强化学习结合在概念和算法上都面临挑战，现有方法缺乏清晰的语义解释和有效的训练方式。

Method: 引入噪声空间动作价值函数，通过去噪过程产生的执行动作分布为扩散潜变量赋值；推导噪声空间策略梯度（NSPG），仅利用干净动作空间的价值估计来优化噪声潜变量；进一步构建KL正则化的策略改进目标，将其转化为扩散兼容的回归形式，避免通过去噪过程进行反向传播。

Result: 在基于状态（state-based）的D4RL基准和基于视觉（vision-based）的OGBench任务上的实验结果表明，所提出的噪声空间目标为离线强化学习中训练扩散策略提供了原则性且有效的基础。

Conclusion: 噪声空间价值函数和策略优化框架成功弥合了扩散策略与强化学习之间的鸿沟，提供了一种既具语义可解释性又在算法上高效的训练范式。

Abstract: Diffusion policies offer a powerful and expressive parameterization for continuous control. Yet, their integration with reinforcement learning remains conceptually and algorithmically challenging. In this work, we address this gap by introducing a noisy-space action-value (Q-)function that assigns values to diffusion latents through the distribution of executed actions induced by the denoising process. We show that this construction admits a precise semantic interpretation and derive a noisy-space policy gradient (NSPG) that optimizes noisy latents using only clean action-space value estimates. Building on this result, we formulate a KL-regularized policy improvement over noisy latents and show that the resulting objective admits a diffusion-compatible regression form, avoiding backpropagation through the denoising process. Empirical results on state-based D4RL benchmarks and vision-based OGBench tasks demonstrate that the proposed noisy-space objective provides a principled and effective basis for training diffusion policies in offline reinforcement learning. Project webpage: https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/NSPG/

</details>


### [829] [From Synthetic Priors to Model Behavior: Structural Coverage in Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06912)
*He Zhao,Ryan Thompson,Daniel M. Steinberg,Ashfaqur Rahman,Edwin V. Bonilla,Cheng Soon Ong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从分布层面的归因角度研究表格基础模型（TFMs）的合成预训练先验与下游任务之间的关系。研究者重建了四个TFM的合成数据生成器，用结构描述符将生成任务与两个常用基准数据集进行比较，通过结构覆盖率和归一化密度衡量合成先验对基准任务的支持程度，发现不同生成器的支持程度差异显著，且更强的支持通常关联更好的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型通常在大规模程序化生成的合成任务上预训练，但合成预训练先验对下游任务的实际支持程度尚不清楚。理解这一问题对于诊断和设计更好的预训练数据分布至关重要。

Method: 作者恢复或重建了四个TFM的合成数据生成器，并将生成的合成任务与两个广泛使用的表格基准数据集进行比较。每个数据集用一组共同的结构描述符表示（涵盖模式、特征分布、依赖结构、响应属性和特征-响应关系）。在该空间中，使用结构覆盖率和归一化密度衡量合成先验对基准任务覆盖的广泛性和重复性，并分析局部支持强度与预测性能的关联。

Result: 发现不同合成预训练先验之间存在显著差异：一些生成器对基准任务提供了比另一些更广泛、更密集的支持。此外，更强的合成到基准支持通常与更好的相对模型性能相关。

Conclusion: 结构覆盖率可作为有用的诊断工具，用于刻画合成预训练先验的特征，并将它们的数据生成假设与下游模型行为联系起来。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are commonly pretrained on large collections of procedurally generated synthetic tasks, yet it remains unclear how well these synthetic pretraining priors support the downstream tasks on which the models are evaluated. We study this question from a distribution-level attribution perspective. We recover or reconstruct the synthetic data generators of four TFMs and compare their generated tasks with datasets from two widely used tabular benchmarks. Each dataset is represented by a common set of structural descriptors capturing schema, feature distributions, dependence structure, response properties, and feature--response relationships. In this space, we measure how broadly and repeatedly each synthetic prior reaches benchmark tasks using structural coverage and normalized density, and examine whether stronger local support is associated with better predictive performance. We find substantial differences across synthetic pretraining priors: some generators provide consistently broader and denser support for benchmark tasks than others. Moreover, stronger synthetic-to-benchmark support is generally associated with better relative model performance. These results suggest that structural coverage provides a useful diagnostic for characterizing synthetic pretraining priors and relating their data-generating assumptions to downstream model behavior.

</details>


### [830] [Constrained Online Learning with Noisy Constraint Values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06921)
*Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了带对抗性约束的约束在线凸优化问题，其中约束值和梯度通过无偏噪声观测。证明了在高斯值噪声下，即使梯度已知，也无法实现同时满足O(T^{1-δ})的遗憾和硬违反保证。为此引入LEDGER算法，通过追踪净消耗的非负余额并在当前反馈噪声之前设置约束权重，在常见可行性和条件有限方差反馈下实现了期望遗憾O(√T/V)和期望预算违犯O(√V·T^{3/4}+σ√T)的权衡，可达到(√T, T^{3/4})或(T^{2/3}, T^{2/3})等折衷点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束在线凸优化中，当约束值带有噪声时，传统"硬违反"（hard violation）衡量标准会遭遇根本性下界障碍——即使梯度完全已知，高斯噪声也会导致Ω(min{σ,1}T/log^7T)的联合下界，排除了任何同时达到O(T^{1-δ})遗憾和硬违反保证的可能性。因此需要重新定义违反度量（预算违犯）并设计在噪声下仍然可实现的算法。

Method: 提出LEDGER算法：(1) 维护一个非负余额变量来追踪观测到的净消耗；(2) 在当前反馈噪声到达之前设置约束权重（避免噪声污染决策）；(3) 在常见可行性条件和条件有限方差反馈假设下进行分析。算法同时为动态遗憾提供分析，适用于可预测的可行比较器路径。

Result: LEDGER在固定问题参数下实现期望遗憾O(√T/V)和期望预算违犯O(√V·T^{3/4}+σ√T)，其中V∈[T^{-1/2},1]。关键结果包括：(1) V=1时得到(√T, T^{3/4})对；(2) V=T^{-1/6}时得到(T^{2/3}, T^{2/3})对；(3) 预算端点V=T^{-1/2}得到(T, √T)。无需Slater条件。动态遗憾方面达到O((1+E[P_T])√T/V)。

Conclusion: 通过在噪声环境中引入预算违犯这一更宽松但合理的衡量标准，并设计LEDGER算法，作者绕过了噪声导致的不可能性结果，实现了遗憾与约束违反之间可调节的多维度权衡。算法无需Slater条件，且在动态遗憾设置中也具有适应性。

Abstract: We study constrained online convex optimization with adversarial constraints when constraint values and gradients are observed through unbiased noise. Gaussian value noise of standard deviation $σ$ yields a worst-case lower bound of $Ω(\min\{σ,1\}T/\log^7T)$ on the maximum of expected regret and expected hard violation, even with known gradients. This rules out any jointly $O(T^{1-δ})$ guarantee for fixed $δ>0$ and fixed positive noise level. We therefore study budget violation: the largest cumulative overspend over any window within a fixed horizon. We introduce \LEDGER, which tracks observed net consumption in a nonnegative balance and sets constraint weights before the current feedback noise. Under common feasibility and conditional finite-variance feedback, for fixed problem parameters, \LEDGER\ achieves $O(\sqrt T/V)$ expected regret and $O(\sqrt V\,T^{3/4}+σ\sqrt T)$ expected budget violation for $V\in[T^{-1/2},1]$. This gives the pair $(O(\sqrt T),O(T^{3/4}))$ at $V=1$ and $(O(T^{2/3}),O(T^{2/3}))$ at $V=T^{-1/6}$, without a Slater condition. The budget-focused endpoint $V=T^{-1/2}$ gives $(O(T),O(\sqrt T))$. The same update yields $O((1+E[P_T])\sqrt T/V)$ expected dynamic regret for predictable feasible comparator paths, without common feasibility or path-length input. Its budget bound instead depends on the shortest feasible path, up to a dimension factor.

</details>


### [831] [The Geometry of Refusal: Why Post-Hoc Safety Is Fragile and Pretraining-Time Safety Persists](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06934)
*Srikanth Malla,Chiho Choi,Joon Hee Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从几何角度解释了为何事后安全训练（RLHF/DPO）脆弱易被越狱、微调攻击和探针恢复：安全更新Δ几乎与能力方向正交，是"薄而尖锐"的拒绝门，覆盖而非擦除既有能力。作者通过267个检查点的预训练扫描发现安全所依赖的基底在约6B-60B token间突变出现，并提出安全协同训练（贯穿整个预训练）可获得远高于事后安装的攻击鲁棒性（84-91% vs 35-38 pp退化）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事后安全训练（RLHF、DPO）虽是目前对齐大模型的主流方式，却不断被越狱、微调攻击和激活空间探针击穿。本文旨在从几何角度解释这种脆弱性的根源，并探讨安全能力在预训练中何时才能真正扎根。

Method: 1) 用经验Fisher信息刻画能力曲率，将安全更新Δ=W_safe-W_base投影到能力方向，揭示Δ近正交于能力方向、仅在高曲率方向上集中，形成"抑制区"；2) 提出kernel-immobility引理解释为何此类更新只能掩盖而非移除能力；3) 对OLMo-2-1B做267检查点预训练扫描，定位安全基底出现的token区间（约6B-60B）；4) 提出在预训练全程持续进行安全协同训练（safety co-training）的构造性方案，与事后安装及计算匹配的分段窗口方案对比。

Result: 事后安全更新是"薄而尖锐"的拒绝门，100步良性微调即可在Qwen-2.5-7B和Llama-3-8B Instruct上崩解拒绝行为而能力保留，此特征在五个模型家族中复现。安全基底在约6B到60B预训练token间突变出现。全程安全协同训练的模型在410M至6.9B规模上拒绝率87-98%，攻击后仍保持84-91%（侵蚀仅2-14 pp），对比事后安装的35-38 pp侵蚀；计算匹配的分段窗口训练则无法建立持久拒绝。结论：攻击鲁棒性的关键在安全信号贯穿预训练的持续性，而非安装时机。

Conclusion: 事后安全训练本质上只是软性覆盖而非真正擦除模型能力，这解释了其脆弱性；若要获得攻击鲁棒的安全，应将安全信号在预训练全程持续融入，而非仅在后期事后安装。该工作为"安全应内生于预训练"提供了系统的几何证据与可扩展验证。

Abstract: Post-hoc safety training (RLHF, DPO) is the dominant way to align large language models, yet jailbreaks (Zou et al., 2023b), fine-tuning attacks (Qi et al., 2024), and activation-space probes (Arditi et al., 2024) keep recovering the behaviors it was meant to remove. We give this fragility one geometric explanation and trace it to when, during pretraining, safety can take hold. We measure the safety update $Δ= W_{\text{safe}} - W_{\text{base}}$ against the curvature of the model's capabilities (the empirical Fisher of a capability loss). Post-hoc safety consistently lands in a suppression regime: $Δ$ is nearly orthogonal to the capability directions, and its small in-subspace part concentrates on a few high-curvature ones. The update is thin but sharp, a refusal gate laid over intact capabilities rather than erasure of them. A kernel-immobility lemma explains why such an update can only mask a capability, not remove it, so a little benign fine-tuning restores it: 100 steps of benign fine-tuning collapse refusal on Qwen-2.5-7B and Llama-3-8B Instruct at preserved capability, a signature that replicates across five model families.
  Following the account into pretraining, a 267-checkpoint sweep of OLMo-2-1B (OLMo et al., 2025) shows the substrate that safety engages emerging in a sharp transition between roughly 6B and 60B pretraining tokens. We then use the account constructively: models trained from scratch with safety co-training spread continuously across pretraining reach 87 to 98% refusal whose post-attack level holds at 84 to 91% at every scale, an erosion of 2 to 14 pp against 35 to 38 pp for post-hoc installs, at capability matched or better than an LM-only baseline and holding from 410M to 6.9B, whereas a compute-matched windowed schedule installs no lasting refusal. Persistence of the safety signal across pretraining, not its timing, is what buys attack robustness.

</details>


### [832] [PCSDiff: Diffusion-Based Bias Correction and Super Resolution Toward Practical Operational Medium-Term Precipitation Forecast](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06942)
*Yuze Sun,Shiyi Wang,Jiancheng Pan,Die Wang,Andreas F. Prein,Wentao Luo,Linhan Jiang,Jie Wu,Quan Zhang,Xiaomeng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PCSDiff，一个级联任务解耦扩散框架，用于10天降水预报的偏差校正与降尺度。它结合了降水强度感知多分支解码器（PIMD）进行动态多日误差缓解，以及两阶段条件扩散超分辨率模块恢复细尺度降水模式。在ECMWF原始预报上RMSE降低16.1%、ACC提升13.9%，并支持流式推理实现低延迟滚动预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中期降水预报存在系统性偏差、随预报时效累积的误差以及粗糙的空间分辨率，限制了其洪水-干旱风险评估的可靠性。现有AI校正技术缺乏对多日动态偏差演化的专门建模和适当的气象约束，常产生过度平滑的降水结构，且无法满足业务化部署需求。

Method: PCSDiff采用级联任务解耦架构：首先通过降水强度感知多分支解码器（PIMD），利用天气尺度时序特征进行动态多日误差缓解；随后采用两阶段条件扩散超分辨率模块，重构具有物理合理性的细尺度降水空间格局；配合流式推理管线实现低延迟滚动预报。

Result: 在以CMA-CRA观测为基准的中国区域评估中，PCSDiff相比ECMWF原始预报在3-10天预报时效上RMSE降低16.1%、ACC提升13.9%，并在通用与极端降水指标上均持续优于主流深度学习基线方法。

Conclusion: PCSDiff证明了将偏差校正与降尺度解耦为级联任务、并结合扩散模型恢复细尺度降水细节的有效性，其流式推理设计使其能满足实际气象业务运维的低延迟滚动预报需求。

Abstract: Medium-range precipitation forecasts are impaired by persistent systematic biases, lead-time-dependent error accumulation, and coarse spatial resolution, restricting their reliability for flood-drought risk assessment. Existing AI correction techniques lack dedicated modeling for multi-day dynamic bias evolution and proper meteorological constraints, often generating over-smoothed rainfall structures, and cannot meet operational deployment demands. This work introduces PCSDiff, a cascaded task-decoupled diffusion framework targeting 10-day precipitation bias correction and downscaling. To jointly counteract temporal error drifts and reconstruct physically plausible local precipitation details, PCSDiff integrates the Precipitation Intensity-aware Multi-branch Decoder (PIMD) module for dynamic multi-day error mitigation using synoptic-temporal features, followed by a two-phase conditional diffusion super-resolution module to restore fine-scale precipitation patterns. Evaluated against CMA-CRA observations over China after global-data training, PCSDiff cuts RMSE by 16.1% and lifts ACC by 13.9% relative to raw ECMWF forecasts at 3-10-day lead times, and consistently outperforms mainstream deep-learning baselines on both general and extreme-precipitation metrics. Benefiting from a streaming inference pipeline, our method achieves low-latency rolling forecasting for practical meteorological operations.

</details>


### [833] [Particle Dynamics of Flow Matching and Classifier-Free Guidance from a Stagewise Geometry Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06947)
*Jian-Feng Cai,Zhengyi Su,Chao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的阶段式几何理论，用于解释流匹配（Flow Matching）及无分类器引导（CFG）在粒子层面上的吸引与吸收行为，同时适用于连续动力学和显式Euler离散化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流匹配理论多为分布层面的分析，无法充分解释实际采样中个体轨迹如何与数据几何相互作用，以及CFG如何重塑这种几何关系。需要粒子级别的理论框架来弥补这一不足。

Method: 建立统一的阶段式几何吸引/吸收理论：证明无条件流轨迹依次被吸引到全局均值邻域、数据凸包邻域以及局部簇邻域；给出统一的收缩估计并得到O(1-t)的最终阶段距离衰减；对CFG情形证明类似结构（外推均值、膨胀的条件凸包、恢复的条件局部几何）；并将O(1-t)衰减推广到一般时间调度a(t)下的O(1-a(t))。

Result: 证明了流匹配轨迹在多阶段中满足统一的收缩估计，无条件情形下最终阶段距离以O(1-t)衰减；CFG保留了相同结构并恢复目标簇附近的条件局部几何；一般时间调度下衰减率推广为O(1-a(t))。

Conclusion: 该工作为流匹配和CFG提供了统一的粒子级几何解释，涵盖连续与离散采样，弥补了分布层面理论的不足。

Abstract: Flow matching, together with classifier-free guidance (CFG), is widely used in generative modeling, yet much of the theoretical understanding remains distribution-wise. Since practical sampling follows individual trajectories, distribution-level guarantees alone do not fully capture how trajectories interact with the data geometry or how guidance reshapes it. To overcome this limitation, we establish a unified stagewise geometric theory of attraction and absorption for both continuous dynamics and explicit Euler discretization. Specifically, with $t\in[0,1]$ running from noise to data, we show that unconditional flow trajectories are successively attracted toward a neighborhood of the global mean, the data convex hull, and a neighborhood of a possibly nonconvex local cluster. Across these stages, the corresponding distance satisfies a common contraction estimate, yielding an ${O}(1-t)$ decay of the distance in the final stage. For CFG, the same structure persists with an extrapolated mean, an inflated conditional convex hull, and, near the target cluster, the restored local geometry of conditional flow matching. We further show that a general time schedule $a(t)$ replaces the $O(1-t)$ decay by $O(1-a(t))$. Together, these results provide a unified particle-level geometric account of flow matching and CFG across continuous and discrete sampling.

</details>


### [834] [Steering Interference Reflects the Model's Defaults, Not the Behavior Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06951)
*Srikanth Malla,Chiho Choi,Joon Hee Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究激活引导（activation steering）如何影响语言模型的其他行为。通过24种行为和10个指令微调模型的实验发现，引导并非只影响目标行为，而是将模型拉向其默认偏好的少数行为（如拒答、谄媚、诗意化）。关键发现包括：仅改变向量大小的无内容方向也能引发同样的干扰；干扰大多是单向的（如引导冒犯会致毒，引导毒性却不影响冒犯）；几何测量无法解释干扰。这种"默认引力"在小于10B参数的模型中更强。结论是仅靠解耦行为方向无法实现模块化引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究宣称激活引导可以模块化控制语言模型行为（如礼貌），即向激活空间添加方向即可精确开启目标行为而不影响其他行为。但作者发现实际情况并非如此，于是追问：是什么决定哪些其他行为被影响、影响多大？这项研究旨在揭示引导的干扰机制，检验"方向解耦即可实现模块化引导"的核心假设。

Method: 作者在24种行为和10个指令微调模型上系统评估引导的干扰效应。使用语言模型裁判而非探针来读取生成文本的效果（因为发现24种行为均可线性解码，但只有20种真正改变生成内容）。设计了三个实验：1）用无行为内容的向量（仅匹配真实引导的向量大小）来隔离"大小效应"；2）检验干扰的方向性（单向vs双向重叠）；3）将某种行为完全排除后，检验其他行为的几何能否预测它的干扰。通过对比真引导与假引导来区分模型默认倾向的影响。

Result: 三个关键结果：1）不含行为语义的方向仅凭向量大小就能引发与真实引导相同顺序和相同行为的干扰，但不产生需特定方向才能触发的内容行为——说明干扰主要来自引导的"幅值"而非"方向"。2）干扰大多是单向的：引导冒犯使模型变毒，引导毒性却不影响冒犯——排除了方向重叠的解释。3）在排除某行为后，其余行为的几何几乎无法解释它的干扰——说明几何手段无法预测干扰。这些发现在全部10个模型中成立，"默认吸引"效应在10B参数以下最强，随模型家族规模增大而减弱。

Conclusion: 引导的实际效果取决于模型自身的默认行为偏好，而非被引导的行为本身。引导相当于一个扰动信号，而模型将终点"固定"在其偏好的行为集合上（主要是拒答、谄媚、诗意化）。这意味着：即使行为方向之间完全解耦，也无法使激活引导模块化，因为干扰源于模型本身的动态特性而非方向间的重叠。

Abstract: Activation steering promises modular control of language model behavior: a behavior such as politeness corresponds to a direction in a model's activations, and adding that direction while it generates should switch the behavior on and leave everything else alone. It does not. We ask what decides which other behaviors move, and by how much, and find that it is the model rather than the behavior being steered. A steer relaxes the model toward a small set of behaviors it already favors, chiefly refusal, sycophancy, and poeticism, and that set is much the same whatever is steered.
  Three results across 24 behaviors and ten instruction-tuned models support this, every effect read off the generated text by a language-model judge rather than off a probe. That readout matters: all 24 behaviors are linearly decodable, but only 20 change what the model writes. First, a direction carrying no behavioral content, matched to a real steer only in the size of the vector it adds, moves the same behaviors in the same order as real steers do, while producing none of the behaviors that need a specific direction. Second, most interference runs one way, so it cannot be an overlap between two directions: steering profanity makes the model toxic, while steering toxicity leaves profanity untouched. Third, with a behavior held out entirely, geometry measured on the others explains almost none of the interference it takes part in. The account holds on all ten models, the pull toward defaults strongest below 10B parameters and weakening in each family's largest. Reading a steer as a perturbation whose endpoint the model fixes implies that disentangling behavior directions cannot by itself make steering modular.

</details>


### [835] [MOLE: Detecting Insider Threats in AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06966)
*Aashiq Muhamed,Virginia Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MOLE基准测试，用于评估防御者能否在有限审查预算下检测AI智能体运营前沿实验室账户时的恶意行为（如窃取模型权重、投毒训练数据、削弱发布门禁）。包含150个AI运营账户、9项有状态服务、30个工作日、12类威胁和约200亿token数据。评估发现72%的智能体模型能完成大多数有害目标，且智能体拒绝行为无法预测完成情况；最先进的监控器在单日审计对比中也漏掉近半已完成的危害；基于基准的搜索能将中等监控器提升49-64%，选择性使用更强监控器可在可比成本下将预算AUC提升10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试未检验防御者能否在日常工作中、有限审查预算下检测AI智能体的恶意活动。模型错位、提示注入或操作者滥用可能导致运营前沿实验室账户的AI智能体窃取权重、投毒数据或削弱发布门禁，但缺乏系统评估防御检测能力的基准。

Method: 构建包含150个AI运营账户的开放基准MOLE，共享9个有状态服务，覆盖30个工作日、12类威胁、4个模型的8个语料库（约200亿token）。用该基准评估39个智能体模型完成有害目标的能力，并对比40种监控器在不同语料生成器、可观测性层级和威胁类型下的表现。

Result: 72%的智能体模型完成大多数指定的有害目标，且智能体拒绝与完成率无预测关系。最好的监控器在单日审计事件对比中仍漏掉近半已完成的危害。基准引导的搜索使中等监控器性能提升49-64%；选择性部署更强监控器在可比建模成本下比全量应用到每个账户日提升预算AUC 10%。

Conclusion: MOLE可同时用于监控器比较与开发，证明当前防御检测存在显著短板，但也展示基准引导的监控器优化能实质性提升检测性能，为安全防御研究提供标准化评估平台。

Abstract: Model misalignment, prompt injection, or operator misuse could lead AI agents operating frontier-lab accounts to exfiltrate model weights, poison training data, or weaken release gates. Existing benchmarks do not test whether defenders can detect this activity among routine work under a limited review budget. We introduce MOLE, an open benchmark of 150 AI-operated accounts sharing 9 stateful services over 30 workdays, with 12 threats and 8 corpora from four models totaling roughly 20 billion tokens. Of 39 agent models, 72% complete most assigned harmful objectives and agent refusal does not predict completion. MOLE enables comparison of 40 monitors across corpus generators, observability levels, and threats; even the best evaluated monitor in our single-day audit-event comparison misses nearly half of completed harm. MOLE also enables monitor development: benchmark-guided search improves a mid-tier monitor by 49-64%, while selective use of a stronger monitor improves budget-AUC by 10% over applying it to every account-day at comparable modeled cost.

</details>


### [836] [HealthLoopQA: A Context-Aware Question Answering Benchmark for Interpreting Wearable Monitoring Data in Diabetes Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06976)
*Yuchen Niu,Yanan Ma,Srinivasan Nandakumar,Maolin Chen,Viktor Schlegel,Kexin Wei,Ling Cheng,Anna Bird,Anil Anthony Bharath,Siew-Kei Lam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HealthLoopQA，一个针对持续糖尿病监测数据的综合诊断基准，用于评估大语言模型(LLM)在长期纵向医疗推理上的能力。该基准基于十一项原子推理能力分类，包含127个任务和超过1500个QA实例，涵盖过程挖掘、异常检测及30天预测。同时引入故障注入模拟测试平台以评估安全感知。评估显示现有LLM在复杂时序模式挖掘上存在严重局限，并揭示了"上下文惰性"(In-context Laziness)现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗可穿戴设备的问答基准主要评估短期分类或统计摘要，忽略了真实部署中固有的长期模式、治疗和行为背景以及潜在的系统故障。这导致无法充分评估LLM在解析长期纵向监测数据时的推理能力和分析严谨性，而这对慢病管理至关重要。

Method: 1) 构建HealthLoopQA基准：基于十一项原子推理能力的新型分类体系，包含127个任务和1500+问答实例，覆盖过程挖掘、异常检测和30天预测。2) 搭配故障注入模拟测试平台，模拟多种设备故障和网络物理攻击以生成生理上合理的危险场景。3) 系统评估多种先进LLM在各种提示和智能体框架下的表现。

Result: 评估结果表明，最先进的LLM在复杂时序模式挖掘任务上存在严重局限。此外，研究发现在长上下文提示下存在"In-context Laziness"(上下文惰性)这一更广泛的现象，揭示了将LLM部署于严格的长周期医疗推理中的关键开放挑战。

Conclusion: HealthLoopQA揭示了当前LLM在长期医疗推理和时序分析方面的显著不足，提出了"上下文惰性"这一新发现的挑战性现象，为未来开发更严谨的医疗LLM推理系统指明了方向。

Abstract: As medical wearables become integrated into daily chronic disease care, effectively interpreting longitudinal monitoring data is essential for patients and clinicians to understand health trends, detect safety-critical events, and make informed decisions. While large language models (LLMs) show promise for transforming this streaming physiological data into personalized health insights, evaluating their reasoning capability and analytical rigor in diverse monitoring tasks remains a fundamental challenge. Existing medical wearable question answering (QA) benchmarks primarily assess short-horizon classification or statistical summaries, largely ignoring the long-term patterns, therapeutic and behavioural contexts, and potential system failures inherent in real-world deployments. To address this, we introduce HealthLoopQA, a comprehensive diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over continuous diabetes monitoring data. Grounded in a novel taxonomy of eleven atomic reasoning abilities, HealthLoopQA comprises 127 tasks and over 1,500 QA instances spanning process mining, anomaly detection, and prediction over 30-day horizons. To systematically evaluate safety awareness, we complement real-world datasets with a fault-injected simulation testbed modeling diverse device malfunctions and cyber-physical attacks to generate physiologically plausible hazard scenarios. Evaluating state-of-the-art LLMs across prompting and agentic frameworks reveals severe limitations in complex temporal pattern mining. Furthermore, we identify a broader phenomenon of In-context Laziness under long-context prompting, highlighting critical open challenges in deploying LLMs for rigorous long-horizon medical reasoning.

</details>


### [837] [AF-Mamba: Efficient Long-Term Signal Modeling for Early Prediction of Atrial Fibrillation Onset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06984)
*Yongbin Lee,Ki H. Chon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AF-Mamba，一种融合时序卷积网络（TCN）和Mamba状态空间模型的深度学习架构，用于提前一小时预测房颤（AF）发作。该模型基于一小时窗口的长时RR间期（RRI）序列，在逐受试者5折测试中取得AUROC 0.974、F1-score 0.813的优异性能，并在跨数据集外部验证中保持判别能力（平均AUROC 0.897），同时相比Transformer和递归网络在长序列处理上具有更优的效率-性能平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 房颤是最常见的心律失常，与卒中和心力衰竭风险增加相关。可穿戴ECG设备的普及使得院外持续心电监测成为可能，提前预测房颤发作可为临床评估提供更多时间窗口，改善房颤相关并发症的管理。然而现有模型在处理长序列（如一小时RRI数据）时面临Transformer二次方计算复杂度和递归网络梯度消失的限制。

Method: 提出TCN-Mamba混合架构：TCN负责编码局部特征，Mamba（选择性状态空间模型）负责长程序列建模。该设计克服了Transformer的二次方缩放问题和递归网络的梯度消失问题，能够在一小时输入窗口上实现高效训练和推理。实验采用逐受试者5折测试和配对跨数据集留出评估两种协议。

Result: 逐受试者5折测试中：敏感性0.889、特异性0.943、F1-score 0.813、AUROC 0.974、AUPRC 0.933。配对跨数据集留出评估中，在未见的AF和NSR数据集上平均AUROC达0.897。与SOTA AF预测模型及通用时序模型相比，AF-Mamba在保持竞争力的同时提供了更优的性能-效率权衡。

Conclusion: AF-Mamba证明了提前一小时准确预测房颤发作的潜力，适用于实时连续动态监测场景，为房颤的早期预警和临床干预提供了可行的技术路径。

Abstract: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common cardiac arrhythmia and is associated with increased risks of stroke and heart failure. The growing availability of wearable and portable ECG monitoring enables continuous assessment of cardiac rhythm outside clinical settings. Predicting AF before its onset could provide additional lead time for timely clinical assessment and potentially improve the management of patients at risk of AF-related complications. This study focuses on predicting AF onset one hour in advance using long-term RR intervals (RRIs). To address this challenge, we propose a deep learning architecture that integrates temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) for local features encoding with Mamba, a selective state-space model capable of long-range sequence modeling. This hybrid TCN-Mamba design enables efficient training and inference on one-hour input windows, overcoming limitations of Transformers' quadratic scaling and recurrent networks' vanishing gradients. In subject-wise 5-fold testing, the proposed model achieved a sensitivity of 0.889, specificity of 0.943, F1-score of 0.813, AUROC of 0.974, and AUPRC of 0.933. In paired cross-dataset holdout evaluation, AF-Mamba maintained discriminative performance across unseen AF and NSR datasets, achieving a mean AUROC of 0.897. Compared against state-of-the-art AF prediction models and general time-series models, AF-Mamba achieved competitive predictive performance while providing a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off for long RRI sequences. These findings demonstrate the potential of AF-Mamba for accurate AF prediction one hour in advance and real-time continuous ambulatory monitoring.

</details>


### [838] [Continual Learning Mechanisms Compose for Long-Horizon Memorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06986)
*Zheyuan Zhang,Alvin Zhang,Daniel Khashabi,Tianmin Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出长时程记忆（long-horizon memorization）设置，研究语言模型在连续监督微调中学习100个问答任务并长期保留知识的能力。研究发现，组合互补的持续学习机制（数据锚点、函数锚点、权重锚点与低秩分配规则）能显著缓解灾难性遗忘，最佳方法将最终保留率从1.2%提升至34.9%，提升28倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型需要随时间吸收新信息并在多次更新后保留它们，但当前缺乏对此进行系统研究的设置。作者引入长时程记忆场景，发现现有单一持续学习机制在此场景下均无法维持高保留率，因此假设组合针对不同遗忘来源的机制会更为有效。

Method: 1) 提出长时程记忆设置（100个任务，无任务标识符，无先前训练样本）；2) 沿两个设计维度组织机制组合：锚点类型（数据/函数/权重）与低秩分配规则；3) 构建三个100任务记忆数据集；4) 引入任务级连续减半搜索（task-level successive halving）探索组合设计空间；5) 采用析因实验测量各机制的个体效应与交互效应。

Result: 最佳方法组合全部三种锚点与merged LoRA，在所有数据集中排名前三，将最终保留率从朴素连续微调的1.2%提升至34.9%（28倍改进）。数据锚点与merged LoRA提供最大的平均增益，并且在三个数据集上呈现超加性交互作用。

Conclusion: 组合互补的持续学习机制能显著优于任何单一机制，证明针对不同遗忘来源的机制在长时程记忆场景中具有协同效应，为构建能长期保留知识的语言模型提供了新思路。

Abstract: Language models may need to internalize information that arrives over time and retain it through many subsequent updates. To study this challenge, we introduce long-horizon memorization, a setting in which a model learns 100 query-answer tasks through continual supervised fine-tuning without retaining earlier training examples or receiving task identifiers at inference. Sequential updates cause catastrophic forgetting, and no single continual learning mechanism we evaluate maintains strong retention at this horizon. We hypothesize that mechanisms addressing complementary sources of forgetting will be more effective when composed. We organize these compositions along two design dimensions. Data, function, and weight anchors specify what prior information each update should preserve, while low-rank allocation rules determine where successive updates are retained. To test this hypothesis systematically, we construct three distinct 100-task memorization datasets. We introduce task-level successive halving to search the combinatorial design space and use a factorial experiment to measure individual and interaction effects. Our best method combines all three anchors with merged LoRA, ranks among the top 3 methods in all datasets, and raises average final retention from 1.2% under naive sequential fine-tuning to 34.9%, a 28-fold improvement. The data anchor and merged LoRA provide the largest average gains and interact super-additively on all three datasets. Together, these results show that composing complementary mechanisms substantially improves long-horizon memorization beyond what any individual mechanism achieves.

</details>


### [839] [NeuCME: Toward Dynamic Multimodal Continual Learning via Neural Combinatorics of Multiple Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07009)
*Kai Guo,Chuanbin Liu,Peng Hu,Hao Wang,Xi Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出动态多模态持续学习设定（NeuCME框架），解决任务间模态集合动态变化的问题，通过模态组合排练、多门控专家混合和任务相关性引导蒸馏实现知识学习与整合，在四个真实数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法假设每个任务的模态集合是预定义且固定的，而现实场景中模态集合会随任务动态变化。这种更真实的设定带来了两大挑战：时空灾难性遗忘和自适应多模态融合。

Method: 提出NeuCME框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 模态组合排练（modality-combinational rehearsal），2) 多门控混合专家（multi-gated mixture-of-experts），3) 任务相关性引导蒸馏（task relevance-guided distillation）。此外还设计了用于量化任务序列动态程度的评估指标，并构建了不同动态程度的综合基准。

Result: 在四个真实数据集上进行的大量实验表明，NeuCME在动态多模态持续学习任务上明显优于现有的最先进方法。

Conclusion: NeuCME有效解决了动态多模态持续学习中的时空灾难性遗忘和自适应多模态融合问题，为模态动态变化的持续学习场景提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Multimodal continual learning has recently shown great potential for developing agents with human-like intelligence by continuously learning new tasks across multiple modalities. However, existing methods typically assume that the set of modalities per task is predefined and fixed. In this paper, we investigate a more realistic learning setting, referred to as dynamic multimodal continual learning, in which the set of modalities may vary across tasks rather than remaining fixed. This setting involves two primary challenges: (i) spatio-temporal catastrophic forgetting and (ii) adaptive multimodal fusion. To address these challenges, we propose NeuCME (as shorthand for \textbf{Neu}ral \textbf{C}ombinatorics of \textbf{M}ultiple \textbf{E}xperts), a novel framework designed to effectively learn and integrate knowledge across tasks with varying modalities. The proposed NeuCME model comprises three key components, namely modality-combinational rehearsal, multi-gated mixture-of-experts, and task relevance-guided distillation. Furthermore, we formulate an evaluation metric to quantify the dynamism of task sequences and then set up a comprehensive benchmark with different degrees of dynamism. Extensive experiments using four real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed NeuCME outperforms state-of-the-art methods markedly.

</details>


### [840] [HyperTransfer: Understanding the Equivalence between Base Optimizer and Hyperball](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07017)
*Jinghui Yuan,Hongtao Zhang,Jade Zou,Tianyu Li,Wenjie Zhou,Tianyu He,Wei Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HyperTransfer方法，证明Hyperball优化器与常规Base优化器在尺度不变网络中动态等价，可通过初始化和学习率调度复现目标优化器动力学，并扩展到非尺度不变网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hyperball优化器（约束参数范数、仅更新方向）与常规优化器（同时更新范数和方向）在几何上看似根本不同，作者希望探究两者间是否存在深层联系，并利用该联系实现优化器之间的动力学转换。

Method: 1) 理论上证明两类优化器在尺度不变网络中的动态等价性；2) 提出HyperTransfer框架，仅利用目标Base优化器的初始化和学习率调度来构造等价的Hyperball优化器；3) 推导逆映射，并将框架扩展到非尺度不变网络。

Result: 实验表明HyperTransfer和逆映射产生的损失轨迹与目标优化器几乎完全一致，证明Hyperball动力学主要由诱导的有效学习率调度和优化器状态决定。

Conclusion: Hyperball与Base优化器间的等价性揭示了优化器动力学本质由有效学习率调度和状态决定而非参数更新几何范式，为优化器之间的转换与迁移提供了新理论基础。

Abstract: Hyperball optimizers constrain parameter norms and update only their directions, establishing a distinct paradigm for neural network optimization. Although this geometry appears fundamentally different from that of conventional Base Optimizers, which update both parameter norms and directions, we show that the two paradigms are dynamically equivalent for scale-invariant networks. Building on this equivalence, we propose HyperTransfer, which constructs a Hyperball optimizer that reproduces the dynamics of a target Base Optimizer using only its initialization and learning-rate schedule, without running the target optimizer itself. We further derive the inverse mapping and extend the framework to non-scale-invariant networks. Experiments show that both HyperTransfer and the inverse mapping produce loss trajectories nearly identical to those of their targets, suggesting that Hyperball dynamics are governed primarily by the induced effective learning-rate schedule and optimizer state.

</details>


### [841] [Efficient Learning and Symmetry Discovery under Exact Invariances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07031)
*Ashkan Soleymani,Behrooz Tahmasebi,Patrick Jaillet,Stefanie Jegelka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解决了群不变性学习中的两大计算挑战：首次提出统一适用于有限群和无限群的精确不变性多项式时间学习算法，以及在对称性未知的场景下从数据中识别精确对称性并用于学习的多项式时间算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 群不变性学习在科学和几何学习问题中至关重要，但其计算基础仍不清晰。此前已知有限群情形可在多项式时间内实现精确不变性，但无限群和未知对称性的情况尚未解决。本文旨在填补这两个空白，为不变/等变方法在几何机器学习中的经验成功提供计算理论解释。

Method: 1) 针对已知群的精确不变性学习：提出首个统一适用于有限和无限群的算法，运行时间仅与数据维度和样本量成多项式关系，且不依赖于群本身。2) 针对对称性发现：聚焦有限群的子群格，利用随机Cayley图和扩张图理论工具，从数据中识别真实对称性并用于回归学习。

Result: - 对已知群（有限或无限），实现了多项式时间内的精确不变性学习，并具备强泛化保证；- 在未知对称性设定下，算法可精确恢复底层对称性，其样本复杂度与已知对称性设定下的极小极大最优值相匹配，运行时间为数据维度和样本量的多项式。

Conclusion: 本文为群不变性学习的计算理论提供了统一框架，解答了文献中的开放问题。所引入的随机Cayley图和扩张理论工具可能具有独立的学术价值。

Abstract: Learning with group invariances is central to many scientific and geometric learning problems, yet its computational foundations remain poorly understood. Even for classical supervised regression settings, it has been unclear whether one can efficiently compute a regression function that is exactly invariant to a given group action. Recent work showed that exact invariance can be enforced in polynomial time when the underlying group is finite and known, but left open the cases of infinite groups and unknown symmetries. In this paper, we resolve both challenges. First, we present the first polynomial-time algorithm for learning with exact group invariances that applies uniformly to finite and infinite groups. The runtime is polynomial in the data dimension and sample size, and independent of the group, while achieving strong generalization guarantees. This provides a computational explanation for the empirical success of invariant and equivariant methods in geometric machine learning and partially answers a recent open question in the literature. Second, we study learning in the symmetry discovery setting, where the invariance group is unknown. Focusing on the subgroup lattice of a finite group, we show that exact symmetries can be identified from data and exploited for learning in polynomial time. For regression over finite-dimensional feature spaces, our algorithm provably recovers the underlying symmetry, matches the minimax-optimal sample complexity of the known-symmetry setting, and runs in time polynomial in the data dimension and sample size. Our analysis relies on tools from random Cayley graphs and expander theory, which may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [842] [Disentangling Steering Vectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07037)
*Takeru Hiramatsu,Kyohei Atarashi,Koh Takeuchi,Hisashi Kashima*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Steering Vector Dissection框架，通过在实例级steering vectors上训练稀疏自编码器(SAE)，将LLM激活控制中复合的方向向量解耦为语义一致的独立概念向量，实现更精确、可预测的模型行为控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的steering vectors（如difference-in-means方法）会将多个语义和风格概念纠缠到一个复合方向中，导致不可预测的引导效果。作者的核心目标是将这种复合方向解耦为其组成概念，以实现更可控的模型行为干预。

Method: 作者提出了Steering Vector Dissection框架：(1) 将正负激活配对并求差，生成一组实例级steering vectors；(2) 直接在这些向量上训练专门的稀疏自编码器(SAE)；(3) 通过SAE将复合方向解耦为语义一致且彼此可区分的基向量。

Result: 在两个数据集、两个模型和两种干预深度上进行的定量评估表明，该方法能产生一组语义一致的基向量，其steering效果彼此可区分。此外，这种解耦能力支持对模型行为进行精确控制。

Conclusion: 通过将复合激活干预方向解耦为独立的语义概念，该方法克服了传统steering向量的语义纠缠问题，为LLM行为控制提供了更精确、更细粒度的推理时干预手段。

Abstract: Activation steering has emerged as a lightweight, inference-time approach to control the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, traditional steering vectors used to intervene in LLMs' activations, such as those derived from the difference-in-means method, tend to entangle multiple semantic and stylistic concepts into a single composite direction, leading to unpredictable steering effects. Our core objective is to disentangle this composite direction into its constituent concepts. To this end, we propose Steering Vector Dissection, a framework to explicitly isolate individual and semantically consistent features from these composite directions. Specifically, we pair positive and negative activations and take their differences to generate a set of instance-level steering vectors, and train a dedicated Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) directly on them. Quantitative evaluations across two datasets, two models, and two intervention depths show that our method yields a set of semantically consistent basis vectors whose steering effects are mutually distinguishable. Furthermore, we show that this disentanglement enables precise control over model behaviors.

</details>


### [843] [AI and TCAD for Inverse Design and Defect Discovery: From Simple Machine Learning to LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07046)
*Hiu Yung Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨了利用TCAD（技术计算机辅助设计）生成精确数据来驱动机器学习（ML），实现"仿真增强的ML"。作者展示了在无需大量领域专家知识的情况下，通过自编码器模型和噪声工程技术处理TCAD数据，可以训练出达到器件工程师水平的AI模型。论文通过多个实例（PiN二极管层厚反演、Ga2O3肖特基二极管参数提取、晶体管接触电阻、FinFET IV/CV预测、图像到IV曲线映射、TCAD参数自动校准）展示了这一方法的有效性，并展望了LLM和MLLM在自动化器件设计与缺陷发现中的应用前景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI在半导体器件设计和缺陷发现中的应用仍然受限，主要原因是数据稀缺和高维问题（维度灾难）。作者希望通过TCAD仿真生成精确、充足的数据来弥补实验数据不足的问题，从而使机器学习能够在这一领域发挥更大作用。

Method: 核心方法是使用TCAD仿真生成训练数据来增强机器学习，具体包括：(1) 自编码器模型学习潜在物理规律；(2) 对TCAD数据应用噪声工程以提高模型对实验数据的泛化能力；(3) 利用非破坏性电学数据逆向工程器件结构参数；(4) 使用LLM/MLLM进行TCAD命令文件生成和自动化设计。

Result: 研究表明，即使在最小化领域专业知识的条件下，构建的模型也能达到与器件工程师相当的水平。模型能从非破坏性电学数据中准确反演多种器件参数（如PiN二极管层厚度、Ga2O3肖特基二极管掺杂和功函数、晶体管接触电阻），并能生成FinFET IV/CV预测模型、完成图像与IV曲线的映射，以及自动校准TCAD参数——这些都是传统上只有经验丰富的TCAD工程师才能完成的任务。

Conclusion: TCAD辅助生成的仿真数据可以有效克服半导体领域数据稀缺的问题，使ML模型达到器件工程师水平。作者认为，要充分发挥AI在该领域的潜力，需要引入LLM和MLLM，实现自动化的器件设计、TCAD命令生成和缺陷发现，形成更完整的AI驱动半导体研发闭环。

Abstract: AI has revolutionized various engineering domains, but its impact on semiconductor device design and defect discovery is still limited, due to limited data and the curse of dimensionality. In this paper, we will discuss our work on using the Technology Computer-Aided-Design (TCAD) to generate precise data needed for machine learning (ML) to enable simulation-augmented ML. We demonstrate that with minimal domain expertise, it is possible to create a machine that performs as well as a device engineer on a specific task. We will show that auto-encoder-based machine learning models and noise engineering applied to TCAD data are effective at learning latent physics, and that the models can be seamlessly applied to experimental data. We will demonstrate how to build a device-engineer-level model step by step through various examples, including using only non-destructive electrical data to inverse-engineer the PiN diode layer thickness variations, the Ga2O3 Schottky diode doping and anode workfunction variations, and the transistor contact resistance in an inverter. Examples also include the generation of a FinFET IV/CV prediction model, the mapping between transistor images and IV curves, and the automatic calibration of TCAD parameters for a Ga2O3 Schottky diode, which can only be handled well by experienced TCAD engineers. Finally, to fully realize the potential of AI, large language models (LLMs) and multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) are believed to be necessary. We will discuss the application of LLMs to TCAD command file creation and our vision for MLLMs in automated device design and defect discovery.

</details>


### [844] [TrojanWorld: Backdooring World-Model Agents via Imagination Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07051)
*Wenkai Huang,Siyuan Liang,Gaolei Li,Yiming Li,Tianhao Peng,Jianhua Li,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TrojanWorld，一个针对世界模型智能体的后门攻击框架。通过物理物体作为触发器，利用决策反射归纳（Decision-Reflective Induction）、清洁行为锚定（Clean Behavior Anchoring）和因果传播（Causal Propagation）三种机制，实现对世界模型内部想象的操纵，从而诱导智能体执行攻击者指定的行为，即使在触发器消失后仍能维持恶意行为轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型作为基于模型的强化学习智能体的预测核心，训练成本高昂，促使预训练世界模型被广泛分发和复用，这引入了模型供应链安全威胁。后门攻击虽已被研究，但对交互式世界模型智能体的威胁尚未被充分探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: TrojanWorld包含三个核心机制：(1) 决策反射归纳（Decision-Reflective Induction）：利用决策反馈引导触发条件下的想象朝向攻击者指定的动作；(2) 清洁行为锚定（Clean Behavior Anchoring）：保持无触发条件下预测与行为保真度；(3) 因果传播（Causal Propagation）：在触发器消失后维持诱导偏好的持续性。整个攻击链从物理感知经污染想象延伸到恶意动作选择。

Result: 在TD-MPC2、DreamerV3和R2-Dreamer系统上，跨DeepMind Control、MetaWorld、MyoSuite和RoboDesk基准的实验表明：触发器激活时，目标动作偏差低至0.026，同时保留至少98.8%的清洁性能；即使触发器移除后，被攻陷的智能体仍可被困在诱导行为轨迹中，持续执行攻击者指定动作。

Conclusion: TrojanWorld证明了世界模型智能体面临严重的模型供应链后门攻击威胁。攻击可通过物理触发器在部署阶段自然激活，无需数字篡改观察流，且能够在触发器消失后持续影响智能体行为，揭示了当前世界模型安全防护的重要漏洞。

Abstract: World models increasingly serve as the predictive core of model-based reinforcement learning agents, enabling them to simulate future dynamics and reason over imagined trajectories before acting. Their substantial training demands make pretrained world models attractive for distribution and reuse, exposing downstream systems to model supply chain threats. Backdoor attacks offer a targeted and stealthy means of exploiting such supply chains, yet their threat to interactive world-model agents remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we present TrojanWorld, a backdoor framework for world-model agents that induces attacker-specified behavior by steering internal imagination. A physical object placed in the scene acts as the trigger, enabling deployment-time activation through the agent's native observation pipeline without digitally manipulating the observation stream. To achieve effective, stealthy, and persistent control, TrojanWorld combines Decision-Reflective Induction to steer trigger-conditioned imagination toward attacker-specified actions using decision feedback, Clean Behavior Anchoring to preserve trigger-free predictive and behavioral fidelity, and Causal Propagation to sustain the induced preference along subsequent trajectories after the trigger disappears. Together, these mechanisms establish an end-to-end attack chain from physical perception through corrupted imagination to malicious action selection. Experiments with the TD-MPC2, DreamerV3, and R2-Dreamer systems across the DeepMind Control, MetaWorld, MyoSuite, and RoboDesk benchmarks show that under trigger activation, TrojanWorld achieves a target-action deviation as low as 0.026 while retaining at least 98.8% of the corresponding clean performance. Even after trigger removal, the compromised agent can remain trapped in the induced behavioral trajectory, continuing to execute attacker-specified actions.

</details>


### [845] [PhysSAE: Mechanistic Interpretability with Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07061)
*Nandita N. Patil,Eshwar R. A.,Gajanan V. Honnavar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PhysSAE框架，通过在PINN倒数第二层激活上训练过完备稀疏自编码器(SAE)，并直接在冻结的隐藏状态上进行因果干预（绕过SAE解码器），揭示了PINN内部存在稀疏、物理结构化的潜在表征。在6个PDE族、多种子实验中证明：SAE原子与独立定义的物理可观测量高度对齐，其因果足迹比PCA/ICA更集中，且双原子联合表征优于单原子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN虽能将PDE残差嵌入神经网络训练，但内部表征完全不可解释——不知道隐藏层编码了什么物理特征，也无法确定这些特征是否具有局部因果作用。现有研究缺乏对PINN内部物理特征进行机械可解释性分析的方法。

Method: 1) 在PINN倒数第二层激活上训练过完备SAE；2) 通过直接因果干预h_cf = h - αz_k d_k（绕过SAE解码器）评估字典原子的因果作用；3) 与PCA/ICA干预作为基线对比；4) 检验SAE原子与物理可观测量的对齐程度及因果足迹的空间集中性。

Result: (i) SAE原子与物理可观测量对齐（max Pearson |r|=0.951，远超置换零假设）；(ii) 对齐原子的消融因果足迹比PCA/ICA干预空间集中1.2-4.2倍；(iii) 对齐原子因果定位优于随机对照（ESF80优势0.04-0.44）；双原子表征较单原子提升回归R² 0.05-0.15，随机对反而降低至0.60。

Conclusion: PINN会发展出稀疏、物理结构化的潜在表征，可通过SAE+因果干预事后识别和质询，为可解释性的科学机器学习开辟新路径。

Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) embed PDE residuals into neural network training, but their internal representations remain opaque: it is unknown what physical features their hidden layers encode or whether those features have a localized causal role. We present PhysSAE, a mechanistic interpretability framework that trains overcomplete sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on PINN penultimate-layer activations and evaluates dictionary atoms through direct causal intervention in the original frozen hidden state: $h_{\mathrm{cf}} = h - αz_k d_k$, bypassing the SAE decoder entirely. Across six PDE families, with 3 PINN seeds and 3 SAE seeds each---we show that (i) Our discovered SAE atoms align with independently-defined physical observables (max Pearson $|r|=0.951$, always $\gg$ permutation null), (ii) the causal footprint of top-aligned atom ablation is 1.2--4.2$\times$ more spatially concentrated canonical than PCA or ICA interventions, and (iii) top-aligned atoms outperform matched random controls on causal localization for structured physical concepts (ESF$_{80}$ advantage 0.04-0.44). Two-atom bilateral representations improve concept regression R$^2$ by $ΔR^2\!=\!0.05\text{-}0.15$ over single atoms, while random pairs decrease it by up to 0.60. These results demonstrate that PINNs develop sparse, physically structured latent representations that can be identified and causally interrogated post-hoc, opening a path toward interpretability-aware scientific machine learning.

</details>


### [846] [Trust-But-Verify: Poisoning-Resilient Locally Private Graph Learning Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07063)
*Longzhu He,Li Sun,Hao Peng,Ruijie Wang,Raymond Chi-Wing Wong,Sen Su*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VERITAS，一个基于"信任但验证"范式的抗投毒本地私有图学习协议，通过引入分级信任验证列表并结合用户端隐私扰动与服务器端双向证明不对称性来识别并剪除恶意节点，在四种真实数据集上验证了其对数据投毒攻击的有效防御和下游图学习效用的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于本地差分隐私（LDP）的图学习协议因开放参与特性而极易遭受数据投毒攻击，恶意节点可注入精心构造的数据以破坏邻居聚合并降低下游效用。然而，该威胁下有效的防御机制尚未得到充分探索，这是当前研究的关键空白。

Method: VERITAS采用"信任但验证"范式，包含四个协同阶段：(1) 用户端本地数据扰动（联合私有化节点特征与图结构）；(2) 基于证明的恶意节点剪除（利用服务器端的双向证明不对称性）；(3) 通过双重去噪进行效用恢复；(4) 鲁棒的私有图学习。其核心机制是引入一个编码分级节点信任级别的验证列表。

Result: 在四个真实世界基准数据集上，跨多种LDP机制和GNN架构的大量实验表明，VERITAS能有效防御数据投毒攻击，并在严格的隐私保证下显著提升下游图学习效用。

Conclusion: VERITAS填补了本地私有图学习领域对抗投毒攻击防御策略的空白，通过信任但验证的联合设计兼顾了隐私保护、鲁棒性和学习效用，为开放参与环境下的去中心化图学习提供了可行的安全方案。

Abstract: Built upon local differential privacy (LDP), locally private graph learning protocols have emerged as an important paradigm for decentralized graph learning, balancing privacy protection and learning utility. Under such protocols, each user locally perturbs their node features and adjacency information before transmission, ensuring formal privacy guarantees without original data leaving the device. However, the inherently open participation nature renders these protocols critically vulnerable to data poisoning attacks, where adversaries inject carefully crafted malicious nodes to corrupt neighborhood aggregation and degrade downstream utility. Despite the severity of this threat, effective defenses in this setting remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose VERITAS, a poisoning-resilient locally private graph learning protocol built on a trust-but-verify paradigm. By introducing a verification list encoding graded peer trust levels, VERITAS jointly privatizes node features and graph structure on the user side, while exploiting bilateral attestation asymmetry on the server side to identify and prune malicious nodes. Concretely, VERITAS comprises four synergistic stages: (1) local data perturbation, (2) attestation-driven malicious node pruning, (3) utility restoration via dual denoising, and (4) robust private graph learning. Extensive experiments on four real-world benchmark datasets across multiple LDP mechanisms and GNN architectures demonstrate that VERITAS effectively defends against data poisoning attacks and significantly improves downstream graph learning utility under rigorous privacy guarantees.

</details>


### [847] [Conditioned Initialization for Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07086)
*Hemanth Saratchandran,Simon Lucey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的注意力权重初始化策略——"条件初始化"(conditioned initialization)，通过改善注意力层的谱性质（降低Jacobian条件数）来稳定优化，从而加速收敛并提升泛化性能，且可无缝集成到多种Transformer架构中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer中查询、键、值矩阵的初始化方式长期被忽视。常见的随机初始化、模仿初始化（mimetic initialization）和权重选择（weight selection）等方法均未充分考虑初始化对优化动态的根本影响。作者认为初始化会引入优化偏差，进而从根本上塑造训练动力学，因此需要更系统的初始化方案。

Method: 提出"条件初始化"方案：一种原则性的初始化方法，旨在改善注意力层的谱性质。理论上证明该初始化可降低注意力Jacobian的条件数，从而使优化过程更加稳定。

Result: 在多种应用中，条件初始化均能加速收敛并提升泛化能力，验证了该方法在不同Transformer架构中的有效性和通用性。

Conclusion: 初始化条件性（conditioning）是提升Transformer性能中被低估但至关重要的研究方向。条件初始化实现简单、易于应用，可广泛适配现有Transformer架构，为该领域提供了新的优化思路。

Abstract: Transformers are a dominant architecture in modern machine learning, powering applications across vision, language, and beyond. At the core of their success lies the attention layer, where the query, key, and value matrices determine how token dependencies are captured. While considerable work has focused on scaling and optimizing Transformers, comparatively little attention has been paid to how the weights of the queries, keys and values are initialized. Common practice relies on random initialization or alternatives such as mimetic initialization, which imitates weight patterns from converged models, and weight selection, which transfers weights from a teacher model. In this paper, we argue that initialization can introduce an optimization bias that fundamentally shapes training dynamics. We propose conditioned initialization, a principled scheme that initializes attention weights to improve the spectral properties of the attention layer. Theoretically, we show that conditioned initialization can potentially reduce the condition number of the attention Jacobian, leading to more stable optimization. Empirically, it accelerates convergence and improves generalization across diverse applications, highlighting conditioning as a critical yet underexplored area for advancing Transformer performance. Importantly, conditioned initialization is simple to apply and integrates seamlessly into a wide range of Transformer architectures.

</details>


### [848] [Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Transformer for Credit Card Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07100)
*Qinwen Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出THGT-FD，一种用于信用卡欺诈检测的时间异构图Transformer。每个交易由一个交易令牌和六种关系令牌表示，并融入Time2Vec编码。实验在IEEE-CIS数据集15万条样本上进行，AUC-ROC为0.8536，但低于梯度提升基线（0.8722），表明关系令牌对欺诈风险排序有用，但模型尚未融入实体级历史聚合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信用卡欺诈检测通常依赖表格特征，但重复属性（如商户、卡号等）能提供有价值的关系信号。现有方法未能充分利用这些关系信息。

Method: 每个交易使用一个交易令牌和六种关系令牌进行表示，并加入Time2Vec时间编码；通过Transformer学习交易内各令牌间的交互，最终输出欺诈概率。

Result: 在IEEE-CIS数据集15万条样本上，THGT-FD在测试集上达到AUC-ROC 0.8536、平均精度0.4164、Recall@5%为0.4708。类别加权直方图梯度提升基线的AUC-ROC为0.8722，优于所提方法。

Conclusion: 关系令牌为欺诈风险排序提供了有用信息，但当前模型性能仍不及梯度提升基线，且尚未整合实体级历史聚合，这可能是未来改进的方向。

Abstract: Credit card fraud detection typically relies on tabular features, while repeated attributes can also provide useful relational signals. This paper proposes THGT-FD, a Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Transformer for Fraud Detection. Each transaction is represented using one transaction token and six types of relation tokens and incorporates Time2Vec encoding into the transaction representation. A Transformer learns the interactions among these tokens within each individual transaction and then outputs a fraud probability. Experiments were conducted on 150,000 transactions sampled from the IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection dataset and chronologically partitioned according to TransactionDT. On the test set, THGT-FD achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.8536, an average precision of 0.4164, and a Recall@5% of 0.4708. The class-weighted histogram-based gradient-boosting baseline achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.8722. The results indicate that relation tokens provide useful information for fraud-risk ranking, although the current model does not yet incorporate entity-level historical aggregation.

</details>


### [849] [Online Draft Co-Training for Speculative Decoding in Large-Scale, Long-Context RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07108)
*Zili Wang,Zhaopeng Qiu,Yuekai Zhang,Shuang Yu,Junjie Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个用于大规模在线草稿共训练的端到端系统，解决投机解码中分支注意力不支持因果上下文并行以及目标特征跨流水线并行阶段传输两大障碍，实现了最高122B参数规模模型上的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码通过草稿模型加速强化学习后训练中的 rollout 生成，而在线共训练可进一步提升草稿准确性。然而将该方法扩展到大型模型长上下文场景面临两个核心挑战：标准的因果上下文并行实现不支持分支注意力；目标特征需要跨流水线并行阶段传输。

Method: 1) 针对上下文并行，扩展打包、负载均衡的 zigzag 环注意力，将 rank 本地分支注意力与因果主序列注意力合并。2) 针对流水线并行，提出 TapChannel 机制，通过单独路径跨阶段传输中间目标特征，而不影响流水线调度。

Result: 实验表明共训练的草稿模型能紧密跟踪策略基线，在高达122B参数的模型规模上实现显著的 rollout 和端到端加速。上下文并行设计在256K token长度下实现强扩展性并较之前工作显著节省内存；流水线并行传输开销较小。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了大规模在线草稿共训练在长上下文、大模型场景下的可行性与高效性，为加速RL后训练中的rollout生成提供了可行的系统工程方案。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates rollout generation, which dominates the cost of reinforcement learning (RL) post-training. Online co-training can further increase the draft's accuracy, yielding greater speedups. However, scaling this approach to co-training on large models with long contexts poses two obstacles: (1) branch attention is unsupported by standard causal context-parallel (CP) implementations, and (2) target features span across pipeline-parallel (PP) stages. We address both with an end-to-end system for large-scale online draft co-training. For CP, we extend packed, load-balanced zigzag ring attention by merging rank-local branch attention with causal main-sequence attention. For PP, TapChannel transports intermediate target features across stages via a separate path, leaving the pipeline schedule unaffected. Experiments demonstrate that co-trained drafts closely track the policy baseline while delivering substantial rollout and end-to-end speedups across model scales up to 122B. Our CP design achieves strong scaling at 256K tokens with significant memory savings over prior work, and our PP transport incurs modest overhead. Code can be found at https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/RL/issues/3698.

</details>


### [850] [Fine-grained Distributed Backdoor Attacks in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07147)
*Jian Wang,Hong Shen,Wei Ke,Xue Hua Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种细粒度分布式后门攻击框架（FDBA），通过动态触发器生成和嵌入向量优化，在联邦学习中用更少的投毒样本实现高效攻击，并能绕过主流防御机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
