CUNO further employs a distribution-level negative preference optimization (NPO) objective at each curriculum stage that steers the model away from its original behavior on the current forget subset while preserving retained performance. Our theoretical analysis shows that the curriculum design is most beneficial when the forget set spans a wide range of unlearning difficulty, a condition naturally satisfied under mass deletion. Comprehensive experiments confirm that CUNO consistently mitigates catastrophic unlearning: at 20% deletion, it retains 74% of the original utility compared to 26-53% for existing methods, and maintains more than half the original utility even at 50% deletion. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cuno-D4FF.

</details>


### [919] [Revisiting Spectral Representations in Generative Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08253)
*Yuehao Wang,Peihao Wang,Hanwen Jiang,Ziyi Yang,Qixing Huang,Zhangyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自监督谱表示对齐的正则化方法，通过将扩散模型生成过程与谱表示学习统一到扰动核的视角下，在扩散训练目标中加入谱正则项，从而在图像和3D点云生成任务上一致地提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明对扩散网络隐藏状态施加表示对齐可以加速训练收敛并提升采样质量，但背后的机制尚不清楚；作者希望从理论上阐明扩散生成模型与自监督谱表示学习之间的深层联系，并据此设计更有效的训练方法。

Method: 作者首先从扰动核（perturbation kernel）的统一视角建立扩散模型与谱表示学习的理论联系；然后从几何角度阐明联合谱学习如何帮助扩散训练；进一步证明了谱对齐目标在表示空间中与扩散分数蒸馏（score distillation）形式等价；基于这些发现，将谱正则项集成到扩散训练目标中。

Result: 在图像和3D点云多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在生成质量上取得了一致的提升。

Conclusion: 谱表示学习与扩散生成模型在扰动核视角下存在内在统一性，谱正则项的引入能够有效促进扩散模型的训练和生成性能。

Abstract: Diffusion models have shown remarkable performance on diverse generation tasks. Recent work finds that imposing representation alignment on the hidden states of diffusion networks can both facilitate training convergence and enhance sampling quality, yet the mechanism driving this synergy remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we investigate the connection between self-supervised spectral representation learning and diffusion generative models through a shared perspective on perturbation kernels. On the diffusion side, samples (e.g., images, videos) are produced by reversing a stochastic noise-injection process specified by Gaussian kernels; on the spectral representation side, spectral embeddings emerge from contrasting positive and negative relations induced by random perturbation kernels. Motivated by this, we propose a self-supervised spectral representation alignment method to facilitate diffusion model training. In addition, we clarify how joint spectral learning can benefit diffusion training from a geometric perspective. Furthermore, we find that the optimization of the spectral alignment objective is in an equivalent form of diffusion score distillation in the representation space. Building on these findings, we integrate a spectral regularizer into diffusion training objectives to improve the performance of diffusion models on multiple datasets. Experiments across images and 3D point clouds show consistent gains in generation quality. Code is released at https://github.com/yuehaowang/spectral-reg-diffusion.

</details>


### [920] [Synergistic Fusion of Topological Structure and Temporal Semantics of Mobility for Urban Region Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08268)
*Namwoo Kim,Jeeyun Chang,Kanghoon Lee,Yoonjin Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Mobility Stream-Structure Synergy (MoSS) 框架，从移动数据中提取两种互补视图（序列视图和基于 zigzag 持久性图的结构视图），并通过协同模块捕获视图间的高阶交互信号，在纽约和芝加哥的多个下游任务上仅用移动数据即达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有城市区域嵌入方法虽通过整合移动数据与辅助模态提升了表示质量，但对人类移动的时间动态性（如区域流入/流出随时间波动、区域间连接的出现/持续/消退）研究不足；且现有融合策略多为视图的加性组合，忽略了视图共同出现时才产生的联合信号。

Method: MoSS 从移动数据中构建两个互补视图：(1) 序列视图——保留每个区域逐小时的流入/流出剖面；(2) 结构视图——基于 zigzag 持久性图捕获区域连接随时间出现、持续与消退的模式。随后协同模块通过多度交互显式提取两视图共同出现时的高阶信号。

Result: 在纽约市和芝加哥的实验表明，MoSS 在三个下游任务上仅使用移动数据即达到最先进性能，优于依赖辅助模态的基线方法。

Conclusion: MoSS 证明了对移动数据本身的深度挖掘（时间动态性 + 结构演化 + 视图间高阶协同）足以替代对辅助模态的依赖，为城市区域表示学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: Urban region embeddings have shown promising results in diverse urban sensing tasks such as crime, income, and service-call prediction. Recent methods improve representation quality by integrating mobility data with auxiliary modalities, using cross-view attention or contrastive objectives to align heterogeneous features into a unified region representation. However, leveraging the temporal dynamics of human mobility remains under-explored. Regional inflow and outflow fluctuate throughout the day, and inter-region connections emerge, persist, and dissolve over time. Moreover, prevailing fusion strategies combine views additively and miss the joint signal that emerges only when views co-occur. To address these gaps, we propose Mobility Stream-Structure Synergy (MoSS), which derives complementary views from mobility data: a Sequence view that preserves each region's hourly inflow/outflow profile, and a Structure view based on zigzag persistence diagrams that capture how regional connectivity emerges, persists, and dissolves over time. A synergy module then extracts emergent representations from the co-occurrence of these views through multi-degree interactions, explicitly capturing higher-order signal across views. Extensive experiments on New York City and Chicago show that MoSS achieves state-of-the-art performance across three downstream tasks using mobility data alone, outperforming baselines that rely on auxiliary modalities.

</details>


### [921] [Online Signature Verification Using Augmented Path Signature and T-Mamba](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08276)
*Ruiling Li,Danyu Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个集成了增强路径签名（APS）描述符与T-Mamba模型的在线签名验证（OSV）框架。APS通过时间和基点增强以及滑动窗口路径签名来捕获几何结构和非线性通道交互，T-Mamba则结合两个TCN块与时间扫描Mamba，同时学习局部时序模式和全局长距离依赖。在MCYT-100、SVC-2004 Task 2和DeepSignDB三个公开基准数据集上取得了最先进的等错误率（EER），尤其在训练数据有限时表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线签名验证在商业和金融应用中至关重要，虽然深度学习方法被广泛采用，但现有方法难以捕获高判别性特征并建模长距离依赖关系，这限制了验证精度。

Method: 提出一个两阶段框架：首先利用APS描述符（含时间和基点增强、滑动窗口路径签名）作为非参数特征映射，有效捕获几何结构与非线性通道交互；随后采用T-Mamba模型，该模型采用混合设计，结合两个TCN块（学习局部时序模式）和基于状态空间模型的Mamba模块（建模全局长距离依赖）。

Result: 在MCYT-100、SVC-2004 Task 2和DeepSignDB三个公开基准数据集上取得了最先进的EER结果，验证了框架的有效性和鲁棒性，尤其在训练数据有限的情况下优势明显。

Conclusion: 该框架通过路径签名与状态空间模型的有机结合，有效解决了在线签名验证中判别性特征提取和长距离依赖建模的挑战，为OSV领域提供了一种新的SOTA解决方案。代码已开源。

Abstract: Handwritten signature verification is vital for personal authentication across commercial and financial applications. Although deep learning methods are widely adopted for online signature verification (OSV), they often struggle with capturing highly discriminative features and modelling long-range dependencies. To address these issues, we propose a novel framework that integrates the augmented path signature (APS) descriptor with the T-Mamba model. The APS descriptor first applies time and basepoint augmentations, then computes sliding-window path signatures. The path signature is a non-parametric feature map from rough path theory that effectively captures geometric structures and nonlinear inter-channel interactions. Inspired by the efficacy of state space models (SSMs) in sequence modelling, our T-Mamba model employs a hybrid design combining two temporal convolutional network (TCN) blocks with a time-scanning Mamba. This design enables the model to learn both local temporal patterns and global long-range dependencies, substantially improving verification accuracy. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art EERs on three public benchmark datasets (MCYT-100, SVC-2004 Task 2, DeepSignDB), validating its effectiveness and robustness, especially when the training data is limited. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/DLRL04/OSV-using-APS-and-T-Mamba.

</details>


### [922] [Adaptively Incorporating Directional Hints into Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08277)
*Alexander Ryabchenko,Jian Qian,Wenlong Mou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出控制变量零阶下降（CV-ZOD）框架，利用廉价但可能不准确的线性子空间方向提示来增强零阶非凸优化，通过控制变量精炼梯度估计器，实现收敛速率在零阶O(d/T)与一阶O(1/T)之间自适应插值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零阶优化在科学仿真等领域至关重要（因无法获得解析梯度），但其收敛速度受维度影响（O(d/T)）。同时存在廉价的方向提示（如线性子空间近似）可以利用，但提示质量可能不可靠。现有引导方法在提示质量下降时会停滞，缺乏既能自适应利用提示又对其质量保持鲁棒的方案。

Method: 提出CV-ZOD框架，其核心思想是在经典零阶梯度估计器中引入控制变量（control variate），该控制变量可基于方向提示设定。理论上首先分析了一种理想oracle算法（每步最优设置参考向量与步长），证明其收敛率可在O(1/T)（一阶）与O(d/T)（零阶）之间根据提示质量插值；随后开发了无需先知提示质量的实用变体，达到相同的oracle保证（相差对数因子）。

Result: 在仿真驱动的科学优化任务上验证了方法有效性：在非凸景观上，零阶下降较慢、现有引导方法在引导恶化时停滞的场景中，CV-ZOD能持续取得进展。

Conclusion: CV-ZOD为带方向提示的零阶非凸优化提供了理论上最优插值收敛率与实用的自适应算法，兼顾了提示的利用效率与对提示质量的鲁棒性。

Abstract: We study zeroth-order optimization of non-convex functions with the aid of directional hints, which are cheap but potentially inaccurate approximations of the true gradient direction, given by linear subspaces at each iteration. To leverage these hints adaptively while maintaining robustness to their quality, we introduce Control-Variate Zeroth-Order Descent (CV-ZOD), a new framework that refines the classical zeroth-order gradient estimator with a control variate that can be set based on the directional hints. We first show that the oracle algorithm that optimally sets the reference vector and step size at each iteration achieves a convergence rate that interpolates between the first-order $O(1/T)$ rate and the zeroth-order $O(d/T)$ rate, depending on the quality of the hints along the trajectory. We then develop a practical variant of CV-ZOD that achieves the same oracle guarantee up to logarithmic factors, without any prior knowledge of the hint quality. We validate the method empirically on simulation-based scientific optimization tasks, demonstrating sustained progress on non-convex landscapes where zeroth-order descent is slower and existing guided methods stall as guidance deteriorates.

</details>


### [923] [HypLTSF: A Hyperbolic Geometric View of Multi-Scale Hierarchies for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08286)
*Namwoo Kim,Hyungryul Baik,Yoonjin Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HypLTSF框架，通过将多尺度时间序列的层级表示嵌入庞加莱球（双曲空间），为其赋予显式的几何结构，从而提升长期时间序列预测性能并达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多尺度建模虽能有效捕捉时间序列中的不同时间粒度的模式，但现有方法将尺度间的层级结构视为信息交换的副产品，而未能将其作为几何结构显式建模。作者认为层级结构本身应当被赋予具体的形式以更好地服务于预测任务。

Method: HypLTSF将各尺度的表示嵌入庞加莱球中，利用双曲空间指数增长的体积天然适配层级结构。同时施加两个约束：(1)径向约束——按抽象层次对嵌入排序；(2)角度约束——将共享同一粗尺度祖先的细尺度模式进行分组。

Result: 在多个长期时间序列预测基准上，HypLTSF取得了最先进的性能，表明将多尺度层级显式建模为几何结构对预测是有效的。

Conclusion: 显式地将多尺度时间序列层级建模为几何结构（而非仅仅依赖交互的涌现效应），是提升长期预测性能的有效且可行的方向。

Abstract: Multi-scale modeling has become an effective approach for long-term time series forecasting, capturing temporal patterns that range from fine-grained local dynamics to coarse global trends. Representations across these temporal scales are inherently hierarchical, with coarser scales abstracting and aggregating information from finer ones. While existing approaches readily exchange information across these scales, the hierarchy itself is typically left as an emergent byproduct of such interactions rather than captured as a geometric structure in its own right. In this paper, we introduce HypLTSF, a framework that endows the multi-scale hierarchy with a concrete geometric form by embedding scale-wise representations into the Poincaré ball, whose exponentially expanding volume naturally accommodates hierarchical structures. To align this geometry with the temporal hierarchy, HypLTSF imposes two constraints: (1) a radial constraint that orders embeddings by their level of abstraction, and (2) an angular constraint that groups fine-scale patterns sharing a common coarser-scale ancestor. Extensive experiments on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks show that HypLTSF achieves state-of-the-art performance, suggesting that explicitly modeling the multi-scale hierarchy as a geometric structure is effective for forecasting.

</details>


### [924] [EMBLEM: Enhancing Multi-script Table Detection through Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08330)
*Dhruv Kudale,Udhay Brahmi,Ganesh Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MANDALA数据集和EMBLEM方法，解决多语言多文字文档中的表格检测问题。EMBLEM通过掩码隐藏文字与字体细节，使预训练模型聚焦于与文字无关的版面结构，在MANDALA上取得20.8%的绝对F1提升，同时在英文基准上保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格检测模型在英语和中文文档上表现良好，但面对多语言、多文字系统时性能下降，原因是文字形态多样且缺乏标注数据。需要一种无需大量多语言标注即可泛化的表格检测方案。

Method: 1) 构建MANDALA数据集：包含2323个含表格页面，覆盖18种语言、15种文字系统、多个领域，全部人工标注。2) 提出EMBLEM掩码范式：通过生成掩码图像隐藏文字和字体特定细节，使基于英文文档预训练的模型关注与文字无关的页面布局特征，实现跨文字系统的表格检测。

Result: 在三种表格检测架构上，EMBLEM在MANDALA上始终优于强基线，并在五个英文主导的基准上保持竞争力。仅用英文掩码图像微调（不使用多语言训练数据），EMBLEM在MANDALA上获得20.8%的绝对F1提升。

Conclusion: 掩码策略能有效去除文字多样性带来的干扰，使模型学习更通用的版面表征，是一种低成本、可扩展的多语言表格检测范式。相关数据和代码已开源。

Abstract: Table detection is a core task in document analysis, supporting downstream applications such as information retrieval, document reconstruction, and visual question answering. While existing deep learning models perform well on English and Chinese documents, they struggle with multilingual, multi-script documents due to script diversity and the limited availability of labeled data. To address this challenge, we introduce MANDALA (Multi-script Annotated Documents for Table Detection), a manually curated dataset of 2,323 table-containing pages spanning 18 languages and 15 scripts across diverse domains. We also propose EMBLEM, a masking-based paradigm for Multi-script Table Detection (MTD). EMBLEM generates masked images that conceal script- and font-specific details, enabling models pre-trained on abundant English documents to focus on script-agnostic page layout. Experiments across three table detection architectures show that EMBLEM consistently outperforms strong baselines on MANDALA while remaining competitive on five standard English-dominant benchmarks. Using only English masked images for fine-tuning, with no multi-script training data, EMBLEM achieves an absolute F1-score gain of 20.8% on MANDALA. We release MANDALA along with the accompanying code and models at https://github.com/IITB-LEAP-OCR/EMBLEM.git.

</details>


### [925] [Distillation as Probability Transport: Routed On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08337)
*Tianle Xia,Lingxiang Hu,Yiding Sun,Linfang Shang,Ming Xu,Lan Xu,Ning Zheng,Wei Xu,Jie Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RouteOPD（路由式在线蒸馏）方法，将在线策略蒸馏（OPD）重新定义为教师引导的概率输运问题。通过将教师-学生分歧分解为学生过剩源和教师不足目的地，并构建显式输运对，RouteOPD优化成对log-odds以逼近教师偏好目标。实验在四种教师-学生设置和四个数学推理基准上一致优于采样的反向KL OPD方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽然使用学生生成轨迹来传递教师知识，但高效采样目标仅将教师分布简化为单个token的标量信用（指示某token应增加或减少概率），却未指定相应的概率重新分配方式（即红色istribution去向不明）。这种粒度不足限制了蒸馏效率。

Method: RouteOPD将教师-学生局部分歧分解为学生过剩源（student-excess sources）和教师不足目的地（teacher-deficit destinations），构建显式输运对；优化成对log-odds以逼近从有界教师势函数获得的联合可实现目标；同时根据教师需求集中度自适应调整输运预算，通过单一输运算子同时控制更新方向和幅度。

Result: 在四种教师-学生设置和四个数学推理基准上的实验表明，RouteOPD一致优于采样逆KL OPD方法，改进伴随更高的路由保真度（routing fidelity）和更低的背景泄漏（background leakage）。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，在在线策略蒸馏中显式建模概率输运是有效的，能够更精准地将概率从学生过剩区域转移到教师偏好区域，从而提升蒸馏性能。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher knowledge on student-generated trajectories, but efficient sampled objectives reduce the teacher distribution to scalar credit on individual tokens. Such credit indicates whether a token should gain or lose probability, yet leaves the corresponding redistribution unspecified. We recast OPD as teacher-guided probability transport and propose RouteOPD (Routed On-Policy Distillation), which decomposes local teacher--student disagreement into student-excess sources and teacher-deficit destinations and couples them into explicit transport pairs. RouteOPD optimizes pairwise log-odds toward jointly realizable targets obtained from a bounded teacher potential, while adapting the transport budget to the concentration of teacher demand. This formulation directs updates toward teacher-preferred destinations and controls their magnitude within a single transport operator. Experiments across four teacher--student settings and four mathematical-reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RouteOPD consistently outperforms sampled reverse-KL OPD, with improvements accompanied by higher routing fidelity and lower background leakage. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly modeling probability transport in on-policy distillation.

</details>


### [926] [TV-Regulated OPD: Direction Matters in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08341)
*Han Xiao,Yifan Niu,Dongyi Liu,Chang Luo,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TV-OPD，通过总变差调节优势函数，解决On-Policy蒸馏训练中监督信号高方差、高噪声导致的不稳定问题，在保持性能的同时实现稳定训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流OPD方法的监督信号在训练中具有高方差和高噪声，导致训练不稳定，影响LLM后训练阶段的知识迁移效果。

Method: 系统探究训练不稳定性的根本机制，发现仅保留token级优势的符号即可达到与标准OPD相当的性能，且更平滑、有界的优势能稳定训练。据此利用总变差(TV)塑造优势函数，提出TV-OPD方法。

Result: 在多种设置下，TV-OPD在训练后期始终取得更好的性能和更低的方差。

Conclusion: 有界且衰减的优势函数能带来稳定的训练动态和稳健的后期性能，TV-OPD是更鲁棒的OPD方法。

Abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) facilitates the transfer of knowledge from domain expert to student in the post-training phase of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the supervision signals in mainstream OPD methods suffer from high variance and noise which is generally instable during training. In this work, we systematically investigated what really matters to the performance and the fundamental mechanisms behind the instability during training. We found that retaining only the sign of token-level advantages is sufficient to achieve the performance comparable to standard OPD. Meanwhile, smoother and bounded advantages can stabilize the training process without sacrificing its performance. These motivated us to shape the advantages using the Total Variation (TV) and propose a robust TV regulated On-Policy Distillation (TV-OPD) method. Benefiting from the bounded and diminished advantages, TV-OPD exhibits stable training dynamics and steady late-stage performance. We conducted comprehensive experiments and found that, across various settings, TV-OPD consistently achieved better performance and lower variance in the late-stage of training.

</details>


### [927] [Geometry-Aware Bayesian Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning on the Stiefel Manifold via Stein Variational Gradient Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08354)
*Quang-Duy Tran,Trung Le,Bao Duong,Phuoc Nguyen,Thin Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）的几何感知低秩适配框架，利用奇异值分解将低秩矩阵在Stiefel流形上进行传输，以保留几何结构的同时实现不确定性量化，从而获得更好的模型校准和更高的预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何感知的低秩适配方法通过强制正交约束来提高子空间利用效率和减少冗余，但这些方法可能产生过度自信的预测；同时，传统在欧几里得空间中的不确定性估计方法未能充分利用低秩流形的几何结构。

Method: 基于低秩适配器的SVD分解，构建基于Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）的框架。低秩矩阵沿Stiefel流形传输以匹配目标分布，保留几何结构；该方法在推断时提供多个解，支持不确定性量化。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在Stiefel流形上实现了良好的模型校准，并且相比欧几里得空间中公式化的SVGD及相关不确定性估计方法，获得了更高的预测精度。

Conclusion: 几何感知的SVGD方法能够有效利用低秩流形结构，在提升模型校准能力和预测精度的同时支持不确定性量化，优于欧几里得空间中的现有方法。

Abstract: Several geometry-aware approaches to low-rank adaptation have emerged for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large pre-trained models. These methods aim to take full advantage of the geometric structure of low-rank manifolds for improving the efficiency in subspace utilization and reducing redundancy by enforcing orthogonality constraints during optimization. The strong empirical results of these techniques have motivated further study into whether predictions from such geometry-based adaptation methods could be overconfident. In this paper, we build on the singular value decomposition factorization of adapters to develop a framework based on Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD). In this formulation, the low-rank matrices are transported along the Stiefel manifold to match the targeted distributions while retaining their crucial geometric structure. Since this geometry-aware SVGD approach provides multiple solutions during inference, it supports uncertainty quantification and produces better-calibrated adapters on the Stiefel manifold. Extensive experiments show that our method delivers strong model calibration and attains higher prediction accuracy than SVGD and related uncertainty estimation methods that are formulated in Euclidean space.

</details>


### [928] [Miles v0.1: Production-Level Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08368)
*RadixArk,:,Tom Chen,Mao Cheng,Shi Dong,Kangrui Du,Yanbin Jiang,Jiajun Li,Yiming Li,Tao Lin,Yusheng Su,Andy Ye,Yueming Yuan,Zhichen Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Miles v0.1 是一个面向前沿后训练的全栈、生产级系统。它基于 slime 的简洁设计，围绕"组件应可验证、干净、可定制"的原则构建强化学习训练循环的每个阶段。系统以准确性、效率、可靠性和可扩展性为首要目标，旨在让前沿规模的 RL 对研究者和企业均可访问。系统包含基于 SGLang 的 rollout 引擎、支持 NVIDIA Megatron-LM 和 PyTorch FSDP 两种后端的训练器，以及三种用于不同部署拓扑的权重同步传输方式。除全参数 RL 外，还支持 LoRA RL、on-policy 蒸馏、监督微调和真正的 on-policy rollout-training 对齐，并将相同架构扩展到扩散模型。案例研究展示了在 64 块 NVIDIA GB300 GPU 上对 GLM-5.2 744B-A40B 模型进行完全异步 agentic RL 终端编程任务训练，前 30 步中位步骤时间为 263 秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿规模的后训练（尤其是强化学习）对研究者和企业而言仍然难以企及，现有系统在可验证性、清洁性和可定制性方面存在不足，难以满足生产级部署对准确性、效率、可靠性和可扩展性的综合需求。

Method: Miles 采用模块化全栈架构：使用 SGLang 构建 rollout 引擎；训练器支持 Megatron-LM 和 FSDP 两种后端；提供三种权重同步传输机制适配不同部署拓扑。系统统一支持全参数 RL、LoRA RL、on-policy 蒸馏、SFT 及扩散模型，并实现真正的 on-policy rollout-training 对齐。

Result: 在 64 块 NVIDIA GB300 GPU 上对 GLM-5.2 744B-A40B 模型执行完全异步 agentic RL（终端编程任务），前 30 个测量步骤的中位步骤时间为 263 秒，验证了系统在超大规模模型上的生产级能力。

Conclusion: Miles 展示了以"组件可验证、干净、可定制"为核心原则构建生产级 RL 系统的可行性，为前沿规模后训练提供了开源解决方案，支持多后端、多传输拓扑及多种训练范式，有望推动大规模 RL 的普及化。

Abstract: We present Miles v0.1, a full-stack, production-ready system for frontier post-training. Building upon the clean design of slime, Miles designs each stage of the reinforcement-learning (RL) training loop around a single principle: components should be verified, clean, and customizable. With accuracy, efficiency, reliability, and scalability as first-class goals, Miles aims to make frontier-scale RL accessible to researchers and enterprises alike. This report walks through the system end to end: rollout engines built on SGLang, a trainer with a choice of two backends (NVIDIA Megatron-LM and PyTorch FSDP), and three weight-synchronization transports for different deployment topologies. Beyond full-parameter RL, Miles also supports LoRA RL, on-policy distillation, supervised fine-tuning, and true-on-policy rollout-training alignment, and extends the same architecture to diffusion models. We close with an end-to-end case study: fully asynchronous agentic RL on a GLM-5.2 744B-A40B model over terminal-use coding tasks, running on 64 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs with a median step time of 263 seconds over the first 30 measured steps. Miles is open-sourced at https://github.com/radixark/miles, with the project website at https://miles.radixark.com.

</details>


### [929] [IPM-FM: A Foundation Model with Consensus Feature Selection for Industrial Process Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08375)
*Liang Cao,Weide Liu,Yan Qin,Jun Cheng,Weisi Lin,Bhushan Gopaluni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了工业过程监控基础模型（IPM-FM），通过自监督预训练从无标签工业数据中学习通用表示，再以少量任务标签数据进行适配，最终通过不确定性感知预测头输出校准的预测结果。在七年柴油闪点软测量数据集上，IPM-FM取得了RMSE 2.99、R² 0.50、95%预测区间覆盖率97%的成绩，相比最强的经典基线和从零训练的序列基线，RMSE分别提升8.3%和14.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前工业过程监控采用"一任务一模型"范式，存在标签效率低、运行漂移下性能易退化的问题。虽然基础模型已重塑语言、视觉和通用时间序列预测领域，但尚未适配到工业过程监控。该领域面临安全关键决策、过程变量与实验室测量之间非对称采样等独特挑战，亟需统一预训练-适配框架。

Method: IPM-FM包含四个核心组件：(1) 自监督Informer骨干网络，从无标签数据学习通用表示；(2) 多准则共识特征选择器；(3) 递归滞后特征回归头；(4) 校准的蒙特卡洛Dropout不确定性模块。整体框架先进行自监督预训练，再通过少量带标签数据适配到具体监控任务。

Result: 在七年水处理（hydrotreater）柴油闪点软测量数据集上，IPM-FM的RMSE为2.99，R²为0.50，95%预测区间覆盖率达到97%。相比最强经典基线和从零训练的序列基线，RMSE分别改善了8.3%和14.6%。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了统一预训练-适配框架在工业过程监控领域的可行性，表明基础模型范式可以有效迁移到该领域，为解决标签效率低下和运行漂移问题提供了新思路。

Abstract: Industrial process monitoring is fundamental to the safety and economic performance of modern process plants. Current practice remains a one-task-one-model paradigm that is label-inefficient and prone to degradation under operating drift. Foundation models have reshaped language, vision, and generic time-series forecasting, but it has not been adapted to industrial process monitoring. This setting poses domain-specific challenges, including safety-critical decisions and asymmetric sampling between process variables and laboratory measurements. We propose the industrial process monitoring foundation model (IPM-FM). It first learns general-purpose representations from unlabeled industrial process data through self-supervised pretraining, then adapts to specific monitoring tasks using a small amount of task-labeled data, and finally produces calibrated predictions through an uncertainty-aware prediction head. IPM-FM integrates a self-supervised Informer backbone with a multi-criteria consensus feature selector, a recursive lag-feature regression head, and a calibrated Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty module. On a seven-year hydrotreater dataset for diesel flash-point soft sensing, IPM-FM attains an RMSE of 2.99, $R^2$ of 0.50, and 97\% coverage of its 95\% predictive interval, outperforming the strongest classical and from-scratch sequence baselines by 8.3\% and 14.6\% in RMSE respectively, supporting the viability of a unified pretraining--adaptation framework for industrial process monitoring.

</details>


### [930] [Geographically Regularized AUC-Maximizing Personalized Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08379)
*Mayu Hiraishi,Kensuke Tanioka,Toshio Shimokawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GrAUC-PFL方法，一种地理正则化的AUC最大化个性化联邦学习方法，用于在保护患者数据隐私的前提下，跨医疗机构直接优化AUC指标来构建诊断和风险预测模型，同时通过图正则化处理机构间的地理异质性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传染病暴发期间需要准确的诊断和风险预测模型支持临床决策，但存在三大挑战：患者级数据因隐私和治理要求无法跨机构共享、不同机构间数据分布存在异质性、AUC作为广泛使用的判别性能指标需要直接优化。现有方法未能同时解决这些问题。

Method: GrAUC-PFL方法直接优化一个平滑的成对AUC代理损失函数来学习个性化模型，保持患者级数据本地化。通过图结构正则化项促使地理上邻近的医疗机构拥有相似的系数向量，同时保留每个机构的个性化模型，从而在隐私保护下兼顾机构异质性和地理相似性。

Result: 模拟研究和实际数据应用表明，该方法能提升判别性能，尤其在地理邻近机构具有相似数据生成特征时效果更佳。

Conclusion: GrAUC-PFL在保护数据隐私的同时实现了AUC的端到端优化，并通过地理正则化有效利用了机构间的空间相关性，为跨机构传染病诊断和风险预测提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Accurate diagnostic and risk-prediction models are important for supporting clinical decision-making during infectious disease outbreaks. However, privacy and governance requirements may restrict patient-level data sharing across healthcare institutions, and data distributions often vary. Moreover, AUC is widely used to evaluate discriminative performance, motivating its direct optimization in model development. We propose geographically regularized AUC-maximizing personalized federated learning (GrAUC-PFL), which directly optimizes a smooth pairwise AUC surrogate to learn personalized models while keeping patient-level data local and accounting for institutional heterogeneity. Graph-based regularization encourages geographically neighboring institutions to have similar coefficient vectors while retaining a personalized models. Simulations and a real-data application suggest improved discriminative performance, particularly when geographically neighboring institutions have similar data-generating characteristics.

</details>


### [931] [Equivariance Breaks the Learning Rate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08381)
*Andrei Manolache,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现Muon等矩阵结构优化器在等变网络上优于Adam的原因之一：等变线性层中每个不可约表示(irrep)块共享一个通道混合矩阵，梯度在该块上被求和并具有秩受限结构，而Adam对权重做逐元素缩放、忽视irrep块的边界，导致同一层内不同块的学习率谱步长不一致。作者提出无需新超参数的块归一化方法，使Adam在块层面进行独立的更新缩放，与动量调优结合后使Adam在rMD17和MD22数据集上达到与Muon相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon等矩阵结构优化器在等变网络上表现优于常用的Adam，但缺乏理论解释；作者希望揭示这一差异的根本原因，并找到能让Adam追赶Muon的机制性改进。

Method: 识别等变线性层中irrep块结构导致的梯度秩受限与求和特性，提出对每个irrep块的更新单独做归一化（不引入新超参数），仅改变更新尺度而保留Adam的动量估计和块内方向；结合对Adam动量系数的调优进行实验验证。

Result: 受控SO(3)等变玩具模型中，块归一化孤立出的失配随宽度增长而增大，而稠密对照组无此增长；在e3nn原子间势模型上，块归一化和调优动量系数各自独立提升性能但均不及Muon，二者结合后Adam在所有数据集上与Muon持平。

Conclusion: 块级步长控制和动量累积在很大程度上解释了Muon相比Adam的优势；通过块归一化与动量调优，Adam可以达到与Muon相当的性能，揭示了优化器与网络结构（irrep块结构）匹配的重要性。

Abstract: Equivariant networks are commonly trained with Adam, yet recent work reports that matrix-structured optimizers such as Muon can perform better on these architectures without explaining why. We identify one source of this difference inside equivariant linear layers. Each irrep block learns a channel-mixing matrix $W_l$ shared across its $2l+1$ components, giving the expanded map $W_l \otimes I_{2l+1}$. For a single application of the layer, the gradient of $W_l$ sums $2l+1$ outer product contributions and has rank at most $2l+1$. Adam rescales stored weights individually without using the irrep boundaries, so one learning rate can produce different spectral step sizes across blocks within a layer. We address this mismatch by normalizing each block update separately, without introducing a new hyperparameter. This changes only the scale of the update, leaving Adam's moment estimates and its direction within each block unchanged. We evaluate the mechanism in a controlled $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-equivariant model with a matched dense control and in an e3nn interatomic potential model trained on rMD17 and MD22. The toy setup isolates a mismatch that grows with width while the dense control shows no corresponding growth. In the interatomic potential model, block normalization and tuning Adam's momentum coefficients independently improve performance, but neither alone matches Muon. Combined, they make Adam competitive with Muon on all datasets, indicating that blockwise step control and momentum accumulation account for much of Muon's advantage.

</details>


### [932] [MLIP Detective: Active Failure Mode Discovery Beyond Benchmark Scores for Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08399)
*Ryuhei Okuno,Nontawat Charoenphakdee,Kaoru Hisama,Yuta Tsuboi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了MLIP Detective，一个基于物理知识的智能体框架，用于主动发现通用机器学习原子间势（u-MLIPs）的隐藏失败模式。该框架从基准证据出发，生成可证伪的物理失败假设，通过低成本模拟筛选，最终将最可疑案例升级给人类专家。作者通过该框架在MACE-MPA-0模型中发现了系统性异常：涉及含O或F吸附质的松弛吸附物-表面体系能量高于其分离碎片，并通过跨模型对比推断该异常源于训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器学习原子间势旨在泛化到各种构型，但传统基准测试可能无法暴露其预定义范围之外的失败情况，需要一种能主动发现隐藏失败模式的方法来补充基准评估。

Method: 提出MLIP Detective智能体框架，采用主动失败模式发现策略：(1)从基准证据出发生成可证伪的、基于物理知识的失败假设；(2)通过低成本模拟进行筛选；(3)仅将最可疑案例升级给人类专家并附上验证方案。

Result: 在无问题特定提示的情况下，MLIP Detective识别并刻画了MACE-MPA-0中的系统性异常：含O或F吸附质的松弛吸附物-表面体系能量高于对应分离碎片。通过跨模型比较，进一步推断该异常可能源于训练数据，与近期报告一致。

Conclusion: 物理知识驱动的搜索方法能有效补充基准测试，主动发现u-MLIPs的隐藏失败模式，为模型评估提供了一种新的自动化、可复现的补充范式。

Abstract: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (u-MLIPs) aim to generalize across diverse configurations. Benchmarks enable reproducible evaluation but may not expose failures outside their predefined scope. Here, we show that physics-informed search can complement benchmark-based evaluation by uncovering hidden failure modes. We introduce MLIP Detective, an agentic framework for active failure mode discovery. Starting from benchmark evidence, MLIP Detective generates falsifiable, physics-informed failure hypotheses, screens them with inexpensive simulations, and escalates only the most suspicious cases to human experts together with proposed verification protocols. Without issue-specific prompting, MLIP Detective identified and characterized a systematic anomaly in MACE-MPA-0: the model predicted some relaxed adsorbate-surface systems involving O- or F-containing adsorbates to be higher in energy than their corresponding separated fragments. Using cross-model comparisons, MLIP Detective further inferred a likely training-data origin for the anomaly, consistent with recent reports.

</details>


### [933] [Environments as Scaffold: Enriching Feedback to Bootstrap Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08404)
*Hongbang Yuan,Zhuoran Jin,Yixin Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"环境侧适应"（FEEs）范式替代传统的"智能体侧预热"策略，通过重构环境（从动作引导转向观察丰富化）来解决大语言模型在长时序任务中强化学习面临的奖励稀疏问题。实验于SciWorld和BFCL基准上验证了该方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在静态推理上表现出色，但通过强化学习训练为长时序自主智能体时面临严重的奖励稀疏问题。传统的智能体侧预热（通过SFT）虽有帮助，却常受限于数据稀缺和探索受限。

Method: 提出构建反馈丰富环境（FEEs）的范式，通过试点研究建立反馈设计策略：在训练后期（包括情节内探索与情节间演化阶段）将环境从"动作引导"转变为"观察丰富化"。

Result: 在SciWorld和BFCL基准上，使用多种Qwen3模型规模和GRPO、GSPO、DAPO等RL算法进行大规模实验，FEEs相较标准设置一致地带来性能提升。分析还发现：训练稳定（熵波动降低）、促进困难任务中主动状态空间探索、环境指导被内化为策略权重（而非仅推理期先验）、组内反馈一致性是稳定优化的关键边界。

Conclusion: FEEs提供了一种从环境侧解决RL训练奖励稀疏问题的有效途径，为长时序自主智能体训练提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large Language Models demonstrate remarkable proficiency in static reasoning, yet training them as autonomous agents through Reinforcement Learning (RL) for long-horizon tasks is often hindered by severe reward sparsity. While conventional \textit{agent-side warming} up via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can alleviate this, it is frequently limited by data scarcity and constrained exploration. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift to \textit{environment-side adaptation} by constructing \textbf{F}eedback-\textbf{E}nriched \textbf{E}nvironments (\textbf{FEEs}). Through a pilot study, we establish a feedback design strategy that reformulates environments by transitioning from action guidance to observation enrichment during the later stages of both intra-episode exploration and inter-episode evolution. Large-scale experiments on SciWorld and BFCL benchmarks using various Qwen3 model scales and RL algorithms such as GRPO, GSPO, and DAPO demonstrate that FEEs consistently yield performance improvements over standard settings. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that training with FEEs \textbf{(1)} stabilizes training dynamics by reducing entropy volatility, \textbf{(2)} facilitates proactive state-space exploration in difficult tasks, \textbf{(3) }ensures the internalization of environmental guidance into policy weights rather than acting as a mere inference-time prior, and \textbf{(4) }identifies intra-group feedback consistency as a critical boundary for stable optimization.

</details>


### [934] [Stochastically Perturbed Weights: Ensembles from Deterministic Machine-Learning Weather Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08412)
*Simon Adamov,Oliver Fuhrer,Reto Knutti,Sebastian Schemm*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"随机扰动权重"(SPW)的方法，无需重新训练即可从已存在的确定性机器学习气象模型(MLWM)中提取不确定性信息。该方法通过在推理时随机扰动网络的原始权重张量来生成集合预测，类似于物理集合中随机扰动参数化趋势的做法。在四个确定性骨干模型(Aurora、GraphCast、SFNO、AIFS)上进行三阶段消融实验，并与多个训练概率模型及ECMWF业务集合进行基准比较。在240小时(10天)预报时效下，SPW集合的CRPSS仅比最佳训练概率基线低0.04-0.13，且零边际训练成本。研究发现没有通用的噪声注入位置，最佳张量组因架构而异，主要失效模式是产生全场的相干偏移导致域均值过度离散。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习气象模型在中尺度全球预报上已匹配或超越业务数值天气预报，但许多已部署的MLWM是确定性的，无法提供自身的不确定性估计。虽然训练概率模型能生成校准集合，但需要专门的训练过程。作者希望探索能否从已存在的确定性检查点中提取不确定性，而无需重新训练，从而节省大量计算资源。

Method: 提出随机扰动权重(SPW)方法：在推理时随机扰动网络权重张量以模拟模型不确定性，类比物理集合模型中随机扰动参数化趋势的做法。通过三阶段消融实验在四个确定性骨干模型上选择生产基线，并在112个初始化时间上与AIFS-ENS、FourCastNet 3、Atlas及ECMWF业务集合(IFS-ENS)进行基准测试。

Result: 在240小时(10天)预报时效下，SPW集合的连续排序概率技能分数(CRPSS)比最佳训练概率基线低0.04-0.13，但实现了零边际训练成本。噪声注入的最优位置因模型架构而异，不存在跨模型通用的注入位置。主要失效模式为相干的全场偏移导致域均值过度离散，限制噪声到粗尺度或扰动初始条件可部分修复此问题。

Conclusion: SPW作为一种无需retraining即可从确定性模型提取不确定性的有效方法，能接近训练概率基线的性能。但目前它是调参程序而非即插即用的通用方案，因为有效扰动位置随架构变化。该研究为从现有确定性预测模型中获取不确定性估计提供了新的思路和实证基础。

Abstract: Machine-learning weather models (MLWMs) now match or outperform operational numerical weather prediction (NWP) at global medium-range forecasting, at far lower inference cost. Many deployed MLWMs are deterministic, producing a single forecast with no estimate of its own uncertainty, whereas a growing family of trained-probabilistic models generate calibrated ensembles directly, at the price of a dedicated training run. We ask instead how much uncertainty can be extracted from a deterministic checkpoint that already exists, without retraining it. Where physical ensembles represent model uncertainty by stochastically perturbing parametrisation tendencies, we perturb the network's raw weight tensors at inference time, a scheme we call stochastically perturbed weights (SPW). We also ask whether it works, where and on which scales to inject the noise, and where it fails. A three-phase ablation across four deterministic backbones, Aurora, GraphCast, SFNO, and AIFS, selects one production baseline per model, benchmarked against the trained-probabilistic AIFS-ENS, FourCastNet 3 and Atlas as well as the operational ECMWF ensemble (IFS-ENS) over 112 initialisation times. At a 240 h (10-day) lead time the SPW ensembles reach continuous ranked probability skill scores (CRPSS) between 0.04 and 0.13 below the best trained-probabilistic baseline, at zero marginal training cost. No injection site works across models: the productive tensor group is architecture-specific, so SPW is at present a tuning procedure rather than a plug-and-play recipe. Its main failure mode is a coherent whole-field offset that overdisperses the domain mean, and restricting the noise to coarse scales or perturbing the initial conditions each repair part of it.

</details>


### [935] [Topological Fraud Detection in Latent Transaction Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08445)
*Avraham Bourla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于拓扑匿名化嵌入的欺诈检测方法，通过迭代的无监督过滤与有监督狙击相结合，实现超低延迟的隐私保护分类，使金融机构能够在不泄露个人身份信息的情况下标记可疑活动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统欺诈检测通常需要访问包含个人身份信息的原始数据，这带来了隐私泄露风险。作者希望在不牺牲隐私的前提下实现高效、低延迟的欺诈检测分诊。

Method: 该方法完全在拓扑匿名化的嵌入空间上运行，采用迭代流程：每轮先进行无监督过滤（初步筛选可疑样本），随后进行有监督的狙击（精确识别真正的欺诈行为）。通过多轮迭代逐步收敛目标。

Result: 实现了超低延迟的隐私保护分诊，能够在保护个人信息的前提下有效标记可疑活动。

Conclusion: 通过将欺诈检测完全构建在匿名化嵌入上，并采用无监督与有监督相结合的迭代策略，可以在隐私保护和检测效率之间取得良好平衡，适用于金融欺诈检测场景。

Abstract: Working entirely on topologically anonymized embeddings, we perform fraud detection using iterative rounds of unsupervised filtering followed by supervised sniping. The result is an ultra-low latency privacy--preserving triage that allows institutions to flag suspicious activity without compromising Personally Identifiable Information.

</details>


### [936] [Not All Variables Agree: Reliability-Aware Variable-Wise Gradient Surgery for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08554)
*Jinwoo Park,Hyeongwon Kang,Pilsung Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PV-Surgery（逐变量手术）优化器端训练策略，解决多变量时间序列预测中均值损失掩盖变量间梯度冲突的问题。通过测量发现30.6%的变量间梯度余弦相似度为负，且64个变量中35个在共享训练下表现劣于单目标基准。PV-Surgery利用一次反向传播构建变量级梯度代理，结合可靠性感知层选择、条件池化和公共方向手术对齐梯度，在五个骨干网络、七个数据集、四个预测跨度上平均降低MSE 3.61%和MAE 2.93%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的均值损失训练只暴露聚合梯度，无法揭示变量间贡献是否一致或相互对抗。作者通过直接测量发现大量变量间梯度冲突（30.6%余弦相似度为负），且梯度冲突与性能损害并非简单对应关系（64个变量中35个比单目标基准更差，但受损比例无法可靠由冲突频率预测），表明变量结构信息被均值训练掩盖，需要新的优化策略。

Method: PV-Surgery包含三个关键组件：1）可靠性感知层选择——通过一次反向传播从输出侧信号构建变量级梯度代理，仅选择代理和接近共享梯度切片的层；2）条件池化——形成锚定池和冲突池而不丢弃变量；3）公共方向手术——将变量或池化梯度与归一化均值对齐，并恢复输入范数以避免重新加权。

Result: 在五个骨干网络、七个数据集和四个预测跨度上的实验中，PV-Surgery平均降低MSE 3.61%和MAE 2.93%，验证了被均值损失训练隐藏的变量结构可以作为有效的优化信号。

Conclusion: 多变量时间序列预测中，均值损失掩盖的变量级结构是一个可用的优化信号。梯度冲突与性能损害不等同，PV-Surgery通过优化器端的逐变量梯度对齐策略有效利用了这种隐藏结构，为多变量预测训练提供了新思路。

Abstract: In data-driven training, multivariate time-series forecasting is usually optimized with a scalar loss averaged over samples, variables, and horizons. This averaging is convenient, but the optimizer sees only the aggregated gradient, which does not reveal whether the variable-wise contributions align or oppose one another. To quantify how often this disagreement arises, we measure the variable-wise gradients directly and find that 30.6% of their pairwise cosine similarities are negative on average across seven datasets. However, conflict and harm are not the same thing. Under shared training 35 of the 64 variables do worse than a full-input single-target oracle, and the harmed fraction is not reliably predicted by how often gradients conflict. We propose Per-Variable Surgery (PV-Surgery), an optimizer-side training strategy for backbones with cache-compatible layers. One backward pass builds variable-wise gradient proxies from output-side signals and keeps the pointwise forecasting loss. Reliability-aware selection targets layers whose proxy sums closely approximate their shared-gradient slices. Conditional pooling forms anchor and conflict pools without dropping variables. Common-direction surgery aligns variable or pooled gradients with their normalized mean and restores input norms to avoid reweighting. In experiments across five backbones, seven datasets, and four horizons, PV-Surgery lowers MSE by 3.61% and MAE by 2.93% on average. For multivariate forecasting, this indicates that the variable-wise structure hidden by mean-loss training is a usable optimization signal.

</details>


### [937] [Certified Topological Interaction in Neural Representations: Class Disentanglement Is Mostly Pairwise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08561)
*Sushovan Majhi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将类别解缠（表征的类条件点云随深度和训练的分离）形式化度量为一个经过认证的拓扑交互量，采用交Euler特征轮廓（Intersetion Euler Characteristic Profile）。基于超过111个训练网络和52,650个认证测量，论文发现解缠按深度分级且在最初几个epoch集中，并提出配对检验需使用无尺度统计量等结构性洞见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类别解缠通常只能通过描述性曲线来观测，缺乏严格、可检验、可比较的数学度量，难以支撑具体的统计声明。

Method: 利用新引入的交Euler特征轮廓（IECP）度量标记点云之间的拓扑交互——即两云球并集重叠部分的Euler特征作为尺度的函数，通过单次Alpha-complex扫描计算，无需边界矩阵化简。每个数值附有权重检：精确置换检验、守护分离认证及配对检验。

Result: 解缠随深度分级且集中于初期epoch；交互商数排序类对可混淆性（Spearman rho=0.83）。在96模型因子设计中，数据增广是唯一相对随机机会分离类的训练选择；权重衰减压缩重叠但不分离；深度和宽度无效果。结构发现：类别三元组的联合纠缠在97%的三元组层细胞和99.5%的深层细胞中低于其最强对的纠缠，远低于实测零值下限。未标准化轮廓质量预测测试准确率（R²=0.94），商数不能；配对检验必须使用无尺度统计量，否则会将特征范数动力学误判为解缠。

Conclusion: 拓扑交互度量（IECP）为解缠提供了具备统计认证性质的定量框架；其结构与训练动力学揭示出解缠的深度分级特性与深层结构性规律（pairwise dominance），且证明了度量选择（有尺度 vs 无尺度）对结论有效性至关重要。

Abstract: Class disentanglement (the separation of a representation's class-conditional point clouds along depth and over training) is usually read off descriptive curves. We measure it as certified topological interaction between labeled point clouds, using the recently introduced Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile: the Euler characteristic of the overlap of the clouds' ball unions as a function of scale, computed by one Alpha-complex sweep with no boundary-matrix reduction. Every number carries a test: exact permutation tests in both directions, a guarded separation certificate, and a paired test for the comparative claims applications make. Across 111 trained networks and 52,650 certified measurements, disentanglement is depth-graded and concentrated in the first epochs, and interaction quotients rank class pairs by confusability (Spearman rho=0.83), on par with cheap separability statistics. In a 96-model factorial population, augmentation is the one training choice that separates classes relative to chance; weight decay compresses the overlap without separating, and depth and width do nothing. The structural finding is one only a k-fold statistic can pose: the joint entanglement of a class triple sits below that of its strongest pair in 97% of triple-layer cells and 99.5% of deep cells, far below a measured null floor, in vision encoders and frozen language models alike. This pairwise dominance is a regularity, not a law: expected from the nesting of overlaps but not forced by geometry, present at initialization and in raw pixels, and manufactured in the last stage alone when a network memorizes random labels. The unnormalized profile mass predicts test accuracy (R^2=0.94), the quotient does not, and neither beats a linear probe. One lesson is reported in full: the paired test must use a scale-free statistic, or it certifies feature-norm dynamics as disentanglement.

</details>


### [938] [AlphaRJM: Reward-Jump Memory for Stochastic Return-Guided Alpha Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08581)
*Sayan Dhan,Selvaraju Natarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AlphaRJM框架，通过Reward-Jump Memory（事件驱动的潜在状态，仅在终端评估时更新）和基于动作条件的SDE回报评论员（用随机粒子表示未来折现发现回报）来解决公式化alpha发现中延迟反馈带来的两大难题（保留池不保留完整评估历史、中间动作价值不确定）。粒子通过均值与不确定性指导动作选择，利用结合能量距离匹配、均值校准和跳跃正则化的分布式贝尔曼目标进行学习。实验表明该方法在多个股票域、预测周期和随机种子下取得稳定收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公式化alpha发现本质上是池依赖的符号搜索问题，其关键挑战在于只有当完整表达式被评估时才能获得信息丰富的反馈，这种延迟反馈造成了两个耦合困难：一是保留的alpha池未能保存全部已实现评估反馈的历史，二是中间构建动作的价值具有不确定性，因为它取决于最终完成的公式。现有方法难以有效处理这种结构化延迟反馈。

Method: 提出AlphaRJM框架，包含两大核心组件：(1) Reward-Jump Memory——一种事件驱动的潜在状态，在token构建过程中保持不变，仅在终端评估事件发生时利用已实现的池奖励和评估结果进行更新；(2) 动作条件的随机微分方程（SDE）返回评论员——以随机粒子形式表示未来折现发现回报。粒子通过其均值和不确定性指导动作选择，并采用结合能量距离匹配、均值校准与跳跃正则化的分布式Bellman目标进行学习。

Result: AlphaRJM在多个股票域、预测周期和随机种子条件下取得了强且稳定的性能提升；消融实验证实了持久评估历史、随机回报建模和分布式监督三个组件的互补作用。

Conclusion: 通过持久化评估历史、随机回报建模与分布式监督的有机结合，AlphaRJM有效解决了公式化alpha发现中延迟反馈带来的搜索困难，为符号搜索问题提供了一种新的强健解法。

Abstract: Formulaic alpha discovery is a pool-dependent symbolic search problem in which informative feedback is observed primarily when a complete expression is evaluated. This delayed feedback creates two coupled difficulties: the retained alpha pool does not preserve the full history of realized evaluation feedback, and the value of an intermediate construction action is uncertain because its consequence depends on the formula eventually completed. We introduce AlphaRJM, which addresses these difficulties through Reward-Jump Memory, an event-driven latent state that remains fixed during token construction and updates only at terminal evaluation events using the realized pool reward and evaluation outcome, and an action-conditioned SDE return critic that represents future discounted discovery returns with stochastic particles. The particles guide action selection through their mean and uncertainty and are learned using a distributional Bellman objective combining energy-distance matching, mean calibration, and jump regularization. Empirically, AlphaRJM delivers strong and stable gains across multiple equity universes, forecasting horizons, and random seeds, while ablations confirm the complementary roles of persistent evaluation history, stochastic return modeling, and distributional supervision.

</details>


### [939] [Difficulty-Adaptive Tree-Structured Policy Optimization for Expanding Reasoning Coverage in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08650)
*Youngjun Yu,Sanghwan Jang,Hwanjo Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DATPO方法，通过优化训练时rollout的结构设计（难度自适应、树状搜索、句子熵引导分叉）来提升推理模型的pass@k覆盖率，而非仅仅关注单样本准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR在提升单样本准确率方面效果显著，但由于训练期间探索有限，往往无法扩展模型的固有推理覆盖率（pass@k），这一问题限制了模型在测试时的扩展能力。作者希望通过优化训练rollout的结构设计来直接提升pass@k。

Method: 通过分析识别三个关键设计原则：(1)难度自适应rollout不仅作为效率启发式，更在扩展pass@k中起关键作用；(2)树状rollout优于并行采样；(3)句子熵引导分叉克服了token级分支的局部化现象，最大化语义多样性。基于这些原则提出DATPO，集成了难度自适应树搜索与兄弟多样性优势项（sibling-diversity advantage term），显式促进语义多样性。

Result: 在数学推理基准上，DATPO在pass@k指标上优于基线方法，这种优势直接转化为更优的测试时扩展（test-time scaling）性能。

Conclusion: 通过结构化设计训练rollout（而非增加计算量），可以显著扩展模型的推理覆盖率，从而提升测试时扩展效果，为RLVR的训练策略优化提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been central to the recent success of Large Reasoning Models. However, while RLVR significantly improves single-sample accuracy, it often fails to expand the model's intrinsic reasoning coverage (pass@k) due to limited exploration during training. To address this, we optimize the structural design of train-time rollouts to enhance pass@k. Our analysis identifies three key design principles: (1) difficulty-adaptive rollout can play an important role in expanding pass@k, beyond serving as an efficiency heuristic; (2) tree-based rollout outperforms parallel sampling in discovering correct answers; and (3) sentence-entropy-guided forking overcomes the localization phenomenon of token-level branching to maximize semantic diversity. Building on these insights, we propose DATPO (Difficulty-Adaptive Sentence-entropy-guided Tree-structured Policy Optimization). DATPO integrates difficulty-adaptive tree search with a sibling-diversity advantage term, explicitly promoting semantic diversity to expand reasoning coverage during training. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DATPO outperforms baselines especially in pass@k, which directly translates to superior test-time scaling performance.

</details>


### [940] [Leveraging Cardiac Imaging to Improve ECG-Based Detection of Chagas Disease in Resource-Constrained Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08582)
*Laura Alvarez-Florez,Daniel Uyterlinde,Samuel Ruipérez-Campillo,Lukas P. A. Arts,Folkert W. Asselbergs,Fleur V. Y. Tjong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出通过对比预训练将心脏磁共振（CMR）成像结构知识迁移到心电图（ECG）表征中，以提升查加斯病的检测能力。使用UK Biobank中63,193对ECG-CMR数据，通过非对称InfoNCE目标函数对齐ECG编码器与临床基础的CMR嵌入空间。尽管预训练阶段未见查加斯病例，该方法仍提高了ECG查加斯检测性能，在CODE-15%和SaMi-Trop数据集上优于未对齐的ECG基础模型基线，并在PhysioNet/CinC 2025挑战赛中获得最佳AUROC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 查加斯病是拉丁美洲心肌病的主要原因，CMR能表征其结构异常，但扫描仪和专家阅片者在流行地区稀缺。ECG便宜且广泛可用，但结构性疾病需从电信号中间接推断。作者希望将CMR的结构知识转移到ECG上，从而在资源匮乏地区实现更有效的ECG-based疾病检测。

Method: 使用63,193对ECG-CMR检查（来自UK Biobank），通过非对称InfoNCE目标函数将ECG编码器与临床grounded的CMR嵌入空间进行对齐。这是一种对比预训练策略，使ECG表征学习到与CMR结构相关的语义信息。预训练过程中未包含任何查加斯病病例。

Result: 在CODE-15%和SaMi-Trop数据集上，冻结线性探针的AUROC达0.851，Top5%-TPR为0.427，优于未对齐ECG基础模型基线的0.827和0.377。在PhysioNet/CinC 2025挑战赛测试集上，模型在SaMi-Trop-3获得最高AUROC，并在ELSA-Brasil挑战得分上位列前三最佳方法之首。

Conclusion: 成像监督的ECG表征能够泛化到超出预训练分布的群体和场景，表明通过CMR知识转移提升ECG在资源匮乏地区诊断价值是可行且有效的策略。

Abstract: Chagas disease is a major cause of cardiomyopathy in Latin America. Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging can characterize its structural abnormalities, but scanners and expert readers remain scarce in endemic regions. Electrocardiography (ECG) is inexpensive and widely available, yet structural disease must be inferred indirectly from electrical signals. We propose to transfer CMR-derived structural knowledge to ECG through contrastive pre-training. Using 63,193 paired ECG-CMR examinations from the UK Biobank, we align an ECG encoder with a clinically grounded CMR embedding space using an asymmetric InfoNCE objective. Despite seeing no Chagas cases during pre-training, the resulting representation improves ECG-based Chagas detection. Across CODE-15% and SaMi-Trop, a frozen linear probe achieves an AUROC of 0.851 and sensitivity at the top 5% of predicted risk (Top5%-TPR) of 0.427 in five-fold cross-validation, compared with 0.827 and 0.377 for an unaligned ECG-FM baseline. On the PhysioNet/CinC 2025 Challenge test set, our model obtains the highest AUROC on SaMi-Trop-3 and the best ELSA-Brasil challenge score among the three top-performing methods, indicating that imaging-supervised ECG representations can generalize to populations and settings beyond the pre-training distribution.

</details>


### [941] [Hyperparameter Scaling Laws Across MoE Sparsity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08690)
*Changxin Tian,Kunlong Chen,Jia Liu,Ziqi Liu,Zhiqiang Zhang,Jun Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过1800次预训练实验（覆盖6种激活参数规模和高达60亿总参数、约20万亿token训练），揭示了超稀疏Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型中超参数缩放规律不足的问题，提出了统一的超参数缩放定律。研究发现：固定稀疏度下，最优batch size与训练token数D呈幂律关系，最优学习率与总计算量C相关；在不同稀疏度下，激活比率A作为额外的幂律乘数进入两关系。该定律可跨MoE稀疏度转移，并在12B总参数、仅激活1/64专家的超稀疏MoE上验证了预测准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型扩展了模型容量但训练计算并不成比例增加，然而增加稀疏度使得可靠超参数迁移变得困难。现有超参数缩放定律无法充分描述超稀疏MoE中最佳学习率和batch size如何随激活比率变化，这些偏移无法仅用总参数量或激活参数量解释，且先前的相关工作结论存在矛盾。

Method: 作者进行了大规模实证研究：执行1800次预训练运行，覆盖六个激活参数规模级别，模型总非嵌入参数高达60亿，处理约20万亿token，耗时约20万等效H800 GPU小时。通过系统性扫描揭示两个缩放区域：固定稀疏度时最优batch size与训练token D成正比幂律关系，最优学习率与训练计算量C相关联；跨稀疏度时激活比率A作为额外的乘法幂律因子加入两种关系，从而形成统一的超参数缩放定律。

Result: 发现传统的超参数缩放定律无法解释超稀疏MoE中学习率和batch size随激活比率的变化。提出的统一缩放定律在大规模评估中优于其他函数形式；在12B总参数、仅激活1/64专家的held-out超稀疏MoE上，预测超参数接近实际最优值，支持跨模型规模和稀疏度的联合外推。实验还验证了跨专家粒度的迁移能力，并区分了激活比率与总专家数的独立影响。

Conclusion: 本文调和了先前研究中矛盾的发现，通过揭示两个缩放机制并引入激活比率作为统一的幂律因子，建立了可跨MoE稀疏度转移的超参数缩放定律，为超稀疏MoE的超参数预测提供了可靠的理论基础，同时支持联合外推到更大的模型规模和更高稀疏度。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models expand model capacity without a proportional increase in training compute, but increasing sparsity makes reliable hyperparameter transfer challenging. In this work, we show that conventional hyperparameter scaling laws are insufficient for ultra-sparse MoEs: the optimal learning rate and batch size vary with activation ratio, and these shifts cannot be explained by either total or activated parameter count alone. To characterize this dependence, we conduct 1,800 pre-training runs spanning six activated-parameter scales and models with up to 6B total non-embedding parameters, processing approximately 20 trillion tokens at a cost of 200,000 equivalent H800 GPU-hours. Our results reconcile conflicting findings in prior work by revealing two scaling regimes. At fixed sparsity, the optimal batch size follows a power-law relationship with training tokens $D$, whereas the optimal learning rate scales with training compute $C$ and remains robust to the allocation between model size and data. Across sparsity levels, the activation ratio $A$ enters both relationships as an additional multiplicative power-law factor. These observations lead to unified hyperparameter scaling laws that transfer across MoE sparsity levels. Large-scale evaluation shows that the scaling form outperforms alternative functional forms. On a held-out ultra-sparse MoE with 12B total parameters and only 1/64 of its experts activated, the predicted hyperparameters remain close to the observed optima, supporting joint extrapolation across model scale and sparsity. Further experiments demonstrate transfer across expert granularities and isolate the effect of activation ratio from that of total expert count.

</details>


### [942] [Multi-Level-Set-Based Physics-Driven Neural Network to Solve 3-D Inverse Scattering Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08594)
*Yutong Du,Zicheng Liu,Bo Qi,Yali Zong,Peixian Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于水平集的物理驱动神经网络求解器（LSPDNN），用于三维电磁逆散射问题。该方法通过多个坐标相关的神经水平集分量来表示未知目标，解决体素级对比度重建中的边界模糊和重建伪影问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的体素级对比度重建方法在三维电磁逆散射中容易出现边界模糊和重建伪影。由于实际散射体通常具有分段均匀特性，需要一种能更好利用这种先验信息的方法来提升重建质量。

Method: 1) 提出软联合多材料模型，分别描述目标支撑和材料分布；2) 全局支撑由多个水平集分量联合形成，局部对比度由归一化分量权重和可学习的复数介电常数候选决定；3) 对材料区域指示器施加模型一致的TV正则化，而非直接作用在重建对比度上；4) 引入自适应损失平衡策略，减少对人工选择正则化权重的依赖。

Result: 数值和实验结果表明，LSPDNN能够重建出边界清晰、材料区域更均匀、背景伪影大幅减少的散射体。在不规则形状、紧密排列目标、多种材料和含噪声测量等具有挑战性的三维逆散射场景中表现出明显优势。

Conclusion: 神经水平集参数化方法在三维电磁逆散射中具有显著优势，能够有效利用散射体分段均匀的先验特性，获得高质量的重建结果。

Abstract: This paper proposes a level-set-based physics-driven neural network solver (LSPDNN) for 3-D electromagnetic inverse scattering. To mitigate boundary blurring and reconstruction artifacts in voxel-wise contrast reconstruction, the proposed solver exploits the piecewise homogeneity of practical scatterers by representing unknown targets with multiple coordinate-dependent neural level-set components. Specifically, a soft-union multi-material model is proposed to separately describe the object support and material distribution. The global support is formed by the union of multiple level-set components, while the local contrast is determined by normalized component weights and learnable complex permittivity candidates. In addition, a model-consistent total variation (TV) regularization is imposed on the material-region indicators, rather than directly on the reconstructed contrast, to suppress fragmented material assignments without excessively smoothing material interfaces. An adaptive loss balancing strategy is further introduced to reduce the dependence on manually selected regularization weights. For each measurement instance, the neural level-set parameters and material candidates are optimized by minimizing a physics-consistent objective function. Numerical and experimental results demonstrate that LSPDNN can reconstruct scatterers with clear boundaries, more uniform material regions, and substantially reduced background artifacts. The results highlight the advantage of the neural level-set parameterization in challenging 3-D inverse scattering cases involving irregular shapes, closely spaced objects, multiple materials, and measurement noise.

</details>


### [943] [Eliciting Weak-to-Strong Generalization with On-Policy Reverse Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08798)
*Youngrok Park,Sangmin Bae,Hojung Jung,Jongwoo Ko,Yunseon Choi,Young Jin Kim,Pashmina Cameron,Aaron Courville,Se-Young Yun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出On-Policy Reverse Distillation (OPRD)方法，在弱到强泛化场景中，通过评估教师策略相对其参考策略在学生轨迹上的偏移，并放大学生验证器驱动的策略梯度沿该方向的分量，从而实现加速学习且超越教师性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统蒸馏将弱教师视为优化目标，可能将教师的能力上限强加给学生，限制了弱到强泛化的可能性。同时，连续模型代际传承和多领域整合中，从零开始的逐步后训练成本过高，需要更高效的蒸馏方法。

Method: OPRD在学生rollout上评估教师策略相对其参考策略的策略偏移，只缩放验证器支持的更新分量（沿该偏移方向放大学生的策略梯度），既保留策略优化的稳定点又加速超越教师的学习过程。

Result: 在连续模型迁移和多教师蒸馏中，OPRD以更少的学生更新次数达到比现有RL和蒸馏方法更高的性能。响应风格分析表明OPRD学生更接近纯验证器RL训练的模型而非弱教师，说明教师引导加速而非重定向学生的自身优化。在强到弱蒸馏中也验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: OPRD有效地将验证器驱动的策略优化与教师引导相结合，无论能力序如何排列均有效，表明教师指导的作用是加速学生自身的优化轨迹而非替代或重定向它。

Abstract: Weak-to-strong generalization asks whether stronger models can learn from weaker supervisors and surpass them. This question is particularly important for successive model generations and multi-domain consolidation, where repeating frontier-scale post-training from scratch can be prohibitively expensive. Yet conventional distillation treats the weak teacher as an optimization target, potentially imposing its capacity ceiling on the student. We introduce On-Policy Reverse Distillation (OPRD), which evaluates the teacher's policy shift relative to its reference policy on student rollouts and amplifies the component of the student's verifier-driven policy gradient along that direction. By rescaling only verifier-supported updates, OPRD preserves the stationary points of policy optimization while accelerating learning beyond the teacher. In both successive model transfer and multi-teacher distillation, OPRD achieves higher performance with fewer student updates than existing RL and distillation approaches. Response-style analysis shows that OPRD students remain closer to models trained with verifier-based RL alone than to their weak teachers, suggesting that teacher guidance accelerates rather than redirects the student's own optimization. Results in conventional strong-to-weak distillation further demonstrate that OPRD effectively combines verifier-driven policy optimization with teacher guidance regardless of capacity ordering.

</details>


### [944] [Target-Independent Micro-Interventions for Predicting Training Response Across Language-Model Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08618)
*Zhongxuan Liu,Sicheng Zhou,Hongzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出L-State框架，通过从同一检查点分支四个标准化、目标无关的微干预并记录其在通用能力空间中的响应，来测量基准分数无法体现的"训练响应状态"。L-State包含直接读出和保持结构的算子读出两种方式，在多个大语言模型（GLM-4-9B、Granite-3.1-8B）上显著优于仅使用能力指标的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准分数只能描述检查点当前能做什么，无法预测它在下一次训练迭代中会如何响应。这种"缺失状态"对于模型训练中的选择与决策至关重要，但目前缺乏有效的度量方法。

Method: 从同一检查点分支四个短小、标准化、目标无关的微干预（micro-interventions），记录它们在通用能力空间中的影响。结合当前能力构成L-State。提出两种读出方式：脉冲块（pulse block）中的直接读出（直接映射响应）与保持结构的算子读出（利用算子结构保持性质）。在平滑局部动力学假设下，算子构造可获得跨族端到端界，并显式考虑源族与目标族的坐标异质性。

Result: 三族留一开发实验中，两种脉冲读出相对仅使用能力将源标准化MSE降低39.4%。在封测GLM-4-9B上，直接与算子读出分别将MSE降低71.8%和78.3%，算子读出将符号平衡准确率从0.366提升到0.754。在封测Granite-3.1-8B上，直接读出达到RMSE 0.544，开发拟合的动作选择性读出达到0.554，而单纯能力基线为1.172。五族审计表明算子坐标随动作和族系变化，建模这些偏差可改善回溯性轨迹预测。

Conclusion: 目标无关的干预能够暴露当前能力指标所遗漏的训练响应信息。直接读出与结构化算子读出覆盖互补的迁移机制，为模型训练过程中的预测与决策提供了新的量化工具。

Abstract: Benchmark scores describe what a checkpoint can do now, but they do not determine how it will respond to the next training episode. We measure this missing state by branching four short, standardized, target-independent micro-interventions from the same checkpoint and recording their effects in a common capability space. Together with current capability, these responses form L-State; its pulse block supports a flexible direct readout and a structure-preserving operator readout. Under smooth local dynamics, the operator construction admits an end-to-end cross-family bound with explicit source- and target-family coordinate heterogeneity. In three-family leave-one-family-out development, both pulse readouts reduce source-standardized MSE by 39.4% relative to capability alone, while separating the best response and direction estimates. On sealed GLM-4-9B, the direct and operator readouts reduce MSE by 71.8% and 78.3%, respectively, and the operator readout raises sign balanced accuracy from 0.366 to 0.754. On sealed Granite-3.1-8B, the direct readout reaches RMSE 0.544 and a development-fitted action-wise selector reaches 0.554, compared with 1.172 for capability alone. A five-family audit finds that the operator coordinate varies by action and family, and that modeling these deviations improves retrospective held-trajectory prediction. Target-independent interventions therefore expose training-response information that current capability misses, with direct and structured readouts covering complementary transfer regimes.

</details>


### [945] [Leveraging contextual events on structure-aware next activity prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08622)
*Alessandro Mele,Claudia Diamantini,Domenico Potena*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于实例图（Instance Graphs）的预测性过程监控方法，通过多种编码策略将上下文信息（即流程执行的环境条件）融入图神经网络（GNN），用于下一活动预测任务。在多个真实事件日志上的实验表明，融入上下文流程实例有助于提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测性过程监控中，下一活动预测是最广泛研究的任务，但现有方法很少显式编码上下文信息（即流程执行的环境条件），这些信息通常通过事件日志属性或聚合度量建模。作者希望引入上下文流程实例来弥补这一不足。

Method: 基于实例图的概念，提出多种编码策略来整合上下文流程实例。针对每种编码策略，生成一组前缀实例图（prefix-Instance Graphs），并将其输入图神经网络（GNN）执行分类任务。

Result: 在多个真实世界事件日志上进行评估，实验结果表明融入上下文流程实例有助于改善下一活动预测的性能。

Conclusion: 融入上下文信息（通过上下文流程实例编码）能够有效提升预测性过程监控的预测效果，证明了该方向的可行性与价值。

Abstract: Predictive process monitoring aims at forecasting various aspects of running processes. Among the different tasks, next activity prediction represents the most extensively investigated. However, only a limited number of existing approaches explicitly encode contextual information, i.e., the environmental conditions in which the process is executed, typically modeled through event log attributes or aggregated measures. In this paper, an approach based on the concept of Instance Graphs is introduced. To incorporate contextual process instances, several encoding strategies are proposed and evaluated by measuring their impact on prediction performance. For each encoding strategy, a set of prefix-Instance Graphs is generated and subsequently provided as input to a Graph Neural Network for the classification task. The proposed approach is evaluated on multiple real-world event logs, and the experimental results demonstrate that incorporating contextual process instances benefits prediction performance.

</details>


### [946] [Suan: Rectifying Direct Preference Safety Alignment in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08634)
*Oleksandr Cherednichenko,Roman Klypa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Suan，一种新型偏好优化算法，直接在梯度层面构建优化目标，而非采用标准变分推导，从而获得更可解释且稳健的训练动态，在保持响应实用性的同时实现优越的安全对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源权重模型在安全对齐上面临持续挑战，后训练变体常出现过度拒绝（over-refusal）和通用质量下降的问题。同时，现有方法在优化目标推导层面缺乏可解释性和稳健性。

Method: 提出Suan偏好优化算法，与现有方法不同，直接在梯度层面制定优化目标，绕过标准变分推导，从而获得更可解释和稳健的训练动态。

Result: 在多样化的竞争基线和基准测试上进行广泛评估，证明Suan在完全保持响应实用性的同时实现了优越的安全对齐。

Conclusion: Suan算法能够在保证响应实用性的前提下显著提升LLM的安全对齐效果，为解决开源模型中安全性与效用性之间的权衡提供了新思路。

Abstract: Integrating robust safety guardrails into Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for delivering helpful yet harmless responses. While proprietary systems exhibit reliable safety controls, their underlying methodologies and trade-offs remain largely undisclosed. Achieving comparable security in open-weight models remains a persistent challenge, as post-trained variants frequently suffer from over-refusal and degraded general quality. To overcome these drawbacks, we introduce Suan, a novel preference optimization algorithm. Unlike existing methods, we formulate the optimization objective directly at the gradient level, bypassing the standard variational derivation. As a result, we obtain more interpretable and robust training dynamics. Extensive evaluations across a diverse suite of competitive baselines and benchmarks demonstrate that Suan achieves superior safety alignment while fully preserving response utility.

</details>


### [947] [SUN: Reaching for Novelty in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08642)
*Wenyan Yang,Arsenii Mustafin,Dominik Baumann,Joni Pajarinen,Simone Parisi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SUN（SUccessor-to-Novelty）框架，通过后继值函数导出的指标同时衡量目标的新颖性与可达性，可无缝集成到任何离策略RL算法中，在包含不可达状态、迷宫等挑战性环境中持续优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有目标条件强化学习中的目标选择策略未能同时兼顾新颖性与可达性这两个信号——它们要么手工权衡，要么顺序应用，要么完全忽略其中一个信号，缺乏统一的联合优化框架。

Method: 提出由后继值函数导出的SUN指标，用于识别既新颖又可达的目标；证明SUN在极限情况下可恢复计数型奖励、约束短期击中概率，并理论上拒绝不可达目标；进一步提出自适应目标选择策略及轻量级伪计数方法以避免经典方法的计算开销。

Result: SUN在标准及新颖环境（含不可达/难达状态、不可逆转移、障碍、迷宫、无界空间）中一致优于最先进的基线方法，且所有理论声明均通过充分基准测试验证。

Conclusion: SUN为探索问题提供了同时兼顾新颖性与可达性的理论可证明的解决方案，具有轻量高效、即插即用等优势，代表了目标条件RL探索方向的重要进展。

Abstract: Exploration in reinforcement learning (RL) remains a fundamental challenge. Recent goal-conditioned RL strategies (which select goals to encourage broader state coverage) have shown promising results, but none scores a goal by novelty and reachability jointly: the two signals are traded off by hand, applied in sequence, or one is neglected outright. In this paper, we introduce a reachability-aware goal-selection framework that explicitly integrates these two aspects, and that can be seamlessly incorporated into any off-policy RL algorithm. To this aim, we propose SUccessor-to-Novelty (SUN), an indicator derived from successor value functions to identify goals that are both novel and reachable. We prove that SUN recovers count-based bonuses in the limit, bounds short-horizon hitting probabilities, and provably rejects unreachable goals. We further present an adaptive goal-selection strategy that leverages these properties, and an accurate yet lightweight pseudocount to avoid the overhead of classic methods. We back up all our claims with thorough benchmarks: SUN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in standard and novel environments with unreachable or hard-to-reach states, irreversible transitions, obstacles, mazes, and unbounded spaces.

</details>


### [948] [MoEMB: Scaling Universal Multimodal Embeddings with Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08663)
*Xuanming Cui,Shlok Kumar Mishra,Wentao Bao,Aashu Singh,Zihao Wang,Xiangjun Fan,Jun Xiao,Ser-Nam Lim,Jianpeng Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MOEMB，通过混合专家（MoE）架构沿"专家轴"扩展通用多模态嵌入（UME）模型，在保持单向量、非自回归编码的同时增加模型容量。仅用3B激活参数即可超越TTE方法（>4x激活参数），在MMEB-V2和MRMR基准上达到SOTA，并首次系统研究MoE嵌入的自适应计算策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态嵌入模型需要处理广泛且复杂度各异的任务，但现有扩展方法面临瓶颈：增加表示尺寸或检索成本高，缩放为重多模态LLM则延迟大。对比学习需要大batch size，直接增加参数与之冲突，且UME任务复杂度差异大，统一缩放带来大量冗余计算。

Method: 通过Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）沿专家轴扩展模型，在保持单向量、非自回归编码的前提下提升编码器容量。系统研究MoE-based UME的设计空间和训练策略，并首次全面探索训练式与推理式自适应计算策略以提升可扩展性和效率。

Result: MoEMB在MMEB-V2和MRMR基准上达到SOTA，仅用3B激活参数即超越TTE方法（其激活参数超过4倍），且计算开销显著更低。

Conclusion: 专家轴扩展是UME高效且有效的扩展方向，自适应计算技术可进一步提升面向大规模检索和推荐系统的MLLM嵌入模型效率。

Abstract: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) increasingly demands encoder's capacity for handling a broad range of tasks and modalities with increased complexity. Prior scaling methods either increase the representation size, retrieval effort, or scales the encoder into a heavy multimodal LLM. Recent works, such as Think-Then-Embed (TTE), explore scaling via reasoning tokens. However, embedding models are hard to scale up: increasing parameters directly tradeoffs for the large training batch size that contrastive learning needs, and retrieval has to be served under tight latency. Moreover, UME tasks are diverse in complexity, where scaling up embedders can bring significant redundant computation. In this work, we propose MOEMB, which instead scales UME along the expert axis through mixture-of-experts (MoE), growing encoder capacity while preserving single-vector, non-autoregressive encoding. Through a systematic study of the design space and training recipes for MoE-based UME, MoEMB sets a new state of the art on both MMEB-V2 and MRMR among models trained on public MMEB-family data: with only 3B active parameters, MoEMB surpasses TTE-based methods with >4x active parameters, using significantly less computes. To further improve the scalability and efficiency, we conduct the first comprehensive study of adaptive computation for MoE-based embedding, spanning diverse strategies across training-based and inference-only methods. Together, these results support expert scaling as an effective and efficient direction for UME, with adaptive computation further improving efficiency for MLLM-based embedding models towards large-scale retrieval and recommendation systems.

</details>


### [949] [Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning in Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09135)
*Jiacheng Xu,Feng Chen,Xiuneng Xu,Bo An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出探针驱动的测试时强化学习（TTRL），通过构造无输出的探针输入并执行候选程序，基于行为一致性定义探针共识奖励（PCR），并引入熵正则化排名掩码策略优化（ERPO）来缓解奖励黑客问题，显著提升代码生成的pass@1和pass@k指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTRL方法依赖答案级自投票获取奖励，但代码生成任务中程序无法通过表面形式比较，无法直接提供可用的训练信号，因此需要一种适用于开放词汇程序的行为级奖励机制。

Method: 1) 从问题陈述构造无输出的探针输入；2) 在探针上执行候选程序，基于行为一致性定义探针共识奖励（PCR）；3) 提出熵正则化排名掩码策略优化（ERPO），通过排名掩码将低PCR转为保守负更新，并用熵上限控制策略漂移。

Result: 在编码基准上，ERPO在域内适应和零样本迁移场景下均显著提升了pass@1和pass@k指标。

Conclusion: 行为级探针共识信号与熵正则化优化策略相结合，能够使TTRL有效应用于代码生成任务，同时抑制奖励黑客现象。

Abstract: Existing methods for test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) derive rewards from answer-level self-voting on unlabeled test-time tasks with canonical answers, but this breaks down for code generation because programs cannot be compared by surface form and therefore do not directly provide a usable training signal. To make TTRL applicable to code generation, we propose probe-driven TTRL, which constructs output-free probe inputs from the problem statement, executes candidate programs on these probes, and defines a Probe Consensus Reward (PCR) from the resulting behavioral agreement. PCR provides a behavioral training signal for open-vocabulary programs, but it is not a fully reliable verifier and remains susceptible to reward hacking through spurious consensus. We therefore introduce Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization (ERPO), which converts low PCR into conservative negative updates through rank masking and controls policy drift with an entropy ceiling. On coding benchmarks, ERPO substantially improves pass@1 and pass@k in both in-domain adaptation and zero-shot transfer.

</details>


### [950] [Neither Adversarial Training Nor Purification: Emergent Adversarial Robustness from Oscillatory Predictive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08683)
*Mohammed-Yassine Habibi,Klea Ziu,Martin Takáč,Makoto Yamada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需对抗训练或测试时对抗纯化的新方法——振荡预测学习（OPL），通过结合人工Kuramoto振荡神经元（AKOrN）与预测性自监督预训练（X-PhiNet），利用架构和表征学习的归纳偏置实现经验鲁棒性。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，AutoAttack-rand评估下分别达到76.63%±0.76%和50.44%的鲁棒精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统对抗鲁棒性主要依赖对抗训练或测试时对抗纯化，这两种方法都因生成对抗样本或迭代去噪而引入显著的计算开销。作者希望探索能否通过架构设计和表征学习的归纳偏置，而非显式的对抗过程，自然涌现出经验鲁棒性。

Method: 提出两阶段框架OPL：第一阶段使用人工Kuramoto振荡神经元（AKOrN），第二阶段结合预测性自监督预训练（X-PhiNet）。由于默认检查点采用随机初始振荡器状态，与其它随机对抗防御方法进行比较，并使用精确、可复现且强攻击的协议（AutoAttack-rand）。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，OPL在ℓ∞、ε=8/255、AutoAttack-rand（EoT K=20）协议下分别达到76.63%±0.76%和50.44%的鲁棒精度；CIFAR-10上进行了额外的CIFAR-10-C corruption评估，结果具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 研究证明经验对抗鲁棒性可以不一定依赖高成本的对抗训练，而可以通过振荡动态与预测性自监督等架构和表征学习的归纳偏置来实现，为低计算开销的对抗防御提供了新方向。

Abstract: Adversarial robustness in computer vision is still largely achieved through adversarial training or test-time adversarial purification, both of which introduce significant computational overhead by generating adversarial examples during training or performing iterative denoising at test time. We study whether empirical robustness can instead emerge from architectural and representation-learning inductive biases. We introduce Oscillatory Predictive Learning (OPL), a two-stage framework that combines Artificial Kuramoto Oscillatory Neurons (AKOrN) with predictive self-supervised pretraining using X-PhiNet. Because our default checkpoint uses randomized initial oscillator states, we compare it with other randomized adversarial defense methods that provide precise, reproducible, and strong attack protocols. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, with additional corruption evaluation on CIFAR-10-C, demonstrate that our method achieves competitive results under the AutoAttack-rand evaluation protocol. On CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, OPL attains 76.63$\pm$0.76$\%$ and 50.44$\%$ robust accuracy, respectively, under $\ell_\infty$, $ε=8/255$, AutoAttack-rand with EoT $K=20$.

</details>


### [951] [HOPE: Heterophily-Aware Open-Set Node Classification with Pseudo-Extrapolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08685)
*Yumeng Dai,Yue Tan,Yixin Liu,Chenxu Wang,Pinghui Wang,Tao Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HOPE是一种面向异配图（heterophilic graphs）的开集节点分类方法。它通过结构增强的特征初始化层捕获多跳结构模式，设计可信邻居聚合机制过滤跨类噪声邻居，并提出异配引导的伪外推策略生成伪未知代理以增强未知类拒绝能力，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开集节点分类方法依赖同配性假设（相连节点共享标签），但真实图往往具有异配性，导致两类问题：(1) 跨类连接使聚合后不同已知/未知类的表征纠缠，判别能力下降；(2) 结构混合使基于阈值的开集方法和跨类特征插值失效，未知类拒绝不可靠。

Method: HOPE包含三个核心组件：(1) 结构增强的特征初始化层，用于捕获多跳结构模式；(2) 可信邻居聚合机制，动态过滤噪声的跨类邻居；(3) 异配引导的伪外推策略，动态维护已知类中心并沿跨类邻域位移方向外推，在结构模糊区域合成伪未知代理。最后通过联合分类和对数间隔正则化优化网络，将合成代理路由到专用的拒绝槽中。

Result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，HOPE一致优于最先进的模型，验证了其有效性、鲁棒性和效率。

Conclusion: HOPE成功将开集图神经网络从同配场景扩展到异配场景，解决了异配图中开集节点分类的判别能力下降和未知类拒绝不可靠的挑战。

Abstract: Standard open-set node classification methods rely on the homophily assumption, where connected nodes share labels. However, real-world graphs are often heterophilic, exposing the limitations of current methods and posing new challenges to open-set node classification. On the one hand, cross-class connectivity causes representations from different known or unknown classes to become intertwined after aggregation, undermining their discriminative capacity. On the other hand, structural mixture invalidates threshold-based open-set methods and cross-class feature interpolation, leading to unreliable unknown-class rejection. To address these challenges, we propose HOPE, a Heterophily-aware Open-set node classification method with Pseudo-Extrapolation. To adapt open-set graph neural networks (GNNs) to heterophilic scenarios, HOPE uses a structure-augmented feature initialization layer to capture multi-hop structural patterns. Meanwhile, we design a trustworthy neighborhood aggregation mechanism for standard GNNs to dynamically filter noisy cross-class neighbors. To enhance unknown-class rejection, we introduce a heterophily-guided pseudo-extrapolation strategy. It dynamically maintains known-class centers and extrapolates along cross-class neighborhood displacement directions, synthesizing pseudo-unknown proxies near structurally ambiguous regions. Finally, we optimize the network with joint classification and logit margin regularization, routing synthetic proxies into a dedicated rejection slot without imposing geometric margin constraints in the representation space. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets show that HOPE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models, validating its effectiveness, robustness, and efficiency.

</details>


### [952] [Chimaera: A Mixture-of-Graph-Experts Architecture for Cross-Task and Cross-Dataset Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08709)
*Jonathan Frank,David Richerby,Ansgar Scherp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Chimaera 是一个将混合专家（MoE）与图基础模型（GFM）相结合的框架，能够整合不同的 GFM 架构（如图提示和线性 GNN 模型），利用大语言模型生成嵌入，并扩展线性 GNN 以支持节点、链接和图级别的任务。在六个基准文本属性图数据集上的实验验证了其有效性和跨任务、跨数据集的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图数据的不规则结构以及嵌入的尺寸和特征差异，使得为图设计基础模型面临重大挑战，需要一种能够整合多样化专家和架构的统一框架。

Method: Chimaera 将 MoE 与 GFM 架构（如图提示、线性 GNN）集成；使用 LLM 生成嵌入；专家可按不同策略（GFM、嵌入等）训练和组合；同时扩展线性 GNN 以支持链接级和图级任务（不仅是节点级任务）。

Result: 在同任务和跨任务的节点、链接、图分类实验（6个基准数据集）中展现了有效性，具备跨任务和跨数据集迁移能力。关键发现：需同时使用大、小语言模型生成嵌入；简单有效的线性 GNN 具有强跨任务迁移性；仅需少量样本即可取得强结果。

Conclusion: Chimaera 验证了 MoE 与图基础模型结合的可行性，并揭示了图基础模型设计中关于嵌入生成、模型选择和数据效率的重要见解。

Abstract: Designing foundation models for graphs is challenging due to the irregular structure of graphs and the different sizes and characteristics of embeddings. Chimaera integrates mixture-of-experts with graph foundation models (GFM). It integrates different GFM architectures, such as graph prompts and linear GNN models. Large language models are used to generate embeddings, and experts can be trained and combined following different strategies, GFMs, embeddings, etc. Furthermore, Chimaera extends existing linear GNNs to support link-level and graph-level tasks in addition to node-level tasks. Empirical analyses are performed on same-task and cross-task experiments with node, link, and graph classification tasks using six benchmark text-attributed graph datasets. The experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of Chimaera and its capabilities for transfer across tasks and datasets. Further insights include the need to use both large and small language models to generate embeddings for the experts, a strong cross-task transferability of simple but effective linear GNNs, and using few samples only to provide strong results.

</details>


### [953] [Learning Length-Extrapolatable Recurrent Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09157)
*Hanwen Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CST（Credit Stabilization through Time）方法，直接在反向传播过程中对状态信用信号进行局部归一化，以稳定其范数但不改变被修正的分量方向，从而解决循环模型在训练时域之外泛化失败的问题。在合成任务和真实数据上，CST在长达128倍训练长度的外推中均取得性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环模型天然适合长上下文化建模，但基于BPTT训练的模型往往无法在训练时域之外工作。传统观点认为梯度消失/爆炸是主因，但研究表明即使梯度严重衰减，密集的逐token损失仍能训练共享的循环规则，说明衰减本身并不能决定学习是否失败。作者转而研究"状态信用"（state credit）——即未来损失到达早期循环状态的信号，并指出其才是决定学习成败的关键。

Method: 作者提出Credit Stabilization through Time (CST)方法。核心思想是在反向传播过程中，对状态信用信号进行局部重缩放（locally rescale），以稳定其范数，同时不旋转正在被修正的分量，且完全不改动前向计算。由于受控合成任务与真实数据表现出不同的信用动力学特性，作者针对这两种场景分别设计了专门化的CST变体。

Result: 在合成任务和真实数据两种设定下，CST均显著提升了模型在训练时域之外的表现，在最长达到128倍训练长度的外推场景中也观察到增益。

Conclusion: 工作揭示了状态信用而非单纯的梯度衰减才是循环模型超时域学习失败的根本原因，并通过CST这一前向不变、反向局部稳定化的干预手段，有效扩展了循环模型的长上下文泛化能力，最高支持128倍训练长度的外推。

Abstract: Recurrent models provide a natural path to long-context modeling, yet models trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT) often fail beyond their training horizon. Classical analyses emphasize gradients that vanish or explode along temporal paths. However, dense per-token losses can still train a shared recurrent rule despite severe decay, showing that decay alone does not determine whether learning fails. We instead study state credit: the signal through which future losses reach earlier recurrent states before contributing to parameter updates. Accordingly, we intervene directly on state credit and propose Credit Stabilization through Time (CST). During backward propagation, CST locally rescales the state-credit signal to stabilize its norm without rotating the component being corrected, while leaving the forward computation unchanged. Because controlled synthetic tasks and real data exhibit different credit dynamics, we specialize CST to each regime. In both settings, CST improves performance beyond the training horizon, with gains observed at up to 128x the training length.

</details>


### [954] [BAFF: Bid-Aware Filter Family for Mitigating Training Data Interference in RTB A/B Tests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08725)
*Jeonglyul Oh,Ikkyu Choi,Inseop Youn,Youngjae Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对RTB在线A/B测试中共享日志训练导致的偏差问题，提出Bid-Aware Filter Family (BAFF)——一类(k,l)参数化的硬过滤器家族，可在日志拆分与日志共享两个极端之间提供结构化搜索空间，并配套提出三阶段在线测量协议，用于在生产环境中评估数据共享策略与无干扰参考模型的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTB在线A/B测试中，对照组和实验组模型通常在包含对方模型生成数据的共享服务日志上训练。这种共享日志训练通过两个渠道引入偏差：ad-ranking分歧（对方可能选择了不同的广告）和bid-pricing分歧（对方可能出价不同），从而扭曲A/B测试结果。日志拆分虽消除偏差但牺牲训练数据量，日志共享保留数据却无法解决偏差，需要介于两者之间的解决方案。

Method: 1. 形式化定义Bid-Aware Filter Family (BAFF)，即一类(k,l)参数化的硬过滤器，可独立控制对ad-ranking分歧和bid-pricing分歧的容忍度，提供介于日志共享与日志拆分之间的结构化搜索空间。2. 提出三阶段在线测量协议，用于在生产环境中评估不同数据共享策略与无干扰参考模型的偏差程度。3. 在离线和在线RTB环境中对(k,l)参数进行系统搜索评估。

Result: 离线模拟中，(k,l)参数扫描得到的操作点相比日志共享和日志拆分都更接近无干扰参考模型。在真实RTB DSP平台在线部署中，基于过滤器的变体比两种基线更紧密地保持了参考模型的业务指标（如CPC、CTR）。最优操作点取决于具体设置，凸显了搜索空间的实用价值。

Conclusion: BAFF过滤器族提供了一种介于日志共享与日志拆分之间的灵活方法，能有效减少RTB A/B测试中的干扰偏差。由于最优(k,l)设置依赖具体场景，该搜索空间本身具有重要的实践价值，可帮助从业者根据实际需求在数据利用与偏差控制间找到平衡。
