Abstract: In online A/B tests for real-time bidding (RTB), control and treatment models are typically trained on a shared serving log that includes data generated by the counterpart model. This shared-log training biases each model's training data through two channels: the counterpart model may have selected a different ad from the ad-candidate pool (ad-ranking disagreement) and may have bid a different price (bid-pricing disagreement), potentially distorting the A/B test outcome. Log-splitting eliminates the bias but sacrifices training data; log-sharing retains all data but leaves the bias unaddressed. We formalize the Bid-Aware Filter Family (BAFF), a class of (k,l)-parameterized hard filters that controls tolerance to each channel independently, providing a structured search space between these two extremes. We further propose a three-stage online measurement protocol that enables evaluating data-sharing strategies by their deviation from an interference-free reference model in production. In offline simulation, a (k,l) sweep surfaces operating points with smaller deviation from the interference-free reference model than both log-sharing and log-splitting. In a live RTB deployment on a demand-side platform (DSP), filter-based variants preserve the reference model's business metrics (e.g., CPC, CTR) more closely than both baselines. The best operating point is setting-dependent, underscoring the practical value of the search space itself.

</details>


### [955] [PAC-Bayesian Bounds for Learning Partially Observed Stochastic Linear Time-Invariant State-Space Systems with Inputs and Sub-Gaussian Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08740)
*Mihaly Petreczky,Mohamad Al Ahdab,John Leth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文推导了部分可观测的线性时不变（LTI）随机动态系统（含输入和次高斯噪声）的PAC-Bayesian误差界，将预测误差期望与训练数据上的预测误差联系起来，并进一步扩展至参数估计误差的有界分析，为系统辨识算法提供有限样本误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习中从有限数据学习的模型需要量化其泛化能力，而现有PAC-Bayesian理论多聚焦于标准监督学习框架，缺少对动态系统（尤其是部分可观测的LTI状态空间系统）的理论保证。作者希望弥合这一空白。

Method: 作者针对部分可观测LTI随机动态系统（含输入、次高斯噪声）推导PAC-Bayesian误差界，将预测误差期望与训练误差关联；并进一步利用该边界推导参数估计误差的界，从而为多种系统辨识算法提供有限样本保证。

Result: 成功推导了预测误差和参数估计误差的有限样本PAC-Bayesian界，适用于一类广泛的系统辨识算法。

Conclusion: 该工作为动态系统的PAC-Bayesian分析提供了新工具；由于LTI系统是RNN的子类，此结果可视为迈向循环神经网络PAC-Bayesian界的第一步。

Abstract: In this paper we derive a Probably Approximately Correct (PAC)-Bayesian error bound for partially observed linear time-invariant (LTI) stochastic dynamical systems in state-space form with inputs and sub-Gaussian noise. Such bounds are widespread in machine learning, and they are useful for characterizing the predictive power of models learned from finitely many data points. The bound derived in this paper relates the expectation of prediction errors with the prediction error generated by the model on the data used for learning. In addition, we show that it can also be used to derive bounds for the parameter estimation error. In turn, this allows us to provide finite-sample error bounds for the prediction error and parameter estimation error for a wide class of system identification algorithms. Furthermore, as LTI systems are a sub-class of recurrent neural networks (RNNs), these error bounds could be a first step towards PAC-Bayesian bounds for RNNs.

</details>


### [956] [Adaptive Anisotropic Attention for Axis-Structured Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08788)
*Mahir Jain,Parshva Runwal,Aditya Ray Mishra,Arvasu Kulkarni,Sandeep Singh,Siddharth Panwar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出自适应各向异性注意力(AAA)，将注意力分解为时间轴路径和空间轴路径，通过可学习的门控加权融合，用于处理脑电等低信噪比结构化信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集自注意力将所有token对视为同等可能的交互（各向同性先验），这与结构化信号不匹配。对于脑电等低信噪比结构化信号，依赖关系沿电极和时间轴组织，均匀先验使每个token暴露于大量无关交互中。

Method: 将注意力拆分为两条路径：时间路径（token关注同电极跨时间的token）和空间路径（token关注同时刻其他电极的token）。一个小型门控网络为每个token预测两条路径输出的凸组合权重（两个非负权重且和为1）。由此构建AXON模型。

Result: 在六个脑电下游任务上，AXON相比密集基线在线性探测和全量微调下均提升了平均平衡准确率。两条路径均必要，加权和优于硬性选择单一路径，主要收益来自门控在各层学习到不同的时空平衡。在受控音频频谱实验中验证了轴分解可迁移到脑电之外的领域。

Conclusion: 将注意力与结构化信号的自然轴对齐提供了有用的归纳偏置，可作为处理结构化低信噪比信号的有效设计原则。

Abstract: Dense self-attention treats all token pairs as equally plausible before learning, an interaction-isotropic prior that can be mismatched to structured signals. For structured, low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) signals such as EEG, dependencies are organized along the electrode and time axes, and this uniform prior exposes each token to many irrelevant interactions. We introduce Adaptive Anisotropic Attention (AAA), which splits attention into two paths: a temporal path, where each token attends to the tokens of its own electrode across time, and a spatial path, where it attends to the tokens of the other electrodes at the same time step. A small gate predicts, for every token, a convex combination of the two path outputs: two non-negative weights that sum to one. On six EEG downstream tasks, the resulting model, AXON (AXis-factorized Operator Network), improves mean balanced accuracy over a dense baseline under both linear probing and full fine-tuning. We show that both paths (temporal and spatial) are necessary and that the weighted sum beats a hard choice of one path; most of the benefit comes from the gate learning a different temporal/spatial balance at each layer of the network. Controlled audio spectrogram experiments show that axis factorization transfers beyond EEG. These results suggest that aligning attention with the natural axes of structured signals provides a useful inductive bias.

</details>


### [957] [Length Generalization for Transformers via Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08851)
*Georg Zetzsche,Hongjian Jiang,Andy Yang,Pascal Bergsträßer,Marco Sälzer,David Chiang,Anthony W. Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过改进C-RASP语言假设中的样本复杂度上界，将原有的双指数上界改进为单指数上界，并展示了在压缩字符串设定下可获得多项式长度泛化界，从而解决了C-RASP猜想面临的矛盾实验证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: C-RASP假设虽然经验验证充分，但理论上缺乏可计算的长度泛化界，且存在看似矛盾的实验。C-RASP+和C-RASP1片段虽然提供了可计算的双指数样本界，但其紧性未知，需要解决这一开放问题。

Method: 本文通过建立与power words（幂词）的新联系，为C-RASP+和C-RASP1片段的样本复杂度提供了指数级更紧的上界；并在压缩字符串场景下推导出多项式长度泛化界。

Result: 成功将样本复杂度上界从双指数改进为单指数；在压缩字符串设定下获得了多项式长度泛化界；并利用该细粒度分析解决了C-RASP猜想面临的反例实验。

Conclusion: 本研究不仅解决了样本复杂度界的紧性问题，还通过细粒度分析调和了C-RASP猜想与其矛盾实验之间的矛盾，进一步巩固了transformer长度泛化理论的基础。

Abstract: Recent advancements in transformer length generalization theory enable us to reliably predict when a transformer can learn to solve a task. In particular, the C-RASP hypothesis (a formalized version of the so-called RASP-l conjecture) posits that transformers length-generalize on a task if and only if a solution is expressible in the C-RASP language. While this hypothesis has strong empirical validation, theoretical problems arise from the fact that no computable length generalization bounds exist for C-RASP, alongside the discovery of seemingly contradictory experiments. To address these problems, we refine the C-RASP hypothesis utilizing the recently-proposed fragments C-RASP+ and C-RASP1. These fragments have computable length generalization bounds, though in the worst case requiring an extremely large (double exponential) sample size. It is an open question whether these sample size bounds are tight. In this paper, we resolve this open question by providing an exponentially tighter bound. In doing so, we show a polynomial length generalization bound for transformers if we adopt compressed strings, via a novel connection to power words. As an application, we show how this yields a fine-grained analysis of the C-RASP conjecture that resolves contradicting experimental evidence against it.

</details>


### [958] [Earth System World Model for What-If Simulations: A Case Study for Terrestrial Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08855)
*Zhihao Wang,Ruichen Wang,Ruohan Li,Lei Ma,George Hurtt,Xiaowei Jia,Gengchen Mai,Shaowen Wang,Yiqun Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向地球系统仿真的动作条件世界建模框架，通过将自然观测到的状态变化视为无标签动作监督（transition-action pretraining），使仿真器从被动预测器转变为支持用户指定干预的交互式代理，并引入掩码响应学习以处理部分状态编辑下的耦合变量推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习仿真器大多是被动预测器，只能在外加强迫下复现模拟轨迹，缺乏显式的交互机制来支持用户指定干预。这限制了其在交互式科学工作流和地球系统数字孪生中的应用，因为用户常常需要探索"如果改变某些状态分量，系统会如何响应"这类问题。

Method: 提出动作条件世界建模框架，核心包括两个组件：(1) transition-action pretraining——将自然出现的状态变化作为无标签动作监督，让模型同时学习规定动力学和条件响应，无需人工标注干预；(2) masked response learning——在部分状态编辑下推断未观测变量，学习耦合系统的依赖关系。

Result: 在六个全球区域的生态系统动力学和多个林龄上测试，实验表明该框架在保持有竞争力的长时程仿真精度的同时，实现了可控的结构性干预和耦合生态系统循环变量的一致响应。

Conclusion: 该工作为从被动地球系统仿真器走向交互式、干预感知的科学替代模型提供了实用路径，展示了仿真器从预测工具向可交互科学代理转变的可能性。

Abstract: Machine learning emulators have become essential for accelerating expensive Earth-system simulations, but most existing approaches remain passive forecasters: they reproduce simulator trajectories under prescribed forcings without an explicit interaction mechanism for user-specified interventions. This limits their use in interactive scientific workflows and Earth-system digital twins, where users often need to explore how a system would respond if selected state components were changed. We propose an action-conditioned world-modeling framework for Earth-system emulation that reformulates simulator trajectories as supervision for controllable state-transition learning. The key idea is transition-action pretraining: naturally observed state changes are treated as label-free action supervision, allowing the model to learn both prescribed dynamics and action-conditioned responses without manually annotated interventions. We further introduce masked response learning to infer unobserved variables under partial state edits and learn coupled system dependencies. We test this framework on ecosystem dynamics across six global regions and multiple stand ages. Experiments show that the model preserves competitive long-horizon emulation accuracy while enabling controllable structural interventions and coherent responses in coupled ecosystem-cycle variables. These results suggest a practical route from passive Earth-system emulators toward interactive, intervention-aware scientific surrogates.

</details>


### [959] [The BatchNorm Illusion: Diagnosing Normalization Artifacts in Machine Unlearning Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08901)
*Aaryaman Kalani,Murari Mandal,Dhruv Kumar,Mohan Kankanhalli,Yash Sinha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了机器学习中近似机器遗忘评估的一个此前未被记录的混淆因素：在基于BatchNorm的架构上，仅对保留数据做一次前向传播（不修改任何权重）就能确定性重写模型的归一化状态，逆转表面上的遗忘指标。作者将该操作形式化为保权定点算子，并证明其导致的差异可归因于BN运行统计而非遗忘方法对权重的修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近似机器遗忘旨在不重新训练的情况下移除特定训练数据的影响，但现有评估方式存在未发现的系统性问题——评估结果可能被BatchNorm架构的伪影所污染，而非真实反映遗忘方法的有效性。

Method: 形式化定义保权定点算子，分离测量失效（BN伪影）与编码器失效（权重残留信息）；利用该算子框架将线性探针提升唯一分解为BN测量偏差与编码器几何成分；在九个方法、标准基准上进行实证验证，并采用GroupNorm对照组消除伪影。

Result: 该伪影可在九个评估方法上逆转遗忘准确率高达78个百分点；攻击者仅需10张无标签图像即可恢复大部分被掩盖的准确率；严格GroupNorm对照可将伪影降至零。成员推理攻击在重新校准下变化不大，表明评估失效主要定位在遗忘准确率和线性探针上。

Conclusion: BN运行统计伪影是机器遗忘评估中的系统性测量问题，与权重编码信息（编码器失效）是本质不同的两类失败。研究者需采用GroupNorm等严格对照或重新校准评估协议，才能获得可信的遗忘效果度量。

Abstract: Approximate machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a trained model without retraining from scratch. We identify a previously undocumented confound in how unlearning is evaluated on BatchNorm-based architectures: a single forward pass over retain data, an operation that modifies no weight, can deterministically rewrite the model's normalization state and reverse the apparent surface-metric forgetting. We formalize this operation as a weight-preserving fixed-point operator and prove that any pre-versus-post gap it induces is provably attributable to BN running statistics rather than to any modification the unlearning method made to the weights. This attribution claim cleanly separates measurement failure (BN artifact) from encoder failure (residual weight-encoded information, recently documented in concurrent work), and the same operator framework yields a unique decomposition of linear-probe elevation into BN-measurement-bias and encoder-geometry components. Empirically, the artifact reverses headline forget accuracy by up to 78 pp across nine evaluated methods on standard benchmarks; an attacker with as few as 10 unlabeled images recovers most of the masked accuracy; and a strict GroupNorm control reduces the artifact to zero across all methods. The tested membership-inference attacks change little under recalibration, locating the observed evaluation failure in forget accuracy and linear probing.

</details>


### [960] [GraphFAS: A Distributed System for Automated Graph Feature Generation and Selection in Industrial Transaction Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08970)
*Yice Luo,Yun Zhu,Xi Chen,Yongchao Liu,Xintan Zeng,Chengying Huan,Kai Zhang,Jinrui Zhang,Juelu Zhang,Jiajun Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GraphFAS（图特征自动选择）框架，解决工业欺诈检测中专家构造特征成本高且忽略图结构信息的问题。通过无参数的多跳子图提取和多尺度聚合生成可解释的结构特征，并扩展Boruta算法实现分布式特征自动选择，使特征工程与模型训练解耦，可无缝集成到表格模型和TreeSHAP解释中，已在支付宝大规模部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业欺诈检测通常依赖昂贵且需专家经验构造的特征，这些特征忽略了图结构中的关系信号；而GNN虽然能捕捉图信息，但难以满足金融风控对可解释性和部署效率的要求。现有方法在特征工程的可解释性与GNN的图建模能力之间存在鸿沟。

Method: GraphFAS包含两个核心模块：(1) 非参数图特征生成模块——通过多跳子图提取和多尺度聚合构建显式、可解释的结构特征，无需学习参数；(2) 基于Boruta的自动分布式特征选择算法——扩展Boruta框架，使用基于中位数的跨分区聚合，在大规模数据上鲁棒地识别重要特征，且几乎不需要领域专业知识。

Result: GraphFAS在支付宝中部署，与端到端GNN流水线相比，工程效率提升了数量级；在大规模图数据上，其性能优于专家驱动方法和图学习基线。特征生成与模型训练的解耦使其能直接与表格模型集成，并兼容TreeSHAP可解释性分析。

Conclusion: GraphFAS通过将图特征聚合从模型训练中解耦，成功弥合了GNN强大但缺乏可解释性与传统专家特征高效但忽略结构信息之间的鸿沟，实现了可解释、可扩展、低工程成本的工业级欺诈检测方案。

Abstract: Industrial fraud detection often relies on costly expert-crafted features that overlook graph-structured relational signals, while GNNs often do not meet the interpretability and deployment requirements of financial risk control. We propose GraphFAS (Graph Feature Automated Selection), a distributed feature selection procedure based on Boruta that bridges this gap through: (1) a non-parametric graph feature generation module that constructs explicit, interpretable structural features via multi-hop subgraph extraction and multi-scale aggregation without learned parameters; and (2) an automated distributed feature selection algorithm extending Boruta with median-based aggregation across partitions to robustly identify informative features at scale with minimal domain expertise. Compared with end-to-end GNN pipelines, GraphFAS decouples feature aggregation from model training, enabling direct integration with tabular models and direct compatibility with TreeSHAPbased explanations. Deployed in Alipay, GraphFAS delivers orderof-magnitude improvements in engineering efficiency while showing strong performance against expert-driven and graph-learning baselines on large-scale graphs.

</details>


### [961] [Transformers as In-Context Samplers: From Closed-Form Diffusion to Estimation-Free Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08981)
*Arman Adibi,Alireza Jafari,Mohammad Ghavamzadeh,Hadi Daneshmand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明冻结的transformer不仅能进行上下文学习（in-context learning）做监督学习任务，还能模拟迭代式生成采样器，即从上下文化样本中生成数据。作者首先证明transformer可以实现闭式及平滑闭式扩散采样器，其中softmax注意力计算责任权重和加权经验均值，前馈层实现欧拉更新。为联系预训练语言模型，他们研究了语义主题采样（如动物、食物、城市），发现隐藏状态呈现两阶段几何结构：中间层趋向均匀球面参考，输出层回到主题相关结构。粒子能量呈现U形模式，并证明transformer可以近似基于能量的采样器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有理论工作证明大语言模型具备上下文学习能力，可处理线性回归等监督学习任务。但是否能将此能力扩展到数据生成（data generation）任务尚不清楚。作者希望弥合这一理论空白，证明transformer也能从上下文样本中模拟生成采样过程，并联系实际预训练模型中的语义主题采样现象。

Method: (1) 构造性地证明transformer可实现闭式和平滑闭式扩散采样器：softmax注意力计算责任权重与加权经验均值，前馈层执行欧拉更新；(2) 通过语义主题采样实验（词来自同一语义类别）研究预训练模型隐藏状态的几何特性，测量归一化隐藏状态的两阶段结构和粒子间交互能量；(3) 证明transformer能实现基于能量的采样器，构造跨层相同的U形能量模式。

Result: 理论证明transformer可以模拟迭代式生成采样器，从上下文样本中生成数据。实验发现隐藏状态呈现两阶段几何：中间层趋向均匀球面参考，近输出层恢复到主题相关结构，对应的粒子能量呈现U形模式。这些实证观察与理论构造相互印证。

Conclusion: 上下文学习能力不仅限于监督推理，还延伸到数据生成领域。冻结的transformer可以充当迭代式生成采样器。softmax注意力在生成中具有明确的生成性角色（计算责任权重和加权平均），且预训练模型中观察到的几何与能量模式与基于能量的采样器构造一致，表明这些理论结构可能捕捉了真实模型的行为。

Abstract: A growing body of work establishes that large language models are not mere statistical memorizers, but are capable of in-context learning: performing inference at test time using only examples provided in the prompt, without any parameter updates. Prior theoretical work has shown that this capability extends to supervised learning tasks such as linear regression. We prove that in-context learning extends further to \emph{data generation}: frozen transformers can simulate iterative generative samplers from in-context samples. We first show that transformers can realize closed-form and smoothed closed-form diffusion samplers. The construction identifies a concrete generative role for softmax attention: it computes responsibility weights and weighted empirical averages, while feedforward layers implement Euler updates.
  To empirically relate these constructions to pretrained language models, we study \emph{semantic-topic sampling}: prompts consisting of words drawn from a common semantic category, such as animals, foods, or cities. Across transformer layers, the normalized hidden states exhibit a two-stage geometry: they move toward a uniform spherical reference in intermediate layers and then return to structured, topic-dependent representations near the output. We further measure an interacting-particle energy on these hidden-state clouds and observe the same U-shape pattern. We then prove that transformers can approximate an energy-based sampler, constructing the same U-shape energy across the layers.

</details>


### [962] [Physics-Informed Deep Learning for False Ventricular Tachycardia Alarm Reduction in the ICU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08992)
*Athanasios Papastathopoulos-Katsaros,Alexandra Stavrianidi,Zhandong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种深度学习框架用于减少ICU中假性室性心动过速(VT)报警，该框架结合1D SE-ResNet、ICU真实数据增强，以及基于三元件Windkessel血流动力学模型的可微分前向模拟作为物理信息辅助重建任务，在VTaC基准上较先前最优方法提升5个Challenge Score点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 假性室性心动过速(VT)报警是ICU中报警疲劳的主要来源。真实的VT与伪影驱动的ECG模式在多模态上缺乏一致性，现有方法难以有效区分，需要引入血流动力学约束来提升判别能力。

Method: 1) 使用1D SE-ResNet作为基础网络；2) 采用ICU真实数据增强策略；3) 引入基于三元件Windkessel血流动力学模型的物理信息辅助重建任务，以可微分前向模拟方式约束网络潜在表征生成生理上合理的动脉血压波形，从而惩罚伪影驱动的ECG模式。

Result: 在VTaC基准的严格实时协议（10秒报警前窗口）下，较先前最先进方法获得5点Challenge Score提升。消融研究表明物理信息目标函数是主要性能驱动力，带来精度提升、2倍标签效率以及更局部化和临床有意义的ECG片段。

Conclusion: 物理信息约束（跨模态一致性）是区分真实VT与伪影的关键，该框架在降低假报警的同时提高了VT检测的准确性和标签效率，对缓解ICU报警疲劳具有临床应用潜力。

Abstract: False ventricular tachycardia (VT) alarms are a leading contributor to alarm fatigue in intensive care units. We propose a deep learning framework combining a 1D SE-ResNet with ICU-realistic data augmentations and a physics-informed auxiliary reconstruction task based on the three-element Windkessel hemodynamic model, implemented as a differentiable forward simulation. By requiring the network's latent representation to produce physiologically plausible arterial pressure waveforms, artifact-driven ECG patterns are penalized while true VT remains coherent across modalities. Evaluated on the VTaC benchmark under a strict real-time protocol (10-second pre-alarm window), our method achieves a 5-point Challenge Score improvement over prior state-of-the-art. Ablation studies confirm that the physics-informed objective is the primary performance driver, providing gains in accuracy, 2x label efficiency, and more localized and clinically meaningful ECG segments.

</details>


### [963] [Let It Go or Learn to Self-Correct: Continuous Diffusion for Constrained Discrete Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09009)
*Mariia Drozdova,Stéphane Liem Nguyen,François Fleuret*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现标准扩散采样在离散约束任务（如数独、图连通性、拉丁方阵、N皇后）中会因早期错误难以撤销而表现不佳，直接采样模型的干净预测（无需重新训练）即可将数独有效性从31%提升至95%；作者进一步提出自校正训练，让模型暴露于自身预测，增强推理时的错误鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在连续域表现优异，但在全局约束的离散任务中，早期更新难以撤销的错误可能被保留。即使模型的干净预测具有信息量，标准采样器仍可能保留早期错误，导致训练与推理之间存在偏差。

Method: 1）对比标准扩散采样与直接采样模型干净预测；2）提出自校正训练（self-correction training），在训练中将模型暴露于自身预测，提升其对推理期错误的鲁棒性。

Result: 直接采样干净预测无需重新训练即可将数独有效性从31%提升至95%，其他离散任务也有一致提升；自校正训练则显著改善了标准采样器的性能。

Conclusion: 连续扩散模型能学习非平凡的全局约束，但离散推理任务需要更好的训练与推理对齐：要么通过减少对早期决策承诺的采样器，要么通过教会模型在推理时纠正自身错误的训练方式。

Abstract: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) generate samples by starting from noise and repeatedly denoising while keeping each update close to the current noisy state. This behavior is effective in many continuous domains, but its role is less clear for globally constrained discrete tasks, such as Sudoku, graph connectivity, Latin squares, and N-queens. In such settings, early discrete errors can be difficult to undo. As a result, standard diffusion sampling may preserve early mistakes, even when the model's clean predictions are informative. We compare standard samplers to sampling directly from the model's clean prediction. Without retraining, this single change improves Sudoku validity from 31% to 95%, with consistent gains across the other discrete tasks. We hypothesize that staying close to the current noisy state is harmful because the reverse trajectory can drift off the forward noising distribution the model was trained on. To reduce this train-test mismatch, we further introduce self-correction training, which exposes the model to its own predictions, improving robustness to errors that arise during inference. This substantially improves the performance of standard samplers. Our results suggest that continuous diffusion models can learn nontrivial global constraints, but discrete reasoning tasks require better alignment between training and inference: either through samplers that reduce commitment to early decisions, or through training that teaches the model to correct its own inference-time errors.

</details>


### [964] [Do Reasoning Representations Help Humans Evaluate LLM Outputs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09038)
*Jaewoo Lim,Sungbok Shin,Sanghyun Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究不同推理表示格式作为人类面向的解释界面而非模型能力代理。通过控制性人类研究，比较六种推理格式在不同复杂度任务上的表现，发现偏好与实用性存在错位：参与者偏好规划/分解式表示，但简单的思维链更能支持验证、信任和可解释性，且偏好格式还会引入校准风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理表示（如思维链）通常以模型中心的标准（如答案准确性和忠实度）评估，忽略了它们是否真正帮助人类评估模型输出。研究者希望从人类使用者角度重新审视推理表示作为人类-模型交互界面的价值。

Method: 开展受控人类研究，考察六种推理格式在不同复杂度任务上的表现。使用基于Web的框架，随机化任务领域、问题实例和表示顺序。收集结构化理解、错误检测与定位、信任校准等细粒度人类判断。

Result: 发现感知偏好与对人类评估的支持之间存在错位：参与者偏好基于规划和分解的表示，但更简单的思维链反而能更好地支持验证、信任和可解释性。此外，参与者的偏好格式会引入校准风险，导致对正确思维的更多误报，并在验证意愿低的情况下仍保持高信任度。

Conclusion: 人类对推理表示的感知偏好并不等于其实际对评估能力的支持；在设计推理表示作为解释界面时，应重新审视偏好与实用性之间的权衡，避免因追求用户偏好而损害人类验证和信任校准效果。

Abstract: Reasoning representations are increasingly used as explanations for large language model outputs. Yet they are typically evaluated with model-centric criteria, such as answer accuracy and faithfulness, leaving it unclear whether they help people evaluate model responses. In this work, we study reasoning representations as human-facing interfaces rather than proxies for model reasoning ability. We conduct a controlled human study of six reasoning formats across tasks of varying complexity, supported by a web-based framework that randomizes task domains, problem instances, and representation order. The study collects fine-grained judgments of structural understanding, error detection and localization, and trust calibration. Our study shows a mismatch between perceived preference and support for human evaluation. Participants prefer planning- and decomposition-based representations, but simpler chain-of-thought traces better support verification, trust, and interpretability. Preferred representations also introduce calibration risks, with more false alarms on correct traces and high trust despite low willingness to verify.

</details>


### [965] [Training-Free Task Vectors for LLM Behavioral Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09054)
*Gabriel J. Perin,Lucas Boscaini,André Araujo,Nina S. T. Hirata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出训练无关任务向量（TFTVs）方法，无需微调即可通过仅使用前向传播统计将激活转向向量映射为秩一权重空间编辑，从而支持行为特征的增强、抑制与组合编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统任务向量依赖微调模型与预训练模型之间的权重差，成本高昂且限制了训练后模型编辑的实用性。作者旨在消除对微调的依赖，使任务向量的发现更加高效可行。

Method: TFTVs将激活转向向量（activation steering vectors）映射为秩一（rank-one）权重空间编辑，仅需前向传播统计即可计算，同时满足支持加法（学习）、减法（遗忘）及多编辑组合的算术性质。

Result: 在大语言模型行为控制任务上，TFTVs能够一致地增强、抑制和组合目标行为，同时保持通用知识与问题求解能力；相较于其他编辑与转向基线方法，在特质控制上表现更强，效用保持更好或相当。

Conclusion: 该方法为训练后模型编辑提供了无需微调的轻量替代方案，有望推动训练无关模型控制领域的新研究方向。

Abstract: Task vectors enable post-training model editing by identifying semantically meaningful directions in weight space, typically computed as the difference between a fine-tuned model and its pretrained initialization. However, this reliance on fine-tuning makes discovering such directions costly and limits the practicality of post-training model editing. To address this limitation, we introduce Training-Free Task Vectors (TFTVs), a novel method to compute task-vector-like directions without requiring fine-tuning. Our method maps activation steering vectors to rank-one weight-space edits using only forward-pass statistics, while satisfying arithmetic properties that directly support learning via addition, forgetting via subtraction, and the composition of multiple edits. Empirically, we evaluate TFTVs on large language model behavioral control tasks and show that they consistently amplify, suppress, and compose target behaviors while preserving general knowledge and problem-solving skills. We also validate our method against other editing and steering baselines, experimentally demonstrating that TFTVs achieve stronger trait control with better or competitive utility preservation. We hope our work opens new directions for the community in post-training model editing and broader training-free model control. Code is available on the project website: tftv-llm.github.io.

</details>


### [966] [PlayTrain: An Efficient Reinforcement Learning Framework for LLM-Generated Adaptable JavaScript Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09059)
*Ryan Truong,Lance Ying,Samuel J. Gershman,Kazuki Irie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PlayTrain 是一个结合大语言模型（LLM）与强化学习（RL）框架的系统，它利用 LLM 从极简的人类提示中生成 JavaScript 游戏，并提供一个高效管道将任何 JS 游戏嵌入标准 gym 环境中进行训练。该系统支持快速克隆 Atari 和 ProcGen 游戏、修改游戏逻辑，并能在单 GPU 节点上以每秒超过100万个智能体决策的速度训练像素级 RL 智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的视频游戏环境（VGE）开发或修改需要大量手写代码，过程繁琐且耗时。作者希望利用 LLM 在 JS 代码生成方面的强大能力，大幅降低 RL 环境的开发成本，实现快速生成和迭代游戏环境，从而加速 RL 研究。

Method: PlayTrain 框架包含两大核心：1) 利用 LLM 从最简单的人类提示中稳健生成 JavaScript 游戏；2) 构建一个高效管道，可以将任何 JS 游戏无缝运行在标准 gym 环境中。由于 JS 格式易于人工试玩，支持人在环境中的交互验证，同时同一游戏可直接用于训练 RL 智能体。

Result: PlayTrain 成功克隆了多个著名的 Atari 和 ProcGen 游戏（以简单 JS 实现），并支持像素级智能体的端到端训练，吞吐量超过每秒 100 万次智能体决策（单 GPU 节点）。同时还能创建修改版本，如支持新颖测试集、程序化生成逻辑或改变游戏动态。

Conclusion: PlayTrain 重新定义了 RL 视频游戏环境的开发流程——只需通过 LLM 生成和修改一个 JS 文件即可完成环境开发。这为未来的 RL 研究开辟了新方向，包括快速环境迭代、自动化环境生成和更灵活的实验设计。

Abstract: While many video-game environments (VGEs) have played crucial roles in advancing reinforcement learning (RL), developing novel VGEs or modifying existing ones to support new features, has been a laborious process requiring extensive hand-coding. Here we present PlayTrain, an RL framework that combines the abilities of large language models (LLMs) to robustly generate JavaScript (JS) games from a minimal human prompt, and an efficient pipeline that can run any JS game in a standard 'gym' environment. Not only are recent LLMs particularly good at writing JS code, but the JS format also allows users to easily play generated VGEs, while PlayTrain enables us to train RL agents on the exact same games. We demonstrate multiple use cases of PlayTrain, including cloning well-known Atari and ProcGen games in simple JS, where PlayTrain trains pixel-based agents end-to-end at over 1M agent-decisions per second on a single GPU node; and creating modified versions thereof (e.g., that support novel test sets, procedural generation logics, or game dynamics). Through PlayTrain, we reimagine RL VGE development: all we need is a single JS file, generated and modified through an LLM. We discuss promising future RL research directions that PlayTrain unlocks.

</details>


### [967] [Multi-Task Learning for Sparsely-Labeled Time Series: A Case Study on Cold-Hardiness Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09062)
*Aseem Saxena,Paola Pesántez-Cabrera,Jonathan Magby,Markus Keller,Alan Fern*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过真实世界案例研究，探讨了在标签稀疏、数据有限条件下使用多任务学习（MTL）进行时间序列建模。研究聚焦于农业领域中的葡萄抗寒性预测问题，采用循环神经网络结合多任务学习架构，将不同葡萄品种作为不同任务，在MTL和迁移学习两种设置下进行评估。结果表明某些MTL架构显著优于单任务学习和最先进的科学模型，并进一步验证了同时预测萌芽和抗寒性的单一多任务模型能提升两者精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 葡萄抗寒性预测对农业生产至关重要，影响种植者是否采取昂贵的防冻措施。然而抗寒性随天气变化且难以直接在田间测量，不同品种间响应差异大，且每个品种的地面真实数据时间稀疏且有限，这使得单任务建模效果不佳，需要探索多任务学习方法来整合有限数据。

Method: 采用循环神经网络（RNN）基于时间序列天气数据进行每日抗寒性预测。将不同葡萄品种视为MTL中的不同任务，设计了多种多任务学习架构（在MTL和迁移学习两种设置下评估），此外还构建了同时学习抗寒性和芽萌发（budbreak）两个相关任务的单一MTL模型。

Result: 实验结果表明不同MTL架构之间存在显著差异，某些架构能够持续优于单任务学习方法和最先进的科学模型；在性质不同但相关的芽萌发预测任务上也得到类似结论；同时学习两个任务的单一MTL模型能同时提升抗寒性和芽萌发预测的准确性。

Conclusion: 多任务学习是在数据稀疏和标签时间稀疏条件下进行时间过程建模的有效策略，合理设计的MTL架构能够充分利用不同品种及不同任务之间的相关信息，优于单任务学习和传统科学模型，为农业领域的预测建模提供了可参考的实用方案。

Abstract: We present a real-world case study of multi-task learning (MTL) for temporal process modeling from limited data with temporally sparse labels. Specifically, we investigate multi-task learning for the important agricultural problem of predicting grape cold hardiness, which is the temperature at which lethal freezing occurs. Cold hardiness changes in response to weather and is difficult to measure directly in the field. Thus, growers rely on predictions to decide when to apply costly frost mitigation measures. We apply recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for daily cold-hardiness prediction from time series weather data. A major challenge is that the cold hardiness response varies across plant cultivars and ground-truth data for each cultivar is temporally sparse and limited. To address this challenge, we investigate multi-task learning (MTL) approaches for combining data, where different tasks correspond to different cultivars. We develop a variety of MTL architectures and evaluate them in both MTL and transfer learning settings. Our results show significant differences between architectures and that certain architectures are able to consistently outperform single-task learning and state-of-the-art scientific models. Additionally, we show similar results for the qualitatively different, but related, task of budbreak prediction. Further, improved accuracy for budbreak and cold hardiness is achieved by a single MTL model that simultaneously learns both tasks.

</details>


### [968] [ThinkPrior: Zero-Rollout Difficulty Priors for Cold-Start Prompt Selection in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09075)
*Tommy Sha,Skylar Zhai,Siqi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ThinkPrior方法，利用外部验证器预先评估提示难度，为增量选择提供零rollout的Beta先验，替代基于历史的选择策略。该方法在处理RLVR中GRPO的静默组（组内全对或全错导致优势为零）问题上，无需牺牲目标策略rollout即可建立难度先验，显著减少早期静默组和浪费的rollout。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，GRPO的奖励-优势项依赖组内奖励差异。当一组rollout全对或全错时，组相对优势为零，形成"静默组"，不产生奖励优势梯度。然而均匀采样会把39%的rollout浪费在这些静默组上。基于历史的选择方法需要先花费目标策略rollout来估计难度，存在冷启动浪费问题。

Method: ThinkPrior在离线单次遍历中使用外部锚点（验证器打分的锚点通过率）构建零rollout的难度先验。该方法对Beta后验采用外部锚点初始化，根据预期可学习性选择提示，并随后从训练结果中更新后验。该方法不改变损失函数或优化器，与DAPO兼容。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B的16个种子上，ThinkPrior使早期静默组减少一半以上，步骤30内浪费的rollout减少近五分之一，且最终准确率无显著差异。在250提示池中，固定预算结果是重分配而非净节省。ThinkPrior+DAPO组合使生成的rollout减少10.6%，两臂保持相同的3840-rollout更新预算。

Conclusion: ThinkPrior通过外部验证器先验消除了冷启动问题，在不改变训练目标的前提下有效减少静默组带来的rollout浪费。先验在首次选择前不需要目标策略rollout，但后验后续使用目标策略结果进行更新，实现高效提示选择。

Abstract: In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trained with group relative policy optimization (GRPO), the KL-free reward-advantage term studied here depends on within-group reward variation. If all rollouts in a group are correct or all are wrong, their group-relative advantages are identically zero; these zero-advantage silent groups provide no reward-advantage gradient, yet uniform sampling spends 39% of a run's rollouts on them. History-based prompt selection must first spend target-policy rollouts to estimate difficulty, creating a cold start with rollout waste; ThinkPrior instead uses an external anchor in one offline pass to construct a zero-rollout difficulty prior before the first target-policy rollout. The verifier-scored anchor pass rate supplies an external-anchor initialization for a Beta posterior; ThinkPrior selects by expected learnability and then updates from training outcomes, changing neither the loss nor the optimizer. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B across sixteen seeds, ThinkPrior more than halves early silent groups and cuts wasted rollouts through step 30 by nearly a fifth, while we detect no difference in final accuracy. On this 250-prompt pool the fixed-budget result is a reallocation rather than a net saving. The measured ThinkPrior+DAPO composition reduces generated rollouts by 10.6% while both arms retain the same 3840-rollout update budget. The prior requires no target-policy rollout before the first selection, but the posterior thereafter uses target-policy outcomes.

</details>


### [969] [Curriculum Learning as Transport: Understanding Curricula with Wasserstein Geodesics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09099)
*Changho Shin,David Alvarez-Melis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Wasserstein课程路径框架，将课程学习解耦为训练分布在离散难度级别上的轨迹，通过12个任务和33个难度轴的系统实验发现课程效果高度依赖上下文，单一策略无法在所有场景中占优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 课程学习受多个耦合设计选择共同支配（难度定义、样例排序、每级暴露量、跨级训练速度），导致难以隔离真正有效的因素。现有研究无法厘清各因素的独立贡献。

Method: 提出基于最优传输（Wasserstein距离）的课程路径框架，将课程表示为训练分布在离散难度级别上的轨迹，从而解耦排序(ordering)、匹配暴露(exposure)、端点平滑性(endpoint smoothness)和节奏(pacing)等因素，并在校准的合成任务套件上进行受控实验。

Result: 课程效果强烈依赖上下文：无单一策略在所有任务、难度轴和预算下占优；课程主要改变固定预算的分配位置。Easy-to-hard排序相对暴露匹配的静态采样提升了困难级别性能，证明收益不能仅由累积暴露解释；端点平滑性和节奏对课程有效作用的位置有显著影响。

Conclusion: 传输视角提供解耦课程设计因素的统一框架，能自然扩展到基于几何的学习节奏和超越一维排序的结构化难度空间。

Abstract: Curriculum learning is governed by several coupled design choices---how difficulty is defined, how examples are ordered, how much exposure each level receives, and how quickly training moves across levels---making it hard to isolate what actually helps. We present Wasserstein curriculum paths, a simple transport-based framework that decouples these factors by representing curricula as trajectories of training distributions over discrete difficulty levels. Across a calibrated synthetic suite with 12 tasks and 33 difficulty axes, we use this framework to isolate the effects of ordering, matched exposure, endpoint smoothness, and pacing under fixed training budgets. We find that curriculum effects are strongly context-dependent: no single strategy dominates across tasks, difficulty axes, and budgets, and curricula mainly change where a fixed budget is spent most effectively. Within this framework, easy-to-hard ordering improves hard-level performance relative to exposure-matched static sampling, showing that the benefit is not explained by cumulative exposure alone. We further show that endpoint smoothness and pacing substantially affect where along the difficulty spectrum a curriculum is effective. Finally, we show that the same transport view naturally supports extensions to learned pacing through geometry and to structured difficulty spaces beyond one-dimensional orderings.

</details>


### [970] [When Does Scale-Invariant Optimization Become Unstable? An Exact Schedule Law with Weight Decay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09116)
*Hasan Amin,Wei-Kai Chang,Rajiv Khanna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了一个支配归一化神经网络优化动力学（scale-invariant optimization）的单一标量法则：该标量同时捕捉学习率调度与权重衰减的作用，而范数增长产生几何自猝灭效应。离散时间动力学中存在清晰边界区分收缩主导与扩张主导的有效学习率，且该平衡点本质上不稳定，导致恒定学习率与权重衰减下产生往复行为。统一齐次优化器框架揭示了自适应方法在自猝灭强度上的结构性二分，解释了其为何在归一化下表现出系统性更弱的稳定化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 归一化使得神经网络的大部分结构呈尺度不变性，产生了隐藏的反饋回路：学习率调度与权重衰减通过参数范数相互作用以控制优化器实际步长。作者希望解析这一复杂交互，寻找一个统一的定量规律来理解和控制训练动力学，并解释不同优化器在归一化下的行为差异。

Method: 1) 推导精确的离散时间标量法则，刻画调度与衰减强迫与范数增长率之间的自猝灭平衡；2) 对完全可解的归一化回归模型进行精确分析，将动力学降维至二维并证明平衡点内在不稳定；3) 提出统一齐次优化器框架（unified homogeneous-optimizer framework），揭示不同优化器在自猝灭强度上的结构二分；4) 在多种网络（MLP、CNN、GPT2）与数据集（MNIST、CIFAR、wikiText、OpenWebText）上验证预测定律。

Result: 理论预测的定律在多种动力学系统、网络结构和数据集上以高精度成立。该标量可直接用于控制训练，且性能在预测边界处出现尖锐峰值。框架还提供了首性原理解释：为何自适应优化方法（如Adam类）在归一化下表现出系统性较弱的稳定化效果——其自猝灭强度结构上更弱。

Conclusion: 归一化优化动力学可归结为单一支配标量，它精确捕捉了学习率调度、权重衰减、参数范数增长之间的反馈交互。该发现为尺度不变优化提供了精确且可操作的视角，对训练动力学理解、优化器行为分析和学习率调度设计均有直接指导意义。

Abstract: Normalization renders large parts of neural networks effectively scale invariant, inducing a hidden feedback loop in which learning-rate schedules and weight decay interact through the parameter norm to control the effective step taken by the optimizer. We show that this interaction is governed by an exact discrete-time law: a single scalar quantity captures all schedule and decay forcing, while norm growth induces an opposing geometric self-quenching effect. This yields a sharp boundary that cleanly separates contraction- and expansion-dominated effective learning rate regimes. To understand the underlying mechanism, we provide exact analysis of a fully solved normalized regression model where the dynamics reduce to two dimensions and show that the balance point is intrinsically unstable, implying that constant learning rate with weight decay cannot stably maintain an interior equilibrium and instead produces recurrent behavior driven by discrete-time Jacobian structure. We further extend this perspective across optimizers through unified homogeneous-optimizer framework that reveals a structural dichotomy in self-quenching strength, providing a first-principles explanation for why adaptive methods exhibit systematically weaker stabilization under normalization.
  Across dynamical systems and neural networks (MLP, CNN, GPT2 / MNIST, CIFAR, wikiText, OpenWebText), the predicted law holds with high precision and enables direct control of training via the identified scalar, with performance peaking sharply at the predicted boundary. Together, these results isolate a single governing quantity for scale-invariant optimization, providing a precise and actionable lens on training dynamics, optimizer behavior, and schedule design in modern deep learning. Code is available in https://github.com/shasanamin/normalized-optimization-dynamics.

</details>


### [971] [Nearly Tight Rademacher Bounds for Sparsely Activated Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09130)
*Xiaoyu Li,Zhizhou Sha,Jiaojiao Jiang,Junbin Gao,Andi Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了单隐层ReLU网络中"输入相关稀疏性"（不同输入激活不同隐单元）的统计复杂度。针对宽度为s、每个输入最多激活k个单元的网络，证明了经验Rademacher复杂度边界为O(WR·min{k,√(sk/m)·log^{3/2}(2m)} + kB/√m)，去除了显式维度因子。文中还分析了输入域的影响：在整球上稀疏的零偏置网络最多只有2k个有效单元，而偏置与WR可比时恢复最坏情况速率。最后给出了agnostic minimax excess-risk界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解ReLU网络泛化能力的关键在于刻画其统计复杂度。现有工作（如Awasthi等人在COLT 2024的工作）针对固定激活模式的网络给出了分析，但实际中不同输入会激活网络的不同子集，这种输入相关的稀疏性会导致挑战性的统计问题。作者希望量化这种稀疏性如何影响泛化界，并澄清输入域结构在其中的作用。

Method: 采用支持保持覆盖（support-preserving cover）和归一化chaining论证来推导Rademacher复杂度上界，消除先前结果中的显式维度因子（仅保留对数项）。通过构造合适的i.i.d.边际分布给出匹配的下界。对于输入域影响的分析，利用球形帽（spherical-cap）构造来证明偏置可比情况下的最坏情况速率，该构造不依赖于采样支持上的稀疏假设。

Result: 获得经验Rademacher复杂度上界CWR·min{k,√(sk/m)·log^{3/2}(2m)} + kB/√m，并通过匹配下界表明该界在达到对数项内是紧的（宽度依赖保持不变）。发现零偏置网络在整球上稀疏时最多只有2k个非零单元，复杂度降至O(kWR/√m)；而偏置与WR可比时，在同一域上恢复最坏情况速率（仅对数维度）。还获得了agnostic minimax excess-risk界min{1,√(s/(km))}（达到对数项）。

Conclusion: 输入相关的稀疏性确实降低了ReLU网络的统计复杂度，但即使允许k个激活单元随输入变化，宽度s对复杂度的某些影响仍然无法完全消除。输入域（球vs采样支持）和偏置条件对稀疏性带来的收益有决定性影响：在整球域上稀疏性更强地约束了可实现的网络结构，而偏置的存在则可对抗这种约束。这些结果加深了对ReLU网络泛化行为的理解。

Abstract: An input may activate few hidden units even when different inputs collectively use an entire network. We study the statistical complexity of this input-dependent sparsity in the one-hidden-layer ReLU model of Awasthi et al. (COLT 2024). For width $s$, at most $k$ active units per input, and effective weight and bias bounds $W,B$, every size-$m$ sample in the class's fixed radius-$R$ input domain satisfies $\mathcal{R}(S)\le CWR\min\{k,\sqrt{sk/m}\log^{3/2}(2m)\}+kB/\sqrt m$. A support-preserving cover and a single normalized chaining argument remove the previous explicit dimension factor, up to logarithms. Lower bounds on appropriate i.i.d. marginals match up to those logarithms, showing how changing active units across inputs retains a width dependence. The input domain matters: zero-bias networks sparse on the entire ball have at most $2k$ nonzero units and complexity $O(kWR/\sqrt m)$, whereas bias bounds comparable to $WR$ restore the worst-case rate on that same domain in only logarithmic dimension. A spherical-cap construction proves the latter claim without assuming sparsity merely on the sampling support. For a specified normalized bounded loss and biases comparable to $WR$, we also obtain agnostic minimax excess-risk bounds of order $\min\{1,\sqrt{s/(km)}\}$ up to logarithms.

</details>


### [972] [NOAH: Learning the Full Patient Journey. A Longitudinal Multimodal Time-Aware Model for Representation and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09140)
*Tobias Susetzky,Raphael Rehms,Dmitrii Seletkov,Özgün Turgut,Michelle Espranita Liman,Lisa Steinhelfer,Rickmer Braren,Daniel Rueckert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NOAH是一个时间感知、任务无关的生成式Transformer模型，用于表示和预测完整的多模态患者旅程。它在MIMIC数据集家族的559百万+临床事件上训练，原生处理医学图像、时间序列、数值信号、分类事件及结构化/非结构化临床记录，支持自回归预测、零样本分类和反事实干预模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI模型难以捕捉真实世界多模态患者数据中复杂、不规则的时序动态和内在随机性。现有方法多为判别式、局限于少数模态、受限于封闭分类词汇表、将时间视为单调的归纳偏置，且在预测未来患者状态方面能力有限。

Method: 引入双向时间集成机制和变分潜在空间，用于捕捉患者状态的连续演化及临床轨迹的随机性。模型为生成式Transformer架构，在MIMIC数据集家族（559百万+临床事件，来自299,000名患者、431,000次医院就诊）上训练，原生支持多种模态数据，实现具有可选时间控制的自回归预测、零样本分类与反事实干预模拟。

Result: NOAH生成高度信息丰富且具预测性的患者状态表征，在临床结局探测、15个ICD章节、29种合并症的探测中表现优异，并在时间到事件预测中表现出色。

Conclusion: NOAH是首个真正全面的多模态生成式患者建模模型，能够无缝处理多种模态与复杂时间动态，为个性化临床护理和数字医学中的智能预测系统提供了多用途、任务无关且可扩展的基础。

Abstract: The digitization of healthcare has generated vast, longitudinal, and multimodal patient records over a lifetime, yet fully exploiting these data to represent and predict patient state trajectories remains a critical challenge. Current AI models often struggle to capture the complex, irregular temporal dynamics and inherent stochasticity of real-world multimodal patient data. Existing AI approaches for modeling longitudinal patient records are predominantly discriminative, limited to a few modalities, constrained by closed categorical vocabularies, treating time as a monotonic inductive bias, or they are limited in forecasting future patient states. We introduce NOAH, a time-aware, task-agnostic, generative transformer model representing and forecasting the full multimodal patient journey. NOAH features a novel bidirectional time integration and a variational latent space to capture the continuous evolution of patient states and the stochasticity of clinical trajectories. Built from over 559 million clinical events from 431,000 hospital visits of 299,000 patients across the MIMIC dataset family, NOAH natively processes medical images, time-series and numeric signals, categorical events, as well as structured and unstructured clinical records. NOAH is the first truly holistic generative model in its field, enabling autoregressive forecasting with optional time control, zero-shot classification, and counterfactual intervention simulation. It generates highly informative and predictive patient state representations that demonstrate strong performance in probing for clinical outcomes, 15 ICD chapters, and 29 comorbidities, as well as in time-to-event prediction. Seamlessly handling diverse modalities and complex temporal dynamics, NOAH provides a versatile, task-agnostic, scalable foundation for intelligent predictive systems in personalized clinical care and digital medicine.

</details>

### [973] [Optimizing Train Driving to Minimize the Electricity Cost of an Entire Railway Traffic Mesh using Evolutionary Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05493)
*Eduardo Pilo de la Fuente,Sudip K. Mazumder,Maria Antonia Simon*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种优化列车驾驶方式的流程，在满足运行约束（如允许速度和行程时长）的同时，最小化列车供电相关的成本（包括能耗成本和功率容量利用成本）。该流程结合了交通模型（整合每条铁路服务在交通网格中的能量和功率足迹）与进化计算框架（搜索最优驾驶方式以实现最优交通网格）。该方法应用于西班牙马德里至巴塞罗那高速铁路450公里路段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 铁路运营中列车驾驶方式对能源成本和电力容量利用成本有显著影响，需要在满足运营约束（速度、行程时间）的前提下，优化驾驶策略以降低供电成本。现有方法可能未同时考虑能耗成本和功率容量成本，需要一种综合优化方法。

Method: 该流程包含两个核心组成部分：(i) 一个交通模型，将每条铁路服务在交通网格中的能源和功率足迹进行整合；(ii) 一个进化计算框架，用于搜索实现最优交通网格所需的最优列车驾驶方式。两者结合共同寻求满足约束条件下的成本最小化。

Result: 该方法被应用于西班牙马德里至巴塞罗那高速铁路的一段450公里长线路，取得实际应用效果。

Conclusion: 通过将交通能量/功率模型与进化算法相结合，能够系统性地优化列车驾驶策略，在保证运营约束的前提下有效降低能源供给成本。

Abstract: This paper presents a procedure to optimize the way trains are driven, which pursues, in addition to fulfilling operational constraints such as admissible speeds or journey durations, the minimization of the cost related to supplying electrical energy to the trains, including the cost of the energy consumption and the cost of the power capacity utilization. This procedure combines: (i) a traffic model that merges the energy and power footprint of each rail service part of the traffic mesh, and (ii) an evolutionary computation framework that enables searching for the optimal way to drive the trains to achieve an optimal traffic mesh. This procedure is applied to a 450 km long section of the high-speed line from Madrid to Barcelona (Spain).

</details>


### [974] [Programmable Cellular Automata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06102)
*Ahmed Khalifa,Muhammad Umair Nasir,Matthew Siper,Steve James,Julian Togelius*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出可编程元胞自动机（Programmable Cellular Automata），将元胞自动机表示为Python代码，并模块化为局部函数和决策函数，同时引入全局函数来处理整体状态信息。作者在PCG基准测试的三个游戏关卡生成任务上进行了实验，发现全局函数能减少求解所需的迭代次数，且纯局部函数无法解决某些问题。分析生成的函数揭示了跨实验共有的常见函数，有助于理解生成器及游戏的关键要素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的元胞自动机局部规则难以设计且不直观，即使通过进化算法生成也难以解释。作者希望提高元胞自动机的可解释性和可编程性，使系统更易理解和有效解决问题。

Method: 将元胞自动机表示为Python代码，分为两部分：局部函数（对局部邻域计算并返回值）和决策函数（根据局部函数的输出决定下一状态）。此外引入全局函数，输入为整个状态并计算结果。测试环境为PCG基准中的三个游戏关卡生成任务。

Result: 实验表明：全局函数能够减少元胞自动机求解问题所需的迭代次数；某些问题仅靠纯局部函数无法找到解。对生成函数的分析发现不同实验中存在共同使用的函数，这既有助于理解生成器本身，也有助于理解这些游戏和其关键特征。

Conclusion: 可编程元胞自动机通过模块化和Python代码表达增强了可解释性，全局函数的加入扩展了表达能力并提升了求解效率，生成函数分析还能揭示游戏的重要特征。

Abstract: Cellular automata is a local computation paradigm where complex behavior can arise from local interactions between simple functions. This paradigm has been used to explain many systems such as biological processes, traffic simulation, computer networks, etc. In games, cellular automata have been used in games such as SimCity and for the generation of spatial content such as caves or dungeons. However, creating effective local rules is hard and unintuitive. Cellular automata can be effectively evolved, but may still be hard to interpret. In this work, we introduce the concept of programmable cellular automata, where we represent the system as Python code. We also modularize the cellular automata into local functions and a decision function. Local functions take a local neighborhood and return a value, while the decision function takes the output of the local functions and decides the value of the next state. Separating the cellular automata into modules written in Python helps with understanding how these systems are working. We also explore adding global functions where they take the whole state and compute a function from it. We tested generating levels for three different games from the PCG Benchmark. The results showed that global functions decrease the number of iterations that cellular automata need to solve a problem, and that we cannot find solutions for some problems with purely local functions. Looking into the generated functions, we can see common functions that have been used in different experiments, which not only helps us understand the generator but also helps us understand these games better and what is important for them.

</details>


### [975] [Photonic reservoir computing with dimensionally compressed readout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07418)
*Gerald Kobi,Mohab Abdalla,Miguel C. Soriano,Damien Rontani*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文研究储层计算中的硬件约束问题（读出层尺寸受限），提出基于随机投影的策略，将高维储层状态压缩到低维子空间。通过任务无关指标和NARMA10基准测试，证明随机投影框架在特定压缩范围内可以优于独立受约束储层，为绕过硬件读出瓶颈提供可扩展路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在硬件实现的储层计算系统中，物理读出层的尺寸受到硬件限制，这限制了储层计算的整体性能。作者希望通过随机投影策略在保持信息处理能力的同时，绕过这一硬件读出瓶颈。

Method: 采用随机投影将高维储层状态压缩到低维子空间；比较小型独立延时储层与大型配置（输出投影至相同受限读出维度）两种方案；使用任务无关指标评估信息处理容量分布；进行全面的超参数扫描以评估不同物理机制下的行为；在NARMA10任务上进行基准测试。

Result: 在相同读出尺寸下，两种配置的信息处理容量分布可能不同；随机投影框架在特定压缩范围内相比独立受约束储层能获得更优的NARMA10任务性能。

Conclusion: 随机投影提供了一种可扩展的手段来绕过基于硬件的储层计算中的物理读出瓶颈，为未来硬件实现提供理论指导。

Abstract: This work addresses a hardware constraint in reservoir computing: the limited size of the readout layer imposed by systems with a physical readout. We investigate a strategy to accommodate this constraint based on random projection, which compresses high-dimensional reservoir states into a lower-dimensional subspace while preserving key properties of the source space and information- processing capabilities. To evaluate this approach, we compare a small, standalone time delay reservoir against a larger configuration whose output is projected down to match the same restricted readout dimension. Using task-independent metrics, we demonstrate that the distribution of information-processing capacities may differ between the two configurations, even at identical readout sizes. Furthermore, we perform a comprehensive hyperparameter scan to assess how both systems behave under varying physical regimes. Finally, we benchmark this approach on the standard NARMA10 task, showing that the random projection framework can yield superior performance compared to a standalone constrained reservoir, within specific compression range. These results provide a scalable pathway to bypass physical readout bottlenecks in hardware-based reservoir computing.

</details>


### [976] [A Gradient-based yet Spike-Timing-Dependent Solution to the Feedback Learning Problem in Neural Microcircuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08070)
*Xiangnan Zhang,Jingxin Liu,Ranqi Lu,Jingyu Liu,Qunxi Dong,Fuze Tian,Lixian Zhu,Bin Hu,Björn W. Schuller*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于梯度隧道（GT）算法和前导-滞后展开技术的在线反馈学习框架，将时间信用分配重新表述为状态分离问题，使神经微电路（NMCs）能够仅通过局部突触尖峰时序进行学习，解决了二十年来NMC反馈学习的难题，并在长时程证据整合和真实基准测试中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大脑使用离散尖峰进行动态计算，但神经微电路如何利用局部尖峰时序解决时间信用分配（temporal credit assignment）仍是一个基本未解问题。现有的尖峰神经网络方法大多通过代理梯度近似反向传播，使学习过程与生物尖峰时序脱节，缺乏计算神经科学上的合理性。

Method: 1) 将时间信用分配重新表述为状态分离问题：直接从当前神经状态中提取由历史扰动诱导的任务所需组件。2) 提出梯度隧道（Gradient Tunneling, GT）算法，实现在线反馈学习。3) 采用前导-滞后展开（lead-lag expansion）技术，从局部突触尖峰时序中推导出信用分配，同时保持与ANN-SNN混合架构的兼容性。

Result: GT训练的NMC在长时程证据整合和抗噪记忆保持方面表现优异；在真实基准测试上，其性能可与领先的SNN在线学习方法相媲美，且使用的参数数量显著更少。

Conclusion: 该框架解决了神经微电路反馈学习这一长达二十年的难题，并为主观上大脑的学习机制提供了一种计算上合理（computationally plausible）的解释，弥合了生物尖峰时序与机器学习算法之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: The brain uses discrete spikes for dynamic computation, yet, how neural microcircuits (NMCs) solve temporal credit assignment using local spike timing remains a fundamental open question. Dominant spiking neural network (SNN) approaches circumvent this by approximating backpropagation through surrogate gradients, decoupling learning from biological spike timing. Here, we reformulate temporal credit assignment as a state separation problem: extracting task-required components induced by historical perturbations directly from the current neural state. This enables an online feedback learning framework for NMCs through a gradient tunneling (GT) algorithm and the lead-lag expansion technique that derives credit assignment from local synaptic spike timing, while remaining compatible with ANN-SNN hybrid architectures. Experimentally, GT-trained NMCs excel at long-timescale evidence integration and noise-robust memory retention, and perform comparably to leading SNN online learning methods on real-world benchmarks with far fewer parameters. The proposed framework addresses the two-decade-old NMC feedback learning problem and suggests a computationally plausible explanation for the brain's learning mechanisms.

</details>

### [977] [Memory as Infrastructure: Reliability Engineering for Persistent Agent Memory in Months-Long LLM-Assisted Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05510)
*Mike Helwig*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文报告了一个为期数月的项目级LLM编码智能体持续运行经验，介绍了SIx Harness——一个开源的记忆与连续性基础设施，包含本地混合检索长期记忆、精度门控上下文注入、防复发存储，以及针对记忆子系统本身的可靠性工程（会话健康门、心跳遥测、告警疲劳预算）。基于78,933次hook调用和85次记录故障的运营数据，提炼出七项设计原则并发布预注册消融协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM编码智能体正从任务级迈向项目级——单次持续数月的协助工作，需要跨多次上下文压缩运行，代码库远大于任何上下文窗口。现有实践缺乏对智能体记忆子系统的可靠性工程关注，缺少可度量的长期运营记录和可复现的评估协议。

Method: SIx Harness将多个组件结合起来：(1)基于SQLite的混合词法-向量检索完全本地长期记忆；(2)精度门控的上下文注入；(3)针对决策和死胡同的反复发存储；(4)能在压缩中存活的约定；(5)记忆子系统自身的可靠性工程——会话启动健康门（区分故障模式）、心跳遥测（确保无故障被枚举遗漏）、借鉴SRE实践的告警疲劳预算。

Result: 提供了首个数月经度、经过仪器测量的持久智能体记忆子系统在生产开发中的运营记录：78,933次hook调用；85次记录故障全部非静默（前3周84次，此后1次，最后20天为零）；注入层十天精度仪表显示零误报；三次生产事故从仪表读数追溯到结构性修复。

Conclusion: 从记录中提炼出七项设计原则，明确说明局限性（N=1、无对照组、自我报告），并发布了带标签的预注册消融协议，任何团队都可用已发布的MIT许可工具包运行。

Abstract: LLM coding agents are crossing from task-scale to project-scale: single assisted efforts that run for months, across repeated context compactions, on codebases far larger than any context window. We report operational experience from one such effort (a research project under a single continuous Claude Code session line since January 2026, driving a 633,000-line codebase, with its memory subsystem continuously instrumented since July 2026) and describe SIx Harness, the open-source memory and continuity infrastructure that emerged from keeping it coherent.
  The harness combines per-project long-term memory (hybrid lexical-vector retrieval over SQLite, fully local), precision-gated context injection, anti-recurrence stores for decisions and dead-ends, conventions engineered to survive compaction, and, the part we argue is missing from operational practice, reliability engineering for the memory subsystem itself: a session-start health gate with discriminated failure modes, heartbeat telemetry designed so that no enumerated failure mode can pass unrecorded, and alert-fatigue budgeting borrowed from SRE practice.
  We present what we believe is the first months-scale instrumented operational record of a persistent agent-memory subsystem in production development use: 78,933 hook invocations; 85 recorded failures, none silent: 84 in the subsystem's first three weeks, one since, none in the final 20 days; an injection layer whose ten-day precision instrument shows zero false fires against an intact denominator; and three production incidents traced from instrument reading to structural fix. From the record we distill seven design principles, state our limitations plainly (N=1, no control arm, self-reported), and publish a tagged pre-registered ablation protocol that any team can run with the released MIT-licensed kit.

</details>


### [978] [Look Before You Prompt, and After: Scaffolding Human-AI Collaboration in Software Tutorial Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05563)
*Avinash Bhat,Vy Bui,Jin L. C. Guo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过分析对17名技术作家的访谈，识别出他们使用LLM编写软件教程时的三项需求，并设计了一个名为dBlocks的工具，支持内容分块、上下文管理和内联代码执行验证。通过5人用户研究和16人的受试者内实验，证明该工具显著提升了写作者对教程内容的信心，减少了验证摩擦，并避免了在冗长聊天记录中搜索的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多数LLM工具为写作者提供很少支持，缺乏帮助其组装、结构化多个LLM响应，策划模型使用的上下文，以及验证生成内容的系统化方法。

Method: 首先对17名技术作家进行访谈以提炼需求，随后采用以人为中心的设计方法，通过5人用户研究迭代精化设计，最终构建dBlocks工具，包含：用于限定内容范围的数据块、用于编辑上下文的上下文管理器、以及用于验证代码的内联执行。最后进行16人的受试者内对照实验。

Result: 与参与者自选的LLM辅助写作工作流相比，用dBlocks制作的教程获得显著更高的写作者信心。工具减少了验证摩擦，使写作者在起草过程中就验证代码（而非推迟或跳过），并通过将教程各节与对应LLM对话保存在同一数据块中，避免写作者搜索冗长聊天记录。

Conclusion: 工作为在软件工程工作流中搭建人机协作的工具提供了启示，证明以人为中心的设计方法可指导LLM集成工具的开发。

Abstract: With LLMs, creating software tutorials now involves steering the model's output and shaping it into a coherent, accurate learning resource, yet existing LLM tools offer writers little support for this work. By analyzing interviews with technical writers ($N=17$), we identify three requirements for how they assemble and structure multiple LLM responses, curate the context the model uses, and verify the generated content. We designed a tool called dBlocks with the following features: blocks to scope content, a context manager to edit context, and inline execution to verify code. Following a human-centered design method, we iteratively refined the design through a user study ($N=5$). In a within-subjects lab study ($N=16$) comparing dBlocks with participants' preferred workflows for LLM-assisted authoring, participants reported significantly higher confidence in the tutorials they produced with dBlocks. In addition, the tool reduced friction in verification, with writers verifying code as they drafted rather than deferring or skipping it, and helped them avoid searching long chat histories by scoping their work into blocks that kept each tutorial section and its LLM conversation together. More broadly, our work offers implications for tools that scaffold human-AI collaboration in SE workflows and shows how human-centered design can guide the development of LLM-integrated tools.

</details>


### [979] [Grounded Skill Synthesis from Code at Scale for Agentic Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05571)
*Yongqi Tong,Pan Wang,Hang Wang,Jianshe Li,Xin Zhang,Jiang-Ming Yang,Wei Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Code2Skill是一个全自动流水线，从GitHub源代码中提取并验证可复用的智能体技能（skills），构建了包含1,006,822条经过验证的技能记录的CodeSkillBank。在72项评估中，使用该技能库的模型平均性能提升11.7%，在57个案例中优于基线，并且超越基于轨迹的技能库方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复用的技能为智能体提供可迁移的程序性知识，但现有方法存在局限：基于轨迹的综合需要与环境交互，而基于文档的技能缺乏可执行的验证证据。源代码提供了一条互补路径——无需先前的智能体经验，但能提供可执行的验证基础。

Method: Code2Skill是一个全自动流水线，包含三步：(1) 从选定的代码单元中提取原子操作、复合工作流和重复模式等实施锚定记录；(2) 通过"源体盲重建"（source-body-blind reconstruction）和"源感知比较"（source-aware comparison）验证每条记录；(3) 为记录附加工作流、边界、来源和源证据等元数据。

Result: 应用于19,769个热门且积极维护的GitHub仓库，产出包含1,006,822条接受记录的CodeSkillBank。在跨9种模型设置、8个基准的72项协议匹配评估中，使用检索到的CodeSkillBank技能增强的模型相比匹配基线平均提升11.7%，在57个案例中胜出。在统一下游接口下，Code2Skill在7个共享基准上全部优于基于轨迹的技能库。基于测试通过的AI生成代码合成的技能通过率达93.50%，略高于人类编写代码的93.00%。

Conclusion: Code2Skill证明了仓库源代码中蕴含的程序性知识可以转化为有根据、可验证且可迁移的智能体技能，在智能体积累足够交互经验之前即可提供有用的程序性知识，并且能够随着AI生成软件数量的增长而扩展。

Abstract: Reusable skills give agents transferable procedural knowledge, making scalable acquisition essential for extending agents beyond prior experience. Existing methods face two limitations: trajectory-based synthesis requires interactions with specific environments, while document-derived skills may lack executable evidence and verification. Source code offers a complementary path: it requires no prior agent experience yet provides executable evidence for grounding abstractions. We present Code2Skill, a fully automated pipeline that transforms selected code units into implementation-anchored records of atomic operations, composite workflows, and recurring patterns, then verifies each record through source-body-blind reconstruction and source-aware comparison. Applied to 19,769 popular, actively maintained GitHub repositories, Code2Skill produces CodeSkillBank, a grounded bank of 1,006,822 accepted records with workflow, boundary, provenance, and source-evidence metadata. Across 72 protocol-matched evaluations covering nine model settings and eight benchmarks, models augmented with retrieved CodeSkillBank skills improve by 11.7% on average over matched baselines and outperform them in 57 cases. Under a unified downstream interface, Code2Skill also outperforms trajectory-derived skill banks on all seven shared benchmarks, showing that repository-derived skills can provide useful procedural knowledge before agents accumulate sufficient interaction experience. Skills synthesized from tested AI-generated code achieve a 93.50% pass rate, compared with 93.00% for human-written code, providing initial evidence that the pipeline can expand with the growing volume of AI-generated software. Overall, Code2Skill transforms procedural knowledge embedded in repositories into grounded, verifiable, and transferable agent skills.

</details>


### [980] [The Impact of GenAI on the Future of Requirements Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05667)
*Travis Breaux,Anmol Singhal*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文调查了AI（特别是LLM）对需求工程（RE）领域的变革影响，梳理了从传统RE研究到提示编程、通用SE代理的演进，并探讨了RE未来发展的两个维度：交互方式的变化和体验方式的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM和通用SE代理使编码实现成本大幅降低，软件工程的重心从编写正确代码转向表达、策划、验证和评估需求。这一转变深刻影响需求工程的研究方向，因此需要对这一变革进行系统性梳理，帮助RE研究者确定未来研究优先级。

Method: 本文采用文献综述的方法：（1）调研变革前沿的AI for RE研究现状；（2）回顾LLM的相关进展；（3）综述提示编程（将LLM指令视为SE语境下的程序）和通用SE代理（结合多种LLM进展形成半自动化SE流程）两个新兴研究领域；（4）沿两条轴线探讨RE的未来——改变与需求交互方式的因素，以及改变开发者和利益相关者（含终端用户）体验需求方式的因素。

Result: 本文系统梳理了AI for RE的过往研究、LLM进展及其在RE中的应用，识别出两条影响RE未来的关键轴线，为RE研究社区在转型期的研究方向选择提供了参考框架。

Conclusion: 需求工程正处于由LLM驱动的范式转型期，RE研究者需要重新定位研究重点，从传统的需求获取与建模转向需求的表达、策划、验证与评估等新挑战。

Abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs), are transforming how we design and build systems by increasing access to domain knowledge and by providing automation support to software engineering (SE). As implementation becomes less expensive through generalist SE agents, engineering effort shifts away from writing correct code and toward expressing, curating, verifying, and evaluating requirements. In this paper, we survey the state of the art in AI for requirements engineering (RE) research leading up to the transformation, before reviewing advances in LLMs. We survey two subsequent research areas: prompt programming, which treats LLM instructions as a program in SE vernacular, and generalist SE agents, which combine multiple LLM advances to yield semi-autonomous processes that complete SE tasks. Finally, we explore the future of requirements engineering along two axes: matters changing how we interact with requirements through the SE process, and matters changing how requirements are experienced by software developers and stakeholders more broadly, including end-users. This article aims to inform how RE researchers can navigate this transformation in the selection of future research priorities.

</details>


### [981] [Regret Dominates Surprise: Design-Time Requirements Engineering for Agentic-AI Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05692)
*Nuwayyir Almohammadi,Rami Bahsoon,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出MS-RGR机制，基于GORE框架为智能体AI系统建模和模拟安全自主性。通过新异性检测（认知惊喜）和评估性风险（认知遗憾）两个信号，解决代理应在常规自主、反思推理还是升级到人类之间决策的"三难问题"。在老年护理监测和自动驾驶场景中，100次随机模拟显示能将静默故障降至接近零，风险检测速度比传感器基线快约17.5倍。回顾性实验显示MS-RGR只能放大而非替代模型层面的安全训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体AI领域的需求工程师在评估、规约和实施安全自主性方面面临挑战，主流框架如GORE缺乏在认知不确定性下系统化处理这些挑战的机制。

Method: 提出Regret-Dominance Mechanism (MS-RGR)，利用认知惊喜（新异性检测）和认知遗憾（评估性风险）两个信号来处理三难问题：代理应在常规自主、反思推理还是升级到人类中做选择。通过LTL安全属性保持形式可追溯性，并在老年护理和自动驾驶场景中实例化。

Result: 100次随机模拟表明MS-RGR将静默故障降至接近零，风险检测比传感器基线快约17.5倍。在208个AGENTHARM场景中跨7个LLM的回顾性测试显示，该机制仅在基线安全性能强（前门拒绝率超80%）的模型上提升有害任务拒绝率（如84.1%升至90.9%）。

Conclusion: MS-RGR能够放大模型层面的安全训练效果而非替代它，作为设计时安全约束在智能体AI需求工程中的初步可行性证据。

Abstract: Requirements engineers for agentic-AI domains face challenges in evaluating, specifying, and operationalizing safe autonomy. Mainstream frameworks, such as Goal-Oriented Requirements Engineering (GORE), lack mechanisms to systematically address these challenges under epistemic uncertainty. We contribute an approach that builds on GORE to model and simulate safe autonomy in agentic-AI systems. We introduce a novel Regret-Dominance Mechanism (MS-RGR) to operationalize safe autonomy. MS-RGR uses two signals: epistemic surprise (novelty detection) and cognitive regret (evaluative risk) to address the trilemma problem: should the agent operate in routine autonomy, undergo reflective reasoning, or escalate to human? We instantiate MS-RGR in elderly care monitoring and autonomous driving. A 100-seed stochastic simulation shows MS-RGR reduces silent failures to near-zero and detects risk approximately 17.5 times faster than a sensor-only baseline, remaining formally traceable via LTL safety properties. A retrospective proxy instantiation applying the DRI gate post-hoc over execution traces from 208 AGENTHARM scenarios across seven LLMs shows the gate improves harmful-task refusal only for models with strong baseline safety (over 80% pre-gate refusal, e.g., 84.1% to 90.9%), indicating MS-RGR amplifies rather than substitutes for model-level safety training. We discuss threats to validity, positioning MS-RGR as initial feasibility evidence for design-time safety constraints in agentic-AI requirements engineering.

</details>


### [982] [Diffs vs. Whole Files: An Empirical Comparison of Iterative Edit-Based and Direct Generation for Flutter/Dart Code Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05779)
*Andrej Andrejev*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对比了代码编辑大语言模型的两种输出范式：直接生成（一次性输出整个修改文件）与基于diff的迭代生成（逐步输出局部搜索/替换编辑）。通过训练两个模型（100M从零训练的Rainbow-Pony-100M和微调的Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B）在共享的Flutter/Dart数据集上的两种范式，评估发现直接生成在编译通过率、位字节比、字符相似度和LLM法官评分等所有指标上均显著优于diff生成。作者识别出diff生成唯一占优的条件是"任务局部性"——即编辑范围短且空间局部化，主要体现在重构类和错误处理/边界情况修复这两类编辑步骤数最少的任务中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索代码编辑LLM的两种输出范式（直接生成与diff迭代生成）的性能差异，并揭示diff生成范式在何种条件下具有竞争力，从而为代码编辑模型选择训练和部署范式提供指导。

Method: 训练两个代码模型（100M从零训练和0.5B微调的Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B），每个模型在共享的Flutter/Dart数据集上分别用直接生成和diff生成两种范式训练，得到四个模型，然后在每组约1790个测试任务上评估编译通过率、位字节比、字符相似度和LLM法官评分等指标，并通过匹配ID对照和限制编译成功子集进行稳健性验证，最后识别diff生成占优的机制——任务局部性。

Result: 直接生成在所有评估指标上均显著优于diff生成，差距在控制任务难度和限制两边都能编译的代码后依然存在。diff生成仅在短且空间局部化的编辑任务上具有竞争力，其类别级优势集中在重构类和错误处理/边界情况修复这两类编辑步骤数最少的任务中。

Conclusion: 编辑型（diff-based）训练范式仅在"任务局部性"突出（即编辑短而局部）时才是合适选择，而对绝大多数代码编辑任务而言，直接生成范式是更优的策略选择。

Abstract: Large language models used for code editing can be trained and deployed in at least two output regimes: direct generation, where the model emits the entire modified file in one shot, and iterative diff-based generation ("steps"), where the model emits a sequence of localized search/replace edits applied one at a time until it signals completion or a step budget is exhausted. The diff-based regime is attractive because it mirrors how developers edit code and should require far fewer generated tokens per turn. We train two code models - a 100M-parameter model trained from scratch (Rainbow-Pony-100M) and a fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B - in both regimes on a shared Flutter/Dart dataset, and evaluate all four resulting models on a held-out set of approx 1,790 tasks per model. Direct generation substantially outperforms diff-based generation on every metric we measure - compilation/static-analysis pass rate, bits-per-byte, character-level similarity to the reference, and blinded LLM-judge ratings of goal fulfillment, correctness, and code quality - and the gap persists after controlling for task difficulty via a matched-ID comparison and when restricting to code that compiles on both sides. We then identify a single, architecture-independent mechanism behind the conditions where diff-based generation does win: it is competitive on short, spatially localized edits, and its category-level wins concentrate in exactly the two task categories - refactoring and error-handling/edge-case fixes - with the lowest mean edit-step count in our dataset. We term this task locality and discuss its implications for when an edit-based training regime is and is not the right choice for a code-editing model.

</details>


### [983] [Correct Tests Are Not Enough: Measuring and Training Oracle Conversion in Specification-Based Test Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05879)
*Yunhao Liang,Chengguang Gan,Ruixuan Ying,Hanjun Wei,Zhe Cui,Shiwen Ni*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究从自然语言规范生成测试用例时，输入质量（发现缺陷）与输出正确性（预测期望结果）之间的相互作用。通过在训练中引入可执行的奖励分解和套件级oracle转换测量，使用五输入-输出测试联合生成和加性GRPO目标，在TC-Bench基准上将全测试正确率从28.59%提升至42.54%，同时揭示了移除kill奖励可提高正确率但降低输入kill的权衡，并识别出oracle转换是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成测试需要同时满足两个条件：能暴露错误行为的输入和正确的期望输出。但这两个要求不必同步提升——模型可以通过选择更简单的输入来提高测试正确性，或者发现有用的输入但无法预测其期望输出。这种相互作用此前未被系统研究，需要理解其作为质量瓶颈的机制。

Method: 1) 生成器在一次响应中联合发出五个输入-输出测试；2) 训练期间，经过审计的参考程序提供正确性反馈，固定缺陷程序库提供两个效用信号：潜在输入kill和生成输出检查后的有效kill；3) 采用加性GRPO目标保存两个信号，且推理时不需执行；4) 通过匹配的50步消融实验和固定输入source-oracle交叉实验来区分两个因素的贡献。

Result: 三个独立训练的Qwen3.5-9B模型在步骤75时，全测试正确率从28.59%提升至42.54%，输入kill从24.06%提升至25.27%，有效全kill从12.23%提升至14.15%。消融实验表明移除kill奖励会得到更高正确率和略高的全kill，但输入kill降至21.60%。source-oracle交叉实验归因NoKill-to-FullKill差异主要来自更难的输入选择而非同一输入上的输出预测更差。

Conclusion: oracle转换被识别为可测量的瓶颈，它比输入发现更难提升。研究展示了在联合测试生成中保留输入效用反馈的优势与局限，为理解和改进测试生成中正确性与实用性之间的权衡提供了方法学框架。

Abstract: Generating tests from a natural-language specification requires both an input that exposes faulty behavior and a correct expected output. These requirements need not improve together: a model can increase test correctness by choosing easier inputs, or discover useful inputs whose expected outputs it cannot predict. We study this interaction through executable reward decomposition and suite-level oracle-conversion measurement. Our generator jointly emits five input--output tests in one response. During training, audited reference programs provide correctness feedback, while a fixed bank of faulty programs provides two utility signals: potential input kill and effective kill after checking the generated output. An additive GRPO objective preserves both signals without requiring execution at inference time. On an audited TC-Bench split with 506 training and 142 evaluation tasks, three independently trained Qwen3.5-9B runs at step 75 increase full-test correctness from 28.59\% to 42.54\%, input kill from 24.06\% to 25.27\%, and effective full kill from 12.23\% to 14.15\%. Matched 50-step ablations reveal a trade-off: removing kill rewards yields higher correctness and slightly higher full kill, but lowers input kill to 21.60\%. A fixed-input source--oracle crossover on 64 training-pool tasks attributes the principal NoKill-to-FullKill difference to harder input selection rather than worse output prediction on identical inputs. These results identify oracle conversion as a measurable bottleneck and show the benefits and limits of preserving input-utility feedback in joint test generation.

</details>


### [984] [Broken on Arrival: Silently Defective LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05881)
*Aditi Patodiya*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文审计了327个量化GGUF模型产物（305个来自Ollama官方库、22个来自HuggingFace社区），通过15项冒烟测试和164项完整评估，发现官方库存在5个静默缺陷产物（占官方产物的1.6%），涉及Qwen2.5-Coder-3B和phi3.5-mini转换。研究还发现两类新现象：小模型因极端量化被误判为损坏，以及后端依赖型故障（CUDA上退化但Metal上正常）。作者发布了审计数据集、quantcheck工具及披露报告，主张模型注册表应引入类似包注册表的验收门禁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发者越来越多地通过拉取量化GGUF产物在本地运行大语言模型，但分发管道中没有任何环节在产物到达用户前进行功能性测试，导致静默缺陷产物可能被大规模分发和使用。

Method: 对327个量化模型产物执行逐层审计流程：先运行15项冒烟测试（校准为健康产物可通过、已知损坏产物失败），可疑项再接受164项完整评估、第二个推理后端、独立分发商对同一模型和量化级别的转换作为仲裁，以及社区文件在其自身模板下重新测试。

Result: 官方库发现5个静默缺陷产物（一批4个Qwen2.5-Coder-3B转换和1个phi3.5-mini转换），在164项任务和冒烟测试中全部为零通过，而相同模型的独立转换正常工作，占官方产物的1.6%。仲裁链证明小模型产物在极端量化下只是"塌缩"而非损坏；另发现两个较老的社区转换在CUDA上严重退化但在Metal上通过，属于后端依赖型故障。

Conclusion: 模型注册表需要引入像包注册表已有的验收门禁。两个已确认的缺陷产物的输出表面统计在健康范围内，任何低噪声启发式方法都无法在不实际执行的情况下发现它们，只有执行测试才能确保量化产物质量。

Abstract: Developers increasingly run large language models locally by pulling quantized GGUF artifacts from public registries, yet nothing in the distribution pipeline functionally tests these conversions before they reach users. We executed 327 quantized code-capable model artifacts: 305 from the official Ollama library, spanning 15 model lines at every eligible quantization level at or under 8 GB, and 22 from the most-downloaded community repositories on HuggingFace. Each ran a 15-task smoke suite calibrated so that healthy artifacts pass while a known-broken one fails; suspects then faced full 164-task evaluation, a second inference backend, an independent distributor's conversion of the same model and quantization as referee, and, for community files, re-testing under the artifact's own template. The official library carries five silently defective artifacts, a batch of four Qwen2.5-Coder-3B conversions and one phi3.5-mini conversion, that solve zero of 164 tasks and zero of the smoke suite on both backends while independent conversions of the same models work: 1.6% of official artifacts, 2 of 29 model-and-size conversion groups. The adjudication chain cleared small-model artifacts that a naive threshold would condemn as broken when they are merely collapsed by extreme quantization, and it exposed two older community conversions that degrade badly on CUDA yet pass on Metal: not defective files but backend-dependent failures, a third phenomenon no registry currently tests for. Two confirmed defects produce output whose surface statistics sit inside the healthy range, invisible to any low-noise heuristic short of execution. We release the audit dataset, the quantcheck acceptance-testing tool, and disclosure reports for every confirmed defect (https://github.com/aditi-p31/quantcheck), and argue that model registries need the acceptance gate that package registries already run.

</details>


### [985] [VibeCheck: Assessing the Quality of LLM-Generated Unit Tests: A Multi-agent Empirical Study across Heterogeneous Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05978)
*Anika Tabassum,Mushahid Intesum,Md. Fahim Arefin,Tarannum Shaila Zaman*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VibeCheck是一项实证研究，评估了三个LLM驱动的IDE代理（Kiro、Antigravity和Cursor，使用Claude Sonnet 4.5）在15个学生开发仓库中生成单元测试的质量。传统指标（执行成功率和覆盖率）无法捕捉深层质量问题，该研究采用五维度评估框架（可运行性、断言强度、逻辑及边界覆盖、隔离性/确定性、可维护性）进行系统评估，发现生成测试虽然可运行但常缺乏强断言和有意义的测试覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估指标（执行成功率、代码覆盖率）过于表面化，无法全面反映LLM生成单元测试的深层质量问题，如弱断言、缺失边界情况、隔离性差和可维护性有限。需要一个更可靠的质量导向评估框架。

Method: 对15个学生开发的Python和JavaScript/TypeScript仓库，使用三个IDE代理（Kiro、Antigravity、Cursor，均以Claude Sonnet 4.5为底层模型）在仅仓库上下文、零样本条件下生成单元测试，采用五维度评估标准进行评测，并应用留一法交叉代理同行评审来比较工具和识别失败模式。

Result: 存在明显的"执行充分性差距"：生成的测试通常可运行，但经常缺乏强断言和有意义的测试覆盖。弱断言和缺失边界情况的发生频率高于阻塞性失败，表明可运行的测试仍然可能是浅层次的。

Conclusion: VibeCheck提供了一个超越通过/失败结果的、面向可靠性的LLM生成测试评估框架，揭示了仅依赖传统执行指标评估的不足。

Abstract: LLM-based IDE agents are increasingly used to generate repository-grounded unit tests, yet common evaluations often rely on execution success or coverage. These metrics can miss deeper quality issues such as weak assertions, missing edge cases, poor isolation, and limited maintainability. This paper presents VibeCheck, an empirical study of unit test generation across 15 student-developed Python and JavaScript/TypeScript repositories. We evaluate Kiro, Antigravity, and Cursor with Claude Sonnet 4.5 as the underlying agent, under repository-only, zero-shot conditions using a five-dimensional rubric covering runnability, assertion strength, logic and edge-case coverage, isolation/determinism, and maintainability. We also apply leave-one-out cross-agent peer evaluation to compare tools and identify failure patterns. Results show a clear execution-adequacy gap: generated tests are often runnable but frequently lack strong assertions and meaningful behavioral coverage. Weak assertions and missing edge cases occur more often than blocking failures, showing that runnable tests can still be shallow. VibeCheck provides a reliability-oriented framework for evaluating LLM-generated tests beyond pass/fail outcomes.

</details>


### [986] [Replications, Revisions, and Reanalyses: Managing Empirical Evidence in Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05983)
*Julian Frattini,Jannik Fischbach,Davide Fucci,Michael Unterkalmsteiner,Daniel Mendez,Robert Feldt,Richard Torkar*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于方法工程构建的研究综合框架，用于系统管理软件工程（SE）领域的实证证据及其演化，超越传统元分析只能综合精确复制的局限，支持复制、修订和再分析三种证据演化类型，从而确定研究领域的前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件工程领域的实证研究综合（research synthesis）非常罕见，且大多局限于纯叙事性综合；即使进行元分析，也只能在精确复制的条件下产生可靠结果，无法从研究变异中泛化。现有方法无法系统性地管理实证证据及其演化，限制了方差理论的效度提升。

Method: 采用方法工程（method engineering）方法，从经过验证的单个方法碎片（method fragments）构建研究综合框架。该框架将证据演化分为三种类型：复制（改进外部效度）、修订（改进内部效度）和再分析（改进结论效度），并通过明确的效度评估标准将新证据与现有证据体系建立清晰关系。

Result: 作者将该框架应用于两个研究领域，明确建模了现有证据片段之间的关系，展示了框架如何通过三种证据演化类型和清晰的效度维度评估标准来确定研究领域的前沿。

Conclusion: 该框架为SE领域提供了系统演化实证证据的视角，能够支持更有建设性和生产力的领域进步，超越了当前研究综合的最先进水平。

Abstract: One aspired outcome of empirical research on quantitative data is a variance theory, i.e., a quantification of the effect of an independent on a dependent variables. The validity of variance theories stems from the synthesis of multiple pieces of evidence, which increases its validity beyond the findings of a single study. However, research synthesis in SE is rare and if done mostly limited to purely narrative syntheses. At best, researchers perform meta-analyses to synthesize variance theories from several quantitative results. But even meta-analyses only produce reliable results when synthesizing exact replications yet fail to generalize from variations. We aim to extend the frontier of research synthesis beyond the state-of-the-art to systematically manage empirical evidence and its evolution. We apply method engineering to construct a framework for research synthesis from proven, individual method fragments. The framework allows researchers to put new evidence in a clear relation to an existing body of evidence and systematically expand knowledge about a studied phenomenon. We demonstrate the application of this framework to two fields of research by explicitly modeling the relationship between existing pieces of evidence. The framework puts three types of evolution of evidence into relation: (1) replications investigate the same hypothesis in a new context to improve external validity, (2) revisions challenge an existing hypothesis to improve internal validity, and (3) reanalyses replace analysis methods to improve conclusion validity. Through a systematic evolution of evidence and clear assessment criteria for each dimension of validity, the proposed framework can determine the frontier of a field of research. The framework provides a perspective to systematically evolve empirical evidence in SE, supporting more constructive and productive advances in our field.

</details>


### [987] [SemVul: Semantic-Enhanced Graph Neural Networks for Code Property Graph-based Vulnerability Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06035)
*Younas Affan,Leonardo Regano,Giorgio Giacinto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SemVul是一个基于代码属性图(CPG)和语义增强的漏洞检测流水线，通过结合节点级和边缘级的预训练代码嵌入，捕获程序的结构流和语义信息，在多个GNN架构和公开基准数据集上验证了其优越性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 源代码漏洞是全球网络攻击的根本原因，现有的漏洞检测方法在泛化能力和检测准确性上存在不足，需要提出能够更好地学习漏洞代码模式的方法。

Method: 提出基于代码属性图(CPG)的漏洞检测方法，结合语义级增强，集成节点级和边缘级语义嵌入（使用预训练代码嵌入技术），并系统评估多种GNN架构。

Result: SemVul在公开基准数据集上优于现有方法，展现出更好的泛化能力和更高的漏洞检测准确率，且该方法对编程语言具有通用性，支持多种架构。

Conclusion: 通过整合结构信息和语义信息，SemVul显著提升了漏洞检测性能，为漏洞检测领域提供了一种通用且高效的新方案。

Abstract: Vulnerabilities in source code are often the root cause of cyberattacks worldwide, as attackers exploit weaknesses in software to gain unauthorized access, steal data, or disrupt services. In this study, we evaluated existing research approaches and propose SemVul, a vulnerability detection pipeline that demonstrates better generalization and higher accuracy in learning vulnerable code patterns. We propose a Code Property Graph-based vulnerability-detection approach combined with semantic-level enhancement, enabling the model to capture both the program's structural flow and the semantic meaning of the code. Our approach integrates both node-level and edge-level semantic embeddings using pre-trained code embedding techniques. We systematically evaluate multiple GNN architectures on publicly available benchmark datasets. SemVul is generic with respect to the programming language and supports multiple architectures. By integrating structural and semantic information, the proposed approach improves vulnerability detection performance. Our results show that SemVul outperforms existing approaches and provides better generalization.

</details>


### [988] [SpecCoder: Specification-Aware Code Generation with Curriculum Dual-Task Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06041)
*Yixuan Li,Mingxuan Huang,Jiajing Wang,Weidong Yang,Xinyi Liu,Ben Fei,Lipeng Ma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出SpecCoder，一个规范感知的两阶段代码生成训练框架。该框架首先通过规范引导的SFT训练LLM推导结构化规范分析并基于规范生成代码，然后引入课程式双任务GRPO联合优化规范引导的生成与判别任务，以增强规范与代码行为之间的一致性。


<details>
